metadata.title: ABWA University, Faisalabad Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes ABWA University, Faisalabad as a private sector university located in the city of Faisalabad. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction across various faculties.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Pesticides (Amendment) Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971 to strengthen provisions regarding adulterated and sub-standard pesticides. It introduces stricter penalties for offenses related to pesticide quality and adds new sections concerning warranties and police assistance for inspections.

metadata.title: The Administrator General's Act, 1913
metadata.amends: Law relating to the office and duties of Administrator General
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the office, duties, and powers of the Administrator General in British India. It defines the scope of assets under administration, outlines the appointment and functions of the Administrator General, and establishes procedures for granting probate or letters of administration.

metadata.title: The Abdul Ghafoor Niazi University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Abdul Ghafoor Niazi University as a private sector body corporate with its main campus in Sargodha. It defines the university's functions, powers, and structure, including the establishment of various faculties and the composition of governing bodies like the Board of Governors.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the import, manufacture, formulation, sale, distribution, and use of pesticides in Pakistan. It establishes a framework for pesticide registration, labeling requirements, and the powers of inspectors to ensure compliance with safety standards.

metadata.title: The Akhtar Saeed University Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Akhtar Saeed University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's functions, powers, and structure, including its faculties, officers, and governing bodies.

metadata.title: The Alhamra University, Lahore, Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Alhamra University, Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's functions, powers, and governance structure, including the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

name: ALI INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Ali Institute of Education Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It outlines the Institute's functions, powers, governance structure, and authority to conduct courses, examinations, and research.

metadata.title: The Allopathic System (Prevention of Misuse) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to prevent the misuse of the allopathic system of medicine and to regulate related matters. It prohibits unqualified persons from using the title 'doctor', displaying medical degrees, performing surgeries, prescribing specific drugs, or selling certain medicines without proper labeling.

metadata.title: The Anti-terrorism Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of terrorism and sectarian violence in Pakistan. It also establishes Anti-terrorism Courts to ensure the speedy trial of heinous offences related to these issues.

metadata.title: The Antiquities Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: law relating to the preservation and protection of antiquities
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law regarding the preservation and protection of antiquities within Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'antiquity' and 'dealer', establishes an Advisory Committee, and outlines powers for acquisition, export control, and penalties for offenses related to antiquities.

name: AQUACULTURE AUTHORITY OF THE PUNJAB ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Aquaculture Authority of the Punjab Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Aquaculture Authority of the Punjab to develop the aquaculture sector and regulate the industry. It aims to facilitate private stakeholders, improve food security, create employment opportunities, and generate revenue within the province.

metadata.title: The Arbitration Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to arbitration in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as arbitration agreements, awards, and courts, while establishing procedures for appointing arbitrators, making interim orders, and setting aside awards.

name: ASIAN UNIVERSITY FOR RESEARCH AND ADVANCEMENT ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Asian University for Research and Advancement Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Asian University for Research and Advancement as a private sector body corporate with its main campus in Multan. It defines the university's structure, including its Board of Governors, Academic Council, and various faculties such as Engineering, Sciences, and Business Management.

metadata.title: The Aspire University Lahore Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Aspire University, Lahore as a private sector university in the Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

name: ASSET MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY OF PUNJAB ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Asset Management Authority of Punjab Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Asset Management Authority of Punjab to effectively manage and utilize government assets. It aims to attract investment, undertake economic projects with private investors, generate revenue, and improve service delivery.

metadata.title: The Bab-e-Pakistan Foundation Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bab-e-Pakistan Foundation to provide an institutional framework for carrying out the functions of the former Bab-e-Pakistan Trust. The Foundation is empowered to construct national memorials, promote Pakistan's arts and culture, organize cultural events, and manage related properties.

name: BABA GURU NANAK UNIVERSITY NANKANA SAHIB ACT 2020

metadata.title: Baba Guru Nanak University Nankana Sahib Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Baba Guru Nanak University Nankana Sahib in Nankana Sahib. It defines the university's structure, including its officers and authorities, and outlines its functions and powers as a body corporate.

metadata.title: The Bahauddin Zakariya University Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a University at Multan to improve teaching and research facilities in the region. It defines various authorities, officers, and committees within the university structure and outlines their powers and duties.

name: BAHAWALPUR COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF LEVY OF FEES) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Cotton Control (Validation of Levy of Fees) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of fees imposed on cotton factory occupiers, dealers, and company managers in West Pakistan. It specifically covers the period from November 27, 1949, to May 8, 1954, under the provisions of the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Act, 1949.

metadata.title: Bahawalpur Metropolitan University Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bahawalpur Metropolitan University as a private sector body corporate located in Bahawalpur. It defines the university's structure, including its patron, officers, and various authorities such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bank of Punjab as a body corporate with perpetual succession to carry on banking business in the Punjab. It defines the bank's share capital, shareholder qualifications, and governance structure including the Board of Directors.

metadata.title: The Beaconhouse National University, Lahore Act 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Beaconhouse National University, Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Boilers Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to steam-boilers in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for key terms like 'boiler' and 'steam-pipe', outlines registration requirements, and sets penalties for illegal use or tampering.

metadata.title: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to boilers and pressure vessels in Punjab. It provides for their regulation, use, construction, installation, repair, and establishes uniform rules regarding registration, inspection, and penalties for illegal use or accidents.

metadata.title: The Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the bonded labour system in Punjab to prevent economic and physical exploitation of the labour class. It declares all agreements, customs, and debts related to bonded labour void and frees bonded labourers from obligations to render such labour.

metadata.title: The Cattle-Trespass Act, 1871
metadata.repeals: Act-I of 1938
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to trespasses by cattle in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for the creation and control of pounds, the duties of pound-keepers, and procedures for seizing cattle that damage land or public infrastructure.

metadata.title: The Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act provides for more effectual control over the administration of charitable and religious trusts within Punjab. It enables interested persons to apply to the Court for directions regarding trust particulars, audits, and expenditure in suits against trustees.

metadata.title: The Charitable Endowments Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the vesting and administration of property held in trust for charitable purposes. It establishes the office of Treasurer of Charitable Endowments and outlines the procedures for appointing treasurers, transferring property, and framing schemes for its administration.

name: CHENAB UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, RAHIM YAR KHAN ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Chenab University of Science and Technology, Rahim Yar Khan Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Chenab University of Science and Technology, Rahim Yar Khan as a private sector body corporate in Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, Rector, and various faculties, while outlining its functions to provide instruction and training across multiple disciplines.

metadata.title: The Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to restrain the solemnisation of child marriages within the Punjab and applicable citizens of Pakistan. It defines a 'child' as a male under eighteen or a female under sixteen and prescribes punishments for contracting, solemnising, or permitting such marriages.

metadata.title: The Cholistan Development Authority Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Cholistan Development Authority to facilitate the speedy development and better administration of the Cholistan area in Bahawalpur Division. It defines the authority's constitution, functions, powers, duties, financial provisions, and miscellaneous matters regarding its operation.

name: CHOLISTAN UNIVERSITY OF VETERINARY AND ANIMAL SCIENCES BAHAWALPUR ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Bahawalpur Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences in Bahawalpur. It provides for advanced teaching, research, diagnostic methodologies, and treatment related to animal health services.

metadata.title: The Christian Marriage Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the solemnization of marriages for persons professing the Christian religion. It establishes procedures for granting licenses, registering marriages performed by ministers or registrars, and defining penalties for false declarations or unauthorized solemnization.

metadata.title: The Civil Defence Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: Ordinance VIII of 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides the legal framework to secure civil defence for Pakistan against hostile attacks by foreign powers. It grants the Federal Government powers to make rules regarding the constitution of Civil Defence Services, control of trade and industry, fire prevention, and the requisition of property.

metadata.title: The Civil Procedure (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes special procedures for adjudicating certain civil disputes in specific areas of West Pakistan. It empowers the Deputy Commissioner to constitute Tribunals and refers disputes to them, while barring the jurisdiction of regular courts for these matters.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the improvement of the constitution and working of certain co-operative societies in the Punjab. It establishes new rules regarding membership, committee composition, and the cessation of certain persons from apex societies.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of co-operative societies and regulates their formation, management, and dissolution. It outlines the rights and liabilities of members, duties of societies, inspection of affairs, and procedures for liquidation and arbitration.

name: COAL MINES (FIXATION OF RATES OF WAGES) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Coal Mines (Fixation of Rates of Wages) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the fixation of minimum wage rates for labour employed in coal mines and related matters. It empowers the Provincial Government to set these rates via notification and ensures that workers receive at least the specified minimum, while allowing for higher contractual rates.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This document outlines the comprehensive code governing civil procedure in British India, establishing rules for courts, jurisdiction, and the conduct of suits. It details procedures for summoning parties, executing decrees, attaching property, and handling appeals from original or appellate decrees.

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912
metadata.repeals: The Government Tenants (Punjab) Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better colonization and administration of government lands in the Punjab. It repeals the previous Government Tenants (Punjab) Act, 1893, and establishes provisions regarding tenant conditions, proprietorship rights, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Commercial Documents Evidence Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Law of Evidence specifically regarding certain commercial documents. It establishes that statements of facts in scheduled documents are themselves relevant facts and allows courts to presume the genuineness and accuracy of specific maritime, aviation, and trade-related documents.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the participation of workers in the profits of companies within the Punjab. It establishes a Workers Participation Fund and outlines the scheme for its management, investment, and distribution of benefits to eligible employees.

metadata.title: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, defining it as a Federal Republic with Islam as its state religion. It outlines the fundamental rights of citizens, the structure of the federation including provinces and territories, and mandates the elimination of exploitation while ensuring judicial independence.

metadata.title: The Contract Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act defines the formation, performance, and discharge of contracts under Pakistani law. It establishes rules regarding competent parties, free consent, voidable agreements, and contingent contracts.

metadata.title: The Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends laws relating to narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances in Pakistan. It regulates the production, processing, trafficking, treatment, and rehabilitation of addicts while establishing special courts and mechanisms for international legal assistance.

metadata.title: The Cooperative Societies (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the repayment of unsecured loans or loans that are insufficiently secured taken from Cooperative Banks and other Cooperative Societies. It mandates specific timelines for partial repayment and securing the remaining balance through mortgage, pledge, hypothecation, or assignment.

metadata.title: The COTHM Global Institute, Lahore Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the COTHM Global Institute, Lahore as a private sector body corporate. It establishes the institute's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, Academic Council, and various administrative officers, while defining their respective functions and powers.

name: COTTON GINNING AND PRESSING FACTORIES ACT, 1925

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better regulation of cotton ginning and cotton pressing factories. It establishes definitions for terms like 'bale' and 'cotton', mandates the maintenance of specific registers by factory owners, and outlines structural requirements and liability rules.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes special provisions for the trial of certain scheduled offences in specific areas of West Pakistan. It establishes a unique tribunal system and grants exclusive jurisdiction to Deputy Commissioners for cognizing these offences, overriding standard procedural laws where necessary.

metadata.title: The Court Fees' Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the levy and collection of court fees in High Courts, other courts, and public offices within Pakistan. It outlines procedures for fee computation, exemptions, refunds, and specific rules regarding probates and letters of administration.

metadata.title: The Defamation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions regarding defamation, defining it as wrongful acts or publications that injure a person's reputation. It distinguishes between slander (oral statements) and libel (written/visual forms) and establishes specific defences such as absolute and qualified privilege.

metadata.title: The Cotton Industry (Statistics) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regular submission of monthly returns regarding quantities of cotton goods manufactured and cotton yarn spun in mills within the Province of Punjab. It establishes powers for officers to inspect mills, verify records, and publish these statistical returns.

metadata.title: The Defence Housing Authority Lahore, Ordinance, 1999
metadata.repeals: Defence Housing Authority Lahore, Ordinance, 1999 (XXXI of 1999)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Defence Housing Authority Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the structure of the Governing and Executive Boards, defines the functions related to housing development, and details provisions regarding funds, land acquisition, and staff appointments.

metadata.title: The Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi as a body corporate to carry out land development schemes and projects. Its primary purpose is to provide housing and welfare facilities for bereaved families of martyrs, war-injured, disabled, and other personnel of the defence forces.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 to allow the authority to be constituted under the Development of Cities Act, 1976. It also includes savings provisions to ensure that rules, contracts, and rights established under the repealed Act remain valid unless specifically cancelled.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN EXCLUDED AREA ELECTORAL LAWS REGULATION, 1950

metadata.title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Excluded Area Electoral Laws Regulation, 1950
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies certain Rules framed under the Government of India Act, 1935 to the Excluded Area in the Punjab province west of Dera Ghazi Khan district. It came into force immediately upon receipt of assent from the Governor General on August 23, 1950.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN EXCLUDED AREA LAWS REGULATION, 1950

metadata.title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Excluded Area Laws Regulation, 1950
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes the legal framework for the peace and good government of the Dera Ghazi Khan Excluded Area. It ceases the enforcement of certain laws that were in force before the area was declared excluded while applying specific laws from August 14, 1947, to the region.

metadata.title: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the employment, rehabilitation, and welfare of disabled persons in Pakistan. It establishes structures such as National and Provincial Councils to oversee these functions and creates a specific fund for rehabilitation purposes.

metadata.title: The Dramatic Performances Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Government to prohibit public dramatic performances that are scandalous, defamatory, seditious, or obscene. It outlines the procedures for issuing prohibition orders, serving notices, and imposing penalties on those who disobey such orders or assist in prohibited performances.

metadata.title: The Drugs Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the import, export, manufacture, storage, distribution, and sale of drugs within Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms like 'drug' and 'adulterated drug', sets up administrative bodies such as the Appellate Board and Provincial Quality Control Board, and outlines offences, penalties, and procedures related to drug control.

metadata.title: The Ehtram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to observe the sanctity of the month of Ramazan in Punjab. It prohibits fasting individuals from eating, drinking, or smoking in public places and restricts the serving of eatables during fasting hours. Additionally, it mandates the closure of cinema houses and theatres from sunset until three hours thereafter.

metadata.title: The Emerson University, Multan Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Emerson University, Multan by reconstituting Government Emerson College. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its officers, authorities, statutes, and miscellaneous provisions.

metadata.title: The Employment (Record of Services) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the compulsory maintenance of service records for persons in specific classes of employment within certain areas. It establishes requirements for employers to obtain and maintain service books for employees, defines key terms such as 'employee' and 'employer', and outlines exemptions and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory registration of essential personnel at Employment Exchanges established by the Government of Pakistan. It defines essential personnel, outlines the liability to register, and establishes procedures for issuing registration certificates and handling applications.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Act, 1956; Pakistan Rehabilitation Act, 1956; Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Act, 1957; Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958; Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Act, 1958; Scrutiny of Claims (Evacuee Property) Regulation, 1961; Price of Evacuee Property and Public Dues (Recovery) Regulation, 1971
metadata.summary: This Act repeals several laws and regulations relating to evacuee property and the rehabilitation of displaced persons. It also provides for the transfer of pending proceedings to specific boards and officers for final disposal.

name: EX-EMPLOYEES OF THE FORMER GOVERNMENT OF EAST PAKISTAN (APPOINTMENT TO PROVINCIAL POSTS) ACT 1986

metadata.title: The Ex-employees of the former Government of East Pakistan (Appointment to Provincial Posts) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and conditions of service for former employees of the Government of East Pakistan to posts under the Government of the Punjab. It establishes that their previous service counts towards seniority and pension eligibility in the new roles.

name: EXCISE DUTY ON MINERALS (LABOUR WELFARE) ACT, 1967

metadata.title: The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967
metadata.repeals: Act XXXII of 1947
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an excise duty on specific minerals to finance measures promoting the welfare of labour in the mining industry. It establishes a dedicated fund for housing and general welfare, creates boards to manage these funds, and outlines the collection process and rates for the duty.

metadata.title: The Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of exit from Pakistan by certain persons. It empowers the Federal Government to prohibit individuals or classes of persons from leaving the country, even if they possess valid travel documents, without necessarily specifying grounds or providing an opportunity to show cause.

metadata.title: The Explosive Substances Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the law relating to explosive substances in Pakistan. It defines explosive substances and outlines punishments for causing explosions, attempting to cause explosions, possessing explosives under suspicious circumstances, and abetting such offenses.

metadata.title: The Explosives Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, possession, use, sale, transport, and importation of explosives. It defines various explosive substances and grants powers for licensing, prohibition, inspection, and inquiry into accidents.

metadata.title: The Extradition Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the extradition of fugitive offenders in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for the surrender of fugitives to treaty and non-treaty states, defines key terms such as 'extradition offence' and 'fugitive offender', and outlines the powers of the Federal Government regarding declarations and notifications.

metadata.title: The Eye Surgery (Restriction) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prevents non-registered medical practitioners from performing eye surgery in Pakistan. It defines specific terms like 'complete blindness' and outlines punishments, including imprisonment and fines, for unauthorized surgeries or unlawful practice.

metadata.title: The Factories Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regulating labour in factories. It establishes comprehensive rules regarding health, safety, working hours, and welfare for workers, including specific protections for children and adolescents.

metadata.title: The Faisalabad Medical University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution and upgrading of Punjab Medical College Faisalabad into Faisalabad Medical University. It establishes the university as a body corporate with powers to impart medical education, conduct research, hold examinations, and award degrees.

metadata.title: The Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Family Courts to expedite the settlement of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs. It defines the qualifications for judges, outlines jurisdiction and procedures, and specifies that these courts shall not apply to suits pending under the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 at the time of enactment.

name: FATIMA JINNAH MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LAHORE ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore by reconstituting the existing Fatima Jinnah Medical College. It provides for the university's corporate status, functions, officer appointments, and the structure of its various authorities including the Syndicate and Academic Council.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY RAWALPINDI ORDINANCE, 1999

metadata.title: The Fatima Jinnah Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the Fatima Jinnah Women University in Rawalpindi. It outlines the powers, duties, and structure of the university's various authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

name: FOODSTUFFS AND FERTILIZERS (CANCELLATION OF AUTHORIZATIONS AND DEALERSHIPS) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Foodstuffs and Fertilizers (Cancellation of Authorizations and Dealerships) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the cancellation of authorizations and dealerships related to the distribution of foodstuffs and fertilizers in the Punjab. It empowers the Government to terminate these authorizations without notice or compensation.

metadata.title: Foreign Private Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of foreign private investment in Pakistan. It establishes conditions for approval, defines terms like foreign capital and industrial undertakings, and outlines protections regarding agreements and repatriation facilities.

metadata.title: The Foreigners Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers upon the Federal Government regarding the entry, presence, and departure of foreigners into Pakistan. It establishes definitions for 'foreigner' and outlines the authority to make orders restricting movement, imposing conditions, and detaining individuals in the interest of national security.

metadata.title: The Forest Act, 1927
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for the management, reservation, and protection of forests in British India. It outlines powers regarding reserved and protected forests, duties on forest produce, procedures for timber transit, and penalties for offences related to cattle-trespass and unauthorized cutting.

metadata.title: The Forman Christian College, Lahore Act 2004
metadata.summary: This Act grants University status to the Forman Christian College, Lahore, which operates in the private sector. It establishes the University as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its functions, powers, jurisdiction, and internal governance structures including the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Fort Monroe Development Authority Act
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Koh-e-Suleman Development Authority (originally named Fort Monroe) to develop the area as a tourist resort. It aims to execute developmental plans, improve local socio-economic conditions, and promote domestic and international tourism.

metadata.title: General Statistics Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes specific authorities for the collection and coordination of statistics to facilitate economic and other planning. It establishes a National Statistical Council and Provincial Statistical Councils, along with Federal and Provincial Statistics Authorities, defining their functions and powers.

metadata.title: Ghani University, Sheikhupura Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Ghani University, Sheikhupura as a private sector body corporate located in the Punjab province. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various faculties, while defining its functions to provide instruction and training across diverse academic branches.

name: GHAZI NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND SCIENCES, DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Ghazi National Institute of Engineering and Sciences, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ghazi National Institute of Engineering and Sciences, Dera Ghazi Khan as a private sector body corporate in the Punjab. It defines the institute's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, Rector, and Academic Council, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction in various fields, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan by reconstituting existing colleges and campuses. It defines the university's corporate status, structure, and the powers of its various authorities including the Syndicate and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The GIFT University, Gujranwala Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the GIFT University, Gujranwala as a private sector body corporate located in the Punjab province. It outlines the university's functions, powers, jurisdiction, and governance structure, including the roles of the Patron, Board of Governors, and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Global Institute Lahore Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Global Institute Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It outlines the institute's functions, including providing instruction in management and commerce, establishing departments, and awarding academic distinctions.

name: GOOD CONDUCT PRISONERS’ PROBATIONAL RELEASE ACT, 1926

metadata.title: The Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conditional release of good conduct prisoners from prison before their sentence is fully completed. It grants the Provincial Government the power to issue licenses allowing such releases under specific conditions, including supervision by a state servant or a religious institution.

metadata.title: The Government College, Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Government College, Faisalabad as a University and provides for its incorporation. It outlines the powers of the university authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while defining their respective functions and duties.

metadata.title: The Government College Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Government College Lahore as a University and provides for its incorporation, powers, and functions. It defines the structure of authorities including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while also outlining provisions for teaching, research, affiliation of institutions, and financial management.

name: GOVERNMENT COLLEGE WOMEN UNIVERSITY FAISALABAD ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Government College for Women Faisalabad Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Government College for Women Faisalabad as a university. It defines the powers, functions, and structure of the new institution, including its officers, authorities, and financial provisions.

name: GOVERNMENT COLLEGE WOMEN UNIVERSITY SIALKOT ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Government College for Women Sialkot Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Government College for Women Sialkot as a university. It defines the structure, functions, and officers of the new university, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various authorities like the Syndicate and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Government Grants Act, 1895
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies the application of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 regarding land grants made by the Government. It establishes that such government grants are not subject to the provisions of the 1882 Act and must be construed according to their own terms.

name: GOVERNMENT SADIQ COLLEGE WOMEN UNIVERSITY BAHAWALPUR ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Government Sadiq College for Women Bahawalpur Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Government Sadiq College for Women Bahawalpur as a university. It defines the structure, functions, and officers of the new institution, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various authorities like the Syndicate and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Grand Asian University, Sialkot Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Grand Asian University, Sialkot as a private sector body corporate located in Sialkot. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions regarding instruction, training, and degree awards across various faculties.

metadata.title: The Green International University Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Green International University as a body corporate located in Lahore within the private sector. It outlines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, and various faculties across science, law, medicine, and engineering.

metadata.title: The Hackney-Carriage Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of hackney-carriages in certain municipalities and cantonments. It empowers municipal committees to make rules regarding licenses, fares, vehicle conditions, and driver requirements.

metadata.title: The Hajvery University, Lahore, Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Hajvery University, Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's functions, including instruction in specific fields like Computer Sciences and Business Administration, research capabilities, and the power to confer degrees. The document also outlines the roles of the Patron (Governor of the Punjab), the Board of Governors, and the Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act removes existing disabilities regarding the power of Hindus to dispose of property for the benefit of persons not yet in existence. It applies to both transfers inter vivos and dispositions by will, subject to specific limitations found in other acts.

metadata.title: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends Hindu Law to prevent the exclusion of certain heirs from inheritance or rights in joint-family property based on disease, deformity, or physical/mental defects. It specifically excludes persons governed by the Dayabhaga School of Hindu Law and does not affect accrued rights or liabilities existing before its commencement.

metadata.title: The HITEC University of Taxila Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the HITEC University of Taxila as a private sector body corporate located at Taxila Cantt. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and functions related to instruction, training, research, and examinations.

name: IMPERIAL COLLEGE OF BUSINESS STUDIES LAHORE ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Imperial College of Business Studies, Lahore, Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Imperial College of Business Studies, Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the Institute's functions, including providing instruction in business administration and computer sciences, conducting research, and awarding academic degrees.

metadata.title: The Imperial Tutorial College University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Imperial Tutorial College University by reconstituting the existing Imperial Tutorial College. It confers upon the new university the power to award degrees, diplomas, and certificates across various faculties including Fashion, Textile Design, Computing, and Applied Sciences.

metadata.title: The Indecent Advertisements Prohibition Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the publication and display of indecent advertisements throughout Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'advertisement' and 'indecent', outlines penalties for contravention, and provides powers for confiscation of offending documents.

name: INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL EMPLOYMENT (STANDING ORDERS) ORDINANCE, 1968

metadata.title: The Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to industrial employment in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes standing orders for industrial and commercial establishments employing twenty or more workmen, covering topics such as classification, wages, leave, and termination.

metadata.title: The Industrial Statistics Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the collection of statistics relating to industries, including matters concerning factories and labour welfare. It establishes the powers of the appropriate Government to direct data collection, appoint a statistics authority, and regulate the publication of returns.

name: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY OF THE PUNJAB ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Information Technology University of the Punjab Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Information Technology University of the Punjab with its campus located in Lahore. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its functions, including providing education in information technology, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

name: INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF THE PUNJAB ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab to plan, design, construct, and maintain infrastructure within the province. It provides for the composition of the Authority, its functions, financial management, and powers regarding land acquisition and enforcement.

metadata.title: The Injured Persons (Medical Aid) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the immediate medical aid and treatment of injured persons to save lives and protect health during emergencies. It establishes procedures to prevent delays in treatment, restrict police interference, and ensure that injured individuals are not taken to police stations before receiving necessary medical care.

name: INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT AND APPLIED SCIENCES, KHANEWAL ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Institute of Management and Applied Sciences, Khanewal Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Management and Applied Sciences, Khanewal as a body corporate in the private sector. It outlines the institute's functions, including providing instruction in various sciences, establishing departments, and awarding academic distinctions. The legislation also defines the structure of the institute, including its officers, authorities, and financial provisions.

name: INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT SCIENCES LAHORE ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Institute of Management Sciences, Lahore, Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Institute of Management Sciences in Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the Institute's functions, including providing instruction and training, conducting research, awarding degrees, and operating within the jurisdiction of the Punjab province.

metadata.title: The Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamia University at Bahawalpur to impart religious knowledge and improve teaching, research, and publication facilities. It grants the university an autonomous status and provides for its incorporation, governance structure, and affiliated institutions.

metadata.title: The Juvenile Justice System Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a criminal justice system and social reintegration framework specifically for juveniles in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'juvenile', 'heinous offence', and 'diversion', while mandating legal assistance for children involved in cases.

metadata.title: The Kalri Lake Development (Repeal) Act, 1964
metadata.repeals: The Kalri Lake Development Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Kalri Lake Development Ordinance, 1959. It provides for the transfer of all assets, liabilities, contracts, and employees from the dissolved Kalri Lake Development Board to the West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation.

metadata.title: The Khatamun-nabiyyeen University, Lahore Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstruction of the Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies into the Khatamun-nabiyyeen University, Lahore. It establishes the university as a body with perpetual succession to impart higher education in Islamic fields and facilitate research on the Quran and Seerat.

name: KHWAJA FAREED UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, RAHIM YAR KHAN ACT 2014

metadata.title: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology in Rahim Yar Khan. It defines the university's structure, including its officers and authorities, and outlines its functions regarding instruction, research, and degree awarding.

name: KING EDWARD MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LAHORE ACT, 2005

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act grants university status to the King Edward Medical College in Lahore. It provides for the reconstitution of the institution to improve medical education, encourage research, and facilitate the awarding of medical degrees.

metadata.title: Kohsar University, Murree Act 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Kohsar University, Murree by reconstituting existing Government Degree Colleges for Boys and Women in Murree. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and functions, while granting it corporate status to acquire property and manage liabilities.

metadata.title: The Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better management of the Lahore Arts Council and matters connected therewith. It establishes the Council as a body corporate with defined functions, funds, and territorial jurisdiction within the former Lahore Division.

metadata.title: The Lahore Canal Heritage Park Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Canal Heritage Park to protect and conserve the canal, its green belts, flora, and fauna as a public trust. It defines the Authority's responsibilities for maintenance, outlines prohibited activities within the park, and sets up an Advisory Committee to guide functions and alterations.

metadata.title: The Lahore City University, Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore City University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It outlines the university's functions, including providing instructions and training across various faculties such as Engineering, Sciences, Law, and Management.

name: LAHORE COLLEGE FOR WOMEN UNIVERSITY, LAHORE ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Lahore College for Women University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Lahore College for Women, Lahore as a University. It outlines the powers of the University, its officers, and various authorities such as the Syndicate and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Development Authority to provide a comprehensive system of metropolitan planning and development for the Lahore Division. It outlines the Authority's powers, functions, financial provisions, and procedures regarding land acquisition, pollution control, and beautification.

metadata.title: The Lahore Garrison University Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Lahore Garrison University as a body corporate in the private sector with its campus located in Lahore. It outlines the university's functions, including providing instruction and training in various branches of knowledge while excluding medical and allied health sciences, and establishes its governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Lahore Leads University Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Leads University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its officers and authorities like the Board of Governors and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing education, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ring Road Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Ring Road Authority to plan, design, develop, manage, operate, and maintain ring roads, strategic roads, and economic corridors. It aims to improve intracity and intercity connectivity through these infrastructure projects while providing for ancillary matters.

metadata.title: The Lahore School of Economics Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore School of Economics as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the school's functions, including instruction in economics and finance, research, and the conferment of degrees, while defining the composition and powers of its Board of Governors.

name: LAHORE UNIVERSITY OF BIOLOGICAL AND APPLIED SCIENCES ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences in the private sector. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its powers to provide instructions, training, and research across various health and scientific disciplines.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Mines) Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions for cases where mines or minerals are situated under land that is desired to be acquired. It specifically addresses the saving of government mineral rights and allows declarations regarding the necessity of specific mines during land acquisition processes.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the acquisition of land needed for public purposes and for companies. It establishes procedures for determining compensation, taking possession, and handling objections during the acquisition process.

metadata.title: The Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883
metadata.repeals: The Land Improvement Act, 1871; Act XXI of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to government loans for agricultural improvements. It defines purposes for granting loans, such as constructing wells or preparing land for irrigation, and outlines procedures for applications and repayment.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Land Reforms Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for further land reforms to ensure a more equitable distribution of wealth in Pakistan. It establishes restrictions on individual land ownership and possession, outlines procedures for obtaining declarations and vesting excess land in the government, and details compensation mechanisms for surrendered properties.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation was promulgated by the Chief Martial Law Administrator to implement equitable distribution of wealth and improve the economic well-being of the peasantry. It establishes Land Commissions with specific powers to restrict land ownership, manage excess land vesting in the government, and regulate tenant rights across various provinces.

metadata.title: The Limitation Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the limitation of suits, appeals, and certain applications to courts. It also provides rules for acquiring ownership of easements and other property through possession.

name: MANAGEMENT AND TRANSFER OF PROPERTIES BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Management and Transfer of Properties by Development Authorities Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act enables Development Authorities in the Punjab to strategically manage and transfer immovable properties. It establishes mechanisms for open auctions, ballots, and joint ventures while ensuring transparency through public notices and audits.

metadata.title: The Martial Law Order No.1371 (Repeal) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No.1371 dated February 9, 1984; Punjab Ordinance No.II of 1989
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Punjab Assembly to repeal Martial Law Order No.1371, which had banned student unions in Punjab. The legislation also repeals the Punjab Ordinance No.II of 1989 that was enacted for this specific purpose.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law regarding the registration of medical practitioners and dentists in Pakistan. It establishes a uniform minimum standard for basic and higher qualifications in medicine and dentistry while reconstituting the Medical and Dental Council.

metadata.title: The Medical and Dental Degrees Ordinance, 1982
metadata.repeals: The Medical Degrees Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Medical Degrees Act, 1916 with certain modifications. It establishes the exclusive right of specific authorities to confer medical and dental degrees in Pakistan and prohibits unauthorised conferment or use of such titles.

metadata.title: The Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) (Punjab Repeal) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.repeals: The Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) Ordinance, 1961, specifically in its application to the Province of Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on November 20, 1970, and came into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Mental Health Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the care, treatment, and property management of mentally disordered persons. It establishes the Punjab Mental Health Authority and provides for community care, admission procedures, discharge, and protection of human rights.

metadata.title: The Miani Sahib Graveyard Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No. 131
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of Martial Law Order No. 131 to manage the Miani Sahib Graveyard. It promotes the functions of the Lahore Graveyard Committee and facilitates the vesting of graveyard property in that committee.

metadata.title: The Mines Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law relating to the regulation and inspection of mines. It establishes provisions for inspectors, mining boards, safety measures, employment hours, and penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Minhaj University, Lahore Act 2005
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Minhaj University, Lahore as a private sector institution located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various academic authorities.

name: MIR CHAKAR KHAN RIND UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology in Dera Ghazi Khan by reconstituting the existing Government College of Technology. It provides for the university's incorporation, functions, officer appointments, and the creation of various authorities such as the Syndicate and Academic Council to manage research, development, and technical education.

metadata.title: The Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the censorship of films and the regulation of their exhibition via cinematographs. It establishes a Board to examine and certify films for public display, outlining procedures for certification, licensing of exhibition places, and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the use of motor vehicles in Pakistan, including provisions for temporary visitors and insurance requirements against third-party risks. It defines authorized insurers and certificates of insurance while exempting certain government-owned vehicles from mandatory insurance policies.

name: MUHAMMAD NAWAZ SHAREEF UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE MULTAN ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's functions, including providing education in agriculture and other branches, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

name: MUHAMMAD NAWAZ SHARIF UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY MULTAN ACT 2014

metadata.title: Muhammad Nawaz Sharif University of Engineering and Technology Multan Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Muhammad Nawaz Sharif University of Engineering and Technology Multan. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and functions related to teaching, research, and technology development.

name: MUKABBIR UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY, GUJRAT ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Mukabbir University of Science & Technology, Gujrat Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Mukabbir University of Science & Technology, Gujrat as a private sector body corporate located in Gujrat. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions to provide instruction in various faculties.

name: MULTAN UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Multan University of Science and Technology Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Multan University of Science and Technology as a private sector university located in Multan City. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various academic faculties, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and granting affiliations to other institutions.

metadata.title: The Multi-unit Co-operative Societies Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation, regulation, and winding up of co-operative societies whose objects are not confined to a single province. It applies to societies registered before or after the commencement of this Act under previous provincial laws.

metadata.title: The Murderous Outrages Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to suppress murderous outrages committed by fanatics in certain districts of the Punjab against servants of the State and other persons. It provides for severe punishments including death or transportation for life, forfeiture of property, and specific trial procedures involving assessors.

name: MURREE KAHUTA HILLY AREAS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Murree Kahuta Hilly Areas Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Murree Kahuta Hilly Areas Development Authority Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Murree Kahuta Hilly Areas Development Authority Act, 1975. It provides for the dissolution of the Authority and transfers its assets, liabilities, rights, and obligations to the Government of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Murree-Kahuta Development Authority Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Murree-Kahuta Development Authority to oversee the development of Murree and Kahuta Tehsils in Rawalpindi District. The Authority is empowered to prepare and implement schemes for various sectors including education, health, agriculture, tourism, housing, and environmental improvement.

metadata.title: The Musarrat Institute of Technology Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Musarrat Institute of Technology as a private sector body with its main campus in Multan. It defines the institute's structure, including the Patron, Board of Governors, Rector, and various faculties, while outlining its functions to provide instruction and training across multiple disciplines.

metadata.title: The Music in Muslim Shrines Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act restricts singing and dancing in Muslim shrines within the Punjab. It defines a Muslim shrine to include recognized saint shrines and their attached premises, while prescribing penalties for women or girls who sing or dance there.

metadata.title: The Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to give effect to recommendations of the Commission on Marriage and Family Laws. It establishes provisions for the registration of Muslim marriages, regulates polygamy and talaq, and outlines rules regarding maintenance and dower.

metadata.title: Muttehida Ulema Board Punjab Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the Muttehida Ulema Board Punjab to make recommendations on religious topics, objectionable literature, and interfaith harmony. It establishes the Board's composition, functions, powers, and administrative structure within the Punjab province.

metadata.title: The Namal University, Mianwali Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Namal University, Mianwali as a private sector body corporate located in the Punjab province. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction in specific faculties, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

name: NAWAZ SHARIF INSTITUTE OF CANCER TREATMENT AND RESEARCH ACT 2025

metadata.title: Nawaz Sharif Institute of Cancer Treatment and Research Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Nawaz Sharif Institute of Cancer Treatment and Research in Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the Institute's functions, including providing cancer diagnosis and treatment, conducting research, educating medical staff, and managing funds and property.

metadata.title: The Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation (Repeal) Act, 2008
metadata.repeals: The Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation Act, 1997. It revives the dissolved Nazaria-i-Pakistan Trust and transfers all rights, properties, assets, and liabilities from the Foundation to the Trust.

metadata.title: The New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the New Murree Development Authority to plan, develop, and manage a new township near Murree. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its constitution, functions, powers, and administrative structure.

metadata.title: The Nexis University, Sialkot Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Nexis University, Sialkot as a private sector body corporate located in Sialkot. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

name: NEXT INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Next Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the Next Institute of Science and Technology as a private sector body corporate with its main campus in Multan. It establishes the Institute's structure, including a Patron, Board of Governors, Rector, and various academic faculties such as Law, Sciences, and Commerce.

metadata.title: The Nishtar Medical University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Nishtar Medical University by reconstituting Nishtar Medical College Multan as a body corporate. It provides for the university's functions, including imparting medical education, conducting research, holding examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Notaries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for and regulates the profession of notaries within the Punjab. It establishes powers to appoint notaries, maintains registers of practitioners, issues certificates of practice, and defines penalties for falsely representing oneself as a notary.

metadata.title: The NUR International University Lahore Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes NUR International University Lahore as a body corporate in the private sector with its campus located in Lahore. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers and authorities, and grants it the power to provide instruction, confer degrees, and administer departments.

metadata.title: The Oaths Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: The Repealing Act, 1873 (XII of 1873)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to judicial oaths, affirmations, and declarations in Pakistan. It also provides for the repeal of laws concerning official oaths and establishes the authority and procedures for administering these oaths.

metadata.title: The Official Trustees Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law constituting the office of the Official Trustee in the Punjab. It establishes the appointment, powers, duties, and liabilities of the Official Trustee, including provisions for fees, audit procedures, and the transfer of trust property.

name: ON-FARM WATER MANAGEMENT AND WATER USERS’ ASSOCIATIONS ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.title: The On-Farm Water Management and Water Users' Associations Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for on-farm water management, conservation, and the optimum utilization of irrigation water sources in the Punjab province. It also establishes the framework for the formation and registration of Water Users' Associations to manage these resources.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the acquisition of Pakistan citizenship through birth, descent, migration, and naturalization. It defines various categories of persons deemed to be citizens at the commencement of the Act and establishes procedures for registration and deprivation of citizenship.

name: PAKISTAN COLLEGE OF PHYSICIAN & SURGEONS ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons as a body corporate to maintain high medical principles and promote specialist practice. It outlines the composition of the College, the functions of its Council, and provisions for postgraduate training and examinations.

name: PAKISTAN DAY MEMORIAL CESS PUNJAB ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The Pakistan Day Memorial Cess (Punjab) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a cess on cinema house and race-course tickets to raise funds for the Pakistan Day Memorial. It establishes a committee to manage the fund and specifies the rates at which the cess shall be charged.

name: PAKISTAN KIDNEY AND LIVER INSTITUTE AND RESEARCH CENTER ACT 2019

metadata.title: Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center Act 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center in the Punjab. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with specific functions to provide medical care, conduct research, and offer training in kidney, liver, bladder, prostate, and pancreatic diseases.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nursing Council Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the laws relating to the registration and training of nurses, midwives, and health visitors in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan Nursing Council, defines its composition, outlines the terms of office for members, and provides for the maintenance of registers and recognition of institutions.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Penal Code
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Pakistan Penal Code, which defines offences and punishments applicable within Pakistan. It includes provisions for general explanations of terms, specific punishments, general exceptions to criminal liability, and rules regarding abetment.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes a force called the Pakistan Rangers to protect and maintain order in border areas. It defines the powers of superior officers, the functions of the Force, and outlines provisions regarding offences, punishments, and privileges for its members.

name: PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the unified and coordinated development of water and power resources in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority as a body corporate with defined powers, duties, and constitution.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Parks and Horticulture Authority in the Punjab to regulate, develop, and maintain public parks, green belts, and green areas. It also provides for the regulation of billboards, sky signs, outdoor advertisements, and promotes open views within the region.

metadata.title: The Partnership Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to partnership in Pakistan. It establishes the nature of partnerships, the rights and duties of partners, relations between partners and third parties, and procedures for the dissolution of firms.

metadata.title: The Patents Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This document establishes the legal framework for patents in Pakistan, covering definitions, administration, patentability criteria, and application procedures. It outlines provisions for the grant, term, and revocation of patents, as well as mechanisms for compulsory licensing and infringement proceedings.

metadata.title: The Payment of Wages Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the payment of wages to certain classes of persons employed in industry within Punjab. It establishes rules regarding wage periods, time and method of payment, permissible deductions, fines, and the powers of inspectors.

metadata.title: The Pharmacy Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Pharmacy Councils at both the Federal and Provincial levels to regulate the practice of pharmacy in Pakistan. It provides for the composition, functions, and powers of these councils, including the approval of examinations and courses of study, as well as the registration and regulation of pharmacists.

name: PIR MEHR ALI SHAH UNIVERSITY OF ARID AGRICULTURE RAWALPINDI ACT, 1995

metadata.title: Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture University Rawalpindi Act, 1995
metadata.repeals: University of Arid Agriculture Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1994 (XVI of 1994)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture University in Rawalpindi to bridge the knowledge gap between arid and irrigated areas. It creates an organized scientific infrastructure for teaching and research aimed at developing dry land regions of the country.

metadata.title: The Police Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for the constitution, organization, and administration of the police in Pakistan. It creates various public safety commissions at provincial, capital city, district, and national levels to oversee police conduct and accountability.

name: POPULATION WELFARE PLANNING PROGRAMME (APPOINTMENT AND TERMINATION) ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.title: The Population Welfare Planning Programme (Appointment and Termination of Service) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the restructuring and reorganization of the Population Programme, specifically regarding the appointment and termination of employees within the Council and Boards. It establishes procedures for appointments by the appointing authority based on recommendations from the Federal Public Service Commission or Departmental Selection Committee.

metadata.title: The Powers-of-Attorney Act, 1882
metadata.repeals: Act XXVIII of 1866
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Powers-of-Attorney, specifically regarding the execution of instruments by donees and payments made without notice of the donor's death or insolvency. It was originally enacted for the Federal ambit but adapted for the province of Punjab via the Powers of Attorney (Amendment) Act 2012.

metadata.title: The Prevention of Anti-National Activities Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the effective prevention of anti-national and treasonable activities by individuals and associations within Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to declare associations as anti-national and establishes a Tribunal to adjudicate on such declarations.

name: PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION ACT (WEST PAKISTAN EXTENSION) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption Act (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to the entire Province of West Pakistan. It also amends specific references within that Act regarding certain districts and repeals the Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act, 1950.

name: PREVENTION OF CRUELTY OF ANIMALS ACT, 1890

metadata.title: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of cruelty to animals within Pakistan. It defines offenses such as overdriving, beating, or selling animals suffering from unnecessary pain and prescribes corresponding penalties including fines and imprisonment.

metadata.title: The Prevention of Gambling Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of gambling within Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'common gaming-house' and 'gaming', establishes penalties for owning, keeping, or participating in gambling activities, and grants magistrates powers to enter and search suspected locations.

name: PRICE CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF PROFITEERING AND HOARDING ACT, 1977

metadata.title: Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of prices and the prevention of profiteering and hoarding of essential commodities in Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to make orders regulating production, distribution, and sale while defining key terms such as dealer, producer, and essential commodity.

metadata.title: The Prisoners Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to prisoners confined by order of a Court. It establishes the duties of prison officers regarding detention, discharge, and the execution of various court warrants and sentences.

metadata.title: The Prisons Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act provides rules for the regulation of prisons in Pakistan and amends the law relating to them. It covers preliminary provisions, maintenance of officers, duties, admission and discharge of prisoners, discipline, food and clothing, employment, health, visits, offences, and miscellaneous matters.

name: PRIVATELY MANAGED SCHOOLS AND COLLEGES (TAKING OVER) REGULATION 1972

metadata.title: The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This regulation mandates the immediate taking over of privately managed schools and colleges by the Central or Provincial Governments. It prohibits owners from closing institutions, transferring property, or making changes to contracts and employment terms without prior government permission.

name: PRIVATELY MANAGED SCHOOLS AND COLLEGES (TAKING OVER) REGULATION 1972

metadata.title: The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This regulation mandates the immediate vesting of privately managed schools and colleges in either the Central or Provincial Government. It prohibits owners from closing institutions, transferring property, or making changes to contracts without prior permission from the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the release on probation of offenders in certain cases and addresses incidental matters. It empowers specific courts to make probation orders, impose conditions such as community service, and manage the administration of bonds and sureties.

metadata.title: The Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order modifies the existing law regarding the prohibition of intoxicants to align with Islamic injunctions from the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It establishes penalties for manufacturing, selling, or possessing intoxicants, defines specific terms related to these activities, and outlines procedures for licensing and enforcement.

name: PROHIBITION OF SMOKING AND PROTECTION OF NON-SMOKERS HEALTH ORDINANCE 2002

metadata.title: The Prohibition of Smoking and Protection of Non-Smokers Health Ordinance, 2002
