metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking and other tobacco uses in places of public work or use and in public service vehicles to protect the health of non-smokers. It empowers the Federal Government to declare no-smoking zones, authorize officers to enforce rules, ban tobacco advertisements, and impose penalties on violators.

name: PROTECTION AGAINST HARASSMENT OF WOMEN AT THE WORKPLACE ACT 2010

metadata.title: The Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to protect women from harassment at the workplace in Punjab. It establishes mechanisms including an Inquiry Committee and an Ombudsperson to handle complaints regarding unwelcome sexual advances or hostile work environments.

name: PROTECTION OF BREAST-FEEDING AND CHILD NUTRITION ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to ensure safe and adequate nutrition for infants by promoting breast-feeding and regulating the marketing of designated products like milk substitutes. It establishes the Punjab Infant Feeding Board to oversee these matters and prohibits specific practices related to advertising and labeling.

name: PROTECTION OF BREAST-FEEDING AND CHILD NUTRITION ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to ensure safe and adequate nutrition for infants by promoting breast-feeding and regulating the marketing of designated products like milk substitutes. It establishes the Punjab Infant Feeding Board to oversee these matters and prohibits specific practices related to advertising and labeling.

metadata.title: Protection of Economic Reforms Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal protection to economic reforms introduced by the Government to create a liberal environment for savings and investments. It ensures that these reforms override conflicting provisions in other laws and protects foreign currency accounts, fiscal incentives, and private sector ownership from government interference or compulsory acquisition.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (REPEAL AND REVIVAL) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Repeal and Revival) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 2022 and revives the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES ACT 1972

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act defines the powers, immunities, and privileges of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, its committees, and its members. It establishes specific protections for members regarding civil or criminal action, detention, and legal proceedings within the assembly precincts.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT SERVICES (REPEAL AND REVIVAL) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services (Repeal and Revival) Act, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2022 and revives the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019. It was enacted to uphold Parliamentary Supremacy by restoring the earlier legislation as if it had never been repealed.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT SERVICES ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Laws (Repealing and Removal of Difficulties) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the recruitment and conditions of service for persons appointed in the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat. It defines various terms related to appointments, pay, conduct, and retirement while establishing the framework for the secretariat's administration.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces a scheme of Social Security to provide financial benefits to certain employees or their dependents in cases of sickness, maternity, employment injury, or death. It establishes the Employees' Social Security Institution and outlines its management, contributions, finance, audit, and various benefit structures.

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to insolvency as administered by courts in the Punjab. It establishes the constitution, powers, and procedures for courts handling insolvency proceedings, including petitions, adjudication, property administration, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the legal framework for the licensing of drivers, registration of motor vehicles, and the issuance of transport permits in Punjab. It also outlines regulations regarding traffic control, vehicle maintenance, and penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Courts of Small Causes in Pakistan. It establishes the constitution, jurisdiction, practice, and procedure for these courts, including provisions for the appointment of judges and the execution of decrees.

metadata.title: The Public Gambling (Repeal) Act, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Public Gambling Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Punjab Assembly to repeal the Public Gambling Act, 1867. It came into force immediately upon its enactment and publication in the Punjab Gazette.

metadata.title: The Public Health (Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes special provisions to prevent the spread of human disease and safeguard public health during an emergency. It empowers the appropriate Government to direct local authorities, appoint additional health staff, and take over administration of essential services.

metadata.title: The Punjab (Multan) Timber Market Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab (Multan) Timber Market Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions for the regulation of the Timber Market in Multan. It prohibits carrying on timber business outside designated areas and outlines rules for site allotments, occupation periods, and penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority as a body corporate responsible for providing clean drinking water to the people of Punjab. It outlines the Authority's functions, including sustainable water supply, infrastructure development, and strategies for water contamination control.

metadata.title: The Punjab Abolition of Jagirs Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Jagirs Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the immediate abolition of all jagirs in the Punjab, excluding those granted to military forces or religious/charitable institutions. It terminates all rights accrued by holders of such jagirs and prohibits the creation of new jagirs after its commencement.

metadata.title: Punjab Acid Control Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls the business of acid in Punjab by establishing a comprehensive mechanism for licensing, prohibition, and penalties. It defines key terms such as 'acid' and 'business premises,' outlines procedures for applying for and renewing licenses, and sets conditions for the import, manufacture, storage, and sale of acids.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Repeal) Act, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973. It provides for the continuation of pending acquisition proceedings and compensation assessments under the repealed Act or the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

name: PUNJAB ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY (RESIDENCE OF GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Property (Residence of Government Officials) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific property in Mauza Mian Mir, District Lahore, to be used as a residence for Government Officials. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 115 and mandates compensation payment to the previous occupants.

name: PUNJAB ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY (WAPDA HOUSE) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific evacuee property in Lahore to construct an office for the Water and Power Development Authority. It also validates actions previously taken under Martial Law Order No. 129 regarding this property.

name: PUNJAB ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY (WAPDA OFFICE) (SECOND) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office) (Second) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific evacuee properties in Mozang, Lahore, to construct an office for the Water and Power Development Authority. It also validates actions previously taken under Martial Law Orders Nos. 92 and 109 issued by the Martial Law Administrator, Zone 'B'.

name: PUNJAB ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY (WAPDA OFFICE) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific evacuee property in Lahore to construct an office for the Water and Power Development Authority. It also validates actions previously taken under Martial Law Order No. 129 issued on May 29, 1962.

name: PUNJAB ADHOC PUBLIC ACCOUNTS COMMITTEE (COMPOSITION AND FUNCTIONS) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Adhoc Public Accounts Committee (Composition and Functions) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of an Adhoc Public Accounts Committee to examine government accounts and Auditor General reports in Punjab. It was promulgated because the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab was dissolved, requiring immediate action to handle unfinished business from the defunct Standing Committee on Public Accounts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Administrative Vigilance Commission (Repeal) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Administrative Vigilance Commission Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to repeal the Punjab Administrative Vigilance Commission Ordinance, 1979. It also terminates all existing appointments and extinguishes rights and privileges under the repealed law.

name: PUNJAB ADVISORS (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Advisors (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment, salary, allowances, and privileges of Advisors to the Chief Minister of the Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 4 of the Provisional Constitution (Amendment) Order No.9 of 1999 due to the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Punjab Aerial Ropeways Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes, facilitates, and regulates the construction and working of aerial ropeways in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Aerial Ropeway', 'Promoter', and 'Inspector', and establishes procedures for applications, orders, inspections, and penalties related to safety and operation.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT AND SUPPLIES CORPORATION ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation to increase agricultural production in the province. It also provides for the transfer of assets, projects, undertakings, and properties from the defunct West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation to the Punjab.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT FINANCE CORPORATION (RECOVERY OF ARREARS) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides facilities to the Agricultural Development Finance Corporation for recovering its dues. It allows agricultural concerns to pledge or mortgage property to secure loans and empowers the Corporation to recover dues by disposing of such property.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of a tax on agricultural income within the Punjab province. It establishes definitions, assessment procedures, and penalties related to non-compliance or concealment of cultivated land.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority to facilitate and regulate the systematic growth of agricultural produce marketing. It provides for the composition, powers, and functions of the Authority, as well as provisions for market committees, registration, fees, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the eradication of agricultural pests in the Province of Punjab. It establishes the powers of the Government to prohibit cultivation methods or crop transport that spread pests, defines the duties of occupiers to carry out preventive measures, and outlines the appointment and powers of Inspectors.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better regulation of the purchase and sale of agricultural produce within the Province of Punjab. It also establishes markets and rules for their proper administration, including the formation of market committees and the issuance of licences.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Research Board Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Agricultural Research Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession to conduct agricultural research in the Province of Punjab. It defines the Board's functions, composition, powers, and financial arrangements while placing its affairs under the supervision of the Government.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE, FOOD AND DRUG AUTHORITY ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority to conduct forensic examinations and testing of fertilizers, pesticides, food, and drugs. It empowers the Authority to render expert opinions on ingredient quality and deal with related matters within the province.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1951; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1955; Agriculturists' Loans (Sind Amendment) Act, 1941; Khairpur State Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1952; West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the advancement and recovery of taccavi loans for agricultural purposes in the Province of Punjab. It empowers the Government to make rules concerning loans for distress relief, land purchase, and seed sales, while establishing mechanisms for recovering these amounts as arrears of land revenue.

metadata.title: The Punjab Alienation of Land Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to agricultural land in the Punjab. It regulates permanent and temporary alienations of land, including restrictions on mortgages, leases, and benami transactions intended to evade provisions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system for the alternate dispute resolution of both civil and criminal disputes within the Punjab. It aims to ensure inexpensive and expeditious justice by providing mechanisms such as mediation, conciliation, and evaluation outside of traditional court adjudication.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animal Health Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the prevention, control, containment, and eradication of scheduled animal diseases in Punjab. It establishes measures for vaccination, quarantine units, check posts, and penalties to meet international standards for animal trade.

name: PUNJAB ANIMALS COMPOUND FEEDING STUFF ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Compound Feeding Stuff Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Animals Compound Feed and Feed Stuff Ordinance 2002
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, sale, and labeling of compound feeding stuffs for animals in Punjab. It establishes provisions for quality control, prohibits adulteration, and outlines the powers of appointed inspectors regarding sampling and analysis.

name: PUNJAB ANIMALS FEED STUFF AND COMPOUND FEED ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Feed Stuff and Compound Feed Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, storage, supply, transport for sale, and marketing of feed stuff and compound feed in the Province of Punjab. It aims to ensure production standards, check adulteration and misbranding, and address ancillary matters related to poultry and livestock feed.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the slaughter of useful animals and regulates the slaughter of other animals in the Punjab. It establishes definitions for terms like 'animal', 'slaughter', and 'stock yard', while also granting powers for entry, search, seizure, and forfeiture.

metadata.title: The Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of a special agency known as the Anti-Corruption Establishment in the Punjab. Its primary purpose is to investigate specific offences relating to corruption by public servants and to hold preliminary inquiries against them.

metadata.title: The Punjab Apprenticeship Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act promotes, develops, and regulates apprenticeship programmes within establishments in the Punjab. It establishes minimum standards for skills, defines the roles of employers and apprentices, and provides a framework for counselling, placement services, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the sale, transport, bearing, or possession of arms, ammunition, and military stores in Punjab. It establishes provisions for licensing, prohibits unlicensed activities, defines various types of arms and ammunition, and outlines penalties for breaches.

name: PUNJAB AUTISM SCHOOL AND RESOURCE CENTRE ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Autism School and Resource Centre (also known as the Maryam Nawaz School and Resource Centre for Autism) in the Punjab to provide education and support for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession to manage the Centre's affairs, property, and operations. The legislation defines the composition of the Board of Governors responsible for the management, administration, and control of the Centre.

metadata.title: The Punjab Bait-ul-Mal Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a charitable fund known as the Punjab Bait-ul-Mal to provide financial assistance for poverty relief, education, and medical needs. It creates a corporate Council responsible for administering the fund and distributing resources to disadvantaged sections of society.

metadata.title: The Punjab Blood Transfusion Safety Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the collection, testing, processing, storage, distribution, and issuance of human blood and blood components in Punjab. It establishes an Authority to ensure health protection and prevent transfusion-transmissible diseases while defining various terms related to blood safety and compliance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Revenue Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Ordinance XII of 1956
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Board of Revenue for the Province of Punjab to oversee revenue administration and land records. It vests superintendence and control over revenue officers and courts in the Board, designating it as the highest appellate authority in revenue cases.

name: PUNJAB BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes and organizes the Punjab Board of Technical Education. It establishes the Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines its members, officers, and powers, and provides for the making of regulations to govern technical education in the province.

name: PUNJAB BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and reconstitutes the Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in the Punjab. It also amends and consolidates existing laws relating to these boards, defining their constitution, jurisdiction, powers, and administrative functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Border Military Police Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the Border Military Police Force in specific notified tribal areas of the Dera Ghazi Khan and Rajanpur districts. It establishes the force's constitution, outlines the appointment and powers of superior officers, and defines various offences and punishments applicable to members of the force.

metadata.title: The Punjab Borstal Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and regulation of Borstal Institutions within the Punjab province. It outlines provisions for the detention and training of adolescent offenders to facilitate their reformation through industrial instruction and moral discipline.

name: PUNJAB BUS STANDS AND TRAFFIC CONTROL (GUJRANWALA) ORDINANCE, 1963 (XX OF 1963) (REPEAL) ACT 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963 (XX of 1963) (Repeal) Act 2011
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963 (XX of 1963)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963. It was passed by the Punjab Assembly in December 2011 and received assent from the Governor on December 31, 2011.

name: PUNJAB BUS STANDS AND TRAFFIC CONTROL (LAHORE) ORDINANCE, 1963 (XIX OF 1963) (REPEAL) ACT 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963 (XIX of 1963) (Repeal) Act 2011
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963 (XIX of 1963)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963. It was passed by the Punjab Assembly in December 2011 and received assent from the Governor on December 31, 2011.

name: PUNJAB CENTER OF EXCELLENCE ON COUNTERING VIOLENT EXTREMISM ACT 2025

metadata.title: Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism as a body corporate within the province. The Center is empowered to conduct research, develop strategies and policies, provide training, and coordinate with various stakeholders to address terrorism and subversive activities.

name: PUNJAB CENTRAL BUSINESS DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Central Business District Development Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Central Business District Development Authority to regulate vertical construction for residential and commercial purposes. It aims to develop a healthy business community while maintaining high environmental standards and modern facilities within the specified area.

metadata.title: The Punjab Charities Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and regulation of charities and the collection of charitable funds in Punjab. It establishes a Commission to administer these provisions and defines the obligations of charity trustees regarding fiduciary responsibilities and accounting records.

metadata.title: The Punjab Child Marriage Restraint Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to restrain the solemnization of child marriages within the province. It establishes strict penalties for marrying children, engaging in child abuse or trafficking, and for guardians who facilitate such acts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Administration Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act institutes a comprehensive system of civil administration in the Punjab to ensure efficient administration and improved service delivery. It establishes roles for Commissioners, Deputy Commissioners, and Assistant Commissioners to oversee general administration, coordinate public facilities, and implement government policies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to Civil Courts in the Province of Punjab. It establishes classes of civil courts, defines their jurisdiction, and outlines the appointment and powers of District Judges and Additional District Judges.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance No. II of 1974
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment to, and the terms and conditions of service for civil servants in the Province of Punjab. It establishes definitions, rules regarding appointments, probation periods, promotions, transfers, and provisions for retirement and pension.

name: PUNJAB CIVILIAN VICTIMS OF TERRORISM (RELIEF AND REHABILITATION) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Civilian Victims of Terrorism (Relief and Rehabilitation) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an institutionalized response to address the hardships faced by civilian victims and their families resulting from acts of terrorism. It provides for timely recognition, state assistance including relief, healthcare, and rehabilitation, as well as the establishment of a dedicated fund for these purposes.

name: PUNJAB CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES AND CO-OPERATIVE BANKS (REPAYMENT OF LOANS) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The Punjab Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the securing and repayment of unsecured loans or loans that are insufficiently secured taken from co-operative banks and societies. It establishes definitions, procedures for service of notice, determination of liability, and powers for the Registrar regarding inquiries and recovery.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION FOR REGULARIZATION OF IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Commission to examine private housing schemes and land sub-divisions developed irregularly or without competent authority approval. It provides for the composition, functions, and powers of the Commission, along with mechanisms for data collection, application submission, regularization processes, fines, and indemnity.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Commission on the Status of Women to empower women and expand their socio-economic opportunities. It provides for the constitution, appointment, term of office, and functions of the Commission while aiming to eliminate discrimination against women.

metadata.title: The Punjab Community Safety Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act ensures community safety measures in buildings and health/fitness centers within the Punjab province. It establishes duties for the Punjab Emergency Service, defines specific roles like safety managers and physicians, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: PUNJAB COMPULSORY TEACHING OF THE HOLY QURAN ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act mandates the compulsory teaching of the Holy Quran for Muslim students in all educational institutions within the Punjab province. It specifies that recitation (Naazrah Quran) is required for grades I to V, while translation is required for grades VI to XII.

name: PUNJAB CONFERMENT OF PROPRIETARY RIGHTS ON NON-PROPRIETORS IN ABADI DEH ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The Punjab Conferment of Proprietary Rights on Non-proprietors in Abadi Deh Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act confers proprietary rights on non-proprietors residing in the abadi deh of villages within Punjab. It vests all rights, title, and interest in land under a house owned by a non-proprietor directly into their ownership free of charge upon the Act's commencement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings (Repeal) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960 to facilitate the transition of pending consolidation schemes. It establishes timelines for implementing confirmed schemes and completing remaining entitlement shares while transferring incomplete cases to district collectors.

metadata.title: Qanun-e-Shahadat Order, 1984
metadata.summary: This Order outlines the rules regarding the relevancy of facts, witnesses, and evidence in legal proceedings. It covers topics such as oral and documentary evidence, admissions, confessions, public documents, and presumptions related to evidence.

metadata.title: The Qarshi University, Muridke Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Qarshi University, Muridke as a private sector body corporate in Punjab. It outlines the university's functions, including providing instruction in specific faculties, establishing constituent colleges, and awarding academic degrees.

metadata.title: The Race Courses Licensing (Repeal) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Race Courses Licensing Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to repeal the Race Courses Licensing Act, 1912. It came into force immediately upon publication in the Punjab Gazette.

metadata.title: The Rashid Latif Khan University Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Rashid Latif Khan University in the private sector with its campus located in Lahore. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its functions, powers, and governance structure.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ravi Urban Development Authority to implement a comprehensive system of planning and development in specified areas. It aims to improve the quality of life, rehabilitate water aquifers, and provide modern civic facilities while evolving policies for housing, industrial development, and waste disposal.

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi Medical University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and incorporation of Rawalpindi Medical University by reconstituting Rawalpindi Medical College. It outlines the university's functions, including imparting medical education, conducting research, holding examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi by reconstituting the Government Postgraduate College for Women. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its functions, officers, authorities, and statutory framework.

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1897
metadata.repeals: Act V of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Reformatory Schools and provides further provisions for dealing with youthful offenders. It establishes powers for the Provincial Government to create, maintain, or discontinue these schools and outlines procedures for sending convicted boys under fifteen years of age to them.

metadata.title: The Registration Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for the registration of documents in Pakistan, defining compulsory and optional registration requirements. It outlines the powers and duties of registering officers, procedures for presenting documents, and provisions regarding fees and penalties.

metadata.title: The Registration of Foreigners Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of foreigners entering, being present in, and departing from Pakistan. It establishes definitions, powers to make rules regarding reporting requirements, burden of proof, penalties for non-compliance, and protections for persons acting under the Act.

name: REGULATION OF GENERATION, TRANSMISSION AND DISTRIBUTION OF ELECTRIC POWER ACT, 1997

metadata.title: The Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power in Pakistan. It establishes the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority to oversee these sectors and issues licenses for various activities within the industry.

name: REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT [(GOVERNMENT CONTROL)] ACT, 1948

metadata.title: The Regulation of Mines and Oil fields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters connected with the regulation of mines, oil-fields, and mineral developments under government control. It empowers the appropriate Government to make rules regarding exploration licenses, mining leases, royalty rates, production control, and pricing of minerals.

metadata.title: The Repealing (Punjab Loans Limitation) Act, 1923
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Loans Limitation Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Loans Limitation Act, 1904. It restores the application of the Limitation Act, 1908 to suits previously governed by the repealed act and provides savings for pending suits and existing causes of action.

metadata.title: The Restriction of Habitual Offenders (Punjab) Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to restrict the movements of habitual offenders in the Punjab and requires them to report themselves at specified times and places. It outlines the procedures for magistrates to issue orders of restriction, including joint proceedings with bonds for good behavior, and details the conditions under which such orders can be made, varied, or cancelled.

metadata.title: The Revenue Recovery Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides better provisions for recovering certain public demands, specifically focusing on land revenue arrears. It outlines the procedures for Collectors to enforce recovery processes in districts other than where the demand originated and defines the remedies available to persons denying liability.

metadata.title: Revolution University, Faisalabad Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Revolution University, Faisalabad as a private sector body corporate located in the Punjab province. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Vice-Chancellor, while defining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Road Transport Workers Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the hours of work and other conditions of employment for road transport workers in Pakistan. It establishes specific rules regarding daily and weekly working hours, mandatory rest intervals, age limits for drivers and general employees, and provisions for leave.

metadata.title: The Sahara University Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sahara University as a private sector institution with its campus located at Narowal. It defines the university's structure, including its authorities, officers, and constituent bodies such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Salar International University Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Salar International University in the private sector with its campus located at Sheikhupura. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its functions, powers, and organizational structure including various faculties and authorities.

metadata.title: Sale of Goods Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to the sale of goods in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'goods', 'delivery', and 'price', and outlines the rights and liabilities of buyers and sellers.

metadata.title: The Sasti Roti Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sasti Roti Authority in the Punjab to provide and distribute subsidized tandoori roti to deserving people. It defines the Authority's functions, powers, and structure, including the ability to regulate prices, quality, and distribution of subsidized flour and roti.

metadata.title: The Seed Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for controlling and regulating the quality of seeds of various varieties of crops. It establishes councils and departments at federal and provincial levels to oversee seed certification, registration, and testing.

metadata.title: The Senate Hill University Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Senate Hill University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various academic faculties, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and managing examinations.

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) (Repeal) Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972. Any actions or orders previously made under the repealed Act are deemed to have been taken or made under this new legislation.

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the validation of certain orders made by settlement commissioners. It was subsequently repealed by the Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) (Repeal) Act, 2012.

metadata.title: The Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework for the administration and control of Sikh Gurdwaras in British India. It creates a specific tribunal to adjudicate disputes regarding property claims, declarations of status, and compensation for office-holders, while also constituting a Board to oversee these institutions.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration Act, 1860
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of literary, scientific, and charitable societies in British India. It establishes the requirements for forming a society through a memorandum of association, defines the governing body's role, and outlines procedures for suits by or against registered societies.

name: SOUTH PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT 2021

metadata.title: The South Punjab Institute of Science and Technology Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the South Punjab Institute of Science and Technology Dera Ghazi Khan as a body corporate in the private sector. It outlines the institute's functions, including providing instruction in various sciences, conducting research, and administering constituent colleges.

metadata.title: The Specific Relief Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to certain kinds of specific relief obtainable in civil suits. It covers topics such as recovering possession of property, enforcing contracts, rectifying instruments, rescinding contracts, cancelling instruments, granting declaratory decrees, appointing receivers, and issuing injunctions.

metadata.title: The Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to regulate the development and control of sports in Pakistan. It establishes a Board with perpetual succession to oversee national sports standards and grants the Board the exclusive right to make rules for uniformity.

name: STAGE CARRIAGES (CANCELLATION OF PERMITS OF ABSENTEES) REGULATION, 1969

metadata.title: The Stage Carriages (Cancellation of Permits of Absentees) Regulation, 1969
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation cancels permits for stage carriages held by absentees and applies to the whole of Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'absentee' and 'actual owner', allows cancelled permits to remain valid for a 20-day transition period, and mandates the surrender of cancelled permits within 15 days.

metadata.title: The Stage-Carrriages Act, 1861
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the licensing and regulation of stage-carriages used to convey passengers for hire in Pakistan. It outlines requirements for licenses, penalties for operating unlicensed carriages or violating license conditions, and provisions regarding the treatment of animals.

metadata.title: The Stage-Carriages Act, 1861
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the licensing and regulation of stage-carriages used to convey passengers for hire in Pakistan. It outlines requirements for licenses, penalties for operating unlicensed carriages or violating license conditions, and provisions regarding animal treatment.

metadata.title: The Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to stamps within the Punjab. It establishes rules regarding the liability of instruments to duty, the payment and cancellation of stamps, valuation for duty, and procedures for adjudication.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulated supply of sugarcane intended for use in sugar factories. It establishes mechanisms to control the purchase of cane, set minimum prices, and license purchasing agents within designated reserved areas.

metadata.title: The Suits Valuation Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes the mode for valuing certain suits to determine the jurisdiction of courts. It establishes rules for determining land values and ensures that court-fee values align with jurisdictional values in specific cases.

metadata.title: The Superior University, Lahore, Act 2004
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Superior University, Lahore as a private sector body corporate. It outlines the university's functions, powers, and structure, including the composition of its Board of Governors and faculties.

metadata.title: The Surrender of Illicit Arms Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the surrender of illicit arms to improve law and order situations in Pakistan. It defines what constitutes illicit arms, mandates their surrender by specific authorities, and outlines punishments for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Suthra Punjab Authority Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Suthra Punjab Authority to manage solid waste and regulate sanitation services within the Punjab. It creates an integrated system for waste collection, transportation, treatment, and disposal while promoting recycling and waste-to-energy initiatives.

name: THAL (INCREASE IN VALUE) (VALIDATION OF LEVY OF TAX) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Thal (Increase in Value) (Validation of Levy of Tax) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of tax under the Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) Act, 1940. It deems taxes levied before a specific rule substitution to be validly collected under the substituted rules.

metadata.title: The Thal Development (Validating) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain acquisitions, privileges, liabilities, and obligations made or incurred by the Thal Development Authority before a specific amendment act. It applies to the districts of Mianwali, Muzaffargarh, and the Khushab Sub-Division of Sargodha.

metadata.title: The Thal Development Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Thal Development Authority and outlines its constitution, functions, and powers regarding land acquisition and development schemes. It also details financial provisions, including taxation and borrowing, as well as procedures for penalties and legal proceedings related to the authority's operations.

metadata.title: The Thal University Bhakkar Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Thal University Bhakkar by re-constituting the sub-campus of the University of Sargodha at Bhakkar. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its structure, including officers, authorities, and governing bodies.

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act regulates irrigation, navigation, and drainage within the territories to which it extends. It grants the Provincial Government powers to control water for public purposes and establishes rules regarding water rates, compensation, and offences related to canals.

name: THE HINDU LAW OF INHERITANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT 1929

metadata.title: The Hindu Law of Inheritance (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.amends: The Hindu Law of Inheritance Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act alters the order of succession for heirs of a Hindu male who dies intestate. It specifically grants rights to a son's daughter, daughter's daughter, sister, and sister's son to succeed after a father's father but before father's brothers.

metadata.title: The Legal Representatives' Suits Act, 1855
metadata.summary: This Act enables executors, administrators, or representatives to sue and be sued for wrongs committed during the lifetime of a deceased person that caused pecuniary loss. It ensures that legal actions do not abate upon the death of either party and allows for the continuation of suits against representatives if assets are available.

metadata.title: The Petroleum Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the import, transport, storage, production, refining, and blending of petroleum and other inflammable substances. It establishes rules for licensing, inspection, testing standards, and penalties for offenses regarding these activities.

name: THE PUNJAB COURT OF WARDS ACT, 1903

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.repeals: Enactments specified in the schedule
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the Court of Wards in the Punjab. It establishes the constitution, jurisdiction, and powers of the Court regarding the superintendence of properties and persons.

metadata.title: The Times University, Multan Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Times University, Multan as a private sector institution located in Multan. It provides for the university's ancillary matters, including its officers, authorities, financial provisions, and initial statutes.

metadata.title: The Town Improvement Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for creating and managing Improvement Trusts to facilitate urban development. It outlines procedures for formulating improvement schemes, acquiring land, and regulating building activities within designated areas.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Offenders Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of citizens convicted in foreign countries to Pakistan and vice versa. It establishes the Competent Authority within the Ministry of Interior to manage applications and warrants related to these transfers.

name: TRANSFER OF POPULATION WELFARE PROGRAMME (FIELD ACTIVITIES) ORDINANCE, 1983

metadata.title: Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of field activities of the Population Welfare Programme from the Federal Government to the Provincial Governments. It outlines the specific powers, functions, and responsibilities that vest in the Provinces while retaining certain national policy and coordination functions with the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act defines the legal framework for transferring property by act of parties, including sales, mortgages, and leases of immovable property. It establishes the rights and liabilities of mortgagors and mortgagees, as well as rules regarding charges and apportionment.

name: TRANSPLANTATION OF HUMAN ORGANS AND TISSUES ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs and tissues for therapeutic purposes within the Punjab. It establishes definitions for key terms like 'brain dead' and 'donor', outlines procedures for living and deceased donors, and sets up committees and authorities to monitor the process.

metadata.title: The Travel Agencies Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development, regulation, and control of the profession of travel agencies in Punjab. It establishes a regulatory committee, outlines licensing requirements, defines service charges, and sets penalties for operating without a license.

metadata.title: The Treasure-trove Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to treasure-trove found in soil or affixed thereto. It establishes procedures for notifying collectors, determining ownership claims, and dividing treasure between finders and owners when no dispute exists.

metadata.title: The Treasure-trove Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to treasure-trove found in soil or affixed thereto. It establishes procedures for notifying collectors, determining ownership claims, and dividing treasure between finders and owners when no dispute exists.

name: UNANI, AYURVEDIC AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS ACT, 1965

metadata.title: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the qualifications and provides for the registration of practitioners of Unani, Ayurvedic, and Homoeopathic systems of medicine in Pakistan. It establishes National Councils for Tib and Homoeopathy to oversee education, research, and the maintenance of professional standards.

metadata.title: The United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act enables effect to be given to certain provisions of the Charter of the United Nations, specifically Article 41. It authorizes the Federal Government to apply measures not involving armed force when called upon by the Security Council and allows for the punishment of persons offending against such orders.

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The University of Agriculture, Lyallpur (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the West Pakistan Agricultural University to establish the University of Agriculture at Faisalabad. It outlines the powers, duties, and structure of the university's authorities, including the Chancellor, Senate, and Syndicate.

metadata.title: University of Arts & Sciences Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Arts & Sciences as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its authorities, officers, and governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

name: UNIVERSITY OF CENTRAL PUNJAB LAHORE ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The University of Central Punjab, Lahore, Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Central Punjab, Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the powers and functions of the University, including its administration, instruction, training, and the award of degrees across various faculties.

metadata.title: The University of Chakwal Act 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Chakwal by reconstituting existing government colleges and sub-campuses. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its powers to acquire property, open sub-campuses, and manage finances.

metadata.title: University of Chenab Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Chenab as a private sector body corporate located in Gujrat. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, and various academic authorities.

name: UNIVERSITY OF CHILD HEALTH SCIENCES, LAHORE ACT 2021

metadata.title: The University of Child Health Sciences, Lahore Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Child Health Sciences, Lahore as a body corporate to provide child health services and medical education. It outlines the university's functions, including imparting training to health professionals and promoting research in child health. The legislation also defines the structure of the university, its officers, authorities, and financial provisions.

metadata.title: The University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the University of Education, Lahore and matters connected thereto. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under emergency powers due to the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY LAHORE ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore, Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: Ordinance No I of 1974
metadata.summary: This Act re-constitutes and reorganizes the University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore to improve teaching, research, publication, and administration. It establishes the university's constitution, defines the powers of its authorities such as the Senate and Syndicate, and outlines provisions for affiliated colleges and staff welfare.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY TAXILA ACT, 1994

metadata.title: The University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila, Act 1994
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Engineering and Technology at Taxila to foster research, development, and high-quality engineering education. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and statutory powers.

metadata.title: The University of Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Faisalabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession located in Faisalabad. It defines the University's functions, including providing instruction and training across various disciplines, conducting research, holding examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The University of Gujrat Act 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Gujrat and provides for its incorporation, powers, and jurisdiction. It outlines the structure of the university's authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while also defining the status of existing colleges.

name: UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES LAHORE ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Health Sciences, Lahore and provides for its incorporation, powers, and functions. It outlines the structure of various authorities including the Board of Governors, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while also defining roles for officers such as the Chancellor and Vice Chancellor.

name: UNIVERSITY OF HOME ECONOMICS LAHORE ACT 2017

metadata.title: The University of Home Economics Lahore Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Home Economics Lahore by reconstituting Government College of Home Economics Lahore. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its officers, authorities, statutes, and financial structures.

metadata.title: University of Jhang Act 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Jhang with its campus located at Jhang. It defines the university's functions, including providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: University of Kamalia Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Kamalia and addresses ancillary matters necessary for its operation. It outlines the structure of the university, including its officers, authorities, committees, and the framework for statutes, regulations, and rules.

metadata.title: The University of Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession located in Lahore. It defines the University's functions, including instruction, research, examinations, and degree conferral, while outlining the structure of its governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The University of Layyah Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Layyah and addresses ancillary matters necessary in the public interest. It outlines the structure, officers, authorities, and functions of the university, including provisions for its fund, statutes, and regulations.

name: UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMENT AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE ACT 2004

metadata.title: The University of Management and Technology, Lahore Act 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Management and Technology, Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's functions, powers, jurisdiction within Punjab, and its governance structure including the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The University of Mianwali Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Mianwali by reconstituting the existing sub-campus of the University of Sargodha. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its functions, officers, authorities, and statutory framework.

metadata.title: The University of Narowal Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Narowal by reconstituting and upgrading the existing sub-campus of the University of Gujrat. It defines the university's corporate status, organizational structure, and the powers of its various authorities and committees.

metadata.title: The University of Okara Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Okara by re-constituting a sub-campus of the University of Education, Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its officers and authorities, and grants it corporate status with perpetual succession.

name: UNIVERSITY OF RASUL MANDI BAHA UDDIN ACT 2018

metadata.title: The University of Rasul, Mandi Baha Uddin Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Rasul, Mandi Baha Uddin. It aims to undertake research and development to produce high-quality technical human resources to meet present-day requirements.

metadata.title: University of Rawalpindi Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Rawalpindi as a private sector body corporate in Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various faculties, while outlining its functions and powers.

metadata.title: The University of Sahiwal Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Sahiwal by re-constituting the sub-campus of Bahauddin Zakariya University, Multan. It defines the university's corporate status, outlines its functions, and establishes its governing bodies including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The University of Sargodha Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the University of Sargodha and makes provisions for matters connected therewith. It outlines the powers, duties, and structure of the University's authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

name: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE ACT 2021

metadata.title: The University of Science and Technology, Lahore Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Science and Technology, Lahore in the private sector. It outlines the ancillary matters necessary for the institute's operation, including its functions, powers, officers, and governing bodies.

metadata.title: The University of Sialkot Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Sialkot as a body corporate in the private sector with its campus located in Sialkot. It outlines the university's functions, powers, and structure, including the establishment of faculties, constituent colleges, and institutes while excluding medical and dental education.

name: UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH ASIA LAHORE ACT, 2005

metadata.title: The University of South Asia, Lahore Act 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of South Asia, Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, holding examinations, and awarding degrees.

name: UNIVERSITY OF SOUTHERN PUNJAB MULTAN ACT 2010

metadata.title: The University of Southern Punjab Multan Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Southern Punjab Multan in the private sector. It outlines the university's functions, officers, authorities, and financial provisions.

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: University of the Punjab Ordinance, 1972; University of the Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act re-constitutes and re-organizes the University of the Punjab to improve teaching, research, publications, and administration while safeguarding its autonomy. It establishes the various authorities of the University, including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and defines their powers and duties.

name: UNIVERSITY OF VETERINARY AND ANIMAL SCIENCES, LAHORE ORDINANCE 2002

metadata.title: The University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore to improve teaching, research, publication, and administration in these fields. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under emergency powers due to the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The University of Wah Act 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Wah as a private sector body corporate located at Wah Cantt. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction in various faculties and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The University of White Rock, Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of White Rock as a private sector university with its main campus in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including the Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction across various faculties and conducting research.

metadata.title: The Urdu Language Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Urdu Language Board to ensure strict compliance with the Urdu script in both public and private sectors within the Punjab province. It aims to preserve Urdu as the National Language of Pakistan by regulating its usage in media, education, and government departments while prohibiting the use of Roman or other non-Urdu scripts for expressing Urdu text.

name: VOLUNTARY SOCIAL WELFARE AGENCIES (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and control of voluntary social welfare agencies in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for applying for registration, defines the powers of the Registration Authority, and outlines conditions for the establishment, continuance, and dissolution of such agencies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Walled Cities and Heritage Areas Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Walled Cities and Heritage Areas Authority to provide a legal framework for conserving walled cities, heritage areas, and properties in the Punjab. It outlines the powers, functions, and constitution of the Authority, including regulations on building use, property transfer, and heritage management.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION AND REPEAL OF LAWS) ACT, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act adapts and repeals certain laws applicable to the Province of West Pakistan. It provides for grammatical changes, construes references to former territories as references to current districts or states, and replaces specific terms used in existing laws.

name: WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURAL BANK (RECOVERY OF DUES) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides facilities to the Agricultural Bank for recovering its dues through the pledging, mortgaging, or hypothecation of property. It empowers the Bank to recover dues by disposing of pledged assets and clarifies that no other law affects these rights.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Border Area Regulation, 1959
metadata.summary: This Regulation defines the border area along the Indo-Pakistan border and establishes committees to manage it. It empowers these committees to declare individuals engaged in smuggling or prejudicial activities as 'undesirable persons' and direct them to surrender their immovable property within the border area.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Border Area Regulation, 1959
metadata.summary: This Regulation defines the border area along the Indo-Pakistan border and establishes committees to manage security and economic activities in that zone. It empowers these committees to declare individuals engaged in smuggling or prejudicial activities as 'undesirable persons' and direct them to surrender their immovable property within the border area.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Board (Dissolution) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the immediate dissolution of the West Pakistan Co-operative Board and the vacation of offices by its Chairman and members. It establishes an Administrator to wind up the Board's affairs, recover assets, settle liabilities, and complete ongoing projects under Government control.

name: WEST PAKISTAN COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF LEVY OF FEES) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Cotton Control (Validation of Levy of Fees) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of fees from occupiers of cotton ginning, pressing, seed oil factories, dealers, and company managers for a specific historical period. It deems these fees validly collected despite any conflicting court judgments or provisions in the West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949, prior to its amendment.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ESTABLISHMENT AND IMPROVEMENT OF PARKS AND HISTORICAL PLACES (LAHORE) (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1968

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Establishment and Improvement of Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Establishment and Improvement of Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the repeal of the West Pakistan Establishment and Improvement of Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963. It also mandates the relinquishment of land previously taken possession of by the Trust under the repealed law and addresses related matters such as compensation and the powers of the Collector.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties within the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically addresses surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax in designated districts, introduces a development cess, and modifies stamp duty rates until June 30, 1963.

name: WEST PAKISTAN FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) (PUNJAB AMENDMENT AND VALIDATION) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Punjab Amendment and Validation) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 to apply specifically to the Province of Punjab. It adds a provision allowing for fees or charges to cover government expenses related to the administration of the Act. Additionally, it validates certain charges levied on sugar mills in Punjab prior to the Ordinance's promulgation.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1964
metadata.summary: This Order authorizes the Governor of West Pakistan to adapt existing provincial laws to align with the Constitution by substituting references to 'the Crown' with 'Government' or 'servants of the State'. It specifies that these adaptations apply to all laws made by legislative authorities in the Province, excluding matters enumerated in the Third Schedule to the Constitution.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the employment of women in establishments within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rights for maternity benefits, prohibits employment during specific periods surrounding childbirth, and outlines procedures for payment and penalties for contravention.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION ACT, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Limitation (Custom) Act, 1920; The Punjab Custom (Power to Contest) Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the provisions regarding the application of Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) in West Pakistan. It establishes Shariat as the rule of decision for various personal matters among Muslims, terminates limited estates under customary law, and repeals specific enactments related to custom.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROHIBITION OF OPIUM SMOKING ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the prohibition of opium smoking in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'opium' and 'excise officer', prohibits the manufacture, possession, or smoking of opium, and outlines penalties for various offences including failing to give notice of a place used for smoking.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PUBLICATION OF TEXTBOOKS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Publication of Textbooks (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of the printing, publication, and sale of textbooks published by or under the authority of the West Pakistan Textbook Board. It establishes prohibitions on unauthorized printing or selling, defines offenses and penalties, and outlines procedures for forfeiture and legal cognizance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RAILWAY SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Railway Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund specifically for the relief of Railway servants and their families in West Pakistan. The fund is divided into two parts to assist Gazetted and non-Gazetted servants with financial aid for death, invalidity, and exceptional cases, while also covering management expenses.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RAILWAY SERVANTS’ WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: Pakistan Railway Servants' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Welfare Fund specifically for the relief and security of Railway servants and their families. It defines the composition of the fund, including contributions from servants and the Railway Board, as well as interest on those contributions. The fund is divided into two parts to separately administer benefits for different classes of railway servants based on their post grades.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Repealing Ordinance, 1970
metadata.repeals: certain enactments specified in the Schedule
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to expressly repeal certain enactments that had become spent or unnecessary. It includes provisions for savings regarding previous operations, rights acquired, and pending legal proceedings under the repealed laws.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REQUISITIONING OF STAGE CARRIAGES (TEMPORARY POWERS) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Motor Vehicles (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the temporary requisitioning of motor vehicles within Punjab when needed for public purposes. It outlines the powers of the District Officer (Revenue) to issue orders, conduct searches, and manage compensation or penalties associated with such requisitions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the hours and other conditions of work and employment for persons in shops, commercial, industrial, and other establishments in Punjab. It was promulgated by the Administrator Martial Law, Zone A, on June 30, 1969, under the powers of the Governor of West Pakistan.

name: WEST PAKISTAN VALIDATION OF NAIB-TEHSILDARS AND NAIB-TEHSILDAR CANDIDATES SELECTION ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Validation of Naib Tehsildars and Naib Tehsildar Candidates Selection Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the selection of Naib Tehsildars and Naib Tehsildar candidates made during the years 1960 and 1961. It deems specific individuals listed in the Schedule to have been validly selected and appointed under the terms specified by the Government.

metadata.title: The Women University Multan Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Women University Multan by reconstituting the Government Postgraduate College for Women Multan. It defines the university's structure, including its officers and authorities, and outlines its functions regarding education and research.

metadata.title: The Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the education of workers' children and related matters. It establishes a levy of education cess on employers of establishments with ten or more workers to fund this initiative.

metadata.title: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of compensation to workmen injured by accidents caused by their employers. It defines key terms such as 'employer', 'dependent', and 'disablement', and establishes the legal framework for calculating and distributing compensation amounts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the consolidation of holdings in the Province of Punjab. It establishes procedures for applications, scheme preparation, compensation payment, and the transfer of rights between landowners and tenants following consolidation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection and promotion of the rights and interests of consumers in the Province of Punjab. It establishes mechanisms for speedy redress of consumer complaints, defines liabilities arising from defective products and services, and sets out powers for an Authority and Consumer Courts.

name: PUNJAB CONTROL OF GOONDAS (REMOVAL OF DOUBTS) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Goondas (Removal of Doubts) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to resolve specific legal doubts regarding the number of Tribunals that can be constituted in every district. It clarifies that the term 'a Tribunal' under the West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959, refers to one or more than one Tribunal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the control of disorderly persons commonly known as goondas in the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Tribunal with specific powers to conduct inquiries, summon witnesses, and declare individuals as goondas, while also defining procedures for appeals and revisions.

name: PUNJAB CONTROL OF NARCOTIC SUBSTANCES ACT 2025

metadata.title: Punjab Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of narcotic and controlled substances, including their production, processing, trafficking, and transportation.
