It aims to prevent illicit narcotics-related activities and eliminate the evils associated with these substances to ensure the socioeconomic wellbeing of the people of Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Copying Fees Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the recovery of fees payable for copies made or supplied of records in offices under the control of Revenue, Judicial, and other officers of Government in the Punjab. It defines 'record' to include various documents attached to proceedings and establishes that unpaid fees may be recovered as arrears of land revenue, with specific provisions regarding pleaders representing clients.

metadata.title: The Punjab Corporation Employees (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance invests the Governor of the Punjab with special powers regarding persons in Corporation service. It allows for the removal or reversion of specific employees appointed between January 1, 1972, and July 5, 1977, without notice if deemed necessary in the public interest.

name: PUNJAB COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF LEVY OF FEES) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Levy of Fees) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of fees from occupiers of cotton ginning factories run by diesel in Punjab. It deems these fees validly collected under the West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949 and the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Act, 1949, prior to their amendment by the 1961 Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF TRANSPORTATION FEE) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Transportation Fee) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of transportation fees under the West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949 and the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Act, 1949. It deems these fees to have been validly levied despite any contrary provisions in the original Acts or court orders.

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the control of cotton production, processing, and sale in the Punjab province. It establishes a Cotton Control Board and Advisory Committees to regulate these activities, including licensing requirements for factories and penalties for adulteration.

name: PUNJAB COUNCIL OF THE ARTS ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Council of the Arts Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance No. II of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Council of the Arts to provide for its patronage, promotion, and development. It defines the composition of the Board of Governors and Executive Committee, outlines their functions, and sets up the administrative structure including funds and audit provisions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court Fees (Abolition) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the abolition of court fees in specific cases within the Punjab. It applies to all criminal cases and civil cases where the subject matter value or relief claimed does not exceed twenty-five thousand rupees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.repeals: Enactments specified in the schedule
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the Court of Wards in the Punjab. It establishes the constitution, jurisdiction, and powers of the Court regarding the superintendence of properties and persons.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) ACT 2006

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an independent and efficient Criminal Prosecution Service in the Punjab to ensure prosecutorial independence. It defines the constitution, administration, powers, and functions of prosecutors within the criminal justice system of the Province.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE INSPECTORATE ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service Inspectorate Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service Inspectorate to introduce an effective system of monitoring and inspection for the service. It defines the structure, functions, and powers of the Inspectorate, including its authority to summon records and submit annual reports.

name: PUNJAB CURRICULUM AND TEXTBOOK BOARD ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board as a body corporate to formulate curricula and approve textbooks. It defines the Board's composition, appointment procedures for members, and outlines its powers and functions regarding educational materials.

metadata.title: The Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority to manage and administer schools in the Punjab province. It provides for the creation of a body corporate responsible for delivering quality elementary, secondary, and higher secondary education to underprivileged segments of society.

metadata.title: The Punjab Debtors' Protection Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the more effective protection of debtors in the Punjab by modifying existing laws. It specifically addresses amendments regarding persons carrying on business as money-lenders and regulates the execution of decrees for money payment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Defamation Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Tribunal to handle defamation claims arising from publications, broadcasts, or social media posts that injure a person's reputation. It defines key terms such as 'defamation', 'Claimant', and 'Defendant', sets minimum damages for cases where the defendant fails to obtain leave to defend, and specifies that the Code of Civil Procedure 1908 applies while certain other laws do not.

metadata.title: The Punjab Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers on officers conducting departmental inquiries against government servants in the Province of Punjab to compel witness attendance and document production. It grants these officers the same powers exercisable by a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, while specifying that processes must be served and executed by the relevant civil court.

metadata.title: The Punjab Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of supply, distribution, prices, and trade in certain essential articles within the Province of Punjab. It empowers the Government to control production, storage, movement, and disposal of these articles through notified orders.

metadata.title: The Punjab Fertilizers (Control) Order, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a regulatory framework for the control of fertilizers within the Province of Punjab. It empowers the Controller to designate dealers, fix maximum prices, limit stock quantities, and require specific information from importers and producers regarding fertilizer consignments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Fertilizers Control Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of the manufacture, supply, importation, distribution, dealership, quality standards, pricing, licensing, advertising, transportation, storage, sale, monitoring, and disposal of fertilizers in the Punjab. It aims to ensure the availability of quality fertilizers for agricultural purposes and addresses matters ancillary thereto.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF TEXTILE TECHNOLOGY CESS ACT 1962

metadata.title: The Punjab Institute of Textile Technology Cess Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to establish and maintain the Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology in Lyallpur. It authorizes the government to levy a cess on textile mills based on installed spindles and looms, outlines assessment procedures, and details provisions for exemptions and recovery.

metadata.title: The Punjab Registration of Godowns Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system for the registration of godowns (warehouses, cold storage, or depots) in the Punjab province. It mandates that owners must register their premises and maintain specific records regarding essential articles stored within them.

metadata.title: The Punjab Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the cultivation of rice in the Province of Punjab to check water-logging, salinity, and seepage damage. It grants the Board of Revenue powers to prohibit or restrict rice cultivation in specified areas while allowing for relaxation of these restrictions for land reclamation operations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Seed Corporation Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Seed Corporation in the Province of Punjab to handle the production, procurement, processing, marketing, and distribution of seeds. It defines the corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines the constitution, powers, and functions of its Board and Managing Director.

name: PUNJAB SEEDS AND FRUIT PLANTS ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Punjab Seeds and Fruit Plants Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better production and distribution of high-quality seeds and fruit plants in the Province of Punjab. It establishes a system for registering growers, certifying seeds and plants, and regulating their sale and distribution.

metadata.title: The Punjab Silkworms (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the production, supply, possession, and rearing of silkworms within the Punjab. It establishes government powers to authorize supply, enter premises for searches, impose penalties for contraventions, and make rules to carry out its purposes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Soil Reclamation Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy reclamation and improvement of areas damaged by floods (Thur and Sem) in Punjab. It also aims to prevent further damage and maximize agricultural production through the establishment of a Board.

metadata.title: The Punjab Tobacco Vend Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the regulation of retail sales of manufactured tobacco in urban areas within the Province of Punjab. It establishes a licensing system for dealers, defines key terms such as 'manufactured tobacco' and 'urban area', and prescribes penalties for selling without a license or breaching license conditions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vegetable Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of a wholesale vegetable market at Lahore. It also validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Order No. 121 and West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962.

name: PUNJAB HOLY QURAN (PRINTING AND RECORDING) ACT 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the Holy Quran text free from printing and recording errors. It also provides for the proper disposal of damaged or shaheed copies of the Holy Quran.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF QURA’N AND SEERAT STUDIES ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies in Lahore as a body corporate. The Institute is empowered to conduct research, publish reports, hold seminars, and provide higher education in the fields of the Quran and Sunnah.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper management and administration of Waqf Properties in the Province of Punjab. It establishes the roles of the Chief Administrator and other officials, outlines procedures for registration, eviction, and lease termination, and details how income from these properties should be utilized.

name: PUNJAB DEVELOPMENT OF DAMAGED AREAS ACT, 1952

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Damaged Areas Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development of damaged areas within the Punjab. It establishes the legal framework for Improvement Trusts to frame schemes involving land acquisition, demolition of unfit buildings, and street alterations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Districts (Reconstitution) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the alteration of district limits and the constitution of new districts within the Province of Punjab. It grants the Government power to alter these limits or create new districts via notification and outlines how existing laws apply to areas affected by such changes.

name: PUNJAB ENFORCEMENT OF WOMEN'S PROPERTY RIGHTS ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection and security of women's ownership and possession rights over their properties. It establishes an Ombudsperson to handle complaints regarding deprivation of property through harassment, coercion, force, or fraud, and outlines procedures for restoring title and possession.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2010
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967; Bank of Punjab Act, 1989; Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act levies taxes and alters the rates of taxes and duties in the Punjab. It amends several existing laws, including the Stamp Act, 1899, the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967, the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989, and the Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000.

metadata.title: The Punjab Flood Relief Cess Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Flood Relief Cess Ordinance, 1973 (Punjab Ordinance No. VIII of 1973)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a flood relief cess in the Province of Punjab during the financial year 1973-74. The cess is imposed on admission tickets for cinema houses and race courses at specified rates, collected similarly to entertainment duty.

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of Government dues as arrears of land revenue in the Province of Punjab. It empowers the Government to issue notifications declaring specific dues recoverable under the Revenue Recoveries Act, 1890.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT LANDS (RESUMPTION OF GRANTS AND EXTINGUISHMENT OF RIGHTS) ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Lands (Resumption of Grants and Extinguishment of Rights) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the resumption of certain government land grants made between 1945 and 1947 that were issued in disregard of public interest or proper procedure. It empowers the Government to order the resumption of such grants and extinguish the rights of grantees, while allowing for compensation only for necessary buildings or trees and refunding acquisition costs if proprietary rights had been acquired prior to the order.

name: PUNJAB HINDU WOMEN'S RIGHTS TO AGRICULTURAL LAND ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The Punjab Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1942; The Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Sind Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the Hindu Law governing women's rights to agricultural land in the Province of Punjab. It establishes specific rules for the devolution of such land when a Hindu dies intestate, granting widows shares equivalent to sons under certain conditions.

name: PUNJAB JINNAH ABADIS FOR NON-PROPRIETORS IN RURAL AREAS ACT 1986

metadata.title: The Punjab Jinnah Abadis for Non-proprietors in Rural Areas Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: Act V of 1975; Ordinance II of 1986
metadata.summary: This Act provides for housing facilities to non-proprietors residing in rural areas of the Punjab. It establishes the process for granting land free of cost, defining proprietary rights after construction, and outlining conditions for cancellation of allotment or re-entry of land.

metadata.title: The Punjab Katchi Abadis Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization, development, and improvement of Katchi Abadis in the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Director-General to oversee these functions and outlines powers regarding land acquisition, shifting of occupants, and the management of funds.

name: PUNJAB LAND DISPOSITIONS (SAVING OF SHAMILAT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for a uniform interpretation of general expressions regarding the disposition of 'Shamilat' lands in the Province of Punjab. It stipulates that Shamilat lands are not included in any land disposition unless specifically mentioned as the subject matter, regardless of existing laws, usage, or custom.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better preservation and protection of certain portions of the territories of Punjab. It establishes provisions for notifying areas, regulating specific matters within those areas, and managing the beds of Nalahs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Records Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Land Records Authority to reform and modernize the system of land records in the province. It aims to improve service delivery, ensure long-lasting tenure security, and address ancillary matters related to land management.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Abolition) Act, 1998
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Revenue (Abolition) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes land revenue in the Province of Punjab starting from Rabi 1996-97. It clarifies that liabilities for revenue due before this period remain unaffected and continue to be collected under existing laws.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land-Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for land revenue administration in the Punjab province, including the division of districts and the appointment of revenue officers. It outlines procedures for creating records of rights, assessing land revenue, collecting payments, and recovering arrears through distress or sale of property.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Utilization Authority Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Land Utilization Authority to manage and develop culturable waste land in the Province of Punjab. It provides for the creation of a Board, defines the powers and functions of the Authority, and outlines procedures for surveying land, preparing schemes, and providing credit facilities to motivate land owners.

metadata.title: The Punjab Lands Improvement Tax Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Lands Improvement Tax Ordinance, 1975 (Punjab Ordinance No. I of 1975)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of improvement tax on specific lands situated in local areas within the Punjab. It establishes a tax rate of Rs. 3.75 per acre per annum for a period of 12 years and outlines procedures for recovery as if it were land revenue arrears.

metadata.title: The Punjab Laws Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act declares which specific rules, laws, and regulations previously made for the Punjab have the force of law. It also serves to amend, consolidate, or repeal other existing rules, orders, and regulations within the territory.

name: PUNJAB LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an efficacious and speedy mechanism for the issuance of Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates in Punjab. It aims to facilitate this process while curtailing fraud and forgery by empowering the National Database and Registration Authority (or civil courts) to issue these certificates.

metadata.title: The Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control and regulation of minor canals in certain areas of West Pakistan. It establishes powers for the Collector and Provincial Government regarding construction, water supply, rate collection, and dispute resolution.

name: PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION (REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Removal of Difficulties) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Removal of Difficulties) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act addresses legal difficulties regarding limited estates held by refugee females in the Punjab who were erroneously treated as full owners. It declares previous decrees treating these allottees as full owners to be of no legal effect and allows affected persons to challenge such decisions within one year.

name: PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION (REMOVAL OF DOUBTS) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Removal of Doubts) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962; The West Pakistan Muslim Personal (Shariat) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963; The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance removes legal doubts regarding the termination of limited estates held by Muslim females under customary law in Punjab. It deems such estates terminated as of December 31, 1962, and invalidates any inconsistent court decrees or orders.

name: PUNJAB NATIONAL CALAMITIES (PREVENTION AND RELIEF) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance and restoration of order in areas affected by calamities such as floods, famines, or epidemics. It establishes powers for a Relief Commissioner to prevent, check, or control these calamities and to provide immediate relief to victims.

name: PUNJAB PARTITION OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Partition of Immovable Property Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends and reforms the law relating to the expeditious partition of immovable property in Punjab. It provides for ancillary matters including definitions, procedures for filing suits, handling non-appearance of defendants, and the calculation of mesne profits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pre-emption (Removal of Doubts) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance removes doubts regarding the existence of the right of pre-emption for specific properties in Mianwali and Sargodha districts. It clarifies that the removal of doubts notification does not apply to sales of agricultural land or other immovable properties described in the Schedule unless specific conditions related to displacement by the Chashma Barrage are met.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pre-emption Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: Act I of 1913
metadata.summary: This Act re-enacts the law relating to pre-emption in Punjab to bring it into conformity with the injunctions of Islam as set out in the Holy Qur'an and Sunnah. It defines key terms such as 'immovable property' and 'pre-emptor', establishes priorities for exercising the right of pre-emption, and outlines procedures for demand, waiver, and determination of price.

metadata.title: The Punjab Privy Purses (Charged Expenditure) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares that the expenditure relating to privy purses of Rulers of former States incorporated into the Province of Punjab is a charge on the Provincial Consolidated Fund. It stipulates that any sums paid by the Federal Government as privy purses to such Rulers or their successors shall be reimbursed out of this Fund.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF INTEREST ON PRIVATE LOANS ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Interest on Private Loans Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the business and practices of private money-lending and advancing loans based on interest within the Punjab province. It defines key terms such as 'interest', 'money lender', and 'loan or debt' to ensure compliance with Islamic injunctions against charging interest.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION AND RESTORATION OF TENANCY RIGHTS ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection and Restoration of Tenancy Rights Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted by the Governor of the Punjab to protect and restore the rights of certain land tenants. It establishes specific grounds necessary for the ejectment of tenants, such as failure to pay rent or misuse of land, and outlines procedures for restoring tenancies.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF OWNERSHIP OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act is enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to protect lawful ownership of immovable property within the province. It provides effective legal remedies against dispossession and establishes a mechanism for the expeditious resolution of related disputes.

name: PUNJAB RECOVERY OF COST (COPIES OF ESSENTIAL REVENUE RECORDS) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of costs incurred by the Government in preparing and supplying copies of essential revenue records to Union Councils. It mandates that these copies be made available for public inspection during office hours and establishes the mechanism for recovering these costs from land revenue payers.

name: PUNJAB REDEMPTION AND RESTITUTION OF MORTGAGED LANDS ACT 1964

metadata.title: The Punjab Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the redemption and restitution of certain mortgages of land in the Province of Punjab. It establishes procedures for mortgagors to apply to the Collector for orders directing redemption and restitution, including provisions for depositing amounts due and ejectment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the relief of indebtedness in the Punjab by amending laws governing relations between debtors and creditors. It establishes procedures for insolvency, usurious loans, debt conciliation boards, and the redemption of mortgages.

metadata.title: The Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the relief of indebtedness in the Province of Punjab. It establishes powers for courts to limit recoverable interest, allows debtors to deposit money in court to stop interest accumulation, and grants immunity from arrest for monetary decrees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of certain powers in relation to requisitioned land after the expiration of previous acts and ordinances. It outlines the procedures for releasing land from requisition, including inquiries, orders for possession, and notice requirements when owners cannot be found.

name: PUNJAB SURVEY AND RECTANGULATION OF LANDS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The Punjab Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the survey and rectangulation of lands within the Province of Punjab. It empowers the Board of Revenue to direct these operations, assess associated costs, and impose penalties for obstruction or non-compliance.

name: PUNJAB TAUNSA BARRAGE BETTERMENT TAX ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Punjab Taunsa Barrage Betterment Tax Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of betterment tax on lands irrigated by the Taunsa Barrage Canals. It establishes the rates for the tax, specifies who is liable to pay it, and outlines procedures for objections, appeals, and recovery of arrears.

name: PUNJAB TENANCY (VALIDATION AND EXTENSION OF PERIOD FOR PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates amendments made to the Punjab Tenancy (Amendment) Rules, 1953, regarding the extension of the period for occupancy tenants to pay compensation. It further extends this payment period for tenants who failed to comply with previous rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for tenancies in Punjab, specifically defining occupancy rights and procedures for their transfer or succession. It outlines regulations regarding rent enhancement, reduction, collection, and adjustments, as well as provisions for ejectment, abandonment, and compensation for improvements made by tenants.

metadata.title: The Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: Punjab Act VI of 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of a tax on lands in the Thal area whose value has increased due to irrigation from the Thal Canal. It outlines the rates, persons liable to pay, methods of recovery, and powers regarding exemptions and withholding irrigation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Trusts Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act revises and modifies the law relating to trusts within the Punjab province. It provides provisions for ancillary matters regarding the creation, administration, and extinction of trusts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to usurious loans in the Province of Punjab. It empowers courts to reopen transactions, relieve debtors of excessive interest liability, and revise unfair agreements or securities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Highways Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to highways in the Province of Punjab. It establishes Highway Authorities, defines their powers regarding road maintenance and encroachments, and sets out duties for highway users including traffic regulations and penalties.

name: PUNJAB TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Punjab Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the levy of tolls on public roads and bridges in the Province of Punjab. It grants the Provincial Government powers to set up toll gates, lease out toll collection rights, and impose penalties for non-payment or unlawful acts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits Cooperative Societies from carrying on business as financial institutions by accepting deposits for lending or investment purposes. It establishes Cooperatives Boards to act as liquidators, verify claims, unearth hidden assets, and oversee the winding up and dissolution of undesirable societies.

name: PUNJAB ELECTRICITY (EMERGENCY POWERS) (CONTROL OF SUPPLY) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity (Emergency Powers) (Control of Supply) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, consumption, distribution, and use of electrical energy, as well as the rates for such supply in the Punjab. It empowers the Provincial Government to issue orders prohibiting or restricting energy supply, discontinuing supply under specific circumstances, fixing supply rates, and delegating functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity (Emergency Powers) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of the public in cases of emergency regarding electricity supply. It empowers the Provincial Government to assume possession and control of a public electricity service if there is a likelihood of supply failure or uncertainty about ownership.

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act explains and amplifies section 7 of the Electricity Act, 1910 specifically for its application to the Punjab. It grants the Punjab Government the powers of a licensee when engaging in the business of supplying electrical energy and outlines procedures for purchasing undertakings.

name: PUNJAB ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND CONSERVATION AGENCY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Energy Efficiency and Conservation Agency Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Energy Efficiency and Conservation Agency as a body corporate to implement provisions of the National Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act, 2016. It defines the Agency's composition, functions, powers, and procedures for meetings and decision-making.

metadata.title: The Punjab Power Development Board Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Power Development Board to facilitate private investors in the power sector and harness energy resources within the province. It provides for the board's composition, functions, funds, and administrative procedures to implement government policies on power generation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, conservation, rehabilitation, and improvement of the environment within the Punjab province. It establishes mechanisms to prevent and control pollution, promote sustainable development, and regulate discharges, emissions, and hazardous substances.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION ON MANUFACTURE, SALE, USE AND IMPORT OF POLYTHENE BAGS (BLACK OR ANY OTHER POLYTHENE BAG BELOW FIFTEEN MICRON THICKNESS) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition on Manufacture, Sale, Use and Import of Polythene Bags (black or any other Polythene Bag below fifteen micron thickness) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the manufacture, sale, use, and import of black polythene bags or any other polythene bag below fifteen micron thickness in the Province of Punjab. It establishes penalties including imprisonment or fines for contravention and empowers the government to make rules and regulations to carry out its purposes.

name: PUNJAB DUTY ON EXCESSIVE WASTAGE OF SPIRITS IN DISTILLERIES (VALIDATION) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Punjab Duty on Excessive Wastage of Spirits in Distilleries (Validation) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy and recovery of excise duty on excessive wastage of spirits in distilleries occurring from July 1, 1940 onwards. It deems any such duties levied prior to this Ordinance as validly collected if they comply with the specified scales.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise Act, 1914
metadata.repeals: Enactments mentioned in the Schedule
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law in the Punjab relating to intoxicating liquor and drugs. It covers import, export, transport, manufacture, sale, possession, licensing, duties, offences, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; The Stamp Act, 1899; The Punjab Finance Act, 1964
metadata.repeals: Section 11 of the Punjab Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act enhances the rates of certain taxes and duties within the Province of the Punjab. It amends existing legislation regarding motor vehicle taxation, entertainment duties, and stamp duties while establishing new tax levies on specific professions and trades.

name: PUNJAB FINANCE ORDINANCE (PROVISIONS RELATING TO HOTEL TAX), 1978

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to levy and enhance the rates of certain taxes and duties within the Province of the Punjab. It specifically substitutes existing provisions regarding hotel tax, defining the tax rate, exemptions for hill stations, and procedures for assessment and collection.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to levy and enhance the rates of certain taxes and duties within the Province of Punjab. It amends several existing acts, including those concerning urban immovable property tax, entertainments duty, motor vehicles taxation, and hotel taxes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of taxes on horse-race betting in the Punjab. It establishes provisions for levying totalizator tax and betting tax, defines key terms such as 'backer' and 'book-maker', and outlines duties regarding assessment, collection, and exemptions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Option (Repeal) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Option Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to repeal the Punjab Local Option Act, 1923. The action was taken in accordance with the direction of the Federal Shariat Court and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: PUNJAB MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSACTION LICENSEES ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicle Transaction Licensees Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a licensing framework for motor vehicle transaction licensees in Punjab to regulate their services and improve delivery for vehicle purchasers. It defines the qualifications for obtaining a license, outlines procedures for granting and renewing licenses, and mandates that licensees act as withholding agents for fees and taxes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the imposition of tax on motor vehicles in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'motor vehicle', 'Government', and 'licensing officer', and establishes obligations for declaring vehicles and paying taxes.

name: PUNJAB REAL ESTATE AGENTS AND MOTOR VEHICLES DEALERS (REGULATION OF BUSINESS) ORDINANCE, 1980

metadata.title: The Punjab Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the business of real estate agents and motor vehicles dealers in the Province of Punjab. It establishes requirements for registration, defines disqualifications for obtaining a certificate, and outlines procedures for maintaining records and fixing commissions.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (VALIDATION OF TAX) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property (Validation of Tax) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of property tax under the repealed Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940 and the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958. It deems certain extended areas within local authority limits to have always been part of rating areas and considers taxes collected from these areas as validly levied.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a tax on urban immovable property in the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'assessing authority', 'owner', and 'tax', and outlines provisions for exemptions, valuation lists, appeals, and penalties for default.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1985

metadata.repeals: The Gift Tax Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act makes specific provisions regarding taxation within the Province of Punjab. It amends sections of the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 and the Punjab Finance Act, 1973 to alter tax levies and exemptions for motor vehicles. Additionally, it repeals the Federal Gift Tax Act, 1963.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: Section 16 of the Punjab Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and fees within the Province of Punjab. It amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to introduce new rules for valuing urban land and adjusting stamp duties on conveyances and exchanges of property. Additionally, it repeals section 16 of the Punjab Finance Act, 1963.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1998
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Punjab Finance Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act levies and enhances the rates of certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Punjab. It amends several existing statutes, including the Stamp Act, the Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, the Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, and the Punjab Finance Act, 1973.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1999
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899; The Punjab Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act reduces the rates of stamp duty and revises certain taxes within the Punjab. It amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to adjust duties on agricultural land, immovable property, and other cases, while also updating tax rates for companies in the Punjab Finance Act, 1977.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2003
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Punjab Finance Act, 1964; Punjab Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act enhances, reduces, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties within the Province of the Punjab. It amends several existing statutes, including the Stamp Act, the Entertainments Duty Act, the Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, and previous Finance Acts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2005
metadata.amends: The Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2002 (II of 2000)
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the levy of sales tax on certain services within the Province of Punjab. It achieves this by amending the Schedule to the Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2006
metadata.amends: The Court Fees Act, 1870; The Stamp Act, 1899; The Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act reduces court fees and rationalizes certain stamp duties applicable to various financial instruments. It also amends the Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 and the Punjab Finance Act, 1964 to update stamp duty provisions and electricity duty schedules. It specifically revises charges for energy supplied by licensees and un-metered premises within the Punjab jurisdiction.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2008
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act levies taxes and alters the rates of tax and duties within the Punjab. It amends existing legislation regarding stamp duties on property transfers, entertainment duties, and sales tax rates.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899; The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act levies taxes and alters tax rates and duties within the Punjab. It amends the Stamp Act of 1899 regarding transfer rights and inserts a new clause into the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 to create a fund for social sector development.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2011

metadata.summary: This Act levies taxes and alters the rates of certain duties within the Punjab province. It amends existing legislation regarding entertainment duties, motor vehicle taxation, sales tax, and local government charges while introducing a new farm house tax.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2013

metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties within the Punjab province. It amends several existing acts related to urban immovable property tax, entertainments duty, motor vehicles taxation, finance, agricultural income tax, and previous finance acts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2014
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Punjab Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Punjab. It also regulates connected matters and amends several existing acts including the Stamp Act, 1899, and the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2015

metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties within the Punjab province. It also addresses ancillary matters related to these financial instruments.

metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties within the Punjab province. It also addresses ancillary matters related to these fiscal changes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2019

metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes and duties within the Province of Punjab. It also addresses ancillary matters related to these fiscal changes.

metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes and duties within the Punjab province. It also addresses ancillary matters related to these fiscal changes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2024

metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties within the Punjab province. It amends several existing statutes, including the Court Fees Act of 1870 and the Stamp Duty Act of 1899, to update fee schedules and substitute specific monetary values.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2026

metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Punjab. It amends several existing provincial acts to update tax rates, introduce electronic payment requirements, and establish a risk-based evaluation system for input tax claims.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties within the Province of Punjab. It establishes specific surcharges on agricultural income-tax in designated districts and outlines various other taxes including those on cinemas, callings, professions, trades, motor vehicles, and railway fares.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties within the Province of Punjab. It establishes specific surcharges on agricultural income-tax, cinemas, motor vehicles, and railway fares for the financial year 1964-65.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties within the Province of Punjab. It specifically establishes surcharges on agricultural income-tax, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, and railway fare taxes for the financial year 1965-66.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and duties within the Province of Punjab. It establishes specific surcharges on agricultural income tax, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, and railway fares for the financial year 1966-67.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and duties in the province of Punjab. It establishes surcharges on agricultural income-tax, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, railway fare taxes, and alterations to stamp duties for the financial year 1967-68.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and surcharges in the Province of Punjab. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income-tax surcharges, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, and railway fare taxes for the financial year 1968-69.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1972
metadata.amends: Punjab Ordinance XI of 1971; West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes, fees, and surcharges in the Province of the Punjab for the financial year 1972-73. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income tax surcharges, cinema taxes, and motor vehicle taxes while also enhancing related fees.

metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and fees within the Province of the Punjab. It substitutes specific schedules for previous acts and enhances fees related to motor vehicles and court proceedings.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1990

metadata.summary: This Act enhances the rates of certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Province of Punjab. It amends various existing statutes, including the Stamp Act of 1899 and provisions related to companies law, by substituting specific figures and references.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1995

metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and enhancement of rates on certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Punjab. It amends the Stamp Act, 1899, and several other specific acts to update duty amounts and definitions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1996

metadata.summary: This Act levies and enhances the rates of certain taxes, duties, and fees in the Punjab. It amends several existing acts, including the Punjab Court Fees Act, 1870, and the Stamp Act, 1899, by substituting specific words with new values.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1997
metadata.amends: Stamp Act 1899; Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act 1958; Punjab Entertainments Duty Act 1958; Punjab Finance Act 1973; Punjab Finance Act 1977
metadata.summary: This Act levies and alters the rates of certain taxes, duties, and fees in the Punjab. It amends several existing acts, including the Stamp Act 1899, to update schedules regarding octroi, air tickets, hotel bills, and property registration fees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2004
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Finance Act, 1958; Finance Act, 1973; Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act enhances, reduces, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties within the Province of the Punjab. It specifically amends the Stamp Act, 1899, and several Finance Acts from 1958, 1973, and 1977 to update duty rates and definitions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Punjab Finance Act, 1977; Punjab Finance Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to taxes and duties in the Punjab. It specifically updates provisions regarding stamp duty, urban immovable property tax, motor vehicle taxation, and capital value tax on immovable property.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 2000

It amends several existing acts, including those related to stamp duty, urban immovable property tax, entertainments duty, motor vehicles taxation, and finance regulations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 2001

metadata.summary: This Ordinance further levies, enhances, and rationalizes certain taxes and duties in the Province of the Punjab. It amends four specific existing Acts: the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; the Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; the Punjab Finance Act, 1964; and the Punjab Finance Act, 1973.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 2002

metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to rationalize certain taxes, fees, and duties within the province. It amends several existing acts and ordinances, including those related to stamp duties, urban immovable property tax, motor vehicle taxation, and finance regulations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Administrator of Martial Law to continue and levy specific taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Province of Punjab. It establishes rates for cinema tax, surcharges on agricultural income tax and motor vehicle tax, and includes provisions regarding railway fares and freight.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to continue and levy specific taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the newly formed Province of Punjab. It establishes rates for agricultural income tax surcharges, cinema taxes, motor vehicle tax surcharges, and railway fare taxes for the financial year 1970-71.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1971

metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, fees, and surcharges in the Province of Punjab. It substitutes existing schedules for agricultural income tax acts and imposes new surcharges on agricultural income tax and motor vehicle tax in specified districts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1981

metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to streamline the rates of certain taxes and duties within the Province of the Punjab. It amends four specific existing Acts: the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; the Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; and the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The Punjab Financial Advisory Services Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Financial Advisory Services as a body corporate to provide financial and management advisory services. It creates an Authority with a Board comprising government officials, assembly members, and private sector experts to ensure efficient use of public resources.

name: PUNJAB GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND ACT 2009

metadata.title: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund to generate revenue for discharging the liabilities of the General Provident Fund. It creates a Reserve Fund within the Public Account and vests the management and administration of the Fund in a Management Committee.

metadata.title: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act levies and collects an infrastructure development cess on the transportation of goods manufactured, produced, consumed in, imported into, or exported out of the Punjab. The collected funds are intended to provide resources for the maintenance, development, and improvement of necessary infrastructure to handle goods traffic.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pension Fund Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Pension Fund to generate revenue for discharging the pension liabilities of the Government of the Punjab. It creates a Reserve Pension Fund and sets up a Management Committee responsible for the administration and management of the Fund.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Financial Management Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates financial affairs in the public sector and matters relating to the Provincial Consolidated Fund and Public Account of the Punjab. It aims to ensure comprehensive, efficient, transparent, and sustainable management of finances to contribute to long-term socio-economic stability.

metadata.title: The Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Revenue Authority as a body corporate to reform and modernize the taxation system in Punjab. It provides for the establishment of an advisory council, defines the powers and functions of the authority, and outlines provisions for the assessment, collection, and returns of taxes.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES ACT 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a tax on services provided, rendered, initiated, received, originated, executed, or consumed in the Punjab. It also deals with ancillary matters related to such taxation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Secretariat Allowance (Withdrawal) Act 1997
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Secretariat Allowance (Withdrawal) Ordinance 1997 (XXXIV of 1997)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the withdrawal of the Secretariat Allowance paid to employees in various Punjab government secretariats. It declares that a previous letter providing this allowance was discriminatory and deemed never to have been issued, while ensuring that allowances already paid are not recoverable.

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Food Authority to oversee food safety and standards within the province. It provides a legal framework for licensing food businesses, regulating food composition, and imposing penalties for selling adulterated or unsafe food.

metadata.title: The Punjab Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, distribution, and movement of foodstuffs in Punjab. It empowers the Government to regulate trade, commerce, storage, and pricing of specific commodities like wheat, rice, and sugar through notified orders.

name: PUNJAB PRICE CONTROL OF ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a mechanism to fix prices and control the artificial hike of essential commodities in the Punjab province. It creates a Price Control Council with specific powers to monitor markets, review fixed prices, and issue directions to ensure implementation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Firewood and Charcoal (Restriction) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits and regulates the burning of firewood and charcoal in factories, brick-kilns, lime-kilns, and other specified places within the Punjab. It defines specific terms such as 'factory' and 'firewood', outlines restrictions with certain exceptions for domestic use or personal kiln operations, and prescribes penalties including imprisonment or fines for contravention.

metadata.title: The Punjab Fisheries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to fisheries in the Province of Punjab. It establishes definitions, appoints inspectors, regulates permits for fishing engines, designates fish sanctuaries, and outlines penalties and powers for seizure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forest (Sale of Timber) Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of timber sales and the establishment of sale depots within the Punjab. It grants the Provincial Government power to make rules regulating these activities, including registration requirements and penalties for infringement.

name: PUNJAB PLANTATION AND MAINTENANCE OF TREES ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Plantation and Maintenance of Trees Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the plantation and maintenance of trees within the Province of Punjab. It mandates that occupiers must plant and maintain three trees per acre, with provisions for government intervention if requirements are not met.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of wildlife in the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Board to oversee these functions and sets out provisions regarding hunting restrictions, licensing, penalties for offenses, and the regulation of zoos and breeding farms.

metadata.title: The Punjab Economic Research Institute Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Economic Research Institute as a statutory body with perpetual succession. It outlines the Institute's functions, which include conducting research in economics and demography, providing advice on economic policies, and assisting national and international agencies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Educational Institutions (Reconstitution) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes certain educational institutions in the Punjab to improve their governance and management. It grants these institutions academic, financial, and administrative autonomy aimed at enhancing the quality of education.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Boards of Governors to manage and control government educational and training institutions in the Punjab. It defines the constitution, powers, and functions of these boards, including provisions for their incorporation, membership, and financial administration.

metadata.title: The Punjab Higher Education Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Higher Education Commission to promote and improve higher education, research, and development within the province. It defines the Commission's structure, including its Controlling Authority, Chairperson, and composition of members, while outlining its powers, functions, and administrative procedures.

name: PUNJAB KINNAIRD COLLEGE FOR WOMEN, LAHORE, ORDINANCE 2002

metadata.title: The Kinnaird College for Women, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the Kinnaird College for Women, Lahore in cooperation with its Association. It establishes the College as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines the composition and powers of the Board of Governors responsible for its administration.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE COLLEGES (MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control and management of private colleges in the Punjab. It establishes a Governing Body to oversee these institutions, streamline their administration, and regulate teacher service conditions.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the promotion and regulation of private educational institutions within the Punjab. It establishes a framework requiring all such institutions to be registered with a designated authority and sets up District Committees to oversee these functions.

name: PUNJAB UNIVERSITIES AND BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION MALPRACTICES ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Universities and Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Malpractices Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the eradication of malpractices connected with examinations held by Universities and Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as candidate, employee, and examiner, and establishes provisions regarding punishment for offenses, privileged documents, and official information.

name: PUNJAB UNIVERSITIES REMOVAL OF UNDESIRABLE GOVERNMENT SERVANTS ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Punjab (Universities) Removal of Undesirable Government Servants Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of Government servants serving in Universities or other educational institutions who are deemed undesirable. It empowers the Governor to terminate such services after giving the servant a reasonable opportunity to show cause against the proposed action.

name: PUNJAB DESTITUTE AND NEGLECTED CHILDREN ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the rescue, protective custody, care, and rehabilitation of destitute and neglected children in the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Child Protection and Welfare Bureau, defines specific offences related to children, and outlines procedures for their rescue and institutional care.

metadata.title: The Punjab Emergency Service Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Emergency Service to maintain preparedness for emergencies and provide timely rescue and medical treatment. It defines the powers of the Service, including coordinating other organizations, establishing emergency response teams, and managing data for prevention.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Forensic Science Agency to conduct forensic examinations of documents, materials, and objects. It defines the agency's functions, including rendering expert opinions for courts and tribunals, maintaining records, and promoting awareness on forensics.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forensic Science Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Forensic Science Authority as a body corporate to conduct forensic examinations on documents, materials, and other objects. It provides for the constitution of the Authority, including its members and experts, and outlines their powers, functions, and procedures for rendering scientific opinions to investigating agencies.

metadata.title: The Punjab High Security Zones (Establishment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the declaration of high security zones and designated areas within the Punjab province. It regulates public gatherings, prohibits activities prejudicial to public safety, and establishes Provincial and District Intelligence Committees to oversee these measures.

name: PUNJAB INFORMATION OF TEMPORARY RESIDENTS ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Information of Temporary Residents Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework for sharing information regarding tenants and other temporary residents with the police in Punjab. It mandates landlords, property dealers, and hotel managers to provide specific details about occupants within set timeframes and to verify identification using national identity cards or passports.

metadata.title: The Punjab Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the prevention of tobacco smoking by juveniles in the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'juvenile' and 'public place', establishes penalties for selling tobacco to minors, and grants powers to make rules.

name: PUNJAB LAND PRESERVATION (EXTENSION TO DERA GHAZI KHAN EXCLUDED AREA) REGULATION, 1959

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Preservation (Extension to Dera Ghazi Khan Excluded Area) Regulation, 1959
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the provisions of the Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1900 to the Dera Ghazi Khan Excluded Area in the Province of Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on September 12, 1959, to ensure peace and good government in that region.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to preventive detention and the control of persons and publications in the Punjab. It grants powers to arrest, detain, and control suspected persons, as well as regulate publications and public meetings to maintain public order.

metadata.title: The Punjab Marriage Functions Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance, 2000; The Punjab Marriage Functions Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act regulates marriage functions and related ceremonies within the Punjab province to prevent wasteful expenses and ostentatious displays. It imposes specific restrictions on decorations, fireworks, dowry exhibitions, food servings, and the timing of events while establishing committees for enforcement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Military Transport Act, 1916
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Military Transport Animals Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the impressment of animals, vehicles, boats, and gear in the Punjab for military transport purposes. It establishes the liability of these items for service or hire, outlines the appointment of inspection officers, and details procedures for enumeration, seizure, and compensation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: W.P. Ordinance No.I of 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of gambling within the Province of Punjab. It defines terms such as 'common gaming house' and 'gaming', while establishing penalties for owning, keeping, or participating in gambling activities in various settings.

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Hoarding Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of hoarding of scheduled articles during the emergent situation caused by the Corona virus pandemic (COVID-19). It defines offences related to stocking excess quantities or accumulating goods without offering them for sale, and grants officers powers to search premises, seize articles, and auction seized items.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE SECURITY COMPANIES (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation, licensing, and control of private security companies in the Province of Punjab. It establishes procedures for granting licenses, defines prohibited activities such as wearing military-style uniforms or operating without a license, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: PUNJAB PROBATION AND PAROLE SERVICE ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Probation and Parole Service Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Probation and Parole Service to effectively assess and manage offenders on probation or parole. It aims to improve coordination within the criminal justice system and facilitate offender rehabilitation through a structured service framework.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF SMOKING IN CINEMA HOUSES ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking in cinema houses within the Province of Punjab. It establishes penalties including fines and arrest without warrant for individuals who smoke during performances, while also granting management the power to post notices regarding these restrictions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to Qaumi Razakars in the Province of Punjab. It establishes their constitution, duties, powers, and disciplinary measures while defining their status as public servants.

metadata.title: The Punjab Rented Premises Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the relationship between landlords and tenants regarding rented premises in Punjab. It establishes a mechanism for settling disputes expeditiously through Rent Tribunals and defines obligations, grounds for eviction, and procedures for tenancy agreements.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF MOTOR VEHICLES (TEMPORARY POWERS) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Motor Vehicles (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the temporary requisitioning of motor vehicles within the Punjab for any public purpose deemed necessary by the District Officer (Revenue). It outlines the procedures for issuing orders, serving notices, appealing decisions to the Government of the Punjab, and provisions regarding compensation and penalties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Safe Cities Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Safe Cities Authority to oversee the construction, development, and maintenance of an integrated command, control, and communications (IC3) system in major cities of Punjab. The primary objective is to ensure the safety and security of people through a city-wide network including surveillance systems and control rooms.

name: PUNJAB SECURITY OF VULNERABLE ESTABLISHMENTS ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Act, 2015 to provide for effective security arrangements at vulnerable locations. It creates a Security Advisory Committee responsible for identifying establishments, issuing security advice, and conducting inspections to prevent acts of terrorism and other crimes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sentencing Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act lays down the factors that courts must consider when passing sentences to improve consistency in sentencing within the Punjab. It establishes a Sentencing Council and defines specific aggravating and mitigating factors, as well as special provisions for cases involving children, terrorism, and violence.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Security) Act, 1999
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Punjab Assembly and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab in early February 1999. It establishes provisions regarding the security of establishments, penalties for violations, and related rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Punjab province to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits the use of loudspeakers that generate unnecessary noise or disturb specific locations like hospitals and educational institutions, while also outlining penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Protection Unit Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of a Special Protection Unit within the Police of Punjab. The Unit is dedicated to providing security to foreigners, important persons, and specific premises, with provisions for its administration, ranks, recruitment, and terms of service.

metadata.title: The Punjab Strategic Coordination Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Provincial Security Council and the Provincial Strategic Coordination Board to create an institutional mechanism for counter-terrorism measures. It outlines the composition, functions, and powers of these bodies to formulate security policies, coordinate with federal agencies, and monitor law and order within Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the suppression of prostitution in the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as brothel, prostitution, and prostitute, and prescribes punishments for keeping brothels, soliciting, living on earnings of prostitution, and causing or abetting the prostitution of minors.

name: PUNJAB TENDOO LEAVES (PROHIBITION ON POSSESSION AND USE IN THE BORDER-BELT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use in the Border-Belt) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use in the Border-Belt) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the possession and use of tendoo leaves within the border-belt of the Punjab Province, including restrictions on bidi manufacturing. It establishes penalties for violations, outlines procedures for seizure and search, and repeals a previous ordinance from 1973.

metadata.title: The Punjab Tribunals of Inquiry Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Tribunals, Commissions, or Committees of Inquiry to investigate matters of public importance. It vests these bodies with specific powers similar to a civil court, including summoning witnesses and seizing documents.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to vagrancy in the Province of Punjab. It establishes welfare homes for the custody and detention of vagrants, defines offenses such as soliciting alms, and outlines the powers of police officers and managers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vigilance Committees Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of Vigilance Committees at District, Sub-divisional, and Union Council levels within the Punjab. It establishes their composition, functions, and powers to ensure effective watch and ward systems while addressing matters related to subversion and sectarianism.

name: PUNJAB WAQF, TRUSTS AND COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES (MONITORING) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf, Trusts and Cooperative Societies (Monitoring) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Waqf, Trusts and Cooperative Societies Commission to monitor and oversee the regulation of waqf, trusts, and cooperative societies in Punjab. It aims to implement a beneficial ownership regime, risk-based supervisory plans, and training activities related to these institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Witness Protection Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes measures to protect witnesses and other persons connected with the investigation, prosecution, and trial of criminal proceedings related to terrorism, sexual offences, or other serious crimes. It creates a Witness Protection Board and specific Units to oversee protection strategies, which may include relocation, identity changes, and special court procedures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance No. XI of 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive system for the planning and development of cities in the Punjab province. It creates an integrated Authority with specific powers to manage housing, infrastructure, traffic, health, and environmental issues while defining its functions, finances, and legal procedures.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING AND TOWN-PLANNING AGENCY ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Housing and Town Planning Agency to provide shelter for the shelterless and implement a comprehensive town planning system. It creates a body corporate with powers to acquire property, sue, and be sued, while defining its composition and functions at various administrative levels.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC UTILITIES INFRASTRUCTURE PROTECTION ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Utilities Infrastructure Protection Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of theft, unauthorized removal, damage, and ensures the repair and maintenance of public utilities infrastructure in Punjab.
