It establishes specific punishments for offenses related to stealing or damaging such infrastructure and defines the liabilities of scrap dealers and relevant authorities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Saaf Pani Authority Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Saaf Pani Authority by re-constituting the existing Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority. It defines the functions, powers, and composition of the new Authority to ensure the provision of safe drinking water across the Punjab province.

name: PUNJAB WATER AND SANITATION AUTHORITY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority to develop, operate, and maintain water supply and sanitation systems in the province. It also aims to conserve groundwater and manage water resources across specified districts including Lahore, Faisalabad, Multan, Rawalpindi, and Gujranwala.

name: PUNJAB SIKH ANAND KARAJ MARRIAGE ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Sikh Anand Karaj Marriage Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Anand Marriage Act, 1909 (VII of 1909)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the solemnization and registration of Sikh marriages known as Anand Karaj within the Punjab province. It establishes procedures for registering marriages, issuing certificates, and dissolving marriages through an arbitration council if reconciliation fails.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Development Board Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Industrial Development Board to manage and run industries in the public sector within the province. It defines the board's constitution, powers, duties, and functions, including its authority to provide loans and maintain accounts.

name: PUNJAB INDUSTRIES (CONTROL ON ESTABLISHMENT AND ENLARGEMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the organized and planned growth of industries in the Punjab. It establishes restrictions on the establishment or enlargement of industrial undertakings, requiring previous written permission from the Government.

name: PUNJAB PREVENTION OF SPECULATION IN ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Speculation in Essential Commodities Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of speculation in essential commodities to curb artificial price hikes and profiteering. It establishes definitions, information declaration requirements, delivery order registration, and penalties for offenses related to speculation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Skills Development Authority Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Skills Development Authority to promote and regulate the technical education and vocational training sector in the Punjab. It defines the composition, functions, and powers of the Authority, including its corporate status and membership structure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Small Industries Corporation to succeed the business and properties of the defunct West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation. It provides for the corporation's constitution, management, powers, duties, financial functions, and the transfer of assets from the dissolved predecessor entity.

name: PUNJAB STATE AID TO INDUSTRIES ACT, 1935

metadata.title: The Punjab State Aid to Industries Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act encourages the development of industries in the Punjab by regulating the granting of State aid. It establishes a Board of Industries to oversee these activities and provides provisions for loans, subsidies, and the supply of machinery on a hire-purchase system.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY ACT 2010

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act reorganizes the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority to ensure proper provision of technical education in the province. It establishes the Authority as a body corporate with powers to manage institutions, conduct research, and provide training across various economic sectors.

name: PUNJAB TIANJIN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY LAHORE ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the reconstitution of existing government institutes into the new university and outlines its functions, governance structure, and powers to acquire property.

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the registration of companies carrying on business for certain undesirable purposes within the Province of Punjab. It also provides legal mechanisms for the winding up and dissolution of such existing undesirable companies.

name: PUNJAB WEIGHTS AND MEASURES (INTERNATIONAL SYSTEM) ENFORCEMENT ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Weights and Measures (International System) Enforcement Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the enforcement of weights and measures based on the International System within the Province of Punjab. It regulates the use of these instruments, establishes standards, appoints officials like Controllers and Inspectors, and outlines penalties for violations such as using non-standard weights or selling un-stamped commercial items.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF LANGUAGE, ART AND CULTURE ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture Act 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture as a body corporate to promote and develop language, art, and culture in the Punjab. The Institute is tasked with advising the government on policy, preserving literature and folk arts, publishing books, and fostering cultural collaboration both nationally and internationally.

metadata.title: The Punjab Journalists Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Journalists Housing Foundation to introduce schemes for the allotment of plots for house construction on a no-profit, no-loss basis. It provides for the constitution of a Board of Directors and a Managing Committee, outlines their powers and functions regarding land acquisition and development, and sets out provisions for funds, audits, and rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Premises (Preservation) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the preservation of certain premises in the Punjab that possess historical, cultural, and architectural value. It regulates alterations, demolition, and re-erection of these special premises while establishing committees to oversee these functions.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for transparency and freedom of information within the Punjab to ensure citizens have improved access to public information. It establishes the Punjab Information Commission, defines the rights of applicants, and mandates proactive disclosure by public bodies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Flood Plain Regulation Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates construction activities within flood plains in the Punjab province to ensure flood mitigation and water resource development. It establishes a framework for designating flood plains, appointing Canal Officers, and creating committees to review and approve construction applications.

name: PUNJAB IRRIGATION, DRAINAGE AND RIVERS ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for irrigation, drainage, and river management within Punjab. It defines ownership of water, regulates canal construction and operation, sets safety standards for dams, and outlines procedures for flood protection and embankment maintenance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Water Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the comprehensive management and regulation of all water resources in the Punjab. It aims to ensure the conservation and sustainability of these resources while regulating their use and addressing related matters.

metadata.title: Punjab Domestic Workers Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the employment of domestic workers in the Province of Punjab to protect their rights and ensure their welfare. It establishes provisions regarding working conditions, minimum wages, leave entitlements, maternity benefits, and the constitution of a Domestic Workers Welfare Fund.

metadata.title: The Punjab Fair Price Shops (Factories) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and maintenance of fair price shops in certain factories within the Punjab to sell daily use articles at cheaper rates to workers. It defines key terms such as 'essential articles', 'fair price', and 'worker', and mandates employers to maintain sufficient stocks and display price lists.

metadata.title: The Punjab Home-based Workers Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of the rights of home-based workers in the Punjab province. It establishes a welfare fund, defines key terms such as employer and contractor, and outlines provisions regarding contributions, registration, and dispute settlement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the formation of trade unions and governs relations between employers and workmen in Punjab. It establishes mechanisms for dispute resolution, including conciliation, arbitration, and Labour Courts, while defining unfair labour practices and penalties for offences.

metadata.title: The Punjab Labour Code, 2026
metadata.summary: This document establishes a comprehensive code for the Punjab region covering definitions, prohibitions on forced and child labour, and workplace safety standards. It further outlines regulations regarding trade union registration, collective bargaining rights, strike procedures, and employer obligations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the employment of women in establishments within Punjab. It establishes rights for maternity benefits, defines prohibited periods for work after childbirth, and outlines penalties for employers who contravene these provisions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Minimum Wages Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates laws regulating minimum rates of wages for unskilled and various categories of skilled workers in industrial, industrial, and commercial establishments within Punjab. It establishes a Minimum Wages Board to recommend wage rates and provides powers to inspectors and authorities to enforce compliance with these minimum standards.

name: PUNJAB OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for occupational safety and health at workplaces within the Punjab province. It aims to protect persons against risks arising from occupational hazards and to promote a safe working environment catering to physiological and psychological needs.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF CHILD LABOUR AT BRICK KILNS ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Child Labour at Brick Kilns Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children at brick kilns in the Punjab and regulates general labour conditions in that sector. It establishes specific rules regarding written contracts, limits on cash advances (peshgi), and procedures for dealing with bonded labourers.

name: PUNJAB RESTRICTION ON EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Restriction on Employment of Children Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children and restricts the employment of adolescents in hazardous occupations within the Punjab. It establishes a Provincial Committee on Child Labour to advise on legislative measures for eradicating child labour and sets specific rules regarding work duration, weekly holidays, and mandatory rest intervals.

metadata.title: The Punjab Weights and Measures Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law regulating the use of weights and measures in the Province of Punjab. It establishes standards for weights and measures, defines the roles of inspectors, and sets penalties for fraudulent practices or unauthorized manufacturing.

metadata.title: The Punjab Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Workers Welfare Fund to facilitate workers in the Province of Punjab. It outlines the constitution of the Fund, the governing body responsible for it, and the liability of establishments to contribute a percentage of their total income.

metadata.title: The Punjab General Clauses Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to facilitate the interpretation of Acts passed by the Provincial Legislature and to shorten the language used therein. It provides general rules for the construction of enactments, defines specific legal terms, and outlines provisions regarding orders, rules, and bye-laws made under various laws.

metadata.title: The Punjab Judicial Academy Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Judicial Academy as a body corporate to provide training for judicial officers and court personnel. It outlines the functions of the Academy, including imparting pre-service and in-service training, developing skills for case management, and promoting ethical values within the judiciary.

name: PUNJAB PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment, salary, allowances, and privileges of Parliamentary Secretaries in the Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on October 21, 2002, following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance No. XII of 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of Members of the Provincial Assembly of the Province of Punjab. It details specific financial entitlements such as daily allowances, travelling expenses, medical facilities, and office maintenance.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY DEPUTY SPEAKER (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance No. XVI of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It details specific entitlements including monthly salary, various allowances, official residence usage, and transport facilities.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SPEAKER (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ord. No. XV of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It details specific financial entitlements including monthly salary, sumptuary allowance, transport costs, official residence maintenance, and perks for former Speakers.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC DEFENDERS SERVICE ACT 2007 (REPEAL) ACT 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 (Repeal) Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Public Defender Service Act, 2007. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the number of goats within the Province of Punjab. It grants the Government powers to regulate grazing, keeping, movement, and slaughter of goats through notifications and rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Halal Development Agency Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Halal Development Agency to regulate and promote the trade of halal food and non-food products within the province. It provides for the agency's functions, including the issuance of domestic Halal certificates, inspection body certification, and the prohibition of improper use of Halal logos.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK ASSOCIATIONS AND LIVESTOCK ASSOCIATIONS UNION (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock Associations and Livestock Associations Unions (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and control of village livestock associations and their unions in the Punjab. It establishes the legal framework for incorporating these bodies, managing their affairs, and regulating the rights and liabilities of their members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock Breeding Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act regulates livestock breeding services in the Punjab to improve genetic potential and protect indigenous breeds. It establishes a Livestock Breeding Services Authority, sets standards for breeding procedures, mandates registration of businesses and animals, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK, DAIRY AND POULTRY DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board to manage and control livestock, dairy, and poultry projects in the public sector within the province of Punjab. It defines the board's constitution, powers, duties, and functions, including its authority to acquire property, maintain funds, and make rules or regulations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the production and marketing of milk and milk products in certain areas of the Punjab. It establishes a Milk Board as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, sue, and be sued.

metadata.title: The Punjab Poultry Production Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates poultry production activities within the Punjab province. It establishes a mandatory registration system for poultry premises to ensure quality products and biosecurity measures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and maintenance of graveyards in the Punjab. It establishes a Committee to investigate encroachments, define graveyard limits, and prepare schemes for their management.

metadata.title: The Punjab Khal Panchayat (Repeal) Act, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Khal Panchayat Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Khal Panchayat Act, 2019 to transfer properties and responsibilities from the defunct Punjab Khal Panchayat Authority to the Irrigation Department. It also outlines specific adjustments for employees, including abolishing vacant positions, terminating contracts, and absorbing staff into government services or surplus pools.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the constitution, functioning, and authority of local governments in Punjab. It covers elections, term of office, finance, properties, and the specific duties of various functionaries within the local government structure.

name: PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTIONS (DISSOLUTION) (EXTENSION OF LIMITATION) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Institutions (Dissolution) (Extension of Limitation) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the extension of limitation periods in matters relating to Union Councils affected by their dissolution under Martial Law. It excludes the time during which acts could not be performed due to this dissolution from the computation of statutory limitation periods.

name: PUNJAB MARRIAGE FUNCTIONS (PROHIBITION OF OSTENTATIOUS DISPLAYS AND WASTEFUL EXPENSES) (REPEAL) ACT 2006

metadata.title: The Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) (Repeal) Act, 2006
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Act, 2003. It ensures that previous legal operations, actions taken, and penalties awarded under the repealed Act remain unaffected.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF EXPRESSINIG MATTERS ON WALLS ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the expression of matters on walls in the Punjab province through posters, writing, or other means intended to attract public attention. It prescribes penalties including imprisonment and fines for violations, while allowing exceptions for owners expressing matters related to themselves or their business.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF KITE FLYING ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits kite flying in the Punjab to prevent danger to human life and property. It defines specific terms such as 'kite flying' involving metallic wires or sharp materials and establishes it as a cognizable, non-bailable offence with strict penalties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shehr-e-Khamoshan Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Shehr-e-Khamoshan Authority to manage and regulate model cemeteries, graveyards, and crematoriums in the Punjab. It provides for the delivery of cemetery, funeral, and crematory services to the public while addressing ancillary matters related to these functions.

name: PUNJAB SUSPENSION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ORDINANCE 1999

metadata.title: The Punjab Suspension of Local Councils Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the immediate suspension of Local Councils constituted under the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979. It mandates that all members and office bearers of these councils stand suspended and cease to hold office upon commencement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Timber Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of a timber market in the revenue estates of Jia Musa and Chak Jia Musa. It also validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Order No. III and West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962, which were later held invalid by the Supreme Court.

metadata.title: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Mineral Development Corporation to promote mineral development within the Province of the Punjab. It defines the corporation's structure, including its Board and Managing Director, and outlines its functions, finance, and administrative powers.

name: PUNJAB MINERALS (CANCELLATION OF SAND LEASES IN RESTRICTED AREAS) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Punjab Minerals (Cancellation of Sand Leases in Restricted Areas) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the cancellation of sand leases within specific restricted areas in the Province of Punjab. It establishes procedures for offering alternative leases or refunding compensation to lessees whose operations are terminated, along with penalties for contravention.

name: PUNJAB MINOR MINERAL (CANCELLATION OF LEASES) ORDINANCE, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Minor Mineral (Cancellation of Leases) Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Minor Mineral (Cancellation of Leases) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the immediate cancellation of certain mining leases of minor minerals granted by officers other than the Deputy Commissioner. It establishes a mechanism for the Government to pay compensation to lessees for necessary roads and buildings constructed during mining operations before the lease termination.

metadata.title: The Punjab Information Technology Board Ordinance, 1999
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Information Technology Board Ordinance, 1999 (XXV of 1999)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Information Technology Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the Board's constitution, functions, powers, and administrative procedures including budgeting and employee management.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an enabling environment for the private sector to participate in public infrastructure and service provision within the Punjab province. It creates institutional arrangements including a Board and an Authority to manage PPP projects, outlines the project delivery process from identification to termination, and sets standards for bidding, negotiation, and implementation.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP FOR INFRASTRUCTURE ACT 2010

metadata.title: The Punjab Public-Private Partnership for Infrastructure Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2014 (IX of 2014)
metadata.summary: This Act creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development within the Punjab province through public-private partnership projects. It establishes institutional arrangements, outlines the project delivery process including identification and approval, and provides mechanisms for dispute resolution and termination of agreements.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Protection Authority Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Social Protection Authority to create a comprehensive and inclusive social protection system for the poor and vulnerable in the Punjab. It defines the composition, functions, and powers of the Authority, including its corporate status and membership structure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Hepatitis Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a surveillance system for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of hepatitis within the Punjab. It outlines responsibilities for healthcare facilities, mandates specific testing procedures, regulates the sale of syringes, and provides for penalties related to offenses.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention and control of infectious diseases within the Punjab province. It empowers the Secretary to impose duties on medical practitioners, restrict gatherings, and manage potentially infectious persons through screening and retention.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES (HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ACT 2019

metadata.title: Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board in the Punjab to manage seized and frozen facilities. It provides for the constitution of the Board, its powers, the establishment of a Directorate, and measures to mainstream employees of these facilities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vaccination Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to vaccination in the Province of Punjab. It establishes duties for local authorities, parents, and guardians regarding the vaccination of children and persons against smallpox.

metadata.title: The Punjab Legal Aid Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Legal Aid Agency to provide legal services to indigent persons in the province of Punjab. It outlines the agency's functions, including policy evolution, fee structure recommendations, and research promotion. The legislation also defines key terms such as 'indigent person' and sets up the administrative framework involving a Director General.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Education Foundation as a body corporate to restructure and promote education in the Punjab province. Its primary functions include providing financial assistance, incentives, and technical support to educational institutions while encouraging private sector participation.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION INITIATIVES MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority to devise and manage dynamic initiatives in the education sector. It aims to implement these initiatives in partnership with the private sector while providing for ancillary matters related to the Authority's establishment and functioning.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION, CURRICULUM, TRAINING AND ASSESSMENT AUTHORITY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Education, Curriculum, Training and Assessment Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Education, Curriculum, Training and Assessment Authority to coordinate educational activities in the province. Its primary purpose is to transform and raise educational standards by managing curriculum development, textbook creation, student assessments, teacher training, and monitoring regimes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Examination Commission Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Examination Commission to improve the examination system for elementary education. It defines the Commission's composition, functions, and powers regarding policy formulation, data collection, and teacher capacity building.

name: PUNJAB FREE AND COMPULSORY EDUCATION ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for free and compulsory education for all children aged five to sixteen years in the Punjab. It establishes the duties of the government, local authorities, parents, and schools to ensure access to education without financial barriers.

name: PUNJAB LOCAL COUNCILS HIGH SCHOOLS (TAKING OVER) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Councils High Schools (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the taking over of High Schools maintained by District Councils and Town Committees in the Province of Punjab by the Government. It transfers rights, authorities, and jurisdiction regarding these schools from local councils to the government while outlining provisions for staff, assets, funds, and financial contributions.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED INSTITUTIONS (MADAARIS AND SCHOOLS) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Madaaris and Schools Management Board in the Punjab to manage seized and frozen educational institutions. It provides for the constitution of the Board, its powers, the establishment of a Directorate, and measures to mainstream students from these institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Text-Book Board Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and incorporation of the Punjab Text-Book Board as a body corporate. It outlines the Board's powers to produce text books, supplementary reading material, and conduct research in the field of curricula.

name: PUNJAB EMPLOYEES EFFICIENCY, DISCIPLINE AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT 2006

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act provides for proceedings against employees in government and corporation service regarding their efficiency, discipline, and accountability. It defines key terms such as 'accused', 'competent authority', and 'corruption' to establish the framework for initiating actions and imposing penalties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Enforcement and Regulation Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Enforcement and Regulatory Authority to oversee the implementation of special laws throughout the province. It prescribes procedures for efficient enforcement, designates a lead regulator, and empowers officers to conduct hearings and administrative actions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of certain essential services in the Punjab. It defines key terms, specifies which employments are covered, and grants powers to order persons to remain in specified areas during times of necessity.

name: PUNJAB ESTABLISHMENT OF SPECIAL COURTS (OVERSEAS PAKISTANIS PROPERTY) ACT 2025

metadata.title: Punjab Establishment of Special Courts (Overseas Pakistanis Property) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes special courts in the Punjab to adjudicate petitions regarding the immovable properties of overseas Pakistanis. It provides for the appointment of judges, the filing of petitions, and ensures that disputes involving overseas Pakistanis are heard exclusively by these designated courts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Film City Authority Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Film City Authority to promote, develop, regulate, and facilitate the cinema and motion picture industry in the Punjab. It aims to encourage local and international productions, strengthen cultural identity, promote technological innovation, attract investment, generate employment, and ensure sustainable film-making practices.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Welfare Fund to provide relief and security for the employees of the Punjab Government and their families. It defines the composition of the fund, including contributions from government servants and interest on investments, and sets up separate parts for gazetted and non-gazetted employees.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes a Benevolent Fund to provide relief for Government servants and their families in the Punjab. The fund is divided into two parts for gazetted and non-gazetted servants, financed by compulsory contributions, government grants, donations, and investment income.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation to provide houses or plots on a no-profit, no-loss basis to government servants and their families. It defines the composition and powers of the Board of Directors, outlines the foundation's corporate status, and provides for the collection of contributions and maintenance of accounts.

name: PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance No. XIV of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Ministers of the Punjab. It defines terms such as 'Minister', 'Family', and 'Official Residence' and establishes specific financial entitlements including monthly salary, equipment allowance, sumptuary allowance, and provisions for official residence and transport.

name: PUNJAB OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN ACT 1997

metadata.title: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Punjab to protect citizens' rights and ensure adherence to the rule of law. It provides for the appointment, tenure, functions, and powers of the Ombudsman to diagnose and redress injustices caused by maladministration or corrupt practices.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission to address grievances of Overseas Pakistanis regarding Government Agencies. It establishes the composition, functions, and powers of the Commission, including its role in reviewing reports, liaising with agencies, and handling complaints.

name: PUNJAB PREVENTION OF CONFLICT OF INTEREST ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Conflict of Interest Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Prevention of Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commission to oversee public office holders in the province. It defines conflicts of interest, outlines duties for recusal, and provides mechanisms for penalties and compliance orders to prevent private interests from interfering with public duties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority to regulate the procurement of goods, services, and works in the public sector within the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Authority', 'Board', and 'corrupt practice' while outlining the establishment, functions, powers, and administrative structure of the Authority.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION EXAMINATION REFORMS ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission Examination Reforms Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the eradication of malpractices in connection with examinations held by the Punjab Public Service Commission. It defines various terms related to examinations and outlines specific offenses, such as leaking question papers or falsifying results, along with their punishments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Service Commission Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Punjab Public Service Commission Act, 1974 with certain modifications. It establishes the composition of the Commission, defines terms of office for members, outlines procedures for removal from office, and sets forth the functions and rules governing the Commission.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment on a regular basis of certain contract employees serving in the Punjab government departments. It establishes procedures for regularization, including the role of Scrutiny Committees and conditions regarding service duration and qualifications.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) ACT, 1956

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary requisitioning of immovable property by the Provincial Government when necessary for federal, provincial, or corporate use. It outlines procedures for issuing requisition orders, defining eligible and ineligible properties (such as religious buildings and private educational institutions), and establishing principles for assessing and paying compensation to owners.

name: PUNJAB RIGHT TO PUBLIC SERVICES ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Right to Public Services Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the right of eligible persons in Punjab to receive public services within a specified time limit. It defines the roles of designated officers and the Punjab Right to Public Services Commission, outlines penalties for delays or deficiencies, and provides mechanisms for appeals and compensation.

name: PUNJAB SPECIAL ASSISTANTS (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Assistants (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment, salary, allowances, and privileges of Special Assistants to the Chief Minister of the Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was dissolved at the time.

name: PUNJAB SUBORDINATE JUDICIARY SERVICE TRIBUNAL ACT 1991

metadata.title: The Punjab Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal to handle matters regarding the terms and conditions of service for members of the subordinate judiciary in Punjab. It grants the Tribunal exclusive jurisdiction over these issues, including disciplinary actions, and outlines the constitution of its benches and procedures for appeals.

metadata.title: The Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Service Tribunals to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants in the Province of Punjab. It defines the composition of these tribunals, including the qualifications for the Chairman and Members, and outlines the procedures for their appointment and resignation.

name: PUNJAB SKILLS DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP AUTHORITY ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Skills Development and Entrepreneurship Authority Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Skills Development and Entrepreneurship Authority to promote and regulate technical and vocational education. It provides for the authority's structure, functions, powers, and the establishment of various agencies related to skills assessment and training.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ehsaas Programme Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Ehsaas Programme as a new umbrella social protection and poverty alleviation initiative for the Government of the Punjab. It aims to reform, reorganize, and consolidate existing initiatives to optimize their effectiveness while providing an integrated policy strategy for deserving persons.

name: PUNJAB EMPOWERMENT OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act promotes and ensures the effective inclusion of persons with disabilities in the community while protecting their rights. It aligns these protections with the Constitution of Pakistan, the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, and international best practices.

metadata.title: The Punjab Panah Gah Authority Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Panah Gah Authority to create a comprehensive system for protecting and providing temporary shelter to shelterless persons. It defines the Authority's composition, powers, functions, and procedures for managing Panah Gahs, including partnerships and resource acquisition.

metadata.title: The Punjab Senior Citizens Welfare Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Senior Citizens Welfare Council to ensure the well-being, comfort, and dignity of senior citizens residing in Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'senior citizen' and 'indigent', outlines the composition of the Council, and grants the Council powers to manage funds, accounts, and welfare packages.

metadata.title: The Punjab Women Protection Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Women Protection Authority to create a comprehensive system for protecting women against violence in the Punjab. It defines the Authority's powers, composition, and functions, including the establishment of protection centers and monitoring relief systems.

metadata.title: The Punjab Health Foundation Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Health Foundation as a body corporate to promote and finance the development of the health sector in the Province of Punjab. The Foundation is empowered to establish health institutions, provide grants and loans to private health providers, and assist in population welfare programs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Healthcare Commission Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Healthcare Commission to regulate healthcare services in the province. It aims to improve the quality of care and ban quackery through mechanisms like registration, licensing, and accreditation.

name: PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS ACT, 2003

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and efficient management of Medical and Health Institutions in the Punjab. It outlines the administration, governance structure including the Board of Management, and defines the objects and functions of these institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for Medical Teaching Institutions in Punjab to improve medical education and healthcare effectiveness. It creates a Provincial Policy Board and Boards of Governors to manage these institutions, defining their objectives, functions, and governance structures.

name: PUNJAB REPRODUCTIVE, MATERNAL, NEO-NATAL AND CHILD HEALTH AUTHORITY ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Reproductive, Maternal, Neo-natal and Child Health Authority Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Reproductive, Maternal, Neo-natal and Child Health Authority to provide a legal framework for managing affairs related to national programs for primary healthcare and family planning in Punjab. It defines the composition of the Authority's Board, outlines its powers and functions, and sets rules regarding its employees, assets, and immunity.

name: PUNJAB SAFE MEDICAL SUPPLIES AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Safe Medical Supplies Authority Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Safe Medical Supplies Authority to procure quality drugs and medical equipment for public health facilities in the Punjab. It provides for the composition, functions, and administrative powers of the Authority to ensure effective and equitable distribution of supplies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Masstransit Authority Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Masstransit Authority to oversee the construction, operation, and maintenance of mass transit systems in major cities of the Punjab. It defines the composition of the Authority, including ex officio members and nominated representatives, and outlines its powers regarding property acquisition and disposal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Road Safety Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Road Safety Authority to ensure safe road design, safe vehicles, trained drivers, and post-accident management. It provides for the composition of the Authority, its functions, and the creation of various agencies related to vehicle safety and driver training.

name: PUNJAB ROAD TRANSPORT BOARD REMOVAL OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Punjab Road Transport Board (Punjab) Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of undesirable employees of the Punjab Road Transport Board. It establishes procedures for the appropriate authority to terminate services after giving a reasonable opportunity to show cause and outlines the right to appeal such orders to the Government.

name: PUNJAB FAIR REPRESENTATION OF WOMEN ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Fair Representation of Women Act, 2014
metadata.amends: Various laws of the Punjab including The Town Improvement Act, 1922; The Punjab Government Educational and Training Institution Ordinance, 1960; The Punjab Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960; The Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961; The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962; The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965; The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970; The Punjab Fair Price Shops (Factories) Ordinance, 1971; The University of the Punjab Act, 1973; and The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends various existing laws of the Punjab to ensure fair representation of women in decision-making processes and their empowerment. It mandates specific quotas for female members, trustees, officers, and representatives across different provincial institutions and boards.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF WOMEN AGAINST VIOLENCE ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Women against Violence Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an effective system for the protection, relief, and rehabilitation of women against violence in the Punjab. It provides mechanisms for filing complaints, obtaining various protective orders, and accessing shelter homes and support services.

metadata.title: The Punjab Women Hostels Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Women Hostels Authority to regulate women hostels established in the private sector within the Punjab province. The legislation aims to provide safe and standard accommodation facilities for women by creating a body corporate with specific powers, composition, and functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Heritage Foundation Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Heritage Foundation in the Province of the Punjab to conserve, maintain, rehabilitate, and develop local heritage. It creates a permanent fund for these purposes and sets up a Board of Governors to manage the Foundation's affairs.

name: PUNJAB HISTORICAL MOSQUES AND SHRINES FUND CESS ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Punjab Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the imposition of a cess on land revenue and urban immovable property tax to raise funds. The collected funds are designated for the repair, maintenance, and endowment of mosques and shrines of historical importance in the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vocational Training Council Act, 1998
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Vocational Training Council Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Vocational Training Council as a body corporate to regulate and manage vocational training institutes in the Punjab. It defines the council's constitution, including members from government departments and the private sector, outlines its functions, and provides powers for rule-making and fund management.

metadata.title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr within the Punjab province. It also establishes ancillary matters including the constitution of councils and committees responsible for these funds.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vegetable Market (Lahore) (Repeal) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Vegetable Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Vegetable Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963 because its objectives have been fulfilled. It includes a saving provision to ensure that actions taken under the repealed Ordinance remain valid.

metadata.title: Punjab Finance Act, 2025
metadata.amends: Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes the structure of sales tax on services in Punjab by amending the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012. It introduces new provisions for tax-free services and modifies various sections to update definitions, schedules, and penalty structures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Horticulture Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Horticulture Authority to regulate, develop, and maintain public parks, green belts, and green areas in the Punjab. It also provides a legal framework for managing billboards, sky signs, outdoor advertisements, and related matters.

name: PUNJAB PRIMARY AND SECONDARY HEALTHCARE SERVICES ACT 2025

metadata.title: Punjab Primary and Secondary Healthcare Services Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for providing primary and secondary healthcare services in the province of Punjab. It creates mechanisms for operating various healthcare facilities, including clinics, hospitals, and mobile units, while also digitizing public healthcare records and building a digital referral system.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC AWARENESS AND DISSEMINATION OF INFORMATION ACT 2025

metadata.title: Punjab Public Awareness and Dissemination of Information Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for disseminating public awareness regarding government and public body projects, initiatives, programs, and policies. It mandates transparency by requiring the naming of public projects and outlines eligibility criteria for advertising agencies involved in these campaigns.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Public Private Partnership Authority to promote and regulate public private partnerships within the province. It aims to encourage private sector participation in projects of public importance by creating an enabling environment for such collaborations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sahulat Bazaars Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Sahulat Bazaars Authority to launch, construct, monitor, regulate, and maintain Sahulat Bazaars in the Punjab. It also aims to supply essential commodities at notified rates and create business opportunities for entrepreneurs.

metadata.title: Punjab Spatial Planning Authority Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Spatial Planning Authority as a body corporate to ensure balanced growth and sustainable development of settlements in the districts. It provides for the establishment of the Authority, defines its powers and functions regarding master and spatial planning, and outlines the composition of the Authority including various government secretaries.

metadata.title: Punjab Specialized Medical Institutions Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for Specialized Medical Institutions in Punjab to improve medical education, responsiveness, and the quality of clinical care. It defines the composition and functions of the Board of Governors, outlines the roles of various directors, and sets objectives for providing health facilities and conducting research.

metadata.title: The Punjab Thalassemia Prevention Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an Advisory Council to manage the control and prevention of Thalassemia and other genetic disorders in Punjab. It outlines the council's composition, powers, and functions, including facilitating early diagnosis, providing genetic counseling, and creating a data bank for policy making.

metadata.title: The Punjab Privatization Board (Repeal) Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010. It provides for the immediate transfer of properties, moveable assets, and employees of the defunct board to the Colonies Department, Board of Revenue, Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Protected Areas Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of ecologically important areas in Punjab. It establishes categories such as national parks, nature reserves, wildlife sanctuaries, and wilderness areas, while also defining management authorities and their functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2018
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Stamp Act, 1958; Punjab Stamp Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes and duties within the Punjab province. It amends the Stamp Act of 1899 to update fee structures for various legal instruments and documents.

metadata.title: The Punjab Power Development Board Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Power Development Board to facilitate private investors in the power sector and harness energy resources within the province. It provides for the board's composition, functions, funds, and administrative procedures to implement government policies on power generation.

name: PUNJAB REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT 1995

metadata.title: The Punjab Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Act, 1995
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act revises the salaries and other emoluments of holders of representative offices relating to the Punjab. It amends several existing acts, including those governing the Provincial Assembly, Ministers, and the Speaker, by substituting specific monetary figures and adding new provisions for allowances.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It repeals several previous amendments related to land acquisition in various regions and substitutes or adds new sections to the original Act.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes provisions regarding interest rates on excess compensation from six percent simple interest to eight percent compound interest in sections 28 and 34.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes 'Provincial Government' for 'Commissioner', omits certain words regarding waste or arable land, and inserts new clauses related to public purpose industries.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to harmonize it with the Punjab Land Records Authority Act, 2017. It updates various sections of the 1967 Act by substituting references to 'Service Centre Officials' with 'Arazi Record Centres' and omitting obsolete subsections.

metadata.title: The Punjab Drugs (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. Its primary purpose is to address the menace of spurious, adulterated, and substandard drugs by updating enforcement mechanisms and establishing a regular monitoring system. The legislation introduces stricter penalties and provisions for quality drug provision through new monitoring teams and regulatory changes.

metadata.title: Punjab Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.amends: The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873; The Land Acquisition (Mines) Act, 1885; The Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887; The Land Acquisition Act, 1894; The Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905; The Co-operative Societies Act, 1925; The Forest Act, 1927; The Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958; The Punjab Tobacco Vend Act, 1958; The Punjab Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959; The Punjab Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960; The Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960; Punjab Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962; The Punjab Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963; The Punjab Arms Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various laws of the Punjab to align them with the local government system established under the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 and the Punjab Civil Administration Act 2017. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session, necessitating immediate action to update official titles and definitions across multiple statutes.

name: INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF THE PUNJAB ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab to plan, design, construct, and maintain infrastructure in line with international best practices. It provides for the composition of the Authority, its functions, financial management, enforcement powers, and legal provisions regarding offences and appeals.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.amends: The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976 to update definitions, alter the composition of the Authority, and modify references to local government laws. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to expand its jurisdiction from the metropolitan area of Lahore to the entire area of Lahore Division. It substitutes various definitions and sections within the parent Act to align them with the broader administrative scope of the Lahore Division.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP FOR INFRASTRUCTURE ACT 2010

metadata.title: The Punjab Public-Private Partnership for Infrastructure Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2014 (IX of 2014)
metadata.summary: This Act creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development within the Punjab province through public-private partnership projects. It establishes institutional arrangements, outlines the project delivery process including identification and approval, and provides mechanisms for dispute resolution and termination of agreements.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the framework for local governments in the Punjab province, defining the composition and functions of various administrative bodies. It outlines the structure for District, Tehsil, Town, Union, Village, and Neighbourhood councils along with their respective officers and responsibilities.

metadata.title: The Companies Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This document establishes the legal framework for the incorporation, registration, and regulation of companies in Pakistan. It outlines procedures for forming companies, issuing shares, managing capital, and regulating prospectuses.

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Courts of Small Causes in Pakistan. It establishes the constitution, jurisdiction, practice, and procedure for these courts, including provisions for the appointment of judges and the execution of decrees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976 to update definitions, alter the composition of the Authority, and modify various sections regarding land acquisition and local government references. It substitutes specific provisions in the original 1976 Act with new text or omits certain sections entirely.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to expand its jurisdiction from the metropolitan area of Lahore to the entire area of Lahore Division. It substitutes various terms throughout the original Act, such as changing references to 'City District' to 'Division' and updating the preamble.

metadata.title: The Antiquities (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Antiquities Act, 1975 to apply its provisions specifically to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' and 'Federal Government' with 'the Punjab' and 'Government', respectively, and modifies definitions regarding export and government authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Laws (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: various Punjab laws relating to land administration (including Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883; Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887; Land Acquisition Act, 1894; Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Alienation of Land Act, 1900; and others)
metadata.repeals: Bahawalpur Court of Wards Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing Punjab laws related to land administration, including the Land Improvement Loans Act and the Punjab Tenancy Act. It primarily updates definitions for terms like 'Collector' and 'Commissioner' and transfers certain powers from the Government to the Board of Revenue.

metadata.title: The Forest (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 by substituting references to 'Federal Government' and 'Provincial Government' with the term 'Government'. It also introduces new definitions for terms such as 'forest', 'forest produce', and 'private public partnership' within the said Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 by substituting a new section 42-A. The amendment establishes procedures for reporting the acquisition of estate rights and mandates enquiries by Revenue Officers regarding these acquisitions.

metadata.title: The Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory registration of essential personnel at Employment Exchanges established by the Government of Pakistan. It defines essential personnel, outlines the liability to register, and establishes procedures for issuing registration certificates and handling applications.

name: FOREIGN PRIVATE INVESTMENT (PROMOTION AND PROTECTION) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: Foreign Private Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of foreign private investment in Pakistan. It establishes conditions for approval, defines terms like foreign capital and industrial undertakings, and outlines protections regarding agreements and repatriation facilities.

metadata.title: The Patents Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This document establishes the legal framework for patents in Pakistan, covering definitions, administration, patentability criteria, and application procedures. It outlines provisions for the grant, term, and revocation of patents, as well as mechanisms for compulsory licensing and infringement proceedings.

name: REGULATION OF GENERATION, TRANSMISSION AND DISTRIBUTION OF ELECTRIC POWERS ACT, 1997

metadata.title: The Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power in Pakistan. It establishes the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority to oversee these sectors and issues licenses for various activities within the industry.

metadata.title: The Companies Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This document establishes the legal framework for the incorporation, registration, and regulation of companies in Pakistan. It outlines procedures for forming companies, issuing shares, managing capital, and regulating prospectuses.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the acquisition of Pakistan citizenship through birth, descent, migration, and naturalization. It defines various categories of persons deemed to be citizens at the commencement of the Act and establishes procedures for registration and deprivation of citizenship.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for local governments in the Punjab province, including Union Councils, District Councils, Municipal Committees, and Metropolitan Corporations. It outlines their composition, election processes, functions, finance, taxation, and enforcement mechanisms.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018 to update definitions and provisions related to agricultural marketing. It introduces new terms such as 'virtual market', 'private market', and 'Pharia' while modifying existing sections regarding market committees and functions.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020 to ensure the smooth functioning of the Authority. It modifies various sections regarding definitions, area specifications, scheme publication timelines, and validates actions taken prior to its commencement.

name: PUNJAB IRRIGATION, DRAINAGE AND RIVERS BILL 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better and sustainable management, control, and regulation of irrigation, drainage, and rivers in the Punjab. It covers matters ancillary to these areas, including streams, lakes, ground water, and navigation.

metadata.title: The Trusts Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to private trusts and trustees in the Punjab. It establishes rules regarding the creation, duties, liabilities, and powers of trustees, as well as the rights of beneficiaries.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shehr-e-Khamoshan Authority Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Shehr-e-Khamoshan Authority to manage and regulate model cemeteries, graveyards, and crematoriums in the Punjab. It provides for various public services including burial, cremation, funeral arrangements, and the transfer of human remains.

metadata.title: The Punjab Highways Authority Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance I of 1989
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Highways Authority to create a unified system for Motorways, Super-Highways, and Highways in the Province of Punjab. It defines the Authority's powers, functions, constitution, and financial management while repealing a previous ordinance.

name: DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES (REGULATION) ACT 1998

metadata.title: The Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) Act, 1998
metadata.repeals: The Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manner in which land is disposed of by Development Authorities in housing schemes. It categorizes plots into residential, commercial, industrial, and public amenity zones and mandates specific disposal methods such as open auctions or ballots for different plot sizes. The legislation also establishes special allotment quotas for disabled persons, defence personnel, police, and government servants.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018 to update definitions and insert new sections regarding market management. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020 (XVII of 2020)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Ravi Urban Development Authority to implement a comprehensive planning and development system in the specified area of Lahore Division. It aims to improve the quality of life, rehabilitate the Ravi River, and manage infrastructure including housing, traffic, and waste disposal on both profit and non-profit bases.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the constitution, functioning, and authority of local governments in Punjab. It covers topics including elections, term of office, finance, and the specific functions of various local authorities.

name: LAHORE CENTRAL BUSINESS DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Lahore Central Business District Development Authority Ordinance, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Lahore Central Business District Development Authority Act, 2021 (VI of 2021)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Lahore Central Business District Development Authority to regulate vertical construction and promote modern facilities in a specific area. It provides for the establishment of the Authority's Board, defines its powers and functions regarding land use, acquisition, and development schemes, while maintaining high environmental standards.

name: LAHORE CENTRAL BUSINESS DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Lahore Central Business District Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Lahore Central Business District Development Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Central Business District Development Authority Act, 2021 to update its preamble and extend its geographical scope. It also modifies the composition of the Authority's Board, adds new powers regarding real estate investment trusts, and revises various sections related to definitions and procedures.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020 to update various sections regarding the Board's composition and powers. It specifically introduces new clauses for determining Chairman terms, land compensation models, and guarantees issued by the Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for local governments in Punjab, including their demarcation, constitution, and classification. It outlines the functions, authority, and duties of various local bodies such as Union Councils, District Councils, and Metropolitan Corporations.

metadata.title: The Defamation (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Defamation Ordinance, 2002 to restrict its application to the whole of Punjab and redefine key terms like 'Government' and 'newspaper'. It also omits the word 'Federal' from section 16 of the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Universities (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973; The Pir Mehr Ali Sah Arid Agriculture University, Rawalpindi Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws governing agricultural universities in the Punjab, specifically targeting the University of Agriculture Faisalabad and the Pir Mehr Ali Sah Arid Agriculture University, Rawalpindi. It introduces new roles such as Pro-Chancellor and Pro-Vice Chancellor, modifies appointment procedures for Vice Chancellors, and updates various sections regarding duties and functions within these institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Pesticides (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971 to transfer authority from the Federal Government to the Government of the Punjab. It specifically alters references to 'Federal Government' and 'Pakistan' to reflect provincial jurisdiction within the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 to address tax liabilities regarding land transfers. It specifically adds a new section stating that taxpayers transferring land to their wives or heirs under eighteen years old on or after July 1, 2003, remain liable for tax as if the transfer did not occur until the heir turns eighteen.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Pesticides (Amendment) Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971 to update terminology from 'brand' to 'pesticide' and modify specific clauses regarding registration and labeling. It also substitutes sections related to import restrictions and significantly alters penalty provisions for offenses involving unregistered pesticides.

metadata.title: Agricultural Pesticides (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971 to replace references to 'brand' with 'pesticide' or specific descriptions. It also omits certain clauses regarding brand requirements and allows the Federal Government to regulate the import of pesticides without trade names.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act 2024
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018 to alter provisions regarding the tenure of Chairperson and members, meeting convening procedures, and office vacancies. It also omits section 5 of the original Act and repeals a previous amendment ordinance from 2023.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 to update definitions regarding livestock and companies, introduce a super tax on high-earning persons, and modify penalty structures for tax defaults. It also inserts new sections to prescribe special procedures for specific categories of taxpayers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
