metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 by omitting specific clauses from sections 2 and 4-A. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on July 28, 2025, and received assent on August 5, 2025.

name: PUNJAB ANIMALS COMPOUND FEED AND FEED STUFF ORDINANCE 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Compound Feed and Feed Stuff Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the manufacture and marketing of animal compound feed and feed stuffs in the Province of Punjab. It establishes definitions for various feed types, sets standards for quality control and labeling, and outlines penalties for adulteration or misbranding.

metadata.title: The Employment of Children Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children in specific occupations and processes listed in its Schedule. It also regulates the working conditions for children, including limits on hours, weekly holidays, and health and safety standards.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975 to update terminology and jurisdictional references. It specifically substitutes 'Government' for 'Provincial Government' or 'Federal Government' and clarifies the roles of the Board of Revenue in property disposal schemes.

metadata.title: The Partition (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Partition Act, 1893 by substituting specific terms within its first section. It replaces references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' and changes 'immovable property paying revenue to Government' to 'agricultural land'. The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 30, 2011, and came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN BORDER AREA REGULATION 1959 (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Border Area Regulation 1959 (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Border Area Regulation 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Border Area Regulation 1959 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It updates definitions regarding Board of Revenue, evacuee property, and state land while modifying committee structures and procedures for handling unauthorized occupation and compensation appeals.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972 (Martial Law Regulation No. 115) within the Province of Punjab. It specifically alters provisions regarding land transfers by gift, ownership limits for tractor owners and tubewell installers, and definitions related to civil services.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (WEST PAKISTAN SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (West Pakistan Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically omits certain words from section 57 and substitutes a new provision for section 59 regarding rates on land benefitted by works.

name: PUNJAB SOIL RECLAMATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The Punjab Soil Reclamation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Soil Reclamation Act, 1952 to extend its application to the whole of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific terms in the long title and preamble to include maximizing agricultural production and replaces references to 'Punjab' with 'West Pakistan'. Additionally, it restructures the constitution of the Board and updates definitions related to canal officers and soil reclamation operations.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Penal Code
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Pakistan Penal Code, which defines offences and punishments applicable within Pakistan. It includes provisions for general explanations of terms, specific punishments, general exceptions to criminal liability, and rules regarding abetment.

metadata.title: Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr in Pakistan. It establishes the organizational structure including Central and Provincial Zakat Councils and outlines exemptions and administrative powers.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE, FOOD AND DRUG AUTHORITY ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority to conduct forensic examinations and testing of fertilizers, pesticides, food, and drugs. It also empowers the Authority to render expert opinions regarding the ingredients and quality of these items.

metadata.title: The Punjab Seed Corporation (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Seed Corporation Act, 1976 to update the composition of the Board and the appointment process for the Managing Director. It substitutes specific sections of the original Act to replace references to the Government with the Chief Minister and adjusts the number of board members.

name: PUNJAB PRICE CONTROL OF ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Act, 2024 to update the composition of the Price Control Council and modify specific departmental references. It substitutes new members for the council, adds a secretariat clause, and changes the name of a relevant government department within the amended sections.

name: THE PREVENTION OF ANTI-NATIONAL ACTIVITIES ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Prevention of Anti-National Activities Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the effective prevention of anti-national and treasonable activities by individuals and associations within Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to declare associations as anti-national and establishes a Tribunal to adjudicate on such declarations.

metadata.title: The Anti-terrorism Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of terrorism and sectarian violence in Pakistan. It also establishes Anti-terrorism Courts to ensure the speedy trial of heinous offences related to these issues.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Relations (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010. It introduces specific changes to sections 3, 9, and 12 of the said Act regarding worker associations and appeal procedures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vigilance Committees Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of Vigilance Committees at District, Sub-divisional, and Union Council levels within the Punjab. It aims to establish an effective watch and ward system to deal with issues such as sectarianism, subversion, and unlawful associations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979 to update definitions and provisions regarding the Chief Administrator of Auqaf. It specifically substitutes text in sections 2 and 3 of the original Ordinance to clarify the role, appointment process, and religious requirements for the Chief Administrator.

metadata.title: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation, administration, and accounting of collections of charitable donations. It also aims to prevent frauds associated with such collections.

name: PUNJAB TOURISM, CULTURE AND HERITAGE AUTHORITY ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Tourism, Culture and Heritage Authority Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Tourism, Culture and Heritage Authority to promote travel and tourism in the Punjab. It provides for the composition of the Authority, its functions, powers regarding property conservation, and provisions for offences and penalties.

name: PUNJAB TOURISM, CULTURE AND HERITAGE AUTHORITY BILL 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Tourism, Culture and Heritage Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Tourism, Culture and Heritage Authority to promote travel and tourism within the province. It provides for the establishment, composition, functions, and governance of the Authority, including provisions for its members, quorum, and disqualifications.

name: PUNJAB TOURISM, CULTURE AND HERITAGE AUTHORITY BILL 2021

metadata.title: Punjab Tourism, Culture and Heritage Authority Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Tourism, Culture and Heritage Authority to promote travel and tourism within the province. It provides for the establishment of a body corporate with specific powers to manage heritage, landscape, and culture while defining the composition, functions, and disqualifications of its members.

name: DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES (REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) Act, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) Act, 1998 to update definitions and disposal procedures. It specifically revises section 2 to redefine 'Development Authority' and section 4 to alter the percentage allocations for land plots based on size and recipient categories.

metadata.title: Namal Institute Mianwali Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Namal Institute Mianwali as a private sector body corporate located in Mianwali. It outlines the institute's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, while defining its functions such as providing instruction in engineering and computer sciences, conducting research, and administering constituent colleges.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for local governments in Punjab, including their constitution, functions, and responsibilities. It details procedures for elections, committee formations, and the discharge of public duties by local authorities.

metadata.title: Rawalpindi Medical University Ordinance 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Rawalpindi Medical University by reconstituting Rawalpindi Medical College. It provides for the university's corporate status, functions, and the appointment of its governing bodies including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Records Authority Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Land Records Authority to reform and modernize the system of land records in the province. It aims to improve service delivery, ensure long-lasting tenure security, and address ancillary matters related to land management.

metadata.title: The Punjab Compulsory Primary Education Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Primary Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for compulsory primary education within the Province of Punjab. It mandates that parents ensure their children attend primary school unless a reasonable excuse exists, defines specific offenses for non-compliance, and empowers School Attendance Authorities to enforce attendance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the preparation and sale of food in the province of Punjab. It establishes provisions for prohibiting the sale of adulterated or unwholesome food, regulating the manufacture and storage of goods, and defining offenses with corresponding penalties.

name: PUNJAB TIANJIN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY LAHORE ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Ordinance 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the reconstitution of existing government institutes into the new university and outlines its functions, governance structure, and powers to acquire property.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 to allow the authority to be constituted under the Development of Cities Act, 1976. It also includes savings provisions to ensure that rules, contracts, and rights established under the repealed Act remain valid unless specifically cancelled.

metadata.title: Nishtar Medical University Ordinance 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Nishtar Medical University by reconstituting Nishtar Medical College Multan as a body corporate. It provides for the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various councils, while transferring existing properties and liabilities from the college to the new university.

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bahawalpur Development Authority as a body corporate to develop the area comprising the Revenue Division of Bahawalpur, excluding desert areas. The Authority is empowered to prepare and implement schemes for agriculture, industry, housing, water supply, and urban renewal, while also acquiring property and managing funds.

metadata.title: The Punjab Text-Book Board Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and incorporation of the Punjab Text-Book Board as a body corporate. It outlines the Board's powers to produce text books, supplementary reading material, and conduct research in the field of curricula.

name: SIALKOT UNIVERSITY OF APPLIED ENGINEERING AND EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES SIALKOT ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Sialkot University of Applied Engineering and Emerging Technologies Sialkot Ordinance, 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the immediate establishment of the Sialkot University of Applied Engineering and Emerging Technologies, Sialkot. It outlines the university's jurisdiction, powers, functions, and the structure of its officers and authorities.

metadata.title: University of Kamalia Ordinance 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and incorporation of the University of Kamalia. It outlines the powers, functions, and structure of the university's authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Syndicate, and various committees.

metadata.title: University of Taunsa Sharif Ordinance, 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and incorporation of the University of Taunsa Sharif. It outlines the powers, functions, and structure of the university's authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Syndicate, and various committees.

name: VIQAR-UN-NISA UNIVERSITY FOR WOMEN RAWALPINDI ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: Viqar-un-Nisa University for Women, Rawalpindi, Ordinance 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Viqar-un-Nisa University for Women in Rawalpindi to provide higher education opportunities. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies like the Syndicate and Academic Council.

metadata.title: Emerson University, Multan Ordinance 2021
metadata.repeals: Emerson University, Multan Act 2021 (VIII of 2021)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of Emerson University, Multan by reconstituting Government Emerson College. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its officers, authorities, and statutory framework.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to establish an effective local government system. It aims to empower decision-making at the grassroots level and improve service delivery through a bottom-up approach.

metadata.title: Times Institute, Multan (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Times Institute, Multan Act 2020 to rename the institution as Times University, Multan and update its governance structure. It substitutes terms like 'Institute' with 'University', changes the head of the institution from Rector to Vice Chancellor, and modifies the composition and nomination processes for the Board of Directors.

name: PUNJAB AUTONOMOUS BODIES IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (EJECTMENT OF UNAUTHORIZED OCCUPANTS) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Punjab Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Unauthorized Occupants) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the summary ejectment of unauthorized occupants from immovable property that vests in autonomous bodies. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Administration Ordinance, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a comprehensive system of civil administration for the Punjab province to ensure efficient governance and improved service delivery. It defines the roles, functions, and powers of Commissioners, Deputy Commissioners, and Assistant Commissioners across divisions, districts, and tehsils.

name: PUNJAB IMMOVABLE PUBLIC PROPERTIES (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Immovable Public Properties (Removal of Encroachment) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions for the removal of encroachments from public properties in Punjab. It establishes the powers of authorized officers to issue notices, conduct hearings, and order the eviction of unauthorized occupants and the removal of structures.

metadata.title: Protection of Economic Reforms Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal protection to economic reforms introduced by the Government to create a liberal environment for savings and investments. It ensures that these reforms override conflicting provisions in other laws and protects foreign currency accounts, fiscal incentives, and private sector ownership from government interference or compulsory acquisition.

metadata.title: University of Murree Ordinance 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Murree in the Punjab province to provide instruction in specific fields such as geology, geography, and forestry. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines its internal structure including roles like Chancellor and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions regarding examinations, degree conferral, and research collaboration.

metadata.title: Faisalabad Medical University Ordinance 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Faisalabad Medical University by reconstituting Punjab Medical College Faisalabad. It provides for the university's corporate status, functions, and the structure of its authorities including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Punjab Drugs (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to address issues such as spurious drugs and inadequate compliance with standards. It introduces stricter penalties, modifies timelines for investigations and reports, and updates definitions regarding foreign drug authorities.

metadata.title: The NUR International University Lahore Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of NUR International University Lahore in the private sector. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and functions such as providing instruction and awarding degrees.

name: PUNJAB CURRICULUM AND TEXTBOOK BOARD ORDINANCE 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board as a body corporate to formulate curricula, develop textbooks, and manage related educational materials. It defines the Board's composition, including ex officio members and appointed experts, and outlines its powers and functions regarding the production and approval of reading material for classes I to XII.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update various sections regarding budget utilization and fund allocation. It also establishes an Ad hoc Accounts Committee for local governments in a district and modifies provisions related to performance reports and election timelines.

metadata.title: The Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Katchi Abadis Act, 1992 to update definitions and procedures regarding government agencies involved in katchi abadi development. It substitutes references to specific authorities with broader terms like 'Governmental Agency' and repeals a previous 2007 Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WELFARE FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund (Amendment) Ordinance 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969 to update definitions of government servants and adjust contribution amounts based on basic scales. It also repeals the earlier Amendment Ordinance of 2007 and validates actions taken under that repealed ordinance.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law regarding the registration of medical practitioners and dentists in Pakistan. It establishes a uniform minimum standard for basic and higher qualifications in medicine and dentistry while reconstituting the Medical and Dental Council.

name: PAKISTAN COLLAGE OF PHYSICIANS AND SURGEONS ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons as a body corporate to maintain high medical principles and promote specialist practice. It outlines the composition of the College, the functions of its Council, and provisions for postgraduate training and examinations.

metadata.title: The Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to regulate the development and control of sports in Pakistan. It establishes a Board with perpetual succession to oversee national sports standards and grants the Board the exclusive right to make rules for uniformity.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nursing Council Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the laws relating to the registration and training of nurses, midwives, and health visitors in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan Nursing Council, defines its composition, outlines the terms of office for members, and provides for the maintenance of registers and recognition of institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Drugs (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to establish a regulatory and enforcement mechanism for cosmetics in Punjab. It expands the definition of drugs to include cosmetic articles and introduces new provisions for licensing, registration, and quality standards.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for village and neighbourhood common assemblies, panchayats, and neighbourhood councils in Punjab. It defines their constitution, powers, duties, election processes, financial management, and mechanisms for superintendence and control.

name: PUNJAB IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY ACT, 1997

metadata.title: The Punjab Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Irrigation and Drainage Authority as a body corporate to streamline the province's irrigation and drainage systems. It replaces existing administrative setups with more responsive arrangements and ensures sustainable operation, maintenance, and management of water resources involving beneficiary participation.

metadata.title: The Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of minimum rates of wages for workers employed in certain industrial undertakings. It establishes Minimum Wages Boards and sets out provisions regarding the recommendation and declaration of wage rates, as well as penalties for paying below the minimum rate.

metadata.title: The Workers' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Workers' Welfare Fund to provide residential accommodation and other facilities for workers. It defines the constitution of the fund, the governing body, and the scope of industrial establishments subject to its provisions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Khal Panchayat Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Khal Panchayat Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Khal Panchayats for each water course in areas where the government maintains a canal irrigation system. It defines the composition, functions, and duties of these bodies, including mediating disputes between farmers and managing water distribution schedules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Punjab to improve medical education and enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and responsiveness of healthcare services in medical teaching institutions. It establishes a Provincial Policy Board and Boards of Governors for these institutions while defining their objectives, functions, and management structures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Panah Gah Authority Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Panah Gah Authority to create a comprehensive system for protecting and providing relief to shelterless persons. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to establish, maintain, and operate temporary shelters known as Panah Gahs across the province.

name: NATIONAL COLLEGE OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION & ECONOMICS, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.amends: The National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to update its provisions regarding the definition of a company, academic disciplines, and campus structure. It also substitutes the section concerning the Board of Governors to redefine membership composition and quorum requirements.

name: NATIONAL COLLEGE OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION & ECONOMICS, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.amends: National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to rename the institution as Alhamra University. It updates various sections regarding academic councils, faculty establishment, jurisdiction, and teaching methods within the Punjab province.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pure Food (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to provide for more effective enforcement of food safety laws and the rationalization of punishments. It introduces new clauses regarding definitions, expands the powers of inspectors to seal premises and use electronic devices for evidence, and substitutes sections with stricter penalties for selling adulterated or unsafe food.

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Food Authority Act, 2011 to facilitate the categorization of food business premises and enhance punishments for violations. It introduces new sections regarding certificates for categorized premises and increases penalties for selling adulterated or substandard food.

name: PUNJAB BOILERS AND PRESSURE VESSELS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002 to align it with provincial jurisdiction in Punjab. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and establishes a Provincial Boilers and Pressure Vessels Safety Board.

name: PUNJAB REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT 2006

metadata.title: The Punjab Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Act, 2006
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act revises the emoluments of holders of representative offices in the Province of Punjab. It amends several existing Acts and Ordinances regarding salaries, allowances, and privileges for the Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Ministers, Parliamentary Secretaries, and Members of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to regulate stage carriages in Punjab. It grants the Government powers to survey routes, declare specified routes, and determine technical specifications for vehicles and permits. The legislation also outlines procedures for applying for permits based on qualifications set by the Government.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE SECURITY COMPANIES (REGULATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2002. It adds a new section prohibiting private security companies from undertaking cash-in-transit business without a No Objection Certificate from the Licensing Authority.

metadata.title: The Allopathic System (Prevention of Misuse) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to prevent the misuse of the allopathic system of medicine and to regulate related matters. It prohibits unqualified persons from using the title 'doctor', displaying medical degrees, performing surgeries, prescribing specific drugs, or selling certain medicines without proper labeling.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the participation of workers in the profits of companies within Pakistan. It establishes a Workers Participation Fund and outlines rules for its management, contribution percentages, and distribution of benefits to eligible employees.

metadata.title: The Foreigners Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers upon the Federal Government regarding the entry, presence, and departure of foreigners into Pakistan. It establishes definitions for 'foreigner' and outlines the authority to make orders restricting movement, imposing conditions, and detaining individuals in the interest of national security.

metadata.title: Qanun-e-Shahadat Order, 1984
metadata.summary: This Order outlines the rules regarding the relevancy of facts, witnesses, and evidence in legal proceedings. It covers topics such as oral and documentary evidence, admissions, confessions, public documents, and presumptions related to evidence.

metadata.title: Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to establish an effective local government system. It aims to empower decision-making at the grassroots level and improve service delivery through a bottom-up approach by modifying various sections regarding definitions, governance structure, and specific administrative areas.

metadata.title: Punjab Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to update definitions regarding adolescents and adults, expand the scope of establishments covered, and modify working hour regulations. It specifically addresses overtime limits, rest intervals, and restrictions on adolescent employment timings.

name: UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH ASIA, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The University of South Asia, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The University of South Asia, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of South Asia, Lahore Act, 2005 to update its sections regarding faculties, affiliations, and governance. It specifically inserts new clauses for student exchange programs, college inspection, and validates previous amendments made by this legislation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to update definitions regarding age limits for adolescents and adults. It also modifies provisions concerning working hours, overtime, and the types of establishments covered under the ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It introduces changes to various sections of the said Ordinance, including additions, omissions, and substitutions.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention and control of infectious diseases in the Punjab province. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session, allowing for immediate action on public health threats.

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to encourage participatory development of canals and establish an effective mechanism for recovering charges. It also ousts civil court jurisdiction in specific proceedings, makes certain offences cognizable and non-bailable, and confers revisional jurisdiction upon the Superintending Canal Officer.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an enabling environment for the private sector to participate in infrastructure and physical service projects within the Punjab. It outlines institutional arrangements, project delivery processes, and mechanisms for dispute resolution and termination of agreements.

metadata.title: The Employment of Children (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Employment of Children Act, 1991 to replace federal references with provincial ones for Punjab. It substitutes specific terms throughout the original Act to align jurisdictional authority with the Government of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Workers' Children (Education) (Amendment) Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972 to replace references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' and to define 'Government' as the Government of the Punjab. It also updates definitions regarding workers by referencing the Punjab Industrial Relations Act 2010 and omits specific wage thresholds and the word 'Provincial' from various sections.

name: PUNJAB SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OF CHILDREN HOMES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2003

metadata.title: The Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.amends: The Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Act, 1976. Specifically, it inserts a requirement for at least four women members into Section 4, clause (g) of the said Act.

name: THE PUNJAB DESTITUTE AND NEGLECTED CHILDREN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act, 2004 to facilitate the registration of organizations managing accommodation for destitute and neglected children. It introduces new offences, increases penalties for existing ones, and defines specific categories of at-risk children.

name: PUNJAB RESTRICTION ON EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Restriction on Employment of Children Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the employment of children and restricts adolescents from performing hazardous work in specific occupations. It establishes a Provincial Committee on Child Labour to advise on measures for eradicating child labour and sets limits on working hours, mandatory rest intervals, and weekly holidays for adolescents.

metadata.title: The Employment (Record of Services) (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Employment (Record of Services) Act, 1951 by substituting references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' and replacing 'Provincial' with 'Government of the Punjab'. It also modifies specific numerical values in the original act regarding penalties or limits.

metadata.title: The Ehtram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to observe the sanctity of the month of Ramazan in Punjab. It prohibits fasting individuals from eating, drinking, or smoking in public places and restricts the serving of eatables during fasting hours. Additionally, it mandates the closure of cinema houses and theatres from sunset until three hours thereafter.

metadata.title: The Juvenile Justice System Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection of rights for children involved in criminal litigation and their rehabilitation within society. It establishes the framework for re-organizing juvenile courts and includes provisions for legal assistance, definitions of key terms like 'child' and 'juvenile court', and procedures to ensure exclusive jurisdiction over cases involving minors.

metadata.title: The Punjab Home-based Workers Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of rights and encourages home-based workers as important stakeholders in the labour market. It defines key terms such as employer, contractor, and home-based worker, while establishing provisions regarding employment prohibitions, including restrictions on employing children under fifteen years of age.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to adapt it for the Punjab province. It substitutes references from 'West Pakistan' to 'the Punjab', introduces daycare rooms for children in establishments with twenty-five or more female employees, and updates various fines and procedural limits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act 2012 (XLII of 2012)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of sales tax on services rendered or provided in the Province of the Punjab. It applies to specific services listed in the Schedule, such as those by hotels, telecommunication providers, and banking companies, at a rate of sixteen per cent.

metadata.title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Factories Act, 1934 to update definitions regarding manufacturing processes and worker classifications. It introduces provisions for declaring factory departments as separate entities while protecting workers' rights.

metadata.title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Factories Act, 1934 by substituting references to 'Provincial' with 'Punjab' and updating various sections regarding penalties and definitions. It also substitutes older employment acts with newer ones and enhances penalties for repeat offenders.

name: THE PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF CHILD LABOUR AT BRICK KILNS ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Child Labour at Brick Kilns Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the employment of children at brick kilns in the Punjab and regulates general labour conditions in that sector. It establishes specific rules regarding written engagement contracts, limits on cash advances (peshgi), and penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 to regulate the disposal of surplus assets from wound-up societies. It mandates that such assets be devoted to public utility or charitable purposes rather than being divided among members.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to update terminology and definitions specific to the Province of Punjab. It introduces changes regarding member limits, merger procedures, and the roles of government officials within cooperative societies.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to update terminology and definitions relevant to the Punjab province. It introduces specific changes regarding membership limits, registration requirements, and provisions for merging societies with corporate bodies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 to address the disposal of surplus assets from wound-up societies. It mandates that such assets be devoted to public utility or charitable purposes rather than being divided among members.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PUBLICATION OF TEXTBOOKS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Publication of Textbooks (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of the printing, publication, and sale of textbooks published by or under the authority of the West Pakistan Textbook Board. It establishes prohibitions on unauthorized printing or selling, defines offenses and penalties, and outlines procedures for forfeiture and legal cognizance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1975. Specifically, it substitutes clause (ii) of subsection (1) in section 5 regarding the appointment of a nominee from the Mines and Minerals Department.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to remove restrictions on double membership in specific cases. It also omits provisions regarding the dissolution of local governments and empowers Deputy Mayors or Vice Chairmen to preside over meetings.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to harmonize its provisions with section 116 of the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013. It specifically substitutes clauses in sections 2 and 3 of the 1958 Act regarding the definition of urban areas and property tax rates.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to align the election system for reserved seats with that of Provincial Assemblies. It introduces proportional representation based on political party lists and mandates open division voting for Mayor and Chairman elections.

name: THE PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update definitions and composition rules for various local government bodies. It introduces specific requirements for technocrat members, adjusts reserved seats for women, peasants, workers, youth, and non-Muslims, and omits section 18A of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to address reserved seats in Union Councils through indirect elections and representation in the Punjab Finance Commission. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to address specific provisions regarding elections and council composition. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT 1991

metadata.title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority as a body corporate to develop the Revenue Division of Dera Ghazi Khan. It grants the Authority powers to prepare development schemes, acquire property, and manage infrastructure projects including housing, irrigation, and waste disposal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update definitions and composition rules for various local government bodies. It introduces specific requirements for technocrats, workers, women, youth, and non-Muslim members in Union Councils, District Councils, Municipal Committees, and Metropolitan Corporations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to empower rural Union Councils with urban characteristics to levy property tax. It substitutes a specific subsection in section 116 of the amended act to define how property tax rates are determined for these councils.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to align the election system for reserved seats with proportional representation based on political party lists. It also modifies provisions regarding the election of local government heads and rationalizes the definition of a technocrat.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to empower the government to divide metropolitan and municipal corporations into zones for better service delivery. It also updates provisions regarding the representation of marginalized segments, increases the number of Deputy Mayors and Vice Chairmen, and clarifies rules for presiding over meetings in the absence of the Mayor or Chairman.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update provisions regarding local areas, delimitation of union councils and wards, and the reconstitution of union councils. It substitutes several sections of the parent Act to clarify the roles of the Government and Election Commission in defining local boundaries and electoral constituencies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update provisions regarding ward definitions, election delimitation, and reserved seats. It also inserts new sections concerning the finality of delimitation and substitutes various sections related to Union Council composition and franchise rules.

metadata.title: The Women University Multan (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Women University Multan Act, 2010 to formally reconstitute the Government Postgraduate College for Women Multan as the Women University Multan. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its structure, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and staff composition.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Stamp Act, 1899 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It adds new clauses defining 'Public Office' and 'Public Officer' to include various government bodies, local authorities, and commercial concerns. The Act also repeals the previous Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973.

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Hoarding Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Prevention of Hoarding Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Punjab to prevent hoarding of scheduled articles during the COVID-19 pandemic emergency. It defines offences related to stocking excess quantities or failing to sell demanded goods, grants powers for warrantless search and seizure, and establishes penalties including imprisonment and fines.

name: PRICE CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF PROFITEERING AND HOARDING (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding (Amendment) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.amends: The Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977 to adapt it for effective price control of essential commodities in Punjab. It establishes a Price Control Council headed by the Chief Minister and modifies various sections regarding definitions, jurisdiction, powers delegation, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to increase pecuniary jurisdiction and update legal definitions. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to increase the pecuniary jurisdiction of District Appellate Courts and update legal definitions. It substitutes specific clauses regarding government and court definitions while omitting certain sections and the schedule of the original Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Family Courts (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Family Courts Act, 1964 to update provisions regarding jurisdiction, definitions, and court procedures within the Punjab. It introduces specific changes to sections concerning defendant appearances, written statements, compromise attempts, and decrees for dissolution of marriage.

metadata.title: The Punjab Commercial Courts Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Commercial Courts in the Punjab to ensure the expeditious disposal of commercial disputes and claims. It defines specific terms such as 'commercial dispute' based on claim value and transaction type, and outlines the powers of these courts under the Code of Civil Procedure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Commercial Courts Ordinance, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Commercial Courts Ordinance, 2021 (extended period expired on 09.10.2021)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Commercial Courts in the Punjab to facilitate the expeditious disposal of commercial disputes and claims arising from trade and business transactions. It provides for the appointment of judges, the establishment of a Secretariat and Registrar, and grants these courts powers similar to Civil Courts under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.

name: THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to update certain provisions within the Punjab province. It includes changes such as renaming courts, omitting specific sections, and substituting text related to judgment timelines, costs, and execution of decrees from reciprocating territories.

metadata.title: The Punjab Drugs (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to align provisions regarding Drug Courts with the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Provincial Government in section 31 of the said Act and transfers existing powers over Drug Courts from the Federal to the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Food Authority Act, 2011 to facilitate the categorization of food business premises and enhance punishments for violations. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pure Food (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to ensure more effective enforcement and rationalization of punishments. It introduces new definitions, modifies inspection powers for inspectors, and establishes stricter penalties for selling adulterated, substandard, or unsafe food.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to prevent violence at sensitive public places. It achieves this by prohibiting armed persons from entering such locations, which include hospitals, government offices, and educational institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Drugs (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to align provisions regarding Drug Courts with the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Provincial Government and transfers existing federal powers over Drug Courts in Punjab to the Provincial Government.

name: PUNJAB EMPLOYEES EFFICIENCY, DISCIPLINE AND ACCOUNTABILITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006. Specifically, it modifies section 2 of the original Act by substituting a sub-clause regarding employees in government or civil service within the province.

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920 to update references from 'Karachi Division' and general provincial terms to specific Punjab entities. It substitutes 'Lahore High Court' for 'High Courts', restricts geographical scope to the Punjab, and updates government designations throughout the original statute.

metadata.title: The Oaths Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: The Repealing Act, 1873 (XII of 1873)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to judicial oaths, affirmations, and declarations in Pakistan. It also provides for the repeal of laws concerning official oaths and establishes the authority and procedures for administering these oaths.

name: UNANI, AYURVEDIC AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS ACT, 1965

metadata.title: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the qualifications and provides for the registration of practitioners of Unani, Ayurvedic, and Homoeopathic systems of medicine in Pakistan. It establishes National Councils for Tib and Homoeopathy to oversee education, research, and the maintenance of professional standards.

metadata.title: The Probation of Offenders (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960 to update definitions and procedures regarding probation orders. It introduces new clauses for management plans and movement restrictions while modifying sections related to admonition orders, probation conditions, and court powers.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at reducing case backlogs and ensuring swift dispensation of justice. It substitutes and inserts various sections to mandate electronic maintenance of records, streamline the institution of suits, expedite the framing of issues and recording of evidence, and modernize the service of summons.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) BILL 2021

metadata.title: the Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at providing inexpensive and expeditious justice. It substitutes specific sections regarding court hierarchy, pecuniary jurisdiction, institution of suits, written statements, proposed issues, and the framing of issues to streamline civil litigation processes.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT LANDS AND BUILDINGS (RECOVERY OF POSSESSION) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy recovery of possession of Government lands and buildings from outgoing lessees, licensees, and unauthorised occupants. It outlines the powers of authorised officers to enter premises, evict occupants, demolish structures, and recover rent arrears when leases or licences expire or are determined.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) BILL 2021

metadata.title: Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 by omitting specific expressions from section 14A. It was enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to reverse amendments made in 2020.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 by adding specific subjects to section 14A. The added subjects include forests, mines, food adulteration, encroachments on public lands, dangerous driving, building safety, and municipal services.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006 to rationalize provisions regarding the service. It specifically updates sections concerning the appointment and tenure of the Prosecutor General, evidence assessment submissions, and procedures for proposing punishment when an accused pleads guilty.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006 by updating provisions regarding appointments to the service. It substitutes specific subsections concerning recruitment methods and omits a previous subsection.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006 to clarify provisions regarding superintendence, administration, and the conduct of prosecutors. It substitutes specific sections in the original Act to define the roles of the Prosecutor General, establish a code of conduct, and determine how this legislation overrides other laws.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to replace references to 'Zila Nazim' with the Deputy Commissioner or Secretary to the Government of the Punjab. It also omits specific requirements regarding written recommendations from police superintendents and modifies the duration of orders issued under this section.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006 to rationalize provisions regarding the service and address ancillary matters. It specifically alters sections concerning the appointment and tenure of the Prosecutor General, the submission of evidence assessments, and the proposal of punishments for guilty pleas.

name: THE PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006 to rationalize provisions regarding the service and address ancillary matters. It specifically alters sections concerning the appointment and tenure of the Prosecutor General, the submission of evidence assessments, and the proposal of punishments for guilty pleas.

metadata.title: The Punjab Charities Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the registration and regulation of charities within the Punjab province. It creates a Commission to oversee charitable activities, defines charitable purposes and trusteeship responsibilities, and sets rules for the collection and accounting of charitable funds.

metadata.title: The Punjab Hepatitis Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Surveillance System for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of hepatitis within the Punjab. It outlines the responsibilities of healthcare facilities, mandates testing protocols, and sets penalties for non-compliance to control the spread of the disease.

name: MARRIAGE FUNCTIONS (PROHIBITION OF OSTENTATIOUS DISPLAYS AND WASTEFUL EXPENSES) ORDINANCE 2000

metadata.title: The Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits ostentatious displays and wasteful expenses during marriage functions in Pakistan. It specifically bans the use of lights, fireworks, and crackers for celebrations while restricting served meals to one dish with soft drinks at public venues.

metadata.title: The Punjab Charities Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the registration and regulation of charities within the Punjab province. It creates a Commission to oversee charitable activities, defines charitable purposes and trusteeship responsibilities, and sets rules for the collection and accounting of charitable funds.

metadata.title: The Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act, 2019 to update its preamble and various sections regarding definitions, functions, and standards. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reconstitution of the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission to receive and redress grievances of Overseas Pakistanis relating to Government Agencies. It establishes the composition, functions, and powers of the Commission, its Advisory Council, Commissioner, and various committees to handle complaints and suggestions.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION FOR REGULARIZATION OF IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Commission to examine private housing schemes and land subdivisions developed irregularly without competent authority approval. Its purpose is to provide for the regularization of these schemes to alleviate grievances for affected individuals.

name: PUNJAB PREVENTION OF SPECULATION IN ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Speculation in Essential Commodities Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to prevent speculation in essential commodities, curb artificial price hikes, and stop profiteering. It applies to the entire province of Punjab and grants powers for information gathering, stock verification, search, seizure, and imposing penalties on offenders.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Repeal and Revival) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act defines the powers, immunities, and privileges of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, its committees, and its members. It establishes specific protections against civil or criminal proceedings, detention, and salary attachment for assembly members during sessions.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF PRIVATE MONEY LENDING ACT 2007

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Private Money Lending Act, 2007
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Money-Lenders Ordinance 1960 (W.P. Ordinance XXIV of 1960)
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits private money lending within the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Government', 'Private Money Lender', and 'Interest', and prescribes severe punishments including imprisonment or fines for violations.

metadata.title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 to incorporate provisions for electronic record systems and biometric verification. It updates definitions related to electronic records, signatures, and specific authorities within the Punjab Land Records framework.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF OWNERSHIP OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2025 to address issues regarding illegal possession and property disputes. It introduces new definitions for 'accused' and 'Judge', substitutes various sections related to offences and complaints, and establishes Scrutiny Committees at the district level.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975 to update provisions regarding land allotment, compensation, and property disposal schemes. It introduces new sections to abate pending proceedings under specific repealed acts and establishes a one-year limitation period for implementing final orders by the Full Board or notified officers.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020 to facilitate its smooth implementation. It introduces a Board structure with specific members, substitutes references from 'Authority' to 'Board', and details the appointment and responsibilities of the Chief Executive Officer.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to confine the authority's jurisdiction to the Metropolitan area of Lahore. It substitutes specific references from 'Lahore Division' or 'area of Lahore Division' with 'Metropolitan area of Lahore' throughout the original Act.

metadata.title: The Fort Monroe Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Fort Monroe Development Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Fort Monroe Development Authority Act, 2016 to extend the Authority's jurisdiction for development and rehabilitation in Koh-e-Suleman and the Tribal Area of District Rajanpur. It substitutes references from 'Fort Monroe' to 'Koh-e-Suleman' throughout the original Act, including its title, preamble, and specific sections.

name: REGULATION OF MINES AND OIL-FIELDS AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT (FEDERAL CONTROL) ACT, 1948

metadata.title: The Regulation of Mines and Oil fields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters connected with the regulation of mines, oil-fields, and mineral developments under government control. It empowers the appropriate Government to make rules regarding exploration licenses, mining leases, royalty rates, production control, and pricing of minerals.

metadata.title: The New Murree Development Authority (Amendment) Act 2004
metadata.amends: The New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004 to update its administrative composition. Specifically, it inserts a new clause regarding the Secretary of Tourism and Resort Member as an ex-officio member and modifies section 4 by substituting 'and' for a comma and omitting specific references related to tourism.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to confine the authority's jurisdiction specifically to the Metropolitan area of Lahore. It substitutes references to 'Lahore Division' with 'Metropolitan area of Lahore' across various sections and clauses of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020 to facilitate its smooth implementation. It establishes a Board of the Authority with specific members and substitutes references to the 'Authority' with 'Board' throughout various sections.

name: INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF THE PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab (Amendment) Act 2016
metadata.amends: Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab Act 2016
metadata.repeals: Punjab Highways Authority Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab Act 2016 to omit a succession clause and address incidental purposes. It specifically repeals the Punjab Highways Authority Act, 1989, and omits section 39 of the parent Act.

metadata.title: The Fort Monroe Development Authority Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Fort Monroe Development Authority to develop Fort Monroe as a tourist resort and promote tourism. It provides for the composition, functions, and powers of the Authority, including provisions for its members, officers, and financial administration.

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Development Authority (Repeal) Act 2018
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991 to allow for the reconstitution of the authority under the Development of Cities Act, 1976. It ensures that existing rules, appointments, and proceedings made under the repealed Act continue to have effect unless specifically cancelled.

metadata.title: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015 by inserting a new section 5A. The inserted provision allows for the refund of cess paid due to inadvertence, error, or misconstruction under specific conditions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015 to update definitions regarding imported and exported goods. It introduces new sections for appointing cess officers, establishing monitoring stations, and framing regulations to ensure proper collection of the cess.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION FOR REGULARIZATION OF IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance, 2021 to improve the functioning of the Commission and address ancillary matters. It substitutes specific words in the long title and preamble, inserts new definitions regarding land ownership and usage, and modifies sections related to the composition of the Commission and its application scope.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to extend hospital services to the general public and improve implementation. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Museums Board Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Museums Board to ensure the efficient maintenance and management of museums in the Punjab. It defines the Board's composition, powers, functions, and financial procedures while outlining the appointment and removal processes for its members and officers.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
