metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Act, 2021 to improve the functioning of the Commission and address ancillary matters. It establishes a new Council to oversee the Commission's recommendations for regularizing irregular housing schemes and introduces specific amendments to sections regarding membership, powers, and procedures.

metadata.title: The Lahore Ring Road Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011 to rename the entity as the Punjab Ring Roads Authority and extend its scope to the entire province of Punjab. It introduces new definitions for economic corridors and strategic roads while modifying various sections regarding fines, project approval limits, and organizational structure.

metadata.title: Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to incorporate digital land record systems and update definitions for officials like Patwaris and Kanungos. It introduces new terms such as 'Digital Cadaster' and 'parcel number' while omitting references to specific traditional roles and areas.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission to receive and redress grievances of overseas Pakistanis regarding government agencies. It outlines the composition, functions, and powers of the Commission, including its role in reviewing the Commissioner's performance and nominating members for advisory councils.

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Safety Laws (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950; The Punjab Food Authority Act, 2011; The Punjab Registration of Godowns Act, 2014; The Punjab Halal Development Agency Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends various existing laws relating to food safety in the Punjab to harmonize the regulatory framework and reduce administrative burdens. It specifically updates definitions, departmental references, and procedural clauses within acts from 1950, 2011, 2014, and 2016.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION FOR REGULARIZATION OF IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance, 2021 to improve the functioning of the Commission and address ancillary matters. It introduces specific exclusions for federal, provincial, local, and waqf lands, defines new terms regarding illegal schemes and land use, and modifies the composition and powers of the Commission.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to update provisions regarding administrative divisions and districts. It specifically revises sections concerning the appointment of Commissioners and Collectors and the creation of new districts.

name: THE TRANSFER OF POPULATION WELFARE PROGRAMME (FIELD ACTIVITIES) ORDINANCE, 1983

metadata.title: Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of field activities of the Population Welfare Programme from the Federal Government to the Provincial Governments. It outlines the specific powers, functions, and responsibilities that vest in the Provinces while retaining certain national policy and coordination functions with the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Forest (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Forest Act, 1927 specifically for its application to certain parts of West Pakistan. It substitutes the word 'vehicles' for the word 'carts' throughout the amended Act in specified districts and areas.

metadata.title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Registration Act of 1908 to update various sections regarding jurisdiction, government definitions, and procedural rules. It specifically restricts the application of the amended act to the Punjab province and substitutes references to 'Pakistan' or 'Provincial Government' with 'Punjab' or 'Government' respectively.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to update provisions regarding administrative divisions and revenue officers. It substitutes several sections of the original act to redefine the structure of Divisions, Districts, Sub-Divisions, and Tehsils, as well as detailing the classes and appointment powers for Commissioners, Collectors, and Assistant Collectors.

name: PUNJAB MINIMUM WAGES FOR UNSKILLED WORKERS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969 to specifically apply to the Punjab region. It substitutes references to Pakistan with the Punjab and updates definitions regarding government authority and industrial areas.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to facilitate the establishment of companies for managing cattle markets across multiple districts. It inserts a new section regarding these companies and modifies specific entries in the Third and Eighth Schedules of the parent Act. Additionally, the Act repeals the earlier Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by omitting specific sections and inserting provisions for companies to establish cattle markets across multiple districts. It also updates various schedules within the said Ordinance regarding these changes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014 by updating the composition and membership requirements of the Commission. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.

metadata.title: The Whipping Act, 1909
metadata.repeals: The Second Repealing and Amending Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act adds whipping as a punishment for specific offences described in Act XLV of 1860. It establishes provisions for compulsory whipping in certain offences and includes special rules for juvenile offenders and frontier districts.

metadata.title: Police Order (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order 2002 by establishing a new Crime Control Department within the police force. It outlines the creation of specialized cadres, defines the hierarchy and staffing of the department, and provides mechanisms for transferring investigations from district police to this new unit.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014 to update the composition of the Commission. Specifically, it changes the number of members from five to six and modifies the requirements for private sector nominees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Punjab Finance Act 2021 (XIX of 2021)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a duty on admission to entertainments in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'entertainment', 'payment for admission', and 'Government', and establishes provisions for liability, penalties, exemptions, and recovery of duties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act 2009 to exclude private sector organizations from the definition of a 'procuring agency' and to limit the scope of 'services'. It also refines exemption clauses, inserts provisions for blacklisting bidders or contractors engaging in corrupt practices, and updates definitions regarding public procurement and corrupt practices.

metadata.title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009 to exclude private sector organizations from the definition of a 'procuring agency' and to limit the scope of 'services'. It also refines the exemption clause and introduces provisions for blacklisting bidders or contractors who engage in corrupt practices.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to incorporate provisions regarding e-stamps and electronically executed instruments. It defines new terms such as 'e-stamp' and expands the definition of 'duly stamped' and 'impressed stamp' to include electronic forms.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 to apply its provisions specifically to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and adjusts penalties and definitions accordingly.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by substituting and inserting specific sections regarding election authorities, terms of office, and dissolution procedures. It establishes an Election Authority with a High Court judge as Chairman to conduct local government elections and introduces provisions for appointing administrators when councils are dissolved.

metadata.title: The Stamp (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.repeals: India Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act amends the application of the Stamp Act, 1899 to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes various sections and schedules within the principal Act to update duty amounts and procedures for specific financial instruments.

metadata.title: The Commercial Documents Evidence Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Law of Evidence specifically regarding certain commercial documents. It establishes that statements of facts in scheduled documents are themselves relevant facts and allows courts to presume the genuineness and accuracy of specific maritime, aviation, and trade-related documents.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to include academies, coaching centers, and tuition centers within its regulatory scope. It achieves this by modifying section 2 of the Ordinance and inserting a new section 12E that grants the Government power to issue instructions for regulating these institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004 to enhance parliamentary oversight and ensure transparency in government affairs. Specifically, it modifies Section 5 of the original Act by reducing the number of directors from three to two and adding requirements for Provincial Assembly membership and professional expertise.

name: PUNJAB FREE AND COMPULSORY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Free and Compulsory Education (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2014 by substituting subsection (3) of section 1. The amendment ensures that the act comes into force at once.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to address special circumstances. It inserts a new section allowing the Registering Authority to issue directives for school closures and alternative education methods during calamities, epidemics, or other hazardous situations.

name: PUNJAB BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962 to provide temporary measures for granting certificates and diplomas. These provisions allow for promotion based on alternative criteria instead of conventional examinations due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION INITIATIVES MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority to devise and manage initiatives in the education sector. It provides for the establishment of a body corporate with powers to enter contracts, acquire property, and partner with the private sector.

name: PUNJAB BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) BILL 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962 to provide temporary provisions for granting certificates and diplomas. These grants are intended as an alternative to conventional examinations for persons promoted through specific criteria during the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 by inserting a new section regarding special directives for school closures. It allows the Registering Authority to issue orders for closure or alternative education during calamities, epidemics, floods, wars, or other hazardous circumstances, including fee adjustments for such periods.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) BILL 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 to implement a corporate governance model. It specifically alters sections regarding the appointment of the Chairperson, the role of the Chief Operating Officer, and related administrative clauses.

name: PUNJAB BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962 to grant regulatory, administrative, and operational autonomy to the Punjab Skills Development Authority. It substitutes Section 4 regarding the Board's composition and terms, and amends Section 10 concerning the Board's powers to conduct examinations.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 to grant regulatory, administrative, and operational autonomy to the Punjab Skills Development Authority. It achieves this by omitting specific clauses related to hostel approval and licensing from section 5 of the original 2010 Act.

metadata.title: The University of Education, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to introduce new definitions and roles for the Pro-Chancellor. It specifically designates the Minister for Education of the Government of the Punjab as the Pro-Chancellor and outlines their duties.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2010

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 by adding a new subsection to section 3. The amendment grants the Authority the power to transfer technical institutions to the Government or other government-controlled bodies.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to improve the management of privately managed educational institutions. It introduces specific provisions regarding fee structures, registration requirements, and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004 to alter the composition and functions of the Board. It also inserts new provisions regarding government directions and repeals a previous amendment ordinance.

name: ALI INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010 to expand the scope of education and training provided at the Institute. It specifically updates section 4 regarding teaching skills instruction and examination procedures for awarding degrees.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 to grant administrative and operational autonomy to the Punjab Board of Technical Education. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to improve the management of privately managed educational institutions. It introduces specific provisions regarding registration requirements, fee structures for the academic year 2015-16, and penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004 to alter the composition and appointment procedures of its Board. It also inserts new provisions regarding government directions and vacancy filling while omitting specific subsections from the original Act.

name: ALI INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act 2010 to expand the scope of education and training provided at the Institute. It was promulgated by the Governor of Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to allow for reasonable fee increases by private schools. It establishes District Committees and Registering Authorities to oversee these institutions and sets specific limits on fee hikes based on previous academic year charges.

name: THE PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to allow for reasonable fee increases. It also updates definitions regarding schools and establishes procedures for District Committees and Registering Authorities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020 to incorporate provisions for its smooth implementation. It modifies specific sections regarding base standards, appointment qualifications, policy board business conduct, search committee procedures, and accounting officer roles.

metadata.title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009 to update the composition of its Board. It substitutes the existing subsection (2) with a new list of members representing various government departments, the Provincial Assembly, and the Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

metadata.title: NUR International University Lahore (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the NUR International University Lahore Act 2015 to update provisions regarding instruction, degrees, and faculty structures. It specifically substitutes sections related to the Vice Chancellor's appointment, acting arrangements, interpretation of provisions, and the list of university faculties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Curriculum Authority to supervise curricula and textbooks in the province. It defines the composition of the Authority, including government nominees and representatives from various sectors, and outlines its functions regarding education standards.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Social Services Board to promote social welfare and coordinate related programs. It defines the Board's composition, including ex-officio members and nominated representatives from various sectors, and outlines its functions, financial provisions, and administrative structure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to facilitate the distribution of rights, assets, and liabilities among successor local governments. It also addresses the succession of groups of offices reverting to the Government upon the repeal of the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update provisions regarding ward definitions, Union Council composition, and election procedures. It specifically addresses the delimitation of wards for general and reserved seats, including those for women, peasants/workers, youth, and non-Muslim members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to modify sections regarding municipal committees, franchise, and delimitation. It also inserts a new section establishing the finality of delimitation for Union Councils and wards after the election schedule is notified.

metadata.title: Punjab Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Order, 2002 to regulate police recruitment ranks and selection processes based on domicile. It also substitutes Article 18 to establish a separate District Investigation Branch with specific supervisory structures and jurisdictional rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update definitions regarding elections and bye-elections. It also modifies provisions related to local area limits, election commissions, and marginal headings concerning vacancies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Police Order (Amendment) Act 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 to update provisions regarding police recruitment ranks and selection criteria. It also substitutes Article 18 to establish the separation of investigation functions from other police duties and defines the structure of District Investigation Branches.

name: UNIVERSITY OF VETERINARY AND ANIMAL SCIENCES, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to update provisions regarding the appointment and tenure of the Vice Chancellor. It also introduces a new section for the Pro-Vice Chancellor and modifies various sections related to qualifications, search committees, and syndicate composition.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a fourth amendment to the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It specifically modifies section 179-A of that Ordinance by substituting subsection (12) with new provisions regarding election notification timelines.

metadata.title: The Public Sector Universities (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The laws of various public sector universities in the Punjab (including University of the Punjab Act 1973, University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore Act 1974, and others)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws governing various public sector universities in the Punjab to update appointment procedures and administrative structures. Key changes include modifying sections related to Vice Chancellor eligibility, search committee composition, and Pro-Vice Chancellor roles across multiple university acts.

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act 2005 to update provisions regarding the appointment and tenure of the Vice Chancellor. It also modifies sections concerning the Chancellor's powers, the role of the Pro-Vice Chancellor, and emergency actions by the university administration.

name: UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to update various sections regarding university governance. Key changes include defining the role of the Pro-Chancellor as the Minister for Health, Punjab, and revising the appointment process and tenure conditions for the Vice Chancellor.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 by adding a new subsection to section 8. The amendment allows for the approval of promotion for civil servants who die or superannuate after being recommended but before assuming their higher post.

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: The King Edward Medical University Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the King Edward Medical University Act, 2005 to modify provisions regarding the Vice Chancellor. It establishes a new procedure for appointing the Vice Chancellor based on recommendations from a Search Committee advised by the Chief Minister of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by substituting and amending specific sections regarding election commissions and result notifications. It replaces references to 'Election Authority' with 'Election Commission' throughout the ordinance.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to restrict the bank from granting advances or altering terms for directors and their connected persons. It defines who is considered a connected person, including family members and entities where the director holds significant shares or positions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to introduce specific definitions regarding proforma and regular promotion. It further substitutes section 8 of the parent Act to regulate eligibility, timing, and the basis (merit or seniority) for granting promotions to civil servants.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms), Order (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes figures in Article 5 and invalidates rights accrued from election proceedings taken before the Act came into force. Additionally, it repeals the earlier Co-operative Societies (Reforms), Order (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1974.

name: CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (REFORMS) ORDER (PUNJAB SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Second Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific dates in Article 5 of the referenced Order and invalidates rights accrued from election proceedings taken before this Act came into force.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972; The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes figures in Article 5 regarding committee member counts and establishes new procedures for superseding committees and electing new ones between February and April 1973. The legislation also invalidates prior election proceedings under a specific 1972 Ordinance and repeals two previous Ordinances related to these reforms.

metadata.title: The Petroleum Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the import, transport, storage, production, refining, and blending of petroleum and other inflammable substances. It establishes rules for licensing, inspection, testing standards, and penalties for offenses regarding these activities.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to align it with the Elections Act, 2017. It introduces provisions for the Election Commission to handle delimitation and ensures that election procedures follow the relevant electoral laws.

metadata.title: The Punjab Emergency Service (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Emergency Service Act, 2006 to update various sections regarding the structure, powers, and conditions of service for officers and rescuers. It includes provisions for regularizing services, defining promotion criteria based on performance and fitness, and adjusting retirement ages.

name: TRANSFER OF POPULATION WELFARE PROGRAMME (FIELD ACTIVITIES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) Ordinance, 1983 to modify definitions regarding field activities and employee status. It specifically addresses the legal standing of employees transferred from the Federal Government to Provincial Governments, ensuring their actions and terms remain valid despite court judgments or other laws.

metadata.title: The Juvenile Justice System Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection of rights for children involved in criminal litigation and their rehabilitation within society. It establishes the framework for re-organizing juvenile courts and includes provisions for legal assistance, definitions of key terms like 'child' and 'juvenile court', and procedures to ensure exclusive jurisdiction over cases involving minors.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Offenders Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of citizens convicted in foreign countries to Pakistan and vice versa. It establishes the Competent Authority within the Ministry of Interior to manage applications and warrants related to these transfers.

metadata.title: Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to insert a requirement for Muslim candidates to submit a specific religious declaration with their nomination papers. It also allows the government to dispense with previous publication requirements in emergencies and adds a Ninth Schedule containing the required declaration text.

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to update definitions and departmental references. It specifically introduces 'e-waste' as a defined term and modifies the composition of the relevant authority to include representatives from various government departments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to rationalize provisions regarding the delegation of powers, filing of complaints, and incidental matters. It specifically alters sections 5, 11, 21, and 34 of the original 1997 Act to update functions delegated to officers and clarify procedural continuities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to adapt it for provincial use in Punjab. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Provincial Government and establishes a Punjab Environmental Protection Council and Agency.

metadata.title: The Punjab Road Safety Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Road Safety Authority to ensure safe road design, vehicles, and trained drivers. It defines key terms such as 'Authority', 'device', and 'road' while outlining the composition, qualifications, and functions of the newly created body.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2019 (XXX of 2019)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an enabling environment for the private sector to participate in public infrastructure and service provision within the Punjab province. It creates institutional arrangements including a Board, Authority, and Executive Committee to manage PPP projects from identification through implementation.

metadata.title: Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions, appointment procedures, and accident reporting requirements. It specifically substitutes sections regarding accident committees and modifies clauses related to inspection authorities and registration processes.

name: PUNJAB OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2019 to update specific sections regarding definitions, council composition, and enforcement mechanisms. It substitutes various terms within the original Act and omits certain subsections to align with current administrative structures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Services Board (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970 to update the composition of the Board and its functions. It specifically revises provisions regarding member nominations from the Provincial Assembly and introduces new requirements for collaboration with public and private sectors.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 by substituting sections regarding the Commission's composition and term of office. It also omits section 6 of the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to ensure that local governments provide designated landfill sites for solid waste disposal. It introduces penalties for illegal dumping and mandates the maintenance of these sites according to bylaws.

metadata.title: The Epidemic Diseases (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958 to replace references to 'West Pakistan' with 'the Punjab'. It also substitutes 'District Coordination Officer' for 'Deputy Commissioner' and omits section 5 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897; the Khairpur State Epidemic Diseases Act, 1941; and the Epidemic Diseases (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the prevention of the spread of dangerous epidemic diseases in Punjab. It empowers the Provincial Government to take special measures and prescribe regulations when an outbreak is threatened or occurring, including inspecting travelers and segregating suspected cases.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975 to modify provisions regarding the Full Board and pending proceedings. It introduces mechanisms for cancelling fraudulent land allotments and mandates that certain pending cases be transferred to the Full Board for final disposal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to provide a more effective system for regulating and monitoring animal slaughter. It introduces specific definitions for terms such as 'carcass', 'gazetted officer', and 'useful animal', while restricting the sale of meat from diseased animals or those slaughtered in contravention of the law.

metadata.title: The Electricity (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Electricity Act, 1910 to update provisions regarding licensee entry, appliance usage, and supply discontinuance. It was promulgated by the President on December 9, 1979, due to circumstances requiring immediate action.

metadata.title: The Electricity Act (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Electricity Act, 1910 to address issues regarding licensee consent, entry into premises for inspection, and notice periods for disconnection. It also introduces new provisions defining theft of energy and penalties for installing artificial means to abstract electricity.

metadata.title: The Registration of Foreigners Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of foreigners entering, being present in, and departing from Pakistan. It establishes definitions, powers to make rules regarding reporting requirements, burden of proof, penalties for non-compliance, and protections for persons acting under the Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Explosives (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Explosives Act of 1884 to adapt its provisions for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and omits specific sections from the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Explosives (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Explosives (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Explosives Act, 1884 by substituting references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and limiting jurisdiction to the province. It also omits section 15 of the original Act and repeals the corresponding Ordinance from 2014.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to modify provisions regarding the crushing of cane. It was promulgated by the Governor of Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to ensure timely and transparent payments to cane growers. It substitutes specific sections regarding crushing dates, direct bank transfers for payments, powers of the Cane Commissioner to determine liability, and penalties for offences.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020; The Sugar Factories (Control) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to ensure timely and transparent payments to cane growers. It introduces new definitions for Cane Purchase Receipts, sets deadlines for crushing and clearing cane payments, and modifies provisions regarding purchasing agents and penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to ensure timely and transparent payments to cane-growers. It introduces new clauses regarding Cane Purchase Receipts, establishes powers for the Cane Commissioner to determine payment liabilities, and increases penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sugar Factories Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950 to ensure timely payment of cane prices to growers. It inserts new subsections regarding the determination and recovery of outstanding payments as arrears of land revenue and substitutes a monetary limit in section 21.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to adapt it following the Eighteenth Amendment to the Constitution. It specifically transfers authority from the Federal Government to the Government of the Punjab and updates references to relevant industrial relations acts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a Special Allowance to employees in the Punjab whose wages do not exceed a specified threshold. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'undertaking' and outlines the rates and timing for these payments.

metadata.title: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a cost of living allowance to employees in the Punjab and establishes matters ancillary thereto. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'undertaking' while specifying the responsibility and timing for payment of these allowances.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to adapt it following the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and updates specific sections regarding profit definitions, worker eligibility, and penalty structures.

metadata.title: The Industrial Statistics Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the collection of statistics relating to industries, including matters concerning factories and labour welfare. It establishes the powers of the appropriate Government to direct data collection, appoint a statistics authority, and regulate the publication of returns.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to update references from Federal Government to the Government of Punjab and align it with the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010. It substitutes specific sections, clauses, and definitions within the original Act to reflect provincial jurisdiction and introduces new provisions for a monitoring committee and penalty structures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Family Laws (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961 to protect women from exploitation and ensure expeditious resolution of family disputes. It specifically changes the jurisdiction from Pakistan to the Punjab, defines new roles for Arbitration Councils and Nikah Registrars, and introduces stricter penalties for contraventions regarding marriage registration and child maintenance.

name: PUNJAB REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ORDINANCE 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance revises the salaries and other emoluments for holders of representative offices in Punjab. It amends five specific Acts from 1974 and 1975 to update financial figures, allowances, and privileges.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to introduce a Review Board for overseeing long-term detentions. It establishes specific procedures for reviewing detention cases after three months, including the composition of the board and the grounds for continued detention.

metadata.title: The Punjab Child Marriage Restraint (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929 to apply specifically to the Punjab province. It updates definitions regarding children and minors, increases penalties for child marriage, and designates Union Councils as the body responsible for filing complaints with Family Courts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Marriage Functions Ordinance 2015
metadata.repeals: The Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates marriage functions and related ceremonies within the Punjab province to prevent ostentatious displays and wasteful expenses. It imposes specific restrictions on decorations, fireworks, dowry exhibitions, food servings, and closing times for events.

name: PUNJAB LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Ordinance, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2021 (IX of 2021)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an efficacious mechanism for the issuance of Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates to curb fraud and forgery. It empowers the National Database and Registration Authority to issue these certificates directly, subject to specific conditions regarding legal heirs and property types.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Finance Act, 2013 by substituting subsection (3) of section 1. It specifies that the amended provisions shall come into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Finance Act, 1977 by inserting new sub-sections into section 3. The amendments mandate that drawing and disbursing officers or principal officers must deduct tax from employee salaries and deposit it in the treasury. It also establishes liability for officers who fail to perform these duties and outlines the recovery process involving an Excise and Taxation Officer, including a right to be heard before recovery.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Finance Act, 2014 to facilitate appeals regarding Luxury House Tax. It substitutes the expression 'Additional Director General, Excise and Taxation, Punjab' for the word 'Government' in section 8 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Finance Act, 2014 by substituting a specific expression in section 8. The amendment replaces the word 'Government' with 'Additional Director General, Excise and Taxation, Punjab' in subsection (12).

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2022 to expand the definition of rating areas and update provisions regarding urban immovable property tax. Specifically, it inserts new language into section 102 to include other local government laws and substitutes subsections (2) through (4) to clarify rating area status for urban areas and rural housing schemes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Fisheries Ordinance, 1961 by inserting a new section on quality control and standards for fish. It also amends section 26 of the said Ordinance to include specific clauses regarding fish standards.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974 to update definitions regarding protected areas, captive animals, and cruelty. It introduces new roles such as Chief Wildlife Ranger and Investigating Officer while modifying sections related to officers, courts, and prosecution services.

metadata.title: The Forest (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to clarify the definition of 'Department' and adjust penalty provisions. It specifically increases minimum fines to match the assessed value of damage caused to forest produce and introduces specific imprisonment terms for offenders who refuse to pay these fines.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE, FOOD AND DRUG AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Act, 2016 to include core departments as members of the Authority for effective representation. It substitutes specific subsections regarding the composition of the Authority and attendance rules for its members.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE, FOOD AND DRUG AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Act 2016 to include core departments as members of the Authority. The amendment aims to ensure effective representation and decision-making by adding specific government officials and scientists to the Authority's composition.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Protection Authority Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Social Protection Authority to create a comprehensive and gender-equitable social protection system for the poor and vulnerable in Punjab. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with specific composition, including government officials, assembly members, and civil society representatives, while outlining their qualifications, tenure, and functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forensic Science Authority (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Forensic Science Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Forensic Science Authority Act, 2025 by adding new clauses to section 3 regarding specific authority members. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on April 22, 2026, and received assent on May 6, 2026.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 to harmonize its provisions with current necessities. It introduces specific changes regarding definitions, permissions for public park usage, lease terms, and repeals a previous amendment ordinance.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 to harmonize its provisions with current necessities. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Forest (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to allow the Government of Punjab to declare reserved or protected forests as no longer reserved or protected. This power applies specifically to projects of national importance undertaken by the Federal Government, the Provincial Government, or their owned organizations and entities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to allow for the use of reserved or protected forest land for national projects of strategic importance when no other option exists. It establishes requirements for organizations to provide substitute plantable land and funds for immediate forestation before such declarations are made.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to facilitate better utilization of wasteland through the establishment of forest companies. It introduces provisions for public-private partnerships on assigned forest land or wasteland and outlines the procedures for these partnerships.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Forest Act, 1927 to facilitate better utilization of wasteland through the establishment of forest companies. It introduces provisions for public-private partnerships on assigned forest land or wasteland and establishes a framework for forest companies to oversee implementation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Forest Act, 1927 to allow for the declaration of reserved or protected forest lands as no longer reserved/protected when required for national projects of strategic importance. It mandates that substitute land equal to or larger than the original area must be declared as forest, allocated in a compact form near the original site, and funded for immediate afforestation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974 to update provisions regarding the constitution and appointment of tribunals. It introduces new sections detailing the qualifications for Chairman and Members, establishes procedures for removing officials due to misconduct or incapacity, and grants financial autonomy to the Tribunal's Chairman.

metadata.title: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981 to adapt its provisions for the Punjab province. It substitutes specific terms like 'Federal Government' with 'Government' and establishes a Provincial Council for the rehabilitation of disabled persons within the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Soil Reclamation (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Soil Reclamation Act, 1952 specifically as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It modifies sections regarding notices for reclamation schemes and the charging or recovery of reclamation fees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Museums Board Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Museums Board to ensure the efficient maintenance and management of museums in the Punjab. It defines the Board's composition, powers, functions, and procedures for appointing members and employees.

metadata.title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 by adding a new clause regarding instruments granting power to an attorney or agreements to sell interests in immovable property. It specifically addresses documents involving rights of one hundred rupees and upwards.

metadata.title: Punjab Masstransit Authority Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Masstransit Authority to oversee the construction, operation, and maintenance of a mass transit system in major cities of the Punjab. It defines the composition of the Authority, its powers regarding property acquisition and disposal, and outlines regulations for service providers and penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Safe Cities Authority Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Safe Cities Authority to construct, develop, and maintain an integrated command, control, and communications system in major cities of Punjab. Its primary purpose is to ensure the safety and security of people through a city-wide IC3 system. The Authority is empowered to manage facilities, enter into contracts, and oversee infrastructure operations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Metrobus Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Metrobus Authority to construct, operate, and maintain a mass transit system in major cities of the Punjab. It defines the Authority's powers, composition, functions, and procedures regarding assets, funds, and service providers.

metadata.title: The University of Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to replace references to a 'Company' with a 'Trust' and updates the list of faculties. It also substitutes the Board of Directors with a Board of Trustees and changes the oversight body from the University Grants Commission to the Higher Education Commission.

name: PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT) BILL 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003 to update provisions regarding definitions, objects, administration, and appointments. It specifically substitutes sections related to the Board of Management, the Head of a Medical Institution, and the Medical Superintendent.

name: PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT) BILL 2021

metadata.title: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.amends: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003 to update provisions regarding definitions, objects, administration, and appointments. It specifically substitutes sections related to the Board of Management, the Head of Medical Institutions, and the Medical Superintendent to streamline governance and recruitment processes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Mental Health (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Mental Health Ordinance, 2001 to transfer authority from the Federal Government to the Government of the Punjab. It specifically updates references to federal bodies with provincial equivalents and modifies the composition of the Mental Health Authority.

name: PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003 to update provisions regarding definitions, objects, administration, and board appointments. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act, 2010 to modify provisions regarding the Commissioner's tenure and removal. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020 to incorporate provisions for its smooth implementation. It modifies specific sections regarding base standards, qualification requirements, business procedures for policy and nomination committees, and the role of the Dean as an accounting officer.

name: UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMENT AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The University of Management and Technology, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The University of Management and Technology, Lahore Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Management and Technology, Lahore Act, 2004 to update its sections regarding academic courses, campus affiliations, and faculty appointments. It specifically revises section 4 to list new faculties, modifies section 5 to restrict sub-campus openings for ten years, and alters section 8 concerning the appointment of the Rector.

metadata.title: The University of Central Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The University of Central Punjab Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Central Punjab Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions and provisions regarding the university's structure and functions. It introduces new clauses for various roles such as Pro-Rector and Provost, expands the list of academic faculties, and grants powers for establishing authorities and managing international collaborations.

name: PAKISTAN KIDNEY AND LIVER INSTITUTE AND RESEARCH CENTER ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center as a not-for-profit organization in Punjab. It defines the Institute's functions, which include providing medical care, conducting research, training medical staff, and promoting health awareness.

name: PUNJAB CIVILIAN VICTIMS OF TERRORISM (RELIEF AND REHABILITATION) ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Civilian Victims of Terrorism (Relief and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an institutionalized response to address the hardships faced by civilian victims and their families due to acts of terrorism. It provides for timely recognition, state assistance for relief and rehabilitation, and the creation of a dedicated Civilian Victims Fund.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Social Services Board to promote social welfare and coordinate related programs. It provides for the board's constitution, functions, financial management, and provisions for citizen participation in social welfare movements.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES (HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board to manage facilities seized or frozen under United Nations Security Council orders in Punjab. It provides for the constitution of the Board, its powers to recruit employees and formulate budgets, and transitional provisions for existing staff. The legislation was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab when the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF WOMEN AGAINST VIOLENCE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence (Amendment) Act 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence Act 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence Act 2016 to facilitate the establishment of Protection Centres in all districts of the province. It substitutes specific terms like 'Government' with 'Authority' and updates definitions regarding domestic violence and relevant officials.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES (SECOND AMENDMENT) BILL 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes (Second Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Act 2021 to improve the functioning of the Commission and address ancillary matters. It establishes a new Council to oversee the Commission, approves recommendations for regularization, and modifies various sections regarding membership, powers, and procedures.

metadata.title: The Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi Act, 2013 to update various sections regarding definitions, powers, and fees. It specifically changes references from 'District' to 'Division', substitutes terms like 'Vice President' with 'Member', and adds provisions for welfare activities and post-employment restrictions.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING AND TOWN-PLANNING AGENCY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002 to address the status of government employees serving within the Agency. It inserts a new section defining how these employees remain government servants unless absorbed into the Agency's service and allows for the delegation of disciplinary and administrative powers.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004 to include provisions for plots alongside houses. It updates various sections of the original Act regarding definitions, housing schemes, membership termination, and allocation procedures.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004. Specifically, it substitutes subsection (4) of section 17 to require that all payments made by a member be updated annually.

name: THE PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004 to facilitate the disposal of houses and plots to in-service government servants upon reaching a specified age. It specifically substitutes provisions regarding the retirement age for property allocation from fifty-eight years onwards.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING AND TOWN PLANNING AGENCY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: Punjab Housing and Town Planning Agency (Amendment) Act 2026
metadata.amends: Punjab Housing and Town Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Housing and Town Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002. Specifically, it substitutes section 19 of the Ordinance to authorize the Agency to raise funds through rates, fees, and charges for its schemes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Women Hostels Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Women Hostels Authority to regulate women hostels in the private sector within the Punjab province. The Authority aims to provide safe and standard accommodation facilities for women by formulating standards, registering hostels, and monitoring operations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act, 2019 to update its preamble and various sections regarding definitions and functions. It expands the Authority's powers to include registering facilities, issuing licenses, maintaining electronic databases, and prescribing standards for clean drinking water provision.

name: PUNJAB INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL EMPLOYMENT (STANDING ORDERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968 to align it with the Punjab Industrial Relations Act 2010. It substitutes references to national laws with provincial ones, changes jurisdictional terms from 'Pakistan' to 'the Punjab', and omits specific sections while updating financial thresholds and definitions in the schedule.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MINIMUM WAGES FOR UNSKILLED WORKERS ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Punjab Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance fixes the minimum rates of wages for unskilled workers employed in specific commercial and industrial establishments within the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'commercial establishment', 'employer', and 'industrial establishment' to determine its scope and application.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to extend the appointment period for Administrators and assign sanitation and waste disposal functions to District and Union Councils. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to extend the appointment period for Administrators. It also assigns sanitation and solid waste collection functions to District Councils and Union Councils.

metadata.title: The Punjab Payment of Wages (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Payment of Wages Act, 1936 to adapt it for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Provincial Government with the Government of the Punjab and updates various sections regarding definitions, penalties, and applicable laws.

metadata.title: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1974 to adapt it for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and updates related industrial relations legislation citations.

metadata.title: The Minimum Wages (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961 to replace references to 'Provincial Government' with 'Government' and specifically refers to the Government of the Punjab. It updates various sections regarding definitions, jurisdiction over industrial relations, penalty amounts for offenses, and the establishment of labour courts under the Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010.

metadata.title: The Punjab Workmen's Compensation (Amendment) Act, 2013
