metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923 to apply specific provisions to the Punjab region. It updates compensation amounts, defines provincial terms, and omits several sections from the original 1923 legislation.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to extend hospital services to the general public and update terminology from 'secured persons' to 'secured employees'. It also modifies various sections to align references with current Punjab laws regarding domestic workers, local governments, and industrial relations.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION AGAINST HARASSMENT OF WOMEN AT THE WORKPLACE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace (Amendment) Act 2012
metadata.amends: The Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010 to update terminology and scope within Punjab. Key changes include substituting 'Ombudsman' with 'Ombudsperson', defining the Government as the Government of the Punjab, and establishing qualifications for the Ombudsperson appointment.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the use of motor vehicles in Pakistan, including provisions for temporary visitors and insurance requirements against third-party risks. It defines authorized insurers and certificates of insurance while exempting certain government-owned vehicles from mandatory insurance policies.

metadata.title: The Times Institute, Multan (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Times Institute, Multan Act, 2020 to update specific sections regarding definitions, educational branches, and board governance. It also modifies the First Statutes of the institute to include new faculties and adjust nomination clauses.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF QURA’N AND SEERAT STUDIES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act, 2014 to rationalize the membership of its Board of Directors and Academic Council. It substitutes specific definitions and clauses regarding board composition, including nominations by the Government and Ittehad Tanzimat-e-Madaris-e-Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Punjab Economic Research Institute (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Economic Research Institute Ordinance, 1980
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Economic Research Institute (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Economic Research Institute Ordinance, 1980 to re-constitute its Board. It substitutes specific clauses regarding definitions and modifies Section 5 to update the composition of the Board and qualifications for members.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF QURA’N AND SEERAT STUDIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act 2014 to rationalize the membership of its Board of Directors and Academic Council. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Economic Research Institute (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Economic Research Institute Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Economic Research Institute Ordinance, 1980 to re-constitute its Board. It substitutes the composition of the Board with specific government representatives and non-official members.

name: NEXT INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: Next Institute of Science and Technology (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.amends: Next Institute of Science and Technology Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Next Institute of Science and Technology Act 2025 by adding a Faculty of Allied Health Sciences, modifying examination approval procedures, and inserting a savings clause for prior examinations. It also updates the Schedule to reflect these structural changes.

metadata.title: Universities and Institutes Laws (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to universities and institutes in both the public and private sectors within the Punjab. Specifically, it substitutes clauses regarding the composition of Provincial Assemblies for these institutions to ensure at least one female member is nominated by the Speaker.

metadata.title: Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009 to update the composition of its Board. The amendments add specific administrative departments and adjust member nominations to reflect changes in departmental nomenclatures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Khal Panchayat Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Khal Panchayats for each water course to manage irrigation rights and obligations among farmers. It defines the composition, functions, and duties of these bodies, including mediating disputes over water distribution and enforcing warabandi schedules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce new provisions regarding private partition schemes in cases of inheritance. It establishes strict time limits for Revenue Officers to decide partition cases and outlines procedures for handling disputes over title within those proceedings.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to update provisions regarding summons service and title inquiries in partition proceedings. Specifically, it substitutes terms to include adults regardless of gender and allows for service via electronic means.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LAND REFORMS REGULATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends paragraph 5 of the West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation by replacing a full-stop with a colon and adding a further proviso. The added provision ensures that orders passed by Land Commissioners or their deputies are subject to appeal, review, or revision in the same manner as other such orders.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to exclude certain notified areas from its operation regarding land revenue assessment and collection. It substitutes section 3 of the 1967 Act with new provisions defining these exclusions and repeals the previous Ordinance passed in 2019.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to exclude certain notified areas from the operation of its provisions regarding revenue assessment and collection. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Trusts Act, 1882 to apply its provisions specifically to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to Pakistan with Punjab and updates various sections regarding registration acts and court jurisdictions.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) BILL 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974 to prohibit the use of specific air guns for hunting. The primary objective is to save wildlife from extinction by banning PCP, CO2, and silenced air guns.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 5 of the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974. Specifically, it omits the word 'and' in clause (b) of subsection (3) and inserts a new clause regarding the Secretary to the Government, Mines and Minerals Department.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974 by modifying section 9. Specifically, it inserts a reference to PCP air guns, CO2 air guns, or silenced air guns into the definition of prohibited means.

metadata.title: The University of Faisalabad (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002 to incorporate references to the Punjab Higher Education Commission and update faculty listings. It specifically revises sections regarding definitions, teaching methods, governance composition, and the university schedule.

metadata.title: The Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Privatization Board to manage a competitive, fair, and transparent process for privatizing government properties. It provides mechanisms for resolving disputes related to privatization and outlines the board's composition, functions, and administrative procedures.

name: PUNJAB GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND (AMENDMENT) BILL 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009 to enhance the investment limit for the Punjab Pension Fund Management Committee. Specifically, it substitutes the phrase 'more than seventy-five' with 'up to one hundred' in section 9 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pension Fund (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pension Fund Act, 2007 to enhance the investment limit for the Punjab Pension Fund Management Committee. Specifically, it substitutes the phrase 'more than seventy-five' with 'up to one hundred' in section 15 of the original Act.

name: PUNJAB PROBATION AND PAROLE SERVICE ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Probation and Parole Service Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Probation and Parole Service to assess and manage offenders on probation or parole. It aims to improve coordination within the criminal justice system by defining the service's structure, functions, and responsibilities.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED INSTITUTIONS (MADAARIS AND SCHOOLS) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Madaaris and Schools Management Board to manage seized and frozen educational institutions in Punjab. It provides for the constitution of the Board, its powers, financial management, and transitional provisions for employees.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce electronic processing for driving license applications and medical certificates. It establishes a centralized Driving License Information Management System and updates provisions regarding photographs, signatures, and biometric impressions.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to introduce provisions for rewarding whistleblowers and officials who report tax evasion, fraud, or corruption. It establishes procedures for sanctioning rewards from penalties imposed on offenders and defines specific conditions under which reward claims may be rejected.

metadata.title: The Partition Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to partition suits in the Punjab. It grants courts the power to order the sale of property instead of division when division is not reasonably possible, and establishes procedures for shareholders to buy out shares or bid at sales.

name: PUNJAB PARTITION OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Partition of Immovable Property (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Partition of Immovable Property Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Partition of Immovable Property Act, 2012. Specifically, it omits subsection (3) of section 9 from the original 2012 Act and comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pension Fund (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Pension Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pension Fund Act, 2007 by inserting new definitions and substituting various sections regarding qualifications for members and the General Manager. It also modifies provisions related to the Reserve Fund, investment restrictions, and budget preparation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pension Fund (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pension Fund Act, 2007 by substituting specific words in section 15. The amendment changes the limit from 'more than seventy-five' to 'up to one hundred' within clause (c) of that section.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act 2015
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 by inserting a new section regarding penalties for overcharging passenger fares. It establishes specific fines and sanctions, such as vehicle impounding or suspension of route permits, for repeated violations of approved fare structures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 (XIX of 2023), The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 (I of 2024)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to introduce a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and modify provisions regarding retirement eligibility. It also repeals two previous Ordinances related to civil servant amendments.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to address issues regarding fare overcharging. It introduces a new section, 112-B, which prescribes specific fines and penalties, including vehicle impounding or suspension of route permits, for drivers who charge passengers more than the approved fares.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Arms Ordinance, 1965 by substituting a new section on offences and penalties related to arms and ammunition. It categorizes weapons into prohibited and non-prohibited bore types and specifies imprisonment terms and fines for various violations.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by inserting specific phrases regarding later dates determined by government notification into sections 3 and 12. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016.

name: THE PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to allow for later dates determined by notification in specific sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to extend the period for claiming a 5% rebate from September 30 to October 31. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by adding a new clause to Section 16. The amendment authorizes the sealing of non-residential immovable properties until unpaid tax amounts are fully paid or recovered.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by changing specific dates in sections 3 and 12 from September 30th to November 30th. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB ENFORCEMENT OF WOMEN'S PROPERTY RIGHTS ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Ordinance, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to protect and secure the ownership rights of women against harassment, coercion, force, or fraud. It establishes a mechanism for women deprived of property to file complaints with an Ombudsperson when no court proceedings are pending, enabling summary enquiries and orders for the restoration of possession or title.

metadata.title: The Hindu Disposition of Property (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916 to apply specific provisions to the Punjab region. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' and 'the Province' with 'the Punjab' and defines 'Government' as the Government of the Punjab.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 2005

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act of 1958. Specifically, it substitutes clause (i) in section 4 of the said Act regarding residential houses measuring up to five marlas.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) BILL 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to introduce provisions for sealing non-residential immovable properties. The amendment allows such properties to be sealed until any unpaid amounts due against them are paid or recovered in full.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Sixth Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to empower local governments to sell immovable properties after obtaining prior government approval and conducting a public auction. It also grants authority for leasing and transferring movable properties through similar prescribed procedures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to empower local governments to sell immovable property after obtaining prior approval from the Government. It specifically allows for the sale of such properties through public auction while granting occupants a right of refusal upon payment of outstanding dues.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012 to exclude Ghazi Khan Medical College from the university's purview. It also provides options for government employees regarding absorption or deputation and transfers specific property rights to the university.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903 by substituting specific sections and updating terminology. It replaces references to 'Provincial Government' with 'Government' and redefines key terms such as 'immovable property', 'Collector', and 'ward'. The legislation also grants the Board of Revenue power to make rules for carrying out the purposes of the Act.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to establish an Urban Transport Company in notified areas. It grants the Company powers to plan routes, operate services, maintain infrastructure, and fix fares, while restricting other authorities from issuing permits or exercising specific functions on those routes.

metadata.title: The Whipping (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Whipping Act, 1909 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes and omits certain sections while adding new clauses that define specific offences punishable by whipping in lieu of or addition to other punishments.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 as it applies to West Pakistan. It inserts a new section allowing the provincial government to dissolve a society's governing body and reorganize it under specific conditions.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to require the registration of Deeni Madrassahs as societies. It imposes specific conditions on these institutions, including annual reporting, account maintenance, and audits, while prohibiting the teaching or publication of literature promoting militancy or sectarian hatred.

metadata.title: The Lahore Ring Road Authority (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011 to extend the scope of the Authority to the entire Province of Punjab. It also updates the long title and preamble to reflect the establishment of the Punjab Ring Road Authority for planning, designing, development, management, operation, and maintenance of ring roads, strategic roads, and economic corridors.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to update definitions and provisions relevant to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to 'Provincial Government' with 'Government', changes jurisdictional terms from 'Pakistan' to 'the Punjab', and updates various fee structures and entity definitions.

metadata.title: The Dourine Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of the spread of dourine among horses in Pakistan. It establishes a framework for the registration, inspection, and segregation of affected horses, including powers for inspectors and veterinary practitioners to manage infected animals.

name: PUNJAB TRANSFUSION OF SAFE BLOOD ORDINANCE 1999

metadata.title: The Punjab Transfusion of Safe Blood Ordinance, 1999
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Transfusion of Safe Blood Ordinance, 1999 (XVI of 1999)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the transfusion of safe and healthy blood products free from viruses and infective agents. It establishes the Punjab Blood Transfusion Authority to register blood banks, issue licenses, and ensure adherence to bio-safety measures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Trusts Act, 2020 to update definitions and registration requirements for various types of trusts. It specifically introduces provisions for specialized trusts, such as pension funds and real estate investment trusts, requiring No Objection Certificates from relevant regulators for registration.

name: PUNJAB HOLY QURAN (PRINTING AND RECORDING) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011 to update provisions regarding the registration of publishers and recording companies. It establishes a Special Cell for enforcement, defines penalties for disrespecting the Holy Quran in media, and outlines procedures for the disposal of damaged copies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to provide for the mode of election to Village and Neighbourhood Councils. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Travel Agencies (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Travel Agencies Act, 1976 to adapt it to the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010 and address ancillary matters. It substitutes specific words in the long title and preamble, restricts the Act's extension to the Punjab, and modifies definitions regarding controllers, government bodies, and tourists.

metadata.title: Punjab Travel Agencies (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Travel Agencies Act, 1976 to adapt it to the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010 and for ancillary matters. It substitutes specific sections of the original Act to limit its scope to the Punjab, redefine terms like 'Government' and 'tourist', establish a regulatory committee, and introduce new provisions regarding licensing, powers of the Controller, penalties, and indemnity.

metadata.title: The Specific Relief (Amendment) Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Specific Relief Act, 1877 by substituting references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' and replacing 'Indian' or 'Federal' terms with local equivalents. It also updates geographical references from Karachi to Lahore and changes 'ship' to 'aeroplane' within specific illustrations of the original act.

metadata.title: The Apprenticeship Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the promotion, development, and regulation of systematic apprenticeship programmes in industries. It aims to secure minimum standards of skill by defining roles for employers, apprentices, and competent authorities.

metadata.title: The Charitable and Religious Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920 to update its short title and commencement provisions. It substitutes specific sections in the original 1920 Act regarding territorial extension and interpretation of terms like 'Court' and 'Government' within the Punjab.

name: FATIMA JINNAH MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore Act 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore Act 2015 to enhance the upper age limit for the post of Vice Chancellor from sixty-one to sixty-five years. It also revises the eligibility criteria for the Vice Chancellor position, including requirements for additional qualifications, teaching experience, and a minimum of eight quality research publications.

name: FATIMA JINNAH MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore Act, 2015 to increase the upper age limit for the Vice Chancellor post from sixty-one to sixty-five. It also revises the eligibility criteria for the position, requiring specific qualifications, experience in teaching and administration, a minimum of eight quality research publications, and professorial status.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPLANTATION OF HUMAN ORGANS AND TISSUES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010 to replace references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab. It also updates specific sections regarding jurisdiction, definitions, and the composition of the Monitoring Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Revenue Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Revenue Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of sales tax on services by the Punjab Revenue Authority. It amends the Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012 to define members, insert functions for the Chairperson before the Authority is constituted, and add a validation clause for past actions.

name: THE PUNJAB REVENUE AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Revenue Authority (Second Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012 to rationalize the composition of the Appellate Tribunal and validate the establishment of the Authority. It includes specific textual changes to sections 5, 18, and 36 of the parent Act regarding office formations, appointment conditions for accountant members, and the deemed date of establishment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Revenue Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of sales tax on services by the Punjab Revenue Authority. It amends the Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012 to substitute definitions in section 2, insert a new subsection regarding the Chairperson's functions before the Authority is constituted, and add a validation clause for past actions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Revenue Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 8 of the Punjab Board of Revenue Act, 1957 by adding new subsections regarding review applications. It specifies that review applications should be filed before the same Member or Full Board that passed the original order and prohibits subsequent review applications after the first one is finally disposed of.

name: THE PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to align it with the Elections Act, 2017. It introduces new sections regarding the application of election provisions, delimitation powers for the Election Commission, and modifies definitions within the parent Act.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to mandate security featured number plates and compulsory registration for vehicles kept in the province. It also introduces provisions for personalized licence plates, penalties for counterfeiting, and procedures for re-registration of vehicles brought from other parts of Pakistan.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2014 to update provisions regarding the Chairperson's remuneration and member appointments. It specifically substitutes sections 4 and 5 of the original Act to define full-time status for the Chairperson and establish age limits and experience requirements for appointed members.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 to update various sections regarding definitions, tax limits, and officer designations. It specifically substitutes terms like 'Assistant Commissioner' with 'Enforcement Officer/Audit Officer' and introduces provisions for framing regulations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Services Board (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970. It substitutes the word 'Governor' with 'Chief Minister' in section 4, subsection (2) of the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 by inserting a new section 22C. The inserted provision allows the Government to appoint persons holding federal posts prior to the 2010 Constitution Amendment to provincial civil services and determines their terms, conditions, cadre, and seniority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to align it with the Elections Act, 2017. It provides for ancillary purposes related to local government elections and administrative functions within the province of Punjab.

metadata.title: Punjab Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Workers Welfare Fund Act 2019 to substitute references to the 'Authority' with the 'Institution' established under the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965. It further modifies provisions regarding collection charges, appellate tribunal transfers, recovery of arrears, and the purchase of essential commodities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to align it with the Elections Act, 2017. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 to define the powers, immunities, and privileges of the Assembly, its committees, and members. It introduces new definitions for terms such as 'Chamber' and 'Committee', inserts provisions regarding the power to detain persons breaching privileges, and substitutes sections related to the preamble and specific articles of the Constitution.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF WOMEN AGAINST VIOLENCE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence Act, 2016 to update terminology and definitions regarding domestic violence and protection authorities. It substitutes references to the 'Government' with the 'Punjab Women Protection Authority' in various sections and inserts new clauses concerning the declaration of existing facilities as protection centres.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Second Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to introduce definitions for beneficial owners and prescribe information reporting requirements. It establishes new sections regarding the provision of information to the Registrar and authorities under the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010.

name: SIND CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to extend its application from the Province of Sind to the whole of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific sections and omits references to 'Sind' in favor of broader provincial designations or relevant laws.

metadata.title: The Forman Christian College Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Forman Christian College Lahore Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forman Christian College Lahore Act, 2004 to facilitate the institution's ability to obtain foreign accreditation. It introduces various changes to definitions, examination powers, honorary degree procedures, inspection committees, and the composition of the Board.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by substituting text in section 28, omitting sections 30-B and part of section 182, and modifying the First Schedule. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 31, 2011, and received assent from the Governor on April 9, 2011.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, TAXILA (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.title: The University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila (Amendment) Act 2004
metadata.amends: The University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila Act, 1994 by adding a new sub-section to section 9. The amendment stipulates that the Chancellor must act and be bound in the same manner as the Governor of a Province under Article 105 of the Constitution.

name: PUNJAB TIANJIN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018 to add provisions regarding employee repatriation and update the scope of study fields. Specifically, it grants transferred employees a one-time option for repatriation to their parent departments and inserts engineering, sciences, management, and related fields into the university's scope.

name: MIR CHAKAR KHAN RIND UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2019 to address specific provisions regarding university employees and academic fields. It adds a clause allowing transferred employees a one-time option for repatriation to their original service and expands the scope of study in Section 4 to include engineering, sciences, management, and related fields.

name: PUNJAB UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY RASUL (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab University of Technology Rasul (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab University of Technology Rasul Act 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab University of Technology Rasul Act 2018 to update the institution's name and scope. It specifically adds provisions for employee repatriation options and expands the fields of study included in the university's mandate.

metadata.title: The NUR International University Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The NUR International University Lahore Act 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the NUR International University Lahore Act 2015 to add the faculty of allied health sciences. It also inserts a new validation section and modifies specific clauses within the original Act's schedule.

name: PUNJAB BOILERS AND PRESSURE VESSELS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002 to further regulate pressure vessels and related matters. It introduces changes regarding definitions, inspection procedures, registration timelines, and penalties for non-compliance within the Punjab jurisdiction.

name: PUNJAB BOILERS AND PRESSURE VESSELS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002 to further regulate pressure vessels and related matters. It introduces changes regarding definitions, inspection procedures, registration timelines, and penalties for non-compliance within the Punjab jurisdiction.

metadata.title: The Anti-Terrorism (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997 to establish procedures for special security cases requiring extraordinary protection. It introduces a designated authority and specific protocols regarding the conduct of trials, including confidentiality measures, secure premises, and the use of virtual proceedings.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to address activities promoting terrorism or prejudicing public safety. It introduces new sections prohibiting the glorification of terrorists, mandating audio/video recording of public meetings, regulating the manufacture and sale of police uniforms, and updating summary trial procedures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Juvenile Smoking (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959 by adding a new section regarding penalties for smoking in educational institutions. It establishes specific fines for first and second offenses and allows for expulsion or higher fines for subsequent offenses.

metadata.title: The Road Transport Workers (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Road Transport Workers Ordinance, 1961 to restrict its application to the Punjab region. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab', defines 'Government' as the Government of the Punjab, and omits references to West Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to regulate axle loads of goods vehicles for public safety and road infrastructure. It introduces penalties for overloading, non-compliance with specifications, and unlicensed bodybuilding workshops, while also establishing procedures for impounding vehicles and issuing licenses.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to regulate axle loads and address overloading issues for public safety. It introduces specific penalties for violations such as overloading trailers, operating unlicensed bodybuilding workshops, and non-compliance with notified specifications.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to make a valid fitness certificate a prerequisite for granting route permits. It inserts a new subsection into section 47 of the Ordinance and substitutes Form-I in the First Schedule with a specific format for transport vehicles.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motion Pictures (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979 to align its provisions with the Government of the Punjab. It specifically substitutes references to the Federal or Provincial Government with 'Government' and changes jurisdictional scope from Pakistan to the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update compensation scales for passengers injured or killed in stage and contract carriages. It substitutes specific sections of the Ordinance to define new monetary amounts payable by permit holders or owners in cases of death, injury, or permanent disability.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965. Specifically, it substitutes a clause in section 49 regarding the security required from applicants for insurance purposes.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ANIMALS SLAUGHTER CONTROL (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It introduces new clauses regarding definitions, prohibits the sale of unmarked meat, and grants powers to veterinary officers to search premises and arrest offenders.

metadata.title: The Public Sector Universities (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: Ordinance XLVIII of 2002; Ordinance XLIX of 2002; Ordinance LXX of 2002; Act VI of 2013; Act VII of 2013; Act VIII of 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws governing certain public sector universities in the Punjab province. It specifically targets Ordinances and Acts from 2002 and 2013 to update titles, preambles, and specific sections regarding various institutions.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to prescribe specific penalties for failing to display security featured or vanity number plates on motor vehicles. It inserts a new entry into the Twelfth Schedule of the Ordinance detailing fine amounts for motorcycles, public service vehicles, and private cars.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to prescribe penalties for failing to display security featured or vanity number plates. It inserts a new entry into the Twelfth Schedule of the Ordinance specifying fine amounts for motorcycles, public service vehicles, and private cars.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to allow owners to apply for personalized vanity plates linked to specific registration marks. It mandates that these plates must be displayed on the motor vehicle and specifies that their material, format, and issuance manner will be prescribed by rules.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update specific clauses regarding vehicle usage. It substitutes new provisions in section 44 concerning school buses, Metrobus operations, and trailers used for non-commercial purposes.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965. It specifically substitutes the Twelfth Schedule of that Ordinance with a new list of violations and corresponding fines for various vehicle types.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to extend the mandatory fitness certificate regime from transport vehicles to motor cars. The legislation introduces a new section requiring certificates of fitness for private vehicles and updates relevant forms and schedules to reflect these changes.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to facilitate the registration and regulation of electric and hybrid vehicles. It introduces specific amendments to various sections of the Ordinance regarding definitions, application procedures, cancellation of transfers based on false information, suspension orders, and updates to the application form.

metadata.title: Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 by inserting a new section regarding fitness certificates for motor cars. It also updates specific forms and adds a Fifteenth Schedule to define validity periods based on vehicle engine capacity.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to facilitate the registration and regulation of electric and hybrid vehicles. It also addresses ancillary matters related to vehicle registration procedures and transfer cancellations.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (First Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to incorporate provisions for an e-traffic management system and the Punjab Safe Cities Authority. It establishes rules for recording traffic violations electronically, issuing e-tickets, and recovering fines through vehicle impoundment and auction if unpaid.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Third Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 24 of the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965. It substitutes new provisions regarding vehicle registration for owners or keepers residing in the Province and allows the Government to impose additional fees.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to regulate Commercial and Private Vehicles for Hire (CVH/PVH) operating through Digital Platforms for Passenger Transportation (DPPT). It introduces new definitions, mandates permits for these vehicles, establishes licensing requirements for Transportation Network Companies (TNCs), and outlines specific prohibitions and responsibilities for drivers and operators.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to include motor cycles in various sections and schedules. It also updates penalty structures for vehicle overloading and modifies requirements regarding fitness certificates.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to allow sixteen-year-olds to drive specific motor cycles with a juvenile permit. It also removes references to 'notified roads' and omits subsection (4) from section 89-B of the Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979 to update definitions and administrative procedures regarding waqf properties. It introduces new clauses for authorities, beneficial owners, and managers while establishing stricter registration timelines and penalties for non-compliance.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF KITE FLYING (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying Ordinance, 2001 to update definitions regarding children and guardians. It also modifies penalties for contraventions, introduces specific provisions for juvenile offenders, and omits certain sections from the original Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Protected Areas (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protected Areas Act, 2020 to incorporate provisions regarding sustainable ecotourism and strengthen conservation measures. It updates definitions, inserts new sections on ecotourism standards, modifies administrative roles, and adjusts penalties for contraventions.

name: LAHORE COLLEGE FOR WOMEN UNIVERSITY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Lahore College for Women University, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Lahore College for Women University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore College for Women University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to clarify the role of the Pro-Chancellor and add new sections regarding their appointment and duties. It specifically designates the Minister for Education of the Government of the Punjab as the Pro-Chancellor and outlines their functions.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY, RAWALPINDI (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Fatima Jinnah Women University, Rawalpindi (Amendment) Act 2004
metadata.amends: The Fatima Jinnah Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Fatima Jinnah Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1999 by adding a new sub-section to section 8. The amendment stipulates that the Chancellor must act and be bound in the same manner as the Governor of a Province under Article 105 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Punjab Women Protection Authority (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Women Protection Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Women Protection Authority Act, 2017 by adding new subsections to section 3. The amendments specify perks and privileges for the Chairperson and establish travelling allowances for members attending Authority meetings.

name: PROTECTION AGAINST HARASSMENT OF WOMEN AT THE WORKPLACE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.amends: The Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act 2010 by adding new subsections to section 7. The amendments specify that the Ombudsperson serves a four-year term without eligibility for extension or re-appointment and establish the procedure for resignation via written notice to the Governor.

metadata.title: The Punjab Women Protection Authority Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Women Protection Authority to create a comprehensive system for protecting women against violence in the Punjab. It defines the Authority's powers to establish protection centers, monitor administration, and provide relief and rehabilitation services.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women (Amendment) Act 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act 2014 by omitting subsection (3) of section 4. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on October 21, 2022.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012 to promote gender inclusivity within the university's administration and faculty. Specifically, it substitutes the term 'woman' with 'person' in certain sections and mandates the inclusion of female principals, lecturers, persons, and experts in various clauses.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012 to promote gender inclusivity within university administration and faculty appointments. It substitutes specific terms regarding women with broader terms or mandates minimum female representation in leadership roles and expert panels.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012 to promote gender inclusivity within university administration and faculty appointments. It substitutes specific terms regarding women with broader terms or mandates for female representation in leadership roles and expert panels.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 to include women from public or private sectors in specific qualifications. It also modifies the appointment terms for members, setting a three-year term with restrictions on reappointment and provisions for chairmanship.

metadata.title: Agricultural Pesticide Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for the registration, manufacture, import, and sale of pesticides in Pakistan. They define terms related to active ingredients and outline requirements for labeling, storage, and safety precautions.

name: CRITERIA FOR FUNDING TO ATTEND WORKSHOPS SEMINARS CONFERENCES

metadata.title: PARB REGULATION (Holding of workshops)
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the eligibility and merit criteria for funding scientific conferences, workshops, and seminars organized by Punjab-based agricultural research or HEC-recognized institutions. It outlines the specific procedures for applying for funds from the PARB budget, including limits on foreign delegate sponsorship and eligible expense categories.

name: CRITERIA FOR FUNDING TO ORGANIZE SCIENTIFIC CONFERENCES

metadata.title: PARB REGULATION (Travel Grant)
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the eligibility, funding, and merit criteria for scientists from public sector agricultural research or educational institutions in Punjab to attend international scientific events. It outlines specific rules regarding airfare, per diem, registration fees, and points awarded based on presentation type and authorship status.

name: DIRECTORATE OF FLORICULTURE (TRAINING & RESEARCH), PUNJAB, LAHORE SERVICES RULES, 1996

metadata.title: The Directorate of Floriculture (Training & Research), Punjab, Lahore Services Rules, 1996
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Directorate of Floriculture (Training & Research) in Lahore and define its structure. They specify the method of recruitment, minimum qualifications, age limits, and promotion criteria for various posts within the department.

name: i. UAF Pay Scales and Allowances Sstatutes 2005

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Employees (Revised Basic Pay Scales, Allowances and Pension) (BS-1-22) Statutes, 2005
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Employees (Revised Basic Pay Scales and Fringe Benefits) Statutes, 2001
metadata.summary: This notification approves the revised statutes for basic pay scales, allowances, and pensions for University of Agriculture Faisalabad employees. It replaces the previous 2001 statutes with new scales effective from July 1, 2005, detailing specific rates for housing, medical, conveyance, and other special allowances.

name: ii. UAF Pay Scales and Allowances Statutes, 2007

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Employees (Revised Basic Pay Scales and Allowances) (BS 1 To 22) Statutes, 2007
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Employees (Revised Basic Pay Scales, Allowances and Pension) (BS-1 to 22) Statutes, 2005
metadata.summary: This document revises the basic pay scales and allowances for existing employees of the University of Agriculture Faisalabad effective July 1, 2007. It establishes new pay scales replacing those from 2005, details fixation methods for current and contract employees, and outlines rules regarding annual increments and frozen dearness allowances.

name: iii. UAF Pay Scales and Allowances Statutes, 2008

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Employees (Revised Basic Pay Scales and Allowances) (BPS-1 to 22) Statutes, 2008
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Employees (Revised Basic Pay Scales and Allowances) (BS-1 to 22) Statutes, 2007
metadata.summary: This notification approves the revised statutes for the University of Agriculture, Faisalabad regarding basic pay scales and allowances for employees BPS-1 to 22. It replaces the 2007 statutes with new scales effective from July 1, 2008, while retaining existing conditions for special allowances and medical benefits.

metadata.title: POSTGRADUATE GPA AND CGPA REGULATIONS
metadata.amends: Statute and Regulations relating to M.Sc. (Hons.) M.Phil./MS
metadata.summary: This document outlines the regulations for calculating Grade Point Average (GPA) and Cumulative GPA (CGPA) across various postgraduate programs including Master of Arts, Master of Science, and Doctor of Philosophy. It establishes specific grade thresholds required to remain on roll, qualify for degree awards, and allows for limited course repetition under certain conditions.

name: PROCEDURE FOR FUNDING OF CGS PROJECTS BY PARB

metadata.title: PARB REGULATION ( Funding Procedure)
metadata.summary: This notification outlines the procedure for funding research projects by the Punjab Agricultural Research Board (PARB). It details the process from identifying priority areas and soliciting proposals to the technical review by Working Groups and final approval by the Board. The document also specifies financial rules, including fund releases, contract signing, payment of honoraria, and administrative powers regarding project modification or termination.

name: Punjab Agricultural Development & Supplies Corporation Employees Gratuity Regulations 1980

metadata.title: PAD&SC Employees Gratuity Regulations
metadata.summary: These regulations provide a lump-sum grant in lieu of pension for employees of the Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation holding non-pensionable posts. Eligibility is granted to those with 10 years of qualifying service or specific eventualities such as death after more than 5 years of service.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT & SUPPLIES CORPORATION EMPLOYEES SERVICE RULES 1982

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Development & Supplies Corporation Employees Service Rules, 1982
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation Regulations, 1977
metadata.summary: These Rules establish the service conditions for employees of the Punjab Agricultural Development & Supplies Corporation. They define terms related to appointments, pay, duties, and classification of posts while specifying that they do not apply to deputations or contract-based personnel.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (MARKET COMMITTEES PROVINCIAL FUND) RULES, 1980

metadata.title: Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets (Market Committees Provincial Fund) Rules, 1980
metadata.summary: These rules establish a Board to manage the Market Committee Provincial Fund under the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 1978. The document defines the Board's composition, outlines its powers and functions regarding market development, and sets guidelines for fund contributions and auditing.

metadata.title: Punjab Agricultural Research Board Rules 2009
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Government of the Punjab under section 12 of the Punjab Agricultural Research Board Act, 1997. They establish the composition of the Board and its committees, define key terms, and outline the functions and powers of the Board regarding agricultural research promotion and management.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH BOARD SERVICE RULES 2009

metadata.title: Punjab Agricultural Research Board Service Rules 2009
metadata.summary: These rules establish the service framework for the Punjab Agricultural Research Board, including post nomenclature and recruitment procedures. They also define performance evaluation methods, compensatory leave eligibility, and gratuity benefits for different categories of employees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets (General) Rules, 1979
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under Section 35 of the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 1978. They establish regulations for market committees, including definitions, licensing procedures, fee structures, and the constitution of boards of arbitrators.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE DEPARTMENT, DIRECTORATE OF AGRICULTURE INFORMATION SERVICE RULES, 2007

metadata.title: Punjab Agriculture Department, Directorate of Agriculture Information Service Rules, 2007
metadata.repeals: Punjab Directorate of Agriculture Information Service Rules, 1998
metadata.summary: These rules establish the method of recruitment, minimum qualifications, age limits, and other matters related to posts within the Punjab Agriculture Department's Directorate of Agriculture Information Service. They also specify the conditions for promotion and initial recruitment for various functional units.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE DEPARTMENT, DIRECTORATE OF AGRICULTURE INFORMATION SERVICE RULES, 2007

metadata.title: Punjab Agriculture Department, Directorate of Agriculture Information Service Rules, 2007
