It establishes merit-based criteria for transferring teaching and allied staff based on factors such as service in far-flung areas, wedlock, compassionate grounds, and disability. The policy also outlines specific categories where transfers are not banned and details the procedural requirements for requesting transfers via an e-portal.

name: PUNJAB HEALTHCARE COMMISSION HUMAN RESOURCE REGULATIONS, 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Healthcare Commission Human Resource Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for human resource management within the Punjab Healthcare Commission. They cover various aspects including employment contracts, appointment processes, employee benefits, leave policies, and disciplinary procedures.

metadata.title: Agricultural Pesticide Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for the registration, manufacture, import, and sale of pesticides in Pakistan. They define terms related to active ingredients and outline requirements for labeling, storage, and safety precautions.

metadata.title: Environmental Samples Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to regulate the authorization of persons for entry and inspection. They establish detailed procedures for taking environmental samples, their dispatch, analysis, and the evidentiary value of laboratory certificates.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE DEPARTMENT (DEVELOPMENT OF DIGITIZED PROFILE OF LAND FOR AGRICULTURE) SERVICE RULES 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Agriculture Department (Development of Digitized Profile of Land for Agriculture) Service Rules 2016
metadata.summary: These rules establish the method of recruitment, minimum qualifications, and age limits for specific posts within the Agriculture Department's functional unit. They were made by the Governor of the Punjab under powers conferred by section 23 of the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974.

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton Control Rules, 1966
metadata.amends: The Punjab Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966; The Punjab Cotton Control Rules, 1949; The Bahawalpur Cotton Control Rules, 1949; Sindh Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Rules 1934
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of Punjab to regulate cotton industries, including ginning and pressing factories, within the province. They establish the Punjab Cotton Control Board, define key terms related to cotton cultivation and trade, and set procedures for licensing, fees, and price regulation.

metadata.title: The Cotton Industry (Statistics) Rules, 1926
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the forms and procedures for submitting statistical returns regarding cotton goods and yarn manufactured in mills. They mandate the maintenance of specific daily registers on mill premises to record descriptions, weights, and quantities of production.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Rules, 1958
metadata.repeals: Bombay (District) Tobacco Act, 1933; Punjab Tobacco Vend Fees Act, 1934; North West Frontier Province Tobacco Vend Fees Act, 1938; Baluchistan Tobacco Vend Fees Regulation, 1942
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for dealer's licenses and associated vend fees under the West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958. They specify fee amounts based on the number of assistants or employees at the premises and define conditions for license issuance and cancellation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties (Litigation) Rules, 1983
metadata.repeals: Government of West Pakistan, Auqaf Department, Notification No. 1(6)-Auqaf-6, dated 14th March, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules empower the Administrator of Auqaf in Punjab to initiate, defend, or compromise legal proceedings regarding Waqf properties. They outline procedures for obtaining court documents, deciding on defense strategies, and engaging counsel for suits filed against or by the Chief Administrator.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties (Accounts) Rules, 1982
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the maintenance of registers for immovable and movable waqf properties, including procedures for recording receipts and valuables. They also establish protocols for bank deposits, payments via cheques or advances, expenditure on establishment, and the conduct of audits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties (Administration) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules provide the framework for the administration and management of waqf properties in Punjab. They establish procedures for appointing managers, creating schemes for property use, forming religious purposes committees, and regulating leases.

name: CHOLISTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (DELEGATION OF POWERS) RULES 1995

metadata.title: Cholistan Development Authority (Delegation of Powers) Rules 1995
metadata.summary: These Rules delegate powers to the Cholistan Development Authority regarding the imposition of penalties on its employees. They specify which authority is competent to award punishments such as suspension, reduction in rank, or dismissal for various posts within the organization.

metadata.title: The Cholistan Development Authority Financial Rules, 1993
metadata.summary: These rules define the financial regulations and delegated powers for the Cholistan Development Authority in Bahawalpur. They outline specific authorities granted to the Managing Director regarding contracts, purchases, refunds, and expenditure sanctions within budget provisions.

name: Federal Government Land Reforms (Payment of Compensation) Rules, 1981

metadata.title: The Federal Government Land Reforms (Payment of Compensation) Rules, 1981
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Federal Government to carry out the purposes of sections 11, 12, and 13 of the Land Reforms Act, 1977. They establish procedures for determining compensation, issuing bonds through the State Bank of Pakistan, and managing the payment of interest and principal to recipients.

name: NOTIFICATION REGARDING PUNJAB SALES TAX SPECIAL PROCEDURE (TRANSPORTATION OR CARRIAGE OF PETROLEUM OILS THROUGH OIL TANKERS) RULES 2018

metadata.title: Punjab Sales Tax Special Procedure (Transportation or Carriage of Petroleum Oils through Oil Tankers) Rules 2018
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the special procedure for levying sales tax on inter-city transportation or carriage of petroleum oils by road through oil tankers in Punjab. They define key terms, set the tax rate at fifteen percent, and establish mechanisms for issuing invoices, withholding tax payments, and filing returns.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards Rules, 1904
metadata.summary: These rules empower the Financial Commissioner of the Punjab to establish schemes for managing the property and guardianship of wards under the Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903. They outline specific procedures for appointing guardians, managing estate assets, conducting legal suits, and publishing necessary notices regarding ward estates.

metadata.title: Punjab e-Stamp Rules 2016
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of the Punjab under section 74 of the Stamp Act, 1899 to regulate the e-stamping system. They define key terms such as 'agency', 'Board', and 'competent authority' and outline the specific functions and duties of the agency responsible for maintaining the software infrastructure and data records.

name: PUNJAB IRRIGATION AND POWER DEPARTMENT LAND IMPROVEMENT TAX RULES, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Irrigation and Power Department Lands Improvement Tax Rules, 1977
metadata.summary: These rules frame the procedure for levying and recovering Land Improvement Tax in the Punjab. They define key terms, specify tax rates, outline the process for issuing demand statements, and establish mechanisms for filing objections to such demands.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Acquisition Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules govern the procedure for acquiring land in Punjab under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894. They outline the responsibilities of the Collector and Commissioner regarding applications, feasibility examinations, notifications, surveys, and the handling of objections.

name: Punjab Land Reforms (Procedure for Ejectment Suits) Rules, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Reforms (Procedure for Ejectment Suits) Rules, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Land Reforms (Procedure for Ejectment Suits) Rules, 1974
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for ejectment suits filed by landlords against tenants in Punjab and the Islamabad Capital Territory. They specify requirements for filing plaints, serving notices, conducting inquiries, and executing orders, including restrictions on the timing of ejectments and entitlement to compensation.

name: Punjab Land Reforms (Procedure for Grant of Land) Rules, 1978

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Reforms (Procedure for Grant of Land) Rules, 1978
metadata.summary: These rules establish the specific procedures for granting land to tenants in the Punjab Province and Islamabad Capital Territory under the Land Reforms Act, 1977. They define eligibility criteria, application forms, verification processes by Sub-Assistant Land Commissioners, and the scale of area to be granted free of charge.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Reforms Rules, 1972
metadata.amends: The Punjab Land Reforms Regulation, 1972 (Martial Law Regulation No. 115 of 1972)
metadata.repeals: Punjab Land Commission's Notification No. DSH-595/72/1857-LC (II), dated 23rd May, 1972
metadata.summary: These Rules are made by the Land Commission of the Punjab to exercise powers under the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972. They supersede a previous notification and establish preliminary provisions, definitions, and the powers of the Chief Land Commissioner regarding case transfers and general control.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Reforms Rules, 1977
metadata.summary: These Rules are made by the Punjab Land Commission under Section 21 of the Land Reforms Act, 1977. They define key terms, outline the powers of the Chief Land Commissioner and other officers regarding case transfers and inquiries, and establish procedures for appeals, reviews, and revisions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue Rules, 1968
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for revenue officers regarding statements, pleadings, and the conduct of mutation proceedings. They also establish regulations for village headmen (Lambardars), including their appointment, duties, and dismissal, as well as rules for crop inspection, land survey, and the collection of land revenue.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATIZATION BOARD MINISTERIAL SERVICE REGULATIONS, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Privatization Board Ministerial Service Regulations, 2012
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the method of recruitment, minimum qualifications, age limits, and other matters related to posts within the Punjab Privatization Board. They come into force immediately upon notification.

metadata.title: The Punjab Privatization Board Process / Procedure (Terms & Conditions) for Auction of Government Properties Regulations, 2013
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the process and procedure for the auction of government properties under the Punjab Privatization Board. They define key terms, outline committee structures, and specify methods for property identification, due diligence, valuation, and bidding.

name: THE PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX RULES, 1997

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Rules, 1997
metadata.summary: These rules provide the procedure for assessing and collecting agricultural income tax in Punjab, specifically for owners holding land in a single patwar circle. They outline the roles of local officials like Mahal patwaris and Collectors in preparing statements, verifying data, and issuing demand notices for advance and final tax payments.

name: THE PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX RULES, 2001

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under section 11 of the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 to regulate agricultural income tax procedures. They establish requirements for maintaining accounts, filing returns of total agricultural income, and methods for assessing and collecting tax.

name: THE WEST PAKISTAN BOARD OF REVENUE (CONDUCT OF APPEALS AND REVISIONS) RULES, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue (Conduct of Appeals and Revisions) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for presenting appeals and applications for revision to the West Pakistan Board of Revenue. They also outline the conditions under which the execution of orders or decrees may be stayed, including specific provisions for urgent petitions.

name: West Pakistan Land Reforms (Payment of Compensation) Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Reforms (Payment of Compensation) Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the West Pakistan Land Commission to facilitate the payment of compensation for land resumed under specific martial law regulations. They establish procedures for issuing, transferring, and renewing bonds, as well as determining titles and managing payments of interest and principal.

name: PUNJAB COOPERATIVES BOARD FOR LIQUIDATION (APPOINTMENT OF CHAIRMAN) RULES 2011

metadata.title: Punjab Cooperatives Board for Liquidation (Appointment of Chairman) Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules establish the qualifications, age limits, tenure, and pay conditions for appointing a Chairman to the Punjab Cooperatives Board for Liquidation. They also outline the procedures for selection via direct recruitment or re-employment, as well as the terms for termination of the Chairman's services.

name: THE PCBL SOCIAL SECTOR DEVELOPMENT FUND RULES 2009

metadata.title: PCBL Social Sector Development Fund Rules 2009
metadata.summary: These rules establish the PCBL Social Sector Development Fund under the Punjab Cooperative Board for Liquidation. The fund is created to support social sector development projects in the Punjab using surplus assets, with control and management vested in the Board.

name: NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY AUTHORITY (FEES) RULES, 2002

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Fees) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules establish the fees payable by licensees for generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power in Pakistan. They specify the calculation methods for annual fees based on capacity or energy volume and outline the terms and timing for payment.

name: NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY AUTHORITY ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR CONSUMERS OF DISTRIBUTION COMPANIES 2003

metadata.title: NEPRA Consumer Eligibility Criteria
metadata.summary: This notification lays down eligibility criteria for consumers of distribution companies in Pakistan. It establishes the rights and requirements for applicants seeking electric power service within a licensee's territory, including application procedures, financial deposits, and technical compliance.

name: NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY AUTHORITY FINES RULE 2002

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Fines) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules empower the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority to impose financial penalties on delinquents for violations of the Act or applicable documents. The document outlines the definitions of key terms, the maximum fine amounts, and the specific procedural steps for investigating violations, admitting guilt, and recovering dues.

name: NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY AUTHORITY GENERATION RULE 2002

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Generation) Rules, 2000
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for granting licenses to entities engaged in the generation of electric power in Pakistan. They define key terms related to generation business, ancillary services, and grid operations while outlining obligations regarding fees, tariffs, and compliance with applicable codes.

name: NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY AUTHORITY LICENSING (DISTRIBUTION) RULES, 1999

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Distribution) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for licensing and regulating the distribution of electric power in Pakistan. They define key terms related to distribution systems, consumer eligibility, and financial obligations while outlining the powers of the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority.

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Application & Modification Procedure) Regulations, 1999
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedure for applying to the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) for licenses related to generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power. They specify the required documents, application fees, and technical details that must be submitted along with an application.

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity Duty Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under Section 17 of the Punjab Finance Act, 1964 to regulate electricity duty. They establish definitions for terms like 'assessed amount' and 'self use', mandate registration for licensees, and set requirements for energy meter installation, testing, and reading.

name: PUNJAB ESTABLISHMENT & POWERS OF OFFICE OF INSPECTION ORDER 2005

metadata.title: The Punjab (Establishment and Powers of Office of Inspection) Order, 2005
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Office of Inspection and defines its powers to handle complaints regarding metering, billing, and tariff collection under the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. It outlines the procedures for filing complaints, conducting investigations, issuing notices, and enforcing penalties against violators.

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Tariff Standards and Procedure) Rules, 1998
metadata.summary: These rules establish the tariff standards and procedural framework for the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority. They define key terms related to petitions, hearings, and evidence while outlining the specific steps for filing applications regarding electric power generation, transmission, and distribution tariffs.

name: نیشنل الیکٹرک پاور ریگولیٹری اتھارٹی تقسیم کار کمپنیوں کے صارفین کےلیے معیارِ ِاہلیت ، 2003

metadata.title: The Arbitration Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This document outlines the provisions for arbitration and dispute resolution mechanisms under Pakistani law. It details the procedures for appointing arbitrators, conducting hearings, and enforcing arbitral awards.

metadata.title: National Environmental Quality Standards (Certification of Environmental Laboratories) Regulations, 2000
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for certifying laboratories as environmental laboratories in Pakistan. They define the functions of such labs, set out criteria for certification including location and equipment requirements, and outline the application and scrutiny process managed by a Committee.

metadata.title: Environmental Samples Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to regulate the authorization of persons for entry and inspection. They establish detailed procedures for taking environmental samples, their dispatch, analysis, and the evidentiary value of laboratory certificates.

metadata.title: The Environmental Tribunal Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Environmental Tribunal, including definitions, terms of office, qualifications for members, and salary structures. They also outline procedures regarding resignations, removals, and the application of specific codes to the tribunal's proceedings.

metadata.title: Hospital Waste Management Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the proper management of hospital waste generated by healthcare facilities in Pakistan. They define various types of waste, assign responsibilities to specific roles within a hospital, and outline procedures for segregation, collection, transportation, storage, and disposal.

metadata.title: Pakistan Biosafety Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Pakistan Biosafety Committee and define terms related to biotechnology. They regulate the manufacture, import, storage, and release of genetically modified organisms for research and commercial purposes.

metadata.title: The Plastic Management Strategy, Punjab
metadata.summary: This notification approves the Plastic Management Strategy for the Punjab province under the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997. The document outlines aims and objectives to address plastic pollution, which causes significant environmental harm, air pollution from burning, and public health risks through food chain contamination.

metadata.title: The Provincial Sustainable Development Fund (Utilization) Rules, 2003
metadata.summary: These rules outline the procedures for filing, appraising, and sanctioning project proposals for financial assistance from the Provincial Sustainable Development Fund. They establish criteria for eligibility, including requirements for proponent contribution and specific priorities for environmental mitigation projects.

name: PROVINCIAL SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT FUND BOARD (PROCEDURE) RULES, 2001

metadata.title: The Provincial Sustainable Development Fund Board (Procedure) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedural framework for the Provincial Sustainable Development Fund Board, including definitions, meeting schedules, and quorum requirements. They also outline the process for setting agendas, making decisions by consensus or majority vote, forming committees, and granting allowances to members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Bio-safety Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules establish a Bio-safety Committee to regulate the manufacture, import, storage, and release of genetically modified organisms in Punjab. They define key terms related to biotechnology and outline the committee's functions regarding risk assessment, licensing, and banning harmful organisms.

metadata.title: Punjab Clean Air Policy
metadata.summary: This document is a policy notification issued by the Environment Protection Department of the Government of the Punjab on April 17, 2023. It outlines a comprehensive strategy to address air pollution challenges in the province, including problem definition, administrative measures, and implementation mechanisms.

metadata.title: Punjab Environmental Protection (Administrative Penalty) Rules 2013
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of the Punjab under Section 31 of the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to establish a framework for imposing administrative penalties. They define key terms, outline procedures for issuing show cause notices and payment notices, and specify minimum penalty amounts based on the nature and duration of contraventions.

metadata.title: Punjab Environmental Protection (Motor Vehicles) Rules 2013
metadata.summary: These Rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under Section 31 of the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to regulate motor vehicles regarding air pollutants and noise emissions. They establish procedures for authorized officers to inspect vehicles, issue directions for compliance, retain documents, and impound non-compliant vehicles.

metadata.title: PUNJAB ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION (POULTRY) REGULATIONS 2013
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for environmental approval of poultry projects in Punjab, including definitions and committee structures. They outline procedures for submitting applications, processing reviews, and making decisions regarding environmental impact assessments.

name: PUNJAB ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION (PRODUCTION AND CONSUMPTION OF SINGLE-USE PLASTIC PRODUCT) REGULATIONS 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection (Production and Consumption of Single-Use Plastic Product) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish a framework for the production, consumption, and distribution of single-use plastic products in Punjab. They define key terms such as producers, consumers, and recyclers, while prohibiting the engagement with banned single-use plastics without a specific license.

name: PUNJAB ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION (SMOG PREVENTION AND CONTROL) RULES 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection (Smog Prevention and Control) Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish standard operating requirements for brick kilns, industrial units, resource recovery units, and tyre pyrolysis plants to prevent smog. They also define terms related to pollution sources like stubble burning and substandard fuels, while outlining administrative penalties and preventive measures.

metadata.title: Punjab Environmental Tribunal Rules 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Environmental Tribunal under the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997. They define the qualifications for Chairpersons and members, specify their terms of office and salary privileges, and outline operational procedures regarding benches, case transfers, and staff.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION ON MANUFACTURE, SALE, USE AND IMPORT OF POLYTHENE BAGS (BLACK OR ANY OTHER POLYTHENE BAG BELOW FIFTEEN MICRON THICKNESS) RULES, 2004

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition on Manufacture, Sale, Use and Import of Polythene Bags (Black or any other Polythene Bag below fifteen micron thickness) Rules, 2004
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under the authority of the Punjab Prohibition on Manufacture, Sale, Use and Import of Polythene Bags Ordinance, 2002. They establish procedures for formal investigations, sampling, inspections, sealing of premises, and prosecution regarding the manufacture, sale, use, or import of black polythene bags or any other polythene bag below fifteen micron thickness.

name: REVIEW OF IEE AND EIA REGULATIONS, 2000

metadata.title: Pakistan Environmental Protection Agency Review of Initial Environmental Examination and Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations, 2000
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Pakistan Environmental Protection Agency to review Initial Environmental Examinations (IEE) and Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA). They outline requirements for project proponents regarding filing procedures, fees, public hearings, and the conditions necessary for obtaining approval.

name: SELF-MONITORING AND REPORTING BY INDUSTRY RULE, 2001

metadata.title: National Environmental Quality Standards (Self-Monitoring and Reporting by Industry) Rule, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for self-monitoring and reporting by industrial units in Pakistan regarding liquid effluents and gaseous emissions. They classify industries into categories A, B, C, or Special Industry based on pollution levels and mandate specific reporting frequencies and parameters for each category.

name: THE POLLUTION CHARGE FOR INDUSTRY (CALCULATION AND COLLECTION) RULES, 2001

metadata.title: The Pollution Charge for Industry (Calculation and Collection) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules establish the mechanism for calculating and collecting pollution charges from industrial units in Pakistan. They define responsibilities for reporting, payment procedures, and the composition of inspection teams responsible for determining pollution levels.

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection (BTS) Regulations, 2012
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the initial environmental examination (IEE) of Base Transceiver Station (BTS) projects in Punjab. They define specific terms related to noise, silence zones, and equipment, while mandating the submission of IEE forms and payment of review fees. The document also sets conditions for approval, including distance restrictions for BTS units with generators near hospitals and schools.

metadata.title: The Punjab Charas Permit and Pass Rules
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for granting permits and passes regarding the import, export, and transport of charas in Punjab. They specify conditions for transit, application forms required from bonded warehouses, and regulations for moving goods to other provinces or licensed vendors.

metadata.title: The Entertainments Duty Rules, 1958
metadata.summary: These rules govern the supply, purchase, and management of entertainment duty stamps in Punjab. They establish requirements for ticket issuance, including serial numbering and specific details to be printed on admission tickets.

metadata.title: the Matches Excise Duty Rules, 1934
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for appeals against orders made by a Collector regarding matches excise duty. They also confer specific search and seizure powers upon Excise officers above the rank of Jamadar or peon, and Police officers above the rank of Constable.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION CESS ON CLUBS RULES 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Cess on Clubs Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for levying and collecting an education cess on clubs within the Punjab province. They define the roles of assessing authorities, mandate the submission of monthly returns, and outline procedures for assessment, appeals, and recovery of unpaid dues.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excisable Articles Confiscation Orders
metadata.repeals: Financial Commissioner's notification No.19, dated the 18th January, 1915
metadata.summary: This notification delegates powers to Commissioners and Collectors regarding the revision of orders passed by subordinate Excise Officers under the Punjab Excise Act, 1914. It also establishes specific rules for the disposal of articles confiscated under Sections 78 and 79 of that Act, mandating the destruction of liquors and hemp drugs while allowing other items to be sold.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise Barrier Rules, 1931
metadata.summary: These rules empower the Excise Commissioner to establish excise outposts on roads and ferries to prevent smuggling. They mandate that drivers must stop their vehicles or animals at these outposts for inspection by an excise officer before proceeding.

metadata.title: The Punjab Farm Houses Tax Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules provide the framework for the assessment, collection, and recovery of farm house tax in Punjab. They define the powers and duties of assessing authorities, outline procedures for filing returns and entering premises, and establish penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Liquor License Rules, 1932
metadata.summary: These rules define the classes of liquor licenses that can be granted and renewed by specific authorities within the Punjab. They outline the powers of various officers regarding wholesale and retail sales of foreign liquor, country spirit, and denatured spirits, as well as regulations for manufacturing fermented liquor.

metadata.title: The Punjab Manufactured Drugs Rules, 1932
metadata.summary: These rules govern the manufacture of medicinal opium and preparations containing morphine, diacetylmorphine, or cocaine by medical practitioners and licensed individuals. They also establish regulations for the inter-provincial import, export, transport, possession, and sale of manufactured drugs other than prepared opium and coca leaf.

name: PUNJAB MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSACTION LICENSEES RULES 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicle Transaction Licensees Rules, 2015
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for licensing motor vehicle transaction licensees in Punjab, including definitions, application procedures, and eligibility criteria. They outline requirements for office premises, IT infrastructure, training, record maintenance, and conditions for license renewal or refusal.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles Rules, 1969
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Rules, 1940; The North-West Frontier Motor Vehicles Rules, 1940; The Baluchistan Motor Vehicles Rules, 1940; The Sind Motor Vehicles Rules, 1940
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of West Pakistan under specific sections of the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965. They supersede previous motor vehicles rules for Punjab, N.W.F.P., Baluchistan, and Sind, establishing definitions, licensing authorities, and fee structures for motor vehicles within the provinces.

name: PUNJAB OPIUM CONFISCATION AND REWARDS ORDERS, 1934

metadata.title: The Punjab Opium Confiscation and Rewards Orders
metadata.summary: These rules govern the disposal of items confiscated under the Opium Act, 1878, and the payment of rewards for information regarding offences. They specify procedures for delivering confiscated goods to collectors, destroying opium, and granting financial rewards based on the authority level and amount involved.

metadata.title: The Punjab Paddy Husking Tax Rules, 1978
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for levying and collecting tax on paddy husking in Punjab. They define key terms, assign powers to district officers for assessment and penalty determination, and mandate specific record-keeping and return filing procedures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Rules, 1979
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of the Punjab under powers conferred by Articles 21 and 31 of the Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979. They define key terms such as 'Authorized Medical Officer' and outline the powers exercised by various excise officers, including District Officers and Constables, within their respective jurisdictions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Restaurant (Consumption of Liquor) Rules, 1939
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the consumption of liquor in restaurants within the Punjab by establishing a system of exemption certificates. They define specific terms such as 'restaurant' and 'country liquor', restrict possession of liquor on non-exempted premises, and set conditions for granting, utilizing, and cancelling exemptions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sugar (Excise Duty) Rules, 1935
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for appeals from Collector orders to Commissioners and allow Financial Commissioners to review case records. They also confer search and seizure powers on specific excise and police officers regarding illegally imported or manufactured sugar.

name: THE PUNJAB BHANG IMPORT EXPORT TRANSPORT AND POSSESSION ORDERS

metadata.title: The Punjab Bhang Import, Export, Transport and Possession Orders
metadata.amends: The Punjab Bhang Import, Export, Transport and Possession Orders (cancelled by Notification No.890 dated 29th June 1915)
metadata.summary: These orders regulate the import, export, transport, and possession of bhang within Punjab under the Punjab Excise Act. They establish specific conditions for licensed sellers regarding permits, duties, quantities, and routes for moving bhang between provinces or districts.

name: The PUNJAB BONDED SPIRIT WAREHOUSE RULES

metadata.title: The Punjab Bonded Spirit Warehouse Rules
metadata.summary: These rules define the Punjab Bonded Spirit Warehouse Rules and establish their application to bonded spirit warehouses. They specify that certain sections of the Punjab Distillery Rules apply mutatis mutandis to these warehouses while excluding others.

metadata.title: The Punjab Brewery Rules, 1932
metadata.summary: These rules govern the licensing and regulation of breweries within the Punjab province. They define key terms related to brewing processes and establish requirements for obtaining a license, including security deposits and building standards.

name: THE PUNJAB CHARAS IMPORT EXPORT TRANSPORT AND POSSESSION ORDERS

metadata.title: The Punjab Charas Import, Export, Transport and Possession Orders, 1935
metadata.summary: This order regulates the import, export, transport, and possession of charas within the Punjab. It defines specific conditions for inter-provincial movement, requires passes for most transactions, and sets limits on quantities that individuals may possess.

name: THE PUNJAB CHARAS PERMIT AND PASS RULES

metadata.title: The Punjab Charas Permit and Pass Rules
metadata.summary: These rules were notified under Financial Commissioner notification No. 4871-EX on November 13, 1935. They were issued in exercise of powers conferred by specific sections of the Punjab Excise Act, 1914.

metadata.title: Punjab Charas Warehouse Rules
metadata.amends: Financial Commissioner's Notification No. 49 (dated the 19th March, 1915) and Financial Commissioner's Notification No. 50 (dated the 19th March, 1915)
metadata.summary: These rules establish bonded warehouses in Punjab for the deposit and removal of charas without payment of duty. They define the administrative control, appointment of officers, and maintenance of registers required for managing these warehouses under the Punjab Excise Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Chemical Works Rules
metadata.summary: These rules define specific terms related to chemical works, such as spirit stores, laboratories, and warehouses, within the context of alcohol manufacture. They establish procedures for applying for licenses to use rectified spirit for medicinal preparations, including requirements for security deposits and building plans.

metadata.title: The Punjab Distillery Rules
metadata.summary: These rules establish the preliminary provisions and regulations for distilleries in Punjab, including definitions of terms related to spirit production. They outline the procedures for applying for licenses, the requirements for security deposits, and the powers granted to the Excise Commissioner.

name: THE PUNJAB EXCISE BEER BOTTLES RULES 1943 APPENDIX

metadata.title: The Punjab Beer Bottles Rules
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Beer Bottles Rules Appendix
metadata.summary: These rules define the meanings of key terms such as 'beer bottle' and 'brewery' within the context of Punjab excise law. They establish regulations regarding the authorization, storage limits, sale, and transportation of empty beer bottles, while explicitly exempting filled bottles and small quantities for domestic use.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise Bottles Rules
metadata.amends: The Punjab Excise Bottles Rules (published with Punjab Government notification No.1178-Ex., dated the 24th February 1942)
metadata.summary: These rules substitute the existing Punjab Excise Bottles Rules to regulate the use, sale, storage, and export of excise bottles within the Punjab. They specify that bottles can only be used for bottling spirit under a license, restrict exports from the province, and set possession limits for distilleries and licensed vendors.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise Fiscal Orders
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Punjab Excise Fiscal Orders to update duty rates for various spirits, sweets, and medicinal preparations. It also establishes specific rules regarding the levying of duties on bhang imports and exports within the Punjab.

name: THE PUNJAB EXCISE GRANT OF REWARD INFORMERS AND OTHER PERSONS RULES 1966

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise (Grant of Reward Informers and Other Persons) Rules, 1966
metadata.summary: These rules establish the authorities empowered to grant rewards to officers, informers, and other persons involved in excise matters. They specify the monetary limits for rewards under the Punjab Excise Act, 1914, and outline procedures for disbursement and account verification.

name: THE PUNJAB EXCISE POWERS AND APPEAL ORDERS

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise Powers and Appeal Orders
metadata.amends: Excise and Taxation Department Notification No.1302-63/760-Ex. 1
metadata.summary: This order appoints the Director General Excise and Taxation Punjab as an Excise Commissioner with powers conferred by the Punjab Excise Act, 1914. It establishes three classes of excise officers, defines restrictions on licensing liquor and drug shops in villages or towns without prior licenses, and details the specific investigative and seizure powers granted to officers of the first, second, and third classes.

name: THE PUNJAB HEMP CULTIVATION AND BHANG PERMIT AND PASS RULES

metadata.title: The Punjab Hemp Cultivation and Bhang Permit and Pass Rules
metadata.repeals: Financial Commissioner's Notification No. 177
metadata.summary: These rules govern the cultivation of hemp plants by religious institutions and regulate the import, export, and transport of bhang within Punjab. They establish conditions for granting special licenses to temple or dharamsala managers and outline procedures for obtaining permits for moving bhang across districts or provinces.

metadata.title: The Punjab Hotel Tax Rules, 1992
metadata.repeals: Notification No. 419.687-65/C Tax. II (F), dated 4.4.1966
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for levying and collecting hotel tax in Punjab under the Punjab Finance Act, 1965. They define key terms such as 'Hotel', 'Tax', and 'Director General', and mandate that hotel owners submit monthly tax statements within seven days of each calendar month's close. The document also outlines procedures for assessing tax on occupied lodging units, maintaining registers for demand and collection, conducting physical verifications, and handling appeals or penalties.

name: THE PUNJAB IMPORT AND POSSESSION OF GANJA ORDERS

metadata.title: The Punjab Import and Possession of Ganja Orders
metadata.summary: This document prohibits the possession of ganja or any preparation thereof within the Punjab. It also prohibits the import of ganja into the region.

metadata.title: The Punjab Intoxicants Confiscation Rules
metadata.summary: These rules govern the procedure for handing over confiscated articles to the Collector and their subsequent disposal. They specify that illicit liquor, unsealed licit liquor, and unfit hemp drugs must be destroyed, while fit items may be sold or disposed of as prescribed.

name: THE PUNJAB INTOXICANTS LICENSE AND SALE ORDERS

metadata.title: The Punjab Intoxicants License and Sale Orders
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Punjab Intoxicants License and Sale Orders, defining maximum possession limits for various intoxicants in retail settings. It outlines the duration of licenses, restrictions on where shops can be located, eligibility criteria for license holders, and procedural requirements for granting new retail liquor licenses.

name: THE PUNJAB LIQUOR IMPORT EXPORT TRANSPORT AND POSSESSION ORDERS

metadata.title: The Punjab Liquor Import, Export, Transport and Possession Orders
metadata.summary: This document establishes orders governing the import, export, transport, and possession of liquor within Punjab. It outlines specific restrictions on importing country fermented liquor, rules regarding duty payments for foreign spirits, and procedures for exporting bonded goods to countries outside Pakistan.

name: THE PUNJAB LIQUOR PERMIT AND PASS RULES

metadata.title: The Punjab Liquor Permit and Pass Rules
metadata.summary: These rules determine the requirements for granting passes and permits for importing, exporting, or transporting country spirit, rectified spirit, denatured spirit, and liquor within Punjab. They also establish procedures for the export in bond of medicinal preparations containing rectified spirit to other provinces, including inspection protocols and duty recovery mechanisms.

name: THE PUNJAB PROFESSIONS AND TRADES TAX RULES 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Professions and Trades Tax Rules, 1977
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under Section 8 of the Punjab Finance Act, 1977 to regulate professions and trades tax. They establish procedures for filing statements, determining tax liability, appealing orders, and collecting taxes from government servants and other entities.

name: THE PUNJAB SPIRITUOUS PREPARATIONS BONDED WAREHOUSE RULES

metadata.title: The Punjab Spirituous Preparations Bonded Warehouse Rules
metadata.summary: These Rules govern the establishment, licensing, and supervision of bonded warehouses for spirituous preparations in Punjab. They outline procedures for applying for licenses, daily operating hours, receipt verification, allowances for transit loss, and liability for duty on excess wastage.

name: THE PUNJAB SUPPLY AND SALE OF HEMP DRUGS RULES

metadata.title: The Punjab Supply and Sale of Hemp Drugs Rules
metadata.summary: These rules establish four kinds of licenses for the vending of hemp drugs in Punjab, distinguishing between wholesale and retail categories. They specify fees, application procedures via auction or tender, and strict conditions regarding stock maintenance, sales quantities, and prohibited substances.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sweets (Manufacture) Rules, 1939
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the manufacture of sweets in Punjab, defining them as fermented fruit or sugar products that have not undergone distillation. They establish procedures for obtaining licenses from the Financial Commissioner, including requirements for premises descriptions and restrictions on using existing distillery locations.

name: THE PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX RULES 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Rules, 1958
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of West Pakistan to prescribe procedures for assessing and collecting urban immovable property tax. They define the powers and duties of assessing authorities, outline the process for preparing valuation lists, and establish mechanisms for objection handling and tax recovery.

name: THE REAL ESTATE AGENTS AND MOTOR VEHICLES DEALERS (REGULATION OF BUSINESS) RULES 1980

metadata.title: The Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Rules, 1980
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under Section 11 of the Punjab Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1980. They establish procedures for registration and renewal of certificates, specify application forms and fees, define security deposit requirements, and outline the powers of the registering authority.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Opium Rules, 1956
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the possession, transport, import, export, and sale of opium and poppy-heads within West Pakistan. They define key terms such as pure opium, excise opium, and retail sale limits, while establishing procedures for government transactions and transit by post.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This document amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964 to regulate the levy and payment of Electricity Duty on energy consumed for specified purposes. It outlines the rates for residential, commercial, industrial, and agricultural use, as well as exemptions for government entities, small generators, and low-consumption users.

name: PUNJAB MEDIUM-TERM FISCAL FRAMEWORK AND BUDGET STRATEGY RULES 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Medium-term Fiscal Framework and Budget Strategy Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for preparing, submitting, and approving the Medium-term Fiscal Framework and Budget Strategy for the Government of the Punjab. They define key terms related to fiscal planning, committees involved in the process, and timelines for finalizing budget proposals before government approval.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pension Fund Rules, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Pension Fund and define its powers, obligations, and restrictions regarding investments and asset management. They outline the duties of the Management Committee and the General Manager in administering the Reserve Fund.

name: PUNJAB RESTAURANT INVOICE MONITORING SYSTEM RULES 2015

metadata.title: Punjab Restaurant Invoice Monitoring System Rules 2015
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Restaurant Invoice Monitoring System (RIMS) under the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012. They mandate the installation of specific hardware and software systems in restaurants to capture transaction data in real-time and authorize the use of video surveillance for monitoring business activities.

name: PUNJAB REVENUE AUTHORITY (MEMBERS AND SECRETARY) RULES 2016

metadata.title: Punjab Revenue Authority (Members and Secretary) Rules 2016
metadata.summary: These rules establish the eligibility criteria, appointment procedures, and terms of office for members and the Secretary of the Punjab Revenue Authority. They define key expressions used within the document and outline the specific responsibilities assigned to the Secretary regarding meetings and reporting.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (ADJUDICATION AND APPEALS) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Adjudication and Appeals) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Punjab Revenue Authority under section 76 of the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012. They establish procedures for original adjudication, including the issuance of show cause notices, principles of natural justice, and the quasi-judicial nature of tax proceedings.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (ADJUSTMENT OF TAX) RULES 2012

metadata.title: Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Adjustment of Tax) Rules 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for registered persons to deduct or adjust input tax paid on goods and services used in providing taxable services within Punjab. They specify conditions under which input tax adjustments are admissible, including apportionment formulas for mixed-use inputs and restrictions regarding non-taxable services, capital goods, and specific categories like vehicles and food items.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (AUDIT) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Audit) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for departmental and special audits conducted by the Punjab Revenue Authority under the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012. They outline procedures for selecting registered persons for audit, conducting reviews of business records, preparing audit reports, and handling penalties for violations.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVES) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Authorized Representative) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules define the persons authorized to represent taxpayers before the Punjab Revenue Authority and its appellate bodies. They establish disqualifications for representatives, outline the procedure for appointing them via a letter of authorization, and set out professional responsibilities regarding conduct and compliance.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (COMPUTERIZED SYSTEM) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Computerized System) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for a computerized system under the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012. They define responsibilities for users regarding data security, outline procedures for authorizing access and assigning unique identifiers, and set guidelines for e-intermediaries.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (ENFORCEMENT) RULES 2014

metadata.title: Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Enforcement) Rules 2014
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Punjab Revenue Authority under section 76 of the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 to regulate enforcement measures. They define key terms such as 'business premises' and 'enforcement', outline powers for officers to visit premises and access records, and establish procedures for sealing business premises in cases of tax evasion or non-compliance.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (FILING OF RETURNS) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Filing of Returns) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedures for registered persons to file sales tax on services returns in Punjab, either manually or electronically. They detail the requirements for e-filing through the Authority's web portal, including data entry, verification, payment generation, and submission processes.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (RECOVERY) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Recovery) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Punjab Revenue Authority under section 76 of the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 to regulate tax recovery procedures. They establish the roles of referring and recovery officers, define the process for issuing certificates and maintaining registers, and outline measures for attaching properties when taxes remain unpaid.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (REGISTRATION AND DE-REGISTRATION) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Registration and De-registration) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for registration and de-registration under the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012. They outline requirements for applying for registration, maintaining registration details, and the process for cancelling or suspending registration due to tax fraud or non-payment.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (SPECIFIC PROVISIONS) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Specific Provisions) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules specify the provisions for levying sales tax on services within the Punjab province. They cover scope, registration, and tax calculation for banking, insurance, shipping agents, and advertising sectors.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (WITHHOLDING) RULES 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Withholding) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules specify the persons who act as withholding agents for sales tax on taxable services provided to government bodies, public sector organizations, and other specified entities. They outline the procedures for deducting and depositing sales tax from payments made to service providers, including specific rates for registered versus unregistered providers and distinct rules for advertisement services.

name: PUNJAB TREASURY ACCOUNTS SERVICE (DEPARTMENTAL EXAMINATION) REGULATIONS, 1978

metadata.title: Punjab Treasury and Accounts Service (Departmental Examination) Regulations, 1978
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for conducting departmental examinations for probationers in the Punjab Treasury and Accounts Service. They define key terms, set qualifying standards, specify examination dates, and outline the subjects and syllabus to be covered.

metadata.title: The Foodgrains (Licensing Control) Order, 1957
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the Governor in exercise of powers under Section 3 of the Foodstuffs (Control) Ordinance, 1957. It establishes licensing controls for foodgrains and wheat products across all provinces except Tribal Areas.

name: PUNJAB FOOD AUTHORITY (DISPOSAL OF EXCESS FOOD) REGULATION, 2019

metadata.title: Punjab Food Authority (Disposal of Excess Food) Regulation, 2019
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes guidelines for food operators to donate excess food that is fit for human consumption to donor organizations for welfare purposes. It outlines the modes of giving, standards for conservation, and procedures for disposing of discardable food or agricultural products not suitable for human consumption. The document aims to reduce economic and environmental costs associated with food waste while encouraging a zero-waste principle in food businesses.

metadata.title: The Punjab Meat (Control) Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the Governor of Punjab to regulate the sale, preparation, storage, and offering for sale of meat within the province. It establishes specific definitions for officials like Commissioners and Inspectors, sets licensing fees and conditions, and outlines procedures for inspection and appeals.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pure Food Rules, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Pure Food Rules, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab to regulate food safety, labelling, and manufacturing standards. They supersede the previous 2007 regulations and cover definitions, additives, hygiene requirements, and licensing for food businesses.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sugar Factories Control Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Sugar Factories Control Board and define its composition, powers, and meeting procedures. They also designate various government officers as ex-officio inspectors with authority to enter factories and examine weighing mechanisms.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sugarcane (Development) Cess Rules, 1964
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Sugarcane (Development) Cess and define terms related to sugar mills, cane sellers, and the Cane Commissioner. They prescribe the time and manner for calculating, recovering, and depositing the cess into government treasuries, along with procedures for non-submission of returns and penalties for defaults.

metadata.title: The Flour Mills (Control) Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the cleaning, milling, and manufacture of wheat products in Pakistan. It empowers a Controller to direct producers on sourcing, manufacturing limits, supply distribution, and pricing while enforcing hygiene and cleanliness standards.

metadata.title: The Foodgrains (Licensing Control) Order, 1957
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the Governor in exercise of powers under Section 3 of the Foodstuffs (Control) Ordinance, 1957. It establishes licensing controls for the purchase, sale, and storage of foodgrains across all provinces except the Tribal Areas.

name: ESTABLISHMENT OF SAWPITS, SAWMILL, CHARCOAL KILN, TIMBER OR FIREWOOD DEPOT RULES 2013

metadata.title: The Establishment of Sawpits, Sawmill, Charcoal Kiln, Timber or Firewood Depot Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These rules establish the requirements for registering sawpits, sawmills, charcoal kilns, and timber or firewood depots within five miles of forest boundaries in Punjab. They define key terms related to timber and processing facilities, mandate specific registers for tracking receipts and sales, and outline powers for Forest Officers regarding arrests, security deposits, and operational prohibitions.

metadata.title: The Private Wildlife Breeding Farm Rules, 2016
metadata.amends: The Private Wildlife Breeding Farm Rules, 2008
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for private wildlife breeding farms in Punjab, defining categories for wild birds and general wildlife farming. They outline eligibility criteria, licensing procedures, land requirements, and record-keeping obligations for licensees.

metadata.title: The Private Wildlife Breeding Farm Rules, 2008
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for private wildlife breeding farms in Punjab, defining categories, eligibility criteria, and licensing procedures. They outline specific conditions for farm establishment, including land requirements, record-keeping, tagging, and inspection protocols to ensure proper management and conservation of wild birds and animals.

metadata.title: The Private Wildlife Reserve Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for declaring and managing private wildlife reserves in Punjab, including specific requirements for land ownership, application procedures, and management plans. The document categorizes reserves into different classes based on area size and defines regulations regarding hunting, fees, and prohibited activities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Community Based Conservancy Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for community-based conservancy zones within the Punjab, allowing local communities to manage and conserve wildlife in specific areas. The document outlines procedures for zone declaration, committee formation, proposal approval, fund utilization, and the registration of conservancy projects.

name: PUNJAB COMPOUNDING OF FOREST OFFENCES AND GRANT OF REWARD RULES 2013

metadata.title: Punjab Compounding of Forest Offences and Grant of Reward Rules 2013
metadata.summary: These rules are made under section 76 of the Forest Act 1927 to regulate the compounding of forest offences and the granting of rewards in Punjab. They define specific forest officer roles, outline procedures for arrest and reporting, establish limits on who can collect compensation based on the damage amount, and set requirements for issuing receipts and remitting funds to the treasury.

metadata.title: Punjab Forest Transit Rules 2013
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under section 76 of the Forest Act, 1927 to regulate the transportation of forest produce. They establish procedures for check-posts, transit permits, hammer-marking requirements, and exemptions for certain timber products.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Plantation Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for public-private partnerships (PPP) in raising forests on forest land or wasteland within the Punjab. They define eligibility criteria for private parties, outline the roles of scrutiny and implementation committees, and set requirements for afforestation plans including species selection and irrigation arrangements.

metadata.title: The Punjab Protected Areas Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of Punjab under the Punjab Protected Areas Act, 2020 to regulate protected areas. They establish eligibility criteria for board members, define board business procedures, and outline the process for entering into management agreements.

name: Punjab Urial Conservation, Protection and Trophy Hunting (Committees) Rules 2010

metadata.title: Punjab Urial Conservation, Protection and Trophy Hunting (Committees) Rules 2016
metadata.amends: Punjab Urial Conservation, Protection and Trophy Hunting (Committees) Rules 2010
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for registering committees dedicated to the conservation and trophy hunting of urials in the Punjab. They define eligibility criteria for committee members and office bearers, outline the constitution and functions of these committees, and specify regulations regarding fund sharing and utilization derived from trophy hunting activities.

metadata.title: Punjab Village Forest Rules 2013
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for managing village forests in Punjab under the Forest Act 1927. They create Village Forest Committees comprising local community members and government representatives to oversee forest boundaries, regulate the collection of produce, and prepare management plans.

name: Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Rules, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Rules, 1974
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of the Punjab under powers conferred by section 46 of the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2007. They specify the conditions for issuing various permits, licences, and certificates related to hunting, shooting, netting, possession of birds, and importing wild animals.

name: Punjab Zoos and Safari Parks Rules 2012

metadata.title: Punjab Zoos and Safari Parks Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish independent management committees for every zoo and safari park in Punjab to exercise supervisory control. They define the composition of these committees, including official and non-official members, their qualifications, meeting procedures, and the powers of the chairperson regarding administration and finance.

name: Terms and Conditions for Establishment of Private Wildlife Breeding Farm

metadata.title: Terms and Conditions for Establishment of Private Wildlife Breeding Farm
metadata.summary: This document outlines the specific terms and conditions required for establishing a private wildlife breeding farm in Punjab. It details requirements regarding land ownership, minimum area sizes, record-keeping, animal tagging, and government inspections.

name: ALI INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION ACADEMIC REGULATIONS

metadata.title: Ali Institute of Education Academic Regulations
metadata.summary: This document outlines the academic regulations for Ali Institute of Education, covering definitions, scope, admission criteria, and study periods. It details requirements for coursework submission, module changes, assessment procedures, and policies on academic honesty.

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Museum Regulations, 1998
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for the management of the Bahawalpur Museum, including the composition and procedures of its Board. They define key terms related to employees, service, and acquisitions, while outlining rules for convening meetings, maintaining minutes, and appointing personnel.

name: BAHWALPUR MUSEUM EMPLOYEES (CONTRIBUTORY PROVIDENT FUND) REGULATIONS 1998

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Museum Employees (Contributory Provident Fund) Regulations, 1998
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the Bahawalpur Museum Employees Contributory Provident Fund and define its constitution, administration, and membership criteria. They outline rules for employee subscriptions, Board contributions, profit distribution, and procedures for nominations and cancellations in the event of an employee's death.

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Museum Employees (Efficiency & Discipline) Regulations, 1998
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for maintaining efficiency and discipline among employees of the Bahawalpur Museum. They define key terms such as misconduct and penalty, outline grounds for disciplinary action including corruption and subversive activities, and prescribe specific penalties ranging from censure to dismissal. The document also details the procedural steps for initiating proceedings, conducting inquiries, and determining appropriate actions against accused employees.

name: BOARD OF GOVERNORS CADET COLLEGE PASRUR DISTRICT SIALKOT'S RULES 2011

metadata.title: The Board of Governors Cadet College Pasrur District Sialkot's Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Board of Governors for Cadet College Pasrur District Sialkot and define its composition, tenure, and powers. The document outlines the specific functions of the Board, its Chairman, Executive Committee, and Principal regarding administration, finance, and personnel management.

name: CHILDREN LIBRARY COMPLEX, LAHORE RECRUITMENT RULES, 1991

metadata.title: The Children Library Complex, Lahore Recruitment Rules, 1991
metadata.summary: These Rules regulate the recruitment and service conditions for persons appointed to various categories at the Children Library Complex, Lahore. They define key terms related to employment, pay scales, and tenure while establishing procedures for resignation and termination of service.

metadata.title: The Children Library Complex, Lahore, Rules, 1992
metadata.summary: These rules frame the administrative and financial framework for the Children Library Complex in Lahore. They establish the powers of the Board, Chairman, and Project Director, along with procedures for meetings, funds management, and audit requirements.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY ADMISSION AND REGISTRATION REGULATIONS 2012

metadata.title: Fatima Jinnah Women University Admission and Registration Regulations, 2012
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the admission and registration processes for Fatima Jinnah Women University (FJWU). They outline eligibility criteria, merit calculation methods, program durations, and academic requirements for both Bachelor's and Master's degrees.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY EMPLOYEES BENEVOLENT FUND STATUTES 2013

metadata.title: Fatima Jinnah Women University Employees Benevolent Fund Statutes 2013
metadata.summary: These statutes establish the University Employees Benevolent Fund for Fatima Jinnah Women University to provide financial relief and benefits to employees and their families. The fund is financed by employee subscriptions, government donations, and investment income, with a Board of Management responsible for its administration and distribution of grants.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY EMPLOYEES GROUP INSURANCE STATUTES 2013

metadata.title: Fatima Jinnah Women University Employees Group Insurance Statutes 2013
metadata.summary: These statutes establish a Group Insurance Fund for employees of the Fatima Jinnah Women University to provide life insurance benefits and financial protection to their families. The document defines eligibility criteria, contribution scales based on Basic Salary (BS) categories, nomination procedures, and payment rules in the event of an employee's death or retirement.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY EMPLOYEES PENSION & GENERAL PROVIDENT FUND STATUTES 2013

metadata.title: Fatima Jinnah Women University Employees Pension & General Provident Fund Statues 2013
metadata.summary: These statutes establish the framework for the Employees Pension and General Provident Fund at Fatima Jinnah Women University. They define key terms such as 'employee' and 'family', apply government pension rules to university staff, and outline procedures for granting pensions, calculating qualifying service, and managing the fund.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY EXAMINATION REGULATIONS 2012

metadata.title: Fatima Jinnah Women University Examination Regulations, 2012
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the examination framework for Fatima Jinnah Women University, covering both graduate and undergraduate degree programs. The document outlines specific requirements regarding credit hours, semester structures, evaluation methods including mid-term and final exams, and procedures for thesis or research projects.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY HOSTEL REGULATIONS 2007

metadata.title: FJWU Hostel Regulations
metadata.amends: Fatima Jinnah Women University Rawalpindi Act
metadata.repeals: existing Regulations/ Rules
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the eligibility, conduct, and management of students residing in hostels at Fatima Jinnah Women University. They establish specific rules regarding visitor access, room usage, property care, and disciplinary measures for violations.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY MEDICAL ATTENDANCE RULES 2015

metadata.title: Fatima Jinnah Women University Medical Allowance Regulations
metadata.summary: These rules establish the medical attendance and allowance regulations for full-time employees of Fatima Jinnah Women University. They define eligible patients, authorized medical personnel, and specific treatments covered or excluded, such as maternity care and dental procedures excluding dentures.

name: Financial Powers Rules for the Execution of civil works of the University of Sargodha, Sargodha

metadata.title: Financial Rules for the Execution of civil works of the University of Sargodha
metadata.summary: These rules establish the financial powers and duties for executing construction works at the University of Sargodha. They define the roles and responsibilities of various engineering staff, including the Project Director, Executive Engineer, and Assistant Engineer, as well as secretariat staff regarding expenditure control and bill verification.

name: Financial Rules 2012 of the University of Sargodha

metadata.title: Financial Rules 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the financial framework for the University of Sargodha and its constituent colleges or sub-campuses. They define key terms, mandate that accounts be kept by the Treasurer in scheduled banks, and outline procedures for fund investment and loan advances to employees.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (BENEVOLENT FUND) STATUTES 2022

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Benevolent Fund) Statutes 2022
metadata.summary: This notification approves the Statutes for establishing the University Employees Benevolent Fund at Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan. The document outlines rules regarding employee subscriptions, eligibility for benevolent grants in cases of death or invalidation, and the management of the fund by a Board of Management.

name: LAHORE MUSEUM EMPLOYEES (CONTRIBUTORY PROVIDENT FUND) REGULATIONS, 1987

metadata.title: The Lahore Museum Employees (Contributory Provident Fund) Regulations, 1987
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the Lahore Museum Employees Contributory Provident Fund and define its constitution, administration, and membership eligibility. They outline rules regarding contributions from employees and the Board, as well as procedures for nominations and termination of membership.

metadata.title: The Lahore Museum Regulations, 1987
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for the administration of the Lahore Museum in Lahore. They define terms, outline the business procedures of the Board of Governors, and set out rules regarding staff appointments, service conditions, and financial powers.

metadata.title: The Lahore Museum Rules, 1969
metadata.summary: These rules establish the administrative framework for the Board of Governors of the Lahore Museum, including definitions, meeting procedures, and quorum requirements. They also outline responsibilities regarding budget submissions, maintenance of accounts, and annual auditing processes.

metadata.title: Model Tenure Track Process Statutes
metadata.summary: This document provides model statutes for implementing the tenure track process at degree-granting institutions in Pakistan. It outlines rules regarding appointments, promotions, reviews, and benefits for faculty members within a specific governance structure involving a Senate and Syndicate.

name: PUNJAB DAANISH SCHOOLS AND CENTERS OF EXCELLENCE AUTHORITY RULES, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These Rules establish the framework for the Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority, defining its extent, definitions, and operational procedures. They outline specific responsibilities regarding school management, curriculum standards, inspections, teacher training, and disciplinary actions.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION FOUNDATION (CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 2005

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Conduct of Business) Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: These rules establish the conduct of business for the Punjab Education Foundation, defining key terms and outlining the powers and duties of its Board of Directors. They also specify the responsibilities of the Managing Director, the procedures for convening meetings, quorum requirements, and the recording of minutes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Contract Appointment) Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: These rules govern the contract appointments within the Punjab Education Foundation under the powers of the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004. They establish eligibility criteria, recruitment methods, specific terms and conditions of service, leave policies, and financial contributions for contract employees.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION FOUNDATION (FINANCE AND AUDIT) RULES, 2005

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Finance and Audit) Rules, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Education Foundation (Maliyaat-Wa-Hisabaat) Qawaed, 1991
metadata.summary: These rules establish the financial and audit procedures for the Punjab Education Foundation. They define key terms, mandate specific banking accounts, outline payment and expenditure protocols, and prescribe record-keeping requirements.

metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Public Library Lahore Rules 2012 to regulate the Board of Governors and the library's operations. metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Public Library Lahore Rules 2012 to regulate the Board of Governors and the library's operations. metadata.summary: These rules establish the Quaid-e-Azam Library as a non-lending research and reference institution open to Pakistani citizens and foreign nationals. metadata.title: The Quaid-e-Azam Library, Lahore General Regulations, 1984
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for the Board of Governors of the Quaid-e-Azam Library, Lahore. They define key terms, outline meeting procedures, set rules for committee appointments, and specify terms of service and financial management for library staff.

metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the administration of the Quaid-e-Azam Library in Lahore under the Punjab Government. They define key terms, outline the powers and meeting procedures of the Board of Governors, and set requirements for financial statements, audits, and staff transfers.

name: Revised Rules and Regulations for MS/MPhil, MS/MPhil leading to PhD and PhD programs, University of Sargodha, 2008

metadata.title: Revised Rules and Regulations for MS/MPhil, MS/MPhil leading to PhD and PhD programs, University of Sargodha, 2008
metadata.summary: This document establishes the revised rules and regulations for MS/MPhil, MS/MPhil leading to PhD, and PhD programs at the University of Sargodha.
