metadata.title: University of Sargodha - Purchase Rules 2006
metadata.summary: These rules govern the purchase of goods and services for the University of Sargodha, covering development and non-development expenditures. They define key terms related to contracts, deliveries, and inspections while establishing procedures for fund availability and specific material purchases.

name: University of Sargodha Undergraduate & Graduate Regulations 2009

metadata.title: Semester Regulations-2009, University of Sargodha
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the undergraduate and graduate programs offered by the University of Sargodha, establishing a semester system with Fall and Spring terms. The document outlines procedures for admissions, teaching organization, course schemes, and academic calendars.

metadata.title: Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Rules, 1995
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Federal Government under section 21 of the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992. They establish authorities for restoring property to bonded labourers and define the powers and duties of District Magistrates in implementing the Act.

metadata.title: Censorship Code
metadata.summary: This notification issues a Censorship Code under the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979 for films in Punjab. It establishes principles regarding artistic expression, filmmaker rights, and board judgment criteria while defining specific content unsuitable for public exhibition.

metadata.title: The Civil Defence (Special Powers) Rules, 1951
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under the Civil Defence (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1951 to secure civil defence for the Federation. They establish services for air raid precautions and civil defence, define the appointment and dismissal of members, and outline functions regarding fire safety, dangerous substances, and property requisitioning.

metadata.title: The Explosives Rules, 1940
metadata.repeals: The Indian Explosives Rules, 1914; The Berar Explosives Rules, 1914; all rules and notifications issued under the Indian Explosives Act, 1884
metadata.summary: These rules supersede previous regulations regarding explosives in Pakistan, including those from 1914 and notifications under the Indian Explosives Act, 1884. They establish definitions, classifications, exemptions, and general provisions concerning the import, transport, manufacture, possession, use, and sale of authorized explosives.

name: FUNCTIONS TO BE PERFORMED BY PHP

metadata.title: null
metadata.summary: This document outlines the specific functions and duties assigned to various ranks within the Punjab Highway Patrol (PHP), including proactive crime control, traffic management, and public education. It details the operational responsibilities of the Additional Inspector General, Deputy Inspector General, Superintendent, and ADIG regarding supervision, inspection, recruitment, and administrative oversight.

name: GOOD CONDUCT PRISONERS’ PROBATIONAL RELEASE RULES, 1927

metadata.title: The Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Rules, 1927
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the conditional release of good conduct prisoners in Punjab. They define the roles and duties of Assistant Directors and Parole Officers, outline the process for granting licenses to released prisoners, and specify procedures for revoking licenses upon breach of conditions.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Notaries Rules, 1965
metadata.summary: These rules establish the qualifications, age limits, and application procedures for appointing notaries in West Pakistan. They also define the fees for issuing certificates, extending practice areas, and renewing licenses.

metadata.title: Notification No. SO (MP) 9-1-G/2008 (P)
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Pakistan Prisons Rules, 1978 under the authority of section 59 of the Prisons Act 1894. The amendments introduce provisions for examining convicts on religious texts and establish committees to oversee such examinations. Additionally, the rules are updated to permit well-behaved prisoners to attend funerals of close relatives under police escort and clarify the powers of Deputy Inspector-Generals.

name: NOTIFICATION REGARDING PUNJAB WITNESS PROTECTION RULES, 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Witness Protection Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Punjab Witness Protection Act, 2018 to establish Witness Protection Units in Punjab for assessing risks and providing protection measures. The document defines key terms, outlines the composition and functions of the units, and sets criteria for risk assessments regarding vulnerable witnesses.

name: Notification Superior Class Jail Facilities to a Prisoner in the Punjab

metadata.title: Notification No.SO(R&P)4-24/10(Part-1)
metadata.summary: This notification directs the Governor of the Punjab to allow superior class jail facilities to eligible prisoners based on specific conditions. Eligibility requires the prisoner to be a casual offender with a graduate degree, a superior mode of living verified by significant land or business assets, and no history of heinous offences.

metadata.title: Notification P III/ 412 /2012
metadata.summary: This notification approves the recruitment criteria, pay scales, allowances, and terms of service for members of the Punjab Highway Patrol. It establishes specific ranks, promotion authorities, training requirements, and administrative controls for the force under the Police Order 2002.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Probation of Offenders Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of West Pakistan under the Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960. They establish the framework for the appointment, duties, and conditions of service for Probation Officers and Chief Probation Officers within the Province.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedures for issuing licenses to manufacture, repair, sell, or keep for sale arms, ammunition, and military stores in Punjab. They establish eligibility requirements for natural persons and legal entities, categorize licensees by business size, and define fees, validity periods, and conditions for renewal or cancellation.

metadata.title: Punjab Censorship of Films Rules 2013
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Censorship of Films Board and define its structure, including the appointment of members, officers, and staff. They outline the procedures for conducting business, holding meetings, examining films, and granting certificates for public exhibition.

name: PUNJAB DISTRICT PUBLIC SAFETY AND POLICE COMPLAINTS COMMISSION RULES, 2007

metadata.title: Punjab District Public Safety and Police Complaints Commission Conduct of Business Rules, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules establish the conduct of business for the District Public Safety and Police Complaints Commission in Punjab. They define the Commission's structure, meeting procedures, decision-making processes, and specific functions regarding police performance evaluation and public cooperation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Juvenile Justice System Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These Rules were framed by the Governor of Punjab to establish a system for the institutional treatment and rehabilitation of juveniles. They provide guidelines for the establishment of Borstal Institutions, legal assistance for juveniles, accommodation standards, admission procedures, and specific protections for female juveniles.

metadata.title: The Punjab Police (Miscellaneous Posts) Recruitment Rules, 2009
metadata.summary: These rules establish the method of recruitment, minimum qualifications, age limits, and other matters regarding specific posts within the Punjab Police Department. They come into force immediately upon notification by the Provincial Police Officer with government approval.

metadata.title: The Punjab Police Promotion Rules, 1934
metadata.summary: This document outlines the rules governing the Punjab Police department's organization, establishment, and administrative functions. It details provisions regarding police ranks, relations with magistrates, building standards, uniform specifications, and equipment management.

metadata.title: Pakistan Prisons Rules, 1978
metadata.summary: These rules govern the superintendence and management of prisons in Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'Prison', 'criminal prisoner', 'habitual criminal', and various types of prison facilities like central and district prisons.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE SECURITY COMPANIES (REGULATION AND CONTROL) Rules, 2003

metadata.summary: These rules regulate and control private security companies in Punjab, establishing procedures for license grants and renewals. They define requirements for staff employment, verification processes, training standards, and the possession of arms by licensees.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF VULNERABLE PERSONS RULES 2015

metadata.title: Punjab Protection of Vulnerable Persons Rules 2015
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Protection of Vulnerable Persons Board and a Protection Unit to oversee security for witnesses, judges, prosecutors, and other persons involved in proceedings under the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997. The document defines key terms, outlines the composition and functions of the Board and Unit, and sets criteria for admitting vulnerable persons into protection programmes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Witness Protection Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Witness Protection Units to assess risks and provide non-court measures for protected persons. They define key terms, outline the composition of units for terrorism and serious offences, and specify the functions and risk assessment factors for these units.

metadata.title: Pakistan Citizenship Rules, 1952
metadata.summary: This section outlines the procedure for a person to claim citizenship by birth in Pakistan. It requires applicants under 21 years of age to submit specific forms accompanied by birth certificates and sworn statements from parents or guardians. The magistrate reviews the application, and if satisfied, recommends granting a certificate to the Provincial Government for final orders.

metadata.title: Pakistan Citizenship Rules, 1952
metadata.summary: This rule outlines the procedure for claiming citizenship by descent under Section 05 of the Act. Applicants must submit a Form 'B' application in triplicate to the Provincial Government, accompanied by specific parental citizenship certificates and evidence of relationship or service.

name: THE PUNJAB PUBLIC ORDER DETENUE RULES, 1979

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Order Detenu Rules, 1979
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under Section 27 of the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960. name: PUNJAB CHRISTIAN MARRIAGE (PREPARATION AND SUBMISSION OF RETURNS OF SOLEMNIZED MARRIAGES) RULES 2023

metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for authorized persons to provide authenticated marriage certificates and submit monthly returns of solemnized Christian marriages. name: SIKH GURDWARAS BOARD (CO–OPTATION OF MEMBERS) RULES, 1926

metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the manner in which notices and statistical returns are to be served and submitted by factory occupiers to the Statistics Authority. They specify deadlines for quarterly and annual returns, procedures for extending submission times, and the relationship to existing rules under the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942.

metadata.title: Pakistan Boilers Rules, 2009
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Federal Government under section 29 of the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002. They establish administrative controls, define powers for the Chief Inspector, outline procedures for boiler registration and renewal, and set guidelines for accident investigation and appeals.

metadata.summary: These rules establish the administrative control and duties of the Chief Inspector and subordinate inspectors regarding boiler safety in Punjab. They cover procedures for registration, inspection, handling accidents, and managing appeals under the Boilers Act, 1923.

metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the form and verification of statements required for registering firms under the Partnership Act, 1932. They also establish procedures for maintaining the Register of Firms, issuing certificates, filing documents, and handling protests or inquiries regarding dissolved firms.

metadata.title: The Punjab Skills Development Authority Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Skills Development Authority and define its powers regarding regional offices, appointments, allowances, and property acquisition. They also outline procedures for meetings, monitoring of training institutes, fund management, and budget maintenance.

name: PUNJAB WEIGHTS AND MEASURES (INTERNATIONAL SYSTEM) ENFORCEMENT RULES, 1976

name: THE PUNJAB SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION SERVICE AND RECRUITMENT RULES, 1976

metadata.summary: These rules govern the service and recruitment within the Punjab Small Industries Corporation. They establish the classification of posts, eligibility criteria for appointment, and the authority responsible for making appointments.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION RULES 2014

metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act 2013 to regulate the implementation of that Act within the province. They establish procedures for designating public information officers, maintaining and computerizing records, and processing applications for information by citizens.

metadata.title: The Punjab Water Resources Commission Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Water Resources Commission and define its structure, including the composition of an advisory committee and the qualifications for appointed experts. They mandate regular meetings to determine water allocation for various sectors such as agriculture, industry, and domestic use, while also outlining procedures for recording minutes and making decisions public.

name: RULES ISSUED UNDER CANAL AND DRAINAGE ACT, VIII OF 1873

metadata.title: Rules issued under Canal and Drainage Act, VIII of 1873
metadata.summary: These rules govern the construction and maintenance of canal works, the procedure for objections to decisions by Divisional Canal Officers, and the granting of water supplies. They also establish regulations regarding charges for water, sanitary restrictions on irrigation near towns, and the process for appealing decisions related to fees and supply stoppages.

metadata.title: The Apprenticeship Rules, 1966
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of West Pakistan under the powers of Section 13 of the Apprenticeship Ordinance, 1962. They establish the constitution, functions, and meeting procedures of the Apprenticeship Advisory Committee and outline regulations regarding apprenticeship contracts, training, stipends, and welfare.

metadata.title: Fair Wage Clause
metadata.summary: This document establishes Clause 19B of an agreement between the Government and contractors, mandating the payment of fair wages to all labourers engaged in public works. It defines 'fair wage' as rates notified during tender invitations or those prescribed by the Pakistan Public Works Department if not specified, ensuring compliance with specific labour regulations regarding deductions, registers, and employment terms.

metadata.title: Rs. 100 Cost of Living Allowance (Aug. 1993)
metadata.repeals: Notification No. S.R.O. 741(1)/93
metadata.summary: This notification directs the Federal Government to pay a cost of living allowance of Rs. 100 per month to private sector employees starting September 1, 1993. The allowance applies to those whose wages do not exceed Rs. 4,665, with higher rates for those earning more to reach a total cap of Rs. 4,165.

name: NOTIFICATION REGARDING MINIMUM WAGES FOR UNSKILLED FOR ALL CATEGORIES OF WORKERS EMPLOYED IN 51 INDUSTRIES IN THE PUNJAB

metadata.title: Notification Regarding Minimum Wages
metadata.summary: This notification specifies the minimum rates of wages for adult unskilled and juvenile workers employed in 51 industries across Punjab. It establishes a daily rate of Rs. 384.62 and a monthly rate of Rs. 10,000, while allowing deductions for housing and transport accommodations.

metadata.title: Payment of Wages (Federal Railways) Rules, 1938
metadata.summary: These rules govern the payment of wages to persons employed on federal railways, including factories and contractors meeting specific employment thresholds. metadata.title: The Payment of Wages (Mines) Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the maintenance of specific registers regarding fines, deductions for damage or loss, and wages in mines. They define key terms such as 'employer', 'paymaster', and 'mine' within the context of the Payment of Wages Act, 1936.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Employers' Returns and Records) Regulations, 1967
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the specific duties of employers regarding returns and records under the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965. metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Employers' Returns and Records) Regulations, 1967

metadata.summary: These regulations define the financial and administrative powers of the Commissioner and Local Directors within the Punjab Employees Social Security Institution. metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Occupational Diseases) Regulations, 1967

metadata.summary: These Regulations govern the appointment of staff and medical boards for social security hospitals and dispensaries in Punjab. They define eligibility criteria for medical officers, outline responsibilities regarding patient records and incapacity certificates, and establish procedures for domiciliary visits and pharmaceutical supply schedules.

name: Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Rule, 1987

metadata.title: The Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Council under the authority of the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981. metadata.title: The Punjab Factories Rules, 1978

metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for constituting and managing committees in factories to which the Punjab Fair Price Shops (Factories) Ordinance, 1971 applies. name: PUNJAB LABOUR DEPARTMENT (MEDICAL INSPECTORATE OF FACTORIES) RULES, 1986

metadata.title: West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Time and places for the meetings of the Governing Body and Disqualifications of the Members of the Governing Body Owing Contributions to the Institution) Regulations, 1967
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the short title and immediate commencement of rules regarding the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Institution. They define key terms, specify procedures for convening meetings, set time and place requirements, mandate notice periods, and outline disqualification criteria for members owing significant contributions.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Factories Canteens Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the requirements for providing and maintaining canteens in factories within West Pakistan where more than 250 workers are employed. They specify construction standards, hygiene measures, ventilation, and accommodation ratios to ensure adequate facilities for workers.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HAZARDOUS OCCUPATIONS (AERATED WATERS) RULES, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hazardous Occupations (Aerated Waters) Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules declare the manufacture of aerated waters as a hazardous operation in factories. They establish requirements for medical fitness certificates, regular examinations by certifying surgeons, and the provision of specific protective gear like face guards and waterproof clothing.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HAZARDOUS OCCUPATIONS (CELLULOSE SOLUTION SPRAYING) RULES, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hazardous Occupations (Cellulose Solution Spraying) Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules declare the spraying of cellulose ester paint or lacquer as a hazardous operation in factories. They establish specific duties for employers and employees, including prohibitions on child employment, requirements for medical fitness certificates, and strict fire safety measures regarding storage and ventilation.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hazardous Occupations (Lead) Rules, 1963
metadata.amends: The Hazardous Occupations (Lead) Rules, 1937; The Hazardous Occupations (Miscellaneous) Rules, 1937; The Hazardous Occupations (Aerated Waters) Rules, 1937; The Hazardous Occupations (Chromium) Rules, 1937; The Hazardous Occupations (Cellulose Spraying) Rules, 1937; The Hazardous Occupations (Sand Blasting) Rules, 1937
metadata.summary: These rules declare specific operations involving lead compounds as hazardous and regulate their conduct in factories. They establish strict prohibitions on the employment of women, adolescents, and children in these operations, mandate regular medical examinations for workers, and set standards for exhaust systems, flooring, and protective clothing.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Hazardous Occupations (Miscellaneous) Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules declare specific operations in factories as hazardous and regulate the employment of children and adolescents within those operations. They mandate medical fitness certificates for workers engaged in these hazardous tasks and require regular examinations by a certifying surgeon.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HAZARDOUS OCCUPATIONS (PETROL GAS GENERATING PLANT) RULES, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hazardous Occupations (Petrol Gas Generating Plant) Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules declare operations involving petrol gas generation in factories as hazardous. They prohibit the employment of women, children, and adolescents in such facilities and mandate specific protective measures like flame traps and separate buildings for generating plants.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hazardous Occupations (Rubber) Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules declare specific rubber-related operations in factories as hazardous and prohibit the employment of women, children, and adolescents in such roles. They establish strict protective provisions regarding ventilation, electrical safety, machinery design, and the prohibition of certain chemicals like carbon bisulphate.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HAZARDOUS OCCUPATIONS (SAND BLASTING) RULES, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hazardous Occupations (Sand Blasting) Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules declare sand blasting a hazardous operation and prohibit the employment of women, adolescents, and children in such operations. They mandate specific protective clothing for workers and require medical fitness certificates issued by certifying surgeons.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HAZARDOUS OCCUPATIONS (SODIUM AND POTASSIUM-BICHROMATES) RULES, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hazardous Occupations (Sodium and Potassium Bichromates) Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules declare operations involving the manufacture or recovery of sodium and potassium bichromates as hazardous. They prohibit the employment of children and adolescents in these operations and mandate medical examinations for workers, including specific chest X-Rays for those exposed to chrome dust for extended periods.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Labour Camps Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules establish standards for the location, layout, and sanitation of labour camps in West Pakistan. They specify requirements for drainage, water supply, medical facilities, cleanliness, and waste disposal to ensure a healthy environment for workers.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Rules, 1961
metadata.amends: The Sind Maternity Benefit Rules, 1929; The Punjab Maternity Benefit Rules, 1944
metadata.summary: These rules establish the administrative framework for maternity benefits in factories within West Pakistan, superseding previous regional rules. They mandate specific procedures for muster rolls, notices of confinement, payment methods, and record-keeping, while defining the powers of labor inspectors and directors.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Minimum Wages Rules, 1962
metadata.summary: These rules were framed by the Government of West Pakistan to establish the administrative framework for the Minimum Wages Board. They define terms, outline the tenure and conduct of board members, prescribe meeting procedures, and set regulations for wage rates and record-keeping.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PAYMENT OF WAGES RULES, 1960

metadata.title: West Pakistan Payment of Wages Rules, 1960
metadata.repeals: Punjab Payment of Wages Rules 1937; Sind Payment of Wages Rules 1937; Baluchistan payment of Wages Rules 1937
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the maintenance of registers for fines, deductions for damage or loss, and wages in factories within West Pakistan. They also establish procedures for imposing fines, approving lists of acts and omissions, and regulating weights and measures used to ascertain wages.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ROAD TRANSPORT WORKERS RULES, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Road Transport Workers Rules, 1962
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of West Pakistan under the powers of section 10 of the Road Transport Workers Ordinance, 1961. They prescribe requirements for employers regarding the maintenance of employment registers, display of notices, and procedures for termination of service and age verification.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS RULES, 1969

metadata.title: West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Rules, 1969
metadata.amends: Punjab Trade Employees Rules, 1940; Sind Shops and Establishments Rules, 1941; North West Frontier Province Trade Employees Rules, 1949
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of West Pakistan to regulate shops and establishments within that region. They supersede previous rules from Punjab, Sind, and NWFP while providing specific provisions on weekly holidays, machinery guarding, leave entitlements, and record maintenance.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Workmen's Compensation Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of West Pakistan under section 32 of the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923. They supersede the previous Workmen's Compensation Rules, 1924, and provide procedures for reviewing payments, commutation of half-monthly payments, medical examinations, and local inspections.

metadata.title: The Workmen's Compensation (Transfer of Money) Rules, 1935
metadata.summary: These rules were framed by the Central Government under section 35 of the Workmen Compensation Act, 1923. They establish procedures for transferring compensation sums awarded to persons residing in other countries and govern the receipt and administration of foreign compensation within the Provinces and Capital of the Federation.

metadata.title: The Official Trustee's (Punjab) Rules, 1914
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor-General in Council under the Official Trustee's Act, 1913 to regulate duties for the Province of Punjab. They establish procedures for accepting trusts, calculating and remitting fees, managing cash balances, and conducting audits.

name: PUNJAB LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES RULES 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for applying for Letters of Administration or Succession Certificates in the Punjab. They outline requirements for applications, including necessary documents and bio-metric verification processes, as well as provisions for issuing duplicate or amended certificates and collecting associated fees.

metadata.title: Animal Birth Control (Dogs) Policy, 2021
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the Animal Birth Control (Dogs) Policy, 2021 to address issues related to stray and feral dogs in Punjab. The policy aims to reduce dog populations through responsible ownership, veterinary services, and specific control techniques while preventing zoonotic diseases like rabies.

name: Prevention of cruelty to animal rules, 1961

metadata.title: Prevention of Cruelty to Animal Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules establish regulations for the prevention of cruelty to animals in West Pakistan. They cover the recognition of societies, licensing requirements for farriers, and specific restrictions on animal usage such as draught hours, loading limits, and age constraints.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animal Health Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules provide the framework for controlling scheduled diseases, identifying and tracing animals, and managing check posts within Punjab. They establish procedures for vaccination certificates, postmortem examinations, and the declaration of controlled areas and quarantine units.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Controls Rules, 1965
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of West Pakistan under the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963. They regulate the hours for slaughtering animals in slaughterhouses and prescribe procedures for the disposal of seized carcasses or meat deemed unfit or fit for human consumption.

metadata.title: Punjab Dourine Rules, 1952
metadata.summary: These rules were framed under section 14 of the Dourine Act, 1910 to regulate procedures regarding entry and search for dourine. They establish guidelines for veterinary examinations, compensation for destroyed mares, and the committee structure for hearing appeals.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK AND DAIRY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT (PARA-VETERINARY STAFF) SERVICE RULES 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock and Dairy Development Department (Para-Veterinary Staff) Service Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the service framework for para-veterinary staff within the Punjab Livestock and Dairy Development Department. They specify that recruitment methods, qualifications, age limits, and other requirements are detailed in an appended schedule.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan South African Horse Sickness Rules, 1959
metadata.repeals: Notification No. 255 dated 29th March, 1908
metadata.summary: These rules were framed by the Government of West Pakistan to deal with cases of South African Horse Sickness. They establish procedures for reporting, isolating, and destroying diseased horses, as well as strict disinfection protocols for stables, vehicles, and clothing.

name: STANDARDS AND PROCEDURE FOR BREEDING ANIMALS, 2015

metadata.title: The Standards and Procedure for Breeding Animals, 2015
metadata.summary: This notification establishes standards and procedures for breeding animals in Punjab, specifically focusing on performance recording and progeny testing programs. It outlines requirements for surveying potential farmers, training technicians, tagging livestock, and recording milk and health data to evaluate bulls based on genetic potential.

metadata.title: WCLA-I Application Form For Permission To Execute Building Works
metadata.summary: This document serves as an application form for permission to execute new construction, alterations, or additions to buildings. It requires owners to submit property details, title documents, and specific building plans along with undertakings regarding compliance with building byelaws.

name: PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (DELIMITATION OF NEIGHBOURHOODD COUNCILS AND VILLAGE COUNCILS) RULES 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Delimitation of Neighbourhood Councils and Village Councils) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules provide for the delimitation of Neighbourhood Councils and Village Councils within districts in Punjab. They establish the appointment of a delimitation committee by the Election Commission to define council boundaries based on specific population criteria and administrative limits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Election) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of the Punjab under section 202 of the Punjab Local Government Act 2022 to regulate local government elections. They cover various aspects including the enlistment of political parties, conduct of polls, appointment of officers, and management of election expenses.

name: PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (REGISTRATION OF BIRTHS AND DEATHS) RULES 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Registration of Births and Deaths) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for reporting and registering births and deaths within the Punjab province. They define specific terms, outline requirements for late registrations, and provide guidelines for handling special cases such as abandoned children or those born abroad.

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Housing Schemes Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of the Punjab under section 202 of the Punjab Local Government Act, 2022 to regulate private housing schemes. They establish procedures for approval, define technical standards for infrastructure and layout plans, set fee structures, and outline penalties for illegal development.

name: PUNJAB REGISTRATION OF CHRISTIAN DIVORCE RULES 2024

metadata.title: The Punjab Registration of Christian Divorce Rules, 2024
metadata.summary: These rules provide the procedure for registering divorces granted to Christians under the Punjab Local Government Act 2022. The process involves submitting an application with specific documents to the Union Council Secretary, followed by approval or rejection by the Assistant Director and potential appeal to the Deputy Director.

metadata.title: Walled City (Heritage Properties) Rules, 2015
metadata.summary: These rules provide a framework for the protection and conservation of heritage properties within the Walled City of Lahore. They establish procedures for the Authority to declare buildings or structures as heritage properties, including processes for public notice, consultation with the Heritage Conservation Board, and handling objections.

name: WALLED CITY OF LAHORE BUILDING REGULATIONS, 2015

metadata.title: Walled City of Lahore Building Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: These regulations provide a framework for regulating building works and controlling construction within the Walled City of Lahore. They aim to protect heritage properties, regulate building heights and densities, and ensure public safety through specific definitions and rules.

metadata.title: The Coal Mines Pithead Bath Rules, 1946
metadata.summary: These rules establish the requirements for constructing and maintaining pithead baths in coal mines to ensure worker hygiene and safety. They specify standards for construction materials, water pressure, lighting, and the provision of attendants and locker rooms based on mine output categories.

metadata.title: The Consolidated Mines Rules, 1952
metadata.summary: These rules establish sanitary and health provisions for all mines in the provinces and the Capital of the Federation. They mandate specific arrangements for drinking water, latrines, urinals, ambulance training, and first aid supplies to ensure worker safety and hygiene.

metadata.title: The Consolidated Mines Rules, 1952
metadata.summary: These rules apply to all mines in the provinces and the Capital of the Federation, establishing standards for drinking water, latrines, and urinals. They also mandate training in ambulance work, provision of first aid equipment, and procedures for registering employees and investigating accidents.

name: EXCISE DUTY ON MINERALS (LABOUR WELFARE) (PUNJAB) RULES, 1971

metadata.title: The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) (Punjab) Rules, 1971
metadata.amends: The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) (West Pakistan) Rules, 1969
metadata.summary: These rules apply the Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967 to the Province of Punjab. They establish the composition and powers of the Miners Welfare Board and Housing Board, along with provisions for assessment, recovery of duties, dispensary services, and financial management.

metadata.title: The Metalliferous Mines Regulations, 1926
metadata.summary: These regulations apply to all mines in India except coal and oil mines. They establish requirements for annual returns, notices regarding mine abandonment or reopening, and specific rules for shafts, explosives, and radioactive ore mining.

metadata.title: The Punjab Mining Concession Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of the Punjab under the powers conferred by section 2 of the Regulation of Mines and Oil-Fields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948. They come into force immediately and provide definitions for terms such as 'exploration', 'mining operation', 'licence', and 'mine' within the context of Punjab's mineral development.

metadata.title: The Punjab Coal Mines Rescue Rules, 1988
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under Section 30-A of the Mines Act, 1923 to regulate coal mines in the province. They establish a Rescue Station Committee, define duties for rescue workers and managers, and outline procedures for equipment maintenance and duty recovery.

metadata.title: The Punjab Miners Training Institutions Regulations, 1999
metadata.summary: These Regulations empower the Governor of the Punjab to establish and regulate institutes for training persons employed or to be employed in mines. They outline the requirements for private institute registration, syllabus determination, management committee composition, and the specific supervisory functions of the Chief Inspector regarding admissions, fees, curriculum, and staff.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of the Punjab under the powers of the Punjab Public Private Partnership Ordinance, 2014. They establish principles for fair and transparent PPP agreements and define specific open competitive bidding procedures, including single-stage and two-stage envelope methods.

name: Punjab Prevention and Control of Dengue (Temporary) Regulations 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention and Control of Dengue (Temporary) Regulations, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Prevention and Control of Dengue (Temporary) Regulations, 2011
metadata.summary: These temporary regulations prescribe measures for the prevention and control of dengue in Punjab, effective from October 6, 2011. They outline specific responsibilities for owners and occupiers regarding waste disposal, water management, and vegetation removal to prevent mosquito breeding.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPLANTATION OF HUMAN ORGANS AND TISSUES RULES 2012

metadata.title: Punjab Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Rules 2012
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010 to regulate organ and tissue transplantation in Punjab. They define key terms, authorize donations during lifetime and after death, outline duties for transplant surgeons, and establish functions for Evaluation Committees.

name: CHILDREN LIBRARY COMPLEX, LAHORE EMPLOYEES (BENEVOLENT FUND) REGULATIONS 2022

metadata.title: The Children Library Complex, Lahore Employees (Benevolent Fund) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the Children Library Complex, Lahore Employees Benevolent Fund to provide financial relief and benefits to employees and their families. The fund is financed by monthly subscriptions from employees and contributions from the Complex, with grants available for deceased or incapacitated employees, as well as educational scholarships for their children.

metadata.title: The Children Library Complex, Lahore Rules, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Children Library Complex, Lahore, Rules, 1992
metadata.summary: These rules establish the administrative framework for the Children Library Complex in Lahore, including the constitution of its Board and the appointment of a principal officer-in-charge. They outline specific provisions regarding board meetings, fund management, record-keeping registers, annual financial reporting, and audit processes.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION FOUNDATION (CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 2005

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Conduct of Business) Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: These rules establish the conduct of business for the Punjab Education Foundation under the powers of Section 13 of the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004. They define key terms, outline the powers and duties of the Board of Directors and Managing Director, and prescribe procedures for meetings and decision-making.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION FOUNDATION (FINANCE AND AUDIT) RULES, 2005

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Finance and Audit) Rules, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Education Foundation (Maliyaat-Wa-Hisabaat) Qawaed, 1991
metadata.summary: These rules establish the financial and audit procedures for the Punjab Education Foundation. They define key terms, mandate specific banking accounts, outline payment and expenditure protocols, and prescribe record-keeping requirements.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (PEF) Rules & Regulations
metadata.summary: The document outlines the rules and regulations for the Punjab Education Foundation, which was restructured under the Punjab Education Foundation Act 2004. It details the composition of the Board of Directors, the foundation's vision to promote quality education through public-private partnerships, and its statutory functions including providing financial assistance and technical support to educational institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Examination Commission Business Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules define the organizational structure, functions, and procedures for the Punjab Examination Commission. They establish the roles of Directors and Committees, outline communication protocols, and prescribe methods for handling fees, assessments, and malpractices.

metadata.title: The Administrator General's (Punjab) Rules, 1914
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Lieutenant Governor of Punjab under the Administrator General's Act, 1913, to govern the administration of estates in the province. They establish procedures for asset disposal, fee calculation and payment, notice requirements for creditors, and the management of funds.

metadata.title: Administrator General's Punjab Rules, 2015
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for obtaining a certificate from the Administrator General of Punjab regarding the assets of a deceased person. They define terms, specify filing requirements, set fees, and outline the process for issuing certificates without advertisement in appropriate cases.

name: GUIDEBOOK FOR CONDUCTING INQUIRY UNDER THE PUNJAB EMPLOYEES EFFICIENCY, DISCIPLINE AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT 2006

metadata.title: Guidebook for conducting inquiry under the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act 2006
subjects: Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act
metadata.summary: This notification approves a guidebook designed to streamline departmental inquiries under the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act 2006. The document aims to eliminate delays by addressing common bottlenecks such as inadequate information, procedural lapses, and failures in hearing cases promptly.

metadata.title: The Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment Rules, 1985
metadata.summary: These Rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab to regulate the Anti-Corruption Establishment in the province. They define key terms, establish areas of jurisdiction for officials, and outline procedures for preliminary enquiries, case registration, and departmental actions against public servants.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION RULES 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004 to regulate the foundation's operations. They define key terms, establish eligibility criteria for government servants to become members, and outline procedures for membership application, termination, and removal of directors.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION RULES, 2005

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Rules, 2005
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation, defining membership eligibility, conditions for civil service members, and procedures for joining or terminating membership. They also outline regulations regarding financial contributions, account maintenance, allocation of residential units, and the removal of directors.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMNET SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (ALLOCATION OF HOUSES COMMERCIAL PLOTS) REGULATIONS 2006

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Allocation of Houses/Commercial Plots) Regulations, 2006
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation to allocate houses and commercial plots to its members. They define entitlement categories based on pay scales, outline the composition of the House Allocation Committee, and set procedures for confirmation, possession, and disposal of plots.

metadata.title: The Punjab Minister (Requisitioned Residence) Rules, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules govern the requisition of residences for Ministers in Punjab, including conditions regarding rent limits and ownership requirements. They also outline the Government's responsibilities to furnish, maintain, repair, and pay utility charges for these residences.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ministers (Furnishing of Residence) Rules, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the terms and conditions for furnishing or re-furnishing official residences of Ministers in the Punjab. They establish a maximum cost limit of one million rupees for new residences and outline procedures for assessment, inventory, maintenance, and repair of furniture and items.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) RULES, 1978

metadata.title: Punjab Public Service Commission (Conditions of Service) Rules, 1978
metadata.summary: These rules establish the conditions of service for the Chairman and Members of the Punjab Public Service Commission. They cover definitions, seniority determination, pay scales, allowances, pension eligibility, leave provisions, and qualifications for selecting new members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Functions) Rules, 1978
metadata.summary: These rules define the functions of the Punjab Public Service Commission regarding the conduct of tests and examinations for recruitment to provincial services and specific civil posts. They specify which posts are excluded from the Commission's purview and outline procedures for appointments, including exceptions for contract posts and transfers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission Regulations, 2000
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Punjab Public Service Commission's selection processes, including requisitions, examinations, and interviews. They supersede all previous regulations and come into force immediately.

metadata.title: Punjab Public Service Commission Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Punjab Public Service Commission's selection processes, including requisitions, examinations, and interviews. They define key terms related to vacancies, departments, and candidates while outlining procedures for advertising posts and handling discrepancies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under section 6 of the Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961. They establish the framework for preliminary enquiries, case registration, and the powers of ex-officio Directors and Deputy Directors within the anti-corruption establishment.

name: Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Rule, 1987

metadata.title: Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Council under the authority of the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981. They define key terms, outline the council's office location and functions, and prescribe procedures for meetings, motions, voting, and staff appointments.

name: PUNJAB EMPOWERMENT OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES RULES 2024

metadata.title: The Punjab Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2024
metadata.amends: The Punjab Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor of the Punjab under section 54 of the Punjab Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2022. They establish rights and entitlements for persons with disabilities regarding equality, accessibility, education, employment, and protection from violence.

name: THE VOLUNTARY SOCIAL WELFARE AGENCIES (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) RULES, 1962

metadata.title: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Rules, 1962
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government of West Pakistan under the Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961. They establish requirements for the registration, constitution, financial management, annual reporting, and dissolution of voluntary social welfare agencies.

name: THE VOLUNTARY SOCIAL WELFARE AGENCIES (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) RULES, 1962

metadata.title: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Rules, 1962
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government of West Pakistan under the Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961. They establish requirements for the registration, constitution, financial management, annual reporting, and dissolution of voluntary social welfare agencies.

metadata.title: TRANSFER POLICY – 2022
metadata.summary: This notification approves the Transfer Policy for the Special Education Department of the Government of the Punjab, effective immediately. It establishes merit-based criteria for transferring teaching and allied staff based on factors such as service in far-flung areas, wedlock, compassionate grounds, and disability. The policy also outlines specific categories where transfers are not banned and details the procedural requirements for requesting transfers via an e-portal.

name: PUNJAB HEALTHCARE COMMISSION (PRICING OF HEALTHCARE SERVICES) REGULATIONS, 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Pricing of Healthcare Services) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish a Pricing Cell/Department within the Punjab Healthcare Commission to determine and review prices for healthcare services. They apply to various categories of healthcare establishments, including public and private hospitals, diagnostic centers, and charitable institutions, while excluding public sector entities whose prices are determined by relevant authorities.

name: PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS RULES, 2003

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Rules, 2003
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the administration and management of Medical and Health Institutions in Punjab. They define the functions of various bodies such as the Board, Academic Council, and Executive Committee, along with provisions for employee appointments, finance, and audits.

name: THE STAGE CARRIAGES (CANCELLATION OF PERMITS OF ABSENTEES) REGULATION, 1969

metadata.title: The Stage Carriages (Cancellation of Permits of Absentees) Regulation, 1969
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation cancels permits for stage carriages held by absentees and applies to the whole of Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'absentee' and 'actual owner', allows cancelled permits to remain valid for a 20-day transition period, and mandates the surrender of cancelled permits within 15 days.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT SERVICE ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Service Act, 2022
metadata.repeals: Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services (Repeal and Revival) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the recruitment and conditions of service for persons appointed in the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat. It also provides for ancillary matters related to these employees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends section 8 of the Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act, 2019. Specifically, it substitutes subsection (1) regarding the election and term duration of the Chairman of the Governing Body.

name: PUNJAB LAWS (REPEALING AND REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: Punjab Laws (Repealing and Removal of Difficulties) Ordinance 2022
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act 2019 (IX of 2019); The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act 2021 (XXI of 2021); The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act 2021 (XXVI of 2021)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals specific laws deemed discriminatory, transgressive, arbitrary, or violative of constitutional provisions in the Punjab. It also establishes a requirement for the Secretary to issue notifications regarding the summoning and prorogation of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 by substituting references to 'Government' with 'Secretary' throughout various sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to provide contract employees with more opportunities for service regularization. Specifically, it inserts the phrase ', in three attempts,' into section 7 of the amended Act.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at providing inexpensive and expeditious justice. It establishes new objectives for courts, modifies jurisdictional limits based on suit value, and updates rules regarding the filing of plaints and written statements.

name: KING EDWARD MEDICAL UNIVERSITY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act of 2005 to incorporate provisions for its smooth implementation. It was promulgated by the Governor of Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Laws (Repealing and Removal of Difficulties) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 by inserting specific words into section 11C. It was passed on August 3, 2021, assented to on August 13, 2021, and published in the Punjab Gazette on August 16, 2021.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends section 12 of the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to modify provisions regarding the retirement age and service years for civil servants. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to rectify an inadvertent typographical mistake in its Sixth Schedule. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on February 11, 2021, as the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at reducing case backlogs and ensuring swift justice. It substitutes several sections regarding court hierarchy, institution of suits, written statements, and evidence recording, while also inserting new provisions for simultaneous summons service.

metadata.title: The Punjab Hotels and Restaurants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants Act, 1976 to adapt it for Punjab by replacing references to 'Federal' and 'Pakistan' with 'Punjab'. It introduces new provisions regarding the appointment of controllers, sealing of establishments, and specific penalties for non-compliance or failure to register.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act 2020 to facilitate its better implementation. It inserts a new section 28-A that empowers the Secretary to frame temporary regulations to prevent the outbreak or spread of infectious diseases.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by substituting 'twenty one months' for 'one year' in section 3. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by omitting specific entries from its Tenth Schedule. The changes remove certain provisions related to the levy of fees for licensing professions and vocations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Tourist Guides (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Tourist Guides Act, 1976 to adapt it for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' with 'Punjab', omits the word 'Federal', and defines 'Government' as the Government of the Punjab.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends section 10 of the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 by substituting 'twelve months' with 'twenty one months'. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to facilitate its better implementation. It substitutes specific words in Section 21 and updates entries in the First Schedule regarding permitted neighbourhood numbers for various metropolitan corporations.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reduces certain stamp duties in the urban areas of Punjab by substituting higher duty amounts with lower ones in the Stamp Act, 1899. It was promulgated by the Governor of Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and came into force on April 1, 2020.

metadata.title: Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance 2019
metadata.repeals: Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to broaden the definition of an employee. Specifically, it substitutes a clause in section 2 to ensure that employees are not disqualified solely because their monthly wages exceed the government-determined threshold.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends section 316 of the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by substituting the word 'seize' with 'cease'. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on November 16, 2019, under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to reduce the required continuous service period for regularization from four years to three years. It broadens the scope of the Act to include all contract employees who have served continuously for at least three years and meet specific eligibility criteria.

metadata.title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018 to address situations where a District Zakat and Ushr Committee's tenure expires without a new committee being constituted. It empowers the Government to assign the committee's functions to the Deputy Commissioner or another senior district officer until a new committee is formed.

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi Act, 2019 (XXIX of 2019)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi by reconstituting the Government Postgraduate College for Women. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its officers, authorities, functions, and statutory framework.

metadata.title: The University of Mianwali Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The University of Mianwali Act, 2019 (XXXI of 2019)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the University of Mianwali and related matters. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) (Amendment) Ordinance 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to update references from the Federal Government to the Government of the Punjab. It also substitutes 'the Punjab' for 'Pakistan' in specific sections and updates definitions regarding companies and workers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to extend the term of office for Administrators of District Education and Health Authorities in the Punjab. The change substitutes 'two years' for 'twelve months' in section 30 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.amends: The Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to facilitate business activities in the province. Specifically, it withdraws the registration and renewal fee requirements by modifying Section 24 of the original Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Order, 2002 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. The amendment omits a specific expression regarding the appointment of Provincial Police Officers from Article 11 of the original order.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to align it with the local government system established under the Punjab Local Government Act 2013. It specifically substitutes references to 'District Coordination Officer' with 'Deputy Commissioner' across various sections and repeals a previous amendment ordinance from 2017.

metadata.title: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by omitting a specific restriction on non-official member appointments in section 8. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB DISABLED PERSONS (EMPLOYMENT AND REHABILITATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981 by increasing the employment quota for disabled persons from two percent to three percent. It was promulgated by the Governor of Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007 to empower the Government to extend the term of the Director General under special circumstances. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Protection Unit Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of a Special Protection Unit within the Police of Punjab to offer dedicated security to foreigners, important persons, and premises. It outlines the unit's structure, ranks, terms of service, functions, fee structures for services rendered, and rules regarding appointments and conduct.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by omitting section 118-A and inserting a new section 195-B. It also includes amendments to the Second, Fifth, and Sixth Schedules of the parent ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 by inserting a new section and modifying its Third and Eighth Schedules. It was promulgated on June 6, 2014, and subsequently repealed by Act XXII of 2014.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 by substituting and amending specific sections. It was promulgated on October 16, 2014, and subsequently repealed by Act XXIV of 2014.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an enabling environment for the private sector to participate in development projects within the Punjab through public-private partnerships. It outlines institutional arrangements, project delivery processes, and definitions related to financing, construction, and operation of infrastructure services.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act, 2007
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act, 2007 (XIV of 2007)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Public Defender Service and outlines its constitution, administration, and hierarchy. It defines the roles, qualifications, and functions of the Chief Public Defender, Additional Chief Public Defenders, District Public Defenders, and Public Defenders.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Security) Act, 1999
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Punjab Assembly and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab in early February 1999. It establishes provisions regarding the security of establishments, penalties for violations, and related rules.

name: PUNJAB ANIMALS COMPOUND FEEDING STUFF ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Compound Feeding Stuff Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Animals Compound Feed and Feed Stuff Ordinance 2002
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, sale, and labeling of compound feeding stuffs for animals in Punjab. It establishes provisions for quality control, prohibits adulteration, and outlines the powers of appointed inspectors regarding sampling and analysis.

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the validation of certain orders made by settlement commissioners. It was subsequently repealed by the Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) (Repeal) Act, 2012.

name: PUNJAB REGULATION AND CONTROL OF LOUDSPEAKERS AND SOUND AMPLIFIERS ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Punjab Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This document is the Punjab Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965. It was issued as Ordinance II of 1965 by the Punjab government.

metadata.title: The Glanders and Farcy Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to glanders and farcy in horses. It defines diseased animals, empowers provincial governments to appoint inspectors, and grants authorities powers of entry, search, and seizure to prevent the spread of dangerous epidemic diseases.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 by updating specific sections regarding financial clauses and auditing requirements. It also adds provisions for health and training institutions established under the Ordinance to comply with relevant federal or provincial laws.

name: PROVINCIAL EMPLOYEES’ SOCIAL SECURITY (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Second Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to update references regarding minimum wages. Specifically, it substitutes the Punjab Minimum Wages Act 2019 for the Minimum Wages Ordinance 1961 and adjusts contribution provisions effective from July 1, 2022.

name: PUNJAB AUTISM SCHOOL AND RESOURCE CENTRE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre Act, 2025 by modifying section 4. Specifically, it inserts the phrase 'or a person nominated by the Chief Minister' after the words 'Chief Minister' in subsection (2), clause (a) of that Act.

name: PUNJAB CENTER OF EXCELLENCE ON COUNTERING VIOLENT EXTREMISM (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act, 2025 by adding a new subsection to section 3. The amendment establishes the Center as a body corporate with perpetual succession, the power to acquire property, and the authority to sue or be sued.

metadata.title: The Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Judicial Academy Act, 2007 to update specific sections regarding location, faculty requirements, and training scope. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026.

metadata.title: The Punjab Legal Aid (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Legal Aid (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Legal Aid Act, 2018 to include new categories of persons eligible for legal aid and to define specific tribunals. It also updates procedural mechanisms regarding indigent persons and repeals a previous ordinance from the same year.

metadata.title: The Punjab Protected Areas (Amendment) Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protected Areas Act 2020 to update specific sections regarding clauses and permissions. It substitutes new expressions in sections 10, 21, and 22 of the original Act to modify regulatory terms and conditions.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Stamp (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to introduce a new definition for 'assignable deed' and adjust stamp duty rates for such deeds. It also modifies specific articles within the original Act regarding proper stamp duties and repeals the preceding Stamp (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026.

metadata.title: The University of Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to expand academic branches and faculties. It specifically allows for the establishment of Agriculture and Veterinary Sciences faculties, online learning programs, and offshore campuses.

metadata.title: Anti-terrorism (Punjab Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Anti-terrorism Act, 1997 by modifying specific subsections regarding detention orders and inquiry procedures. It establishes requirements for joint investigation teams involving police, intelligence agencies, and armed forces when orders are issued by such entities.

metadata.title: Companies Profits (Workers Participation) (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 1968 by substituting references to 'Government' with 'Institution' in various sections. It also inserts a new definition for 'Institution' and adds provisions regarding recovery charges determined by a Committee.

metadata.title: Drugs (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to update the composition of Drug Courts. It specifies that a Drug Court shall consist of a Chairperson and two members with specific qualifications and experience in pharmaceutical and medical fields.

metadata.title: Lahore Leads University (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Leads University Act, 2011 to update provisions regarding constituent colleges, teaching methods, and board composition. It also authorizes the establishment of sub-campuses abroad and allows for the removal of difficulties in implementing the Act.

metadata.title: The Notaries (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Notaries Ordinance, 1961 to restrict its application from Pakistan to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Provincial Government with the Secretary or authorized officers and omits specific sections regarding fees and tenure.

metadata.title: The Probation of Offenders (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960 to adapt its provisions specifically for the Punjab province. It introduces definitions for community service, expands the authority of Deputy Commissioners in supervising probationers, and sets conditions courts must consider when mandating community service.

metadata.title: Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to insert provisions for financial benefits. It allows secured persons to purchase essential commodities from government-notified outlets upon approval and fund availability.

metadata.title: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019 to update provisions regarding mediator judges and expert nominations. It also modifies the appointment process for the Director General of the Authority and removes specific clauses regarding perks and privileges for retired officials.

metadata.title: Punjab Arms (Amendment) Act, 2025
