metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Arms Ordinance, 1965 to introduce regulations regarding gun shooting clubs and clarify definitions for non-prohibited bore arms. It substitutes various sections of the original ordinance to replace references to the Government with the Secretary and Magistrates with Deputy Commissioners, while also adding new offenses and penalties for unauthorized possession or carrying of weapons.

metadata.title: Punjab Consumer Protection (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 to update definitions regarding commercial purposes and online transactions. It also modifies provisions related to fines for violations and redesignates District Judges as Consumer Courts under the Lahore High Court.

metadata.title: Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Judicial Academy Act, 2007 to update definitions regarding rules and regulations, establish sub-campuses, and expand the Board's functions. It also introduces provisions for committees, rule-making by the Government, and regulation-framing by the Board.

name: PUNJAB LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.amends: Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act 2021 to reduce hardship for people in Punjab. It inserts references to civil courts into section 3 and omits section 10 of the original Act.

metadata.title: Punjab Public Representatives' Laws (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.amends: Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act 1975; Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends three specific laws relating to the salaries and allowances of public representatives in the Province of Punjab. It substitutes fixed monetary amounts with references to the current salary scales for Ministers, the Speaker, and the Deputy Speaker.

metadata.title: Punjab Road Safety Authority (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Road Safety Authority Act 2023 to update provisions regarding appointments, budgeting, and financial management. It introduces a specific fund for the Authority, mandates annual audits by the Auditor General of Pakistan alongside chartered accountants, and establishes rules for maintaining accounts and incurring expenditure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vagrancy (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958 to update definitions regarding organizers and persons, including transgender individuals. It substitutes sections on punishment for organizing or employing people to solicit alms, cognizance of offences, and jurisdiction for trials.

metadata.title: Stamp (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 by updating provisions related to valuation appeals, section numbering, and refund procedures for spoiled stamps. It also modifies the authority responsible for writing in specific subsections of the original act.

metadata.title: The Police Order (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 to establish Organized Crime Units in every district for handling specific serious offenses. It defines the leadership hierarchy for these units and lists categories of cases eligible for transfer, such as kidnapping, extortion, and drug trafficking. Additionally, the Act repeals the previous amendment ordinance from 2023.

metadata.title: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019 to update definitions, timelines, and procedural requirements for ADR proceedings. It introduces new clauses regarding authorities and chairpersons while modifying existing sections related to case returns and service providers.

name: PUNJAB GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009 by altering section 9. Specifically, it substitutes the phrase 'more than seventy-five' with 'up to one hundred' in clause (d) of that section.

metadata.title: The University of Gujrat (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Gujrat Act, 2004 to restore the status and premises of specific colleges that were previously transferred to the university. It also reverses the transfer of properties, rights, interests, and liabilities held by those colleges back to their original ownership.

name: PUNJAB INDUSTRIES (CONTROL ON ESTABLISHMENT AND ENLARGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963. It substitutes section 11 of the 1963 Ordinance to allow the Government to exempt industrial undertakings from provisions or regularize past contraventions upon payment of determined requitals.

name: PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to provide lifetime security for former Chief Ministers who served at least six months after the 2002 elections. It substitutes a new section 21-A into the parent Act to define these perks and privileges.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to modify Section 4. It grants the Chief Minister the authority to specify posts and regularize contract employees in the public interest without reference to the Commission.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to modify provisions regarding the retirement of civil servants. Specifically, it substitutes clause (ii) of section 12 to define retirement conditions based on age or years of service.

name: PUNJAB COMPULSORY TEACHING OF THE HOLY QURAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2018 to update definitions regarding compulsory teaching and Naazrah Quran. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May 18, 2021, and assented to by the Governor on May 28, 2021.

name: PUNJAB HOLY QURAN (PRINTING AND RECORDING) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011 to strengthen provisions against translating or interpreting the Holy Quran contrary to Muslim beliefs. It increases penalties for such offenses, adds a new subsection for intentional derogatory use punishable by life imprisonment, and designates related offenses as cognizable and non-bailable.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act 2020 to facilitate its better implementation. It inserts a new section allowing the Secretary to frame temporary regulations to prevent outbreaks and determine expense defrayal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by omitting specific entries from its Tenth Schedule regarding fees for licensing professions and vocations. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance 2020.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Representatives' Laws (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to the public representatives of the Province of Punjab. It specifically updates provisions regarding salaries, allowances, and privileges for members, ministers, speakers, and advisors.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act 2013. It specifically alters provisions regarding the Commissioner's term of office and procedures for examining information during complaint inquiries.

name: PUNJAB CURRICULUM AND TEXTBOOK BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Act, 2015 to introduce new requirements for publishing religious textbooks. Specifically, it mandates that any textbook or curriculum related to Islam must receive prior approval from both the Muttahida Ulema Board Punjab and the Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board before publication.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by substituting 'twenty one months' for 'one year' in section 3. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance 2020.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Act 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 by substituting 'twenty one months' for 'twelve months' in section 10. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance 2020.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to improve its implementation. It substitutes specific words in section 21 and updates entries in the First Schedule regarding permitted neighbourhood numbers for various metropolitan corporations.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to broaden the definition of an employee. Specifically, it substitutes a clause in section 2 to ensure that employees are not disqualified solely because their monthly wages exceed government-determined limits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Representatives' Laws (Amendment) Act 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to the public representatives of the Province of Punjab. It updates salaries, allowances, and privileges for members of the Provincial Assembly, Ministers, Speakers, and other officials.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to reduce the required period of continuous service from four years to three years for contract employees. It broadens the scope of regularization eligibility and specifies conditions such as vacancy availability and satisfactory performance. The Act also repeals the earlier Ordinance passed on the same subject matter.

metadata.title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018 to update provisions regarding the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Council, District Committees, and Local Committees. It includes changes to eligibility criteria for council members, fund disbursement procedures, and mechanisms for appointing administrators when elections cannot be held.

metadata.title: Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act 2015 to increase the permitted number of external sound systems from one to four. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Explosive Substances (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Explosive Substances Act, 1908 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It modifies section 7 by substituting a full stop with a colon and adding a proviso regarding deemed consent for trial proceedings.

metadata.title: The Limitation (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Limitation Act, 1908 to establish a ninety-day limitation period for filing revision petitions under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It inserts a new Article 162-A into Part X of the First Schedule of the Limitation Act, 1908.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act, 2015 to increase the permitted number of external sound systems at places of worship from one to four. It specifically allows these systems for Azan, religious recitations, and announcements regarding lost or found items.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 to harmonize its provisions with current necessities. It introduces specific changes regarding definitions, permissions for public park usage, lease terms, and repeals a previous amendment ordinance.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to align it with the local government system established under the Punjab Local Government Act 2013. It specifically substitutes references to 'District Coordination Officer' with 'Deputy Commissioner' across various sections and repeals a previous amendment ordinance from 2017.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ehtram-e-Ramazan (Amendment) Act 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ehtram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981 to update and rationalize provisions specifically for the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific words in various sections of the Ordinance regarding jurisdiction, fines, arrest powers, and government authority.

metadata.title: The Police Order (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It omits a specific expression regarding the appointment of Provincial Police Officers from Article 11 and repeals the previous Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017.

name: THE PUNJAB EMPLOYEES EFFICIENCY, DISCIPLINE AND ACCOUNTABILITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006 to specify time limits for punishments and grant appeal rights to former employees. It also substitutes ninety days with sixty days in certain sections regarding case resolution timelines.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 to preserve trees on public land. It introduces specific penalties for illegally cutting trees without prior permission from the Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007 to empower the Government to extend the term of the Director General under special circumstances. It also validates actions taken by the Government between the repeal of a previous Ordinance and the commencement of this Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Maternity Benefits (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maternity Benefits Ordinance, 1958 to further regulate employment conditions for women. It specifically substitutes Section 3 of the Ordinance to prohibit employing women during six weeks before and after childbirth and restricts arduous work.

name: THE PUNJAB PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Representatives' Laws (Amendment) Act 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to the public representative offices of the Province of Punjab. Specifically, it updates salary figures, allowances, and privileges for members of the Provincial Assembly, Parliamentary Secretaries, Ministers, and the Speaker.

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 to grant administrative and operational autonomy to the Punjab Board of Technical Education. It achieves this by omitting a specific subsection from section 5 of the original 2010 Act and repealing the corresponding 2015 Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by removing a restriction on consecutive terms for non-official members. It also repeals the previous Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 by inserting new clauses and modifying existing sections regarding rules, regulations, and board composition. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on February 19, 2015, and came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: PUNJAB DISABLED PERSONS (EMPLOYMENT AND REHABILITATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981 by increasing the employment quota from two percent to three percent. It also repeals the Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF EXPRESSING MATTERS ON WALLS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Act, 1995
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Act, 1995 by increasing fines and adding provisions for summary trials. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance from 2015.

metadata.title: The Punjab Strategic Coordination (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Strategic Coordination Act, 2014 to update the composition of the Provincial Security Council. It substitutes the existing subsection (1) with a new list of members including the Chief Minister, Home Minister, Law Minister, nominated assembly members, and various secretaries.

name: PUNJAB EMPLOYEES EFFICIENCY, DISCIPLINE AND ACCOUNTABILITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006. It specifically substitutes section 19 to regulate appeals before the Punjab Service Tribunal regarding final orders passed under sections 16 or 17 of the amended act.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to adapt provisions specifically for the Punjab province. It updates various sections regarding government definitions, wage limits, survivor pensions, and the establishment of medical institutions through public-private partnerships.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963. It specifically substitutes clause (a) of section 2 in the original Act to redefine the term 'animal' for legal purposes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by inserting a new section regarding additional powers of taxation for local governments. It also includes savings provisions to validate taxes levied prior to the Act's commencement under previous procedures.

name: PUNJAB WEIGHTS AND MEASURES (INTERNATIONAL SYSTEM) ENFORCEMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Weights and Measures (International System) Enforcement (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Weights and Measures (International System) Enforcement Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Weights and Measures (International System) Enforcement Act, 1975 to include new definitions for terms such as 'calibration', 'counterfeit', 'repairer', and 'seal'. It also modifies existing sections regarding penalties for forging stamps, using false instruments, and selling goods with deficient weight or measure.

metadata.title: The Administrator General's (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Administrator General's Act, 1913 to update provisions regarding the appointment and powers of the Administrator General in Punjab. It specifically revises sections related to estate administration thresholds, the definition of 'Government', and procedures for granting certificates when assets do not exceed one hundred thousand rupees.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to establish the Government as a shareholder capable of holding up to eighty percent of the bank's issued shares. It also repeals the earlier Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011.

metadata.title: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928. It substitutes the word 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' in section 1, subsection (2) of the original 1928 Act.

name: HINDU LAW OF INHERITANCE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT 2012

metadata.title: The Hindu Law of Inheritance (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Hindu Law of Inheritance (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Hindu Law of Inheritance (Amendment) Act, 1929. It substitutes the word 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' in section 1, subsection (2) of the 1929 Act.

metadata.title: The Injured Persons (Medical Aid) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Injured Persons (Medical Aid) Act, 2004 to restrict its application to the Punjab region. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' and defines 'Government' as the Government of the Punjab. Additionally, it grants the Government power to make rules for carrying out the purposes of the Act.

metadata.title: The Official Trustees (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Official Trustees Act, 1913 to restrict its application specifically to the Punjab province. It also updates definitions regarding the Government and clarifies the appointment of an Official Trustee for the Province.

metadata.title: The Powers of Attorney (Amendment) Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Powers of Attorney Act, 1882 by substituting a new subsection regarding its extension to the whole of Punjab. It also omits sections 4 and 5 from the said Act.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a second amendment to the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972. It comes into force immediately upon enactment and specifically substitutes the phrase 'one thousand rupees' with 'twenty thousand rupees' in section 11 of the amended Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963. It specifically updates the definition of 'animal' within section 2 of the original 1963 Act to include various domesticated species.

metadata.title: The Punjab Bonded Labour System (Abolition) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992 to apply its provisions specifically to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and adjusts various penalties and definitions within the original legislation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Punjab Katchi Abadis Act, 1992. Specifically, it substitutes the figure '2006' with '2011' in section 6, subsection (1) of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It specifically inserts a new sub-section (5a) into section 179-A of that Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958 to apply it specifically to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to 'West Pakistan' and 'Pakistan' with 'Punjab', changes the definition of Government to mean the Government of the Punjab, increases financial limits, and omits section 15 of the said Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF BREAST-FEEDING AND CHILD NUTRITION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002 to adapt it for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and establishes a Punjab Infant Feeding Board.

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) (Repeal) Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972. It also provides that any actions or orders taken under the repealed Act are deemed to have been taken under this new legislation.

name: PUNJAB REVISION OF MEDICAL FACILITIES OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT 2006

metadata.title: The Punjab Revision of Medical Facilities of Public Representatives Act, 2006
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries. Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Special Assistants (Salary. Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Advisors (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act revises the medical facilities available to holders of representative offices in the Province of Punjab. It extends these benefits to include the parents, spouse, and dependent children of Members, Ministers, Speakers, Deputy Speakers, Parliamentary Secretaries, Special Assistants, and Advisors.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 by substituting the term 'Managing Director' with 'President' in various sections and updating share capital figures. It also repeals the earlier Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005.

metadata.title: The Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment (Amendment) Act 2005
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend the Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Government College University, Faisalabad (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Government College University, Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Government College University, Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002 to introduce new roles and powers for the Chancellor and Pro-Chancellor. It specifically designates the Minister for Education of the Punjab as the Pro-Chancellor and grants the Chancellor powers similar to a Provincial Governor.

metadata.title: The Government College University, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Government College University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Government College University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to clarify the role of the Pro-Chancellor and define the Chancellor's powers. It specifically designates the Minister for Education as the Pro-Chancellor and aligns the Chancellor's functions with those of a Provincial Governor under Article 105 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The University of Sargodha (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Sargodha Ordinance, 2002 to introduce new definitions and roles regarding the Pro-Chancellor. It specifically designates the Minister for Education of the Government of the Punjab as the Pro-Chancellor and outlines their duties.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 by substituting the word 'Governor' with 'Government' in section 10. It also repeals the earlier Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.

metadata.title: The Lahore Arts Council (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002; The Lahore Arts Council (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by substituting the word 'Governor' with 'Chief Minister' in specific sections. It also repeals two previous ordinances related to the Lahore Arts Council.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by changing a specific date in section 24 from December 31, 2002 to June 30, 2003. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.

name: PUNJAB OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2003

metadata.title: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman (Amendment) Act 2003
metadata.amends: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997 to modify provisions regarding High Court judges and sitting judges acting as ombudsmen. Specifically, it alters eligibility criteria for sitting judges and changes the tenure requirements for ombudsmen.

name: PUNJAB REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2003

metadata.title: The Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.amends: The Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 by substituting references to the Governor with the Chief Minister in specific sections. It also deletes certain phrases involving the Governor and repeals a previous amendment ordinance from 2002.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION NO. 118 (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Martial Law Regulation No. 118 (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Ordinances Temporary Enactment Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends Martial Law Regulation No. 118 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It deletes specific paragraphs, substitutes paragraph 10 regarding assets of privately managed colleges and schools, and repeals the Punjab Ordinances Temporary Enactment Act, 1973.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific terms in sections 20 and 68 regarding Divisional and Sub-Divisional Canal Officers and establishes procedures for appeals against water distribution orders.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to include sub-soil water and tube-wells within its scope for West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ANIMALS SLAUGHTER CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to update its provisions regarding territorial scope and specific animal categories. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Police (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Act, 1861 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces a new section allowing for the summary disposal of cases where an accused person pleads guilty and pays a specified sum.

name: AGA KHAN PROPERTIES (SUCCESSION AND TRANSFER) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Aga Khan Properties (Succession and Transfer) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the automatic and undisputed succession and transfer of Aga Khan's properties in Punjab to his successor without requiring probate or other legal formalities. It ensures the continuity of custodianship by exempting these transfers from various taxes, fees, and duties while allowing for specific exceptions made by the Aga Khan during his lifetime.

metadata.title: The Akhtar Saeed University Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Akhtar Saeed University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its governing bodies and faculties, and grants powers to establish departments, prescribe courses, and confer degrees.

metadata.title: The Anti-Terrorism (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997 to establish procedures for special security cases involving terrorism. It introduces new provisions for conducting trials with enhanced confidentiality measures, including sealed records, undisclosed identities, and the use of virtual proceedings.

name: ASSET MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY OF PUNJAB ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Asset Management Authority of Punjab Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Asset Management Authority of Punjab to effectively manage and utilize government assets. It aims to attract investment, undertake economic projects with private partners, generate revenue, and improve service delivery.

name: CENTRAL UNIVERSITY OF EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES ACT 2026

metadata.title: Central University of Emerging Technologies Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Central University of Emerging Technologies as a private sector body corporate in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and various faculties covering fields such as Computer Science, Medicine, and Engineering.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 by substituting 'Secretary to Government of the Punjab, Public Prosecution Department' for 'the Provincial Government' in section 417. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on February 04, 2026, and received assent from the Governor on February 25, 2026.

metadata.title: Ghani University, Sheikhupura Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Ghani University, Sheikhupura as a private sector body corporate located in the Punjab province. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various faculties covering sciences, arts, engineering, and law.

name: BAHAWALPUR STATE COURT OF WARDS ACT 1942

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur State Court of Wards Act, 1942
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur State Court of Wards Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This document records the repeal of The Bahawalpur State Court of Wards Act, 1942. It was enacted via the Punjab Laws (Amendment) Act 2011 and became effective on April 20, 2011.

metadata.title: The Electricity Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the supply and use of electrical energy in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for granting licenses to supply energy, defining key terms related to electricity infrastructure, and outlining the procedures for applications and objections regarding energy supply areas.

metadata.title: The Hindu Gains of Learning Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act removes doubt regarding the rights of a member of a Hindu undivided family to property acquired through their learning. It establishes that such gains are the exclusive and separate property of the acquirer, regardless of who imparted the learning or who supported the family during the acquisition.

metadata.title: The Identification of Prisoners Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the taking of measurements and photographs of convicts and other persons involved in criminal proceedings. It defines specific terms such as 'measurements' and 'police officer', outlines the powers of Magistrates to order these actions, and establishes procedures for resistance, record destruction upon acquittal, and rule-making.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (Drivers) Ordinance, 1942
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the requisitioning of services from persons capable of driving motor vehicles on behalf of the Government during an emergency. It establishes a register of drivers, outlines procedures for notifying address changes, and grants officers the power to order registered individuals to perform driving services.

metadata.title: The Naturalization Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the naturalization of aliens resident in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for granting certificates of naturalization, including requirements regarding residence duration, good character, and language knowledge.

metadata.title: The Petroleum Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the import, transport, storage, production, refining, and blending of petroleum and other inflammable substances. It establishes rules for licensing, inspection, testing standards, and penalties for offenses regarding these activities.

name: VOLUNTARY SOCIAL WELFARE AGENCIES (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2012

metadata.title: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961. It substitutes references to the 'Provincial Government' with 'Government' and restricts the jurisdiction of the Punjab section by replacing 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab'. The definition of 'Government' is also updated to specifically mean the Government of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 38 of the Registration Act, 1908 to include overseas persons in specific clauses. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent on November 20, 2024.

metadata.title: The Registration (Second Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 to regulate and supervise the profession of conveyance writing. It also introduces penalties for individuals who engage in conveyance writing without a valid enrolment or license.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to provide for the mode of election to Village and Neighbourhood Councils. It includes ancillary amendments regarding definitions, constituency delimitation, and election methods for various local government bodies.

metadata.title: The Globexa International University, Lahore Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Globexa International University, Lahore as a private sector body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board of Governors, and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its powers to administer academic programs and award degrees.

name: PROVINCIAL EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Second Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to update references from the Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961 to the Punjab Minimum Wages Act 2019. It also modifies section 20 of the Ordinance regarding contribution payments deemed valid under the new minimum wage act.

name: PUNJAB AUTISM SCHOOL AND RESOURCE CENTRE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre Act, 2025 by modifying Section 4. Specifically, it inserts the phrase 'or a person nominated by the Chief Minister' after the words 'Chief Minister' in subsection (2), clause (a) of that section.

name: PUNJAB CENTER OF EXCELLENCE ON COUNTERING VIOLENT EXTREMISM (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act, 2025 to grant the Center corporate status with perpetual succession and the power to enter contracts and acquire property. It also allows the Center to sue or be sued in its own name, subject to government approval for disposing of immovable property.

metadata.title: The Punjab Child Marriage Restraint Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929 and the Punjab Child Marriage Restraint Ordinance 2026
metadata.summary: This Act aims to restrain child marriages in the Punjab province and provides for related matters. It establishes penalties for contracting child marriages, committing child abuse, trafficking children, and guardians involved in such acts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings (Repeal) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960. It provides for the implementation and transfer of pending consolidation schemes to district collectors within specified timeframes.

name: PUNJAB CONTROL OF NARCOTIC SUBSTANCES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Narcotic Substances (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2025 to update references to official gazettes and specific controlled substances. It also inserts a new section regarding rewards for commendable service in enforcing the Act.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006. Specifically, it substitutes the expression 'Secretary to the Government, Public Prosecution Department' for the words 'the Government' in section 13, subsection (6), clause (ii) of the amended Act.

name: PUNJAB EMPLOYEES EFFICIENCY, DISCIPLINE AND ACCOUNTABILITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006. It specifically substitutes a proviso in section 21 regarding the time limits for finalizing proceedings against retired employees.

name: PUNJAB EMPOWERMENT OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Amendment) Act 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Act 2022 to update definitions regarding blindness and visual impairment. It also inserts a new clause into Section 19 concerning the Secretary to Government of the Punjab, Planning and Development Board.

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to update provisions regarding climate change and e-waste. It also modifies various sections of the original act to adjust committee compositions, departmental responsibilities, and enforcement procedures.

metadata.title: THE PUNJAB FILM CITY AUTHORITY ACT 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Film City Authority to regulate and promote the film industry within the province. It aims to foster creative fields, strengthen cultural identity, generate employment, and ensure best practices in the sector.

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Safety Laws (Amendment) Act 2026
metadata.amends: Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950; Punjab Food Authority Act 2011; Punjab Registration of Godowns Act 2014; Punjab Halal Development Agency Act 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws in the Punjab to harmonize the food safety regulatory framework and reduce administrative burdens. It specifically updates definitions, substituting references to the 'Cane Commissioner' with the 'Director General (Food)/Cane Commissioner' and establishing the 'Food Safety and Consumer Protection Department' as the Administrative Department across multiple statutes.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING AND TOWN PLANNING AGENCY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Housing and Town Planning Agency (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Housing and Town Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Housing and Town Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002. It specifically substitutes section 19 of the Ordinance to allow the Agency to raise funds by imposing rates, fees, and other charges.

metadata.title: The Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Judicial Academy Act, 2007 to update provisions regarding the academy's location, training scope, and faculty qualifications. It specifically repeals the earlier Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to incorporate digital technologies into land record management and survey processes. It updates definitions for terms like 'Digital Cadaster' and 'parcel', modifies appointment duties for Kanungos and Patwaris, and alters provisions regarding summons service via electronic means.

metadata.title: The Punjab Legal Aid (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Legal Aid (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Legal Aid Act, 2018 to include new categories of persons eligible for legal aid and to define specific tribunals. It also updates procedural mechanisms regarding the Agency's role in providing aid to indigent persons and other declared categories.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to include academies, coaching centers, and tuition centers within its regulatory scope. It also inserts a new section granting the Government power to issue instructions for regulating these institutions.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC UTILITIES INFRASTRUCTURE PROTECTION ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Utilities Infrastructure Protection Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to prevent the theft, unauthorized removal, damage, and illegal maintenance of public utilities infrastructure in the Punjab. It defines specific offenses related to these activities and prescribes imprisonment terms and fines for violators, including scrap dealers and owners of re-rolling plants.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 to update definitions regarding regulations and substitute terms like 'Assistant Commissioner' with 'Enforcement Officer/Audit Officer'. It also modifies tax rates for specific services such as telecommunications and carriage of goods.

name: PUNJAB SKILLS DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP AUTHORITY ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Skills Development and Entrepreneurship Authority Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Skills Development and Entrepreneurship Authority to promote and regulate technical and vocational education. It creates a body corporate with powers to establish institutes, monitor them, assess students, and issue certifications within the province.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vegetable Market (Lahore) (Repeal) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Vegetable Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Vegetable Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963 because its objectives have been fulfilled. The repeal applies immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979 to update definitions and administrative provisions regarding the Chief Administrator of Augaf. It specifically substitutes text in sections 2 and 3 of the Ordinance to clarify the role of the Chief Administrator and establish eligibility criteria.

name: PUNJAB WAQF, TRUSTS AND COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES (MONITORING) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf, Trusts and Cooperative Societies (Monitoring) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Commission to monitor and oversee the regulation of Waqf, trusts, and cooperative societies in the Punjab. It aims to implement a beneficial ownership regime, risk-based supervisory plans, and training activities related to these institutions.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This document amends the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on April 29, 2026, and received assent from the Governor on May 11, 2026.

name: QUAID-E-AZAM INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT SCIENCES, SARGODHA ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Quaid-e-Azam Institute of Management Sciences, Sargodha Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Quaid-e-Azam Institute of Management Sciences, Sargodha as a body corporate in the private sector. It provides for the institute's structure, functions, and the establishment of faculties such as Computer Sciences and Business Management.

metadata.title: Revolution University, Faisalabad Act 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Revolution University, Faisalabad as a private sector body corporate located in the Punjab province. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Vice-Chancellor, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The University of Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to expand academic branches and faculties. It also authorizes the establishment of offshore campuses and online learning programs while updating the university's powers regarding campus administration.

metadata.title: The Baha-ud-Din Zakariya University (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Baha-ud-Din Zakariya University Act, 1975. It was enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent on November 12, 2025.

metadata.title: The Grand Asian University, Sialkot (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Grand Asian University, Sialkot Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Grand Asian University, Sialkot Act, 2021 to update its provisions regarding faculty establishment and governance. Specifically, it modifies sections related to the university's constitution, administrative clauses, and the list of prescribed faculties.

metadata.title: The Imperial Tutorials College University (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Imperial Tutorials College University Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Imperial Tutorials College University Act, 2020 to update provisions regarding appointments and roles within the university administration. It specifically revises sections concerning the Vice Chancellor, Registrar, and Treasurer, including eligibility criteria, appointment procedures, and tenure rules.

name: MUKABBIR UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY, GUJRAT (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Mukabbir University of Science & Technology, Gujrat (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Mukabbir University of Science & Technology, Gujrat Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Mukabbir University of Science & Technology, Gujrat Act, 2025 to update its short title and commencement provisions. It specifically revises Section 4 to clarify the names of the university's faculties, including Sciences, Computer Science, Social Sciences, and Mathematics and Statistics.

name: NATIONAL UNIVERSITY, TOBA TEK SINGH ACT 2025

metadata.title: National University, Toba Tek Singh Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National University, Toba Tek Singh as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university powers to administer various faculties including Engineering, Law, Sciences, and Arts, while defining the roles of its governing bodies such as the Board and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Orion International University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Orion International University as a private sector body corporate in the Punjab province. It provides for the university's administration, instruction, training, and the award of degrees across various faculties including engineering, sciences, and law.

name: PUNJAB CONTROL OF NARCOTICS SUBSTANCES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Narcotics Substances (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Control of Narcotics Substances Act, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Punjab control of Narcotics Substances (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Control of Narcotics Substances Act, 2025 to modify provisions regarding bail, court jurisdiction, and procedural requirements. It also repeals a previous amendment ordinance from the same year.

name: PUNJAB DESTITUTE AND NEGLECTED CHILDREN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act, 2004 by substituting specific words in several sections of the original law. The amendments primarily change conjunctions from 'and' to 'or' and modify punctuation at the end of clauses to allow for alternative actions or conditions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Enforcement and Regulation (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Enforcement and Regulation Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Enforcement and Regulation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Enforcement and Regulation Act, 2024 by omitting specific references to section 14-A and substituting terms related to authorized officers and budget approval processes. It also introduces new guidelines for employees of the Authority under the Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Finance Act, 1964 and other related laws to update definitions regarding energy generation and self-consumption. It introduces new provisions for levying Electricity Duty on non-licensee generators and establishes penalties for failure to pay such duties.

name: PUNJAB TOURISM AND HERITAGE AUTHORITY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Tourism and Heritage Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Tourism and Heritage Authority to promote, manage, and develop tourism and heritage-related activities in the province. It defines the composition of the Authority, including a Chairperson appointed by the Chief Minister and various members representing different government departments.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION INITIATIVES MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority to devise and manage initiatives in the education sector. It provides for the establishment of a body corporate with powers to enter contracts, acquire property, and partner with the private sector.

name: UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES, LAHORE ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Health Sciences, Lahore and provides for its incorporation, powers, and functions. It outlines the structure of various authorities including the Board of Governors, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while also defining roles for officers such as the Chancellor and Vice Chancellor.

metadata.title: The Amending Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments related to the Naval Discipline Act, 1934. It substitutes the word 'naval' for 'military' and 'sailor' for 'soldier' in various sections of the Indian Army Act, 1911, and other related laws.

name: ROYAL UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMENT, INFORMATION AND SCIENCES, MULTAN ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Royal University of Management, Information and Sciences, Multan Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Royal University of Management, Information and Sciences, Multan as a private sector body corporate in Punjab. It defines the university's functions, powers, and structure, including its faculties such as Engineering, Arts, and Health Sciences.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND EMERGING SCIENCES ACT 2025

metadata.title: The University of Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Sciences Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Sciences as a private sector institution with its main campus in Lahore. It provides for the establishment, maintenance, and administration of the university along with its departments, constituent colleges, schools, centers of excellence, and laboratories.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to update various sections regarding wage limits, government definitions, and benefit calculations. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: Punjab Drugs Rules, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of Punjab under section 44 of the Drugs Act, 1976 to regulate drugs within the province. They establish the composition and functions of the Provincial Quality Control Board and District Quality Control Boards, define key terms related to drug storage and sale, and outline procedures for reporting and supervision.

name: AQUACULTURE AUTHORITY OF THE PUNJAB ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Aquaculture Authority of the Punjab Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Aquaculture Authority of the Punjab to regulate the aquaculture industry and facilitate private stakeholders. Its primary objectives include developing the sector, improving food security, creating employment opportunities, and generating revenue for the province.

name: CHENAB UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, RAHIM YAR KHAN ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Chenab University of Science and Technology, Rahim Yar Khan Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Chenab University of Science and Technology, Rahim Yar Khan as a private sector body corporate in Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board, and various faculties, while outlining its functions to provide instruction, conduct research, and administer constituent colleges.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975 to update provisions regarding the disposal of rural agricultural and urban properties. It introduces new schemes for land management, modifies administrative roles, and establishes specific time limits for implementing final orders by the Full Board.

metadata.title: The Forest (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to allow the Government of Punjab to declare reserved or protected forests as no longer reserved or protected for projects of national importance. The amendments specifically add new subsections to sections 27 and 34-A of the original Act to facilitate this declaration under prescribed terms and conditions.

metadata.title: The Nexis University, Sialkot (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Nexis University, Sialkot Act 2025 to update specific sections and the schedule regarding faculty names and governance titles. It substitutes references to 'Chancellor' with 'Chairperson Board of Governors' and updates the list of faculties included in the university.

metadata.title: The COTHM Global Institute, Lahore Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the COTHM Global Institute, Lahore as a private sector body corporate. It establishes the institute's structure, defines key terms and roles, and outlines its functions regarding academic programs and degree awards.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to update specific sections regarding financial clauses and audit requirements. It also adds conditions for health and training institutions established under the Ordinance to comply with relevant federal or provincial laws.

metadata.title: The Police Order (Second Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 to introduce new definitions for 'Incident Commander', 'Riot Management Unit', and 'Riot Zone'. It establishes procedures for managing unlawful assemblies and riots, including the use of technology in coordination with the Punjab Safe City Authority.

metadata.title: The Panjnad University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Panjnad University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It outlines the university's functions, including providing instruction across various disciplines and establishing constituent colleges and research centers.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to allow individuals aged sixteen and above to drive motorcycles up to 125 CC or equivalent electric motorcycles with a juvenile driving permit. It also modifies section 89-B of the Ordinance by omitting specific provisions regarding notified roads and subsection (4).

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce definitions and mechanisms for end-of-life vehicles and their scrapping. It aims to strengthen air quality management by reducing vehicular emissions through the promotion of eco-friendly mass transit and the transition to electric vehicles.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce electronic processing for driving license applications and medical certificates. It also inserts new provisions regarding driving on the wrong side of the road and updates definitions related to digital systems.

metadata.title: The Public Sector Medical Universities (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002; The King Edward Medical University Act, 2005; The Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore Act, 2015; The Rawalpindi Medical University Act, 2017; The Faisalabad Medical University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws governing public sector medical universities in the Punjab to update eligibility criteria for Vice Chancellors. Specifically, it raises the minimum age requirement from sixty-five to seventy years and updates the professional experience and publication requirements for candidates.

metadata.title: The Public Sector Universities (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: Ordinance XLVIII of 2002; Ordinance XLIX of 2002; Ordinance LXX of 2002; Act VI of 2013; Act VII of 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws governing certain public sector universities in the Punjab province. It specifically targets Ordinances and Acts related to institutions such as Government College University, Lahore, and Government College for Women Faisalabad to update their titles and nomenclature.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE, FOOD AND DRUG AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Act 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Act 2016 to include new definitions for various regulated terms. It specifically adds definitions for alternative medicine, animal feed, biological medicine, cosmetics, orthopaedic implants, raw materials, soil, and water contamination.

metadata.title: The Punjab Child Marriage Restraint Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to restrain the solemnization of child marriages in the province. It defines key terms such as 'child' and 'child marriage', prohibits the registration of such marriages, and prescribes strict penalties for offenders including adults marrying children, guardians facilitating these unions, and those involved in child trafficking or abuse.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The Punjab Finance Act, 1973; The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Punjab. It amends several existing acts, including provisions related to urban immovable property tax, motor vehicles taxation, finance act schedules, and sales tax on services.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forensic Science Authority (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Forensic Science Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Forensic Science Authority Act, 2025 by adding new clauses to section 3 regarding specific authorities. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on May 6, 2026.

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Safety Laws (Amendment) Ordinance 2026
metadata.amends: Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950; Punjab Food Authority Act 2011; Punjab Registration of Godowns Act 2014; Punjab Halal Development Agency Act 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing laws in Punjab to harmonize the regulatory framework and reduce administrative burdens. It specifically updates references to the 'Cane Commissioner' as 'Director General (Food)/Cane Commissioner' and designates the Food Safety and Consumer Protection Department as the Administrative Department across multiple acts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Higher Education Commission (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Higher Education Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Higher Education Commission Act, 2014 to introduce restrictions on appointments. Specifically, it inserts a new subsection prohibiting the appointment of any person as Chairperson if they are over sixty-five years of age on the last date for application submission.

metadata.title: The Punjab High Security Zones (Establishment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework for declaring high security zones and designated areas within the Punjab province. It regulates public gatherings, prohibits activities prejudicial to public safety, and outlines procedures for obtaining permission to hold events in specific zones.

metadata.title: The Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Ordinance 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Judicial Academy Act, 2007 to shift the main campus to Kala Shah Kaku and expand training functions to include government department officers. It also updates faculty requirements to include Ph.D. scholars with extensive experience or former Vice Chancellors.

metadata.title: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015 to update definitions regarding goods imported into or exported out of the Punjab. It also modifies provisions related to cess rates, procedural rules for information seeking and penalties, and establishes new sections for appointing Cess Officers and setting up monitoring stations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Legal Aid (Amendment) Ordinance 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Legal Aid Act 2018 to extend legal aid provisions to indigent persons dispossessed of immovable property. It specifically facilitates access to justice for those pursuing proceedings before Tribunals established under the Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act 2025.

metadata.title: The Punjab Protected Areas (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protected Areas Act, 2020 to update specific sections regarding clauses and permissions. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on April 22, 2026, and received assent from the Governor on May 06, 2026.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF OWNERSHIP OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2025 to address issues regarding illegal possession and property disputes. It introduces new definitions for 'accused', substitutes sections related to punishment and complaints, and establishes a Scrutiny Committee for each district to facilitate amicable resolutions.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF OWNERSHIP OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property (Amendment) Ordinance 2026
metadata.amends: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act 2025 to address illegal possession and strengthen procedural mechanisms. It substitutes several sections to redefine terms like 'accused' and 'Judge', introduces penalties for attempts or abetment, and establishes a Scrutiny Committee for each district to investigate complaints.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC UTILITIES INFRASTRUCTURE PROTECTION ORDINANCE 2026

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Utilities Infrastructure Protection Ordinance, 2026
