metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework to prevent the theft, unauthorized removal, damage, and illegal maintenance of public utilities infrastructure in Punjab. It defines specific offenses related to these activities and prescribes imprisonment terms and fines for violators, including special provisions for scrap dealers.

name: PUNJAB REGULATION OF KITE FLYING ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Regulation of Kite Flying Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of kite flying in the Punjab to save human life and protect public and private property. It prohibits the manufacture, sale, or use of kites with dangerous materials like metallic wire or sharp threads while establishing a registration system for permissible materials.

metadata.title: The Punjab Senior Citizens Welfare Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the well-being, comfort, and dignity of senior citizens residing in the Punjab. It establishes the Punjab Senior Citizens Welfare Council to oversee welfare services, including social, economic, and legal protection needs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Trusts Act, 2020 to update regulatory references and insert new sections regarding regulators and appeals. It specifically designates the Director General Labour Welfare as a regulator for issuing No Objection Certificates in certain matters and establishes procedures for appeals against decisions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vagrancy (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958 to align legal provisions with contemporary child protection standards. It specifically raises the age threshold for certain protections from fourteen to sixteen years and designates the Director General of Social Welfare as the competent authority.

metadata.title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 to incorporate provisions for electronic record systems and biometric verification. It updates definitions related to electronic records, signatures, and co-operative societies while establishing new roles for the Board of Revenue and Punjab Land Records Authority.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Stamp (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to introduce a new definition for 'assignable deed' and establish specific stamp duties for such instruments. It also modifies existing sections and schedules within the original Act to adjust duty rates and definitions.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to introduce and define 'assignable deeds' for immovable properties. It establishes a uniform stamp duty rate of 1% for both urban and rural areas to eliminate existing discrimination between them.

metadata.title: The Superior University, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Superior University, Lahore Act, 2004 to update provisions regarding faculty establishment and sub-campus operations. It substitutes specific clauses in sections 4 and 5 of the original Act to align university governance with current accreditation policies and restrictions on opening new campuses.

metadata.title: The Suthra Punjab Authority Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Suthra Punjab Authority to manage solid waste and regulate sanitation services within the Punjab. It creates an integrated system for waste collection, transportation, treatment, and disposal while promoting recycling and waste-to-energy initiatives.

metadata.title: The Walled City of Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Walled City of Lahore Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Walled City of Lahore Act, 2012 to expand its scope and enhance jurisdiction over walled cities, heritage areas, and heritage properties in the Punjab. It establishes a comprehensive legal framework and specialized institutional arrangements for the effective conservation and management of these sites.

metadata.title: The Abdul Ghafoor Niazi University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Abdul Ghafoor Niazi University in the private sector with its main campus located at Sargodha. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its functions, powers, and faculty structures.

metadata.title: The ABWA University, Faisalabad Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the ABWA University in Faisalabad as a private sector institution. It provides for the university's corporate structure, defining its governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council, and outlines its functions including instruction, research, and community service.

metadata.title: The Anti-terrorism (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Anti-terrorism Act, 1997 to insert new provisions regarding detention orders issued by armed or civil armed forces. It mandates that such inquiries be conducted by a joint team comprising police officers and members of civil armed forces or intelligence agencies. The existing provisions for sub-sections (1) and (2) remain in force for a period of two years from 2025.

name: ASIAN UNIVERSITY FOR RESEARCH AND ADVANCEMENT ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Asian University for Research and Advancement Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Asian University for Research and Advancement as a private sector body corporate in the Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Board of Governors, Academic Council, and various faculties such as Engineering, Sciences, and Business Management.

metadata.title: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions regarding inspectors and the Director General. It introduces specific procedures for accident reporting, site investigation, and the constitution of accident committees to determine root causes and fix responsibilities.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers Participation) (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 1968 by substituting references to 'Government' with 'Institution' in several sections. It also inserts a new definition for 'Institution' and adds provisions regarding recovery charges determined by a Committee.

metadata.title: The Crownridge University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Crownridge University as a private sector body corporate with its main campus in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including roles such as Chancellor and Board of Governors, and outlines its functions to provide instruction across various faculties like Natural Sciences, Computing, and Engineering.

metadata.title: The Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi Act, 2013 to update terminology from 'District' to 'Division' and modify definitions regarding projects and welfare activities. It also introduces new powers for the Authority to impose various fees, carry out welfare activities for defence personnel, and frame regulations and bye-laws.

metadata.title: The Drugs (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to update provisions regarding Drug Courts. It specifically revises section 31 to define the composition of a Drug Court, including requirements for the Chairperson and members based on judicial and pharmaceutical experience.

metadata.title: The Drugs (Second Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to include 'Therapeutic goods' in specific sections alongside drugs. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on December 17, 2025.

metadata.title: The Forest (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to update definitions regarding flora, fauna, and specific roles within the forestry department. It also introduces stricter penalties for offenses committed in reserved forests, including higher imprisonment terms and fines.

metadata.title: The Ganj Shakar University, Pakpattan Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ganj Shakar University, Pakpattan as a private sector body corporate in the Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board, and various academic authorities, and grants it powers to provide instruction across multiple faculties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Labour Code, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates, simplifies, and rationalizes laws regarding workers' rights and the elimination of forced labor in Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'worker' and 'wage' and establishes that the Code applies to all workplaces within the province except for civil servants, defense services, and police forces.

metadata.title: The Globus University Kamalia Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Globus University Kamalia as a private sector body corporate located in the Punjab province. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board, and various faculties, while outlining its functions to provide instructions, conduct research, and award academic degrees.

metadata.title: The Lahore Capital University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Capital University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction across various faculties and conducting research.

metadata.title: The Imperial Tutorial College University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Imperial Tutorial College University by reconstituting the existing Imperial Tutorial College. It confers upon the new university the power to award degrees, diplomas, and certificates while defining its corporate structure and functions.

name: LAHORE INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Lahore Institute of Science and Technology, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Lahore Institute of Science and Technology, Lahore Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Institute of Science and Technology, Lahore Act, 2021 to upgrade the institution's status from an institute to a university. It substitutes specific expressions throughout the original act to reflect this change in name and authority.

metadata.title: The Lahore Leads University (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Leads University Act, 2011 to update definitions regarding constituent colleges and expand the university's faculties. It grants the Board new powers to decide teaching methods, affiliate institutions, collaborate with foreign partners, and establish technology parks.

name: MIR CHAKAR KHAN RIND UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2019 to include specific provisions regarding employee repatriation and expanding the scope of study fields. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on January 20, 2025, and received assent from the Governor on January 29, 2025.

metadata.title: The Minhaj University, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Minhaj University, Lahore Act, 2005 to update its provisions and definitions. It specifically omits references to 'Lahore' in certain sections and inserts new clauses regarding constituent colleges, the Pro-Vice Chancellor, and various academic functions.

name: MUKABBIR UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY, GUJRAT ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Mukabbir University of Science & Technology, Gujrat Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Mukabbir University of Science & Technology, Gujrat as a private sector institution with its main campus in Gujrat. It defines the university's corporate status, constituent bodies such as the Board and Academic Council, and outlines its functions including providing instruction in faculties like Law, Commerce, Arts, and Social Sciences.

name: NATIONAL COLLEGE OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION & ECONOMICS, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to rename the institution as Alhamra University. It introduces significant changes regarding the Academic Council, faculty establishment procedures, teaching methods, and jurisdictional limits within the Punjab province.

metadata.title: The Musarrat Institute of Technology Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Musarrat Institute of Technology as a private sector body in the Punjab with its main campus in Multan. It defines the institute's structure, including its Patron, Board, and various faculties such as Law, Engineering, and Medical Sciences.

name: NAWAZ SHARIF INSTITUTE OF CANCER TREATMENT AND RESEARCH ACT 2025

metadata.title: Nawaz Sharif Institute of Cancer Treatment and Research Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Nawaz Sharif Institute of Cancer Treatment and Research in Lahore as a body corporate. It outlines the Institute's functions, including providing oncological treatment, conducting research, educating medical staff, and managing funds for its operations.

name: NEXT INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Next Institute of Science and Technology (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Next Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Next Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2025 to add a Faculty of Allied Health Sciences and modify examination procedures. It also updates specific sections regarding faculty composition, board recommendations, and the institute's authority to award degrees based on prior examinations.

metadata.title: The Nexis University, Sialkot Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Nexis University, Sialkot as a private sector body corporate in the Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and Vice-Chancellor, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Notaries (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Notaries Ordinance, 1961 to restrict its application from Pakistan to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Provincial Government with the Secretary or authorized officers and omits specific sections.

metadata.title: The Police Order (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order 2002 by establishing a new Crime Control Department within the police force. It outlines the creation of a specialized Crime Control Force and defines the administrative hierarchy, including the role of the Additional Inspector General of Police as the head of the department.

name: NEXT INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Next Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the Next Institute of Science and Technology in the private sector with its main campus located at Multan. It establishes the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its functions, powers, and internal structure including various faculties and administrative units.

metadata.title: The Probation of Offenders (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960 to adapt it for the Punjab province. It introduces provisions for community service, defines the role of the Deputy Commissioner in supervision, and adjusts conditions regarding the duration of probation orders.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to provide for financial benefits for secured persons. It allows these benefits to be used for purchasing essential commodities from government-notified outlets, subject to fund availability and government approval.

metadata.title: The Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Order 2002 to establish a new Crime Control Department within the police force. It creates a specialized cadre for this department and outlines procedures for transferring criminal investigations from district police to the new department or between officers within it.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce an e-traffic management system powered by artificial intelligence for recording violations and issuing electronic tickets. It establishes procedures for contesting charges, collecting fines electronically, and increasing penalties or impounding vehicles if fines remain unpaid.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce new definitions for Commercial and Private Vehicles for Hire (CVH/PVH) and Digital Platform for Passenger Transportation (DPPT). It establishes requirements for permits for operating these vehicles through digital platforms and introduces a licensing regime for Transportation Network Companies (TNCs).

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (First Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to incorporate provisions regarding an electronic traffic management system and the Punjab Safe Cities Authority. It establishes procedures for recording violations, issuing e-tickets, and recovering fines through vehicle impoundment and auctioning if unpaid.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to include motor cycles in various sections and schedules. It also increases fines for overloading goods vehicles and reduces the imprisonment term for repeat offenders.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Third Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965. It substitutes a new provision in section 24 regarding vehicle registration and additional fees for owners or keepers residing in the Province.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce electronic processing for driving license applications and medical certificates. It also defines new terms such as the Driving License Information Management System and electronic ticketing system, while adding provisions regarding driving on the wrong side of the road.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 by omitting specific clauses from sections 2 and 4-A. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on July 28, 2025, and received assent from the Governor on August 5, 2025.

metadata.title: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019 to update provisions regarding mediator judges and expert nominations. It also modifies the appointment process for the Director General of the Authority and adjusts related perks and privileges.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acid Control Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls the business of acid in Punjab by establishing a comprehensive mechanism for its management. It prohibits carrying on the business of acid without a license and restricts sales to persons under eighteen years of age.

name: PUNJAB AUTISM SCHOOL AND RESOURCE CENTRE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre Act 2025 to update the name of the institution. Specifically, it substitutes 'Maryam Nawaz School and Resource Centre for Autism' for the previous name in sections 2 and 3 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Arms Ordinance, 1965 to introduce specific definitions and regulations regarding gun shooting clubs. It substitutes various terms like 'Government' with 'Secretary' and 'Magistrate' with 'Deputy Commissioner' across multiple sections of the Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976 to update references from 'Government' to 'Chief Minister' and modify sections regarding officers and controlling authorities. It also repeals a previous amendment ordinance passed in the same year.

name: PUNJAB BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976 to allow vacant positions in Boards to be filled by the private sector. It also substitutes specific terms regarding the Controlling Authority and omits certain clauses to streamline official business.

name: PUNJAB AUTISM SCHOOL AND RESOURCE CENTRE ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Autism School and Resource Centre to provide education and support for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder in the Punjab. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession to manage the centre and defines its constitution, including a board comprising government officials, experts, parents, and other members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consumer Protection (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 to update definitions regarding commercial purposes and electronic transactions. It also revises provisions concerning fines for violations and redesignates consumer courts under the jurisdiction of the Lahore High Court.

name: PUNJAB CENTER OF EXCELLENCE ON COUNTERING VIOLENT EXTREMISM ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Center of Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism to address challenges arising from terrorism and subversive activities. The Center is empowered to conduct research, develop strategies, provide training, and coordinate with various stakeholders to prevent radicalization and combat extremism.

name: PUNJAB CONTROL OF NARCOTICS SUBSTANCES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Narcotics Substances (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Control of Narcotics Substances Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Control of Narcotics Substances Act, 2025 to align its operational and legal setup with other relevant laws. It introduces specific changes to sections regarding bail conditions, court jurisdictions, and procedural requirements for narcotics offences.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004 to enhance parliamentary oversight and ensure transparency in government affairs. It specifically alters Section 5 of the original Act by changing the number of directors required from the Provincial Assembly and adding requirements for expertise and gender representation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Educational Institutions (Reconstitution) (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Educational Institutions (Reconstitution) Act, 2021 to reconstitute certain educational institutions in Punjab. It aims to improve governance and management by providing academic, financial, and administrative autonomy to enhance education quality.

metadata.title: The Punjab Emergency Service (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Emergency Service Act, 2006 by substituting specific expressions in section 6. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on December 17, 2025.

name: PUNJAB ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND CONSERVATION AGENCY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Energy Efficiency and Conservation Agency Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Energy Efficiency and Conservation Agency as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the transfer of existing employees and assets from the Punjab Energy Efficiency and Conservation Program to the new Agency.

metadata.title: The Punjab Enforcement and Regulations (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Enforcement and Regulations Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Enforcement and Regulations Act, 2024 to facilitate the appointment of Magistrates for trial of offences. It also prescribes expedient procedures for annual budget approval and the issuance of guidelines by the Director General.

metadata.title: The Punjab Fertilizers Control Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of fertilizers in the Punjab, covering their manufacture, supply, importation, distribution, quality standards, pricing, and disposal. It aims to ensure the availability of quality fertilizers for agricultural purposes by establishing a framework for licensing, monitoring, and enforcement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Finance Act, 1977 to introduce new provisions regarding tax deduction from employee salaries. It mandates that drawing and disbursing officers or principal officers of local authorities must deduct tax from salaries and deposit it in the treasury.

name: PUNJAB CONTROL OF NARCOTIC SUBSTANCES ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of narcotic and controlled substances, including their production, processing, trafficking, and transportation. It also aims to prevent illicit narcotics-related activities and matters ancillary thereto to eliminate evils associated with these substances.

metadata.title: The Punjab Financial Advisory Services Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Financial Advisory Services as a body corporate to provide financial and management advisory services. It defines the composition of the Authority's Board, including government secretaries and private sector experts, and outlines the functions and powers of the new entity.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes the structure of sales tax on services in Punjab by amending the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012. It introduces new provisions for tax-free services and modifies various sections regarding exemptions, penalties, and schedules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forensic Science Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Forensic Science Authority to conduct forensic examinations of documents, materials, and other objects. It provides for the appointment of experts, the composition of the Authority, and procedures for rendering scientific opinions on evidential material referred by investigating agencies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015 to introduce provisions for refunds. It allows the Authority or its authorized officer to grant refunds of cess paid due to inadvertence, error, or misconstruction under specific conditions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Judicial Academy (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Judicial Academy Act, 2007 to update definitions regarding rules and regulations, establish sub-campuses, and modify the functions of the Board. It also introduces new sections for constituting committees and framing regulations to ensure effective implementation of the Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Khal Panchayat (Repeal) Act, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Khal Panchayat Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Khal Panchayat Act, 2019 to transfer properties and responsibilities from the defunct Punjab Khal Panchayat Authority to various government departments. It outlines the absorption of employees into the Irrigation Department or Surplus Pool, the abolition of vacant positions, and the transfer of pension funds to the Finance Department.

name: PUNJAB LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2021 to reduce hardship and facilitate people in the province. It inserts references to civil courts into section 3 and adds a proviso regarding procedure under the Succession Act, 1925 for civil court cases. Additionally, it omits section 10 of the original 2021 Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2022 to update references to local government laws and redefine rating areas. It also specifies that urban immovable property tax shall be levied under the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The Punjab Horticulture Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Horticulture Authority to manage public parks, green belts, and outdoor advertisements. It provides for the regulation of billboards, sky signs, and other structures within designated areas in the province.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes local governments in the Punjab and consolidates laws regarding their powers and functions. It aims to establish an effective elected local government system for meaningful devolution of political, administrative, and financial responsibility.

name: PUNJAB PRICE CONTROL OF ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Act, 2024 to update the composition of the Price Control Council and modify specific sections. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on July 30, 2025, and received assent from the Governor on August 05, 2025.

name: PUNJAB PRIMARY AND SECONDARY HEALTHCARE SERVICES ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Primary and Secondary Healthcare Services Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for providing primary and secondary healthcare services in the Punjab province. It outlines mechanisms for operating healthcare facilities, including Maryam Nawaz Health Clinics and Hospitals, through community services and digital referral systems.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF KITE FLYING (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying Ordinance, 2001 to update definitions regarding children and guardians. It introduces stricter penalties for violations, specifically addressing offenses committed by children under the Juvenile Justice System Act, 2018.

metadata.title: The Punjab Protected Areas (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protected Areas Act, 2020 to incorporate definitions for ecotourism and officers, and to update administrative references. It introduces new provisions on sustainable ecotourism practices while omitting specific sections from the original act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Mines and Minerals Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an efficient and transparent administrative, legal, and fiscal framework to create a competitive environment for domestic and foreign investment in the mining and minerals sector in Punjab. It defines key terms related to exploration, licensing, and operations while excluding nuclear energy resources, mineral oil, and natural gas from its application.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF OWNERSHIP OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act protects lawful ownership of immovable property in the Punjab by providing effective legal remedies against dispossession. It establishes a mechanism for the expeditious resolution of related disputes and defines specific offences regarding illegal possession, including severe penalties for individuals and entities involved.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF OWNERSHIP OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY ORDINANCE 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance is promulgated to protect lawful ownership of immovable property in Punjab and provide effective legal remedies against dispossession. It establishes a mechanism for the expeditious resolution of disputes connected with such property and defines specific offences related to illegal possession.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC AWARENESS AND DISSEMINATION OF INFORMATION ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Awareness and Dissemination of Information Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for the Punjab government and public bodies to launch public awareness campaigns regarding government projects, initiatives, programs, and policies. It mandates transparency by ensuring access to information and public participation through various advertising agencies and media platforms.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Representatives' Laws (Amendment) Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends laws relating to the public representative offices of the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific salary amounts with references to 'the same as his salary' in three existing Acts from 1975 concerning Ministers, the Speaker, and the Deputy Speaker.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Repeal) Act, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018; The Punjab Regularization of Service (Repeal) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 and the Punjab Regularization of Service (Repeal) Ordinance, 2025. It ensures that actions taken under the repealed 2018 Act continue to have effect despite its repeal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Repeal) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to facilitate a shift in appointment modes from Basic Pay Scale to Lump Sum Pay Package. The primary objective is to reduce the financial burden on the Government exchequer regarding pensions and other liabilities.

name: PUNJAB REGULATION OF KITE FLYING ORDINANCE 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Regulation of Kite Flying Ordinance 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of kite flying in the Punjab to save human life and protect public and private property. It defines specific terms related to kite materials, establishes offences and punishments for prohibited activities, and sets up a registration system for manufacturers and sellers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Road Safety Authority (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Road Safety Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Road Safety Authority Act, 2023 to update provisions regarding appointments, budget approval, and fund management. It introduces a specific fund for the Authority, mandates annual budget preparation by the Director General, and establishes requirements for financial audits by the Auditor General of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to promote and encourage public private partnerships within the province of Punjab. It aims to create an enabling environment for private sector participation in projects of public importance by defining key terms, establishing an Authority, and outlining procedures for bidding and contracting.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sahulat Bazaars Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Sahulat Bazaars Authority to launch, construct, monitor, regulate, and maintain Sahulat Bazaars in the Punjab. It also aims to supply essential commodities to the general public at notified rates and create business opportunities for entrepreneurs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Spatial Planning Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Spatial Planning Authority to ensure balanced and sustainable development of settlements across the province. It provides for the creation of a body corporate with powers to regulate land use, execute master and spatial plans, and harmonize relevant laws.

metadata.title: The Punjab Thalassemia Prevention Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions for the control and prevention of Thalassemia and other genetic disorders within the Punjab. It establishes an Advisory Council to oversee early detection, management, and the creation of a data bank for policy making.

name: PUNJAB TIANJIN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018 to add provisions regarding employee repatriation and update the scope of study fields. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on January 20, 2025, and received assent from the Governor on January 29, 2025.

metadata.title: The Punjab Specialized Medical Institutions Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for Specialized Medical Institutions in Punjab to improve medical education, responsiveness, and the quality of clinical care. It defines the objectives of these institutions, which include providing health facilities, conducting research, and training, while also establishing a Board of Governors to administer their affairs.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 by substituting specific officials in Section 144 and omitting certain subsections. It replaces references to 'Zila Nazim' with the Deputy Commissioner or Secretary to the Government of the Punjab, Home Department, and adjusts the duration of orders issued under this section.

name: INSTITUTE OF SOUTHERN PUNJAB MULTAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Institute of Southern Punjab Multan (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.amends: The Institute of Southern Punjab Multan Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Institute of Southern Punjab Multan Act, 2010 to officially rename the institution as the University of Southern Punjab. It substitutes references from 'Institute' to 'University' throughout the long title, preamble, sections, and schedule, while also establishing specific faculties and defining the university's jurisdiction within the Punjab province.

metadata.title: Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Order, 2002 by inserting a new article to establish Organized Crime Units in every district. It defines the leadership structure for these units and lists specific categories of serious crimes, such as kidnapping, extortion, and human trafficking, that must be transferred to them for investigation.

metadata.title: The Police Order (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 (II of 2024)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 by establishing Organized Crime Units in every district to handle specific serious offenses. It defines the leadership structure for these units and grants powers to officers within them for investigating cases like kidnapping, extortion, and drug trafficking.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Laws (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972; The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act 1972 and the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act 2019. The amendments streamline the working of the Assembly Secretariat by substituting references to 'Secretary' with 'Secretary General' and defining the status and functions of the Secretary General.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 to include income from livestock and companies within its scope. It introduces a new super tax on high-earning persons and modifies various sections regarding definitions, assessment procedures, and penalties for default.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018 to alter provisions regarding the tenure of Chairperson and members, meeting convening procedures, and office vacancies. It also omits section 5 of the original Act and substitutes subsections related to the powers of the Director General and Chairman.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018 to alter provisions regarding the tenure of Chairperson and members, meeting convening procedures, and the omission of a specific section. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance from 2023 while saving actions taken under it.

name: PUNJAB UNDESIRABLE COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES (REPEAL AND RE-ORGANIZATION) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Repeal and Re-organization) Act, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 and dissolves the Cooperatives Board established under that repealed law. It vests all properties, movable and immovable, previously controlled by the dissolved board into the Government of the Punjab for supervision by the Board of Revenue.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 (XIX of 2023); The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 (I of 2024)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to introduce a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme for civil servants appointed after a specific ordinance. It modifies sections regarding pension eligibility, service requirements, and retirement benefits while repealing two previous Ordinances related to these amendments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to introduce a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme for civil servants appointed or regularized after its commencement. It also modifies provisions regarding pension eligibility, gratuity calculation, and compassionate allowances for dismissed servants.

metadata.title: The Punjab Defamation Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions regarding defamation and matters connected therewith within the Punjab. It establishes a framework for claims before a Tribunal, defines key terms such as 'defamation' in the context of social media, and sets minimum damages for unsuccessful defenses.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Punjab. It also deals with ancillary matters related to these financial changes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act, 2010 to modify provisions regarding the Commissioner's tenure and resignation procedures. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023.

metadata.title: Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act 2010 to allow the Government to remove a Commissioner at any time before their term expires without assigning a reason. It also modifies section 6 of the Act to include 'removed' as a ground for vacancy alongside resignation.

name: PUNJAB PRICE CONTROL OF ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ORDINANCE 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Ordinance 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a mechanism to fix prices and control the artificial hike of essential commodities in the Punjab. It creates a Price Control Council and empowers it to issue orders regulating production, distribution, and sale to prevent profiteering.

name: PUNJAB REVISION OF SALARIES OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Punjab Revision of Salaries of Public Representatives Act, 2024
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Special Assistants (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Advisors (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act revises the salaries of holders of public representative offices in the Province of Punjab. It amends several existing Acts and Ordinances from 1974, 1975, and 2002 to update salary figures and grant the Government the power to increase these salaries via notification.

metadata.title: The Punjab Enforcement and Regulation Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Enforcement and Regulatory Authority to oversee the implementation of special laws across the province. It prescribes procedures for efficient enforcement, designates lead regulators, and empowers officers to conduct administrative actions against violations.

name: PUNJAB RICE CONTROL OF ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ACT 2024

metadata.title: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a mechanism to fix and regulate the prices of essential commodities within the Punjab province. It aims to prevent artificial price hikes and profiteering by empowering a Price Control Council to issue orders regarding production, movement, and sale of these goods.

metadata.title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 by modifying section 38 to include provisions for overseas persons. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on November 20, 2024.

metadata.title: The Punjab Saaf Pani Authority Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Saaf Pani Authority by re-constituting the existing Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority. It provides for the functions and powers of the new Authority to ensure the availability of safe drinking water, including infrastructure development, water filtration, and community education.

metadata.title: Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to address grave and emergent situations endangering public peace. It substitutes Section 144 to provide Deputy Commissioners and specially empowered officers with powers to issue immediate orders for preventing obstruction, injury, or danger to life and safety.

metadata.title: Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to address grave and emergent situations endangering public peace. It specifically substitutes Section 144 to provide powers for issuing immediate orders in cases of nuisance or apprehended danger.

metadata.title: The Senate Hill University Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Senate Hill University in the private sector with its main campus located in Lahore. It provides for the university's corporate status, governance structure, and functions including instruction, research, and examination.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2023

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019 to address anomalies regarding appeals against orders passed by the same authority. It grants employees aggrieved by such orders the right to prefer an appeal before the Speaker or the Governor within sixty days.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to facilitate the registration and regulation of electric and hybrid vehicles. It introduces specific amendments to various sections of the Ordinance regarding vehicle definitions, documentation requirements, transfer cancellations, suspension orders, and application forms.

name: LAHORE UNIVERSITY OF BIOLOGICAL AND APPLIED SCIENCES ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's powers to provide instruction, conduct research, award degrees, and manage affiliated colleges within various scientific disciplines.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2023

metadata.title: Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.amends: Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018 to alter provisions regarding the tenure of Chairperson and members, meeting convening procedures, presiding officers, and vacancy filling. It also omits section 5 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019 to update definitions, timelines, and procedural requirements for ADR proceedings. It introduces new clauses regarding the Authority and Chairperson while omitting certain previous sections and modifying time limits for case returns to court.

metadata.title: The Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961 to establish a comprehensive mechanism for safeguarding public servants from false and frivolous complaints. It introduces provisions for preliminary probes, requires prior permission for registering criminal cases against specific ranks of officials, and sets conditions for arresting public servants.

metadata.title: Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 by inserting specific words into section 9 regarding posts. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006 to regulate client-attorney relationships. It substitutes subsection (2) regarding the tenure of the Prosecutor General and omits subsection (5) of section 6.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Finance Act, 2014 by substituting the expression 'Additional Director Taxation, Punjab' for the word 'Government' in section 8. The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on January 23, 2023.

name: PUNJAB GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009 by substituting specific words in section 9. The amendment changes a limit from 'than seventy-five' to 'up to one hundred'. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Home-based Workers Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of the rights of home-based workers in the Punjab province. It aims to encourage these workers as important stakeholders in the labour market and covers ancillary matters related to their employment.

metadata.title: Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 by updating its Schedule. Specifically, it omits a previous sub-clause and inserts an explanation regarding tax liability for motor vehicles with seating capacity exceeding six persons, excluding buses and station wagons not plying for hire.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pension Fund (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pension Fund Act, 2007 by substituting specific words in section 15. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on January 23, 2023.

metadata.title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009 to update the composition of its Board. It substitutes the existing subsection regarding the Board's members with a new list including specific government secretaries and nominated representatives from the Provincial Assembly and Chamber of Commerce.

metadata.title: The Punjab Road Safety Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Road Safety Authority to ensure safe road design, vehicles, and drivers through international best practices. It defines key terms related to road users, vehicles, and safety devices while outlining the composition and qualifications of the Authority's members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to update definitions regarding adolescents and adults, expand the list of covered establishments, and modify working hour limits. It also revises provisions related to overtime, authority appointments, and specific exclusions for certain professions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 to regulate various provisions and address immediate circumstances while the Provincial Assembly is not in session. It introduces a Special Court for specific offences, modifies definitions regarding schedules and officers, and grants the Government power to amend the Act's schedules via notification.

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 to regulate various provisions and address immediate circumstances while the Provincial Assembly is not in session. It introduces a Special Court for specific offences, inserts new sections regarding appeals and powers to amend schedules, and modifies existing definitions and clauses within the parent Act.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to insert a new clause regarding the sealing of non-residential immovable properties. The amendment allows for such properties to be sealed until unpaid tax amounts are fully paid or recovered.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974. It specifically inserts a reference to PCP air guns, CO2 air guns, or silenced air guns into section 9 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Women Hostels Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Women Hostels Authority to regulate women hostels established in the private sector within the Punjab province. Its primary aim is to provide safe and standard accommodation facilities for women along with ancillary matters.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to facilitate the expeditious disposal of appeals and related matters. It inserts a provision allowing any other Secretary to the Government of the Punjab, specially empowered by the Chief Secretary, to act in place of the Secretary Food within section 13-A.

metadata.title: The University of Gujrat (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Gujrat Act, 2004 to restore the status and premises of several colleges that existed before the original Act. It specifically reverses property transfers and liabilities previously assigned to the University, returning them to the respective colleges.

metadata.title: The Walled City of Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.amends: The Walled City of Lahore Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Walled City of Lahore Act 2012 to expand its scope from just the Walled City of Lahore to include walled cities, heritage areas, and heritage properties across the Punjab. It establishes a comprehensive legal framework and specialized institutional arrangements for the conservation and management of these heritage sites.

metadata.title: The Aspire University Lahore Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Aspire University Lahore as a private sector university located in the Punjab province. It provides for the university's corporate status, governance structure including the Board of Governors and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and administering constituent colleges.

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Metropolitan University Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bahawalpur Metropolitan University as a private sector body corporate located in Bahawalpur. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board, and various authorities, and grants it jurisdiction across the Punjab Province.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975 to modify provisions regarding the Full Board of Revenue and property disposal. It introduces new subsections to allow for the cancellation of fraudulent land allotments and establishes a timeline for disposing of transferred proceedings.

metadata.title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Factories Act, 1934 to update definitions regarding manufacturing processes and machinery. It also modifies provisions related to worker counts, clerical employment classifications, and safety standards within factories in Punjab.

metadata.title: The Forest (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to update definitions regarding the Forestry, Wildlife and Fisheries Department. It also introduces minimum fine thresholds based on damage value and specifies imprisonment periods for offenders who refuse to pay fines.

name: PUNJAB IRRIGATION, DRAINAGE AND RIVERS ACT 2023

metadata.title: The Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and control of irrigation, drainage, and rivers in the Punjab province. It aims to establish better and sustainable systems for managing water resources including streams, lakes, and ground water.

name: LAHORE CENTRAL BUSINESS DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Lahore Central Business District Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Lahore Central Business District Development Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Central Business District Development Authority Act, 2021 to update its preamble and substitute specific words throughout the text. It establishes a new Board structure with defined member roles, expands the authority's jurisdiction to include Walton Airport Area, and introduces powers for real estate investment trusts and land acquisition models.

metadata.title: The Khatamun-nabiyyeen University, Lahore Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act reconstructs the Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies into the Khatamun-nabiyyeen University, Lahore. It provides for the incorporation of the new university with perpetual succession, property rights, and administrative structures to facilitate research, publications, and higher education in Islamic fields.

metadata.title: The Lahore City University Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore City University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various faculties, while outlining its functions to provide instructions and training across multiple disciplines.

metadata.title: The Muttehida Ulema Board Punjab Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes the Muttehida Ulema Board Punjab to serve as a special institution for making recommendations on religious matters. Its primary functions include addressing sectarian issues, promoting interfaith harmony, and advising on objectionable literature and educational curriculum changes.

metadata.title: The NUR International University Lahore (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.amends: The NUR International University Lahore Act 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the NUR International University Lahore Act 2015 to update provisions regarding instruction, training, and degree conferment. It also substitutes sections related to the appointment of the Vice Chancellor, acting arrangements, interpretation difficulties, and the list of university faculties.

name: MULTAN UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Multan University of Science and Technology Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Multan University of Science and Technology as a private sector university in Punjab. It defines the structure of the university, including its governing bodies like the Board of Governors and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and granting affiliations to colleges.

name: PROTECTION AGAINST HARASSMENT OF WOMEN AT THE WORKPLACE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010 by adding new subsections to section 7. The amendments specify that the Ombudsperson shall hold office for four years without eligibility for extension or re-appointment and allow resignation via written notice.

name: PRICE CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF PROFITEERING AND HOARDING (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding (Amendment) Ordinance 2022
metadata.amends: The Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977 to adapt it for effective price control of essential commodities in Punjab. It establishes a Price Control Council headed by the Chief Minister and modifies various sections regarding definitions, powers, penalties, and procedural laws.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (REPEAL AND REVIVAL) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Repeal and Revival) Act, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act 2022 and revives the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act 1972. It was deemed assented to by the Governor on August 30, 2022, under Article 116(3) of the Constitution.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act defines the powers, immunities, and privileges of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, its committees, and its members. It provides legal protections against civil or criminal proceedings for matters brought up in the Assembly and restricts detention and court processes during assembly sessions.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT SERVICES (REPEAL AND REVIVAL) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services (Repeal and Revival) Act, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to repeal the Secretariat Services Act, 2022 and revive the Secretariat Services Act, 2019. It came into force immediately upon its publication in the Gazette after deemed assent was granted under Article 116(3) of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce a new section regarding fitness certificates for motor cars. It establishes specific validity periods for these certificates based on vehicle engine capacity and updates related schedules.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT SERVICE ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Service Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the recruitment and conditions of service for persons appointed in the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat. It also provides for ancillary matters related to these employees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act 2019 to modify the election terms for the Chairman of the Governing Body. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Revenue Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Board of Revenue Act, 1957 by adding new subsections to section 8 regarding review applications. It stipulates that review applications should be filed before the same member or board that passed the original order and prohibits subsequent applications after the first one is finally disposed of.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2014 by omitting subsection (3) of section 4. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received the Governor's assent on October 21, 2022.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ehsaas Programme Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Ehsaas Programme as a new umbrella initiative for social protection and poverty alleviation in the province. It aims to reform existing initiatives, optimize resource utilization, and employ modern technology to ensure transparency and efficiency in delivering welfare services.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2022
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes and duties in the Punjab province. It amends existing legislation regarding stamp duties on property transfers to REITs, motor vehicle taxation for electric vehicles, and sales tax on services.

name: PUNJAB FREE AND COMPULSORY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Free and Compulsory Education (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2014. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on October 21, 2022.

name: PUNJAB HOLY QURAN (PRINTING AND RECORDING) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011 to update provisions regarding publisher registration, board composition, and printing standards. It introduces new sections for law enforcement designation, special cells for compliance monitoring, and penalties for disrespecting the Holy Quran in digital or printed forms.

name: PUNJAB EMPOWERMENT OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Act 2022
metadata.summary: This Act promotes and ensures the effective inclusion of persons with disabilities in the community while protecting their rights. It aligns these protections with the Constitution of Pakistan, the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, and international best practices.

name: PUNJAB INDUSTRIES (CONTROL ON ESTABLISHMENT AND ENLARGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963. It provides for the government to exempt industrial undertakings from certain provisions and regularize past contraventions subject to payment of required fees.

name: PUNJAB LAWS (REPEALING AND REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Laws (Repealing and Removal of Difficulties) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act 2019 (IX of 2019); The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act 2021 (XXI of 2021); The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act 2021 (XXVI of 2021)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals specific laws deemed discriminatory, arbitrary, or violative of constitutional provisions within the Punjab. It also establishes a procedure for issuing notifications regarding the summoning and prorogation of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.

name: PUNJAB IMMOVABLE PUBLIC PROPERTIES (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Immovable Public Properties (Removal of Encroachment) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions for the removal of encroachments from public properties in the Punjab. It establishes definitions for key terms like 'public property' and 'unauthorized occupant,' and outlines the procedure for issuing notices, conducting hearings, and ordering the eviction of unauthorized occupants.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes local governments in the Punjab and consolidates laws relating to their powers and functions. It aims to establish an effective elected local government system for meaningful devolution of responsibility and authority to promote good governance.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 by substituting the word 'Government' with 'Secretary' in various sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to provide lifetime security for former Chief Ministers who served at least six months after the 2002 elections. It substitutes Section 21-A of the original Act with new provisions regarding perks and privileges.

name: PUNJAB OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2019 to update definitions, substitute specific terms like 'Council' for 'Government', and modify the composition of relevant committees. It also alters provisions regarding the cognizance of offences by the police.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes local governments in the Punjab and consolidates laws relating to their powers and functions. It establishes an effective elected local government system to promote good governance, service delivery, and transparent decision-making through institutionalized public participation.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF INTEREST ON PRIVATE LOANS ACT 2022
