metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Interest on Private Loans Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the business and practices of private money-lending and advancing loans based on interest within the Punjab province. It defines key terms such as 'money lender', 'interest', and 'loan' to ensure comprehensive coverage of related mischief.

metadata.title: The Punjab Panah Gah Authority Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Panah Gah Authority to create a comprehensive system for protecting and providing temporary shelter to shelterless persons in the Punjab. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to establish, maintain, and operate Panah Gahs, acquire property, and formulate standards for service delivery.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF WOMEN AGAINST VIOLENCE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2022

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protection of Women Against Violence Act, 2016 to update terminology and definitions within the provincial legal framework. It substitutes specific terms like 'District Coordination Officer' with 'Commissioner' and expands the definition of domestic violence to include relationships based on employment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to allow the Chief Minister to specify posts and regularize contract employees without reference to the Commission. The amendment is enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent on January 12, 2022.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Ordinance 2022
metadata.amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act 2018 to provide contract employees with more opportunities for service regularization. It inserts the phrase 'in three attempts' into section 7 of the amended Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Seed Corporation (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Seed Corporation Act, 1976 to update the composition of the Board and the appointment process for the Managing Director. It substitutes specific sections in the original Act to replace references to the Government with the Chief Minister and adjusts the number of board members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Trusts Act, 2020 to update definitions regarding natural persons and specialized trusts. It introduces new registration requirements for specialized trusts involving regulators and establishes a register of trusts maintained by provincial and tehsil directors.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Financial Management Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates financial affairs in the public sector and matters relating to the Provincial Consolidated Fund and Public Account of the Punjab. It aims to ensure comprehensive, efficient, transparent, and sustainable management of finances to contribute to long-term socio-economic stability.

metadata.title: The Sahara University Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sahara University as a private sector institution with its campus located in Narowal. It provides for the constitution of the university as a body corporate and defines its various governing bodies, including the Academic Council, Board of Governors, and Executive Board.

metadata.title: The Salar International University Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Salar International University as a private sector body corporate located in Sheikhupura. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various faculties such as Management Sciences and Medicine.

name: SIALKOT UNIVERSITY OF APPLIED ENGINEERING AND EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES SIALKOT ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: Sialkot University of Applied Engineering and Emerging Technologies Sialkot Ordinance 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sialkot University of Applied Engineering and Emerging Technologies in Sialkot. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy to conduct teaching, research, and examinations in fields such as engineering, sciences, and technology.

metadata.title: The University of Arts & Sciences Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Arts & Sciences as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its internal structure, including the Vice Chancellor, Deans, and various governing boards.

metadata.title: The University of Central Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The University of Central Punjab Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Central Punjab Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions regarding colleges and administrative roles. It also expands the powers of the Board to establish new faculties, manage authorities, collaborate with international institutions, and award honorary degrees.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020 to update definitions and modify the composition and powers of the Authority's Board. It introduces new clauses regarding land acquisition compensation models and specifies the appointment terms for the CEO.

metadata.title: The University of Kamalia Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Kamalia in District Toba Tek Singh with its campus located at Kamalia. It grants the university a corporate status, perpetual succession, and academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

metadata.title: University of Kamalia Ordinance 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Kamalia in District Toba Tek Singh with its campus located at Kamalia. It grants the university corporate status, perpetual succession, and academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

metadata.title: The University of Rawalpindi Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Rawalpindi as a private sector body corporate within the Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various faculties, while outlining its powers to acquire property and provide education.

metadata.title: The University of Layyah Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Layyah by reconstituting the sub-campus of Baha-ud-din Zakaria University Multan located at Layyah. It grants the new university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its corporate structure, composition, and powers to manage property and personnel.

metadata.title: The Urdu Language Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act ensures strict compliance with the Urdu script in both public and private sectors within the Punjab province. It establishes an Urdu Language Board to promote, develop, and regulate the usage of the exact Urdu script as the national language of Pakistan.

metadata.title: University of Taunsa Sharif Ordinance 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Taunsa Sharif in District Dera Ghazi Khan with its campus located at Taunsa Sharif. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its jurisdiction within the district limits.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at providing inexpensive and expeditious justice. It establishes new objectives for courts, defines pecuniary jurisdiction limits, and mandates electronic record-keeping for proceedings.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to adapt it following the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and updates definitions regarding companies and workers.

metadata.title: The Emerson University, Multan Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Emerson University, Multan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including roles such as Chancellor and Vice Chancellor, and outlines provisions for property acquisition and staff absorption from the former Emerson College.

name: VIQAR-UN-NISA UNIVERSITY FOR WOMEN RAWALPINDI ORDINANCE 2022

metadata.title: The Viqar-un-Nisa University for Women, Rawalpindi, Ordinance 2022
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Viqar-un-Nisa University for Women in Rawalpindi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while transferring all properties and liabilities from the former Government Post Graduate College to the new university.

name: GHAZI NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND SCIENCES, DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Ghazi National Institute of Engineering and Sciences, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ghazi National Institute of Engineering and Sciences, Dera Ghazi Khan as a private sector body corporate in Punjab. It defines the institute's structure, including its patron, board, and staff, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction in engineering and technology, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: Emerson University, Multan Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of Emerson University, Multan by reconstituting Government Emerson College, Multan. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its composition, powers to hold property, and the transfer of assets and liabilities from the college.

metadata.title: The Grand Asian University, Sialkot Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Grand Asian University, Sialkot as a private sector institution in Punjab. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction in engineering, law, pharmacy, and sciences.

name: KING EDWARD MEDICAL UNIVERSITY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005 to incorporate provisions for its smooth implementation. It alters the long title and preamble of the original Act, redefines constituent colleges, adjusts faculty and staff employment statuses, and modifies jurisdictional powers regarding attached hospitals.

name: INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT AND APPLIED SCIENCES KHANEWAL ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Institute of Management and Applied Sciences, Khanewal Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Management and Applied Sciences, Khanewal as a body corporate in the private sector. It outlines the institute's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and Rector, and defines its functions such as providing instruction in various sciences, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

name: LAHORE CENTRAL BUSINESS DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Lahore Central Business District Development Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Central Business District Development Authority to regulate and promote state-of-the-art vertical construction in a specific area. It aims to develop a healthy business community by maintaining high environmental standards and modern facilities for both residential and commercial purposes.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to confine the authority's jurisdiction strictly to the Metropolitan area of Lahore. It substitutes specific references from 'Lahore Division' or 'area of Lahore Division' with 'Metropolitan area of Lahore' across various sections and definitions within the parent Act.

name: LAHORE CENTRAL BUSINESS DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Lahore Central Business District Development Authority Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Lahore Central Business District Development Authority to oversee development in the specified area. Its primary purpose is to regulate state-of-the-art vertical construction for residential and commercial use while maintaining high environmental standards and modern facilities.

metadata.title: The Lahore Ring Road Authority (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011 to rename the entity as the Punjab Ring Road Authority and extend its scope to the entire province of Punjab. It updates definitions for ring roads, strategic roads, and economic corridors while modifying various sections regarding governance, project approval limits, and financial powers.

name: LAHORE INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LAHORE ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Lahore Institute of Science and Technology, Lahore Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Institute of Science and Technology, Lahore as a private sector body corporate in Punjab. It defines the institute's structure, including its Patron, Board, and Rector, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Lahore Ring Road Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011 to rename the entity as the Punjab Ring Roads Authority and extend its scope to the entire province. It updates definitions for ring roads, strategic roads, and economic corridors while modifying the powers of the Chairperson and Board.

name: NATIONAL COLLEGE OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION & ECONOMICS, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the National College of Business Administration & Economics, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to incorporate a private company as an educational entity and redefine the Board of Governors. It also adds new campuses in Multan, Rahim Yar Khan, and Bahawalpur to the institute's structure.

metadata.title: The Namal University, Mianwali Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Namal University, Mianwali as a private sector body corporate located in Mianwali. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board, and Rector, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The NUR International University Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The NUR International University Lahore Act 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the NUR International University Lahore Act 2015 to add the faculty of allied health sciences. It specifically inserts new departments for Physical Therapy, Medical Lab Technology, and Speech & Language Pathology while validating previous statutory provisions.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 by inserting specific words into section 11C. The amendment adds the phrase 'excluding media persons' to subsection (1) of that section.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 to define the powers, immunities, and privileges of the Assembly, its committees, and its members. It introduces new definitions for terms such as 'Chamber', 'Committee', and 'Officer of the House', and establishes provisions regarding the power to detain individuals prejudicial to assembly privileges.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to extend hospital services to the general public and improve implementation. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to modify provisions regarding the retirement of civil servants. Specifically, it substitutes new clauses in section 12 concerning mandatory retirement at age sixty or voluntary retirement after twenty-five years of service or reaching fifty-five years of age.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to modify provisions regarding the retirement of civil servants. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Apprenticeship Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act promotes, develops, and regulates apprenticeship programmes within establishments in the Punjab province. It establishes minimum standards for skills, defines key terms like 'apprentice' and 'employer', and outlines the obligations of both employers and apprentices regarding training and contracts.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION FOR REGULARIZATION OF IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance, 2021 to improve the functioning of the Commission and address ancillary matters. It introduces specific exclusions for certain types of land owned by federal or local governments and modifies definitions regarding illegal housing schemes and non-planned areas.

metadata.title: The Punjab Commercial Courts Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Commercial Courts in the Punjab to facilitate the expeditious disposal of commercial disputes and claims arising from trade and business transactions. It aims to provide an effective legal regime for early resolution of such disputes, thereby supporting investment and ease of doing business within the province.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION FOR REGULARIZATION OF IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes (Amendment) Ordinance 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance 2021 to improve the functioning of the Commission and address ancillary matters. It introduces specific amendments to the long title, preamble, definitions, composition of the Commission, and operational clauses of the original Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION FOR REGULARIZATION OF IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Commission to examine and regularize private housing schemes and land sub-divisions developed irregularly without competent authority approval. It aims to alleviate grievances for affected individuals by providing a legal framework for the regularization of such developments within the Punjab.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION FOR REGULARIZATION OF IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission for Regularization of Irregular Housing Schemes Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Commission to examine and regularize private housing schemes and land subdivisions developed irregularly without competent authority approval. It aims to alleviate grievances for affected individuals by providing a legal framework for the regularization of such developments within the Punjab.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON IRREGULAR HOUSING SCHEMES (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes (Second Amendment) Ordinance 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Commission on Irregular Housing Schemes Act 2021 to improve the functioning of the Commission and address ancillary matters. It establishes a new Council to oversee irregular housing schemes, defines its composition, and grants it the power to review recommendations and issue binding directions to government agencies.

name: PUNJAB COMPULSORY TEACHING OF THE HOLY QURAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2018 to update definitions regarding compulsory teaching and Naazrah Quran. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May 18, 2021, and received assent from the Acting Governor on May 28, 2021.

metadata.title: The Punjab Community Safety Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act ensures community safety measures in buildings and health or fitness centers within the Punjab. It establishes duties for the Punjab Emergency Service, defines specific roles like safety managers and physicians, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Emergency Service (Amendment) Act 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Emergency Service Act 2006 to update provisions regarding the structure, promotions, and retirement conditions of emergency officers. It introduces requirements for physical fitness and regularizes the service status of certain officers after a specific period of employment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Educational Institutions (Reconstitution) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes certain educational institutions in the Punjab to improve their governance and management. It grants these institutions academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while establishing a Board of Governors for oversight.

name: PUNJAB ENFORCEMENT OF WOMEN'S PROPERTY RIGHTS ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework to protect and secure the ownership and possession rights of women in Punjab against harassment, coercion, force, or fraud. It empowers an appointed Ombudsperson to investigate complaints regarding property deprivation and issue orders to restore title or possession, either directly or through referral to civil courts for complex cases.

name: PUNJAB ENFORCEMENT OF WOMENS PROPERTY RIGHTS ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act protects and secures the ownership and possession rights of women in property within the Punjab. It establishes an Ombudsperson to handle complaints regarding illegal deprivation of such rights through harassment, coercion, force, or fraud, enabling summary enquiries and orders for restoration without immediate court intervention unless complex adjudication is required.

name: PUNJAB HOLY QURAN (PRINTING AND RECORDING) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011 to strengthen penalties for translating or interpreting the Holy Quran contrary to Muslim beliefs. It increases imprisonment terms and fines, adds provisions for life imprisonment in cases of unlawful intent, and introduces new sections regarding the cognizance and trial of offences under the Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The Punjab Finance Act, 1977; The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes and duties within the Province of Punjab. It also addresses ancillary matters related to these fiscal changes.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act, 2020 to facilitate its better implementation. It inserts a new section allowing the Secretary to frame temporary regulations to prevent outbreaks and determine expense defrayal methods.

name: PUNJAB LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an efficacious and speedy mechanism for the issuance of Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates in the Punjab. It aims to facilitate this process while curtailing fraud and forgery by utilizing the National Database and Registration Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by omitting specific entries from its Tenth Schedule regarding licensing fees for professions and vocations. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020.

name: PUNJAB LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a speedy mechanism for issuing Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates in the Punjab to curb fraud and forgery. It empowers the National Database and Registration Authority to issue these certificates based on Family Registration Certificates and mandates the creation of a Succession Facilitation Unit to process applications.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to rectify an inadvertent typographical mistake in its Sixth Schedule. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on February 12, 2021, as the Provincial Assembly was not in session at the time.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to provide for the mode of election to Village and Neighbourhood Councils. It also introduces ancillary matters regarding the constitution of Town Committees and delimitation processes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to establish an effective local government system. It aims to empower decision-making at the grassroots level and improve service delivery through a bottom-up approach.

name: PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003 to update definitions, objects, administration, and appointment procedures for medical institutions. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) (Amendment) Ordinance 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act 2020 to incorporate provisions for smooth implementation and other relevant laws. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session, and it came into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Punjab Museums Board Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Museums Board to ensure efficient maintenance and management of museums in the Punjab. It defines the Board's composition, powers, functions, and the roles of its officers, including the Chief Executive Officer.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission to address grievances of Overseas Pakistanis regarding government agencies. It establishes the composition, tenure, and functions of the Commission, including its powers to review performance and nominate members for advisory councils and committees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Panah Gah Authority Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Panah Gah Authority to create a comprehensive system for protecting and providing temporary shelter to shelterless persons in the Punjab. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to establish, maintain, and operate Panah Gahs, acquire property, and formulate standards for their operation.

name: PUNJAB PREVENTION OF SPECULATION IN ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Speculation in Essential Commodities Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of speculation in essential commodities to curb artificial price hikes and profiteering. It establishes definitions for key terms, mandates information provision and stock declarations by dealers, and sets rules for delivery order registration and lifting periods.

name: PUNJAB PREVENTION OF SPECULATION IN ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Speculation in Essential Commodities Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of speculation in essential commodities to curb artificial price hikes and profiteering. It empowers authorized officers to verify stocks, require information on production and sales, and regulate delivery orders within the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Privatization Board (Repeal) Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010. It provides for the immediate transfer of properties, moveable assets, and employees of the defunct board to the Colonies Department, Board of Revenue, Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Representatives' Laws (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974; The Punjab Special Assistants (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Advisors (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to the salaries, allowances, and privileges of public representatives in the Province of Punjab. It specifically updates financial figures for members, defines eligibility for perks for former Speakers, and adds security provisions for former Chief Ministers.

name: PUNJAB TOURISM, CULTURE AND HERITAGE AUTHORITY ORDINANCE 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Tourism, Culture and Heritage Authority Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Tourism, Culture and Heritage Authority to promote travel and tourism in the province. It creates a body corporate with defined composition, powers, and procedures for managing heritage, landscape, and culture.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act, 2013. It extends the Commissioner's term of office and modifies provisions regarding on-spot examination of information and annual reporting.

metadata.title: The Punjab Travel Agencies (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Travel Agencies Act, 1976 to adapt it to the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010 and address ancillary matters. It substitutes specific sections within the 1976 Act to change jurisdictional references from Federal/Pakistan to Punjab, define new roles for controllers, establish a regulatory committee, and introduce powers for sealing unlicensed agencies.

metadata.title: The Qarshi University (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Qarshi University, Muridke Act 2011 to reflect changes in its governing body and structure. It substitutes references to 'Muridke' with 'Society', deems the university established in the private sector, and updates faculty listings and trust definitions.

metadata.title: The Rashid Latif Khan University Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Rashid Latif Khan University in the private sector with its campus located in Lahore. It provides for the university's powers to offer instructions across various disciplines, establish constituent colleges and institutes, prescribe courses of study, and confer degrees.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020 to facilitate its smooth implementation. It introduces a Board structure with specific members and substitutes references to 'Authority' with 'Board' throughout various sections.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes local governments in the Punjab and consolidates laws relating to their powers and functions. It aims to establish an effective elected local government system for meaningful devolution of political, administrative, and financial responsibility.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.amends: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020 to facilitate its smooth implementation. It establishes a Board of the Authority and substitutes references to the 'Authority' with 'Board' throughout various sections, while also defining the roles and appointment terms for the Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

name: SOUTH PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT 2021

metadata.title: The South Punjab Institute of Science and Technology Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the South Punjab Institute of Science and Technology Dera Ghazi Khan as a body corporate in the private sector. It provides for the institute's structure, functions, including offering courses in sciences and social sciences, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to update terminology and definitions relevant to the Punjab province. It introduces new clauses regarding electronic services, multi-storey buildings, and specific entities subject to stamp duty while adjusting financial figures and jurisdictional references.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020; The Sugar Factories (Control) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to ensure timely and transparent payments to cane growers. It introduces new definitions for Cane Purchase Receipts, sets specific deadlines for crushing cane and clearing payments, and modifies provisions regarding purchasing agents and legal liabilities.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to ensure timely and transparent payments to cane-growers. It introduces specific provisions regarding the crushing schedule, direct bank transfers for payments, determination of liability by the Cane Commissioner, and changes to offence classification.

metadata.title: The Superior College, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Superior College, Lahore Act, 2004 to transform the institution into the Superior University, Lahore. It substitutes references of 'College' and 'Institute' with 'University', updates the long title and preamble, and establishes the new university as a body corporate in the private sector.

metadata.title: The Thal University Bhakkar Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Thal University Bhakkar as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the reconstitution of the sub-campus of the University of Sargodha at Bhakkar into the new university and outlines its structure, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and other governing bodies.

metadata.title: The Times Institute, Multan (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Times Institute, Multan Act, 2020 to update definitions and modify the composition of the Board of Governors. It also revises the First Statutes regarding faculty structures and nominee requirements for the institute.

metadata.title: The University of Chenab Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Chenab as a private sector body corporate located in Gujrat. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Board, and various authorities, and grants it powers to provide instruction across multiple faculties.

metadata.title: Ravi Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Ravi Urban Development Authority Act 2020 to ensure the smooth functioning of the Authority. It modifies various sections regarding definitions, area specifications, scheme publication timelines, and includes provisions for saving and validating prior actions taken by previous authorities.

metadata.title: The University of Faisalabad (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002 to incorporate changes regarding faculty definitions and governance structures. Specifically, it updates sections related to academic disciplines, teaching methods, and the representation of the Punjab Higher Education Commission within the university.

metadata.title: The University of Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to replace references to a 'Company' with a 'Trust' and updates the definition of the sponsoring body. It also revises the list of faculties, substitutes the Higher Education Commission for the University Grants Commission, and omits specific clauses regarding the Ibadat Educational Trust.

name: UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMENT AND TECHNOLOGY LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The University of Management and Technology, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The University of Management and Technology, Lahore Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Management and Technology, Lahore Act, 2004 to update its scope and structure. It introduces new faculties, modifies teaching modes to include online learning, restricts sub-campus openings for ten years, and changes the appointment criteria for the Rector.

name: UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH ASIA, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2021

metadata.title: The University of South Asia, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The University of South Asia, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of South Asia, Lahore Act, 2005 to update its provisions regarding faculties, teaching methods, and institutional affiliations. It specifically inserts new clauses to facilitate student exchange programs, regularize previous difficulties, and define specific faculty structures including engineering and allied health sciences.

name: UNIVERSITY OF CHILD HEALTH SCIENCES, LAHORE ACT 2021

metadata.title: The University of Child Health Sciences, Lahore Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Child Health Sciences, Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the university's structure, including constituent colleges and hospitals, and aims to impart medical education, promote research in child health, and provide related services.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to update terminology and expand definitions for the Province of Punjab. It introduces new provisions regarding membership limits, merger procedures, and specific rules for housing society members.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Second Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to update definitions regarding beneficial owners and prescribe information requirements. It introduces new sections for the Registrar to decide specific questions and mandates societies to provide detailed information to authorities under the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010.

name: BABA GURU NANAK UNIVERSITY NANKANA SAHIB ACT 2020

metadata.title: Baba Guru Nanak University Nankana Sahib Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Baba Guru Nanak University Nankana Sahib as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various councils, while outlining its functions such as conducting examinations, awarding degrees, and managing research.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at ensuring swift justice and reducing case backlogs. It substitutes and inserts new sections regarding court hierarchies, electronic maintenance of records, timelines for written statements, and modern methods for serving summons.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 by adding specific subjects to section 14A. The amendments include forests, mines, food adulteration, encroachments on public lands, dangerous driving, building safety, and municipal services.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to introduce procedural reforms aimed at reducing case backlogs and ensuring swift justice. It substitutes several sections to establish a court hierarchy, mandate electronic record maintenance, set strict timelines for filing written statements and framing issues, and modernize the service of summons.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to adapt it to the Constitution's Eighteenth Amendment and provincial jurisdiction. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab, updates definitions regarding workers and companies, and establishes a new committee for monitoring implementation.

metadata.title: The Green International University Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Green International University as a body corporate located in Lahore within the private sector. It defines the university's structure, including its Board of Governors and various faculties, and outlines its powers to conduct courses, hold examinations, and award degrees.

metadata.title: Kohsar University, Murree Act 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Kohsar University, Murree by reconstituting existing Government Degree Colleges in Murree. It defines the university's corporate status, structure, and transfers associated properties and liabilities to the new institution.

name: PUNJAB BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962 to provide temporary provisions for granting certificates and diplomas. These grants are intended for persons promoted through an alternative criterion rather than conventional examinations due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018 to update definitions and provisions related to agricultural marketing activities. It introduces new terms such as 'virtual market' and 'private market,' while also modifying sections regarding the authority's functions and committee structures.

name: PUNJAB CURRICULUM AND TEXTBOOK BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Act, 2015 to introduce new requirements for publishing religious textbooks. Specifically, it mandates that any textbook or curriculum related to Islam must receive prior approval from the Muttahida Ulema Board, Punjab before publication.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to update terminology and definitions relevant to the Punjab province. It introduces specific provisions regarding housing societies, merger procedures, and membership transfer rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Hotels and Restaurants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants Act, 1976 to adapt it for Punjab-specific administration. It rationalizes penalties, substitutes references from 'Pakistan' to 'Punjab', and introduces new provisions regarding sealing establishments and advertising unlicensed venues.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2020
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Punjab Entertainment Duty Act, 1958; Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes and duties in the Punjab province. It amends several existing laws, including the Stamp Act of 1899, various 1958 Acts, and the Sales Tax on Services Act of 2012.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act 2020 to facilitate its better implementation. It inserts a new section 28-A that empowers the Secretary to frame temporary regulations to prevent the outbreak or spread of infectious diseases.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions for the prevention and control of infectious diseases within the Punjab province. It empowers the Secretary to declare infection threats, impose duties on medical practitioners, and enforce restrictions on persons, things, and premises to mitigate public health risks.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions for the prevention and control of infectious diseases within the Punjab province. It empowers the Secretary, with approval from the Chief Minister, to declare infection threats and impose duties on medical practitioners, health facilities, and the general public.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by substituting 'twenty one months' for 'one year' in section 3. It also repeals the Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by omitting specific entries from its Tenth Schedule regarding licensing fees for professions and vocations. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to amend the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019. It was issued because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary under Article 128 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Ordinance 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reconstitution of the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission to address grievances regarding government agencies. It establishes the composition, tenure, and functions of the Commission, including its powers to review annual reports and refer complaints.

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Hoarding Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of hoarding of scheduled articles during the emergent situation caused by the Corona virus pandemic (COVID-19) in Punjab. It defines offenses related to stocking excess quantities or accumulating goods without offering them for sale, and establishes powers for search, seizure, and auction of such articles.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to improve medical education and enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and responsiveness of healthcare services within Medical Teaching Institutions in Punjab. It establishes a Provincial Policy Board to oversee these institutions and defines their objectives, structure, and operational functions.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to address special circumstances such as calamities or epidemics. It inserts a new section allowing the Registering Authority to issue directives for school closure and alternative education methods during hazardous situations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Hoarding Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to prevent hoarding of essential articles during the COVID-19 pandemic when the Provincial Assembly was not in session. It defines offenses related to stocking excess quantities or failing to sell demanded goods, prescribes penalties including imprisonment and fines, and grants officers powers to search premises without a warrant and auction seized items.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to address special circumstances such as calamities, epidemics, or natural disasters. It empowers the Registering Authority to issue directives for school closures and determine alternative education methods and fee structures during these events.

metadata.title: The Punjab Tourist Guides (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Tourist Guides Act, 1976 to adapt it for provincial use by substituting 'Federal' with 'Punjab' and replacing references to the central government with the Government of the Punjab. It also substitutes Section 11 to allow the Government to delegate its powers under the Act to subordinate officers or authorities via notification.

metadata.title: The Punjab Protected Areas Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of ecologically important areas within the Punjab. It establishes a Management Board to oversee these efforts and empowers the Government to declare various types of protected areas such as national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, and wetlands.

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 to ensure that surplus assets from wound-up societies are not divided among members but are instead devoted to public or charitable purposes. It inserts a new section 15-A detailing these disposal requirements and repeals the corresponding Ordinance of 2020.

metadata.title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 to address the disposal of surplus assets from wound-up societies. It mandates that such assets must be devoted to public utility or charitable purposes rather than being divided among members.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to improve its implementation. It substitutes specific words in Section 21 and updates the First Schedule regarding permitted neighbourhood numbers for various metropolitan corporations.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 by substituting 'twelve months' with 'twenty one months' in section 10. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 by substituting 'twenty one months' for 'twelve months' in section 10. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2020

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to facilitate its better implementation. It substitutes specific words in Section 21 and updates entries in the First Schedule regarding permitted neighbourhood numbers for various metropolitan corporations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979 to update definitions regarding authorities, beneficial owners, and reporting entities in line with anti-money laundering standards. It also introduces new provisions for the appointment of administrators, mandatory registration timelines for waqf properties, and requirements for maintaining centralized records.

metadata.title: The Punjab Women Protection Authority (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Punjab Women Protection Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Women Protection Authority Act, 2017 to insert new subsections regarding perks, privileges, and conditions of service for the Chairperson. It also provides for travelling allowances for members attending Authority meetings.

metadata.title: The Punjab Trusts Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act revises and modifies the law relating to trusts within the Punjab province. It establishes provisions for the creation, validity, and subject matter of trusts, while explicitly excluding Muslim law regarding waqf and customary family relations from its scope.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ravi Urban Development Authority to oversee comprehensive planning and development in a specified area. It aims to improve the quality of life, rehabilitate the Ravi River, and provide modern civic facilities while evolving policies for housing, industry, and waste disposal.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reduces certain stamp duties in the urban areas of the Punjab. It amends the Stamp Act, 1899 by substituting specific monetary values and percentages with lower figures to effect these reductions.

metadata.title: The Ravi Urban Development Authority Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Ravi Urban Development Authority to oversee comprehensive planning and development in specified areas of Lahore Division. It aims to improve the quality of life, rehabilitate the Ravi River aquifer, and manage civic infrastructure including housing, transportation, and waste disposal.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to modify provisions regarding the date for starting cane crushing. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 to ensure timely and transparent payments to cane-growers. It introduces new clauses regarding Cane Purchase Receipts, establishes powers for the Cane Commissioner to determine payment liabilities, and updates penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Times Institute, Multan Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Times Institute, Multan as a corporate body with perpetual succession. It outlines the institute's structure, including its Board of Governors and various academic roles, while defining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Fort Monroe Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Fort Monroe Development Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Fort Monroe Development Authority Act 2016 to extend the Authority's jurisdiction for development and rehabilitation of Koh-e-Suleman and the Tribal Area of DG Khan. It substitutes references from 'Fort Monroe' to 'Koh-e-Suleman' throughout the original Act, including its title, preamble, and specific sections.

metadata.title: The University of Chakwal Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Chakwal by reconstituting existing government colleges and sub-campuses into a single body corporate. It defines the university's powers to acquire property, open sub-campuses, and outlines the transfer of assets and employees from the predecessor institutions.

metadata.title: The Namal Institute Mianwali Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Namal Institute Mianwali as a private sector body corporate located in Mianwali. It provides for the institute's structure, including its Patron, Board, and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction in engineering and computer sciences, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

name: MIR CHAKAR KHAN RIND UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Mir Chakar Khan Rind University of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the reconstitution of the Government College of Technology Dera Ghazi Khan into this new university, including the transfer of properties and liabilities.

name: PAKISTAN KIDNEY AND LIVER INSTITUTE AND RESEARCH CENTER ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center in the Punjab. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with specific functions to provide medical care, conduct research, and offer training in kidney, liver, bladder, prostate, and pancreatic diseases.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to broaden the definition of an employee. Specifically, it substitutes a clause in Section 2 to clarify that employment status is not lost solely because monthly wages exceed a government-determined threshold.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to broaden the definition of an employee. It specifically addresses wage thresholds to ensure employees are not disqualified solely because their monthly wages exceed government-determined limits.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT SERVICES ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the recruitment and conditions of service for persons appointed in the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'post', and 'Secretariat' while establishing the structure and composition of the Secretariat headed by a Secretary.

metadata.title: The Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act, 2019 to update its preamble and expand the functions of the Authority. The amendments include changes to definitions regarding facilities and codes, as well as new powers for the Authority to register facilities, issue licenses, maintain databases, and oversee infrastructure projects for clean drinking water provision.

metadata.title: The Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act 2019 to update definitions, expand the functions of the Authority regarding water infrastructure and licensing, and modify specific sections related to governance and strategic guidance. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority as a body corporate to manage clean drinking water supply in the province. It outlines the Authority's functions, including conducting surveys, constructing water filtration plants, and ensuring sustainable access to safe water for the public.

metadata.title: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system for the alternate dispute resolution of civil and criminal disputes within the Punjab. It aims to ensure inexpensive and expeditious justice by utilizing processes such as mediation, conciliation, and evaluation outside of traditional court adjudication.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018 to update definitions and operational provisions. It introduces new terms such as 'virtual market' and 'private market,' expands the functions of the Authority, and establishes specific rules for management committees and remuneration.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animal Health Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the prevention, control, containment, and eradication of scheduled animal diseases in the Punjab. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'controlled areas', 'disease-free areas', and 'scheduled diseases' to meet international standards for animal trade.

name: PUNJAB BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Act 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962 to grant regulatory, administrative, and operational autonomy to the Punjab Skills Development Authority. It substitutes Section 4 regarding the Board's composition and terms, and amends Section 10 concerning the Board's powers to conduct examinations and issue certificates.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2019
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Punjab Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Punjab province. It amends existing legislation including the Stamp Act of 1899, the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act of 1958, and the Punjab Finance Act of 1977 to update tax rates and definitions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Domestic Workers Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the employment of domestic workers in the Province of Punjab to protect their rights and ensure their welfare. It establishes provisions for dignified working conditions, prohibits bonded labor and discrimination, and sets standards for wages and benefits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Khal Panchayat Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Khal Panchayats for each water course to manage irrigation rights and obligations. It defines the composition, functions, and duties of these bodies, including their role in mediating disputes and distributing water schedules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to exclude certain notified areas from its operation regarding assessment and collection of land revenue. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019.

metadata.title: The Punjab Khal Panchayat Ordinance 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Khal Panchayats for each water course in areas maintained by the Government under the canal irrigation system. It defines the composition, functions, and duties of these bodies, including their role in mediating disputes, managing water distribution schedules (warabandi), and handling issues like cattle trespassing.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to align it with the Elections Act, 2017. It introduces various changes to definitions, sections regarding elections, and provisions for local government administration within the Punjab province.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to align it with the Elections Act, 2017. It introduces new definitions, inserts additional sections, and modifies various clauses regarding elections, government agencies, and local government structures within the Punjab province.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to improve medical education and enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and responsiveness of healthcare services. It establishes a body corporate structure for Medical Teaching Institutions and creates a Provincial Policy Board to oversee their functioning.

metadata.title: The Punjab Minimum Wages Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates laws regulating minimum wage rates for unskilled and skilled workers in industrial and commercial establishments across Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'employer', 'worker', and 'commercial establishment' to establish the legal framework for fixing and enforcing these wages.

name: PUNJAB OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for occupational safety and health at workplaces in the Punjab province. It aims to protect persons against risks arising from occupational hazards and to promote a safe working environment catering to physiological and psychological needs.

name: PUNJAB PREVENTION OF CONFLICT OF INTEREST ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Conflict of Interest Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Prevention of Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commission to regulate public office holders in the province. It sets principles to prevent conflicts between private interests and public duties while providing mechanisms for resolution.

name: PUNJAB PROBATION AND PAROLE SERVICE ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Probation and Parole Service Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Probation and Parole Service to effectively assess and manage offenders on probation or parole. It aims to improve coordination within the criminal justice system and facilitate offender rehabilitation through a structured service framework.

name: PUNJAB PROBATION AND PAROLE SERVICE ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Probation and Parole Service Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Probation and Parole Service to effectively assess and manage offenders on probation or parole. It aims to improve coordination within the criminal justice system and facilitate offender rehabilitation through a structured service framework.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act creates an enabling environment to promote private sector participation and investment in partnership with the public sector for providing public infrastructure and services. It aims to bridge the gap between demand and supply of such services, harness the role of PPPs for mobilizing private funding, and address related matters.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an enabling environment for private sector participation in development projects within the Punjab province through Public Private Partnerships (PPP). It aims to bridge the gap between public infrastructure demand and supply by mobilizing private funding, resources, and expertise. The legislation applies to all PPP projects conceived, developed, approved, and implemented in the Province of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Representatives' Laws (Amendment) Act 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974; The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act 1972; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to the public representatives of the Province of Punjab. It updates salaries, allowances, and privileges for members of the Provincial Assembly, Ministers, Speakers, and other officials.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to reduce the required period of continuous service from four years to three years for contract employees. It broadens the scope of the Act to include all contract employees who have served continuously for at least three years and meet specific eligibility criteria for regular appointment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes local governments in the Punjab to ensure the effective discharge of public services. It defines various terms related to administration, elections, and governance while specifying the extent of its application within the province.

name: PUNJAB RIGHT TO PUBLIC SERVICES ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Right to Public Services Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the right of eligible persons in Punjab to receive public services within a specified time limit. It defines the responsibilities of designated officers, outlines procedures for service notification, and provides mechanisms for accountability and compensation for service deficiencies.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES (HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board in the Punjab to manage seized and freezed facilities. It provides for the mainstreaming of employees within these facilities and outlines the powers, composition, and functions of the Board and its Directorate.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES (HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Ordinance 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board to manage facilities seized or frozen under United Nations Security Council orders. It provides for the mainstreaming of employees within these facilities and outlines the composition, powers, and functions of the Board and a newly established Directorate.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED INSTITUTIONS (MADAARIS AND SCHOOLS) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Madaaris and Schools Management Board in the Punjab to manage seized and frozen institutions. It aims to ensure the mainstreaming of students from these institutions and provides for related matters.
