name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED INSTITUTIONS (MADAARIS AND SCHOOLS) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: Punjab Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Ordinance 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Madaaris and Schools Management Board in the Punjab to manage seized and frozen educational institutions. It provides for the constitution of a body corporate with specific powers to acquire property, recruit staff, and formulate budgets for these institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sentencing Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act lays down the factors that courts must consider when passing sentences to improve consistency in sentencing within the Punjab. It establishes a Sentencing Council and defines specific aggravating and mitigating factors, such as violence, cruelty, and the offender's history, that influence the severity of punishment.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 to grant regulatory and operational autonomy to the Punjab Skills Development Authority. It comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to align it with the Elections Act, 2017. It introduces new sections regarding the application of election provisions, delimitation rules by the Election Commission, and amendments to definitions and procedures for village and neighbourhood formation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Skills Development Authority Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Skills Development Authority to promote and regulate the technical education and vocational training sector in the Punjab. It defines the composition of the Authority, including ex officio members and nominated representatives from the Provincial Assembly.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to align it with the Elections Act, 2017. It introduces provisions for the Election Commission to delimit villages and neighbourhoods and modifies various sections regarding definitions, election procedures, and voting rights.

metadata.title: The Punjab Water Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the comprehensive management and regulation of all water resources in the Punjab. Its primary objective is to ensure the conservation and sustainability of these resources while addressing connected matters.

metadata.title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018 to update provisions regarding service agencies, council composition, and fund disbursement. It also introduces mechanisms for appointing administrators when committees are not constituted and repeals a previous amendment ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018 to address situations where a District Zakat and Ushr Committee's tenure expires without a new committee being constituted. It empowers the Government to assign the committee's functions to the Deputy Commissioner or another senior district officer until a new committee is formed.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act institutionalizes and strengthens civic engagement for non-political action in the Punjab by establishing village Panchayats and urban neighbourhood councils. It provides definitions for key terms, outlines applicable areas, and sets forth provisions regarding elections, corruption practices, and the structure of local boards.

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Rawalpindi Women University in Rawalpindi by reconstituting the existing Government Postgraduate College for Women. It grants the university corporate status, allowing it to hold property, sue and be sued, and administer campuses.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to exclude certain notified areas from its operation regarding land revenue assessment and collection. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: THE PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by substituting the word 'seize' with 'cease' in section 316. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: THE PUNJAB REGULARIZATION OF SERVICE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to reduce the required period of continuous service from four years to three years for contract employees. It broadens the scope of regularization to include all contract employees who have served continuously for at least three years and meet specific eligibility criteria.

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of Rawalpindi Women University in Rawalpindi by reconstituting the Government Postgraduate College for Women. It declares the new entity as a body corporate with perpetual succession and transfers all properties, rights, and liabilities from the former college to the university.

name: THE PUNJAB WORKERS WELFARE FUND ACT 2019

metadata.title: The Punjab Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Workers Welfare Fund to facilitate workers in the province. It defines the fund's constitution, outlines payment obligations for establishments based on total income, and details the recovery mechanisms and tax treatment of contributions.

metadata.title: The University of Mianwali Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Mianwali by reconstituting the existing sub-campus of the University of Sargodha located at Mianwali. It grants the new university corporate status, perpetual succession, and the authority to acquire property, manage assets, and administer campuses.

metadata.title: The University of Mianwali Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Mianwali as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the reconstitution of the existing sub-campus of the University of Sargodha at Mianwali into the new university and transfers all associated properties, rights, and liabilities to it.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to prescribe penalties for failing to display security featured or vanity number plates. It inserts a new entry into the Twelfth Schedule of the Ordinance specifying fine amounts for motorcycles, cars/jeeps, and public service vehicles.

name: CHOLISTAN UNIVERSITY OF VETERINARY AND ANIMAL SCIENCES BAHAWALPUR ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Bahawalpur Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Bahawalpur to promote animal health services through advanced teaching, research, and diagnostics. It incorporates the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and transfers properties and liabilities from the former University College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences.

metadata.title: The Punjab Charities Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration, administration, and regulation of charities and the collection of charitable funds in Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'charity', 'charitable purpose', and 'collector', and establishes a Charity Commission to oversee these activities.

metadata.title: Punjab Agriculture Policy, 2017
metadata.summary: This notification approves the Punjab Agriculture Policy, 2017, to be followed by all line departments and stakeholders. The policy aims to transform the agriculture sector into a diversified, sustainable, modern, and market-driven entity through ICT empowerment and efficient resource utilization.

metadata.title: The Punjab Charities Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration, administration, and regulation of charities and the collection of charitable funds in Punjab. It establishes a Charity Commission to oversee these activities and defines key terms such as 'charitable purpose' and 'promoter'.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION INITIATIVES MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority to devise and manage dynamic initiatives in the education sector through partnerships with the private sector. It defines the composition, powers, and operational procedures of the Authority, including its corporate status, membership structure, and meeting requirements.

metadata.title: The Punjab Hepatitis Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Surveillance System for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of hepatitis within the Punjab. It outlines responsibilities for healthcare facilities regarding patient data reporting, waste disposal, and the use of auto-disabled syringes to control the spread of the disease.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to levy, alter, and rationalize certain taxes and duties within the province. It also addresses ancillary matters related to these financial changes.

name: PUNJAB SIKH ANAND KARAJ MARRIAGE ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Sikh Anand Karaj Marriage Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the solemnization and registration of Sikh marriages, commonly known as Anand Karaj. It establishes the legal framework for conducting these ceremonies, registering them with an appointed Registrar, and includes provisions for the dissolution of marriage through an Arbitration Council.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act, 2015 to increase the permitted number of external sound systems from one to four. The change allows for one system in each direction, substituting the previous restriction on the number of external speakers.

name: PUNJAB SAFE MEDICAL SUPPLIES AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Safe Medical Supplies Authority Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Safe Medical Supplies Authority to procure quality drugs and medical equipment for public health facilities in the Punjab. It provides for the composition, powers, and functions of the Authority, including its role in ensuring the prompt and equitable distribution of these supplies.

name: PUNJAB TIANJIN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY LAHORE ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore by reconstituting existing government institutes. It provides for the university's corporate status, property rights, and the transfer of employees from the predecessor institutions.

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Development Authority (Repeal) Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991 to allow the authority to be constituted under the Development of Cities Act, 1976. It ensures that existing rules, appointments, contracts, and rights acquired under the repealed Act continue to have effect unless specifically cancelled.

metadata.title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr within the Punjab province. It also establishes provisions for ancillary matters related to these financial obligations.

name: THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to update certain provisions within the Punjab jurisdiction. It includes substitutions and omissions in various sections regarding court procedures, execution of decrees, and cost determinations.

metadata.title: The Explosive Substances (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Explosive Substances Act, 1908 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. Specifically, it modifies section 7 by adding a proviso regarding the deemed consent for trial proceedings if the Provincial Government does not respond within sixty days.

metadata.title: The Limitation (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Limitation Act, 1908 to introduce a ninety-day limitation period for filing revision petitions under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It inserts a new Article 162-A into the First Schedule of the Limitation Act, 1908.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to update references from the Federal Government to the Government of the Punjab and to align with the Companies Act 2017. It establishes a new committee to monitor the implementation of the Act and introduces specific definitions for 'worker' and 'profits' within the provincial context.

name: THE PUNJAB BONDED LABOUR SYSTEM (ABOLITION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Bonded Labour System (Abolition) (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992 to make provisions more effective against exploitation in bonded and forced labour. It updates definitions to include 'forced labour' and inserts new sections regarding eviction protections and advance payments for employers.

name: THE PUNJAB COMPULSORY TEACHING OF THE HOLY QURAN ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act makes the teaching of the Holy Quran compulsory for Muslim students in all educational institutions within the Province of Punjab. It mandates specific recitation and translation requirements based on the student's grade level.

name: THE PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority to facilitate and regulate the systematic growth of agricultural produce marketing. It aims to assist agricultural commerce development, provide support to growers, and include incidental provisions for these purposes.

name: THE PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE INSPECTORATE ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service Inspectorate Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service Inspectorate to introduce an effective system for monitoring and inspecting the service. It defines the structure of the Inspectorate, including the appointment of a Director General, and outlines its functions such as periodic inspections, performance monitoring, and advising the government on improvements.

name: THE PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004 to facilitate the disposal of houses and plots to in-service government servants upon reaching a specified age. It also includes incidental provisions regarding the management of excess housing inventory.

metadata.title: The Drugs (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 by omitting specific sections and altering penalties related to spurious or adulterated drugs. It introduces stricter punishments for variations in drug specifications and modifies fines and imprisonment terms for various offenses.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to harmonize it with the Punjab Land Records Authority Act 2017. It updates various sections regarding definitions, fees, and procedures related to land records and mutation processes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Legal Aid Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Legal Aid Agency to provide legal services to indigent persons in the province of Punjab. It outlines the agency's functions, including policy evolution, monitoring legal aid provision, and maintaining a panel of accredited advocates. The legislation also defines key terms such as 'indigent person' and 'family dispute,' and sets out procedures for applying for and receiving legal aid.

metadata.title: The Punjab Laws (Amendment) Ordinance 2018
metadata.amends: Various laws of the Punjab (including The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873; The Land Acquisition (Mines) Act, 1885; The Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887; The Land Acquisition Act, 1894; The Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905; The Co-operative Societies Act, 1925; The Forest Act, 1927; The Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958; The Punjab Tobacco Vend Act, 1958; The Punjab Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959; The Punjab Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960; The Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960; and The Punjab Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various existing laws of the Punjab to harmonize them with the local government system established under the Punjab Local Government Act 2013. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to extend the term of office for Administrators of District Education and Health Authorities from twelve months to two years. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: THE PUNJAB SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.amends: The Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to facilitate business activities in the province. Specifically, it modifies section 24 regarding registration applications and fee structures.

name: THE PUNJAB REGULARIZATION OF SERVICE ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment on a regular basis of certain contract employees serving in the Punjab government. It deems eligible contract employees with satisfactory performance to be validly appointed and outlines the procedure for their regularization, including scrutiny committees and seniority determination.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act, 2015 to allow up to four external sound systems at places of worship for specific purposes like Azan and Khutba. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018.

metadata.title: The Punjab Witness Protection Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes measures to protect witnesses and other persons connected with criminal proceedings involving terrorism, sexual offences, or other serious crimes. It creates a Witness Protection Board and specific Units to oversee policy guidelines, provide close protection services, and manage the relocation or identity change of protected individuals.

metadata.title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 by adding specific clauses regarding instruments granting power to attorneys or agreements to sell rights in immovable property. It extends to the whole of Punjab and comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Registration (Second Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 to regulate and supervise the profession of conveyance writing. It introduces penalties for individuals who engage in conveyance writing without a valid enrolment or license.

name: THE PUNJAB UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY RASUL ACT 2018

metadata.title: The Punjab University of Technology Rasul Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab University of Technology Rasul by reconstituting the Government College of Technology Rasul. It provides for the university's corporate status, property rights, and functions to produce high-quality technical human resources.

metadata.title: The University of Sialkot Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Sialkot as a body corporate in the private sector within the Punjab province. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Board, while defining its functions such as providing education, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The University of Murree Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Murree in the Punjab province to provide instruction, training, and research opportunities. It defines the university's corporate status, governance structure including a Chancellor and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions such as prescribing courses, holding examinations, and awarding degrees.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ACT 2017

metadata.title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 to allow the authority to be constituted under the Development of Cities Act 1976. It ensures that existing rules, appointments, contracts, and rights acquired under the repealed Act continue in effect unless specifically cancelled.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 to allow the authority to be constituted under the Development of Cities Act, 1976. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Faisalabad Medical University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Faisalabad Medical University by reconstituting Punjab Medical College Faisalabad. It provides for the university's corporate status, governance structure, and functions including medical education, research, and degree awarding.

metadata.title: The University of Narowal Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Narowal by reconstituting and upgrading the sub-campus of the University of Gujrat located at Narowal. It grants the new university corporate status, defines its governing bodies, and provides for the transfer of assets and employees from the former sub-campus to the new institution.

metadata.title: The Faisalabad Medical University Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Faisalabad Medical University by reconstituting Punjab Medical College Faisalabad. It provides for the university's corporate status, functions in medical education and research, and the transfer of properties and liabilities from the college to the new university.

metadata.title: The Nishtar Medical University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Nishtar Medical University by reconstituting Nishtar Medical College Multan as a university. It provides for the administration of medical education, research, examinations, and the awarding of degrees within the Punjab province.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 to harmonize its provisions with current necessities. It introduces specific amendments regarding definitions, permissions for public park usage, lease terms, and repeals a previous Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 to harmonize its provisions with current necessities. It introduces specific changes regarding definitions, permissions for public park usage, lease terms, and advertisement rights.

It establishes conditions requiring substitute land declaration and immediate afforestation funding before such changes can occur.

metadata.title: The Punjab Halal Development Agency Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Halal Development Agency to regulate and promote the trade of halal food and non-food products in the province. It aims to ensure uniform Halal Standards and facilitate the implementation of directions from the Pakistan Halal Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to empower local governments to sell immovable property via public auction with prior government approval. It also substitutes Section 124 of the Ordinance to regulate the use, sale, and leasing of local government property.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Records Authority Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Land Records Authority to reform and modernize the system of land records in the province. It aims to improve service delivery, ensure long-lasting tenure security, and address ancillary matters related to land management.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update definitions and composition rules for various local bodies. It introduces specific requirements for technocrats, workers, women, peasants, youth, and non-Muslim members in Union Councils, District Councils, Municipal Committees, and Corporations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to empower the government to divide metropolitan and municipal corporations into zones for better service delivery. It also updates provisions regarding the representation of marginalized segments like workers, peasants, and technocrats, as well as rules for presiding over meetings in the absence of mayors or chairmen.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to empower rural Union Councils with urban characteristics to levy property tax. It substitutes a specific subsection in section 116 of the amended act to define how property tax rates are determined for these councils.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to empower the government to divide metropolitan and municipal corporations into zones for better service delivery. It also updates provisions regarding the representation of marginalized segments, increases the number of Deputy Mayors and Vice Chairmen, and clarifies rules for presiding over meetings in the absence of key officials.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to change the election system for reserved seats to proportional representation based on political party lists. It also modifies the election methods for Mayors and Chairmen to use open division and updates the definition of a technocrat.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Sixth Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to empower local governments to sell immovable properties after obtaining prior government approval and conducting a public auction. It also provides provisions for granting leases on immovable properties and transferring movable properties through public auctions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to align the election system for reserved seats with that of Provincial Assemblies. It introduces provisions for proportional representation via political party lists and mandates open division voting for Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Chairman, and Vice Chairman positions (excluding Union Councils). Additionally, it rationalizes the definition of a technocrat and establishes new procedures for electing members to reserved seats.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to ensure that local governments provide designated landfill sites for solid waste disposal. It introduces penalties for illegal dumping and mandates the maintenance of these sites according to bylaws.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to prevent violence at sensitive public places. It specifically prohibits armed persons from entering such locations, which include hospitals, government offices, and educational institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update definitions regarding technocrats and modify the composition of Union, District, Municipal, and Metropolitan Councils. It also omits section 18A of the parent Act and adjusts provisions concerning the election of chairmen and vice-chairmen.

metadata.title: The Punjab Marriage Functions Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance 2000 (II of 2000); The Punjab Marriage Functions Ordinance, 2015 (VI of 2016)
metadata.summary: This Act regulates marriage functions and related ceremonies within the Punjab province. It prohibits ostentatious displays such as street decorations, fireworks, and dowry exhibitions, while also restricting food served at public places to a single dish.

metadata.title: The Punjab Maternity Benefits (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maternity Benefits Ordinance, 1958 to provide further protections for employed women. It specifically substitutes Section 3 of the Ordinance to prohibit employing women during six weeks following childbirth and restricts arduous work before and after delivery.

name: PUNJAB MARRIAGE FUNCTIONS ORDINANCE 2015 (EXTENDED FOR A FURTHER PERIOD OF 90 DAYS BY THE PAP ON 18.4.2016)

metadata.title: The Punjab Marriage Functions Ordinance 2015
metadata.repeals: The Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates marriage functions and related ceremonies within the Punjab province to prevent ostentatious celebrations and wasteful expenses. It imposes specific restrictions on decorations, fireworks, dowry displays, food servings, and the timing of events, while also establishing committees for enforcement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Poultry Production Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates poultry production activities within the Punjab province. It establishes requirements for registering poultry premises to improve product quality and ensure biosecurity measures.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984 to improve the management of privately managed educational institutions. It specifically regulates fee structures, mandates registration for all institutions, and establishes penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009 to exclude private sector organizations from specific definitions and refine the scope of services. It introduces provisions for blacklisting bidders or contractors who engage in corrupt practices and updates definitions regarding procuring agencies and public procurement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act 2009 to exclude private sector organizations from the definition of a 'procuring agency' and to limit the scope of 'services'. It also refines exemption clauses, redefines corrupt practices, and inserts a new section on blacklisting bidders or contractors who engage in such practices.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF CHILD LABOUR AT BRICK KILNS ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Child Labour at Brick Kilns Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children at brick kilns in the Punjab to protect their growth, health, and education. It also regulates labor conditions by mandating written contracts, limiting cash advances, and establishing presumptions regarding child employment.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF CHILD LABOUR AT BRICK KILNS ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Child Labour at Brick Kilns Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children at brick kilns in the Punjab to protect their growth, health, and education. It also regulates labor conditions by mandating written contracts, limiting cash advances, and establishing presumptions regarding child employment.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF CHILD LABOUR AT BRICK KILNS ORDINANCE 2016 (EXTENDED FOR A FURTHER PERIOD OF 90 DAYS BY THE PAP ON 13.4.2016)

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Child Labour at Brick Kilns Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the employment of children at brick kilns in the Punjab and regulates labor conditions to protect their health, growth, and education. It establishes requirements for written engagement contracts, limits on cash advances (peshgi), and creates mechanisms to identify bonded laborers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Representatives' Laws (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974; The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to the salaries, allowances, and privileges of public representatives in the Province of the Punjab. It substitutes specific monetary figures in sections concerning members, parliamentary secretaries, ministers, and the speaker to reflect updated financial standards.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF WOMEN AGAINST VIOLENCE ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Women against Violence Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an effective system for the protection, relief, and rehabilitation of women against violence in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'violence', 'domestic violence', and 'Protection Centre' to create an enabling environment for women victims.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pure Food (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to ensure more effective enforcement and rationalize punishments for food-related offenses. It introduces new definitions for local authorities and expands the powers of inspectors regarding sealing premises and using electronic devices for evidence.

name: PUNJAB RESTRICTION ON EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Restriction on Employment of Children Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children and restricts the employment of adolescents in hazardous occupations within the Punjab. It establishes a Provincial Committee on Child Labour to advise on measures for eradicating child labour and defines specific working hour limits, mandatory rest intervals, and weekly holidays for adolescents.

metadata.title: The Punjab Revenue Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Revenue Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of sales tax on services by the Punjab Revenue Authority. It amends the Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012 to clarify definitions regarding members and insert provisions for validation of past actions taken before the full establishment of the Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Revenue Authority (Second Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012 to rationalize the composition of the Appellate Tribunal and validate the establishment of the Authority. It includes specific textual amendments to sections 5, 18, and 36 of the parent Act, adding new clauses regarding office formation and deemed establishment dates.

name: PUNJAB RESTRICTION ON EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN ORDINANCE, 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Restriction on Employment of Children Ordinance 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the employment of children and restricts the employment of adolescents in hazardous occupations within the Punjab. It establishes a Provincial Committee on Child Labour to advise on measures for eradicating child labour and defines specific working hour limits, mandatory rest intervals, and holiday requirements for adolescents.

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Protection Unit Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Special Protection Unit within the Police of the Punjab province. It provides for the constitution, ranks, functions, and terms of service for members dedicated to securing foreigners, important persons, and premises.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 to grant administrative and operational autonomy to the Authority. It omits a specific subsection from section 5 of the original Act and repeals the earlier Amendment Ordinance of 2015.

metadata.title: The Punjab Safe Cities Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Safe Cities Authority to oversee the construction, development, and maintenance of an integrated command, control, and communications (IC3) system. The Authority is tasked with ensuring the safety and security of people in major cities of the Punjab, starting with Lahore.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to allow for later dates determined by notification in specific sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vigilance Committees Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Vigilance Committees at the District, Sub-divisional, and Union Council levels within the Punjab province. It outlines the constitution, composition, and specific functions of these committees to monitor local areas for subversive activities and sectarianism.

name: PUNJAB VIGILANCE COMMITTEES ORDINANCE 2016 (EXTENDED FOR A FURTHER PERIOD OF 90 DAYS BY THE PAP ON 03.4.2016)

metadata.title: The Punjab Vigilance Committees Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Vigilance Committees at the District, Sub-divisional, and Union Council levels within the Punjab province. Its primary purpose is to ensure an effective watch and ward system to monitor subversive activities, hate literature, and sectarianism.

name: THE CONSTITUTION (TWENTY-SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016 (ACT NO.XXV) OF 2016)

metadata.title: The Constitution (Twenty-second Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to update terminology from 'servants' to 'staff' and modify provisions regarding the Election Commission. It introduces new criteria for appointing Commissioners and members, including requirements for senior civil servants or technocrats with specific experience levels.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to mandate the display of security featured number plates on motor vehicles. It also prescribes specific penalties for the counterfeiting or unauthorized preparation of these number plates.

name: THE PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update definitions and composition rules for various local bodies. It specifically introduces new requirements for technocrat members, adjusts reserved seats for women, peasants/workers, youth, and non-Muslims, and omits section 18A of the original Act.

name: ALI INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010 to expand the scope of education provided at the institute. It specifically updates Section 4 to include new branches of knowledge and modify examination procedures for awarding degrees and certificates.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Twenty-first Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act amends Article 175 of the Constitution to exclude certain terrorism-related offenses from standard constitutional trial provisions. It establishes special courts for trying individuals belonging to terrorist groups using religion or a sect as their name, particularly in cases involving armed forces combat.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Constitution of Pakistan to facilitate the speedy trial of certain offenses related to terrorism and insurgency. It specifically alters Article 175 and adds new entries to the First Schedule, allowing for trials under specific military and protection acts against individuals belonging to terrorist groups.

metadata.title: The University of Okara Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University of Okara by re-constituting the sub-campus of the University of Education, Lahore. It defines the university's corporate status, governing bodies, functions, and the rights of its employees and students.

name: FATIMA JINNAH MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LAHORE ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Fatima Jinnah Medical University Lahore by reconstituting and upgrading Fatima Jinnah Medical College Lahore. It provides for the university's corporate status, governance structure, functions in medical education and research, and the transfer of properties and liabilities from the college to the new university.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012 to substitute the word 'woman' with 'person' in specific sections and to mandate minimum numbers of female principals, lecturers, and experts. It also repeals a previous amendment ordinance from 2015.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012 to promote gender inclusivity within the university's administration and faculty. Specifically, it substitutes the term 'woman' with 'person' in certain sections and mandates the inclusion of female principals, lecturers, experts, and other staff members in various clauses.

metadata.title: The Fort Monroe Development Authority Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Fort Monroe Development Authority to develop the area as a tourist resort. It aims to promote domestic and international tourism, execute developmental plans, and improve socio-economic conditions for local people.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan (Second Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012 to exclude Ghazi Khan Medical College from the university's purview. It also provides options for government employees regarding absorption or deputation and transfers property rights associated with specific colleges back to the Government.

metadata.title: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by omitting a specific restriction on non-official member appointments in section 8. It also repeals the previous Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.

metadata.title: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by removing a restriction on consecutive terms for non-official members. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF THE PUNJAB ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab to oversee the planning, designing, construction, and maintenance of infrastructure in the province. It provides for the hiring of consultants and contractors to execute these projects according to international best practices. The document also defines the composition of the Authority, including ex-officio members from government departments and local governments, as well as technical experts.

metadata.title: The NUR International University Lahore Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes NUR International University Lahore as a body corporate in the private sector within the Punjab province. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and Vice Chancellor, and defines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 to update specific sections regarding rules, regulations, and board composition. It comes into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce penalties for overcharging fares by transport vehicle operators. It establishes specific fines and sanctions, such as impounding vehicles or suspending route permits, for repeated violations of approved fare structures.

name: PAKISTAN KIDNEY AND LIVER INSTITUTE AND RESEARCH CENTER ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center as a not-for-profit organization in the Punjab. It grants the Institute corporate status, defines its functions regarding medical care, research, education, and property management, and outlines its powers to conduct surveys and promote health policies.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to address issues regarding fare overcharging. It introduces a new section imposing specific fines and penalties, such as vehicle impounding or suspension of route permits, for repeated violations by transport operators.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to regulate axle loads of goods vehicles for public safety and road infrastructure. It introduces new penalties for overloading trailers or trolleys, operating unlicensed bodybuilding workshops, and non-compliance with notified specifications.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to allow owners to apply for personalized vanity plates linked to specific registration marks. It mandates that these plates be displayed on motor vehicles according to prescribed materials and specifications.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Arms Ordinance, 1965 to update offences and penalties related to the sale, possession, and transport of arms. It specifically categorizes weapons into non-prohibited and prohibited bore types with corresponding imprisonment terms and fines.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Arms Ordinance, 1965 to update provisions regarding offences and penalties related to arms, ammunition, and military stores. It specifically substitutes Section 13 to define punishments for selling, possessing, or transporting contraband weapons, distinguishing between non-prohibited and prohibited bore weapons.

metadata.title: The Punjab Child Marriage Restraint (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929 to curb child marriage and protect women from exploitation within the Punjab province. It substitutes specific sections of the original 1929 Act to redefine terms like 'child' and 'minor', increase penalties for marrying a child, and designate Family Courts for trial jurisdiction.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006 to update provisions regarding appointments, recruitment, promotion, and transfer within the service. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance of 2015.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006. It specifically alters Section 8 regarding appointment procedures for the service, substituting subsections to clarify recruitment, promotion, and transfer rules while omitting a previous subsection.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006. It specifically alters section 8 regarding appointment procedures for the service, substituting subsections (3) and (4) with new text on recruitment, promotion, and transfer, while omitting subsection (5).

name: PUNJAB DISABLED PERSONS (EMPLOYMENT AND REHABILITATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981 by substituting 'three percent' for 'two percent' in section 10. It also repeals the Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.

name: PUNJAB DISABLED PERSONS (EMPLOYMENT AND REHABILITATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981. It substitutes the words 'three percent' for 'two percent' in section 10 of the 1981 Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Drugs (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to address issues regarding spurious and adulterated drugs. It introduces stricter penalties, defines foreign drug authorities, and modifies timelines for quality control board actions and prosecutions.

name: PUNJAB CURRICULUM AND TEXTBOOK BOARD ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board as a body corporate to formulate curricula, develop textbooks, and manage related educational materials. It defines the Board's organizational structure, including specific wings and the composition of its members, while outlining appointment procedures and duties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Drugs (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to align provisions regarding Drug Courts with the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Provincial Government in specific sections and transfers existing federal powers over Drug Courts in Punjab to the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004 to update provisions regarding the Board's composition, quorum, and appointment processes. It also inserts new sections to allow the Government to issue binding directions to the Foundation and modify terms related to vacancies and service conditions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Family Courts (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Family Courts Act, 1964 to update definitions and procedures within Punjab. It introduces specific changes regarding summons issuance, written statement deadlines, and decrees for marriage dissolution including dower adjustments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2015
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Finance Act, 2010; Punjab Finance Act, 2011; Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Punjab. It also deals with ancillary matters related to these financial regulations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007 to empower the Government to extend the term of the Director General under special circumstances. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Food Authority Act, 2011 to introduce categorization of food business premises and enhance punishments for violations. It inserts new sections regarding premise categorization and creates stricter penalties for selling adulterated or unsafe food, including specific provisions for large-scale manufacturers.

name: PUNJAB INFORMATION OF TEMPORARY RESIDENTS ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Information of Temporary Residents Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework for sharing information about tenants and temporary residents with the police to combat terrorism and other crimes. It mandates that landlords, property dealers, and hotel managers provide specific details about occupants to the police within set timeframes using computerized national identity cards or passports.

metadata.title: The Punjab Higher Education Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Higher Education Commission to improve and promote higher education, research, and development within the province. It defines the Commission's structure, including its Chairperson, members, and Controlling Authority, while outlining their terms of office and responsibilities.

name: PUNJAB INFORMATION OF TEMPORARY RESIDENTS ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Information of Temporary Residents Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework for the Punjab government to collect and share information regarding tenants, guests, and temporary residents with the police. It mandates that landlords, hotel managers, and property dealers provide specific details about occupants within set timeframes to help combat terrorism and other crimes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a mechanism to levy and collect an infrastructure development cess on goods manufactured, produced, consumed, imported into, or exported out of the Punjab. The collected funds are deposited in the Provincial Consolidated Fund to be utilized for the maintenance, development, and improvement of infrastructure required to handle goods traffic.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF QURA'N AND SEERAT STUDIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act, 2014 to rationalize the membership of its Board of Directors and Academic Council. It substitutes specific clauses regarding member nominations and definitions within the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to update provisions regarding summons service and title inquiries. It substitutes specific wording in sections 24 and 141 of the parent Act to include electronic means for service and clarify revenue officer inquiries.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF QURAN AND SEERAT STUDIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act 2014 to rationalize the membership of its Board of Directors and Academic Council. It substitutes specific clauses regarding definitions, board member nominations, and academic council composition within the parent Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update definitions regarding elections and bye-elections. It also modifies provisions related to revenue estate division, local area delimitation limits, election commission roles, and section headings.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to address reserved seats in Union Councils through indirect elections and provide representation to local governments in the Punjab Finance Commission. It also facilitates the distribution of rights, assets, and liabilities among successor local governments following the repeal of the 2001 Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to facilitate the distribution of rights, assets, and liabilities among successor local governments. It also addresses the succession of offices reverting to the Government upon the repeal of the 2001 Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to address activities promoting terrorism or supporting terrorists. It introduces new sections prohibiting the glorification of terrorist acts, mandating audio/video recording of public meetings, and regulating the manufacture and sale of police uniforms.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to address activities related to terrorism and public safety. It introduces new sections prohibiting the promotion of terrorism, mandating audio/video recording of public meetings, and regulating the manufacture and sale of police uniforms.

metadata.title: The Punjab Masstransit Authority Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Masstransit Authority to construct, operate, and maintain a mass transit system in major cities of the Punjab. It defines key terms related to the system, such as corridors, depots, and service providers, and outlines the composition and powers of the Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Masstransit Authority Ordinance 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Masstransit Authority to oversee the construction, operation, and maintenance of a mass transit system in major cities of the Punjab. It defines key terms related to the system, such as corridors, depots, and ancillary facilities, and outlines the composition and powers of the Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Family Laws (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961 to protect women from exploitation and ensure expeditious resolution of family disputes. It introduces specific changes regarding the composition of Arbitration Councils, marriage registration procedures, penalties for non-compliance, and provisions for child maintenance.

name: PUNJAB MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSACTION LICENSEES ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicle Transaction Licensees Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a licensing framework to regulate motor vehicle transaction licensees in the Punjab province. It aims to improve service delivery for purchasers by defining eligibility criteria, renewal procedures, and limits on service charges.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014 to update the composition and membership requirements of the Commission. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.

name: PUNJAB PARTITION OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Partition of Immovable Property (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Partition of Immovable Property Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Partition of Immovable Property Act, 2012 by omitting subsection (3) of section 9. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on March 17, 2015.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act 2014 to update the composition of the Commission and its membership numbers. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF EXPRESSING MATTERS ON WALLS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Act, 1995
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Act, 1995 to increase fines and introduce stricter trial procedures. It also repeals a previous Ordinance with the same subject matter.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF EXPRESSING MATTERS ON WALLS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Act, 1995 to increase fines for offenses related to wall writing. It also inserts a new section establishing that such offenses are cognizable and non-bailable, allowing for summary trials by Magistrates of the first class.

metadata.title: The Punjab Revenue Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of sales tax on services by the Punjab Revenue Authority. It amends the Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012 to address discrepancies in the Authority's establishment and to deem certain actions taken by the Chairperson as valid.

metadata.title: The Punjab Safe Cities Authority Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Safe Cities Authority to construct, develop, and maintain an integrated command, control, and communications (IC3) system in major cities of the Punjab. Its primary purpose is to ensure the safety and security of people through a city-wide surveillance and monitoring network.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pure Food (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to ensure more effective enforcement and rationalization of punishments. It introduces new definitions for 'Code' and 'Director', expands the scope of 'Local Authority', and substitutes sections regarding selling adulterated food, large-scale manufacturing offences, substandard food, and unsafe food with stricter penalties.

name: PUNJAB SECURITY OF VULNERABLE ESTABLISHMENTS ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for effective security arrangements to protect vulnerable establishments, including places of worship and sensitive offices. It establishes a Security Advisory Committee to identify these establishments, inspect them quarterly, and issue necessary security advice to their managers.

name: PUNJAB SECURITY OF VULNERABLE ESTABLISHMENTS ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Ordinance 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for effective security arrangements to protect vulnerable establishments and prevent acts of terrorism. It establishes a Security Advisory Committee responsible for identifying, inspecting, and advising on security measures for these locations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Protection Authority Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Social Protection Authority to create a comprehensive social protection system for the poor and vulnerable in the province. It defines the composition of the Authority, including government officials, assembly members, civil society representatives, and sets out qualifications for non-official members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Protection Authority Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Social Protection Authority as a body corporate to provide a comprehensive social protection system in the province. The Authority is designed to deliver efficient services to the poor and vulnerable, addressing livelihood risks and enhancing the rights of marginalized groups.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Punjab province to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits the use of loudspeakers that cause annoyance, injury, or disturb specific locations like hospitals and educational institutions, while also defining penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Punjab province to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits the use of loudspeakers that cause annoyance, disturb peace, or incite controversy, while specifying exceptions for places of worship and public events with permission.

metadata.title: The Punjab Strategic Coordination (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Strategic Coordination Act, 2014 to update the composition of the Provincial Security Council. It substitutes the existing subsection regarding the council's members with a new list including specific government officials and nominated representatives.

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Protection Unit Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of a dedicated Special Protection Unit within the Punjab Police. The unit is established to ensure security for foreigners, important persons, and specific premises notified by the Provincial Police Officer.

metadata.title: The Punjab Sugar Factories Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950 to ensure timely payment of cane prices to growers. It inserts new subsections regarding the determination and recovery of outstanding payments as arrears of land revenue and substitutes a higher monetary limit in section 21.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act 2010 to grant administrative and operational autonomy to the Punjab Board of Technical Education. It omits subsection (2) of section 5 of the original Act to enable the Board to independently perform its assigned functions.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to extend the deadline for claiming a 5% rebate from September 30 to October 31. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to include definitions for 'e-stamps' and electronic instruments. It also inserts a new section regarding certificates for e-stamp genuineness issued by designated officers.

name: THE PUNJAB CURRICULUM AND TEXTBOOK BOARD ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board as a body corporate to formulate curricula and develop textbooks. It defines the Board's organizational structure, including specific wings and the composition of its members.

name: THE NUR INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY LAHORE ACT 2015

metadata.title: The NUR International University Lahore Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes NUR International University Lahore as a body corporate in the private sector within the Punjab province. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and Vice Chancellor, and defines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Forest Act, 1927 to facilitate better utilization of wasteland through the establishment of forest companies. It introduces provisions for public-private partnerships in forest development and outlines the procedures for government notification of forest land to these companies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to address reserved seats in Union Councils through indirect elections and representation in the Punjab Finance Commission. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Strategic Coordination (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Strategic Coordination Act, 2014 to update the composition of the Provincial Security Council. It substitutes the existing subsection regarding the council's members with a new list including specific government officials and nominated representatives.

name: THE PUNJAB SOCIAL PROTECTION AUTHORITY ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Protection Authority Ordinance 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Social Protection Authority to create a comprehensive and gender-equitable social protection system for the poor and vulnerable in the province.
