It defines the composition of the Authority, including government officials, assembly members, and civil society representatives, along with their qualifications and tenure.

metadata.title: The University of Jhang Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Jhang with its campus located in Jhang. It defines the university's structure, including roles such as Chancellor and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions like conducting examinations, awarding degrees, and managing staff.

metadata.title: The University of Sahiwal Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Sahiwal by re-constituting the sub-campus of Bahauddin Zakariya University, Multan in Sahiwal. It defines the university's corporate status, organizational structure including the Chancellor and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and conferring degrees.

metadata.title: The Bab-e-Pakistan Foundation Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bab-e-Pakistan Foundation to provide an institutional framework for carrying out the functions of the former Bab-e-Pakistan Trust. The Foundation is empowered to construct national memorials, promote Pakistan's arts and culture, and organize various cultural programs.

metadata.title: The Bab-e-Pakistan Foundation Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Bab-e-Pakistan Foundation as a body corporate to manage national memorials and promote Pakistan's arts, crafts, and culture. It defines the composition of the Board of Governors and outlines various functions including organizing cultural events, conducting research, and establishing art galleries.

name: KHWAJA FAREED UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, RAHIM YAR KHAN ACT 2014

metadata.title: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan Act 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology, Rahim Yar Khan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various councils, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, awarding degrees, and maintaining campus discipline.

metadata.title: The Lahore Garrison University Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Garrison University as a body corporate located in Lahore within the private sector. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and various academic units, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

name: MANAGEMENT AND TRANSFER OF PROPERTIES BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Management and Transfer of Properties by Development Authorities Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act enables Development Authorities in the Punjab to strategically manage and transfer immovable properties. It establishes specific categories for transferring properties up to five marlas, prioritizing the general public, defense personnel, police, disabled persons, and destitute individuals.

name: MANAGEMENT AND TRANSFER OF PROPERTIES BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 2014

metadata.title: The Management and Transfer of Properties by Development Authorities Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance enables Development Authorities in the Punjab to strategically manage and transfer immovable properties. It establishes rules for transferring properties through open auctions, ballots, or joint ventures, with specific provisions for defense personnel, police, and destitute individuals.

name: MUHAMMAD NAWAZ SHARIF UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY MULTAN ACT 2014

metadata.title: Muhammad Nawaz Sharif University of Engineering and Technology Multan Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Muhammad Nawaz Sharif University of Engineering and Technology Multan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various councils, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, awarding degrees, and managing research.

metadata.title: The NUR International University Lahore Ordinance 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of NUR International University Lahore in the private sector. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 to adapt its provisions specifically for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and adjusts penalties and definitions accordingly.

metadata.title: The Punjab Arms (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 to adapt its provisions for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and adjusts penalties and definitions accordingly.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to facilitate the appointment of federal civil servants transferred to the province following the Eighteenth Amendment. It empowers the Government to determine the terms and conditions, including cadre and seniority, for these newly appointed provincial civil servants.

name: PAKISTAN KIDNEY AND LIVER INSTITUTE AND RESEARCH CENTER ORDINANCE, 2014

metadata.title: The Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center Ordinance
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute and Research Center as a not-for-profit body corporate in the Punjab. It outlines the Institute's functions, which include providing medical care, conducting research, training medical staff, and promoting health awareness.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Commission on the Status of Women to empower women and expand their socio-economic opportunities. It aims to eliminate all forms of discrimination against women and provides for ancillary matters related to these goals.

name: PUNJAB CURRICULUM AND TEXTBOOK BOARD ORDINANCE, 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board as a body corporate to formulate curricula, develop textbooks, and manage related educational materials. It defines the Board's organizational structure, including specific wings and the composition of its members, while outlining appointment procedures and duties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976 to update definitions, alter the composition of the Authority, and modify provisions regarding land acquisition and local government references. It substitutes specific sections in the parent Act to align them with newer legislation like the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.

name: PUNJAB EMPLOYEES EFFICIENCY, DISCIPLINE AND ACCOUNTABILITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006 to modify provisions regarding appeals before the Service Tribunal. Specifically, it substitutes section 19 of the original Act to adjust timelines for filing appeals when final orders are not passed by the Appellate Authority or Chief Minister within sixty days.

metadata.title: The Punjab Explosives (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Explosives (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Explosives Act, 1884 to adapt provisions for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and omits specific sections from the original act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Explosives (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Explosives Act of 1884 to adapt it for provincial administration in Punjab. It substitutes references to the Federal Government and Chief Inspector with local equivalents and omits specific sections.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.amends: The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976 to update definitions, alter the composition of the Authority, and modify provisions regarding land acquisition and local government references. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This document amends the Punjab Finance Act, 2013. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on February 19, 2014.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2014
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Punjab. It also regulates connected matters related to these financial instruments.

name: PUNJAB FAIR REPRESENTATION OF WOMEN ACT 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Fair Representation of Women Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Town Improvement Act, 1922; The Punjab Government Educational and Training Institution Ordinance, 1960; The Punjab Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960; The Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961; The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962; The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965; The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970; The Punjab Fair Price Shops (Factories) Ordinance, 1971; The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends various existing laws of the Punjab to ensure fair representation of women in decision-making processes and their empowerment. It mandates specific quotas for female members, trustees, officers, and teachers across different government institutions, boards, and educational bodies.

name: PUNJAB FREE AND COMPULSORY EDUCATION ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for free and compulsory education for all children aged five to sixteen years in the Punjab province. It establishes the right of every child to receive education without fees or charges and outlines the duties of the Government and local authorities to ensure admission, attendance, and completion of schooling.

name: PUNJAB FREE AND COMPULSORY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Free and Compulsory Education Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for free and compulsory education for all children aged five to sixteen years in the Punjab. It establishes the right of every child to receive education without fees from class one to ten, including non-formal and vocational options, while defining duties for the Government and local authorities to ensure access, quality, and attendance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Relations (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010 to further regulate worker associations and labour court procedures. It substitutes specific text in sections 3, 9, and 12 of the original Act regarding association formation, appeal applications, and numerical figures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Higher Education Commission Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Higher Education Commission to improve and promote higher education, research, and development within the province. It defines the Commission's structure, including its controlling authority (the Chief Minister), composition of members, appointment terms, and powers as a body corporate.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF QURA'N AND SEERAT STUDIES ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Institute of Qura'n and Seerat Studies in Lahore to facilitate research, publications, and higher education on the Quran and Seerat. The Institute is constituted as a body corporate with powers to manage property, conduct seminars, and affiliate with universities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by omitting specific sections and inserting new provisions regarding companies for cattle markets. It also repeals the Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to allow for the establishment of companies under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 to manage cattle markets across multiple districts. It also inserts a new section regarding these companies and repeals the previous Amendment Ordinance from 2014.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to facilitate the establishment of companies for managing cattle markets across multiple districts. It inserts a new section allowing the government to create such companies and requires local governments to obtain their consent before organizing cattle markets. Additionally, it omits specific entries from the Third and Eighth Schedules of the amended Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to facilitate the establishment of companies for managing cattle markets across multiple districts. It omits specific sections and entries from various schedules of the parent Ordinance while inserting new provisions regarding company membership and market organization.

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock Breeding Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act regulates livestock breeding services in the Punjab to improve genetic potential and protect indigenous breeds. It establishes a Livestock Breeding Services Authority with specific powers and defines key terms related to breeding, semen, and veterinary practices.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update provisions regarding local areas, union councils, and delimitation. It substitutes several sections of the parent act to redefine local government structures and election boundaries.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update provisions regarding local areas, Union Councils, and delimitation processes. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Mental Health (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Mental Health Ordinance, 2001 to adapt it for provincial application within Punjab. It substitutes references to the Federal Government and Federal authorities with their respective Punjab counterparts and modifies sections regarding the Authority's composition and functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission to receive and redress grievances of overseas Pakistanis regarding government agencies. It defines the composition of the Commission, including the Chief Minister as Chairperson, and sets up an Advisory Council for recommendations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Payment of Wages (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Payment of Wages Act, 1936 to update terminology and financial limits specific to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and adjusts penalty amounts and definitions regarding industrial establishments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission to receive and redress grievances of overseas Pakistanis regarding government agencies. It also empowers the Commission to refer complaints to concerned offices and handle ancillary matters related to this community.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an enabling environment for the private sector to participate in developing physical and infrastructure services in the Punjab. It aims to improve the efficiency, reliability, and quality of these services while incorporating principles of fairness, competition, and transparency into procurement processes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an enabling environment for the private sector to participate in public infrastructure projects within the Punjab province. It aims to improve service reliability, mobilize private resources for construction and maintenance, and introduce modern management techniques while ensuring fairness and transparency.

metadata.title: The Punjab Registration of Godowns Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Registration of Godowns Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive system for the registration of godowns in the Punjab province to ensure the stable supply of essential articles. It defines key terms such as 'godown' and 'essential article', outlines procedures for registration and record maintenance, and grants powers to authorities for inspection and seizure of goods.

metadata.title: The Punjab Registration of Godowns Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a comprehensive system for the registration of godowns in the Punjab province. It mandates that owners must register their premises before storing essential articles and outlines procedures for inspection, record maintenance, and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Act 2014
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to adapt it for the Punjab province. It introduces new provisions for daycare rooms for children of female employees and updates various sections regarding government definitions, leave periods, fines, and court jurisdictions.

name: PUNJAB REPRODUCTIVE, MATERNAL, NEO-NATAL AND CHILD HEALTH AUTHORITY ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Reproductive, Maternal, Neo-natal and Child Health Authority Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Reproductive, Maternal, Neo-natal and Child Health Authority to provide a legal framework for managing affairs related to national programs for primary healthcare and family planning. The Authority is constituted as a body corporate with perpetual succession, managed by a Board of Governors comprising government officials, assembly members, and civil society representatives.

metadata.title: The Punjab Strategic Coordination Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Provincial Security Council and the Punjab Strategic Coordination Board to create an institutional mechanism for counter-terrorism efforts. It outlines the composition, functions, and powers of these bodies to formulate security policies, monitor agencies, and improve coordination within the province.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2014

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by changing specific dates in sections 3 and 12 from September 30th to November 30th. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Strategic Coordination Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Provincial Security Council and the Punjab Strategic Coordination Board to address security and counter-terrorism issues in the province. It defines the composition, functions, and administrative structure of these new institutions.

metadata.title: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1974 to adapt it for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and updates related industrial relations legislation.

metadata.title: The Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Defence Housing Authority Rawalpindi as a body corporate to carry out land development schemes. Its primary purpose is to provide housing and financial security for the bereaved families of martyrs, war injured, disabled, and other defence force personnel.

name: GOVERNMENT COLLEGE WOMEN UNIVERSITY FAISALABAD ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Government College Women University Faisalabad Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Government College Women University Faisalabad by reconstituting the existing Government College for Women Madina Town Faisalabad. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its structure, functions, and governance mechanisms including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Academic Council.

name: GOVERNMENT COLLEGE WOMEN UNIVERSITY SIALKOT ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Government College Women University Sialkot Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Government College Women University Sialkot as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the reconstitution of the existing Government College for Women Sialkot into a university and outlines its functions, structure, and governance.

metadata.title: The Lahore Canal Heritage Park Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Canal Heritage Park as a public trust to ensure its protection and conservation. It provides for the maintenance of a healthy environment, the preservation of local flora and fauna, and regulates public access and recreational activities within the specified area.

name: GOVERNMENT SADIQ COLLEGE WOMEN UNIVERSITY BAHAWALPUR ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Government Sadiq College Women University Bahawalpur Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Government Sadiq College Women University Bahawalpur as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the reconstitution of the existing Government Sadiq Degree College for Girls into a full university and outlines its functions, structure, and governance.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to expand its jurisdiction from the metropolitan area of Lahore to the entire Lahore Division. It substitutes specific terms in the preamble and sections regarding the area covered, district status, and definitions related to agencies, land, and housing schemes.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to expand its jurisdiction from the metropolitan area of Lahore to the entire area of Lahore Division. It substitutes specific terms in the preamble and sections regarding the extent of the Act, district definitions, and various legal definitions related to land, agencies, and housing schemes.

metadata.title: Notification No. PA:4-4/2013/1122
metadata.summary: This notification announces that Parliamentary Secretaries in the Punjab cease to hold office. The action is consequent upon the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 20, 2013.

metadata.title: Order dissolving the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
metadata.summary: This notification publishes an Order made by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 112(1) of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. The Order dissolves the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab with immediate effect, dated March 20, 2013.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to adapt provisions for the Punjab province. It updates various sections regarding wage limits, survivor pensions, funeral grants, and the establishment of medical institutions through public-private partnerships.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to update the definition of 'animal' in section 2. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on August 26, 2013.

name: MUHAMMAD NAWAZ SHAREEF UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE MULTAN ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various councils, while defining its functions such as providing education in agriculture, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

name: PUNJAB BOILERS AND PRESSURE VESSELS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002 to align it with provincial jurisdiction by substituting references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab. It also establishes a Provincial Boilers and Pressure Vessels Safety Board and modifies various sections regarding the application and enforcement of the ordinance.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004 to include provisions for plots alongside houses. It updates definitions, substitutes specific clauses regarding housing schemes and membership termination, and modifies sections related to location allocation and pricing.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING AND TOWN PLANNING AGENCY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002 to address the status of government servants serving within the Agency. It inserts a new section regarding employee absorption into the Agency service and allows the Government to delegate disciplinary and administrative powers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; The Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The Punjab Finance Act, 1972; The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997; The Punjab Finance Act, 2010; The Punjab Finance Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Punjab. It amends several existing acts related to urban immovable property tax, entertainments duty, motor vehicles taxation, agricultural income tax, and capital gains on immovable property.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce new provisions regarding private partition schemes for joint land-owners upon inheritance. It establishes specific time limits for revenue officers to decide partition cases and outlines procedures for handling title disputes during partition proceedings.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to grant additional powers for prescribing taxes and fees. It also validates certain levies collected prior to its enactment that did not strictly follow procedural requirements.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to address specific provisions regarding elections and local governance structures. It includes changes to sections concerning non-Muslim member representation, election schedules, returning officers, and polling station locations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to update provisions regarding ward definitions, delimitation processes, and election procedures. It introduces new sections on the finality of delimitation and substitutes existing sections concerning Union Council composition and franchise rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to address specific provisions regarding municipal committees, election franchise, and delimitation finality. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under emergency powers because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to update definitions and election procedures for Union Councils. It introduces specific provisions regarding ward delimitation, the composition of Union Councils including reserved seats for women, peasants/workers, youth, and non-Muslim members, and rules for filling vacancies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to insert a requirement for Muslim candidates to submit a specific religious declaration with their nomination papers. It also adds provisions allowing the government to dispense with previous publication requirements in emergencies and inserts a new Ninth Schedule containing the required declaration.

name: PUNJAB MINIMUM WAGES FOR UNSKILLED WORKERS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969 to specifically apply to the Punjab province instead of Pakistan. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab', updates the definition of industrial areas, increases a specific monetary figure from two thousand to ten thousand, and inserts a new section granting power to amend the Schedule.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motion Pictures (Amendment) Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Motion Pictures Ordinance 1979 to align its provisions with the jurisdiction of the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government and Pakistan with the Government of the Punjab and the Punjab respectively, while also updating terminology for local administration.

metadata.title: The Punjab Police Order (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 to regulate police recruitment based on district domicile and establish specific quotas for direct recruitment and departmental promotions. It also substitutes Article 18 to separate investigation functions from other police duties, defining the structure and jurisdiction of District Investigation Branches.

name: PUNJAB PARTITION OF IMMOVABLE PORPERTY ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Partition of Immovable Property Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends and reforms the law relating to the expeditious partition of immovable property in Punjab. It establishes specific procedures for filing suits, serving notices, handling non-appearance of defendants, and determining mesne profits while excluding agricultural land from its scope.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION AGAINST HARASSMENT OF WOMEN AT THE WORKPLACE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace (Amendment) Act 2012
metadata.amends: Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010 to update terminology and provisions within the Punjab province. It substitutes 'Ombudsperson' for 'Ombudsman', updates references to industrial relations acts, and modifies sections regarding qualifications, appointments, and appeal processes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 to include women from public or private sectors in specific qualifications and to change member appointment terms. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on January 7, 2013, and received assent from the Governor on January 12, 2013.

metadata.title: The Punjab Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Order, 2002 to update recruitment rules for police ranks and establish quotas for direct recruitment based on domicile. It also substitutes Article 18 to separate investigation functions from other police duties, defining the structure and jurisdiction of District Investigation Branches.

metadata.title: The Punjab Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974 to update provisions regarding the composition of tribunals, appointment procedures for chairmen and members, and the constitution of benches. It also introduces new sections concerning the removal of officials due to misconduct or incapacity and grants financial powers to the Chairman.

metadata.title: The Punjab Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974 to update provisions regarding the composition of tribunals, appointment terms, and removal processes. It also inserts new sections concerning financial powers and omits specific existing sections and schedules from the parent Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Services Board (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970 by substituting the word 'Governor' with 'Chief Minister' in section 4, subsection (2). It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on January 12, 2013.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Information Commission to ensure transparency and freedom of information within the province. It grants citizens the right to access public information held by various government bodies and mandates proactive disclosure of specific details by public institutions.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION ORDINANCE, 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Ordinance 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Information Commission to ensure transparency and freedom of information within the Punjab province. It grants citizens the right to access public information held by government bodies, local governments, and other substantially financed organizations.

name: PUNJAB WEIGHTS AND MEASURES (INTERNATIONAL SYSTEM) ENFORCEMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Punjab Weights & Measures (International System) Enforcement (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Punjab Weights and Measures (International System) Enforcement Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Weights and Measures (International System) Enforcement Act, 1975 to update definitions regarding calibration, counterfeit seals, and repairers. It also substitutes sections related to penalties for forging stamps, using false instruments, and selling goods with deficient weight or measure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Workmen's Compensation (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923 to update definitions and compensation amounts specific to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab', aligns tribunal definitions with the Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010, and revises monetary limits for death, disablement, and legal fees.

metadata.title: The Women University Multan (Amendment) Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Women University Multan Act 2010 to reconstitute the Government Postgraduate College for Women Multan as the Women University Multan. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its structure, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and staff provisions.

metadata.title: The Antiquities (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Antiquities Act, 1975 to replace references to 'Pakistan' and 'Federal Government' with 'the Punjab' and 'Government' respectively. It also establishes an Advisory Committee for antiquities, modifies provisions regarding land acquisition for public purpose, and omits section 38 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to establish the Government as a shareholder capable of holding up to eighty percent of the bank's shares. It also repeals the earlier Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011.

metadata.title: The Administrator General's (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Administrator General's Act, 1913 to update provisions regarding estate administration within the Punjab. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and deemed assented to under Article 116(3) of the Constitution after the Governor did not act within the stipulated period.

metadata.title: The Charitable and Religious Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920 to extend its application to the whole of Punjab with specific exceptions. It also substitutes Section 2 of the original Act to define key terms like 'Court' and 'Government' within the context of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Defamation (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Defamation Ordinance, 2002 by substituting text in section 1 to extend its application to the whole of Punjab. It also inserts a new clause defining 'Government' and modifies the definition of 'newspaper' in section 2, while omitting the word 'Federal' from section 16.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Twentieth Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to address procedures for appointing care-taker Prime Ministers and Chief Ministers. It introduces new provisions regarding committees formed by the Speaker when political parties cannot agree on a candidate, and it modifies articles related to the Election Commission and caretaker governments.

metadata.title: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981 to align it with provincial governance structures. It substitutes specific terms to refer to the Government of the Punjab and establishes a Provincial Council for the rehabilitation of disabled persons with defined functions.

name: DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES (REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) Act, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) Act, 1998 to update definitions and disposal procedures. It specifically revises section 2 to redefine 'Development Authority' and section 4 to establish new percentage-based quotas for allotting plots to defence personnel, police, government servants, minorities, and destitutes.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975 by inserting new definitions and substituting specific terms regarding government bodies and courts. It clarifies the transfer of urban and rural properties to the Government for disposal under specific schemes.

metadata.title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Factories Act, 1934 to update provisions specific to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab', updates penalty amounts, and modifies definitions regarding government factories.

metadata.title: The Hindu Disposition of Property (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916 by substituting references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' and updating government titles. It was deemed assented to under Article 116(3) of the Constitution after the Governor did not act within ten days.

metadata.title: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928 by substituting 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' in section 1. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and deemed to have received assent under Article 116(3) of the Constitution after the Governor did not act within ten days.

name: HINDU LAW OF INHERITANCE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Hindu Law of Inheritance (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Hindu Law of Inheritance (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Law of Inheritance (Amendment) Act, 1929 by substituting the word 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' in section 1. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and deemed to have received assent under Article 116(3) of the Constitution.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan by reconstituting existing colleges and institutions in that region. It defines the university's corporate status, structure, and powers to acquire property and administer campuses.

metadata.title: The Injured Persons (Medical Aid) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Injured Persons (Medical Aid) Act, 2004 to replace references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' and restricts the definition of 'Government' to the Government of the Punjab. It also substitutes section 14 to grant the Government power to make rules for carrying out the purposes of the Act.

name: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY OF THE PUNJAB ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Information Technology University of the Punjab Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Information Technology University of the Punjab with its campus located in Lahore. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its functions, including providing education, conducting research, awarding degrees, and managing staff.

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005 to update provisions regarding the Chancellor's role and the Vice Chancellor's appointment process. It introduces new criteria for the Vice Chancellor's eligibility, establishes a Search Committee, and modifies sections related to emergency powers and the Pro-Vice Chancellor's functions.

metadata.title: The Official Trustees (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Official Trustees Act, 1913 to update its scope and definitions for the Punjab province. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab after reconsideration following a return from the Governor, and deemed assented to under Article 116(3) of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Minimum Wages (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961 to update terminology and financial limits specific to the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the 'Provincial Government' with 'Government of the Punjab' and adjusts penalty amounts and court jurisdictions.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 by substituting a specific monetary amount in section 11. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly on February 28, 2012, and received assent from the Governor on March 7, 2012.

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920 to update references from 'outside the Karachi Division' to 'in the Punjab' and to specify the Lahore High Court as the relevant court. It also substitutes various terms regarding government authority and omits section 82 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update definitions regarding buses operated by schools and the Punjab Metrobus Authority. It also modifies the classification of trailers used for goods carriage versus passenger hire.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 by substituting a new Twelfth Schedule containing specific traffic violations and their corresponding fines. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab after reconsideration following the Governor's return for assent.

metadata.title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Parks and Horticulture Authority in the Punjab to regulate, develop, and maintain public parks, green belts, and green areas. It also provides for the regulation of billboards, sky signs, and outdoor advertisements to promote open views.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Pesticides (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971 to replace references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab. It also substitutes specific sections within the Ordinance to align jurisdictional powers and committee compositions with provincial authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Universities (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Universities Act, 1973; The Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture University, Rawalpindi Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws governing agricultural universities in the Punjab, specifically targeting the University of Agriculture Faisalabad and the Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture University. It introduces new roles such as Pro-Vice Chancellor, modifies appointment procedures for Vice Chancellors, and updates various sections regarding duties and powers within these institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to update the definition of 'animal' in section 2. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and deemed assented to under Article 116(3) of the Constitution on July 30, 2012.

metadata.title: The Punjab Bonded Labour System (Abolition) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992 to replace references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab. It also substitutes specific terms regarding district officials and increases certain numerical limits within the original legislation.

name: PUNJAB BUS STANDS AND TRAFFIC CONTROL (GUJRANWALA) ORDINANCE, 1963 (XX OF 1963) (REPEAL) ACT 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963 (XX of 1963) (Repeal) Act 2011
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963 (XX of 1963)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on December 21, 2011, and received assent from the Governor on December 31, 2011.

name: PUNJAB BUS STANDS AND TRAFFIC CONTROL (LAHORE) ORDINANCE, 1963 (XIX OF 1963) (REPEAL) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963 (XIX of 1963) (Repeal) Act 2011
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963 (XIX of 1963)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on December 21, 2011, and received assent from the Governor on December 31, 2011.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to address promotion cases involving civil servants who die or superannuate after recommendation but before assuming charge. It inserts a new subsection allowing competent authorities to approve such promotions with effect from the day immediately preceding the death or superannuation.

name: PUNJAB CONFERMENT OF PROPRIETARY RIGHTS ON OCCUPANCY TENANTS AND MUQARRARIDARS ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Conferment of Proprietary Rights on Occupancy Tenants and Muqarraridars Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act confers proprietary rights on occupancy tenants and muqarraridars regarding land in their possession, aligning with Islamic injunctions. It deems these individuals as owners of the land and requires revenue officers to update records accordingly, while providing a specific remedy for landlords who can claim ownership if they prove original cultivation rights within six months.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903 to update terminology and definitions within the legislation. It substitutes specific sections in the original act to reflect current administrative structures and clarify terms such as 'Government', 'Collector', and 'ward'.

metadata.title: The Public Sector Universities (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973; The University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore, Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws governing various public sector universities in the Punjab. It specifically updates provisions regarding the appointment, qualifications, and tenure of Vice Chancellors and introduces roles for Pro-Vice Chancellors.

name: PUNJAB EMPLOYEES EFFICIENCY, DISCIPLINE AND ACCOUNTABILITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006 to update definitions regarding civil servants and court/tribunal employees. Specifically, it modifies Section 2 of the parent Act to clarify which government employees are excluded from certain clauses concerning civil service members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to adapt it for provincial use in Punjab by substituting federal references with provincial ones. It establishes a Provincial Environmental Protection Council and a Provincial Environmental Protection Agency while defining their composition and functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Curriculum Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Curriculum Authority to supervise curricula and textbooks in the province. It also aims to maintain education standards and regulate supplementary educational materials.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004. It substitutes a new provision in section 17 requiring that all payments made by members be updated annually.

name: PUNJAB INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL EMPLOYMENT (STANDING ORDERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968. It substitutes references to newer Punjab legislation, updates financial figures, omits specific sections, and modifies standing orders within the schedule of the original ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Katchi Abadis Act, 1992 by updating a specific figure in section 6 from 2006 to 2011. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and deemed assented to by the Governor on April 18, 2012.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update provisions regarding budget allocation and officer designations. It also establishes an Ad hoc Accounts Committee for local governments in districts where elections have not yet been held.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It substitutes a specific subsection regarding the timeline for notifying local government election dates.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Punjab Finance Act, 1977; Punjab Finance Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to taxes and duties in the Punjab, including the Stamp Act, Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, and previous Finance Acts. It introduces changes such as new stamp duty exceptions for partition instruments, revised tax payment deadlines with late surcharges, and updated definitions for capital value tax on immovable property.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by inserting a new subsection into section 179-A. The amendment empowers the Government to change the boundaries of a union, tehsil, or town through notification in the official Gazette.

metadata.title: The Punjab Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958 to apply it specifically to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to 'West Pakistan' and 'Pakistan' with 'Punjab', increases financial limits for benefits, and omits a specific section from the original ordinance.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION OF BREAST-FEEDING AND CHILD NUTRITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection of Breast-Feeding and Child Nutrition (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002 to align it with provincial jurisdiction in Punjab. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and establishes a Punjab Infant Feeding Board with specific powers and functions.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC DEFENDER SERVICE ACT, 2007 (REPEAL) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 (Repeal) Act 2012
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and deemed to have received assent on June 22, 2012.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 to update provisions regarding the composition and membership of the Commission. It specifically substitutes sections dealing with the appointment criteria, term of office, and age limits for members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Metrobus Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Metrobus Authority to construct, operate, and maintain a mass transit system in major cities of the Punjab. It defines the composition of the Authority, including ex officio members like the Chief Minister and Transport Minister, as well as nominated representatives from various sectors. The legislation also outlines the powers of the Authority regarding property acquisition, asset management, and the regulation of service providers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Revenue Authority to reform and modernize the taxation system in the province. It provides for the establishment of a progressive and professionally efficient tax management organization while offering assistance to taxpayers.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPLANTATION OF HUMAN ORGANS AND TISSUES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010 to replace references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab. It also updates specific sections regarding the constitution of a Monitoring Authority and repeals the corresponding Ordinance from 2012.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPLANTATION OF HUMAN ORGANS AND TISSUES ORDINANCE, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Ordinance, 2012
metadata.amends: Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010 to adapt federal provisions for application within the Punjab province. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and establishes a specific Monitoring Authority structure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Workers' Children (Education) (Amendment) Act 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972 to replace references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' and updates definitions regarding workers. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab after reconsideration following a return for review by the Governor.

metadata.title: The Road Transport Workers (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Road Transport Workers Ordinance, 1961 to restrict its application to the Punjab province and update specific clauses regarding fines and definitions. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab after reconsideration following a return for review.

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) (Repeal) Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and deemed to have received assent under Article 116(3) of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Specific Relief (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Specific Relief Act, 1877 to adapt its provisions for the Punjab province. It substitutes references to Pakistan with the Punjab and replaces Indian federal terms with local equivalents like Lahore.

name: UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to introduce the office of Pro-Chancellor and modify provisions regarding the Vice Chancellor. It establishes the Minister for Health as the Pro-Chancellor and updates eligibility criteria and appointment procedures for university leadership.

name: UNIVERSITY OF VETERINARY AND ANIMAL SCIENCES, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to introduce a new Pro-Vice Chancellor position. It also updates qualifications for the Vice Chancellor, establishes a Search Committee, and modifies sections regarding emergency powers and syndicate functions.

name: VOLUNTARY SOCIAL WELFARE AGENCIES (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961. It substitutes specific words to change references from 'Provincial Government' to 'Government' and limits jurisdiction to 'the Punjab'. The Act came into force immediately upon its deemed assent.

metadata.title: The Walled City of Lahore Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework for the conservation, planning, development, and management of the Walled City of Lahore. It creates specialized institutional arrangements to protect heritage value while regulating infrastructure, services, business activities, and commercial operations within the city.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to establish the Government as a shareholder of the bank. It specifically substitutes section 7 to allow the Government to hold up to eighty percent of the shares issued by the Bank.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Nineteenth Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to include the Islamabad High Court in various articles. It specifically addresses amendments regarding Article 81, Article 175, and provisions related to the Judicial Commission and Parliamentary Committee.

metadata.title: The Employment (Record of Services) (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Employment (Record of Services) Act, 1951 to replace references to 'Pakistan' and 'Provincial' with specific references to 'the Punjab' and 'Government of the Punjab'. It also updates financial limits in the original legislation by substituting lower figures with higher amounts.

metadata.title: The Employment of Children (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Employment of Children Act, 1991 to adapt it for the Punjab province by substituting references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab. It omits specific federal and national terms throughout the original act and repeals references to other provincial child labour acts.

metadata.title: The Epidemic Diseases (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958 to replace references to 'West Pakistan' with 'the Punjab'. It also substitutes 'District Coordination Officer' for 'Deputy Commissioner' and omits section 5 of the original act.

name: PUNJAB SALES TAX ON SERVICES ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a tax on services provided, rendered, initiated, received, originated, executed, or consumed in the Punjab. It also deals with ancillary matters related to this taxation scheme.

metadata.title: The Global Institute Lahore Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Global Institute Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It outlines the institute's functions, including providing instruction in management and commerce, awarding degrees, and managing staff and students.

metadata.title: The Lahore Leads University Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Leads University as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and Vice Chancellor, and defines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, awarding degrees, and supporting research.

metadata.title: The Partition (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Partition Act, 1893 to apply specific provisions to the Punjab region instead of Pakistan. It substitutes 'the Punjab' for 'Pakistan' and changes references to revenue-paying immovable property to 'agricultural land'.

name: POLICY GOVERNING PROMOTION OF CIVIL SERVANTS ON DEPUTATION ABROAD

metadata.title: Policy Governing Promotion of Civil Servants on Deputation Abroad
metadata.summary: This notification clarifies the requirements for civil servants seeking promotion after returning from deputation abroad. It specifies that a full year of service (12 complete months) must be earned in a calendar year before promotion consideration, with provisions for reporting deficiencies in the following year.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to establish specific compensation scales for passengers injured or killed in stage and contract carriages. It substitutes conditions in various sections of the Ordinance regarding permit holders' financial liability and introduces a monetary limit for appeals.

name: PUNJAB BUILDINGS DEPARTMENT (PUNJAB HOUSE KARACHI) SERVICE RULES, 2011

metadata.title: Punjab Buildings Department (Punjab House Karachi) Service Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of the Punjab under the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974. They establish the method of recruitment, minimum qualifications, and age limits for posts in the Punjab Buildings Department.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Punjab Entertainment Duty Act, 1958; The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000; The Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act levies taxes and alters the rates of certain duties in the Punjab. It amends existing legislation regarding entertainment duty, motor vehicle taxation, sales tax, local government charges, and introduces a new farm house tax.

metadata.title: The Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Ring Road Authority as a body corporate to manage the planning, design, development, operation, and maintenance of the Lahore Ring Road and other strategic roads. The Authority is empowered to acquire property, levy tolls, enter into contracts, and implement various measures for road security and environmental improvement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Food Authority to oversee food safety and standards within the province. It defines key terms related to food, including adulterated, misbranded, and additive substances, to regulate the food industry.

name: PUNJAB FOOD SAFETY AND STANDARDS AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Food Safety and Standards Authority Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the safety and standards of food within the Punjab province. It also establishes the Punjab Food Safety and Standards Authority to oversee these matters.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to update provisions regarding administrative divisions and revenue officers. It substitutes several sections of the original act to redefine the structure of Divisions, Districts, Sub-Divisions, and Tehsils, while also updating the classes and appointment powers of various revenue officers.

name: PUNJAB HOLY QURAN (PRINTING AND RECORDING) ACT 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Holy Quran (Printing and Recording) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the Holy Quran text free from printing and recording errors. It also provides for the proper disposal of damaged or shaheed copies of the Holy Quran.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to introduce changes regarding district coordination officers and specific sections. It also omits certain sections and entries from the First Schedule of the original ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Laws (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: certain Punjab laws relating to land administration
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing Punjab laws related to land administration, including the Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883 and the Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887. It updates definitions for terms such as 'Collector' and 'Commissioner' across various acts and substitutes references from provincial government bodies to specific revenue authorities.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2011

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 by adding a new subsection to Section 3. The amendment grants the Authority the power to transfer technical institutions to the Government or to bodies controlled by the Government.

metadata.title: The Punjab Power Development Board Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Power Development Board to implement government policies in the energy sector. It aims to facilitate private investors and harness available energy generation resources within the province.

metadata.title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 to update references from 'Pakistan' or 'Provincial Government' to 'the Punjab' and specific courts. It also substitutes new clauses regarding the scope of registration by registrars and omits certain provisions in section 90.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 by substituting specific terms and updating references to align with the Government of the Punjab and the Lahore High Court. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 30, 2011, and assented to by the Governor on April 30, 2011.

metadata.title: The Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Trusts Act, 1882 to update references from 'Pakistan' to 'the Punjab' and change specific city names like Karachi and Quetta to Rawalpindi and Lahore respectively. It also omits certain clauses related to the United Kingdom and updates registration act references.

name: ALI INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE ACT 2010

metadata.title: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ali Institute of Education Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It outlines the institute's functions, including providing teacher education degrees, conducting research, and managing its own staff and students.

metadata.title: The Qarshi University, Muridke Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Qarshi University, Muridke as a private sector body corporate in the Punjab. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and various academic units, while defining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Forest (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 by substituting references to 'Federal Government' and 'Provincial Government' with the word 'Government'. It also introduces new definitions for terms like 'forest produce', 'wasteland', and 'trespass', and inserts new subsections regarding land acquisition rights and shifting cultivation.

name: INSTITUTE OF SOUTHERN PUNJAB MULTAN ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Institute of Southern Punjab Multan Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Southern Punjab Multan as a private sector body corporate located in Multan. It outlines the institute's functions, including providing instruction in various faculties, establishing departments, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: The King Edward Medical University Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the King Edward Medical University Act, 2005 to update provisions regarding the appointment of the Vice Chancellor. It establishes a Search Committee to recommend candidates and modifies the term of office and eligibility criteria for the position.

name: PROTECTION AGAINST HARASSMENT OF WOMEN AT THE WORKPLACE ACT 2010

metadata.title: Protection against Harassment of women at the Workplace Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to protect women from harassment at the workplace in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'harassment', 'employee', and 'employer' and mandates that every organization establish an Inquiry Committee within thirty days of enactment to handle complaints.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.repeals: The Constitution (Seventeenth Amendment) Act, 2003; Legal Framework Order, 2002; Legal Framework (Amendment) Order, 2002; Legal Framework (Second Amendment) Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Constitution of Pakistan by correcting provincial names, defining high treason, and inserting new articles regarding fair trial, freedom of association, right to information, and education. It also repeals the Legal Framework Orders of 2002 and the Seventeenth Amendment Act, 2003.

name: PUNJAB DAANISH SCHOOLS AND CENTERS OF EXCELLENCE AUTHORITY ACT 2010

metadata.title: The Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority to manage and administer educational institutions in the province. It aims to provide quality elementary, secondary, and higher secondary education to underprivileged segments of society while regulating the establishment and functioning of these schools.

metadata.title: The Punjab Examination Commission Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Examination Commission to improve the examination system for elementary education in the province. It defines the Commission's composition, functions, and powers regarding policy formulation, data collection, and research.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2010
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967; Bank of Punjab Act, 1989; Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000
