metadata.summary: This Act levies taxes and alters the rates of taxes and duties in the Punjab. It amends several existing laws, including the Stamp Act, 1899, the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967, the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989, and the Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000.

metadata.title: The Punjab Healthcare Commission Act 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Healthcare Commission to improve the quality of healthcare services in the province. It also aims to ban quackery in all its forms and manifestations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the formation of trade unions and governs relations between employers and workmen in the Punjab. It also provides mechanisms for avoiding and settling industrial disputes arising between these parties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce new reporting procedures for the acquisition of land rights. It mandates that persons acquiring rights through inheritance, purchase, or other means must report such acquisitions to the Service Centre Official within three months.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to establish an Election Authority and define its composition and functions. It also substitutes sections regarding the term of office for local governments, notification of election results, and provisions for the dissolution of councils and appointment of administrators.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to replace references to the Election Authority with the Election Commission. It substitutes specific sections regarding election conduct, result notifications, and election scheduling within the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1975. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on February 12, 2010.

metadata.title: The Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Privatization Board to manage a competitive and transparent process for privatizing government properties. It also provides mechanisms to resolve disputes related to privatization and covers ancillary matters necessary for the Board's operation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance formulates the law relating to the formation of trade unions and regulates activities between employers and workmen. It aims to improve industrial relations and provide mechanisms for avoiding and settling disputes arising between them.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act reorganizes the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority to ensure proper provision of technical education in the province. It establishes the Authority as a body corporate with powers to manage institutions, prescribe courses, and support workforce training.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to modify provisions regarding valuation lists and tax recovery. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on July 12, 2010, and received assent from the Governor on July 19, 2010.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2009

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by substituting clause (a) of section 7. The amendment addresses procedures for reducing or extending intervals between valuation lists and handling lost or destroyed lists due to circumstances beyond control.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP FOR INFRASTRUCTURE ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Punjab Public-Private Partnership for Infrastructure Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development within the Punjab province through public-private partnership projects. It establishes institutional arrangements, including a PPP Steering Committee, to promote, facilitate, coordinate, and oversee such projects.

metadata.title: The Sasti Roti Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sasti Roti Authority in the Punjab to provide and distribute subsidized tandoori roti to deserving people. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to regulate the manufacture, storage, transport, and sale of sasti roti and subsidized flour at fair prices.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to restrict banks from granting advances or altering terms for directors and their connected persons. It defines 'connected persons' to include family members and entities where the director holds significant shares or management positions.

metadata.title: The Women University Multan Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Women University Multan as a body corporate with perpetual succession located in Multan. It outlines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various governing bodies, while defining its functions such as providing education, conducting research, awarding degrees, and managing student welfare.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update regulations regarding registration marks and number plates. It also repeals the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007 and validates actions taken under that repealed ordinance.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to establish Urban Transport Companies in notified areas. It grants these companies powers to plan routes, operate services, maintain infrastructure, and fix fares, while restricting transport authorities from issuing permits or exercising specific powers on those routes.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to establish Urban Transport Companies in notified areas. It grants these companies powers to plan routes, operate services, maintain infrastructure, and fix fares, while restricting transport authorities from issuing permits or exercising specific powers on those routes.

metadata.title: The HITEC University of Taxila Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the HITEC University of Taxila in the private sector. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and various academic bodies, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 by substituting the Twelfth Schedule with a new list of violations and corresponding fines. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2009
metadata.amends: Stamp Act 1899; Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act 1993
metadata.summary: This Act levies taxes and alters tax rates and duties within the Punjab province. It also amends the Stamp Act of 1899 and the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act of 1993 to include specific provisions regarding asset transfers and social sector funds.

metadata.title: The Punjab Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Fisheries Ordinance, 1961 to insert a new section regarding fish quality and control standards. It also modifies specific clauses within the original ordinance and repeals the Punjab Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce new regulations regarding seatbelt usage and the prohibition of using hand-held mobile telephones while driving. It also updates various sections of the Ordinance to include penalties for contraventions and expands the authority of government-authorized persons alongside police officers.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WELARE FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund (Amendment) Ordinance 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969 to update definitions of government servants and adjust contribution amounts based on basic scales. It also repeals the earlier Amendment Ordinance of 2007 and validates actions taken under that repealed ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Katchi Abadis Act, 1992 to update definitions and procedures regarding katchi abadi (informal settlement) development. It specifically replaces references to local authorities with 'Governmental Agency' and repeals a previous 2007 amendment ordinance.

name: PUNJAB GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND ACT 2009

metadata.title: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund to generate revenues for discharging the liabilities of the General Provident Fund. It provides for the creation of a Reserve Fund, defines the powers and functions of the Management Committee, and outlines the corporate status of the Fund.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to establish a Review Board for overseeing detention cases. It introduces specific procedures for reviewing detentions exceeding three months and mandates the release of individuals if sufficient cause for continued detention is not found.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF KITE FLYING (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Punjab Prohibition of Dangerous Kite Flying Activities Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Prohibition of Dangerous Kite Flying Activities Ordinance, 2001 by changing the terminology from 'dangerous kite flying activities' to simply 'kite flying'. It substitutes specific sections within the original Ordinance to redefine offenses, update definitions regarding materials used, and introduce new provisions for registration and permissions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority to regulate the procurement of goods, services, and works in the public sector. It defines key terms such as 'procuring agency' and 'public procurement,' and grants the Authority powers to monitor laws, evaluate procedures, and recommend reforms to improve governance and transparency.

metadata.title: The Punjab Rented Premises Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the relationship between landlords and tenants regarding rented premises in the Punjab province. It establishes a framework for creating tenancies through written agreements, defines key terms like 'pagri' and 'rent', and provides a mechanism for expeditious dispute resolution via Rent Tribunals.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP FOR INFRASTRUCTURE ORDINANCE, 2009

metadata.title: Punjab Public-Private Partnership for Infrastructure Ordinance 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development within the Punjab province through public-private partnership projects. It aims to improve infrastructure services, mobilize private resources, and introduce modern management techniques while ensuring fairness and transparency.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to insert new definitions and provisions regarding the amalgamation, division, and alteration of societies. It also empowers the Government of the Punjab to make rules for carrying out the purposes of the Act.

metadata.title: The Sasti Roti Authority Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sasti Roti Authority in the Punjab to provide and distribute subsidized tandoori roti to deserving people. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to regulate the manufacture, storage, transport, and sale of sasti roti, including fixing rates and controlling quality.

name: UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.title: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to regulate the appointment and qualifications of the Vice Chancellor. It establishes a Search Committee process where the Chief Minister appoints the Vice Chancellor based on recommendations from this committee.

name: ALI INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE ORDINANCE, 2008

metadata.title: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Ali Institute of Education Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the institute's functions, including providing teacher education, conducting examinations, and awarding bachelor of education degrees.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 by omitting section 7. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.amends: The King Edward Medical University Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the King Edward Medical University Act, 2005 to modify the provisions regarding the appointment of the Vice Chancellor. It establishes that the Vice Chancellor shall be appointed by the Chancellor on the recommendation of the Chief Minister for a term not exceeding four years.

metadata.title: The Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation (Repeal) Act, 2008
metadata.repeals: The Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation Act, 1997 (XII of 1997)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation Act, 1997. It also revives the Nazaria-i-Pakistan Trust and transfers its rights and liabilities to the revived trust.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Act, 2006

metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975; The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act revises the emoluments of holders of representative offices in the Province of the Punjab. It amends existing legislation regarding the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Speaker, Deputy Speaker, and Ministers.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2006
metadata.repeals: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to mandate the registration of Deeni Madaris and establish requirements for annual reports and audits. metadata.title: The University of Education, Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 2006
metadata.amends: The University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions and structural provisions. It specifically alters sections regarding constituent colleges, officer appointments, and the roles of the Chancellor and Registrar.

metadata.title: The University of Education, Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 2006
metadata.amends: The University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions regarding affiliated and constituent colleges. It also revises sections concerning the appointment and duties of the Registrar and Treasurer, and clarifies the status of government educational institutions within the university structure.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 by substituting the word 'President' for 'Managing Director' in various sections and clauses. It also updates share denominations and repeals a previous Ordinance on the same subject.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to replace references to the 'Managing Director' with the term 'President' in various sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Beaconhouse National University, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Beaconhouse National University in Lahore as a private sector body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Board of Governors and Academic Council, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Minhaj University, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Minhaj University, Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various faculties, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding academic degrees.

name: KING EDWARD MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LAHORE ACT, 2005

metadata.title: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act grants university status to the King Edward Medical College in Lahore, reconstituting it as the King Edward Medical University. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its structure, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Senate, and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to regulate stage carriages and improve the road transport system. It grants the Government powers to survey routes, declare specified routes, determine vehicle specifications, and fix permit numbers based on factors like traffic congestion and environmental needs.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to regulate stage carriages in Punjab. It grants the Government powers to survey routes, declare specified routes, and determine technical specifications for vehicles and permits. The document also inserts new sections regarding permit applications, qualifications, and procedures for granting permits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961. It substitutes the word 'Director' with 'Director General' in various sections of the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to empower the Government to regulate stage carriages on specific routes. It introduces new provisions for conducting surveys, declaring specified routes, and determining technical specifications and permit requirements. The document also outlines procedures for granting permits based on applicant qualifications and business plans.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to clarify definitions regarding proforma and regular promotions. It establishes that promotions are not claims of right and must be granted with immediate effect from the date of assumption of charge, rather than the date a post becomes available.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the levy of sales tax on certain services within the Province of the Punjab. It amends the Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000 by removing specific entries from its schedule regarding marriage halls and lawns.

metadata.title: The Punjab Heritage Foundation Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Heritage Foundation in the Province of the Punjab to conserve, maintain, rehabilitate, and develop local heritage. It creates a permanent fund for these purposes and constitutes a Board of Governors to manage the foundation's affairs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection and promotion of the rights and interests of consumers in the Punjab province. It establishes liability for manufacturers regarding damages caused by defective products arising from reasonably anticipated use.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It specifically omits the phrase 'through a secret ballot' from subsection (4) of sections 42 and 69 in the amended ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update references and definitions within that ordinance. It introduces new clauses regarding misconduct, modifies provisions related to city district creation, and alters sections concerning Union Council functions and Zila Nazim elections.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 2005

metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958. It specifically substitutes a clause in Section 4 to exclude one residential house up to five marlas used for residential purposes from tax liability.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to require the registration of Deeni Madrassahs as societies. It imposes specific conditions on these institutions, including annual reporting, account maintenance, and audits, while prohibiting the teaching or publication of literature promoting militancy or sectarianism.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to mandate the registration of all Deeni Madaris. metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update definitions, modify council functions, and adjust provisions regarding district administration and elections. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: FATIMA JINNAH WOMEN UNIVERSITY, RAWALPINDI (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.amends: The Fatima Jinnah Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Fatima Jinnah Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1999 to clarify the Chancellor's duties. Specifically, it mandates that the Chancellor must act and be bound in the same manner as a Governor under Article 105 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

name: UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH ASIA, LAHORE ACT 2005

metadata.title: The University of South Asia, Lahore Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of South Asia, Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. metadata.title: The Forman Christian College, Lahore Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act grants University status to the Forman Christian College, Lahore in the private sector. It establishes the institution as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its functions, powers, jurisdiction, and governance structure.

metadata.title: The Forman Christian College, Lahore Ordinance, 2004
metadata.summary: This Ordinance grants University status to the Forman Christian College, Lahore, converting it into a private sector university. It establishes the institution as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its functions, powers, and governance structure under the supervision of the Governor of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Forman Christian College, Lahore Ordinance, 2004
metadata.summary: This Ordinance grants University status to the Forman Christian College, Lahore, which is located in the private sector. It establishes the institution as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its functions, powers, and governance structure under the jurisdiction of the Province of Punjab.

metadata.title: The Government College University, Faisalabad (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Government College University, Faisalabad Ordinance, 2002 to define the role of the Pro-Chancellor. It assigns duties and powers to the Minister for Education as the Pro-Chancellor and adds new clauses regarding the composition of the university body.

metadata.title: The GIFT University, Gujranwala Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the GIFT University, Gujranwala as a body corporate in the private sector with its campus located in Gujranwala. It defines the university's functions, including providing instruction and training across various disciplines, conducting research, and awarding degrees within the jurisdiction of the Punjab province.

metadata.title: The Government College University, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Government College University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Government College University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions and structural provisions. It specifically designates the Minister for Education as the Pro-Chancellor and clarifies the Chancellor's functions in relation to the Governor of the Province.

name: LAHORE COLLEGE FOR WOMEN UNIVERSITY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Lahore College for Women University, Lahore (Amendment) Act 2004
metadata.amends: The Lahore College for Women University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore College for Women University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to introduce new definitions and roles regarding the Pro-Chancellor. It adds specific clauses defining the Pro-Chancellor's duties, powers, and composition of women members nominated by the Speaker.

metadata.title: The Injured Persons (Treatment and Protection) Act
metadata.summary: This Act establishes protocols for the immediate medical treatment of injured persons, prioritizing their care over other medico-legal formalities. It restricts police interference during treatment, mandates specific procedures for shifting patients between hospitals, and prohibits taking injured individuals to police stations before they receive necessary aid.

metadata.title: The New Murree Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004 to update specific clauses within Section 4. It inserts a new clause regarding the Secretary of Tourism and Resort Development Department and modifies existing clauses related to wildlife and tourism.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update requirements regarding insurance security for applicants. Specifically, it substitutes a clause in section 49 of the Ordinance to mandate that applicants furnish security issued by registered insurance companies.

metadata.title: The New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the New Murree Development Authority to plan, develop, and manage a new township near Murree. It defines the Authority's constitution, functions, and powers regarding urban design, building regulations, and master plan implementation.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Education Foundation as a body corporate to restructure and promote education in the province. It outlines the foundation's functions, including providing financial aid, incentives, and technical assistance to educational institutions while encouraging private sector participation.

name: PUNJAB DESTITUTE AND NEGLECTED CHILDREN ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the rescue, protective custody, care, and rehabilitation of destitute and neglected children in the Province of the Punjab. It establishes a Child Protection and Welfare Bureau and defines specific terms related to child protection, prostitution, and destitution.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act enhances, reduces, and rationalizes certain taxes, fees, and duties within the Province of the Punjab. It specifically amends the Stamp Act, 1899 by substituting fixed fee amounts with a uniform percentage rate for various instruments.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation to provide housing facilities for government servants and their families. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Board of Directors responsible for managing the foundation's affairs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Journalists Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Journalists Housing Foundation to introduce schemes for the non-profit allocation of plots for house construction. It provides provisions regarding the foundation's establishment, board composition, powers, and functions.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF LANGUAGE, ART AND CULTURE ACT 2004

metadata.title: The Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture to promote and develop language, art, and culture in the Punjab. The Institute is empowered to conduct research, preserve literature and folk arts, publish books, and collaborate with national and international institutions.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE SECURITY COMPANIES (REGULATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2002. It adds a new section prohibiting private security companies from undertaking cash-in-transit business without a No Objection Certificate from the Licensing Authority.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Services Board (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970 to update provisions regarding member nominations and board functions. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on September 10, 2004, and received assent from the Governor on October 9, 2004.

metadata.title: The University of Education, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to clarify the definition of 'Pro-Chancellor' and assign duties to the Minister for Education. It also modifies sections regarding the Chancellor's functions relative to the Governor and adds new clauses concerning Provincial Assembly members.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, TAXILA (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.amends: The University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila Act, 1994 by adding a new sub-section to section 9. The amendment stipulates that the Chancellor must act and be bound in the same manner as the Governor of a Province under Article 105 of the Constitution of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Superior College, Lahore Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Superior College, Lahore as a private sector institute located in Lahore. It defines the functions and powers of the Institute, including providing instruction, conducting research, and awarding degrees, while also establishing the Board of Governors and the role of the Patron.

name: UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMENT AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE ACT 2004

metadata.title: The University of Management and Technology, Lahore Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Management and Technology, Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in the Punjab province. It defines the university's functions, including providing instruction in various fields like management and IT, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The University of Sargodha (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Sargodha Ordinance, 2002 to define the role of the Pro-Chancellor and adjust specific sections regarding the Chancellor's functions. It designates the Minister for Education as the Pro-Chancellor and modifies clauses related to the composition of the university body.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 by substituting the word 'Government' for 'Governor' in section 10. It also repeals the earlier Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.

metadata.title: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.amends: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997 to update provisions regarding the High Court and the tenure of sitting judges serving as Ombudsmen. It specifically alters sections 3, 4, and 5 of the original 1997 Act to allow for the recall of sitting judges before their tenure expires and to clarify eligibility criteria.

name: INSTITUTE OF SOUTH ASIA, LAHORE ACT 2003

metadata.title: The Institute of South Asia, Lahore Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of South Asia, Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the institute's functions, including providing instruction in computer sciences and other branches of learning, conducting research, and awarding degrees.

metadata.title: The Lahore Arts Council (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002; The Lahore Arts Council (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by substituting the word 'Governor' with 'Chief Minister' in specific sections. It also repeals two previous ordinances related to the Lahore Arts Council.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 to add a new section regarding official vehicle plates for members. It grants members the right to display an official plate on their specific vehicle and outlines rules for its use, replacement, and surrender.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 to address tax liabilities related to land transfers. Specifically, it ensures that persons transferring land to their wives or heirs under eighteen years of age remain liable for tax as if the transfer did not occur, until the heir reaches adulthood.

metadata.title: The University of Gujrat Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Gujrat by reconstituting several existing government colleges in Gujrat. It defines the university's corporate status, powers, and internal structure including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2003
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Punjab Finance Act, 1964; Punjab Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws to enhance, reduce, and rationalize certain taxes, fees, and duties in the Province of the Punjab. It specifically updates rates for stamp duty, entertainment duty, motor vehicle taxation, and import/export duties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Juvenile Smoking (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959 to increase the age limit for tobacco purchase from sixteen to eighteen years. It also introduces stricter penalties for selling tobacco to juveniles and mandates publicity regarding these provisions before enforcement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by changing a specific date in section 24. It also repeals the Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.

name: PUNJAB MARRIAGE FUNCTIONS (PROHIBITION OF OSTENTATIOUS DISPLAYS AND WASTEFUL EXPENSES) ACT 2003

metadata.title: The Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits wasteful expenses and ostentatious displays associated with marriages in the Punjab province. It specifically bans decorating public spaces, using explosives or fireworks, displaying dowry publicly, and serving full meals at events other than the Walima ceremony, where only one dish is permitted for up to 300 invitees.

name: PUNJAB OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2003

metadata.title: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.amends: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997

It substitutes certain words in Section 3, modifies Section 4 to allow sitting High Court judges to be recalled before their tenure expires, and inserts restrictions in Section 5.

metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974. It adds an explanation to section 5-A defining 'member' to include the Speaker, Deputy Speaker, and a Minister.

name: PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS ACT 2003

metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and efficient management of Medical and Health Institutions in the Punjab. name: THE LAHORE ARTS COUNCIL (FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2003

metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by substituting the word 'Governor' with 'Chief Minister' in specific sections. It also repeals the Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.

name: THE PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2003

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This document is a notification publishing the Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003. The Ordinance amends Section 24 of the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001, specifically changing a date from December 31, 2002, to June 30, 2003.

name: THE INSTITUTE OF SOUTH ASIA LAHORE ORDINANCE 2003

metadata.title: The Institute of South Asia, Lahore, Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Institute of South Asia, Lahore as a corporate body with perpetual succession. metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to alter provisions regarding the nomination and powers of the Board Chairman. It also modifies requirements for tenure and government approval within the said Act.

metadata.title: The Defamation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes provisions regarding defamation and matters connected thereto. It defines key terms such as author, publisher, and publication, and establishes that defamatory statements are actionable without proof of special damage.

name: DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES (REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2002

name: DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES (REGULATION) (FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to further regulate local governance in the province. It introduces new definitions for various council types and establishes a District Assembly with specific functions and powers.

name: THE PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1995

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to further regulate local government structures in the Punjab province. It introduces new definitions for various local councils, modifies population thresholds for different types of councils, and establishes a new chapter regarding District Assemblies.

metadata.title: The Civil Defence (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Civil Defence Act, 1952 to redefine the scope of civil defence measures. It specifically includes remedial actions taken during calamities or disasters in peacetime and defines these measures as those not amounting to actual combat.

metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 1978 to provide for the dissolution of Market Committees following general elections. It also stipulates that upon dissolution, all assets shall vest in the Government and liabilities shall be assumed by it.

metadata.title: The Punjab Bait-ul-Mal (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Bait-ul-Mal (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Bait-ul-Mal Act, 1991 by establishing a corporate Council with specific composition and tenure rules. It also modifies provisions regarding District Bait-ul-Mal Committees and repeals a previous Amendment Ordinance from 1994.

metadata.title: The Punjab Compulsory Primary Education Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Primary Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for compulsory primary education in the Province of Punjab, defining eligible children and their parents' obligations. It mandates that every child must attend a primary school unless specific reasonable excuses exist, such as illness or lack of nearby schools.

metadata.title: The Punjab Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1973 by omitting a specific subsection. It also repeals the earlier Amendment Ordinance of 1994 and comes into force immediately upon enactment.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ARID AGRICULTURE RAWALPINDI ACT, 1995

metadata.repeals: The University of Arid Agriculture Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Arid Agriculture at Rawalpindi to bridge the knowledge gap between arid and irrigated areas. It creates a corporate body with perpetual succession, granting it powers to conduct instruction, research, and award degrees in agricultural and related sciences.

metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment and Validation) Ordinance, 1994

metadata.summary: This Act levies and revises the rates of certain taxes, duties, and fees in the Punjab. It amends existing legislation including the Stamp Act, Urban Property Tax Act, Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, and the Punjab Finance Act to update tax structures and introduce new charges.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950 as applicable to the Punjab. It specifically inserts a provision allowing aggrieved persons to file complaints in court if the Collector or Cane Commissioner fails to decide on prosecution within sixty days.

metadata.amends: The Weights and Measures (International System) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Weights and Measures (International System) Act, 1967. It specifically substitutes clause (25) of section 2 in the parent Act to redefine the meaning of a 'weighing instrument'.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 to facilitate the establishment of Family Courts in each district. It specifically mandates that at least one Family Court per district must be presided over by a woman judge and increases certain financial limits within the original act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the imposition of a tax on agricultural income accruing from land situated in the Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 1978 to provide for the dissolution of Market Committees under specific circumstances. It grants the Government power to dissolve committees if a general election is announced and their use of funds or influence for political purposes is deemed contrary to public interest.

metadata.title: The Punjab Bait-ul-Mal (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Bait-ul-Mal Act, 1991 to establish a new Council structure and modify member qualifications. It empowers the Government to create the Punjab Bait-ul-Mal Council with specific roles for an Ameen and non-official members who must be renowned social workers or experts.

metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 to alter the composition, tenure, and appointment procedures of the Commission. metadata.summary: This Act amends the Antiquities Act, 1975 to update terminology and definitions regarding ancient antiquities. It establishes a new Advisory Committee with members from Parliament and grants ownership of all buried antiquities to the Federal Government.

metadata.title: Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the bonded labour system throughout Pakistan to prevent economic and physical exploitation of the labour class. It declares all customs, agreements, or contracts related to bonded labour void and extinguishes any existing obligations to repay bonded debts.

metadata.summary: This Act provides legal protection for economic reforms introduced by the Government to create a liberal environment for savings and investments. metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 to establish specific presumptions regarding certain commercial documents. It lists various shipping, aviation, and trade certificates that courts may presume were duly made by appropriate authorities or contain accurate statements.

metadata.title: The Indian Tea Cess (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tea Cess Act, 1903 to substitute specific words regarding recommendations for tea planters in North Bengal and Terai. It received assent on September 26, 1989, and comes into force on a date appointed by the Central Government.

metadata.title: The Martial Law Order No. 1371 (Repeal) Ordinance, 1989
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No. 1371 dated February 9, 1984 issued by M.L.A. Zone 'A' (Punjab)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to repeal Martial Law Order No. 1371, which had banned student unions in M.L.A. Zone 'A'. The legislation was issued because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary under Article 128 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Bank of Punjab Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Bank of Punjab as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It establishes the bank's capital structure, defines the composition of its Board of Directors, and outlines the qualifications for shareholders.

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a Special Allowance to employees in the Punjab whose wages do not exceed a specified threshold. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'wages' and mandates that employers pay this allowance alongside regular wages starting from May 1, 1988.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1989

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance, 1989
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by adding a new clause to Section 4. The amendment specifically addresses the taxation status of residential houses owned and occupied by retired Government servants.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Amendment Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974 to update salary figures and allowances. It specifically revises sections regarding official transport entitlements for committee chairmen and adds new provisions concerning car usage and maintenance responsibilities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by omitting specific provisions in Section 12 and Section 12-A. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on December 24, 1988, and received assent from the Governor on January 9, 1989.

name: THE PUNJAB EMPLOYEES SPECIAL ALLOWANCE (PAYMENT) ACT, 1988

metadata.title: The Punjab Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a special allowance to employees in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as employee, employer, and wages, and specifies the rates at which the allowance must be paid based on wage levels.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by omitting specific provisos in Section 12 and deleting Section 12-A. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on December 24, 1988, and received assent from the Governor on January 9, 1989.

name: THE PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988

metadata.title: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.amends: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 by substituting Section 21 to establish discretionary grants for the Chief Minister and other Ministers. It also repeals the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988.

name: THE PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT 1988

metadata.title: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.amends: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance III of 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update provisions regarding discretionary grants for the Chief Minister and other ministers. It also repeals the Punjab Ordinance III of 1988 which was previously in force.

name: THE PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 1988

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to adjust tax exemptions based on annual property values. It specifically repeals a previous Ordinance issued in 1988 regarding these amendments.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965. It extends to the Province of Punjab and comes into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to introduce changes regarding electoral units and non-Muslim representation. It also establishes a bar on contesting elections based on political party names or symbols and modifies provisions for no-confidence votes against local council chairmen.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1988

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1953 to adjust tax levies on specific properties belonging to widows, disabled persons, or minor orphans. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Tenth Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan by substituting specific numbers in Articles 54 and 61. It received the assent of the President on March 25, 1987, and came into force immediately.

name: PUNJAB ANIMALS COMPOUND FEEDING STUFF ACT, 1988

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Compound Feeding Stuff Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture and marketing of compound feeding stuffs in the Province of Punjab. It establishes definitions for various feed types, ingredients, and additives while mandating that no person may manufacture or sell these products without a specific license.

metadata.title: The Murree-Kahuta Development Authority Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Murree-Kahuta Development Authority to oversee the development of Murree and Kahuta Tehsils in Rawalpindi District. It defines the Authority's composition, powers, and functions, including property acquisition, scheme implementation, and infrastructure development.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1987
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act enhances the rate of tax on certain categories of motor vehicles in the Province of the Punjab. It amends the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 by substituting specific entries regarding seating capacity and engine power for taxation purposes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update definitions regarding metropolises and metropolitan corporations. It also revises provisions concerning the number of Muslim members in local councils and establishes new criteria for determining membership based on population size across various urban bodies.

name: THE EX-EMPLOYEES OF THE FORMER GOVERNMENT OF EAST PAKISTAN (APPOINTMENT TO PROVINCIAL POSTS) ACT, 1986

metadata.title: The Ex-employees to Provincial of the Former Government of East Pakistan (Appointment Posts) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment and conditions of service for former employees of the Government of East Pakistan who migrated to Pakistan. It ensures that their past service counts towards seniority and pension eligibility under the Government of the Punjab.

name: THE PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSE COURTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887. It substitutes specific words in sections 1 and 12 regarding jurisdiction and fee limits.

name: THE PUNJAB CIVIL COURTS ORDINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on June 14, 1986.

name: THE PUNJAB CIVIL COURTS ORDINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance of 1962 by substituting specific words in Section 18. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent on June 14, 1986.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: Section 16 of the Punjab Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and fees in the Province of Punjab. It amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to introduce new provisions for valuing urban land and adjusting stamp duty rates for agricultural and immovable property.

name: THE PUNJAB INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Development Board (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.amends: The Punjab Industrial Development Board Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Industrial Development Board Act, 1973 to update the composition and voting rules of the Board. Specifically, it adds references to a Vice Chairman in various sections and grants the Vice Chairman a casting vote in case of equality or absence of the Chairman.

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1987
metadata.amends: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1987. It also amends several existing laws, including the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923, the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944, and the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by omitting specific clauses from sections 21, 21-A, and 29. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on February 27, 1986, and received assent from the Governor on March 10, 1986.

name: THE PUNJAB JINNAH ABADIS FOR NON-PROPRIETORS IN RURAL AREAS ACT, 1986

metadata.title: The Punjab Jinnah Abadis for Non-proprietors in Rural Areas Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act provides for housing facilities to non-proprietors residing in rural areas of the Punjab. It establishes mechanisms for the government to grant land free of cost, define terms related to allotment and ownership, and set conditions regarding the alienation of such land.

metadata.title: The Bahauddin Zakariya University (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bahauddin Zakariya University Act, 1975. It specifically alters Section 23 regarding member elections and Section 25 concerning government officials.

name: HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (NINTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985

metadata.title: The Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Ninth Amendment) Order, 1985
metadata.amends: The Proclamation of the fifth day of July, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 10 of the Proclamation of July 5, 1977, by adding a new clause regarding Senate elections. It stipulates that a person is disqualified from being elected to the Senate if they were not elected to the National Assembly under the relevant Order.

metadata.title: The Islamia University (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975 to alter provisions regarding the election of members to the Provincial Assembly and the composition of government departments. It specifically substitutes clauses in Section 22 concerning member elections from divisions and districts, and adds a new clause in Section 24 regarding the Secretary to Government of the Punjab Finance Department.

metadata.title: The Public Gambling (Repeal) Act, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Public Gambling Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Public Gambling Act, 1867. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on November 7, 1985.

metadata.title: The Punjab (Multan) Timber Market (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab (Multan) Timber Market Act, 1973 to alter provisions regarding price payments and trust funds. It specifically adds a proviso to section 5(3) requiring that an opportunity of being heard be provided to appellants before any order is made.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Eighth Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan by modifying various articles related to executive powers and parliamentary procedures. It specifically alters provisions concerning the Prime Minister's advice, the President's discretion, the composition of the Senate, and the process for passing bills.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973 to update financial limits and timeframes for land development. Specifically, it increases a monetary threshold from twenty thousand to forty thousand and reduces a development period from twenty years to five years.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Repeal) Act, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973. It provides for the continuation of pending proceedings under the repealed Act and adjusts compensation mechanisms to align with the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

name: PUNJAB BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962 by adding a proviso to section 8. The amendment ensures that no member of the board can be removed without providing them an opportunity to be heard.

name: PUNJAB DEVELOPMENT OF DAMAGED AREAS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Damaged Areas (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Development of Damaged Areas Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Development of Damaged Areas Act, 1952 by adding a proviso to section 4. The amendment mandates that when undertaking schemes under this section, a provision for the construction of a mosque must be made where necessary.

metadata.amends: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update salary figures, allowances, and other provisions for the Chief Minister and Ministers. It was assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on November 7, 1985, and came into force immediately.

name: PUNJAB BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985

metadata.title: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976 to update provisions regarding board composition, officer appointments, and inspection powers. It comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE COLLEGES (MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Colleges (Management and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance issued by the Governor of the Punjab to amend the Punjab Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970. It specifically adds new wording regarding the opportunity for a Chairman or Member to be heard before certain actions are taken.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974. It updates specific monetary figures in sections 4 and 7 and modifies section 5 regarding travelling allowance rates for officers.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974 to update financial provisions for assembly members. It increases various allowances, introduces new medical facilities, and adds an office maintenance allowance.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY DEPUTY SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Allowances Assembly and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update salary figures and add provisions for leave of absence. It substitutes specific monetary amounts in various sections and introduces a new section regarding the Chief Minister's power to grant leave.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978. It adds specific words to section 10 regarding rules and regulations and inserts a new sub-section allowing the Commission to make regulations for carrying out the purposes of the Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update financial figures and allowances. It substitutes specific monetary amounts in various sections regarding equipment allowances, official cars, and other privileges for the Speaker.

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Premises (Preservation) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the preservation of certain historical, cultural, and architectural premises in the Punjab. It establishes a Committee to advise on matters related to these sites and regulates alterations, demolition, or re-erection thereof.

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973 to alter the election process for members of the Provincial Assembly. metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973 (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973 to ensure procedural fairness in administrative orders. Specifically, it adds provisions requiring that affected persons be afforded an opportunity of being heard before any order is passed under certain sections.

metadata.title: The University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Engineering and Technology Lahore Act, 1974. It adds specific provisos to sections 10 and 10-A requiring that affected persons be afforded an opportunity of being heard before certain orders are passed.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.amends: The University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore Act, 1974. It specifically alters provisions regarding the election of members to the Provincial Assembly and modifies clauses related to government appointments within the university.

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of the Punjab Act, 1973. It specifically alters provisions regarding the election of members to the Provincial Assembly and adds a new clause concerning the rank of the Additional Secretary in the Finance Department.

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab Ordinance, 1985 (Amendment)
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of the Punjab Act, 1973 by adding specific provisos to sections 11 and 11-A. The amendments ensure that no orders are passed under these sections unless the affected person is afforded an opportunity of being heard.

name: BANKING AND FINANCIAL SERVICES (AMENDMENT OF LAWS) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Banking and Financial Services (Amendment of Laws) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Registration Act, 1908; The Partnership Act, 1932; The Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing laws to align them with the Banking Tribunals Ordinance, 1984. It specifically updates definitions regarding financial institutions and expands the scope of banking business activities permitted under current legislation.

metadata.title: The Cholistan Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Cholistan Development Authority Act, 1976 by adding a proviso to section 15. The amendment mandates that while undertaking functions under clause (f), provision must be made for constructing mosques.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to update definitions regarding loans and financial instruments. It specifically introduces new clauses to include participation certificates, musharika certificates, modaraba certificates, and other State Bank of Pakistan-approved instruments alongside traditional debentures.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to ensure that schemes include provisions for plots designated for mosques. It also adds a proviso to Section 39 requiring that affected persons be given an opportunity of being heard before any action is taken under that section.

name: ON-FARM WATER MANAGEMENT AND WATER USERS ASSOCIATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the On-Farm Water Management and Water Users Association Ordinance, 1981. It adds specific provisos to sections 10 and 11 to ensure that no cancellation order or other order is passed without giving an opportunity of being heard to the relevant association or affected person.

metadata.title: The Police (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Act of 1861 by adding a proviso to Section 30 regarding the refusal of licenses. It stipulates that a magistrate must convey written satisfaction that granting a license will not cause a breach of peace or prejudice public safety before issuing it.

metadata.title: The Prisoners (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This document is a notification publishing an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab. The Ordinance amends Section 40 of the Prisoners Act, 1900, by deleting specific wording regarding the removal of persons.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 1978 to ensure that decisions are not made without providing an opportunity for a person to be heard. It also inserts provisions regarding notice periods and costs in specific sections of the parent Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976. It adds a proviso to Section 7(2) requiring that no decision be made unless the member to be affected is given an opportunity to be heard.

name: REVIVAL OF THE CONSTITUTION OF 1973 ORDER, 1985

metadata.summary: This Order amends the Constitution of 1973 to revive its provisions following a period of martial law. It specifies dates for the first meetings of the National Assembly, Senate, and Provincial Assemblies to facilitate elections and business transactions.
