metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Co-operative Societies Ordinance, 1966 and the Co-operative Banks (Re-payment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to address specific amendments regarding loan repayment procedures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to replace references to 'grade' with 'service or cadre' throughout various sections. It also modifies provisions regarding promotion seniority and inserts specific wording changes in sections concerning higher posts and service brackets.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976 to include provisions for allocating plots for mosques in city schemes. It also adds a proviso to Section 38 requiring that affected persons be given an opportunity to be heard before any action is taken under that section.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Punjab Educational and Training Institutions (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Punjab Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960. Specifically, it substitutes section 4 to require that the Board consist of not less than nine members appointed by the Governor of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to amend the Punjab Finance Act, 1963. It specifically modifies Section 16 regarding taxation on profits from the re-assignment or transfer of banking finance accounts and adds provisos and explanations concerning banking companies and customers.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING FACILITIES FOR NON-PROPRIETIES IN RURAL AREAS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.amends: The Punjab Housing Facilities for Non-Proprietors in Rural Areas Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Housing Facilities for Non-Proprietors in Rural Areas Act, 1975. It adds a provision requiring that no order in an appeal be passed without giving the affected person an opportunity to be heard.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979. It grants urban local councils the power to inspect buildings constructed in violation of provisions and requires alterations or demolition where necessary.

name: PUNJAB MINERALS (CANCELLATION OF SAND LEASES IN RESTRICTED AREAS ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Punjab Minerals (Cancellation of Sand Leases in Restricted Areas) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the cancellation of sand leases in certain restricted areas within the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Authority', 'Government', 'Sand Lease', and 'Restricted area' to facilitate this process.

name: PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.amends: The Punjab Ministers Salaries (Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Ministers Salaries (Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. Specifically, it inserts the word 'one' after 'of' in section 7 and substitutes the word 'cars' with 'car' within that same section.

metadata.title: The Punjab Youthful Offenders (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Youthful Offenders Ordinance, 1983 to provide specific changes to its sections. It substitutes the phrase 'without assigning any reason' with 'after affording him an opportunity of being heard' in Section 7 of the Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Registration of Unrecognized Institutions Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This ordinance provides for the promotion and regulation of private educational institutions within the Punjab. It establishes definitions for terms like 'Board', 'College', and 'School', sets out procedures for registration, cancellation, and appeals, and specifies penalties for operating without registration.

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Reformatory Schools Act, 1897 by altering Section 17. Specifically, it replaces a comma with a full-stop after the word 'persons' and omits the requirement that at least two individuals must be citizens of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to update terminology regarding debentures and participation term certificates. It adds a new definition for participation term certificates and modifies the exemption clause to include instruments issued by companies or corporate bodies for raising capital.

metadata.title: University of Agriculture, Faisalabad (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to amend the University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973. It was published for general information on September 20, 1984, and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The University of Engineering and Technology Lahore (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Engineering and Technology Lahore Act, 1974 by adding provisos to Sections 37 and 41. The amendments require that orders under these sections cannot be passed without affording an opportunity of being heard to the affected institution or person.

metadata.title: Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980 to remove specific exclusions regarding foreign currency accounts from the First Schedule. It also substitutes a colon for a semicolon in section 3 and adds a proviso prohibiting the compulsory collection of Zakat on certain assets acquired or maintained in foreign currency.

metadata.title: The Bahauddin Zakariya University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Bahauddin Zakariya University Act, 1975 to update the geographical jurisdiction of the university. Specifically, it substitutes references to the Multan Division with a combination of the Multan and D.G. Khan Divisions, as well as the Okara district of Lahore Division.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (PUNJAB) ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912. It substitutes specific monetary amounts and penalties within sections 24 and 33 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Third Amendment) Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 203F of the Constitution by adding a proviso regarding appeals within six months. It was promulgated by President Zia-ul-Haq on July 28, 1983.

name: PUNJAB (WILDLIFE PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983

metadata.title: The Punjab (Wildlife Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974 to update provisions regarding the Board's advisory functions, hunting restrictions, and penalties for contraventions. It specifically modifies sections related to wildlife policy supervision, hunting frequency limits, and punishment terms for illegal activities involving weapons or vehicles.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court Fees (Abolition) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the abolition of court fees in specific criminal and civil cases where the relief value does not exceed twenty-five thousand rupees. It applies to all courts, including revenue courts, and is deemed effective from August 1, 1978.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment), Ordinance 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce specific provisions regarding land owners with large holdings. It stipulates increased percentages on land revenue for irrigated and unirrigated land exceeding certain acreage limits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Utilization Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Punjab Land Utilization Authority Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Utilization Authority Ordinance, 1981 to motivate land owners to develop their culturable waste land through credit facilities. It introduces new provisions for granting loans to land owners for improving land and outlines specific methods for the recovery of these loans.

metadata.title: The Punjab Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973 to redefine 'Small handicraft Industry'. The amendment specifies that such an industry must be engaged in manufacturing producer or consumer goods with total assets (excluding land and buildings) not exceeding fifty lacs of rupees.

metadata.title: The Universities Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: laws relating to certain Universities in the Punjab
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the laws relating to specific universities in the Punjab, including the University of Agriculture Faisalabad, University of Engineering and Technology Lahore, Dinazariya Baha-ud-din University, and Islamia University Bahawalpur. The primary change inserts new sections granting revisional powers to the Chancellor of these universities to examine records and pass orders regarding findings or orders passed by other authorities.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Act (Amendment Ordinance), 1983
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Act, 1962 to address issues regarding land acquisition prior to the Succession Act, 1948. It inserts a new section 2-A that validates decrees and judgments based on custom or usage while voiding those contrary to the Muslim Personal Law.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Amendment) Order, 1982
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 181 of the Constitution by adding an explanation to define who is considered a Judge of a High Court. Specifically, it includes persons who have retired as Judges of a High Court within that definition.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Fourth Amendment) Order, 1982
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 228 of the Constitution to specify that the President shall appoint a member of the Islamic Council as its Chairman. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on September 22, 1982, and came into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Second Amendment) Order, 1982
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends Articles 203B, 203C, 203D, 203DD, 203F, and inserts new Articles 203G and 203GG into the Constitution of Pakistan. It specifically revises definitions regarding the Federal Shariat Court, expands its revisional jurisdiction over criminal cases involving Hudood laws, and establishes binding decision-making powers for the court.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Third Amendment) Order, 1982
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 203F of the Constitution to establish a Shariat Appellate Bench within the Supreme Court. The Bench consists of three Muslim Judges and up to two Ulema appointed by the President, who are granted the same powers and privileges as Supreme Court Judges.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Regulation (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972, to address legal changes resulting from the revocation of emergency provisions in 1976 and 1977. It introduces specific definitions for tenants, modifies clauses regarding land partition and joint ownership, and updates rules concerning the alienation of holdings.

metadata.title: The Motion Pictures (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979 to regulate admission charges for film exhibitions. It adds provisions to Section 13 regarding maximum charges and inserts a new subsection in Section 18 to punish those who charge excess fees or sell tickets above the fixed limits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Administrative Vigilance Commission (Repeal) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Administrative Vigilance Commission Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This ordinance repeals the Punjab Administrative Vigilance Commission Ordinance, 1979. It terminates all appointments made under the repealed act and extinguishes existing rights and privileges associated with the commission.

metadata.title: Allama Iqbal Open University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Allama Iqbal Open University Act, 1974 to introduce a compulsory 'Islamic and Pakistan Studies' discipline at the Bachelor's level. It also revises the composition of the Executive Council, modifies provisions regarding staff transfers between government bodies and universities, and updates statutes related to faculty appointments.

name: ALLAMA IQBAL OPEN UNIVERSITY (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of the Punjab Act, 1973 to update provisions regarding faculty attendance, employee service extensions, and appointment procedures for Deans and Department Chairmen. It also modifies clauses related to the election of professors and substitutes specific terms in sections concerning university governance.

metadata.title: Arbitration (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Arbitration Act, 1940 by requiring arbitrators or umpires to state reasons for their awards in sufficient detail. It empowers courts to remit awards that lack adequate reasoning and specifies consequences if such directions are not followed.

metadata.title: Banking Companies (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 by modifying section 22. The amendment adds specific language regarding loans received from the Federal Government or foreign agencies to the existing explanation in that section.

name: CENSUS ORDINANCE, 1959 (APPLICATION TO TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1981

metadata.title: The Regulation to apply the Census Ordinance, 1959 (X of 1959), to the Tribal Areas
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the provisions of the Census Ordinance, 1959 to the whole of the Tribal Areas in Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President on February 22, 1981, and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: CHAIRMAN AND MEMBERS OF FEDERAL LAND COMMISSION (VALIDATION OF ORDERS) ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.title: Chairman and Members of Federal Land Commission (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain orders passed by the Chairman or a Member of the Federal Land Commission before its commencement. It declares these orders validly passed and effective, notwithstanding any contrary court decisions.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Constitution of Pakistan by inserting a new Article 203CC regarding the creation of a panel of Ulema to assist the Court in cases involving Islamic law. It also adds a new clause to Article 203E granting the Court the power to review its own decisions.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Fifth Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 1 of the Constitution by adding specific words to clause (2). It was promulgated by President General Zia-ul-Haq on July 1, 1981, pursuant to the Proclamation of Martial Law.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Fifth Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order serves as the Fifth Amendment to the Constitution of Pakistan. It amends Article 1 by adding specific words and figures to its second clause, effective immediately upon publication.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Fourth Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution to increase the salary figures for the Supreme Court and High Courts. It came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.title: The Qanun-e-Shahadat, 1984
metadata.summary: This Order revises, amends, and consolidates the law of evidence in Pakistan to align it with Islamic injunctions found in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It applies to all judicial proceedings before courts, quasi-judicial authorities, tribunals, and arbitrators throughout the country.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Second Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 203C of the Constitution to specify that the Chairman of the Court shall not consist of more than eight Muslim members. It also omits Article 203CC from the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Second Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 203C of the Constitution to limit the number of Muslim members in a specific court. It also omits Article 203CC from the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Third Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 259 of the Constitution of Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes certain words in clause (2) regarding academic distinction to include the fields of sports or nursing.

metadata.title: Ehteram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to observe the sanctity of the month of Ramazan in Pakistan. It prohibits eating, drinking, or smoking in public places during fasting hours and restricts the serving of eatables in hotels and restaurants. Additionally, it mandates the closure of cinema houses and theatres from sunset until three hours thereafter.

metadata.title: Emigration (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Emigration Ordinance, 1979 to address specific provisions regarding licences issued under the Emigration Act, 1922. It stipulates that such existing licences are deemed issued under the new Ordinance but require payment of prescribed security and fees to be considered valid.

metadata.title: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the employment, rehabilitation, and welfare of disabled persons in Pakistan. It establishes a National Council at the federal level and Provincial Councils to formulate policies and coordinate efforts for the care of disabled individuals.

metadata.title: Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1973 to introduce a new sub-section regarding cost of living allowances. It mandates that employers pay an allowance equal to forty percent of wages if they exceed one hundred rupees per month, effective from July 1, 1981.

metadata.title: The Federal and Provincial Cabinets (Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.amends: The Federal and Provincial Cabinets Order, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Federal and Provincial Cabinets Order, 1981 by inserting a new Article 10A. The amendment ensures that persons in the service of Pakistan who are appointed as Ministers continue to hold their posts without disadvantageous changes to their terms.

metadata.title: The Federal and Provincial Cabinets Order, 1981
metadata.amends: The Federal Minister's Oath of Office Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the composition and tenure of the Federal and Provincial Cabinets, including the appointment of Ministers and Ministers of State. It also prescribes the form of the Oath of Office for these officials and repeals the previous Federal Minister's Oath of Office Order from 1978.

name: FEDERAL EMPLOYEES BENEVOLENT FUND AND GROUP INSURANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Federal Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Act, 1969 by substituting the Second Schedule. The amendment updates the sums assured to be paid to the families of deceased employees based on their last drawn pay.

metadata.title: The Amendment of the Federal Service Commission Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends section 7 of the Federal Service Commission Ordinance, 1977. It inserts specific clauses regarding deemed appointments and recommendations for posts in Pakistan services.

metadata.title: The Frontier Corps (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959 to update definitions and provisions regarding Political Officers, retirement, transportation, and imprisonment. It also revises the First and Third Schedules of the parent Ordinance to reflect changes in unit names and affirmations.

name: HOLDERS OF REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES (PUNISHMENT FOR MISCONDUCT) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1981

metadata.amends: The Holders of Representative Offices (Punishment for Misconduct) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Holders of Representative Offices (Punishment for Misconduct) Order, 1977 by adding a new clause to Article 5. The amendment allows the Federal Government to issue rules or orders without requiring prior sanction from the competent authority.

name: INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.title: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1961 to update definitions regarding credit facilities and shareholding structures. It also revises provisions related to the appointment of directors, management personnel, and security interests held by the bank.

metadata.title: Gift-tax (Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Gift-tax Act, 1963 by updating definitions of various tax officials and adding new clauses regarding valuers. It also restructures Chapter III to define classes of gift-tax authorities and establishes their subordinate relationships.

metadata.title: The Natural Gas (Development Surcharge) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Natural Gas (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1967 to update pricing units and interest rates. Specifically, it substitutes 'twenty rupees per thousand cubic feet' with 'twenty rupees per decacubic metre' in section 2 and changes the payable interest rate from six percent to twelve percent per annum in section 3.

name: OFFICE OF THE CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, PAKISTAN MARTIAL LAW ORDER

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 86
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Order No. 21 by modifying specific clauses regarding the definition of offences under martial law. It adds new clauses to address crimes such as cheating, forgery, criminal misappropriation, and breach of trust.

name: OFFICE OF THE CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, PAKISTAN MARTIAL LAW ORDER

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 85
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order places several electricity companies under the control of the Federal Government effective January 1, 1972. The order aims to renovate power distribution systems and expand supply to provide better service to consumers.

metadata.title: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956 to allow the Federal Government to specify a person for a particular role in section 9(2). It was promulgated by the President under Article 89 of the Constitution due to immediate circumstances.

name: PAKISTAN DEFENCE OFFICERS HOUSING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1981

metadata.title: Pakistan Defence Officers Housing Authority (Amendment) Order, 1981
metadata.amends: Pakistan Defence Officers Housing Authority Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Pakistan Defence Officers Housing Authority Order, 1980 by modifying specific clauses regarding beneficiary categories. It substitutes terms related to peasants and workers in Article 24 of the original order.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Penal Code (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Penal Code by inserting new sections 402A, 402B, and 402C. It defines hijacking as unlawfully seizing or exercising control over an aircraft and prescribes punishments including death, life imprisonment, and fines for committing, attempting, abetting, or harbouring hijackers.

metadata.title: Partnership (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Partnership Act, 1932 to restrict words in firm names that imply government sanction or are declared undesirable by provincial governments. It also modifies fee structures for registration services and updates the schedule of maximum fees payable to the Registrar.

name: PENSIONS AND PROVIDENT FUNDS (PAYMENT IN RUPEES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.amends: The Pensions and Provident Funds (Payment in Rupees) Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pensions and Provident Funds (Payment in Rupees) Order, 1959 to facilitate the conversion of pensions into rupees or sterling at authorized exchange rates. It also exempts individuals who opted for specific pension rules from reimbursing amounts drawn before May 12, 1972.

name: PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.title: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO) and creates a Space Research Council to oversee its operations. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Council and an Executive Committee responsible for policy direction and budget approval.

name: POPULATION WELFARE PLANNING PROGRAMME (APPOINTMENT AND TERMINATION OF SERVICE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1981

metadata.amends: The Population Welfare Planning Programme (Appointment and Termination of Service) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.summary: This Order amends the Constitution of Pakistan by inserting specific text into Article 9. It was issued by President M. Zia-ul-Haq on April 25, 1981.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the restructuring and reorganization of the Population Programme, including the appointment of persons connected with it. name: PUNJAB CODE VOLUME-I PART-II OF IV

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for tenancies in Punjab, specifically defining occupancy rights and procedures for their acquisition or loss. metadata.summary: This Act provides for the impressment of animals, vehicles, boats, and gear in the Punjab for military transport purposes. metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Utilization Authority Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Land Utilization Authority to manage culturable waste land in the Province of Punjab. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to acquire property and execute approved projects for proper land utilization.

metadata.title: The Quaid-i-Azam University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Quaid-i-Azam University Act, 1973 to update provisions regarding the composition of the Syndicate and the transfer of university officers. It also inserts a new section concerning inter-transfers between the Federal Government, provincial authorities, and universities while amending various statutes within the parent Act.

metadata.title: Amendment of Act XXVIII of 1973
metadata.summary: This document amends Act XXVIII of 1973 regarding the Quaid-i-Azam University. It modifies sections related to Senate composition, member eligibility, and conditions for ceasing membership in authorities. metadata.title: The Razmak Cade College Regulation, 1977 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This order amends section 8 of the Razmak Cade College Regulation, 1977. It substitutes the financial limit in sub-section (2) and adds a new sub-section (3) regarding the powers of the Board Chairman and Vice-Chairman.

metadata.title: Sales Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sales Tax Act, 1951 by modifying section 3 to align sales tax payment rules with excise duty provisions. It was promulgated by the President under emergency powers granted by the Proclamation of July 5, 1977.

metadata.title: The State Bank of Pakistan (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956 to update various sections regarding time limits for payment and duties. metadata.title: The Punjab Land Utilization Authority Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Land Utilization Authority within the Province of Punjab. It provides for the creation of a body corporate to manage culturable waste land, prepare schemes, and execute approved projects for proper utilization.

metadata.summary: This document contains amendments to the Control of Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Ordinance, V of 1970. It modifies various sections regarding authority functions, trade practice definitions, stock orders, and provincial clauses.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The Punjab Finance Act, 1963; The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1971; The Punjab Finance Act, 1964; The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance streamlines and enhances the rates of certain taxes and duties levied in the Province of the Punjab. It substitutes schedules in existing Finance Acts and Ordinances, prescribes new tax rates for electricity and vehicle registration, and outlines procedures for assessment and collection.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Development Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The Punjab Industrial Development Board Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Industrial Development Board Act, 1973 to update specific clauses within sections 2, 5, and 6. It substitutes references to 'industries' or 'industry' with the term 'Board' in various subsections regarding the Managing Director's control.

metadata.title: The Punjab Economic Research Institute Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Economic Research Institute as a statutory body with perpetual succession. It outlines the Institute's functions, which include conducting research in economics and demography, providing information on modern techniques, and advising the Government on economic policies.

name: PUNJAB REAL ESTATE AGENTS AND MOTOR VEHICLES DEALERS (REGULATION OF BUSINESS) ORDINANCE, 1980

metadata.title: The Punjab Real Estate Agents And Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the business of real estate agents and motor vehicles dealers in the Province of Punjab. It establishes requirements for registration, defines key terms, and sets out disqualifications for obtaining a certificate to engage in this business.

metadata.title: The Capital Issues (Continuance and Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Capital Issues Act, 1947 to update the list of securities and instruments included in its provisions. It specifically adds Modaraba Certificates and Mutual Fund Units while removing references to bonds and participation terms.

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of the Punjab Act, 1973 to introduce compulsory 'Islamic and Pakistan Studies' at the Bachelor's Degree level. It also updates provisions regarding the appointment of a Pro-Vice-Chancellor, modifies the composition of the Syndicate, and allows university employees to serve in government posts without loss of benefits.

name: EXCISE DUTY ON MINERALS (LABOUR WELFARE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967. Specifically, it substitutes the rate of one rupee with fifty-five paisa in section 3 of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Education Foundation Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Education Foundation as a body corporate to promote and finance educational activities in the Punjab. The Foundation is tasked with conducting surveys, testing innovative educational approaches, and funding projects aimed at universal literacy and employment-oriented skills training.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Development Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Punjab Industrial Development Board Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Industrial Development Board Act of 1973 to enable the Board to sell or transfer shares and assets of its completed projects. It authorizes the Board to dispose of these assets with the approval of the Government.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK ASSOCIATIONS AND LIVESTOCK ASSOCIATIONS UNION (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock Associations and Livestock Associations Unions (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and control of village livestock associations and their unions in the Punjab. It establishes the legal framework for applying for registration, amending bye-laws, and defining the rights and liabilities of members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance issued by the Governor of the Punjab on August 21, 1979. It amends the existing Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to introduce provisions regarding election result challenges, asset declarations for council members, and restrictions on holding dual memberships. It also establishes grounds for removing chairmen, vice-chairmen, or members from office due to misconduct, absenteeism, or failure to declare assets.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Ordinance, 1979 (Second Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to prohibit candidates from contesting elections on a party basis. It forbids candidates from identifying with political parties, accepting financial aid from them, displaying party insignia, or seeking votes based on party affiliation.

metadata.title: Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr in Pakistan. It establishes provisions related to these Islamic precepts and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

name: PUNJAB PREVENTION OF GAMBLING AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Gambling Amendment Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Punjab Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978 by inserting a new section titled '5-A'. The new section grants police officers of the rank of Sub-Inspector or higher specific powers to arrest without warrant, search for gaming instruments, and seize gaming moneys and articles suspected of being used in gambling offences.

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959 to update procedures for fixing fair rent and introducing new provisions regarding tenant eviction. Specifically, it allows salaried employees, widows, or minor orphans who have retired or died within six months to seek vacant possession of residential buildings for personal use.

metadata.title: The Punjab Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper management and administration of Waqf properties within the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Chief Administrator and Deputy Administrators to oversee these properties, defines key terms related to religious endowments, and outlines the appointment and control of government officials involved in this sector.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1978 by substituting specific clauses regarding lodging units and deleting a proviso in clause (e). It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on January 22, 1979, to take effect immediately.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958 to update its name from 'West Pakistan' to 'Pakistan'. It also adds provisions regarding the removal or termination of service for employees allocated under specific dissolution orders.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912 to address issues regarding fraud or misrepresentation in acquiring tenancy rights. It grants the Board of Revenue the authority to resume land or reduce its area if it is found that a person was not eligible for such rights due to fraud or other reasons.

name: FOODSTUFFS AND FERTILIZERS (CANCELLATION OF AUTHORIZATIONS AND DEALERSHIPS) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Foodstuffs and Fertilizers (Cancellation of Authorizations and Dealerships) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the cancellation of authorizations issued under the West Pakistan Foodstuffs Distribution Order, 1967, and dealerships granted under the Punjab Fertilizers (Control) Order, 1973. It empowers the Government of the Punjab to terminate these authorizations or dealerships without paying any compensation.

name: MURREE KAHUTA HILLY AREAS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Murree Kahuta Hilly Areas Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Murree Kahuta Hilly Areas Development Authority Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Murree Kahuta Hilly Areas Development Authority Act, 1975. It provides for the transfer of liabilities, rights, and obligations to the Government upon the dissolution of the Authority.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update definitions and licensing requirements. It introduces new provisions regarding the possession of the Pakistan Highway Code by drivers and license applicants, modifies conditions for vehicle registration in Tribal Areas, and adjusts clauses related to transport vehicles and license renewals.

name: PUNJAB AUTONOMOUS BODIES IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (EJECTMENT OF UN-AUTHORISED OCCUPANTS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Punjab Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Un-authorised Occupants) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Punjab Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Un-authorised Occupants) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Un-authorised Occupants) Ordinance, 1965. It clarifies definitions regarding unauthorised occupants and grants autonomous bodies the power to evict them using necessary force without paying compensation for certain structures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to amend the Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962. It specifically substitutes the word 'fifty' for 'twenty five' in Section 18(1)(a) of the original Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Corporation Employees (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance invests the Governor of the Punjab with special powers regarding persons in Corporation Service. It allows for the removal or reversion of specific employees appointed between January 1, 1972, and July 5, 1977, without notice, while providing mechanisms for representation and review.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of Punjab to amend the Punjab Finance Act, 1964. It comes into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: Section 5 of the Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to amend the existing Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1978. It specifically repeals Section 5 of that Ordinance with effect from July 1, 1978.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; The Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The Punjab Finance Act, 1964; The Punjab Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing acts to levy and enhance specific taxes and duties within the Province of the Punjab. It introduces rebates for lump-sum tax payments, adjusts duty rates on electricity consumption, modifies hotel tax structures based on room charges, and alters entertainment duty percentages.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Revenue (Abolition) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to restore certain provisions regarding land revenue liability for owners of specific land sizes. It repeals the Punjab Land Revenue (Abolition) Act, 1977, and substitutes sections 56-A and 70-A in the principal Act to define enhanced tax rates for landowners exceeding specified acreage limits.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to amend the Punjab Local Government Act, 1975. It specifically adds a new sub-section regarding the status of functionaries under the Local Council Service for the purposes of the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974.

metadata.title: The Punjab Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal measures for the prevention of gambling within the Province of Punjab. It defines terms such as 'common gaming house' and 'gaming', and establishes penalties for owning, operating, or participating in illegal gambling activities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the manufacture, sale, and consumption of intoxicating liquors in the Punjab province. It defines key terms such as 'intoxicating liquor', 'bottle', and 'manufacture' and establishes penalties for violations including imprisonment and fines.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 to clarify rules regarding the appointment of members as Chair and to update the Commission's functions. It specifically revises Section 6 concerning member appointments and substitutes new text for Section 7 detailing the Commission's duties in recruitment, advisory roles, and other prescribed functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Service Commission Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Punjab Public Service Commission Act, 1974 with certain modifications. It establishes the composition, terms of office, and functions of the Punjab Public Service Commission while outlining procedures for the appointment, removal, and ineligibility of its members.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF STAGE CARRIAGES (TEMPORARY POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Punjab Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970 to update terminology and procedures regarding vehicle requisition. It introduces specific compensation calculations based on depreciation and profit margins for owners whose vehicles are kept in possession by the District Magistrate.

metadata.title: The Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of a tax on lands in the Thal area where value has increased due to irrigation facilities. It defines terms such as 'Collector', 'Government', and 'Thal Canal', and outlines rules for tax imposition, demand preparation, recovery methods, exemptions, and rule-making powers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and continuance of local government institutions in Punjab. It consolidates existing laws relating to local government and amends them to address certain connected matters.

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959 to update definitions and procedures regarding rent control. It introduces new sections for appointing additional rent controllers, establishing criteria for fixing fair rent based on construction costs and local circumstances, and outlining processes for handling disputes and appeals.

name: THE UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE LYALLPUR (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Lyallpur (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture Lyallpur Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Agriculture Lyallpur Act, 1973. It substitutes the word 'Faisalabad' for 'Lyallpur' wherever it occurs in the amended Act.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Sixth Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to extend the tenure of Supreme Court and High Court Chief Justices who attain specific ages. It also modifies clauses regarding Tribal Areas and updates definitions within Article 260 related to parliamentary positions.

metadata.title: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1973. It extends to the whole of Pakistan and came into force on May 1, 1977.

name: LAND REFORMS (BALUCHISTAN PAT FEEDER CANAL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends paragraph 17 of the Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972 by substituting a specific date in clause (a) of the third proviso. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance, 1977.

metadata.title: The Labour Laws (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: certain laws relating to industrial relations and welfare of workers
metadata.repeals: The Labour Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act further amends various laws concerning industrial relations and the welfare of workers in Pakistan. It repeals the previous Labour Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977 and specifies detailed amendments to schedules and sections of existing acts such as the Workmen's Compensation Act, Factories Act, and Payment of Wages Act.

name: PUNJAB BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962, to insert new sections regarding restrictions on issuing diplomas and certificates. It establishes penalties for contravention of these rules and specifies who can take cognizance of offenses under the ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Provincial Legislature of Punjab that amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly on June 6, 1977, and received assent from the Governor on June 8, 1977.

name: PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Members of the National and Provincial Assemblies (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Amendment) Act, 1963; The Punjab Assembly Privileges Act, 1972; The North-West Frontier Province Assembly Privileges Act, 1973; The Sind Members' Assembly Privileges Act, 1975; The Baluchistan Provincial Assembly Privileges Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977 (XII of 1977)
metadata.summary: This Act amends several laws relating to the privileges of members of the National and Provincial Assemblies. It was enacted under the Proclamation of Emergency issued on April 21, 1977.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Abolition) Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1961; The Bahawalpur State Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1949; The Punjab Land Revenue (Abolition) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes land revenue in the Province of Punjab for the Rabi season starting from 1978-77. It repeals previous agricultural income tax acts and an earlier ordinance regarding the abolition of land revenue.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK, DAIRY AND POULTRY DEVELOPMENT BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board Act, 1974. It specifically substitutes Section 5 of the original Act to redefine the composition and appointment process for the Board's directors and non-official members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; The Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.repeals: Section 11 of the Punjab Finance Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act enhances the rates of certain taxes and duties in the Province of Punjab. It amends existing legislation regarding motor vehicle taxation, entertainment duties, and stamp duties while repealing specific sections of previous finance acts.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974. Specifically, it substitutes the number 'seventy-five' for 'twenty-five' in Section 7 of the amended Act.

name: PUNJAB MINOR MINERAL (CANCELLATION OF LEASES) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Minor Mineral (Cancellation of Leases) Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Minor Mineral (Cancellation of Leases) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the cancellation of certain mining leases of minor minerals in the Punjab Province. It terminates existing leases granted by officers or authorities other than the Deputy Commissioner through open auction, while excluding leases held by government departments or bodies established by law.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1966
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Requisitioning Ordinance No. IV of 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1966 by updating specific numerical values in Section 6. It also repeals the Punjab Requisitioning Ordinance No. IV of 1977.

metadata.title: The Punjab Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973 by substituting a new definition for 'small industries' in Section 2. The amendment specifies that small industries are engaged in handicrafts or the manufacture of consumer or producer goods where total fixed assets (excluding land) do not exceed thirty lacs rupees.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC SERIVCE COMMISSION EXAMINATION REFORMS ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission Examination Reforms Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to provide for the eradication of malpractices connected with examinations held by the Punjab Public Service Commission. It defines key terms such as candidate, examiner, and question paper, and prescribes punishments including imprisonment or fines for offenses like premature disclosure of questions, impersonation, and falsification of results.

metadata.title: The Punjab Soil Reclamation (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Soil Reclamation Act, 1952 to grant additional powers to the Administrator appointed under Section 78. Specifically, it allows the Administrator to perform functions and exercise powers of the Board for preparing new schemes, completing existing ones, levying fees, and recovering properties.

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887 by adding a new sub-section to Section 77. The amendment specifies that the limitation for suits mentioned in sub-section (3) of the Third Group shall be one year from the day the rent or money equivalent becomes due.

name: PUNJAB TENANCY (VALIDATION AND EXTENSION OF PERIOD FOR PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) Ordinance, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) Ordinance, 1989. It extends the deadline for occupying tenants to pay compensation for acquiring proprietary rights, substituting a new date for payment.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVEABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to liberalize tax relief for specific categories of property owners. It deletes a subsection regarding buildings occupied by owners for residence and substitutes new monetary limits in rating areas.

metadata.title: The Representation of the People (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Representation of the People Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Representation of the People (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Representation of the People Act, 1976 by inserting a new section granting the Election Commission powers to punish for contempt similar to those of a High Court. It also repeals the earlier Representation of the People (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977.

metadata.title: The Universities Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends laws relating to universities in the Punjab. It substitutes specific clauses regarding age limits in various university acts, such as those for Agriculture, Engineering, and Islamia University.

metadata.title: The Town Improvement (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Town Improvement Act, 1922 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1980 with the Punjab Local Government Act, 1978, and introduces new provisions regarding housing schemes and land requisition.

metadata.title: The Cholistan Development Authority Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Cholistan Development Authority to ensure the speedy development and better administration of the Cholistan area in the Bahawalpur Division. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its composition including ex-officio members, and sets rules for the appointment, tenure, and disqualification of the Managing Director.

metadata.title: The Antiquities Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Antiquities Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law relating to antiquities in Pakistan. It provides definitions for terms such as 'antiquity', 'dealer', and 'national monument', establishes an Advisory Committee, and outlines procedures for dispute resolution regarding the status of objects.

name: CONFORMITY WITH FUNDAMENTAL RIGHTS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT OF LAWS) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Conformity with Fundamental Rights (Punjab Amendment of Laws) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Conformity with Fundamental Rights (Punjab Ordinance No. VII of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain laws in the Province of Punjab to ensure conformity with fundamental rights. It specifically revises provisions regarding the registration of societies and the establishment/enlargement of industrial undertakings, introducing mechanisms for the supersession of governing bodies when they fail their duties or act against public interest.

metadata.title: The Islamia University of Bahawalpur (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975 by adding a new section regarding the recovery of dues. It authorizes the University or authorized persons to apply to the Collector for recovering sums due under any bond as if they were land revenue arrears.

name: CONFORMITY WITH FUNDAMENTAL RIGHTS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT OF LAWS) ORDINANCE, 1976

metadata.title: The Conformity with Fundamental Rights (Punjab Amendment of Laws) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: Registration Act, 1860; The Punjab Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends specific laws in the Punjab to ensure conformity with fundamental rights under Article 8 of the Constitution. It introduces provisions for the supersession of a society's governing body if it fails to discharge duties or acts contrary to public interest, and adds safeguards regarding industrial establishment applications.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to update definitions and expand the authority's powers. It introduces new clauses regarding managing directors and service areas while empowering the authority to initiate comprehensive development planning, manage water and sanitation systems, and undertake urban improvement schemes.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to facilitate immediate legislation as the Provincial Assembly was not in session. It introduces specific amendments regarding definitions, planning processes, and regulatory controls for urban development within the province.

name: PRIVATELY MANAGED SCHOOLS AND COLLEGES (TAKING OVER) (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972 to update provisions regarding school management and government permissions. It also repeals a previous Ordinance on the same subject matter.

name: PRIVATELY MANAGED SCHOOLS AND COLLEGES (TAKING OVER) (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1976

metadata.title: The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972. It introduces stricter conditions for closing, suspending, or transferring privately managed schools and colleges without prior government permission.

name: PUNJAB AUTONOMOUS BODIES IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (EJECTMENT OF UN-AUTHORISED OCCUPANTS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Un-authorised Occupants) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: The Punjab Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Un-authorised Occupants) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Un-authorised Occupants) Ordinance, 1965. It modifies Section 2 by omitting specific words and inserting a new sub-clause regarding the Punjab Government Servants Benevolent Fund.

metadata.title: The (Amendment) Punjab Civil Servants Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This document is a notification publishing an Ordinance to amend the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974. The Ordinance extends to the whole of the Punjab and came into force on November 22, 1976.

name: PUNJAB COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF TRANSPORTATION FEE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Transportation Fee) (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Transportation Fee) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance No. IV of 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Transportation Fee) Act, 1974. It deletes an existing proviso to section 2 and adds a new subsection regarding the refund or adjustment of fees not paid before the Act's commencement.

name: PUNJAB COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF TRANSPORTATION FEE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Transportation Fee) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: The Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Transportation Fee) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Transportation Fee) Act, 1974. It provides for the recovery of unpaid or adjusted transportation fees in accordance with specific provisions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive system for the planning and development of cities in the Punjab province to improve the quality of life. It creates an integrated approach for resource utilization, land management, and policies regarding housing, industry, traffic, health, education, and sanitation.

name: PUNJAB BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and establishes Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in the Punjab. It also consolidates the law relating to these boards and amends the previous West Pakistan Ordinance from 1968.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ordinance on Development of Cities, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a comprehensive framework for the development of cities in the Punjab province to improve the quality of life and ensure optimal resource utilization. It creates Development Authorities with specific powers to acquire property, plan infrastructure, and manage housing, traffic, health, education, water supply, sewerage, drainage, and waste disposal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development of Cities Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a comprehensive system for the development of cities in the Punjab province. It creates an Authority to manage resources and implement policies related to housing, industrial development, water supply, traffic, sewerage, health, and waste disposal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Punjab that amends the Punjab Finance Act, 1972. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly on June 28, 1976, and received assent from the Governor on the same day.

metadata.title: The Punjab Highways(Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Highways Ordinance, 1959 to address encroachments on highways and regulate the deposit of materials or erection of structures. It substitutes specific sections within the Principal Ordinance to clarify penalties, enforcement procedures by the Highway Authority, and restrictions on dumping waste.

metadata.title: The Punjab Highways (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Highways Ordinance, 1959 to address encroachments on highways and regulate industrial waste dumping. It renumbers specific clauses regarding structures and fences, substitutes sections concerning encroachment penalties and fee recovery, and updates departmental names within the ordinance.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956. It specifically adds a proviso to Section 3 to prohibit the requisitioning of buildings used for private educational institutions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce new clauses regarding definitions of irrigated and unirrigated land. It also establishes exemptions from land revenue for owners of small plots and introduces enhanced tax rates for owners of larger agricultural holdings.

metadata.title: The Punjab Seed Corporation Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Seed Corporation as a body corporate within the Province of the Punjab. It provides for the corporation's powers to acquire property, its administrative structure including a Board and Managing Director, and the registration of growers.

name: PUNJAB TENANCY (EXTENSION OF PERIOD FOR PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy (Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: The Punjab Tenancy (Validation of Compensation) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Tenancy (Validation of Compensation) Ordinance, 1969 to extend the period for payment of compensation. It applies to the whole of the Province of Punjab and comes into force immediately.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (VALIDATION OF TAX) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property (Validation of Tax) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940; The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of property tax under the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Acts of 1940 and 1958. It deems certain extended rating areas to have always been included within local authority limits for the purposes of these Acts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Seed Corporation Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Seed Corporation to handle the production, procurement, processing, and marketing of seeds within the Province of Punjab. It defines the corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines the constitution, powers, and management structure of the Board and the Managing Director.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to provide for the levy of tax in Cantonment areas. It introduces a new section regarding tax rates and modifies existing sections to apply these changes to assessments made under the new provisions.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1976

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to introduce new tax levies on buildings and lands in cantonment areas. It establishes specific annual value thresholds for taxation and adds provisions regarding assessments made before July 1, 1975.

metadata.title: The Universities Laws Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973; The University of Agriculture Lyallpur Act, 1973; The University of Engineering and Technology Lahore Act, 1974; The Multan University Act, 1975; The Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Universities Laws Ordinance, 1976 (Punjab Ordinance No.X of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Act amends various university laws in the Punjab to update provisions regarding retirement ages for teachers and officers. It specifically substitutes new clauses in five different university acts to standardize age limits for service.

metadata.title: The Universities Laws Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: The Punjab Laws relating to the Universities
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab laws relating to universities to update retirement age provisions for teachers and officers. It substitutes specific clauses in various university acts to standardize the completion of age requirements for retirement.

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture, Lyallpur (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture, Lyallpur Act, 1971
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Agriculture, Lyallpur Act, 1971 by adding a new section regarding the recovery of university dues. It empowers the University or authorized persons to apply to the Collector for recovering sums due as if they were land revenue arrears.

metadata.title: The Seed Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for controlling and regulating the quality of seeds of various varieties of crops in Pakistan. It establishes bodies such as the National Seed Council, Federal Seed Certification Agency, and National Registration Agency to oversee seed standards, certification, and grower registration.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The University of Engineering & Technology, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The University of Engineering & Technology, Lahore Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Engineering & Technology, Lahore Act, 1974. It introduces a new section regarding the recovery of university dues by treating them as land revenue arrears.

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of the Punjab Act, 1973 by adding a new section regarding the recovery of university dues. It authorizes the University or any authorized person to apply to the Collector for recovering sums due under bonds or land revenue arrears.

metadata.title: The Basic Democracies Order (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Basic Democracies Order, 1959 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. Specifically, it substitutes 'sixty per centum' for 'fifty per centum' in Article 59 regarding local rates.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to address various provisions regarding the National Assembly, High Court powers, and economic reforms. It includes specific changes to articles concerning reserved seats, defamation, preventive detention orders, and the composition of the National Assembly.

metadata.summary: This document is a corrigendum published in the Punjab Extraordinary Gazette on March 5, 1975. It provides specific textual corrections to The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 1974, including changes to dates, spelling errors, and punctuation within various sections.

name: CORRIGENDUM IN THE LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Development Authority Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This document serves as a corrigendum issued by the Punjab Government to correct typographical, grammatical, and punctuation errors in The Punjab Development Authority Act, 1975. It provides specific instructions on how to read corrected words and figures across various sections and pages of the original Act.

name: CORRIGENDUM IN THE MURREE KAHUTA HILLY AREAS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.summary: This document serves as a corrigendum published in the Punjab Gazette on May 22, 1975. It contains specific textual corrections and amendments to several Ordinances enacted earlier that same year regarding salaries, allowances, privileges, and education boards.

It specifies precise changes to be made on specific pages and lines of the original ordinance, including word substitutions, deletions, and reordering of text.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) ACT, 1975
