metadata.repeals: Claims (Displaced Persons) Act, 1956; Pakistan Rehabilitation Act, 1956; Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Act, 1957; Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958; Settlement Act, 1958; Scrutiny of Claims (Evacuee Property) Regulation, 1961; Price of Evacuee Property and Public Dues (Recovery) Regulation, 1971
metadata.summary: This Act repeals several existing laws and regulations related to evacuee property and the rehabilitation of displaced persons in Pakistan. It also provides for the transfer of pending proceedings to provincial authorities and outlines schemes for the disposal of urban and rural properties.

metadata.title: The Canal (Punjab Amendment) and Drainage Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to further regulate water supply and drainage in the Province of Punjab. It introduces new definitions for water outlets and internal khal, establishes irrigation committees, and outlines procedures for changing water sources or aligning link water-courses.

metadata.title: The Islamia University of Bahawalpur (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975 by adding a new sub-section to section 11. The amendment stipulates that the Chancellor must act and be bound in the same manner as the Governor of the Province under Article 105 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Federal Adaptation of Laws Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This Order makes necessary adaptations to existing laws in force immediately before the commencement day to bring them into accord with the Constitution. It directs specific substitutions and omissions of terms such as 'Central' to 'Federal' and defines appropriate government references for national versus provincial matters.

metadata.title: The Islamia University of Bahawalpur Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamia University at Bahawalpur with an autonomous status to impart religious knowledge and improve teaching facilities. It provides for the university's corporate structure, including its Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and Vice-Chancellor, and transfers properties from the previous Jamia Bahawalpur Ordinance.

name: LAHORE WATER AND SEWERAGE AUTHORITY ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Lahore Water and Sewerage Authority Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Water and Sewerage Authority as a body corporate to facilitate the construction, supply, improvement, expansion, operation, and maintenance of water, sewerage, and drainage services. It defines the composition of the Authority, including members from local committees, the provincial assembly, and various government departments, and outlines the appointment and qualifications of the Managing Director.

metadata.title: The Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore Development Authority to improve the quality of life in the metropolitan area of Lahore. It provides for an integrated approach to planning resources and ensuring effective utilization for housing, industrial development, traffic, transportation, health, education, water supply, sewerage, drainage, solid waste disposal, and related matters.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972. It was enacted by Parliament and received the President's assent on April 17, 1975.

name: MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY (EXEMPTION FROM PREVENTIVE DETENTION AND PERSONAL APPEARANCE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Members of the National Assembly (Exemption from Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Members of the National Assembly (Exemption from Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Members of the National Assembly (Exemption from Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) Ordinance, 1963. It substitutes specific clauses regarding when exemption from detention applies to Members during session breaks or for reasons of State.

metadata.title: The Multan University (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Multan University Act, 1975 to update provisions regarding university governance and employment conditions. It introduces new powers for the Chancellor concerning teacher transfers and appointments, modifies rules on Statute drafting by the Syndicate, and revises retirement terms for university officers.

name: MURREE KAHUTA HILLY AREAS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Murree-Kahuta Hilly Areas Development Authority Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Murree-Kahuta Hilly Areas Development Authority to oversee the development of hilly areas in the Tehsils of Rawalpindi, excluding the Federal Capital Area. The Authority is granted powers to prepare and enforce schemes for agriculture, industry, forest conservation, irrigation, housing, tourism, and urban renewal, as well as the power to acquire and dispose of property.

metadata.title: The Police (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Police (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Act, 1861 as it applies to the Province of the Punjab. Specifically, it inserts the phrase 'compulsorily retire' into section 7 after the word 'dismiss'. The Act also repeals the Police (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1975.

metadata.title: The Police (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Act, 1861 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. Specifically, it inserts the word 'dismiss' after 'compulsorily retire' in section 7 of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Political Parties (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Political Parties (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Political Parties Act, 1962 to align its provisions with the Constitution of Pakistan. It introduces restrictions on party formation regarding sovereignty and integrity, establishes a mechanism for dissolving parties prejudicial to national security, and omits several existing sections.

metadata.title: The Punjab Administrative Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Administrative Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Administrative Tribunals Act, 1974 to update provisions regarding the establishment and jurisdiction of Service Tribunals. It specifically substitutes sections related to tribunal composition, appointment terms, and appeal procedures concerning civil servants' service conditions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Administrative Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Administrative Tribunals Act, 1974 to update terminology and restructure tribunal composition and jurisdiction. It establishes specific procedures for appeals regarding civil servants' terms of service, disciplinary matters, and appointments, while deleting previous sections from the principal Act.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT AND SUPPLIES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation Act, 1973 to empower the Managing Director to recover dues from defaulters as arrears of land revenue. It also repeals the corresponding Ordinance passed in 1975.

metadata.title: The Multan University Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Multan to provide teaching and research facilities in the region. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and various councils, while granting powers to award degrees and conduct examinations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to specify conditions under which civil servants shall retire from service. It also repeals the earlier Ordinance regarding this subject.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to update provisions regarding the retirement of civil servants. It specifies conditions for retirement based on public interest directions, completion of twenty-five years of service, or reaching the age of fifty-eight.

name: PUNJAB COUNCIL OF THE ARTS ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Council of the Arts Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Council of the Arts to provide patronage and promote arts and culture within the province. It outlines the functions of the Executive Committee, funding sources, and powers regarding the takeover of organizations mismanaging cultural affairs.

name: PUNJAB COUNCIL OF THE ARTS ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Council of the Arts Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Council of the Arts to promote and develop arts and culture in the province. It defines the composition of the Board of Governors and the Executive Committee, outlining their powers and functions for managing the Council's affairs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Ordinance No. X of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1973 by substituting Section 10 regarding cognizable and non-bailable offences and adding a new section 12-A concerning government power to make additions to the Schedule. It also repeals Ordinance No. X of 1975.

name: PUNJAB BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1961; The West Pakistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Multan and Sargodha) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and establishes new Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in the Punjab, including locations at Gujranwala, Bahawalpur, and Rawalpindi. It also amends and consolidates existing laws relating to these educational boards.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1975
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965; West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Section 10 of the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and fees in the Province of the Punjab. It amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to adjust stamp duties on agricultural land and other property transactions, repeals a specific section of the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965, and modifies provisions regarding urban immovable property tax.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING FACILITIES FOR NON-PROPRIETORS IN RURAL AREAS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Housing Facilities for the Non-Proprietors in Rural Areas (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.amends: The Punjab Housing Facilities for the Non-Proprietors in Rural Areas Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Housing Facilities for the Non-Proprietors in Rural Areas Act, 1975. Specifically, it inserts a new provision regarding land acquisition under the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973.

metadata.title: The Punjab Improvement Tax Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of improvement tax on certain lands in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Land', 'Local Area', and 'Tax' and applies to lands situated in specified local areas.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING FACILITIES FOR NON-PROPRIETORS IN RURAL AREAS ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Non-Proprietors Housing Facilities Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for housing facilities to non-proprietary persons in the rural areas of the Punjab Province. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'non-proprietor', 'urban area', and 'housing scheme', and outlines the process for preparing housing schemes and acquiring land for residential sites.

metadata.title: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Mineral Development Corporation to promote mineral development within the province. It defines the corporation as a body corporate with powers to acquire property and sue, while placing its general administration under the direction of the Board of Directors.

name: PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Ministers of the Punjab. It establishes specific financial rates for ministers, including equipment allowances, sumptuary allowances, and official residence provisions.

name: PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of Ministers in the Punjab. It establishes specific salary rates, defines terms related to official residences and family maintenance, and outlines entitlements for travel and transport expenses.

name: PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION (REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Removal of Difficulties) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Removal of Difficulties) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the removal of difficulties regarding the rights of refugee females who were erroneously treated as full owners instead of limited owners of property allotted to them. It extends the benefit of Supreme Court views to persons aggrieved by such errors and allows affected parties to challenge past decrees or orders within one year of the Act's commencement.

name: PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION (REMOVAL OF DIFFICULTIES) ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Removal of Difficulties) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance addresses legal difficulties regarding limited estates allotted to refugee females in the Punjab, correcting the erroneous treatment of them as full owners. It extends the benefits of a Supreme Court decision confirming these allottees as limited owners under custom and allows affected proceedings to be decided afresh within one year.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 5, 1975, and received assent from the Governor on March 31, 1975.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SPEAKER (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It details specific financial entitlements including monthly salary, transport costs, official residence usage, and travel benefits.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SPEAKER (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SPEAKER (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'family', 'official residence', and 'maintenance' within the context of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Tenancy Amendment Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Tenancy Act of 1887. It extends to the whole of the Province of Punjab and comes into force immediately.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SPEAKER (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It details specific financial entitlements, official residence provisions, and travel benefits available to the office holder.

name: PUNJAB TENANCY (REMOVAL OF DOUBTS AND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887 to remove doubts regarding the extinction of mugarraridari tenancies. It substitutes district names in specific clauses and adds new sections to regulate the acquisition or extinguishment of these rights following a previous Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Thal Development (Amendment) Act, 1975

It also extends the Act's application to specific districts and repeals a previous Ordinance from 1975.

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Lyallpur (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture Lyallpur Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Agriculture Lyallpur Act, 1973 to update provisions regarding staff appointments, transfer conditions, and syndicate authority. It specifically revises rules on retirement dates for officers and teachers based on years of service or age.

name: UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE LYALIPUR (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.amends: The University of Agriculture, Lyallpur Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Agriculture, Lyallpur Act, 1973. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on March 12, 1975.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The University of Engineering and Technology Lahore (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The University of Engineering and Technology Lahore Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Engineering and Technology Lahore Act, 1974 to update provisions regarding university governance and employment. It grants the Chancellor authority over teacher services and modifies rules concerning the Syndicate's power to draft statutes affecting university authorities.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore (Second Amendment) Act, 1975

metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore Act, 1974 by adding a new subsection to section 10. The amendment stipulates that the Chancellor must act and be bound in all matters as the Governor of a Province acts under Article 105 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab (Amendment) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The University of Multan (Second Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the University of Multan Act, 1975 to modify territorial limits, election procedures for teachers and assembly members, and provisions for recovering university dues. It also introduces new sections regarding a transitional Chancellor's Committee and the saving of existing statutes.

name: UNIVERSITY OF THE PUNJAB (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab (Second Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of the Punjab Act, 1973 to further regulate the performance of the Chancellor's functions. It adds a new sub-section to Section 48 of the parent Act, binding the Chancellor to act in accordance with the Constitution of Pakistan.

name: UNIVERSITY OF THE PUNJAB (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab (Second Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of the Punjab Act, 1973 to further regulate the performance of the Chancellor's functions. It adds a new sub-section to Section 48 of the parent Act, binding the Chancellor to act in accordance with the Constitution of Pakistan.

name: WEST PAKISTAN EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to apply it to the Province of Punjab. It specifically adds a new provision regarding survivor's pensions for deceased persons with dependents.

metadata.title: The Punjab West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This document is a notification publishing an Act passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It amends the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958, to apply its provisions to the Province of Punjab.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WELFARE FUND (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Employees Welfare Fund (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Punjab. It introduces a new subsection to Section 5 to provide for death compensation in cases caused by civil war or invasion.

name: WEST PAKISTAN JAMIA ISLAMIA BAHAWALPUR (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Jamia Islamia Bahawalpur (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Jamia Islamia Bahawalpur Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Jamia Islamia Bahawalpur Ordinance, 1964. It substitutes specific department names and official titles within various sections of the original Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, specifically regarding procedures for dealing with land revenue arrears. It substitutes section 82 to clarify the issuance of arrest warrants against defaulters after a notice period and deletes the existing sub-section (2) of that section.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Punjab Ordinance No. VIII of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific provisions in the Third Schedule regarding tax rates for motor vehicles plying for hire within Corporation, Municipality, or Cantonment limits based on seating capacity.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to apply it to the Province of the Punjab. It specifically substitutes the composition of the Board under Section 70 of the Ordinance with a new list of eleven members and their appointing authorities.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 as it applies to the Punjab province. It specifically alters tax rates for motor vehicles plying for hire exclusively within city limits based on seating capacity.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'fourteenth' for 'twelfth' in Section 2, Clause (a) of the said Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVEABLE PROPERTY TAX (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immoveable Property Tax (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Immoveable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Urban Immoveable Property Tax Act, 1958 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific wording regarding property vesting and ownership within the relevant sections of the parent Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ordinance
metadata.summary: This document is an extraordinary issue published by the Government of the Punjab Law Department on November 20, 1974. It appears to be an ordinance containing specific administrative instructions or amendments regarding local divisions and jurisdictions within the province.

metadata.title: The Basic Democracies Order (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Basic Democracies Order, 1959, as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific clauses regarding definitions for 'Town', 'Town Committee', 'Union', and 'Union Committee' within Article 13 and adds new clauses to Article 18 concerning the division of urban or rural areas.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It also repeals the earlier Ordinance passed on the same subject matter.

metadata.title: The Constitution (Second Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to include specific groups in Article 106 and to define who is not considered a Muslim under the Constitution. It adds new clauses regarding the finality of Prophethood and the definition of a non-Muslim for legal purposes.

metadata.title: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a cost of living allowance to employees in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'undertaking' while specifying the calculation rates for the allowance based on wage levels.

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Municipal Administration Ordinance No. IV of 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960, as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It specifically addresses issues regarding encroachments on public spaces and buildings vested in Municipal Committees, including procedures for removal and associated penalties.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rangers (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the West Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 by substituting 'Pakistan Rangers' for 'West Pakistan Rangers' and changing references from 'Central' to 'Federal'. It received the President's assent on April 8, 1975, and came into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Punjab Administrative Tribunals Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Administrative Tribunals to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters regarding the terms and conditions of service for employees in the Punjab Province. It outlines the qualifications, appointment procedures, tenure, and resignation processes for the Chairman and Members of these tribunals.

name: PUNJAB ANIMALS COMPOUND FEEDING STUFF ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Animals Compound Feeding Stuff Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture and marketing of animal compound feeding stuffs in the Province of the Punjab. It defines key terms such as adulterated and misbranded feeding stuffs and establishes a licensing system for manufacturers.

name: PUNJAB COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF TRANSPORTATION FEE) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton Control (Validation of Transportation Fee) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of transportation fees under the West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949, and the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Act, 1949. It applies to the whole of the Punjab and deems any such fees levied before this Act came into force as validly collected.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Punjab Finance Act, 1973; The West Pakistan Urban Property Tax Act, 1958; The West Pakistan Entertainment Duty Act, 1958; The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: section 8 of the West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and fees in the Province of the Punjab. It amends previous legislation regarding cotton ginning licences, property tax rates, and entertainment duties while repealing a specific section of an earlier ordinance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment to and terms of service for civil servants in the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'civil servant', 'ad hoc appointment', and 'probation', and establishes the procedures for initial recruitment, promotion, transfer, and confirmation.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK, DAIRY AND POULTRY DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board to manage livestock, dairy, and poultry projects in the public sector within the province. The legislation defines the Board as a corporate body with perpetual succession and outlines its constitution, powers, and the roles of its directors.

name: PUNJAB PLANTATION AND MAINTENANCE OF TREES ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Plantation and Maintenance of Trees Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the plantation and maintenance of trees in the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Department', 'Government', 'land', 'occupier', and 'plantation', and mandates that occupiers must plant and maintain a specific number of trees on their land.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of members of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Member', 'session', and 'period of residence on duty' and establishes rules regarding salary eligibility based on attendance and holding offices of profit.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1973 (Punjab Ordinance No. XVIII of 1973)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Public Service Commission for the Province of Punjab consisting of five members. It outlines the functions of the Commission, including conducting recruitment tests and advising on service terms, while also defining the tenure and resignation procedures for its members.

name: PUNJAB TENDOO LEAVES (PROHIBITION ON POSSESSION AND USE IN THE BORDER BELT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use in the Border-Belt) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Ordinance No. XXII of 1973
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the manufacture, possession, and use of tendoo leaves within the border-belt of the Punjab province. It defines specific terms related to the border area and tendoo leaves used for bidi production and establishes penalties for violations.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERATION AND MANAGEMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of wildlife in the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Wildlife Management Board and defines various terms related to wild animals, officers, and protected areas.

metadata.title: The Punjab Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1974
metadata.summary: This Order adapts existing provincial laws to bring them into accord with the Constitution of Pakistan. It substitutes specific terms like 'Central' with 'Federal' and 'West Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' across various acts.

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of the Punjab Act, 1973 to allow for exceptions in appointment qualifications. It enables the Chancellor to relax standard requirements based on outstanding scholarship or contribution to learning in individual cases.

metadata.title: The Weights and Measures (Metric System) (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Weights and Measures (Metric System) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Weights and Measures (Metric System) Act, 1967 to align terminology with international standards. It substitutes specific words such as 'International' for 'Metric' and updates definitions related to substance amounts and time duration.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Arms (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 to update terminology from 'West Pakistan' to 'Pakistan' and 'Central Government' to 'Federal Government'. It grants the Federal Government specific powers to prohibit certain arms and ammunition via notification and to issue licenses for non-prohibited weapons across the whole of Pakistan.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore, Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession to improve teaching, research, and administration while safeguarding its autonomy.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Finance (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. Specifically, it substitutes 'twenty paisa' for 'twelve paisa' in certain subsections regarding tax rates. The Act also repeals the earlier West Pakistan Finance (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1974.

metadata.title: Workers' Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workers' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971 to substitute 'Federal Government' for 'Central Government' and to amend sections regarding the Governing Body. It also inserts a new section on vesting of funds and adds Chapter IIIA to establish Workers' Welfare Boards for managing allocated money and projects.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Arms (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 by substituting 'Pakistan' for 'West Pakistan' and 'Federal Government' for 'Central Government'. It grants the Federal Government exclusive power to issue licenses for prohibited bore weapons while allowing Provincial Governments to license non-prohibited weapons.

name: ASSISTANT SETTLEMENT COMMISSIONERS VALIDATION OF ORDERS ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Assistant Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain orders passed by Assistant Settlement Commissioners during the period of the Interim Constitution and Emergency. It declares these orders valid despite the lack of delegated powers to such commissioners, overriding any conflicting court decrees or previous acts.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972, specifically regarding its application to the Province of the Punjab. It substitutes specific figures and clauses within the original Order to update committee management procedures and election timelines.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972, specifically regarding the Province of Punjab. It substitutes clauses in Article 5 to establish procedures for superseding committees and appointing administrators when member numbers fall below a certain threshold.

name: CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (REFORMS) ORDER (PUNJAB SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Act, Order (Punjab Second Amendment)
metadata.summary: This document is an Order passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to amend the Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972. It specifically updates the application date range for elections within the province and validates rights accrued before its enforcement.

metadata.title: The Constitution Eighth Amendment Order, 1973
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 246 of the Constitution of Pakistan by omitting specific clauses and paragraphs. It was promulgated by President Zulfikar Ali Bhutto on May 17, 1973, and came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.title: The Constitution Eleventh Amendment Order, 1973
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 201 of the Constitution of Pakistan to include members of the Defence Services and persons subject to their laws in the list of eligible judges. It was promulgated by President Zulfikar Ali Bhutto on July 2, 1973, and came into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Constitution Ninth Amendment Order, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 56 of the Constitution of Pakistan to correct the titles of military chiefs. Specifically, it substitutes 'Chief of Staff' with 'Chief of the Staff' for the Army, Navy, and Air Force.

name: CONSTITUTION OF THE ISLAMIC REPLIC OF PAKISTAN PART-I

metadata.title: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document is a notification published in the Gazette of Pakistan on April 12, 1973, authenticating the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. It outlines the structure of the state, fundamental rights, principles of policy, and provisions regarding the federation, parliament, and government.

name: CONSTITUTION OF THE ISLAMIC REPLIC OF PAKISTAN PART-III

metadata.title: The Supreme Court and High Courts Act
metadata.summary: This document outlines the powers of the Supreme Court to issue directions and review its own judgments, establishing that its decisions on questions of law are binding on all courts in Pakistan. It further details the composition, appointment qualifications, tenure, and jurisdiction of High Courts, including provisions for common High Courts between provinces.

name: CONSTITUTION OF THE ISLAMIC REPLIC OF PAKISTAN PART-IV

metadata.title: The Constitution (Eighth Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document outlines provisions for the first National and Provincial Assemblies under the Constitution, including rules for filling casual vacancies and oath requirements. It also specifies the composition and term limits for the Senate during the interim period before the first general election.

metadata.title: The Constitution Seventh Amendment Order, 1973
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 9 of the Interim Constitution of Pakistan regarding fundamental rights. Specifically, it adds a proviso to clause (1) of Article 9 to exclude persons arrested or detained under preventive detention laws prior to the commencement day from certain applications of that clause.

metadata.title: The Constitution Tenth Amendment Order, 1973
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Constitution of Pakistan by omitting clause (1) of Article 109 and inserting a new Article 131A regarding budgetary provisions. It grants the Governor authority to prepare annual budget statements and authorize expenditure when the Provincial Assembly is not in session for the financial year ending June 30, 1974.

metadata.title: The Constitution Thirteenth Amendment Order, 1973
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Fourth Schedule of the Constitution of Pakistan by updating entries in the Provincial and Concurrent Legislative Lists. Specifically, it substitutes references to various Land Reforms Regulations from 1972 into the relevant legislative lists.

metadata.title: The Constitution Twelfth Amendment Order, 1973
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Constitution of Pakistan to implement provisions related to land reforms and legislative lists. It specifically modifies Article 279 and the Fourth Schedule regarding Provincial and Concurrent Legislative Lists.

metadata.title: Federal Security Force Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and regulation of the Federal Security Force in Pakistan. It outlines the force's functions, including assisting civil administration in maintaining law and order and supporting police operations.

name: GREATER LAHORE WATER SUPPLY, SEWERAGE AND DRAINAGE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Ordinance, 1967
metadata.repeals: The Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage (Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Ordinance, 1967. It adds new provisions regarding regulations for material maintenance, accounts, and procedures, while simultaneously repealing a previous amendment ordinance from 1973.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972 to regulate land transfers and gifts, particularly regarding heirs and widowed sisters. It also grants additional land possession rights to owners of agricultural tractors or tubewells while restricting those who already hold significant land areas.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972, to establish a Federal Land Commission and modify various paragraphs regarding government powers and definitions. It substitutes specific text in the regulation to replace references to the President with the Federal Government and adds new provisions for dispute resolution and uniform policy implementation.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION NO. 118 (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Martial Law Regulation No. 118 (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Ordinances Temporary Enactment Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends Martial Law Regulation No. 118 specifically for its application to the Province of Punjab. It deletes specific paragraphs regarding privately managed educational institutions and substitutes new provisions defining asset ownership, while also repealing a previous ordinance that enacted similar provisions.

metadata.title: The Mines (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Mines Act, 1923 to improve safety standards and working conditions in mines. It introduces new provisions regarding canteens, shelters, first-aid rooms, and secrecy of complaint sources while modifying existing sections related to health, flooding, and fire hazards.

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Municipal Administration (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960 as it applies to the Province of the Punjab. Specifically, it omits certain words regarding the Electoral College Act from section 7 of the Ordinance and repeals the previous Municipal Administration (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973.

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Municipal Administration (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960 as it applies to the Province of the Punjab. Specifically, it omits certain words regarding the Electoral College Act from section 7 of the Ordinance and repeals the previous Municipal Administration (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973.

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960 to apply specifically to the Province of the Punjab. It grants the Administrator specific powers regarding the disposal of rights, liabilities, properties, and assets of the Authority, as well as the writing off of losses.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Citizenship (Second Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951 by inserting a new section 14B. The new provision addresses the status of persons who migrated from Jammu and Kashmir to Pakistan with the intention of residing there.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972. It specifically modifies section 2 to add provisions regarding premises notified by the Speaker.

metadata.title: The Punjab (Multan) Timber Market Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Ordinance (Multan) No. XXIV of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions for the Timber Market in Multan, regulating business operations and land allotments within the municipal limits. It defines specific terms related to timber and furniture manufacturing while establishing penalties for contravention of its rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973 to update definitions regarding housing schemes and kachi abadi improvements. It introduces restrictions on land owners receiving developed sites in lieu of compensation for specific facility-based acquisitions while allowing cash payments for the balance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Amendment Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973 to clarify definitions regarding housing schemes and kachi abadi improvements. It introduces provisions allowing land owners to receive developed sites in lieu of cash compensation for specific acquisition purposes, while mandating full cash payment if the land is acquired solely for health, education, or utility services.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.amends: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973 to update definitions regarding housing schemes and katchi abadi improvements. It also introduces restrictions on land owners receiving multiple developed sites in lieu of compensation for such improvements.

name: PUNJAB ACQUISITION OF LAND (HOUSING) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Second Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973 to expand the definition of Official Development Agencies. It includes autonomous bodies, local councils, and town improvement trusts within this definition while establishing conditions for government oversight and penalties for non-compliance.

name: PUNJAB ACQUISITION OF LAND (HOUSING) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1973

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.amends: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973 by altering punctuation and adding provisions regarding organizations declared as Official Development Organizations. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on September 10, 1973, as the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the acquisition of land in the Province of Punjab specifically for housing schemes in both urban and rural areas. It outlines procedures for public notification, surveying land, determining compensation, and defining key terms related to administration and infrastructure.

metadata.title: The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of land in both urban and rural areas of the Punjab Province specifically for housing schemes. It establishes procedures for public notification, surveying, marking boundaries, and determining compensation for affected landowners.

metadata.title: The Punjab Administrative Tribunals Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Administrative Tribunals in the Province of Punjab to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants. It defines the composition of these tribunals, outlines the process for filing appeals against departmental orders, and grants the tribunals powers similar to civil courts.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT AND SUPPLIES CORPORATION ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Agricultural Development and Supplies Corporation to increase agricultural production in the province. It also facilitates the transfer of business, projects, and properties from the dissolved West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation to the Punjab government.

metadata.title: The Punjab Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides powers to regulate and control the production, acquisition, distribution, prices, storage, and movement of certain essential articles in the Province of the Punjab. It authorizes the Government to issue orders for fixing prices, regulating trade, prohibiting withholding from sale, and collecting information to ensure equitable availability.

metadata.title: The Punjab Essential Articles (Control) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides powers to the Government of the Punjab to control the production, acquisition, supply, prices, and distribution of certain essential articles within the province. It authorizes the issuance of orders to regulate trade, commerce, and consumption while ensuring the availability of essential goods in the public interest.

metadata.title: The Punjab Fertilizers (Control) Order, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a regulatory framework for the import, production, sale, and distribution of fertilizers within the Punjab province. It defines key terms such as dealer, importer, and producer, and grants the Controller powers to fix prices, specify authorized dealers, limit stock quantities, and require detailed information on imports and production costs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Flood Relief Cess Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Finance Act, 1973 to specify new rates for a flood relief cess levied on cinema tickets and race course admissions during the financial year 1973-74. It also repeals the earlier Punjab Flood Relief Cess Ordinance, 1973.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ordinance (Finance Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance issued by the Governor of Punjab to amend the Punjab Finance Act, 1973. It was promulgated on September 19, 1973, and applies to the whole of the province.

name: CONSTITUTION OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF PAKISTAN 1973

metadata.title: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document is the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, enacted by the National Assembly and authenticated by the President on April 12, 1973. It establishes the framework for the state, defining the roles of the Federal and Provincial governments, legislative procedures, financial arrangements, and the distribution of powers between different levels of administration.

metadata.title: The Punjab Flood Relief Cess Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a flood relief cess in the Province of the Punjab. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly and assented to by the Governor on November 23, 1973.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1951; The Bahawalpur Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1949; The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965; The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; The Court-fees Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and fees in the Province of the Punjab. It amends several existing laws, including those related to agricultural income tax, motor vehicle taxation, urban immovable property tax, and court fees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Development Board Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Industrial Development Board to manage, control, and run industries in the public sector within the province. It defines the Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its constitution, including the appointment of a Chairman, Directors, and a Managing Director.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Development Board Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Industrial Development Board to manage and control industries in the public sector within Punjab. It defines the Board's corporate status, composition, appointment procedures for its Chairman and Managing Director, and outlines its administrative powers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Ordinances Temporary Enactment Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary enactment of provisions from certain Ordinances promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab. It ensures these ordinances continue in operation for six months after they cease to operate under Article 135 of the Interim Constitution, while validating all actions taken under them.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK, DAIRY AND POULTRY DEVELOPMENT BOARD ORDINANCE, 1973

metadata.title: The Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board to manage, control, and develop projects in livestock, dairy, and poultry sectors within the Punjab. It defines the Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its constitution, including the roles of the Chairman, Managing Director, and non-official members.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Public Service Commission for the Province of Punjab to conduct recruitment tests and examinations. It also empowers the Governor to make rules for carrying out the purposes of the Ordinance and defines the composition, term of office, and functions of the Commission.

name: PUNJAB TENDOO LEAVES (PROHIBITION ON POSSESSION AND USE IN THE BORDER-BELT) ORDINANCE, 1973

metadata.title: The Punjab Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use in the Border-belt) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the possession and use of tendoo leaves in the border-belt of the Punjab Province, including the manufacture of bidi. It defines key terms such as 'border-belt' and 'tendoo leaf', establishes penalties for contravention, and outlines procedures for prosecution and rule-making.

metadata.title: The Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Small Industries Corporation to succeed the business and properties of the defunct West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation. It provides for the development of small, cottage, and other industries within the Province of Punjab.

name: ROAD TRANSPORT CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN) REMOVAL OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965 to apply it to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific terms within the Ordinance and repeals a previous 1972 Amendment Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It adds new clauses defining 'Public Office' and 'Public Officer' to include various government bodies, commercial concerns, and co-operative societies.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Thal Development (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Thal Development (Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Thal Development Act, 1949 by substituting clauses regarding appeals and adding provisions for the disposal of assets and liabilities upon the dissolution of the Authority. It also grants specific powers to the Administrator regarding writing off losses and defines the vesting of remaining properties in the Government.

metadata.title: The Thal Development (Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Thal Development Act, 1949 to add new regulations regarding drainage in the Greater Lahore Water and Sewerage Trust. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) ORDINANCE, 1973

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of wildlife in the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Wildlife Management Board and defines key terms such as game animal, protected animal, and trophy.

metadata.title: The University of Agriculture Lyallpur Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The University of Agriculture Lyallpur Ordinance, 1973 (Punjab Ordinance II of 1973)
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the West Pakistan Agricultural University at Lyallpur to improve teaching, research, and administration. It establishes the University of Agriculture at Lyallpur as a body corporate with defined structures including a Chancellor, Syndicate, Senate, and Academic Council.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Arms (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Arms (Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 by changing the punishment term for certain offenses from three years to seven years and adding specific provisos regarding heavy weapons. It also omits clause (a) of section 14 in the said Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 1973

metadata.title: West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 by modifying provisions regarding sickness benefits and financial limits. It also repeals the earlier West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972.

name: WEST PAKISTAN EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific terms within related ordinances and rules to reflect changes in organizational names and titles.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to replace the Road Transport Corporation with the Punjab Road Transport Board in the Province of the Punjab. It details the new composition of the Board and stipulates that the Corporation continues to function until the Board is established.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRESS AND PUBLICATIONS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Press and Publications (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance (Punjab Amendment) of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It specifically alters provisions regarding temporary changes in newspaper publication locations by extending the approval timeframe from 24 hours to 72 hours. Additionally, the Act repeals the earlier West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance (Punjab Amendment) of 1972.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PREVENTION OF GAMBLING (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961 to apply specifically to the Province of Punjab. It inserts specific words regarding horse-races and grey-hound track races into section 3 of the parent Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PREVENTION OF GANBLING (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961, as it applies to the Province of Punjab. Specifically, it inserts a reference to 'grey-hound track race' alongside 'horse-race' in section 3, clause (b) of the parent Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TANDOO LEAVES (PROHIBITION ON POSSESSION AND USE) (PUNJAB REPEAL) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tandoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) (Punjab Repeal) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Tandoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the West Pakistan Tandoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966 specifically within its application to the Province of the Punjab. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on December 16, 1973.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Code Amendment (Criminal Procedure) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, as it applies to the Province of Punjab. It specifically restricts officers from issuing documents requiring the production of bank accounts or conducting searches in banks without prior written permission from the High Court.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968 to apply it to the Province of Punjab. It modifies specific sections regarding offences and adds a proviso concerning cases where the Deputy Commissioner deems it necessary to entrust a case to a court in accordance with applicable law.

name: GREATER LAHORE WATER SUPPLY, SEWERAGE AND DRAINAGE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Ordinance, 1967. It specifically adds a proviso to clause 4 regarding staff members opting for different applicable employment rules.

metadata.title: The University of the Punjab Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The University of the Punjab Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act re-constitutes and re-organizes the University of the Punjab to improve its teaching, research, and administration while safeguarding its autonomy. It establishes the university as a body corporate with specific governing bodies including the Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Labour Laws (Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923; The West Pakistan Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968; The Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: Labour Laws (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends several laws relating to industrial relations and the welfare of workers in Pakistan. It specifically repeals the Labour Laws (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1972 and introduces changes to standing orders regarding termination of employment, notice periods, and gratuity payments.

metadata.title: The Labour Laws (Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923; The West Pakistan Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968; The Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: The Labour Laws (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws relating to industrial relations and the welfare of workers in Pakistan. It specifically updates provisions regarding termination of employment, standing orders, and gratuity calculations while repealing a previous ordinance.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972 to address specific provisions regarding land transfers by gift and agricultural machinery ownership. It clarifies exceptions for gifts to heirs or widowed sisters and introduces rules for acquiring additional land area based on tractor or tubewell ownership prior to December 1971.

metadata.title: The Short Land Reforms Regulation, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation (Regulation 64 of 1959)
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation establishes Land Commissions for each province to implement land reforms aimed at improving the economic well-being of the peasantry. It defines key terms such as 'economic holding' and 'subsistence holding' based on provincial acreage limits and grants these commissions powers to override conflicting laws, orders, or customs.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION NO. 118 (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Martial Law Regulation (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Martial Law Regulation No. 118 applicable to the Province of the Punjab. It substitutes paragraph 10 regarding the vesting of privately managed college and school assets in the Provincial Government and deletes paragraphs 9 and 11.

name: PRIVATELY MANAGED SCHOOLS AND COLLEGES (TAKING OVER) REGULATION 1972

metadata.title: Regulation No. 118
metadata.summary: This Regulation governs privately-managed colleges and schools in Pakistan, defining terms related to their management and ownership. It stipulates that contracts made after March 15, 1972, regarding the sale or transfer of such institutions are void, and mandates that these institutions must operate on a genuinely benevolent, philanthropic, and non-profit basis.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES ACT, 1972

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act defines the privileges of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, its Members, and Committees. It establishes protections against civil or criminal proceedings related to matters brought up in the Assembly and restricts the detention of Members during sessions.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance defines the privileges of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, its Members, and Committees. It establishes protections against civil or criminal proceedings for Members during Assembly sessions and limits their arrest or detention in Civil, Revenue Courts, Commissions, or Election Tribunals.

metadata.title: Labour Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends certain laws relating to industrial relations and the welfare of workers in Pakistan. It specifically targets amendments to existing Acts such as the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923, and the Factories Act, 1934.

metadata.title: The Punjab (Multan) Timber Market Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No. 111
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes provisions for the Timber Market in Multan and regulates business activities within the municipal limits. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 111, which was subsequently repealed by the Interim Constitution.

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Services (Appellate Tribunals) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The Punjab Civil Services (Appellate Tribunals) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Services (Appellate Tribunals) Ordinance, 1970 to update definitions and procedural mechanisms for tribunals. It introduces provisions for ad hoc appointments of tribunal members when vacancies exist or disagreements arise, and clarifies rules regarding majority decisions.

name: PUNJAB CONTROL OF GOONDAS (REMOVAL OF DOUBTS) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Goondas (Removal of Doubts) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance clarifies the number of tribunals that can be constituted in every district under the West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959. It explicitly states that the provisions regarding tribunal numbers shall always mean one or more than one Tribunal.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes, fees, and surcharges in the Province of the Punjab for the financial year 1972-73. It establishes specific rates for agricultural income tax, cinema entry fees, motor vehicle surcharges, and urban property tax.

name: PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION (REMOVAL OF DOUBTS) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: Labour Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923; The Factories Act, 1934; The Wages Payment Act, 1936; The Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing laws relating to industrial relations and the welfare of workers in Pakistan. It specifically targets acts such as the Workmen's Compensation Act, the Factories Act, the Wages Payment Act, and the Employees' Social Security Ordinance to update provisions regarding compensation, factory safety, wage deductions, and domestic servant treatment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pre-emption (Removal of Doubts) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance removes doubts regarding the right of pre-emption in relation to the sale of certain properties. It specifically applies to agricultural land and other immovable properties situated in Mianwali District or Khushab Tehsil of Sargodha District, particularly concerning persons displaced by the construction of the Chashma Barrage.

metadata.title: The Punjab Silkworms (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the production, supply, possession, and rearing of silkworms within the Punjab. It establishes prohibitions on unauthorized activities regarding silkworms and grants powers to the Government for inspection, seizure, and rule-making.

name: PUNJAB TENANCY (VALIDATION AND EXTENSION OF PERIOD FOR PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The Punjab Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) Ordinance, 1969. It extends to the whole of the Punjab and modifies Section 2 by adding a proviso regarding compensation rights decided in legal proceedings before July 30, 1972.

name: ROAD TRANSPORT CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN) REMOVAL OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965 to apply it to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific terms within the original ordinance and related rules, replacing references to 'Road Transport Corporation' with 'Board', 'Corporation' with 'Board', and 'Chairman' with 'Managing Director'.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES AND CO-OPERATIVE BANKS (REPAYMENT OF LOANS) (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Banks (Repayment Societies and of Co-operative Loans) (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Co-operative Banks (Repayment Societies and of Co-operative Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Co-operative Banks (Repayment Societies and of Co-operative Loans) Ordinance, 1966. It grants the Registrar powers to call for records and examine decisions or awards made by the Government or Deputy Registrars regarding propriety and legality.

name: WEST PAKISTAN COTTON CONTROL (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Cotton Control (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966, to extend its application to the Province of Punjab. It introduces new definitions for 'Inspector' and 'owner', modifies licensing procedures, updates penalty amounts, and adds requirements for monthly cotton returns by factory occupiers.

name: WEST PAKISTAN EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965, to apply it to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes specific clauses regarding the appointment of a Chairman for the Labour Department.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W. P. Ordinance No. XIX of 1965)
