metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, to replace the Road Transport Corporation with the Road Transport Board in the Province of Punjab. It provides for the substitution of specific terms and sections within the principal Ordinance while allowing the Corporation to continue functioning until the new Board is established.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, to apply its provisions to the Province of Punjab. It introduces requirements for government servants to declare financial interests in vehicles and modifies sections regarding permits, compensation, and enforcement of Claims Tribunal orders.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRESS AND PUBLICATIONS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Press and Publications (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963 to apply it to the Province of Punjab. It grants the District Magistrate authority to approve changes in newspaper printing locations within the district.

metadata.title: Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the education of workers' children and related matters. It mandates employers of specific establishments to provide free education up to matriculation level for their employed children.

metadata.title: The Pesticides Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the import, manufacture, formulation, sale, distribution, and use of pesticides in Pakistan. It establishes a registration system for pesticide brands to ensure they are not deceptive and meet specific quality standards before being sold or used.

metadata.title: The Child Marriage Restraint (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929 to apply specifically to the Province of Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Martial Law provisions and came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.title: The Electricity Act (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Electricity Act, 1910, to update provisions regarding licensee consent, entry into premises for inspection, and notice periods for disconnection. It also clarifies definitions of theft related to energy abstraction and introduces new sections concerning devices used for unauthorized energy use.

metadata.title: The Essential Commodities Control Order, 1971
metadata.summary: This Order provides powers to the Central Government for price control and regulation of essential commodities in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'dealer', 'essential commodity', and 'producer', and establishes rules regarding maximum prices, information furnishing by importers and producers, and the disposal of these commodities.

name: PUNJAB COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF LEVY OF FEES) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Punjab and the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: The West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949 and the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates fees levied from cotton ginning factory occupiers under the West Punjab and Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Acts of 1949 prior to their amendment. It stipulates that any unpaid or refunded fees shall be recoverable according to the provisions of the West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966.

metadata.title: The Punjab People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to local government in the Punjab province. It provides definitions for terms used throughout the legislation and establishes the framework for People's Local Councils, municipalities, and related administrative bodies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Factories (Essential Articles) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the framework for employers in Punjab factories to maintain fair price shops for workers. It defines key terms such as 'worker', 'employer', and 'essential articles' while mandating that these shops sell goods without profit or added charges like rent or staff salaries.

name: PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTIONS (DISSOLUTION) (EXTENSION OF LIMITATION) ORDIANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Punjab Local Government Institutions (Dissolution) (Extension of Limitation) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the extension of limitation periods in specific matters relating to Union Councils. It applies to acts or things that could not be completed within the required time due to the dissolution of Union Councils under Martial Law Order No. 21.

name: PUNJAB TAUNSA BARRAGE BETTERMENT TAX ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Taunsa Barrage Canals Betterment Tax Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance imposes a betterment tax on lands receiving irrigation from the Taunsa Barrage Canals. It outlines the rates for the tax, specifies who is liable to pay based on land ownership or tenancy, and establishes procedures for preparing demand statements, handling objections, and recovering arrears.

metadata.title: The Punjab Finance Ordinance, 1971
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, fees, and surcharges in the Province of the Punjab. It substitutes existing schedules for agricultural income tax and motor vehicle taxation with new ones effective July 1, 1971.

name: THAL (INCREASE IN VALUE) (VALIDATION OF LEVY OF TAX) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Thal (Increase in Value) and Validation of Levy of Tax Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates taxes levied under specific rules of the Thal (Increase in Value) Tax Assessment Rules, 1961, prior to their substitution. It declares that such taxes were validly collected and allows for the recovery of any unpaid amounts according to the substituted rules.

metadata.title: The Punjab Gaz. (Extra.), July 17, 1971
metadata.summary: This document is a government notification from the Punjab regarding the extension of certain provisions to specific districts. It clarifies that rights or liabilities acquired before the promulgation of the Thal Development (Amendment) Act, 1955, are deemed valid despite any contrary contents in that Act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION, LAHORE) (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Lahore) (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Lahore) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Lahore) Ordinance, 1961. It adds a new sub-section granting the Controlling Authority the power to direct the Board to conduct its affairs in specified matters.

name: West Pakistan Agricultural University (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural University (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Agricultural University Ordinance, 1961, specifically for its application to the Province of the Punjab. It empowers the Government to integrate any educational institution situated in the Punjab with the university via official notification, transferring all associated rights, properties, assets, and liabilities to the university.

name: WEST PAKISTAN BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (PUNJAB SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Technical Education (Punjab Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962, specifically regarding its application to the Province of the Punjab. It adds a new sub-section to section 12, empowering the Controlling Authority to direct the Board on how to conduct its affairs and perform its functions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Punjab Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to apply it to the Province of Punjab. It specifically revises provisions regarding sick leave entitlements for tuberculosis patients and adjusts the age limits for dependant children.

name: WEST PAKISTAN FAMILY COURTS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 to apply specifically to the Province of Punjab. It introduces new provisions regarding the service of notices, substitutes sections on Muslim Family Laws, and adds powers for the High Court and District Courts to transfer suits and appeals between family courts or district courts.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963 to apply specific provisions regarding compensation for displaced persons in the Punjab province. It adds a new proviso to Section 19(2) of the Act concerning the valuation of immovable property acquired by claimants under the Rehabilitation (Displaced Persons) Act, 1958.

name: WEST PAKISTAN FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) (PUNJAB AMENDMENT AND VALIDATION) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 to apply specifically to the Punjab province. It also validates certain fees and charges levied on sugar mills in the area before the Ordinance came into force, deeming them validly collected or receivable as arrears of land revenue if unpaid.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Punjab. It adds new clauses to define 'Province' and establish rules for allowing transport vehicles registered in one province to be driven within another.

name: West Pakistan Publication of Textbooks (Regulation and Control) (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Publication of Textbooks (Punjab Amendment) (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Publication of Textbooks (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Publication of Textbooks (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1970 to apply it to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes 'Punjab Text Book Board' for 'West Pakistan Textbook Board' and makes other textual changes to sections 3 and 5 of the principal Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WAQF PROPERTIES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Wagf Properties Ordinance, 1961 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Wagf Properties Ordinance, 1961 to grant the Chief Administrator broader powers to take over and manage Waqf properties. It specifically addresses the administration of religious services and ceremonies at these properties.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 as it applies to West Pakistan. It substitutes specific terms regarding canal officers in sections 20 and 68 and introduces new provisions for appeals against orders made by Sub-Divisional Canal Officers.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (WEST PAKISTAN SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (West Pakistan Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically omits certain wording regarding cost proportions in section 57 and substitutes a new section 59 concerning annual rates on lands benefiting from drainage schemes.

metadata.title: Workers' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Workers' Welfare Fund to provide residential accommodation and other facilities for workers. It outlines the fund's composition, including an initial contribution from the Central Government and payments from industrial establishments based on their total income.

metadata.title: The Explosive Substances (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Explosive Substances Act, 1908 to apply it specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It inserts specific wording regarding government or authorized officers into Section VI of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) (Punjab Repeal) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.repeals: The Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This ordinance repeals the Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) Ordinance, 1961, specifically in its application to the Province of the Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on November 21, 1970.

name: PAKISTAN CRIMINAL LAW (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Pakistan Criminal Law (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958 to apply to persons serving in connection with West Pakistan affairs who are not members of an All-Pakistan Service. Specifically, it inserts the words 'and to withdraw prosecution' between 'prosecution' and 'on' in section 12 of the amended Act.

name: PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION ACT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to apply it to persons in the civil services or holding civil posts in West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'Inspector' for 'Deputy Superintendent' and omits a specific proviso within section 5-A of the amended Act.

name: PUNJAB CIVIL SERVICES ( APPELLATE TRIBUNALS) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Punjab Civil Services (Appellate Tribunals) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for modifications in the law relating to Civil Services Appellate Tribunals within the Punjab Province. It establishes the constitution, jurisdiction, and powers of these tribunals to hear appeals regarding seniority fixes for government servants.

name: RAILWAYS (TRANSPORT OF GOODS) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947, specifically regarding its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes the word 'twenty-six' for 'twenty-three' in section 1, subsection (3) of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Social Services Board to promote social welfare and coordinate related programs. It provides for the constitution of the Board, defining its members, including a President, Vice-Presidents, Chairman, Secretary, and various nominated or ex-officio representatives.

metadata.title: The Soil Reclamation (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Soil Reclamation Act, 1952 to apply it to the Province of the Punjab. It substitutes specific clauses regarding public notices and omits references to reclamation fees in certain sections.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961. It grants the Director and officers of the Establishment specific powers of search, arrest, and seizure of property throughout West Pakistan during preliminary inquiries or investigations.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ANIMALS SALUGHTER CONTROL (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to extend its application to the Province of the Punjab. It introduces new definitions for meat and rules, adds restrictions on selling unmarked carcasses, establishes presumptions for prosecutions, grants search and arrest powers to veterinary officers, and defines penalties for contraventions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LOCAL COUNCILS HIGH SCHOOLS (TAKING OVER) ORDINANCE 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Councils High Schools (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the taking over of High Schools maintained by District Councils and Town Committees in West Pakistan by the Government. It transfers control, rights, authorities, properties, assets, and staff from local councils to the government effective from the date of enforcement.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Punjab. It introduces changes to sections concerning vehicle definitions, permit applications, bank guarantees for stage carriages, compensation amounts for passenger injuries or death, and procedures for claims tribunals.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958, specifically regarding its application to the Province of the Punjab. It achieves this by omitting subsection (3) of section 13 of the aforementioned Act.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update provisions regarding fitness certificates and stage carriage permits. It introduces new requirements for permit applications, including affidavits of ownership and bank guarantees, while substituting several sections of the principal Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN NURSING SERVICES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Nursing Services (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Nursing Services Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Nursing Services Ordinance, 1959, to apply specifically to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes various clauses regarding definitions and council composition, including the addition of new categories for public health nurses and health visitors.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PUBLICATION OF TEXTBOOKS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Publication of Textbooks (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of the printing, publication, and sale of textbooks and works published by or under the authority of the West Pakistan Textbook Board. It establishes prohibitions on publishing without permission, outlines penalties for contravention, and grants powers to the Government to make rules and exempt specific textbooks.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRIVATE COLLEGES (MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL) (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970 (Punjab Amendment)
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970 to apply specifically to the Province of Punjab. It modifies provisions regarding the composition of governing bodies, removal procedures for members, disciplinary actions against employees, review mechanisms for aggrieved persons, and regulatory rules.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959. It was issued under Martial Law and published for general information on February 6, 1970.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE ACT 1873 (EXTENSION TO III LORA CANAL OF BANNU DISTRICT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage Act (Extension to III Lora Canal of Bannu District) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905; The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the provisions of the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to the III Lora Canal in Bannu District. It validates the levy of occupier's rates for areas irrigated by this canal and deems certain notifications issued since November 23, 1959, to have been made under the applicable Act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REQUISITIONING OF STAGE CARRIAGES (TEMPORARY POWERS) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the temporary requisitioning of stage carriages in West Pakistan to ensure passenger transport services. It grants District Magistrates the power to order, maintain, and use motor vehicles as stage carriages while outlining procedures for appeals, compensation, and penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: The Conciliation Courts (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961 by adding a new subsection to section 8 regarding applications made under disability and modifying section 16. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan on February 13, 1969, and assented to by the Governor on March 8, 1969.

name: GREATER LAHORE WATER SUPPLY, SEWERAGE AND DRAINAGE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Ordinance, 1967. It substitutes specific clauses regarding the administrative control of staff by a Trust and inserts provisions concerning the Finance Department's representative on the Trust.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (PUNJAB) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912 to update definitions and applicability within West Pakistan. It substitutes specific sections regarding tenancy acts, defines improvements related to land cultivation, and repeals certain sections while omitting others from the original act.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically substitutes interest rates from six percent to eight percent compound interest and adds provisions regarding waivers of rights by landowners.

name: NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE NEW IRRIGATION PROJECTS (CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF SPECULATION IN LAND) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1969

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province New Irrigation Projects (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) (Amendment) Act, 1969
metadata.amends: The North-West Frontier Province New Irrigation Projects (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the North-West Frontier Province New Irrigation Projects (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land) Act, 1950. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan on February 13, 1969, and received assent from the Governor on March 8, 1969.

metadata.title: The Notaries (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Notaries Ordinance, 1961 by adding a new section 16-A. The amendment allows the Provincial Government to delegate its powers under the Ordinance or related rules to subordinate officers or authorities via official notification.

name: PUNJAB TENANCY (VALIDATION AND EXTENSION OF PERIOD FOR PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION) ORDINANCE 1969

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy (Validation and Extension of Period for Payment of Compensation) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates amendments made to the Punjab Tenancy (Amendment) Rules, 1953, regarding the extension of the payment period for compensation. It further extends this period by one year for occupancy tenants who failed to pay compensation within the previously extended timeframe.

metadata.title: The Sind Irrigation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 to include 'tube-wells' and 'sub-soil water' in specific clauses regarding water supply sources. It also authorizes the Provincial Government to levy retrospective water-rates for increased water-supply resulting from new or improved canals.

metadata.title: The Sind Tenancy (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Tenancy Act, 1950 to extend its application to the District of Khairpur. It substitutes specific subsections in Section 1 of the Act to include Khairpur and other districts within the scope of the tenancy laws.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Arms (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965 to update the list of prohibited weapons and define specific types of knives. It substitutes text in section 3 to include air pistols, swords, daggers, and flick-knives in the prohibited list, while also inserting a new definition for 'flick-knife'. Additionally, it amends section 10 by changing a numerical figure from 19 to 20.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It repeals several previous amendment acts and substitutes new clauses regarding court definitions, collector powers, notification procedures, and compensation disputes.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CRIMINAL LAW (AMENDMENT) ACT (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, (Repeal) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal the West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963. It ensures that the repeal does not affect previous operations, acquired rights, penalties incurred, or ongoing legal proceedings under the repealed Act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN DUTY ON EXCESSIVE WASTAGE OF SPIRITS IN DISTILLERIES (VALIDATION) ORDINANCE 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Duty on Excessive Wastage of Spirits in Distilleries (Validation) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy and recovery of excise duty on excessive wastage of spirit in distilleries occurring from July 1, 1940 onwards. It deems any such duties levied before this Ordinance came into force as validly collected if they comply with the specified provisions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965. It substitutes specific wording regarding contribution rates and updates provisions for medical care entitlements.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 to classify cinemas into specific categories for duty and welfare cess purposes. It establishes new scales for levying duties based on cinema class and optimum tax capacity, effective from July 1, 1969.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 to update definitions for terms like 'auditorium' and 'cinema'. It also introduces new penalty provisions for duty evasion and establishes a tiered scale for levying entertainments duty based on cinema class.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965 by modifying section 12 regarding lodging charges. Specifically, it omits certain words related to fans and air-conditioning from existing clauses and adds a new explanation defining 'lodging unit' charges to include bedding, light, heat, telephone, and other connected payments.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Amendment) Act, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 to update procedural requirements regarding summons, document production, and notice display. It specifically substitutes sections 4, 7, 8, and 9 of the original act to incorporate changes related to Qazis appointed under Dastur-ul-Amal Diwani and Riasat Kalat, as well as detailed rules for serving plaintiffs and defendants within Union Council jurisdictions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Welfare Fund to provide relief and security for the employees of the West Pakistan Government and their families. It creates separate parts of the fund for gazetted and non-gazetted servants, outlines contribution sources, and sets up Provincial and Divisional Welfare Boards to administer the fund and arrange insurance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960. It specifically modifies Section 6 to include the Secretariat Board of Management in dealing with Part II of the Fund concerning non-gazetted servants and adjusts related clauses regarding expenditure powers.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HISTORICAL MOSQUES AND SHRINES FUND CESS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'eleven' for 'ten' in sub-section (4) of section 3 of the amended Act.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 by substituting an entry in its Schedule regarding the Sind Land Revenue Code. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Martial Law on November 3, 1969.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to empower police officers to charge on the spot for specific traffic offences involving scooters, motor cycles, motor rickshaws, private cars, or taxis. It establishes a procedure for issuing charges in triplicate and requires offenders to deposit fines within seven days to avoid further legal proceedings.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PREVENTION OF GAMBLING (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling (Amendment) Act, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961. It specifically adds a proviso to Section 4 requiring imprisonment of not less than one month and a fine of not less than one hundred rupees.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRIVY PURSES (CHARGED EXPENDITURE) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Privy Purses (Charged Expenditure) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares that the expenditure relating to privy purses of Rulers of former States incorporated into West Pakistan is a charge on the Provincial Consolidated Fund. It further stipulates that any sums paid by the Central Government as privy purses to these rulers shall be reimbursed from said fund.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PUBLICATION OF BOOKS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Publication of Books (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of printing and publishing books or works first published in a foreign country within West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'book' and 'Government', establishes procedures for obtaining permission to publish, outlines penalties for contravention, and grants powers to make rules.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RAILWAY SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Railway Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund to provide financial relief to Railway servants and their families in West Pakistan. The fund is divided into two parts for gazetted and non-gazetted servants, financed by compulsory contributions, government grants, donations, and investment income.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RAILWAY SERVANTS WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Railway Servants' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Welfare Fund to provide relief and security for Railway servants and their families in West Pakistan. It creates two separate parts of the fund, one for gazetted servants and one for non-gazetted servants, managed by respective Committees of Management. The fund is utilized primarily for insurance arrangements and other prescribed benefits.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RICE (RESTRICTIONS ON CULTIVATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959. It grants the Board of Revenue or authorized officers the power to relax cultivation restrictions for specific areas or holdings to facilitate land reclamation operations for a period not exceeding three years.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to regulate opening hours, rest intervals, and employment restrictions for women and young persons. It was promulgated by the Administrator of Martial Law, Zone A, exercising powers conferred under the Martial Law Proclamation of 25th March, 1969.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 (Second Amendment) Ordinance
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to further amend the West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969. It specifically substitutes certain figures and words in subsection (2) of section 24 regarding departmental receipts.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes, cesses, and surcharges in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific rates for cinema taxes, motor vehicle surcharges, railway freight, and welfare cesses effective from July 1, 1969.

name: WEST PAKISTAN STATUTORY BODIES (APPOINTMENT AND REMOVAL OF LEGAL ADVISERS) (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Statutory Bodies (Appointment and Removal of Legal Advisers) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Statutory Bodies (Appointment and Removal of Legal Advisers) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal an earlier law from 1965. It was issued under the Martial Law Proclamation of March 25, 1969, and published in the Extraordinary Gazette on November 22, 1969.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TRIBUNALS OF INQUIRY ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tribunals of Inquiry Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Tribunals of Inquiry and vests them with specific powers. It grants these tribunals the authority of a civil court while trying suits under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, including powers to summon witnesses, seize documents, and issue commissions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (VALIDATION OF VALUATION LIST AND TAX) ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property (Validation of Valuation List and Tax) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the valuation list and the tax levied on buildings and land located in the Sind Industrial Trading Estate, Karachi. It deems the area a rating area from August 19, 1963, and confirms that taxes collected between January 1, 1964, and July 2, 1964, were validly levied.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vaccination (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958 to update provisions regarding vaccination schedules and definitions. It specifically clarifies the age of a 'child' as under sixteen years and introduces new clauses for Smallpox Eradication Officers and unprotected persons.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WEIGHTS AND MEASURES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Weights and Measures (Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Weights and Measures Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Weights and Measures Ordinance, 1965 by adding a new subsection to section 38. The amendment allows rules made under that section to specify fines of up to one thousand rupees for contraventions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS ORDINANCE, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: The law relating to the hours and other conditions of work and employment of persons employed in shops and commercial, industrial and other establishments in West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws regarding working hours and employment conditions for persons in shops, commercial, industrial, and other establishments in West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Administrator of Martial Law exercising the powers of the Governor under the Martial Law Proclamation of March 25, 1969.

metadata.title: The Whipping (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Whipping Act, 1909 to apply its provisions to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific sections and adds new clauses defining offences punishable by whipping in lieu of or in addition to other punishments.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968. It was issued under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Civil Procedure (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes special procedures for adjudicating civil disputes in specific areas of West Pakistan to meet their unique requirements. It creates tribunals composed of government officials and sets rules for the application, constitution, and operation of these tribunals, while excluding certain existing laws like the Evidence Act and Code of Civil Procedure from applying to proceedings under this Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Excise Regulation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Excise Regulation, 1915 to allow the Provincial Government to prohibit possession or consumption of excisable articles under specific conditions. It also substitutes a clause in section 33 to change the wording regarding who possesses or consumes such articles.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to apply it to certain areas in the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

name: PUNJAB COURT OF WARDS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1968

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.amends: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes special provision for the trial of certain scheduled offences in specific areas of West Pakistan. It establishes a Tribunal consisting of a Government official and four other members to decide on the guilt or innocence of accused persons, overriding standard procedures under the Evidence Act and Code of Criminal Procedure.

name: SIND ABKARI ACT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1968

metadata.title: The Sind Abkari Act (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Abkari Act, 1878 to grant the Provincial Government broader powers to prohibit or restrict the possession and consumption of intoxicants. It also updates specific wording in the Act regarding the prohibition of selling intoxicants.

name: WEST PAKISTAN BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (MULTAN AND SARGODHA) ORDINANCE, 1968

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Multan and Sargodha) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education for the regions of Multan and Sargodha in West Pakistan. It defines key terms, outlines the composition and tenure of board members, and provides procedures for resignation and removal.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF GOONDAS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1968

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas (Amendment) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959 to update definitions and expand tribunal powers regarding evidence acceptance. It also substitutes sections to broaden the list of behaviors considered goondaism, including specific offenses related to vice, intimidation, and evasion of taxes.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ESTABLISHMENT AND IMPROVEMENT OF PARKS AND HISTORICAL PLACES (LAHORE) (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1968

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) and (Repeal) Improvement Ordinance, 1968
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) Improvement Ordinance, 1963
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) Improvement Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the repeal of the West Pakistan Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) Improvement Ordinance, 1963. It mandates the Trust to relinquish possession of specific lands within ninety days, including all materials and structures thereon, while addressing compensation liabilities and legal procedures for delivery.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and surcharges in the Province of West Pakistan for the financial year 1968-69. It imposes additional agricultural income-tax on specific districts, levies taxes on cinemas and motor vehicles, and introduces a tax on railway fares and freights until June 30, 1969.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1968 (Amendment)
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1968 to adjust the computation of appeal periods and tribunal appointment timelines. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution due to the Provincial Assembly not being in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL EMPLOYMENT (STANDING ORDERS) ORDINANCE, 1968

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.amends: The law relating to industrial employment in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to industrial employment in West Pakistan. It applies to industrial and commercial establishments employing a specified number of workmen, excluding those under central or provincial government authority with existing service rules.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1968
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Industrial Disputes Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to industrial disputes in the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session, exercising powers under Article 79 of the Constitution.

name: ADMINISTRATION OF BASIC DEMOCRACIES (TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1967

metadata.title: The Administration of Basic Democracies (Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1967
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the administration of Basic Democracies within the Tribal Areas of West Pakistan. It establishes the framework for local councils, including Union, Town, Tehsil, District, and Divisional Councils, and defines key terms such as Collector, Commissioner, and Controlling Authority.

name: BAHAWALPUR COTTON CONTROL (VALIDATION OF LEVY OF FEES) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur Cotton Control (Validation of Levy of Fees) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of fees under the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Act, 1949 for a specific period. It applies to occupiers of cotton factories, dealers, and company managers in certain districts of West Pakistan.

name: BASIC DEMOCRACIES ORDER (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Basic Democracies Order (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Basic Democracies Order, 1959 to apply its provisions further to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces restrictions on re-election for chairmen who have vacated office and modifies rules regarding motions of no-confidence against union council and town committee chairmen.

name: CHARITABLE FUNDS (REGULATION OF COLLECTIONS) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1967

metadata.title: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) (West Pakistan Amendment and Extension) Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953 to extend its application to the whole of West Pakistan except Tribal Areas. It further substitutes various sections to redefine terms like 'Government', exclude certain donations and shrine offerings from specific provisions, and grant powers to the Government regarding appellate authorities and rule-making.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Trade Unions Ordinance, 1968
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Trade Unions Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the registration and recognition of Trade Unions in West Pakistan. It also defines the legal status of registered and recognized Trade Unions within the province.

name: EXCISE DUTY ON MINERALS (LABOUR WELFARE) ACT, 1967

metadata.title: The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an excise duty on certain minerals dispatched from mines in Pakistan to finance measures for the welfare of labour employed in the mining industry. It establishes a Mines Labour Housing and General Welfare Fund with separate accounts for housing and general welfare, detailing how proceeds are collected, credited, and utilized for health, sanitation, education, and living standards.

metadata.title: The Industrial Disputes (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959, as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'employees' with 'employers' in section 5, subsection (6) of the amended Ordinance.

name: INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES (WEST PAKISTAN SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Industrial Disputes (West Pakistan Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

name: KARACHI CONTROL OF DISORDERLY PERSONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons (Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.amends: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952 by altering punctuation and omitting specific words in section 1, subsection (2). It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: GREATER LAHORE WATERSUPPLY, SEWERAGE AND DRAINAGE ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance facilitates the execution of the Greater Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Scheme. It transfers functions and powers regarding water supply and drainage from the Municipal Committee to the Lahore Improvement Trust.

name: KARACHI MUNICIPAL CORPORATION TERMINAL TAX (VALIDATION) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Karachi Municipal Corporation Terminal Tax (Validation) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the Terminal Tax levied, charged, collected, or realized by the Karachi Municipal Corporation under specific provisions of the City of Karachi Municipal Act, 1933. It applies to taxes collected after the coming into force of the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960, and ensures that such taxes are deemed valid and not liable for refund.

metadata.title: The Karachi (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Karachi Development Authority Order of 1957 by adding a new clause regarding the scrutiny of accounts. It mandates that the Statement of Accounts and reports from the Comptroller and Auditor-General be laid before the Provincial Assembly for examination.

metadata.title: The Mines (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Mines Act, 1923 to give effect to ratified international conventions regarding minimum age and night work for women. It includes specific amendments to sections 26-A, 46, and others within the parent Act.

name: PROVINCIAL INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1967

metadata.title: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962. It introduces new requirements for submitting accounts and audit reports to the Government and mandates that these documents be laid before the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan.

name: RAILWAYS (TRANSPORT OF GOODS) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'twenty' with 'twenty-three' in section 1, sub-section (3) of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Registration (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Provincial Legislature of West Pakistan that amends the Registration Act, 1908. It specifically renumbers section 30 and omits subsection (e) of that section within the context of West Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Thal Development (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Thal Development Act, 1949 by inserting a new chapter on Audit and Accounts. It establishes requirements for the relevant Authority to maintain accounts, submit annual statements, and produce documents for examination by the Comptroller and Auditor-General of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Arms (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Arms Ordinance of 1965 by omitting specific sections and explanations. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan on July 4, 1967, and received assent from the Governor on July 15, 1967.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Cotton Control (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966. It substitutes specific words and figures in Section 31 of the said Ordinance to update references from the Cotton Control Act, 1949 and the Cotton Control Act, 1952 (Khanpur Act V of 1952).

name: WEST PAKISTAN DOWRY (PROHIBITION ON DISPLAY) ACT, 1967

metadata.title: The Dowry (Prohibition on Display) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the giving or receiving of dowry in connection with marriage within West Pakistan. It also forbids the intentional display of cash, ornaments, or clothes as dowry presents and establishes that such items belong to the woman involved.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958 to update specific provisions regarding price controls and trade distribution. It substitutes the number 'nine' with 'fourteen' in section 1 and inserts the word 'prices' into the long title of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Pharmacy Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Pharmacy Councils to regulate the practice of pharmacy throughout Pakistan. It provides for the creation of a Central Pharmacy Council and Provincial Pharmacy Councils, defining their composition and powers.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan that amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964. It was assented to by the Governor on October 17, 1967, and published in the Gazette on October 21, 1967.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and duties in West Pakistan, excluding the Tribal Areas. It establishes specific surcharges based on land-revenue amounts and defines freight and passenger fare taxes.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PAT FEEDER CANAL (CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF ALLENATION OF LAND) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Pat Feeder Canal (Control and Prevention of Alienation of Land) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to control the unauthorized alienation of lands within the irrigation command of the Pat Feeder Canal of Gudu Barrage. It aims to safeguard the interests of genuine landowners and the government during a period when land ownership is undetermined due to ongoing settlement operations.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956 to introduce a new section allowing members to opt for a consolidated allowance. Under this provision, eligible members can receive a fixed monthly sum in lieu of various specific allowances and benefits.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PURE FOOD ORDINANCE (EXTENSION TO THE TRIBAL AREAS OF QUETTA DIVISION) REGULATION, 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance (Extension to the Tribal Areas of Quetta Division) Regulation, 1967
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This regulation extends the West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to the Tribal Areas of Quetta Division. It was issued by the Governor of West Pakistan with the approval of the President under Article 223 of the Constitution.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REDEMPTION AND RESTITUTION OF MORTGAGED LANDS AMENDMENT ACT 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1967 (Amendment)
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This document is an amendment act passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan to modify the West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964. It adds a proviso to Section 7 allowing a mortgagor to file a suit for redemption within the unexpired period of limitation fixed by law.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958 to update provisions regarding financial audits and reports. It mandates that annual reports and audit findings be laid before the Provincial Assembly for scrutiny by the Committee on Public Accounts.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958. It specifically alters the composition of the Authority by substituting the provision regarding its members to allow for a Chairman appointed by the Government and not more than three other members.

name: WORKING JOURNALISTS (CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1967

metadata.title: The Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.amends: The Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces new procedures for handling grievances by working journalists against newspaper establishments and modifies rules regarding the definition of wages and termination of employment.

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically alters monetary limits and substitution of authorities within sections 15 and 27-A of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 by inserting a new section (70-A) that bars courts and other authorities from entertaining matters involving the Registrar, societies, banks, or the Provincial Government. It further prevents any court from questioning the validity of orders passed under the Act or granting injunctions related to proceedings thereunder.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 by inserting a new section to classify society officers as public servants and adding provisions regarding the continuation of powers for registrars and liquidators. It also includes standard clauses ensuring that the repeal of previous acts does not revive old laws or affect acquired rights.

metadata.title: The Conciliation Courts (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces new provisions excluding cases against government servants from conciliation unless a specific certificate is granted, and modifies sections regarding applicable evidence and procedural laws.

metadata.title: The Factories (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Factories Act, 1934 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific wording in sections 34, 35, 36, and 42 regarding worker requirements and inserts a new section 47A concerning adult workers and overtime work.

metadata.title: The Industrial Disputes (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959 to apply it to the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically adds provisions regarding registered trade unions being deemed parties to disputes and modifies section 18 to recognize unions under the Trade Unions Act, 1926.

name: KARACHI CONTROL OF DISORDERLY PERSONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952. It was issued because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary under Article 79 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Notaries (West Pakistan) Amendment Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Notaries Ordinance, 1961 to apply its provisions to the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically substitutes a clause regarding the administration of oaths and taking affidavits in relation to matters enumerated in Section 8.

name: PAKISTAN MEMORIAL CESS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964 to facilitate the construction of the Pakistan Day Memorial at Lahore. It establishes a new Committee and a Fund to manage loans, contracts, and works for the memorial project.

name: PAKISTAN MEMORIAL CESS (WEST PAKISTAN) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964 by substituting the year 1967 for 1966 in section 4. The amendment is deemed to have taken effect from June 30, 1966.

name: PUNJAB UNIVERSITY MALPRACTICES (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The Punjab University Malpractices (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab University Malpractices Act, 1950, to expand its scope from universities to include Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education. It establishes requirements for written sanctions from specific officials before an employee can be employed by a university or board.

name: SIND FAMINE RELIEF FUND (WEST PAKISTAN REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The Sind Famine Relief Fund (West Pakistan Repeal) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.repeals: Sind Famine Relief Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Sind Famine Relief Act, 1937. It also provides for the immediate discontinuance of the Sind Famine Relief Fund and credits any remaining balance to the Provincial Consolidated Fund.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Board (Dissolution) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the dissolution of the West Pakistan Co-operative Board and the appointment of an Administrator to wind up its affairs. It details the transfer of properties, funds, and liabilities from the dissolved Board to the Administrator and outlines the Administrator's duties.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES AND CO-OPERATIVE BANKS (REPAYMENT OF LOANS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966 to address fraudulent alienations and insufficient security for loans. It introduces definitions for 'benami loans' and expands borrower liability to include real beneficiaries in such cases, while also modifying provisions regarding the registration of documents and recovery of loans from firm assets.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CO-OPERATIVE SOCITIES AND CO-OPERATIVE BANKS (REPAYMENT OF LOANS) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Societies Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the repayment of unsecured loans or loans that are insufficiently secured taken from co-operative societies and banks in West Pakistan. It establishes mechanisms for the Registrar to obtain information on outstanding loans, issue notices to borrowers and sureties, and ensure these loans are repaid within a specified timeframe.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land-Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to land-revenue in the Province of West Pakistan. It covers matters including the making and maintenance of records-of-rights, the assessment and collection of revenue, and the appointment and functions of Revenue Officers.

name: WEST PAKISTAN COTTON CONTROL VALIDATION OF LEVY OF FEES ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966 (Validation of Levy of Fees)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy, charging, collection, and realization of fees from cotton dealers, occupiers, and factory managers for a specific period between 1949 and 1954. It declares these fees to have been validly collected even though they were levied under an Act that was later amended or repealed.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the production, processing, and sale of cotton in West Pakistan. It establishes a Cotton Control Board and Advisory Committees to regulate these matters.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958 by substituting the word 'nine' for 'eight' in a specific subsection. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under emergency powers because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963 to introduce new definitions and procedures regarding scheduled offences. It grants the Commissioner specific powers to refer cases involving these offences to Tribunals and establishes rules for the appointment of Tribunal members.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 to address pending suits under the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890. It also updates definitions, qualifications for judges, jurisdictional areas, and procedures regarding evidence recording and appeals within family courts.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act continues and levies certain taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan for the financial year 1966-67. It establishes specific surcharges on agricultural income, cinema taxes, motor vehicle taxes, and tolls on inland vessels.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT LANDS AND BUILDINGS (RECOVERY OF POSSESSION) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy recovery of possession of Government lands and buildings from outgoing lessees, licensees, and unauthorised occupants. It empowers authorised officers to enter premises, evict occupants, and remove structures when leases expire or licences are revoked due to specific circumstances.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HISTORICAL MOSQUES FUND CESS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960 by inserting the words 'and shrines' after 'mosques' in various sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958. It substitutes specific wording in section 9 of the original Act to adjust tax calculations.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1965. Specifically, it substitutes the words 'excluding land' for 'including land' in clause (ii) of section 2 of the said Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TENDOO LEAVES (PROHIBITION ON POSSESSION AND USE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966 by substituting specific dates within sections 3 and 4. The changes extend certain prohibition periods from August 31st to September 30th and alter another deadline to November 30th, 1966.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRESS AND PUBLICATIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Press and Publications (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963 to introduce stricter regulations regarding printing press declarations. It empowers District Magistrates to authenticate or refuse declarations based on moral turpitude convictions, name discrepancies, or threats to national security.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TENDOO LEAVES (PROHIBITION ON POSSESSION AND USE) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the manufacture and possession of bidi using tendoo leaves within the Province of West Pakistan, specifically targeting the border-belt area. It defines key terms such as 'endoo leaf' and establishes penalties for violations, including imprisonment and fines.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959, to modify provisions regarding appeals against orders made by the Controller. It substitutes new sub-sections in section 15 to allow District Judges to hear appeals or refer them to Additional District Judges and validates appeals transferred before the amendment came into force.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION (SECOND AMENDMENT) AMENDING ORDINANCE, 1966

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Second Amendment) Amending Ordinance, 1966
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1962. It specifically modifies Section 3 by omitting a previous sub-clause and adding new provisions regarding the continued exercise of Controller powers until otherwise notified.

metadata.title: The Essential Personnel (Registration) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948, specifically regarding its application to West Pakistan. It substitutes a subsection in section 6 to restrict court cognizance of offences to complaints made by or on the authority of the Joint Director, Employment Exchanges, West Pakistan.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

name: KARACHI CONTROL OF DISORDERLY PERSONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952. It substitutes the year '1966' for '1965' in section 1, subsection (2) of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Industrial Disputes (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Industrial Disputes Ordinance of 1959 to regulate conciliation proceedings in public utility services and other industries. It introduces specific procedures for handling strike notices and sets time limits for issuing certificates when settlements are not reached.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes 'Provincial Government' for 'Commissioner', omits specific land descriptions in section 17, and inserts new clauses regarding acquisitions for company buildings or works serving a public purpose.
