metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (Validation of Fees) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates fees charged, collected, or realized by the Regional Transport Authority, Karachi between May 25, 1962, and March 12, 1965. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (ABATEMENT OF ARBITRATION PROCEEDINGS) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Abatement of Arbitration Proceedings) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the abatement of arbitration proceedings and annulment of awards involving the Karachi Development Authority and its contractors. It applies to disputes referred to arbitration under agreements made pursuant to the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957, where such references failed to achieve their intended objects.

metadata.title: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to facilitate the transfer of functions to the newly established West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation and to update specific clauses regarding industrial programs and financial limits.

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration Act, 1965 (West Pakistan Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Municipal Administration Ordinance of 1960 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces provisions for electing members to represent special interests, such as women and minorities, within municipal committees and updates related sections regarding composition and qualifications.

name: RAILWAYS (TRANSPORT OF GOODS) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) Amendment Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947 by substituting the word 'eighteen' with 'twenty' in section 1, sub-section (3). It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 due to circumstances rendering immediate legislation necessary.

name: ROAD TRANSPORT CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN) REMOVAL OF UNDESIRABLE EMPLOYEES ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Road Transport Corporation (West Pakistan) Removal of Undesirable Employees Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of undesirable employees of the Road Transport Corporation in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'appropriate authority' and outlines the process for terminating services, including the payment of gratuity or Provident Fund, while also establishing an appeal mechanism to the Government.

name: SIND CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: Co-operative Societies Act, 1912; Bombay Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 (as applicable to the District of Karachi)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to extend its application from the Province of Sind to the whole of West Pakistan (excluding Tribal Areas). It substitutes specific terms throughout the Principal Act and repeals earlier cooperative societies acts applicable to Karachi.

metadata.title: The Succession (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Succession Act, 1925 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically substitutes Section 370 with new provisions regarding the calculation and payment of court-fees for certificates granted by District Judges.

metadata.title: The Town Improvement (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Town Improvement Act, 1921 to grant the Government powers over Trust activities. It allows the Government to quash proceedings, suspend resolutions, prohibit actions, or require specific measures if they are deemed contrary to law or public interest.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION, HYDERABAD) (VALIDATING) ACT, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad) (Validating) Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act validates acts done, powers exercised, and functions performed by the Chairman-designate of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad, between November 1, 1960, and August 16, 1961. It deems these actions to have been properly carried out under the West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad) Ordinance, 1961.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION, PESHAWAR) (VALIDATING) ACT, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) (Validating) Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act validates the acts, powers, functions, and duties performed by the Chairman-designate of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar between November 2, 1960, and August 17, 1961. It confirms that these actions were legally done by the Board under the West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961.

name: WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961. It substitutes specific terms regarding directors and adds a clause designating the Secretary to Government of West Pakistan, Co-operation Department as an ex-officio Member Director.

name: QUETTA AND LALAT (CIVIL AND CRIMINAL LAW) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Quetta and Kalat (Civil and Criminal Law) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a system for settling civil disputes and ensuring speedy trials of offences in the Divisions of Quetta and Kalat, as well as certain other areas of West Pakistan. It creates specific Tribunals to handle scheduled offences and defines the powers of District Magistrates regarding these cases.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Agricultural University Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Agricultural University Ordinance, 1961 to alter the powers of the Syndicate regarding the framing of University Ordinances. It specifically addresses matters such as fees, creation of posts, appointment modes, duties, and establishment of departments by requiring Academic Council opinion before Syndicate consideration.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ANIMALS SLAUGHTER CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to update specific sections regarding its scope and definitions. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN AUTONOMOUS BODIES IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (EJECTMENT OF UNAUTHORIZED OCCUPANTS) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Autonomous Bodies Immovable Property (Ejectment of Unauthorized Occupants) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the summary ejectment of unauthorized occupants from immovable property vested in autonomous bodies within West Pakistan. It empowers these bodies to evict persons who enter or occupy such property without lawful authority, including the removal of crops and structures erected thereon.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CO-OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Development Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Co-operative Development Board Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Co-operative Development Board Ordinance, 1962 to update specific terminology and insert new clauses regarding council functions. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under emergency powers because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONSOLIDATION OF HOLDINGS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960 by substituting section 13 and adding a new section 18-A. The changes empower the Board of Revenue to call for records of proceedings at any time or upon application within ninety days, and authorize the summary ejectment of unauthorized occupants from consolidation scheme lands.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF GOONDAS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959. It specifically substitutes a clause in section 5 regarding who lays information with the Tribunal, allowing for officers outside police-station jurisdictions or Extra Assistant Commissioners to do so.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the sale, transport, bearing, or possession of arms, ammunition, and military stores in West Pakistan. It establishes licensing requirements for these activities and defines specific terms such as 'arms', 'ammunition', and 'cannon'.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan for the financial year 1965-66. It specifically introduces surcharges on motor vehicle taxes, tolls on steam and motor vessels in inland waters, and a tax on railway fares and freights.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND AMENDMENT ORDINANCE 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Amendment Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960. It inserts new sections to allow for the recovery of unpaid rent or lease-money as arrears of land-revenue and provides legal protection against suits or prosecutions for actions taken in good faith under the Ordinance.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Utilization (Repeal) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Land Utilization Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal the West Pakistan Land Utilization Ordinance, 1959. It was issued because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary under Article 79 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the repeal and amendment of certain laws in force in the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces a scheme of social security to provide benefits to certain employees or their dependents in cases of sickness, maternity, employment injury, or death. It establishes the legal framework for these provisions and defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'employment injury' within the context of West Pakistan.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to allow the Government to prescribe a special registration procedure for specific classes or types of motor vehicles. It substitutes Section 41 of the principal Ordinance and omits the Seventh Schedule.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956. It substitutes specific wording in Section 3 regarding the date an elected member takes office.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Pure Food (Amendment) Act, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960, to update terminology and definitions regarding food products. It substitutes specific terms like 'Food Authority' with 'Local Authority' and provides detailed definitions for items such as adulterated food, butter, milk, and margarine.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: Sind Home Guards Act, 1948; West Punjab Qaumi Razakars Act, 1949; North-West Frontier Qaumi Razakars Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to Qaumi Razakars in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes a body called the Qaumi Razakars under the control of the Deputy Commissioner, defining their duties, organization, and legal protections while repealing previous acts related to Home Guards and Qaumi Razakars in other provinces.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REGULATION AND CONTROL OF LOUDSPEAKERS AND SOUND AMPLIFIERS ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Regulation of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of loudspeakers and sound amplifiers in the Province of West Pakistan to prevent public nuisance and disorder. It prohibits their operation in specific locations such as residential areas, places of worship during prayer times, hospitals, and educational institutions, while allowing exceptions for religious ceremonies like Azan and Khutba.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SEEDS AND FRUIT PLANTS ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Seeds and Fruit Plants Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better production and distribution of high-quality seeds and fruit plants in West Pakistan. It establishes a system for registering growers, certifying seeds and plants, and regulating their disposal.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation to promote the development of small and cottage industries in the province. It defines key terms such as 'small industry' and 'cottage industry', and sets up the corporate structure including a Board of Directors appointed by the Governor.

name: WEST PAKISTAN STATUTORY BODIES (APPOINTMENT AND REMOVAL OF LEGAL ADVISERS) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Statutory Bodies (Appointment and Removal of Legal Advisers) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1959; The West Pakistan (University of Sind) Ordinance, 1961; The West Pakistan (University of Punjab) Ordinance, 1961; The West Pakistan (University of Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961; The West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for government control and supervision over the appointment, engagement, and removal of legal advisers and legal practitioners by statutory bodies in West Pakistan. It stipulates that no statutory body can appoint a legal adviser or engage a legal practitioner without prior government approval and grants the government the power to remove such personnel.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TOBACCO VEND ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958 by substituting the words 'town committee' for 'notified area' in clause (h) of section 2. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution due to immediate legislative necessity.

name: WEST PAKISTAN UNIVERSITIES AND BOARDS OF EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Universities and Boards of Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Universities and Boards of Education Ordinances, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various Ordinances from 1961 regarding the establishment of universities and education boards in West Pakistan. It grants the Governor power to review the work of Chairmen and Vice-Chancellors and reduce their terms of office if necessary.

name: WEST PAKISTAN UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1961. It substitutes section 24 to require that certain matters regarding posts, teachers, appointments, departmental duties, and faculties be referred to the Academic Council for final consideration before being taken up by the Syndicate.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959 to update fair rent calculations for residential and non-residential buildings. It establishes specific rent rates based on construction dates, lease terms, and permitted increases, while also defining procedures for determining just rent in complex cases involving sub-letting or furnished premises.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WEIGHTS AND MEASURES ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Weights and Measures Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the laws regulating the use of weights and measures in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'Government', 'Inspector', and various standards, while outlining procedures for preparing, verifying, and maintaining secondary and working standards.

name: WORKING JOURNALISTS (CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965

metadata.title: The Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960, to specify a period during which Wage Board decisions remain in force. It extends to the whole of West Pakistan except the Tribal Areas and comes into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (Extension) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to the Divisions of Quetta and Kalat. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan and assented to by the Governor on April 11, 1964.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: law relating to Motor Vehicles in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws relating to motor vehicles in the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces a requirement for issuing notice to the Government or statutory authorities before granting an injunction against them, with specific exceptions and time limits.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It incorporates recommendations from the Law Commission regarding witness summons, supply of police statements to the accused, and procedures for trials before Courts of Session.

name: CONCILIATION COURTS ORDINANCE (EXTENSION TO TRIBAL AREAS OF QUETTA DIVISION) REGULATION, 1964

metadata.title: The Conciliation Courts Ordinance (Extension to Tribal Areas of Quetta Division) Regulation, 1964
metadata.summary: This regulation extends the Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961 to the Tribal Areas of Quetta Division in West Pakistan. It was made by the Governor with the approval of the President under Article 223 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Forest (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces new provisions for courts to direct the eviction of accused persons and the removal of encroachments from Reserved and Protected forests within a fixed period.

name: KARACHI CONTROL OF DISORDERLY PERSONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution. It amends the Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952, specifically substituting the year 1964 with 1965 in Section 1 and the preamble of the original Act.

name: KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 to regulate the appointment of legal advisors and the handling of pending court matters by the Authority. It mandates that no person can be appointed as a legal advisor or entrusted with pending cases without prior government approval.

metadata.title: The Karachi Road Transport Corporation (Repeal) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.repeals: The Karachi Road Transport Corporation Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Karachi Road Transport Corporation Ordinance, 1959. It provides for the dissolution of the Corporation and the immediate transfer of its assets, liabilities, rights, and obligations to a successor company.

metadata.title: The Central Adaptation of Laws Order, 1964
metadata.summary: This Order is made by the President of Pakistan to adapt existing laws in force immediately before the commencement day to align with the Constitution. It provides for modifications, additions, or omissions necessary to bring these laws into accord with constitutional provisions.

name: LAND CONTROL (CAPITAL OF THE FEDERATION) (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.repeals: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal the Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1948. It was issued under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes a new definition for 'motor cab' in section 2 of the parent Act.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It inserts a new section (64-A) that excludes civil courts from entertaining matters or questioning the legality of actions taken by Provincial or Regional Transport Authorities under this Act.

name: NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HAZARA FOREST (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Hazara Forest (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The North-West Frontier Province Hazara Forest Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act amends the North-West Frontier Province Hazara Forest Act, 1936 to address issues regarding land possession and encroachments. It introduces new sections empowering courts to order the delivery of possession or removal of encroachments within a specified period and imposes fines for continued occupation.

name: NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE TENANCY (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Tenancy (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The North-West Frontier Province Tenancy Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the North-West Frontier Province Tenancy Act, 1950 to apply specific provisions regarding rent and government dues to Upper Tanawal in Hazara District. It limits tenant rent to forty percent of the produce and adjusts liability for government dues based on the share of produce received by the tenant.

metadata.title: The Penal Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Penal Code as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'rigorous' for the word 'simple' in sections 500, 501, and 502 of the Penal Code.

name: PAKISTAN MEMORIAL CESS (WEST PAKISTAN) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a special cess to raise funds for the Pakistan Memorial in West Pakistan. The levy applies to admission tickets for cinema houses and race-courses at specified rates per ticket.

name: PROVINCIAL INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Amendment Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962. It specifically substitutes clause (1) of section 2 to redefine 'Small Industry' regarding handicrafts or consumer/producer goods.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939; Sind Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1940; Bahawalpur Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 to extend its application to the whole of West Pakistan and update references from 'Punjab' to 'Province of West Pakistan'. It also repeals three specific agricultural produce market acts from NWFP, Sind, and Bahawalpur while preserving existing actions taken under those repealed laws.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF WEST PAKISTAN PRIVILEGES ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan Privileges Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act defines the privileges of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan, its Members, and Committees. It establishes civil and criminal immunities for Members regarding matters brought before the Assembly and restricts preventive detention or court proceedings during Assembly sessions.

name: PUNJAB TOWN IMPROVEMENT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The Town Improvement (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Town Improvement Act, 1922 by substituting specific wording in clause (1) of section 12 regarding trustees. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB SOIL RECLAMATION WEST PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The Punjab Soil Reclamation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The Punjab Soil Reclamation Act, West Pakistan, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Soil Reclamation Act, 1952, to extend its application to the whole of West Pakistan. It updates specific terminology within the Act and modifies sections regarding the Board's composition, powers, and definitions related to soil reclamation and agricultural production.

metadata.title: The Railways (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Railways Act, 1890 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It achieves this by omitting specific clauses and words from various sections of the original 1890 Act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION LAHORE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1961. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan on March 24, 1964, and assented to by the Governor on March 17, 1964.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION PESHAWAR) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan on March 13, 1964, and received assent from the Governor on March 17, 1964.

name: WEST PAKISTAN BOARD OF REVENUE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Board of Revenue Act, 1957 by inserting specific words into section 8. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan and assented to by the Governor on April 3, 1964.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONSOLIDATION OF HOLDINGS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1964 (Amendment)
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960. It adds a new sub-section to section 11 regarding the limitation period for appeals under the Ordinance.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Amendment Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to further amend the West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963. It clarifies the interpretation of specific words in Part A of the First Schedule regarding their applicability only to offences under Section 307 of the Pakistan Penal Code.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CRIMINAL LAW (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958. It substitutes the word 'weight' for the word 'six' in a specific subsection of the original Act.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Family Courts in West Pakistan to expedite the settlement of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs. It defines the qualifications for judges, outlines the procedure for instituting suits, and grants exclusive jurisdiction to these courts over specified matters.

metadata.title: The Stamp (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.repeals: Indian Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to apply it specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes various monetary values and duties throughout the principal Act and repeals the Indian Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1922.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties in West Pakistan for the financial year 1964-65. It establishes specific surcharges on land revenue, taxes on cinemas, motor vehicles, railway fares, and tolls on vessels plying in inland waters.

name: WEST PAKISTAN FIREWOOD AND CHARGOAL (REGISTRATION) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Firewood and Charcoal (Restriction) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits and regulates the burning of firewood and charcoal in factories, brick-kilns, lime-kilns, and other specified places within West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'factory' and 'firewood', outlines specific exemptions for domestic use and certain industrial processes, and establishes penalties including imprisonment or fines for violations.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan General Clauses (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956 by modifying the definition of 'Commissioner' in Section 2. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan and received assent from the Governor on March 13, 1964.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HISTORICAL MOSQUES FUND CESS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'ten' for the word 'five' in subsection (4) of section 3 of the said Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HORSE RACE BETTING TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Horse-Race Betting Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958 to extend its application to the whole of West Pakistan except the Tribal Areas. It also adds a clause regarding the applicability of the Sind Betting Tax Act, 1938, to the Karachi District.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GHULAM MUHAMMAD BARRAGE BETTERMENT TAX ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Barrage Betterment Tax Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of a betterment tax on Kabuli lands irrigated by the Ghulam Muhammad Barrage Canals in West Pakistan. It establishes specific tax rates for perennial and non-perennial zones, outlines the process for preparing demand statements, and details provisions for objections, appeals, and recovery of arrears.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HORSE RACE BETTING TAX (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958 to update definitions of tax officers and modify provisions regarding tax levies on book-makers. It introduces new sections for government payments to managers for tax collection and updates references from Divisional Excise Officers to the Director of Excise and Taxation.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Jamia Islamia (Bahawalpur) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and re-organizes the West Pakistan Jamia Islamia in Bahawalpur as a corporate body. It empowers the institution to manage affiliated Madrasas and Dar-ul-Ulooms, confer degrees, and conduct research in Islamic subjects.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LAWS (EXTENSION TO KARACHI) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Laws (Extension to Karachi) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends various West Pakistan enactments to the District of Karachi. It also repeals corresponding laws previously in force within that specific district.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 by adding a new explanation to Section 3. The amendment clarifies that members of associations declared unlawful within the preceding seven days are deemed to be acting prejudicially to public order.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to consolidate laws regarding preventive detention and control. It introduces new provisions for a Board to review detention cases exceeding three months and modifies sections related to arrest custody and legal representation.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 to extend its application to the whole of West Pakistan except the Tribal Areas. It also modifies Section 17 of the principal Act to include the Sind Motor Vehicles Tax Act, 1939 as applicable to Karachi.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962 by omitting subsection (2) of section 7. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan and assented to by the Governor on April 4, 1964.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act levies a cess on tickets for admission to cinema houses and race-courses in West Pakistan. The collected funds are intended to raise money for the Pakistan Memorial.

name: WEST PAKISTAN NATIONAL CALAMITIES (PREVENTION AND RELIEF) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958 to update provisions regarding relief commissioners and powers during calamities. It introduces new sections for appointing relief commissioners and clarifies the scope of their authority in declared calamity-affected areas.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1964
metadata.summary: This Order adapts existing laws applicable in West Pakistan to align with the Constitution of Pakistan. It authorizes the Governor to make necessary modifications, additions, or omissions to ensure these laws are consistent with constitutional provisions regarding the President and provincial legislatures.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Primary Education (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962. It specifically substitutes a clause in section 8 regarding the appointment of five members by the Commissioner.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRESS AND PUBLICATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Press and Publications (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963 to strengthen provisions regarding public order and national security. It introduces new powers for District Magistrates to refuse authentication of declarations from printers or publishers suspected of acting prejudicially to defense or security, while also providing mechanisms for appeals and modifications by the Government.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROHIBITION OF WALVER ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Walver Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the giving or accepting of 'walver' (a payment made in consideration of betrothal or marriage) within the Division of Quetta in West Pakistan. It defines 'walver' as cash or kind paid to a woman's parent, guardian, or relative and establishes penalties for those who give, agree to give, or accept such payments.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Primary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962 to update definitions regarding appropriate authorities for schools and transfer teachers to government service. It also modifies provisions concerning local council liabilities, omits specific sections, and establishes new rules for funding primary education through various government and municipal sources.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956 to update provisions regarding member allowances and residence periods. It specifically substitutes explanations in Section 2 concerning ordinary residence and adds new explanations to Section 5 detailing rates for half-day allowances and rules for reckoning journey time.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REGULATION OF LOUD SPEAKERS AND SOUND AMPLIFIERS ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the use of loudspeakers and sound amplifiers in the Province of West Pakistan. It requires permission from the Deputy Commissioner for operation in public places and sets conditions regarding volume, timing, and location restrictions to prevent annoyance or disturbance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SUPPRESSION OF PROSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the existing West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961. It specifically substitutes clause (a) in section 2 regarding the definition of a 'brothel' to include places where facilities are known to be available for prostitution.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Timber Market (Lahore) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Timber Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Timber Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963 to clarify the powers of the Lahore Premile Improvement Trust. The amendments address specific authorities regarding site layout modifications, cancellation and re-allotment of sites, auction methods, and restrictions on bamboo merchants within Lahore.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REDEMPTION AND RESTITUTION OF MORTGAGED LANDS ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the redemption and restitution of certain mortgages of land in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes procedures for mortgagors to apply for redemption, declare due sums, and obtain possession of their land after paying the mortgage amount and costs.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TOBACCO VEND (EXTENSION TO KARACHI) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend (Extension to Karachi) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958 to extend its provisions to the District of Karachi. It specifically substitutes a clause in section 1 to exclude the Tribal Areas from the Act's application and inserts a new clause regarding Bombay's application to Karachi.

name: WEST PAKISTAN UNIVERSITY OF PESHAWAR (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan University of Peshawar (Amendment) Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan (University of Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan (University of Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961. It specifically updates definitions regarding registered graduates and modifies the composition rules for the Syndicate within the university.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Universities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several Ordinances relating to universities in West Pakistan, specifically inserting new sections regarding the appointment of legal advisors. It mandates that no person can be appointed as a legal advisor or entrusted with pending court matters without the prior approval of the Government and unless the practitioner is on an approved list.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1961 to provide powers for the Administrator to summarily evict unauthorized occupants and terminate leases or tenancies upon breach of conditions. It establishes procedures for compensation regarding crops and improvements, outlines appeal mechanisms to the Chief Administrator, and adds provisions for prescribing lease terms.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958. It specifically adds a new sub-section to section 17 regarding the appointment of legal advisors and restrictions on legal practitioners handling cases where the Authority is a party.

metadata.title: The Agror Valley Regulation (Repeal) Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: The Agror Valley Regulation, 1891
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan on April 1, 1963, and received assent from the Governor on April 13, 1963. Its sole purpose is to repeal the Agror Valley Regulation, 1891.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: THE CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 as it applies to West Pakistan. It introduces a new section requiring courts to award compensation to heirs or victims in cases involving death, injury, or property loss during sentencing.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (PUNJAB) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912 to extend its application to the District of Lasbela. It substitutes a specific subsection listing various districts in West Pakistan where the Act applies.

name: BASIC DEMOCRACIES ORDER (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Basic Democracies (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Basic Democracies Order, 1959 (P.O. No. 18 of 1959)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Basic Democracies Order, 1959, to apply specific changes to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces provisions regarding no-confidence motions for Chairmen and Vice-Chairmen of various local bodies, establishes new roles like Vice-Chairman in District Councils, and modifies clauses related to municipal bodies and election authorities.

name: CONCILIATION COURTS ORDINANCE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The Conciliation Courts Ordinance (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces a new section allowing persons sentenced under specific sections to apply for sentence modification if there has been a failure of justice.

metadata.title: The Frontier Crimes Regulation (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901, by substituting specific subsections and adding a new Third Schedule. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: ELECTION OF CHAIRMEN AND VICE-CHAIRMEN OF MUNICIPAL COMMITTEES (VALIDATING) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Election of Chairmen and Vice-Chairmen of Local Councils and Vice-Chairmen of Municipal Committees (Validating) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the elections of Chairmen and Vice-Chairmen for Local Councils and Municipal Committees held in West Pakistan under specific orders and ordinances from 1959 and 1960. It declares these elections valid despite any procedural irregularities regarding ballot forms or serial number recording, ensuring they cannot be challenged in court.

name: KARACHI CONTROL OF DISORDERLY PERSONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952. It was issued because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary under Article 79 of the Constitution.

name: FRONTIER CRIMES REGULATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Frontier Crimes Regulation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901, to apply specifically to the Quetta and Kalat Divisions. It inserts a new subsection allowing for immediate measures, including bonds or custody, pending an enquiry to prevent offences.

name: MARRI BUGTI (EXTENSION OF THE PUNJAB LAND REVENUE ACT) REGULATION, 1963

metadata.title: The Marri Bugti (Extension of the Punjab Land Revenue Act) Regulation, 1963
metadata.summary: This regulation extends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 (as applicable to Baluchistan) to the Tribal Area of Marri Bugti. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan with the approval of the President and comes into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It inserts new provisions regarding trespass on municipal property and grants Municipal Committees the power to eject trespassers with necessary force.

name: MOTOR VEHICLES WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 to replace references to the 'West Pakistan Road Transport Board' with the 'Road Transport Corporation'. It establishes the structure of the new Corporation, including the terms and conditions for its Chairman and Members, while allowing the existing Board to continue functioning until the Corporation is fully established.

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960, specifically regarding its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes a new subsection in section 11 concerning the conditions under which the Vice-Chairman must vacate office following a vote of no-confidence.

name: PAKISTAN PENAL CODE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The Pakistan Penal Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Penal Code as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes certain words and commas in section 304-A regarding sentencing terms.

metadata.title: The Press and Publications (West Pakistan) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Press and Publications Ordinance, 1960 to extend its application to West Pakistan. It introduces new definitions for 'printer' and 'publisher', restricts the publication of certain court and assembly proceedings without official authorization, and establishes powers for government inquiries into printing press affairs.

name: PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS OF NATIONAL ASSEMBLY (EXEMPTION FROM PREVENTIVE DETENTION AND PERSONAL APPEARANCE) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The Privileges of Members of National Assembly (Exemption from Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act provides exemptions for Members of the National Assembly from preventive detention and personal appearance in Civil, Revenue Courts, or before Election Tribunals during specific periods surrounding a session. It grants these privileges automatically unless waived in writing by the concerned Member(s).

name: PROVINCIAL INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION WEST PAKISTAN (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962 to update definitions and expand the Corporation's powers. It introduces new clauses regarding loans, guarantees for cottage and small industries, and establishes limits on financial commitments.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL INCOME-TAX (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income-Tax (Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income-Tax Act, 1951 by adding new subsections to Section 8. The amendments clarify the treatment of land transfers made between May 1952 and June 1954 in favor of wives or heirs under eighteen years of age.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVICES (WAR) AMENDMENT RULES (WEST PAKISTAN REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Government Services (War) Amendment Rules (West Pakistan Repeal) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Punjab Government Services (War) Amendment Rules, 1943
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Government Services (War) Amendment Rules, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Punjab Government Services (War) Amendment Rules, 1943, and validates certain actions taken under those rules. It also provides for the determination of seniority for government servants who rendered war service.

name: PUNJAB LAND REVENUE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 as it applies to specific territories in West Pakistan. It introduces a new section (37-A) regarding the acquisition and transfer of interests in evacuee land under the Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Act, 1958.

name: PUNJAB MINOR CANALS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The Punjab Minor Canals (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Minor Canals Act of 1905 to apply specific provisions to certain areas of West Pakistan. It substitutes text in sections 1, 69, and 70 of the principal Act to reflect the new jurisdictional scope.

name: RAILWAYS (TRANSPORT OF GOODS) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947, to update specific sections regarding railway administration and government references. It substitutes numerical values in section 1, redefines 'railway administration' in section 2, changes 'Central Government' to 'Provincial Government' in sections 3 and 6, and modifies wording in sections 4 and 5.

name: SIND COURT OF WARDS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Sind Court of Wards (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Sind Court of Wards Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Court of Wards Act, 1905 to modify provisions regarding the disqualification of landholders and pension-holders. It introduces specific conditions under which property may be preserved for families of political or social importance and updates clauses related to physical defects, habits, and criminal convictions affecting property management.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to press and publication in West Pakistan. It establishes requirements for printing presses, mandates declarations by printers and publishers, and regulates the publication of newspapers and news-sheets.

name: SIND VILLAGE OFFICERS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Sind Village Officers (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Village Officers Act, 1881 by updating the list of districts covered under its provisions. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on May 27, 1963, under Article 79 of the Constitution to address immediate legislative circumstances.

name: SUGAR FACTORIES CONTROL (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (West Pakistan) Amendment Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950 to allow the Provincial Government of West Pakistan to appoint Additional Cane Commissioners. These officials are authorized to exercise powers and perform duties of the Cane Commissioner in specified districts.

name: SIND RURAL CREDIT AND LAND TRANSFER (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The Sind Rural Credit and Land Transfer (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.amends: The Sind Rural Credit and Land Transfer Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Rural Credit and Land Transfer Act, 1947 to regulate permanent alienation of agricultural land in favor of creditors. It also defines specific categories of debtors and imposes restrictions on mortgaging land when the mortgagee is a creditor.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ABOLITION OF CESSR (HABUBS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Abolition of Cesses (Habubs) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Abolition of Cesses (Habubs) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the West Pakistan Abolition of Cesses (Habubs) Ordinance, 1962. It omits specific words regarding 'areas' and 'revenue paying areas' from section 2 of the amended ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (REVENUE OFFICERS AND REVENUE COURTS OF SHEIKHUPURA) REGULATION OF PROCEEDINGS ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Revenue Officers and Revenue Courts of Sheikhupura) Regularisation of Proceedings Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regularizes acts and proceedings taken by Revenue Officers and Revenue Courts in the district of Sheikhupura between August 8, 1960, and April 23, 1962. It validates these actions even if they were performed beyond the official limits of the district or while sitting in specific premises like Shahdara Tehsil estates.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY (RESIDENCE OF GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (Residence of Government Officials) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific property in Mauza Mian Mir, District Lahore, to be used as a residence for Government Officials. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 115 issued on February 24, 1962, and mandates compensation of ninety-six thousand rupees to Mr. Nasir-ud-Din and party.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY (WAPDA HOUSE) (SECOND) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office) (Second) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific properties in Lahore to construct the office of the Water and Power Development Authority. It also validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Orders regarding these properties.

name: WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961. It substitutes provisions regarding the appointment of whole-time Directors and modifies rules concerning the distribution of supplies through co-operative societies.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY (WAPDA HOUSE) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific property in Lahore to construct the office of the Water and Power Development Authority. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 129 regarding this property.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ANTI-CORRUPTION ESTABLISHMENT (EXTENSION TO TRIBAL AREAS OF QUETTA, D.I. KHAN AND PESHAWAR DIVISION) REGULATION, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment (Extension to Tribal Areas of Quetta, Dera Ismail Khan and Peshawar Divisions) Regulation, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961 to the Tribal Areas of Quetta, Dera Ismail Khan, and Peshawar Divisions. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan with the approval of the President on October 31, 1963.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ANIMALS SLAUGHTER CONTROL ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the slaughter of useful animals and regulates the slaughter of other animals in West Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms like 'animal', 'carcass', and 'useful animal', while mandating veterinary inspections before slaughter can occur.

name: WEST PAKISTAN BUS STAND AND TRAFFIC CONTROL (GUJRANWALA) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Martial Law Orders (Continuance in Force) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion within the municipal limits of Gujranwala. It regulates vehicular movement, mandates the removal of existing petrol pumps from specific sites on the Grand Trunk Road, and validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Orders.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 by inserting new subsections regarding the jurisdiction of District Judges and the High Court based on suit values. It also provides for the transfer of civil suits between courts under specific provisions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN BUS STAND AND TRAFFIC CONTROL (LAHORE) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion within the Lahore Municipal Corporation. It also validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Order No. 112 and West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 by modifying Section 21 regarding the jurisdiction of civil courts based on suit value. Specifically, it adjusts the threshold for suits instituted in the Court of the District Judge, Additional District Judge, or Civil Judge of the First Class versus the High Court.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CIVIL COURTS ORDINANCE (EXTENSION TO TRIBAL AREAS OF QUETTA DIVISION) REGULATION, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance (Extension to Tribal Areas of Quetta Division) Regulation, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the application of the West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to the Tribal Areas forming part of Quetta Division. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan with the approval of the President under the authority granted by Article 223 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963 to address issues related to blood feuds and public peace. It introduces provisions for District Magistrates to require bonds with or without sureties from individuals likely to cause bloodshed or quarrels between families.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958 to update references regarding distribution and prices. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the more speedy trial and effective punishment of certain heinous offences in West Pakistan. It also aims to take effective steps for the eradication of corruption.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963 to adjust stamp duty rates for debt acknowledgements and receipts. It specifies new fee structures based on the amount of money or property involved and clarifies the validity of documents executed before the Ordinance came into force.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1962 by deleting section 8. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under emergency powers because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ESTABLISHMENT AND IMPROVEMENT OF PARKS AND HISTORICAL PLACES (LAHORE) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Establishment and Improvement of Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of public parks and gardens, as well as the reconstruction and renovation of historical places in Lahore. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 126 regarding land acquisition and residential site sales.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 to extend its provisions to the whole of West Pakistan except the Tribal Areas. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN INDUSTRIES (CONTROL ON ESTABLISHMENT AND ENLARGEMENT ) ORDINANCE 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industries (Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the organized and planned growth of industries in West Pakistan. It regulates the establishment or enlargement of industrial undertakings, requiring prior written government permission, and defines specific criteria for what constitutes an 'industrial undertaking' based on worker numbers.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific surcharges on land revenue and introduces new taxes on agricultural income, cinema operations, professional fees, and export/import licenses for the financial year 1963-64.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 by modifying specific entries in section 28. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on May 10, 1963, to address circumstances requiring immediate legislation.

name: WEST PAKISTAN INDUSTRIES (CONTROL ON ESTABLISHMENT AND ENLARGEMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the organized and planned growth of industries in West Pakistan. It restricts the establishment or enlargement of industrial undertakings without prior written permission from the Government.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Act, 1962. It terminates limited estates in respect of immovable property held by Muslim females under customary law and omits a specific subsection from section 7 of the said Act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN NATIONAL CALAMITIES (PREVENTION AND RELIEF ACT) (EXTENSION TO TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act (Extension to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This regulation extends the West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958 to the Tribal Areas of Quetta, Dera Ismail Khan, and Peshawar Divisions. It was made by the Governor of West Pakistan with the approval of the President and comes into force immediately.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Nursing Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Nursing Services Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Nursing Services Ordinance, 1959, to update specific clauses regarding government health officials. It substitutes new entries in the Schedule to include roles such as the Nursing Superintendent at Lahore General Hospital and updates references to various nursing officers within the Health Department.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956 to provide additional benefits to assembly members. Specifically, it grants each member a free non-transferable first-class railway pass for up to 5,000 miles per year and entitlement to free indoor and outdoor medical facilities equivalent to those of a Class I Officer of the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Pure Food (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to update provisions regarding the sale of specific food items and the powers of inspectors. It also inserts new clauses to expand inspection authorities and empower magistrates to try related offences summarily.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RECOVERY OF COST (COPIES OF ESSENTIAL REVENUE RECORDS) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of costs incurred by the Government of West Pakistan in preparing and supplying copies of essential revenue records to Union Councils. It defines key terms such as 'essential revenue record' and 'estate', mandates that these copies be made available for public inspection, and establishes that the associated costs shall be recovered from land revenue payers.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the production and marketing of milk and milk products in certain areas of West Pakistan. It establishes Milk Boards as corporate bodies with defined structures, membership terms, and powers to acquire property and manage operations within the province.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SUPPRESSION OF PROSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958. It substitutes a specific sub-section in section 1 and inserts new words into section 24 regarding the application of the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act to Karachi.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to update definitions and tax provisions. It specifically revises clauses regarding family members of owners, expands the definition of 'owner' to include mortgagees and evacuee property holders, and adjusts tax rates and exemptions for residential buildings.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959 by adding a proviso to section 13. The amendment specifies conditions under which a landlord can apply for possession of a residential building if the tenant or their dependents own another residential building in the same urban area within sixty days preceding the Act's commencement.

name: WEST PAKISTAN USE OF LOUD SPEAKERS (PROHIBITION) ORDINANCE, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Use of Loudspeakers (Prohibition) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the use of loudspeakers in West Pakistan except with permission from the Deputy Commissioner and for specific purposes like Azan.
