It establishes penalties for violations, including imprisonment or fines, and grants the government powers to make exempting orders and rules.

metadata.title: The Whipping (West Pakistan) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Whipping Act, 1909 to apply specific provisions regarding whipping as punishment for certain offences in West Pakistan. It inserts new sections defining offences punishable by whipping and mandates compulsory whipping for specific crimes involving minors or disfigurement.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vegetable Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a wholesale vegetable market in Lahore and validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Orders. It provides for the immediate acquisition of land, compensation assessment, and the regulation of vegetable dealers within the municipal limits.

metadata.title: The Forest (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Forest Act, 1927 as it applies to certain districts of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'vehicles' for the word 'carts' wherever it occurs in the Act.

metadata.title: Forest Laws Amendment Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: Forest Act, 1927; North-West Frontier Province Forest Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends specific sections of the Forest Act, 1927 and the North-West Frontier Province Forest Act, 1936 to substitute references to the Central Government with Provincial Government. It also validates certain duties that were previously levied and collected under these amended sections before the Ordinance's promulgation.

name: FRONTIER CRIMES REGULATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Frontier Crimes Regulation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901, specifically regarding its application to certain areas in West Pakistan. It introduces new definitions for 'Council of Elders' and 'Commissioner', adds provisions for property forfeiture in specific conviction cases, omits a subsection on revisional jurisdiction for certain districts, and validates actions taken under the regulation between February 10 and April 19, 1962.

name: GWADUR (APPLICATION OF WEST PAKISTAN LAWS) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Gwadur (Application of West Pakistan Laws) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan (Gwadur) Extension of Laws Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends all West Pakistan laws, acts, and notifications to the territory of Gwadur. It deems these laws to have been in force in Gwadur since September 8, 1958, the date Gwadur became part of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Hazara Forest (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Hazara Forest Act, 1936 by substituting the word 'one-fifth' with 'cone-half' in sub-section (1) of section 14. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan pursuant to Presidential Proclamation instructions.

name: KARACHI CONTROL OF DISORDERLY PERSONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952 by updating specific years and substituting references to 'Agent' and 'Provincial Government' with 'Central Government'. It also omits Section 1-A from the said Act.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879 by adding a new sub-section to Section 8 and inserting a new section 135-JJ. The amendments establish the Deputy Commissioner as the Collector for a district and authorize the Board of Revenue to fix scales of fees for record entries and copies.

name: PUNJAB LAND REVENUE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 as it applies to the Province of Punjab in West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes subsection (3) of section 51 regarding the rate of assessment imposed on any area.

name: PUNJAB LAND REVENUE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 to apply to certain parts of West Pakistan. It grants the Government power to assess or re-assess land revenue in specific areas where previous assessment periods have expired, within two years of the Ordinance's commencement.

metadata.title: The Miani Sahib Graveyard Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No. 131
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of Martial Law Order No. 131 regarding the Miani Sahib Graveyard until the expiry of that order. It promotes the functions of the Lahore Graveyard Committee constituted under the West Pakistan Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958.

name: PUNJAB TOWN IMPROVEMENT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Punjab Town Improvement (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 to the Province of West Pakistan and amends its provisions accordingly. It substitutes specific sections within the principal Act to align terminology with the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960, and updates rules regarding the constitution and management of improvement trusts.

name: SIND EDUCATION CESS (WEST PAKISTAN REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Sind Education Cess (West Pakistan Repeal) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: Sind Muslim Education Cess Act, 1946; Sind Muslim Education Cess (Extension) Act, 1947; Sind Muslim Education Cess (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals three specific Acts relating to the Sind Muslim Education Cess enacted by the Province of Sind. It also provides for the transfer of any remaining proceeds from these repealed Acts to the general revenues of West Pakistan.

name: SIND LAND REVENUE CODE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879 by adding a new sub-section to Section 8 and inserting a new section 135-JJ. The amendments establish the Deputy Commissioner as the Collector for a district and authorize the Board of Revenue to fix scales of fees for record entries and copies.

metadata.title: Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Registration Act, 1908 to clarify definitions of immovable and movable property and update sections regarding leases, mortgages, and wills. It also introduces provisions preventing parties from challenging the validity of a registered document after registration has occurred.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 as it applies to West Pakistan. It inserts a new section (16A) granting the provincial government the power to dissolve a society's governing body and reorganize it if deemed necessary.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION AND REPEAL OF LAWS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) Act, 1957. It specifically directs the omission of entries relating to the Baluchistan States Union in Schedule II of the aforementioned Act.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Laws) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance adapts and amends certain laws applicable in the Province of West Pakistan following the implementation of the Provincial Re-organization Committee's Report. It replaces specific expressions in existing laws with new terms to reflect changes in government titles and abolished posts, and it deems specified Acts adapted according to the schedule.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ABOLITION OF CESSES (HABUBS) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Abolition of Cesses (Habubs) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes all cesses (Habubs) leviable in cash or kind within the Kalat Division of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'cess', 'Government', and 'land owner' to clarify the scope of the abolition.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION, KARACHI) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Karachi) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the Karachi Board of Secondary Education, establishing it as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines key terms related to institutions, examinations, and governance, while outlining the composition, tenure, resignation, removal, and meeting procedures for the Board's members.

name: WEST PAKISTAN BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes and organizes the West Pakistan Board of Technical Education. It defines the Board as a body corporate, outlines its membership composition, and establishes rules for meetings, vacancies, and resignations.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: law relating to Civil Courts in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws relating to Civil Courts in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes classes of civil courts, including those for District Judges, Additional District Judges, and Civil Judges, and defines their respective jurisdictions and powers.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF GOONDAS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959 by adding a new section. The amendment allows a Public Prosecutor to withdraw proceedings before a Tribunal with the Tribunal's consent and mandates the release or discharge of the accused if they are in custody solely for those proceedings.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF GOONDAS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959 by adding new clauses to Section 13. The amendments expand the definition of goondas to include those who deal in stolen property or habitually seduce, kidnap, or abduct women and minors.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CO-OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Development Board Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Co-operative Development Board to promote and supervise the co-operative movement in the province. It defines the Board's constitution, including its Chairman and members appointed by the Government and the Co-operative Union, and outlines its powers to appoint officers and manage co-operative affairs.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Federal Capital (Essential) Supplies Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958 by deleting specific words from section 1. It also repeals the Federal Capital (Essential) Supplies Order, 1956.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This document is an Order issued by the Governor of West Pakistan on September 22, 1962. It amends section 1 of the Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958 by substituting the word 'four' with the word 'eight'. The order was signed by Malik Amir Mohammad Khan and countersigned by Malik Abdul Hamid.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Excess Appropriation (Repeal) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Excess Appropriation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal the West Pakistan Excess Appropriation Ordinance, 1960. It was published in the Gazette on May 4, 1962, and deemed to have taken effect from May 25, 1962.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT DUES RECOVERY ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Recovery Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of government dues in the Province of West Pakistan as if they were arrears of land revenue. It defines key terms such as 'defaulter' and 'Government', allows the Governor to declare specific dues recoverable under the Revenue Recoveries Act, 1890, and empowers the Government to make rules for its implementation.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (EXTENSION TO KARACHI DIVISION) ACT, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions (Extension to Karachi Division) Act, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960 to the Karachi Division. The extension is deemed effective from June 5, 1962.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960. It modifies definitions regarding 'Government Servant' and changes contribution language from voluntary to compulsory.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties in West Pakistan. It establishes new surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax for specific districts, introduces a development cess on lands, modifies stamp duty rates, and imposes a tax on cinemas.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959. It specifically omits the word 'West' from sub-section (2) of section 1 of the original 1959 Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN INSTITUTE OF TEXTILE TECHNOLOGY CESS ACT, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology Cess Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to establish and maintain the Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology in Lyallpur. It authorizes the levying of a cess on spindles and power-looms installed in textile mills within the Province of West Pakistan.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960. It specifically omits certain words from section 1 of the original 1960 Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to establish a Board for reviewing detention cases. It introduces restrictions on the duration of detention without Board authority and outlines procedures for secret proceedings regarding legal representation during Board reviews.

name: WEST PAKISTAN KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957, to update provisions regarding the composition of the Governing Body and the appointment of the Director-General. It also establishes new rules for member tenure, remuneration, and defines specific authorities responsible for disciplinary actions based on salary levels.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MARTIAL LAW ORDERS (CONTINUANCE IN FORCE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Martial Law Orders (Continuance in Force) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Martial Law Orders (Continuance in Force) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Martial Law Orders (Continuance in Force) Ordinance, 1962. The amendment specifically inserts a figure and comma after 'No.' in section 1, subsection (2) of the original Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MARTIAL LAW ORDERS (CONTINUANCE IN FORCE) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Martial Law Orders (Continuance in Force) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: Martial Law Orders Nos. 111, 112, 118, 119 and 121 issued by the Martial Law Administrator Zone B
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues in force certain Martial Law Orders issued by the Martial Law Administrator of Zone B. It also incorporates specific amendments to these orders, primarily adding or substituting clauses that define punishments for contravention.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) ACT, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Limitation (Custom) Act, 1920; The Punjab Custom (Power to Contest) Act, 1920; The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937; The North-West Frontier Province Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1935; The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1948; The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Sind Amendment) Act, 1950; The Bahawalpur State Shariat (Muslim Personal Law) Application Act, 1951; The Khairpur State Muslim Female Inheritance (Removal of Customs) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the provisions for the application of Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes Shariat as the rule of decision for various personal law matters among Muslims and terminates limited estates held by Muslim females under customary law.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Amendment Act, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956 to increase mileage allowances and daily rates for members traveling by rail or air. It specifically substitutes higher monetary values in the principal Act and adds new provisions regarding entitlements for journeys performed in air-conditioned accommodation or first class.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rangers (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 to update definitions, modify sentencing terms, and revise disciplinary procedures. It specifically alters sections regarding criminal force definitions, imprisonment durations, and types of administrative penalties available to the Force.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REGISTRATION OF UNRECOGNIZED EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Registration of Unrecognized Educational Institutions Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration of unrecognized private educational institutions in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the authority responsible for registration, defines key terms such as 'unrecognized private educational institution', and outlines the process for applying for registration certificates.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Requisitioned Land Powers Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958 by omitting specific words regarding the Federal Capital and substituting provisions related to compensation determination. It also repeals the Requisitioned Land Powers Order, 1956, with its provisions applying as if the repealed Order were a West Pakistan Act of 1956.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: law relating to primary education in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the laws relating to primary education in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'child', 'District', and 'primary school', and establishes provisions for transferring local council properties and staff to government control upon its enforcement.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION (DISSOLUTION) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1960 and the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Establishment and Actions) Validating Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dissolution of the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation. It transfers all assets, liabilities, and employees to the Industrial Development Corporation while repealing previous ordinances related to the corporation's establishment.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION (ESTABLISHMENT AND ACTIONS) VALIDATING ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries (Establishment and Validation of Actions) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regularizes the establishment of the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation. It also validates certain actions and orders taken under the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1960.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The law relating to the levy of tolls on public roads and bridges in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws regarding the levy of tolls on public roads and bridges in West Pakistan. It grants the Government powers to set up toll-gates, lease out toll collection rights, and establish penalties for refusing or evading toll payments.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Textbook Board Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Textbook Board as a body corporate to oversee the production and publication of textbooks for Classes I to XII. It also provides for supplementary reading materials, guide books for teachers, and research in the field of curricula.

name: WEST PAKISTAN UNIVERSITIES REMOVAL OF UNDESIRABLE GOVERNMENT SERVANTS ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Universities) Removal of Undesirable Government Servants Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of government servants serving in universities and other educational institutions in West Pakistan who are deemed undesirable. It empowers the Governor to terminate such services after giving the servant a reasonable opportunity to show cause, while also allowing for the payment of specified pensions or Provident Fund.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959. It inserts new provisions regarding the powers of appellate authorities to transfer applications and appeals between controllers or other subordinate authorities.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Karachi Rent Restriction Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959 by omitting specific references to the Federal Capital in certain sections. It also repeals the application of the Karachi Rent Restriction Act, 1953 to areas outside cantonment zones and provides for the transfer of pending proceedings from the repealed Act to the new framework.

name: WEST PAKISTAN VALIDATION OF NAIB TEHSILDARS AND NAIB TEHSILDAR CANDIDATES SELECTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Validation of Naib-Tehsildars and Naib-Tehsildar Candidates Selection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Validation of Naib-Tehsildars and Naib-Tehsildar Candidates Selection Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Validation of Naib-Tehsildars and Naib-Tehsildar Candidates Selection Ordinance, 1962. It substitutes specific column references in Section 3 and updates entries in the Schedule to reflect new dates for validation.

name: WEST PAKISTAN VALIDATION OF NAIB TEHSILDARS AND NAIB TEHSILDAR CANDIDATES SELECTION ORDINANCE, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Validation of Naib Tehsildars and Naib Tehsildar Candidates Selection Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the selection of Naib Tehsildars and Naib Tehsildar candidates made during the years 1960 and 1961. It deems specific individuals listed in the Schedule to have been validly selected as of their respective dates, regardless of existing rules or court decrees.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1961. Specifically, it substitutes the date 'seventeenth April' for 'seventh April' in clause (b) of sub-section (3) of section 1 of the amended Ordinance.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Universities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Universities Ordinances to update provisions regarding student residence, discipline, and extra-curricular activities. It also introduces rules for disciplinary action against students and mandates that colleges frame rules concerning staff efficiency and discipline with university approval.

metadata.title: The Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to recommendations of the Commission on Marriage and Family Laws. It establishes an Arbitration Council, mandates the registration of Muslim marriages, regulates polygamy through a permission process, and outlines procedures for divorce.

name: NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE SUGAR FACTORIES CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Sugar Factories Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: The North-West Frontier Province Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the North-West Frontier Province Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950 to update references and add new provisions regarding cane cultivation. It substitutes specific terms related to land revenue and tenancy laws and grants the Cane Commissioner power to prohibit the cultivation of unsuitable sugar-cane varieties.

metadata.title: The Punjab University (West Pakistan) Amendment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab University Act of 1954 to regulate the tenure of specific university bodies following the commencement of the law. It stipulates that members of the Senate, Academic Council, Standing Finance Committee, and Board of Appointments holding office immediately before this Ordinance shall continue until June 30, 1961.

metadata.title: The Registration Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Registration Act, 1908 to include co-operative societies within specific legal definitions and clauses. It updates sections regarding agricultural loans and the roles of officers granting such loans.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to gambling in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'common gaming-house' and 'gaming', and prescribes penalties for keeping, operating, or participating in illegal gambling activities.

metadata.title: The Road Transport Workers Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the hours of work and other conditions of employment for road transport workers in Pakistan. It establishes specific limits on daily and weekly working hours, mandates rest intervals, sets minimum leave entitlements based on continuous employment duration, and defines age restrictions for drivers and general employees.

metadata.title: The Sind Irrigation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 by adding specific words to section 90 and omitting a proviso. It also modifies section 92 of the principal Act regarding construction timelines within local areas.

metadata.title: The Central Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Order adapts Central Acts and Ordinances to reflect the change in government following the proclamation of October 7, 1958. It substitutes specific expressions (such as 'Crown' for 'President') throughout specified laws and deems these adaptations to have taken effect from March 23, 1956.

name: VOLUNTARY SOCIAL WELFARE AGENCIES (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and control of voluntary social welfare agencies in Pakistan. It establishes the legal framework for establishing new agencies, continuing existing ones, and maintaining registers of approved organizations.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION, HYDERABAD) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education at Hyderabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition of the Board, including the Chairman, Vice-Chancellor, Director of Education, and various representatives from colleges and schools. The document also outlines the terms of office for members, procedures for filling vacancies, and the powers exercised by the Board within its territorial limits.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION, LAHORE) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Lahore) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the Board of Secondary Education in Lahore, renaming it the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Lahore. It establishes the Board as a corporate body with perpetual succession and defines its composition, member terms, and powers.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION, PESHAWAR) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education at Peshawar. It defines the terms used within the document, such as 'Board', 'College', and 'University', and outlines the procedures for member resignation, removal, and filling vacancies.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (UNIVERSITY OF THE PESHAWAR) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (University of Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-constitutes and re-organizes the University of Peshawar to improve teaching, research, and administration. It establishes the university as a body corporate with powers to confer degrees, hold examinations, and manage property.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (UNIVERSITY OF THE PUNJAB) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (University of the Punjab) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-constitutes and re-organizes the University of the Punjab to improve teaching, research, and administration. It establishes the University as a body corporate with powers to confer degrees, hold examinations, and manage property.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (UNIVERSITY OF THE SIND) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (University of Sind) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and re-organizes the University of Sind, establishing it as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and outlines its powers to provide instruction, conduct examinations, confer degrees, and manage property.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Pests (Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959. It specifically modifies Section 10 and Section 14 of the principal Ordinance regarding references to sections and definitions of officers.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural University Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Agricultural University at Lyallpur as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and grants it powers to confer degrees, conduct research, and manage property.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: The Sind Prevention of Bribery and Corruption Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of a special agency known as the Anti-Corruption Establishment in West Pakistan. The agency is empowered to investigate specific corruption offences by public servants and conduct preliminary inquiries.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of certain sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1961-62. It specifies the authorized amounts for various provincial services, purposes, and charges detailed in the attached schedule.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Act, 1958. Specifically, it alters section 2 of the Act by replacing a word and inserting new text regarding commissions for examining witnesses.

name: WEST PAKISTAN DETERMINATION OF LAND REVENUE AND WATER RATE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Determination of Land Revenue and Water Rate Ordinance, 1961 (Amendment)
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Determination of Land Revenue and Water Rate Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Determination of Land Revenue and Water Rate Ordinance, 1959. It modifies Section 3 to change wording regarding land revenue reassessment and adds a new subsection specifying when notified rates become payable.

name: WEST PAKISTAN DISCONTINUANCE OF SIND ROAD FUND ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The Sind Road Fund Discontinuance Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: The Sind Road Fund Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to discontinue the Sind Road Fund established under the Sind Road Fund Act, 1947. It also provides for crediting the remaining balance of that fund to the Provincial Consolidated Fund.

name: WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation to increase agricultural production. It defines the corporation's structure, including its Board of Directors, management powers, and the appointment process for key officials like the Chairman and Financial Director.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GENERAL CLAUSES (EXTENSION TO SPECIAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan General Clauses (Extension to Special Areas) Regulation, 1961
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the provisions of the General Clauses Act, 1897 to the Special Areas of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan with the previous approval of the President.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This ordinance extends the West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959, to certain parts of the Karachi Division where it did not previously apply. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on October 20, 1961.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of certain taxes leviable in West Pakistan. It establishes new surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax, introduces specific stamp duties, and imposes taxes on cinemas, legal practitioners, and other specified classes of persons for the financial year 1961-62.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 to update specific dates and payment schedules for vehicle taxes. It substitutes new months and days in various sections of the original Act to reflect changes in tax liability periods.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: certain Central laws
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to remove obsolete or discharged Central laws from the Statute-book. It also authorizes amendments to certain other Central laws as specified in its schedules.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes further payments from the Provincial Consolidated Fund of West Pakistan for a specific twelve-month period ending on June 30, 1961. It appropriates sums not exceeding Rs. 7,32,70,000 to defray supplementary charges for various government services and purposes detailed in the attached Schedule.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SUPPRESSION OF PROSTITUTION ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the suppression of prostitution in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as brothel, prostitution, and public places, and prescribes punishments for keeping brothels, soliciting, living on earnings of prostitution, and exploiting another's prostitution.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HILL TRACT IMPROVEMENT ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the improvement and expansion of certain areas in the hill tracts of the Rawalpindi and Hazara districts. It establishes a Trust to carry out these purposes and defines the constitution, powers, and duties of its Chairman and Trustees.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958. It substitutes specific dates in Section 7 of the original Act to update provisions related to property tax assessments.

name: WEST PUNJAB AND THE BAHAWALPUR COTTON (CONTROL) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Punjab and the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: The West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949 and the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949, and the Bahawalpur Cotton (Control) Act, 1949. It specifically inserts references to 'other mechanical' power alongside electrical power and substitutes terms regarding cotton seed in specific sections of both Acts.

name: BALUCHISTAN LAWS REGULATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Baluchistan Laws Regulation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Baluchistan Laws Regulation of 1913 to update references regarding the Commissioner and Court of the Commissioner. It also substitutes new sections concerning revisional powers, restricting officers from revising their own decisions and outlining procedures for reporting cases to the Provincial Government.

name: WEST PAKISTAN UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology in Lahore. It defines the university's corporate status, powers to confer degrees, conduct research, and manage property.

metadata.title: The Cooperative Societies (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the repayment of unsecured or insufficiently secured loans taken from Cooperative Banks and other Cooperative Societies. It mandates specific timelines for repaying a portion of such loans and securing the balance through mortgage, pledge, hypothecation, or assignment.

metadata.title: The Dir (Advisory Council) Regulation, 1960
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes a Council of Advisors to aid and advise the Ruler of Dir in exercising his functions. It defines the composition of the Council, including a Chief Advisor appointed by the Governor, and provides for the election of other members.

name: FRONTIER CRIMES REGULATION (WEST PAKISTAN EXTENSION) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Frontier Crimes Regulation (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901 to the districts of Kalat, Kharan, Makran, and Lasbela in West Pakistan. It applies the regulation to all territories comprising these districts that were not previously covered by its extension.

name: FRONTIER CRIMES REGULATION (WEST PAKISTAN SECOND EXTENSION) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Frontier Crimes Regulation (West Pakistan Second Extension) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901, to the District of Mianwali in West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on December 13, 1960, pursuant to instructions from the President.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 as it applies to West Pakistan. It specifically substitutes provisions regarding distinguishing registration marks and introduces a new Sixth Schedule listing district-specific letter codes for vehicle registration.

metadata.title: Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to reform the Central Statute-book by extending certain laws to new areas and removing obsolete legislation. It addresses the incorporation of former provinces, acceding states, and tribal areas into West Pakistan following the Establishment of West Pakistan Act, 1955.

name: NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE DEVELOPMENT CESS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Development Cess (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: North-West Frontier Province Development Cess Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the North-West Frontier Province Development Cess Act, 1949. It includes changes to the preamble, instructions regarding waqf property administration, and penalties for disobedience of Chief Administrator orders.

name: PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to apply its provisions specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces new sections requiring public servants to declare assets disproportionate to their known income and imposes penalties for failing to do so or possessing property acquired by improper means.

metadata.title: The Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the release of offenders on probation in certain cases and establishes the legal framework for such supervision. It defines key terms, empowers specific courts to make probation orders, and outlines the conditions under which a person may be discharged conditionally instead of receiving immediate punishment.

name: SIND LAND REVENUE CODE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879 to update provisions regarding defaulters and security bonds. It substitutes new text for Section 164 and Schedule D of the said Code to regulate protest payments and forfeiture procedures.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Provincial Laws Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Provincial Laws (Adaptation to Decimal Coinage) Act, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and adapts certain West Pakistan provincial laws to align them with the introduction of the decimal coinage system. It specifies substitutions for old currency values in various Acts, Ordinances, and Regulations listed in its schedules.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for West Pakistan. It covers charges for the financial year 1960-61, including services such as administration, justice, education, health, and various capital outlays.

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: law relating to municipal administration in Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to municipal administration in Pakistan. It provides for the short title, extent, commencement, power to exempt local areas, definitions of key terms, and the establishment of Municipal Committees.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan District (Reconstitution) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the alteration of district limits and the constitution of new districts in West Pakistan. It specifies how existing laws apply to newly added areas, defines terms like 'Government', and adapts references from the district of Shahpur to Sargodha effective September 16, 1960.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 by omitting specific words from section 11. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on April 27, 1960.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'two' with 'four' in sub-section (3) of section 1 of the aforementioned Act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONSOLIDATION OF HOLDINGS ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: law relating to consolidation of holdings in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the laws regarding the consolidation of land holdings in West Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'holding', 'estate', and 'Board of Revenue' to facilitate the redistribution of lands within estates or sub-divisions to reduce the number of plots.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Excess Appropriation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the Governor of West Pakistan to apply further sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for specific services. It covers financial years ranging from 1948-49 to 1954-55 across the provinces of Punjab, Sind, and North-West Frontier.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance and enhancement of certain taxes in West Pakistan. It imposes surcharges on land revenue, agricultural income-tax, stamp duties, cinema taxes, and motor vehicle taxes for the financial year 1960-61.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTION ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Boards of Governors to manage and control government educational and training institutions in West Pakistan. It defines the composition, powers, and financial responsibilities of these boards, including the establishment of a Board Fund and requirements for annual reporting and audits.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HORSE-RACE BETTING TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958 to adjust tax rates and introduce new regulations for book-makers. It substitutes specific subsections regarding tax levies on backers and inserts a new section granting the government power to regulate betting times, places, credit payments via cheques, and record-keeping.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HISTORICAL MOSQUES FUND CESS ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a fund to raise money for the repair, maintenance, and endowment of historically important mosques in West Pakistan. It imposes a cess on land revenue or urban immovable property tax payable by Muslims to finance these activities.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to preventive detention and the control of persons and publications connected with the maintenance of public order in West Pakistan. It grants the Government power to arrest and detain individuals deemed prejudicial to public safety or order, while establishing procedures for reviewing detention orders.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Money-Lenders Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: law relating to money-lenders in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws regarding money-lenders, their registration, and account regulation in West Pakistan. It establishes requirements for obtaining an effective licence to carry on the business of money-lending and defines key terms related to loans, interest, and traders.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRACTITIONERS' REGISTRATION AND MEDICAL COUNCIL ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Medical Practitioners Registration and Medical Council Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the registration of medical practitioners and the constitution of a Medical Council in West Pakistan. It establishes the Medical Council of West Pakistan, defines key terms such as 'registered practitioner' and 'medical institution', and outlines the composition, tenure, and powers of the Council.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROHIBITION OF SMOKING IN CINEMA HOUSES ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking in cinema houses within the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'cinema house' and 'management', establishes penalties including fines and arrest for offenders, and grants powers to police officers and District Magistrates regarding enforcement and exemptions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROHIBITION OF OPIUM SMOKING ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Opium Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the manufacture, possession, and smoking of opium in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'opium', 'Government', and 'place' to clarify the scope of the law.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RELIEF OF INDEBTEDNESS ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: the law relating to the relief of indebtedness in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws regarding the relief of indebtedness in West Pakistan. It provides specific protections for debtors, including limits on recoverable amounts, immunity from arrest, and exemptions for certain properties like homes and livestock from attachment or sale.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the preparation and sale of foods in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes definitions for food terms, prohibits false warranties and mixing of food, and sets rules regarding the manufacture, sale, and importation of wholesome food.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Special Tribunal Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Special Tribunal in West Pakistan to try specific offences committed by Murad Mangrio and other outlaws. It grants the Tribunal exclusive jurisdiction, defines its procedural powers regarding witnesses and trials in absentia, and outlines sentencing limits and appeal rights to the High Court.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Supplementary Appropriation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the further payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for West Pakistan. It covers services and purposes for a twelve-month period ending on June 30, 1960, including demands for land revenue, irrigation, health, agriculture, and various administrative expenses.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation to promote the development of cottage and small industries in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines the Corporation's constitution, authorized capital structure with government majority ownership, and the powers of its Board of Directors.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Usurious Loans (Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959 by modifying specific wording in section 4 regarding credit institutions. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on June 11, 1960.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959 to update provisions regarding rent applications, repair responsibilities, and rent calculation methods. It introduces new sections allowing tenants to deduct certified repair costs from rent and clarifies how utility charges and tendered rent are treated.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958. It substitutes specific dates within sections 21 and 27 of the principal Act, changing 'June' to 'September' and 'October' to 'January' respectively.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties (Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1959 to update terminology from 'Administrator' to 'Chief Administrator of Augaf'. It introduces new sections regarding the recovery of unpaid rent as land-revenue arrears and grants the Chief Administrator powers to issue instructions for waqf management. The document also establishes penalties for disobeying requisitions issued by the Chief Administrator.

name: WEST PUNJAB THAL (INCREASE IN VALUE) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: The Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) Act, 1940 by adding a new definition for 'Collector' to Section 2. It clarifies that the term includes Deputy Commissioners and officers specially appointed by the Provincial Governor.

metadata.title: The Excise Regulation (Extension) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Excise Regulation of 1915 to specific districts in West Pakistan. It applies the regulation to Kalat, Kharan, Las Bela, Mekran, Pishin, Sibi, and Duki.

metadata.title: The Cinematograph (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Cinematograph Act, 1918 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers the Provincial Government to issue directions regulating film exhibitions and adding new sections regarding scientific, educational, news, and documentary films.

metadata.title: The Khairpur Municipal District (Establishment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares the Khairpur Notified Area a Municipal District under the Sind District Municipal Act, 1901. It establishes an officer appointed by the Commissioner to exercise municipal powers until a formal municipality is established and preserves existing appointments, rules, and proceedings.

name: NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE SUGAR CANE (ADDITIONAL LAND REVENUE) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Sugar-cane (Additional Land Revenue) Repeal Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Sugar-cane (Additional Land Revenue) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal an existing Act. It declares that the repealed Act is deemed to have been repealed on a specific date in October 1958.

metadata.title: The Police (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Act, 1861 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It inserts a new section granting the Inspector-General authority over police accounts and modifies provisions regarding assemblies and processions.

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The 1934 Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act; The Provincial Insolvency (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1939; The Provincial Insolvency (Sind Amendment) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates various amendments to the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920, as applicable to West Pakistan. It specifically adds a provision regarding the temporary alienation of land belonging to an insolvent estate and repeals several earlier enactments related to insolvency in Punjab and Sind.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1959

metadata.title: The Punjab Act V of 1939 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This document amends the Punjab Act V of 1939 by inserting specific conditions regarding a member's continuance and omitting certain subsections. It also adds a new section delegating government powers to a Commissioner, excluding the power to make rules.

name: PUNJAB LAND REVENUE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: West Pakistan (Punjab Land Revenue Act) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887, specifically regarding its application in certain districts and leased areas of West Pakistan. It clarifies that previous amendments made by the 1956 Act do not affect the continuance of the 1887 Act in specified regions like Bannu, Dera Ismail Khan, and others.

metadata.title: The Kalri Lake Development Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy and coordinated development, general improvement, and expansion of the Kalri Lake area in Thatta District of West Pakistan. It establishes a Board to carry out these provisions and defines the composition, powers, and procedures of that Board.

metadata.title: The Punjab University (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab University Act of 1954 by substituting 'West Pakistan' for 'Punjab' in specific clauses regarding officials and adding a new clause about the Chairman of the Board of Secondary Education. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on April 23, 1959.

name: SIND EXCISE LAWS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The Sind Excise Laws (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: Sind Abkari Act, 1878; Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940
metadata.repeals: Abkari Act No. I of 1895 (Khairpur)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Abkari Act, 1878, and the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940 to include the District of Khairpur within their scope. It also repeals the Abkari Act No. I of 1895 regarding Khairpur while preserving existing actions and liabilities under the amended acts.

name: SIND ACTS (EXTENSION TO KHAIRPUR DISTRICT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The Sind Acts (Extension to Khairpur District) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: Notice to Police of Suspicious Characters Act, 1898; The Khairpur Tonga Act, 1905; The Khairpur Bullock Cart Act, 1929; The Khairpur State Irrigation Act, 1929; The Khairpur State Courts Act, 1941; The Khairpur State Primary Education Act, 1945; The Khairpur State Municipal Act, 1947; The Khairpur State Small Towns Act, 1947; The Hurs Control Act, 1947; The Khairpur Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1953; The Khairpur Essential Articles (Control of Price, Movement and Anti-hoarding) Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends various Sind Acts to the Khairpur District and repeals corresponding local Khairpur Acts. It ensures that committees, appointments, and legal actions under the repealed acts are deemed to continue under the extended Sind legislation.

name: SIND LAND REVENUE CODE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879 by inserting a new section 5-A. The amendment empowers the Provincial Government to appoint an Additional Commissioner to discharge functions under the Act.

metadata.title: The Sind University (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind University Act, 1947 to alter provisions regarding the appointment and tenure of the Vice-Chancellor. It substitutes new sub-sections in Section 8 to define how the Chancellor appoints the Vice-Chancellor, sets a three-year term with eligibility for re-appointment, and outlines arrangements for temporary vacancies.

metadata.title: The Thal Development (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Thal Development Act, 1949 by deleting Section 7 and modifying Section 9. The amendment allows the Provincial Government to remove any member at any time without assigning a reason.

metadata.title: The Stamp (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the application of the Stamp Act, 1899 to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific sections and clauses to replace references to 'the Crown' with 'Government' or 'Provincial Government' and omits certain central government provisions.

name: THAL DEVELOPMENT (WEST PAKISTAN SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The Thal Development (West Pakistan Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Thal Development Act, 1949 by adding a new section to Chapter X. The amendment empowers the Provincial Government to delegate its powers, duties, and functions under the Act to any subordinate authority via notification.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION AND REPEAL OF LAWS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) Act, 1957. It specifically substitutes an entry in Schedule II regarding the Baluchistan States Union to define the functions of the Provincial Government or empowered officers.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (GWADUR) EXTENSION OF LAWS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Gwadur) Extension of Laws Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the application of specific enactments to the territory of Gwadur, which was included in Pakistan on September 8, 1958. It amends the Coasting Vessels Act, 1938, to include Gwadur within its scope by inserting specific words into section 2.

name: WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURAL BANK (RECOVERY OF DUES) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides facilities to the Agricultural Bank for recovering its dues. It empowers agriculturists and co-operative societies to pledge, mortgage, hypothecate, or assign movable or immovable property to secure loans advanced under the Agricultural Bank Act, 1957.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: law relating to the eradication of agricultural pests in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws regarding the eradication of agricultural pests in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'agricultural pest' and 'infested crop', grants the government powers to prohibit cultivation methods or transport of infested crops, and establishes the authority and duties of appointed Inspectors.

name: WEST PAKISTAN APPROPRIATION (AMENDMENT AND EXTENSION) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation (Amendment and Extension) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Appropriation Act, 1958 to prevent the lapse of unappropriated sums as of March 31, 1959. It allows these funds to be used for specific services during a transitional period from April 1 to June 30, 1959.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation (Second) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for West Pakistan. It covers various services and purposes for the financial year 1959-60, including administration, justice, education, health, agriculture, and capital works.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONTEMPT OF COURTS (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Contempt of Courts (Repeal) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Contempt of Courts Act, 1938; Khairpur State Contempt of Courts Act, 1950; Contempt of Courts (Sind Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal three specific acts related to contempt of courts. It came into force on a date appointed by government notification.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of certain sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for West Pakistan. It covers expenses for a three-month period ending on June 30, 1959, including various services such as administration, police, education, health, and capital works.

name: WEST PAKISTAN DETERMINATION OF LAND REVENUE AND WATER RATE ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Determination of Land Revenue and Water Rate Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the separation of land revenue from water rate in areas where a composite charge is imposed. It also makes provision for the re-assessment of these rates.

name: WEST PAKISTAN DISCONTINUANCE OF SIND MOSQUE AND HOSTELS FUND ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Discontinuance of Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund Cess Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the discontinuance of the Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund established under the Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund Cess Act, 1951. It also repeals the aforementioned Act and directs that the remaining balance of the fund be utilized for the repair and maintenance of historically significant mosques in the former Province of Sind.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1958. It specifically omits section 6 of the aforementioned Act and is deemed to have come into force on January 1, 1959.

name: WEST PAKISTAN FINANCE ACT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1958 by substituting specific dates and references within sections 5, 8, 11, and 15. It also inserts a new section to impose taxes on cinemas, legal practitioners, income tax practitioners, clearing agents, contractors, and motor vehicles for goods or passenger transport.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF GOONDAS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the control of disorderly persons in West Pakistan commonly known as goondas. It establishes a Tribunal consisting of District Magistrates or empowered Magistrates to conduct inquiries, issue summonses, and manage proceedings deemed judicial.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan General Clauses (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956. Specifically, it substitutes clause (25) of section 2 to redefine the term 'financial year' with new dates effective from April 1, 1959.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuation and enhancement of certain taxes in West Pakistan. It imposes surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax, amends stamp duties, and levies new taxes on cinemas, betting, and specific professional classes.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance restricts the number of goats in West Pakistan to protect public interest. It empowers the Government to regulate grazing, keeping, movement, and slaughter of goats through notifications and rules.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HINDU WOMEN'S RIGHTS TO AGRICULTURAL LAND ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Hindu Women's Rights to Property Act, 1942; The Sind Extension of Hindu Women's Rights to Property Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the rights of Hindu women to agricultural land in the Province of West Pakistan. It applies where a Hindu dies intestate and establishes specific rules for the devolution of such land, particularly regarding widows under different schools of Hindu law.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Juvenile Smoking Act, 1918; The Punjab Juvenile Smoking Act, 1918 as applicable to the former State of Bahawalpur; The North-West Frontier Province Juvenile Smoking Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the prevention of tobacco smoking by juveniles in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'juvenile' and 'public place', establishes penalties for selling tobacco to minors, authorizes the seizure of smoked tobacco, and repeals previous juvenile smoking acts from Punjab and NWFP.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LAND DISPOSITIONS (SAVING OF SHAMILAT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for a uniform interpretation of general expressions regarding the disposition of 'Shamilat' lands in West Pakistan. It stipulates that unless specifically mentioned, Shamilat lands are not included in dispositions of other land, whether testamentary or otherwise.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Utilization Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the utilization of proprietary waste and arable lands in West Pakistan for growing food and other crops. It empowers the Collector to direct that uncultivated land capable of reclamation be brought under cultivation within a specified period.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 to allow for lower tax rates on specific classes of motor vehicles in designated areas or routes. It also exempts tractors and trailers used for agricultural purposes from certain provisions and omits references to private carriers and a specific article regarding taxation.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Highways Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: law relating to highways in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to highways in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the powers of Highway Authorities, defines key terms such as 'highway' and 'vehicle', and outlines regulations for road maintenance, traffic control, and encroachments.

name: WEST PAKISTAN NATIONAL CALAMITIES (PREVENTION AND RELIEF) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958. It specifically adds a reference to the Khairpur National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1954 within Section 12 of the parent Act.

metadata.title: The Ordinance of West Pakistan XIV of 1969
metadata.amends: The Ordinance of West Pakistan XIV of 1959
metadata.summary: This document serves as an amendment to the Ordinance of West Pakistan XIV of 1959. It modifies specific sections regarding police and civil agency coordination in preventing smuggling, alters punctuation and clauses within section 6 and 7, and changes a numerical value in section 20.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a new force called the West Pakistan Rangers to protect border areas and maintain law and order in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines the structure, command hierarchy, recruitment conditions, and duties of the Force, including cooperation with police agencies for crime prevention and smuggling control.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Nursing Services Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Nursing Services Council and defines key terms related to nursing, midwifery, and health visiting.
