It outlines the composition of the Council, the process for member elections or nominations, and grants the Council corporate status with powers to sue and contract.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956. It substitutes specific wording in Section 3 regarding the officers or offices of the Central and Provincial Governments.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RICE (RESTRICTIONS ON CULTIVATION) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the cultivation of rice in the Province of West Pakistan to check the increase of water-logged land caused by salinity and seepage. It empowers the Board of Revenue to impose restrictions on rice cultivation while protecting existing standing crops.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Supplementary Appropriation Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for services ending on June 30, 1959. It covers a period of fifteen months and specifies various charges including administration, justice, police, agriculture, and public health.

name: WEST PAKISTAN SURVEY AND RECTANGULATION OF LANDS ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the survey and rectangulation of land in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes provisions regarding the assessment of costs for these operations, penalties for obstruction, and rules regarding civil court jurisdiction.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TOBACCO VEND ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to amend the West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958. It specifically modifies Section 4 of the parent Act regarding the authority of a Collector or any person authorized by him.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to update definitions and tax liability clauses. It specifically expands the definition of 'owner' to include mortgagees with possession, lessees in perpetuity, and trustees having possession of trust property.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the registration of companies carrying on business for certain undesirable purposes, such as lottery or chance-based schemes. It also provides legal mechanisms for the winding up and dissolution of existing companies that fall under this definition.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: Usury Act XXVIII of 1855
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to usurious loans in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers courts to re-open transactions, relieve debtors of excessive interest liability, and alter securities where interest is deemed excessive or the transaction was substantially unfair.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vaccination (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958 to update definitions regarding vaccination procedures and authorities. It also modifies sections concerning vaccination seasons and appointment processes.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN RENT RESTRICTION ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance restricts the increase of rent and limits the eviction of tenants in urban areas within West Pakistan. It applies to all urban areas except the Capital and Special Areas and deems its provisions effective from the date the previous Act expired.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958 to facilitate the transfer of assets and liabilities from government departments to the Authority. It also grants the Authority powers to undertake schemes sponsored by other agencies and modifies service conditions for personnel in relevant electricity and irrigation departments.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1959 (principal Ordinance)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the laws relating to the management of Waqf properties in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes an Administrator for Waqfs, defines various terms related to religious and charitable property, and outlines procedures for taking over waqf administration and legal petitions regarding property status.

metadata.title: The Boilers (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Boilers Act, 1923 to apply it to the Province of West Pakistan. It substitutes specific clauses regarding inspector titles and adds provisions allowing the Provincial Government to appoint Additional Chief Inspectors or Deputy Chief Inspectors for specified areas.

metadata.title: The Cinematograph (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends and extends the Cinematograph Act, 1918 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces provisions regarding film certification, restrictions on adult-only exhibitions, and procedures for appealing censorship decisions to the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Cinematograph (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Cinematograph Act, 1918 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'one-half' for the word 'cone-' in section 7 of the Act.

name: CITY OF LAHORE CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.amends: The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941
metadata.repeals: The City of Lahore Corporation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941 to replace the Administrator with an Administrative Committee following the supersession of the Corporation. It details the powers, duties, and composition of this new committee under the control of the Provincial Government while repealing a previous 1958 Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WILD LIFE PROTECTION ORDINANCE, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Wild Life Protection Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the protection of wild life in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes regulations regarding the appointment of officers, licensing for hunting and possession, and prohibits the killing or importing of specific wild birds and animals without a permit.

name: CITY OF LAHORE CORPORATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941 to address immediate circumstances while the Provincial Assembly is not in session. It establishes an Administrative Committee to exercise powers and duties when the Corporation is superseded and outlines the composition, control, and functions of this committee under the supervision of the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Industrial Statistics (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942 to facilitate its application in West Pakistan. It authorizes the Provincial Government to delegate the powers and functions of the statistics authority to other officers or subordinate authorities under specified conditions.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to apply to certain districts of West Pakistan. It includes specific textual substitutions and omissions within sections 17, 18, and 23 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It primarily facilitates the establishment of a Road Transport Board and validates existing rules and actions taken under previous regulations.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 to apply specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes a new body corporate called the West Pakistan Road Transport Board and transfers the undertakings of existing local boards to this new entity.

name: NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE TOWN IMPROVEMENT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Town Improvement (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The North-West Frontier Province Town Improvement Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the North-West Frontier Province Town Improvement Act, 1954 to address circumstances requiring immediate action following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly and abrogation of the Constitution. It specifically adds a new section (4-A) regarding the filling of seats on Municipal Trusts during periods of supersession by the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Red Cross Society (Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.amends: The Pakistan Red Cross Society Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Pakistan Red Cross Society Act, 1920. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION ACT (WEST PAKISTAN EXTENSION) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption Act (West Extension) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to cover the entire Province of West Pakistan. It also repeals the specific Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act from 1950 and adapts references in the extended Act to local penal codes where necessary.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Army (Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Army Act, 1952 to include provisions for personnel seconded from the Navy and Air Force. It also inserts new sections regarding medical corps secondment and defines specific terms related to military custody and rewards.

metadata.title: The Prisons (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prisons Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces new clauses regarding the appointment and powers of Deputy Inspectors-General within defined territories.

name: PUNJAB AND NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MUNCIPAL AND DISTRICT BOARDS LAWS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab and North-West Frontier Province Municipal and District Boards Laws (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.amends: Punjab Municipal Act, 1911; North-West Frontier Province Municipal Act, 1950; Punjab District Boards Act, 1883
metadata.repeals: The Punjab and North-West Frontier Province Municipal and District Boards Laws (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends three specific pieces of legislation regarding municipal and district boards in Punjab and the North-West Frontier Province. It achieves this by inserting the phrase 'or persons' into specific clauses of the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911, the N.W.F.P. Municipal Act, 1950, and the Punjab District Boards Act, 1883.

name: PUNJAB AND NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE MUNICIPAL AND DISTRICT BOARDS LAWS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab and North-West Frontier Province Municipal and District Boards Laws (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: Punjab Municipal Act, 1911; North-West Frontier Province Municipal Act, 1950; Punjab District Boards Act, 1883
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends three specific laws regarding municipal and district boards in Punjab and the North-West Frontier Province. It inserts the phrase 'or persons' into specific sections of the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911, the N.W.F.P. Municipal Act, 1950, and the Punjab District Boards Act, 1883.

name: PUNJAB MUNICIPAL (EXECUTIVE OFFICERS) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Municipal (Executive Officers) Amendment Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur State Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1931; The West Pakistan and West Pakistan Amendment Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1931 to extend its application to specific districts in West Pakistan. It also repeals the Bahawalpur State Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1931 and a related 1958 Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB MUNICIPAL (EXECUTIVE OFFICERS) (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur State Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of the Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1931, as amended in 1957, to specific districts in West Pakistan. It also repeals the application of the Bahawalpur State Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1951, for municipalities within those districts.

name: PUNJAB SECONDARY EDUCATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Secondary Education (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Secondary Education Act, 1954 to update references from 'Punjab' to 'Lahore' and modify specific sections regarding board membership and terms. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 102 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB SECONDARY EDUCATION (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority as a body corporate to manage water and power resources. It outlines the authority's powers for irrigation, flood control, and power generation, while defining its composition and operational duties.

name: PUNJAB SECONDARY EDUCATION (WEST PAKISTAN SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Secondary Education (West Pakistan Second Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Punjab Secondary Education Act, 1954. It specifically modifies Section 30 of the original Act by changing a full-stop to a semi-colon and adding a proviso regarding the payment of emoluments for a whole-time Chairman.

name: PUNJAB TOWN IMPROVEMENT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Town Improvement (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur State Town Improvement Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Bahawalpur State Town Improvement Act, 1946 and amends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 to extend its application to specific districts in West Pakistan. It ensures that all appointments, regulations, and contracts made under the repealed Act continue in force as if made under the amended Act.

name: PUNJAB TOWN IMPROVEMENT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Amendment Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 by modifying specific sections regarding judicial members and tribunal provisions. It grants the Provincial Government authority to fix shorter terms of office and dissolve tribunals deemed unnecessary.

name: PUNJAB TOWN IMPROVEMENT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Town Improvement (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur State Town Improvement Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of the Punjab Town Improvement (Amendment) Act, 1957 after its expiry. It extends these provisions to additional districts in West Pakistan and repeals the application of the Bahawalpur State Town Improvement Act, 1946.

metadata.title: The Punjab University (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of the Punjab University (Amendment) Act, 1957 after its expiry. It amends the principal Punjab University Act, 1954 by updating faculty titles and clarifying the roles of university officers.

metadata.title: The Punjab University (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab University Act, 1954 to update terminology regarding university staff and modify the roles of the Vice-Chancellor. It also revises provisions concerning the appointment of fellows, the composition of academic bodies, and the process for Senate statutes requiring government assent.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYAT (WEST PAKISTAN EXTENSION AND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayat (West Pakistan Extension and Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: Sind Village Panchayats Act, 1933; North-West Frontier Province Village Council Act, 1935; Khairpur State Dehati Adalat Act, 1939; Bahawalpur State Panchayat Act, 1943; Sind Village Sanitation Act, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends laws relating to panchayats in the Province of West Pakistan. It extends the Punjab Village Panchayat Act, 1939 to the whole of West Pakistan (excluding the Federal Capital and Special Areas) while repealing several specific acts from Sindh, NWFP, Khairpur State, and Bahawalpur State.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYAT (WEST PAKISTAN EXTENSION AND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayat (West Pakistan Extension and Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to panchayats in the Province of West Pakistan. It extends the Punjab Village Panchayat Act, 1939 to West Pakistan while repealing specific sections and substituting others with new provisions.

name: SIND DISTRICT MUNICIPAL (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Sind District Municipal (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Sind District Municipal (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind District Municipal Act, 1901 to allow the Provincial Government to extend a councillor's term of office by up to one year. It also adds provisions for what happens when a councilor's term expires before elections are held, requiring them to vacate their office and treating the municipality as superseded until new elections occur within one year.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Municipal Authorities (Supersession) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the immediate supersession of municipal authorities in West Pakistan following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly and abrogation of the Constitution. It transfers powers and duties from these superseded authorities to the Commissioner of the respective divisions.

name: SIND LOCAL BOARDS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Sind Local Boards (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Boards Act, 1923 to modify specific sections regarding office terms and provisos. It grants the Provincial Government the authority to extend the term of office for members of local boards via notification under recorded reasons.

name: SIND LOCAL BOARDS AND LAND REVENUE CODE (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Sind Local Boards and Land Revenue Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1968
metadata.amends: Sind Local Boards Act, 1923; Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879
metadata.repeals: Bombay Land Revenue Code, 1879 (as applicable to the district of Khairpur); Ordinance VIII of 1957
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Boards Act, 1923, and the Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879 to extend their application to specific districts in West Pakistan. It also repeals the Bombay Land Revenue Code, 1879 as it applies to the district of Khairpur, while preserving existing actions and liabilities under that code.

name: SIND MUNICIPAL BOROUGHS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The Sind Municipal Boroughs (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Sind Municipal Boroughs (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Municipal Boroughs Act, 1925 to allow for the extension of a councillor's term of office by up to one year via provincial government notification. It also adds provisions regarding the consequences if a municipality's ordinary term expires before general elections are held, including the supersession of the body and the timeline for holding new elections.

metadata.title: The Town Improvement (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 and North-West Frontier Province Town Improvement Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922, and the North-West Frontier Province Town Improvement Act, 1954. It specifically deletes certain references to municipal acts and modifies section 10 to add a clause regarding the Provincial Government's opinion on a trustee's continuance in public interest.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (CRESCENT TEXTILE MILLS FIRING) (PUBLIC INQUIRY) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Crescent Textile Mills Firing) (Public Inquiry) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Court of Inquiry to investigate the circumstances surrounding the police firing at Crescent Textile Mills in Lyallpur on June 20, 1958. The document outlines the court's composition, terms of reference regarding the justification for the firing, procedural powers, and rules concerning the publication of its final report.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (KHAIRPUR STATE PEOPLES WELFARE TRUST ACT) REPEAL ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Khairpur State People's Welfare Trust Act) Repeal Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Khairpur State and the People's Welfare Trust Act, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Khairpur State and the People's Welfare Trust Act, 1955. It immediately vests all property, assets, rights, liabilities, and obligations previously held by the trust in the Government of West Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Undesirable Companies Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the registration of certain undesirable companies and mandates the winding up and dissolution of such entities. It defines specific purposes and undesirable objects, restricts business activities in the Federal Capital, and outlines penalties for contravention.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (MONTGOMERY MUNICIPALITY) VALIDATION OF TAXES ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Montgomery Municipality) Taxes Act, Validation 1958
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain taxes imposed by the Municipal Committee of Montgomery. It deems these taxes to have been validly imposed with effect from October 1, 1958.

name: WEST PAKISTAN (MONTGOMERY MUNICIPALITY) VALIDATION OF TAXES ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Montgomery Municipality) Validation of Taxes Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain taxes imposed by the Municipal Committee of Montgomery. It deems these taxes to have been validly imposed with effect from October 1, 1956, despite the Provincial Assembly not being in session at the time.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ABOLITION OF ESTATE DUTY (AGRICULTURAL LANDS) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Abolition of Estate Duty (Agricultural Lands) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Estate Duty Act, 1950 to abolish estate duty on agricultural lands within West Pakistan. It inserts specific wording into section 2 of the said Act to ensure no duty is levied on such land.

name: WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT FINANCE CORPORATION (RECOVERY OF ARREARS) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides facilities to the Agricultural Development Finance Corporation for recovering its dues. It empowers agricultural concerns to pledge or mortgage property to secure loans and allows the Corporation to recover dues by disposing of such property.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1951; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1955; Agriculturists' Loans (Sind Amendment) Act, 1941; Khairpur State Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1952; West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the advancement and recovery of taccavi loans for agricultural purposes in West Pakistan. It also provides for the making of rules regarding loans, seed sales on credit, and the recovery of advances and interest.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) XII of 1884; the Act, Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Punjab 1951, X of 1951; Agriculturists' Act, 1955; Loans (Sind Amendment) Punjab V of 1952; Khairpur State Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the laws relating to the advancement and recovery of taccavi loans for agricultural purposes in West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor under Article 102 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the payment and appropriation of certain sums out of the Provincial and Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1958-59. It specifies the total aggregate amount to be paid and applied towards defraying charges for various services and purposes listed in the Schedule.

name: WEST PAKISTAN BORDER POLICE FORCE ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Border Police Force Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the Border Police Force in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the Force, defines its functions including border defense and intelligence collection, and outlines the appointment and control structure under the Government.

name: WEST PAKISTAN BORDER POLICE FORCE ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Border Police Force Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the Border Police Force in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the Force, defines its duties including border defense and intelligence gathering, and outlines the appointment and control structure under the Government of West Pakistan.

name: WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Orphanages Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the maintenance and control of orphanages in West Pakistan. It establishes provisions for issuing licenses, defining key terms like 'orphan' and 'orphanage', and outlining the responsibilities of managers and district magistrates.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers powers on officers conducting departmental inquiries against government servants in West Pakistan to compel the attendance of witnesses and the production of documents. It grants these officers the same powers as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, with penalties for disobedience matching those of civil court processes.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers on officers conducting departmental inquiries against government servants in West Pakistan to compel witness attendance and document production. It grants these officers the same powers as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, while specifying that processes must be served by the local civil court.

name: WEST PAKISTAN DISCONTINUANCE OF (SIND) LAND REVENUE EQUALIZATION FUND ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Discontinuance of (Sind) Land Revenue Equalization Fund Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Sind Land Revenue Equalization Fund Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the discontinuance of the Land Revenue Equalization Fund established under the Sind Land Revenue Equalization Fund Act, 1947. It also repeals the said Act as amended by the 1955 Amendment Act and transfers the fund's balance to the Provincial Consolidated Fund.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Drugs (Extension) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Drugs (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Drugs Act, 1940 to the whole of the Province of West Pakistan. It also repeals the previous Drugs (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1957.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to the levy of duty on admission to entertainments in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'entertainment', 'payment for admission', and 'proprietor' to regulate the imposition of duties.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of the expiring West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1957. It consolidates the law relating to the levy of a duty on admission to entertainments in the Province of West Pakistan.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897; Khairpur State Epidemic Diseases Act, 1941; Epidemic Diseases (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the prevention of the spread of dangerous epidemic diseases in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers the Provincial Government to take necessary measures, prescribe temporary regulations, and delegate powers to prevent disease outbreaks.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of supply, distribution, and trade in certain essential articles within West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to issue orders controlling production, storage, movement, and consumption of these articles through licences or prohibitions.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of production, acquisition, keeping, storage, movement, supply, distribution, and trade in certain essential articles within West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to regulate these activities through notified orders to ensure public interest during times when immediate action is necessary.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1946 and the West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of certain essential services in West Pakistan by regulating employment conditions and preventing abandonment of work. It establishes offenses for disobeying lawful orders, abandoning employment without excuse, or discontinuing essential services, along with corresponding penalties.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, distribution, and movement of foodstuffs in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to regulate trade, commerce, storage, and pricing through notified orders.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuation and enhancement of certain taxes in West Pakistan. It establishes additional land revenue surcharges in specific districts and increases agricultural income-tax in others, while also levying new taxes on cinemas and entertainment.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOOD CONDUCT PRISONERS' PROBATIONAL RELEASE (EXTENSION) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: West Pakistan Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release (Extension) Act, 1958
metadata.amends: Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1920
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release (Extension) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act extends the Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1920 to the entire Province of West Pakistan, excluding the Federal Capital and Special Areas. It substitutes specific sections in the original 1920 Act and repeals a previous 1957 Ordinance on the same subject.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GRAVEYARDS (PRESERVATION AND MAINTENANCE) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and maintenance of graveyards in West Pakistan. It establishes committees to investigate encroachments, define graveyard limits, and handle applications regarding land titles within these areas.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HORSE RACE BETTING TAX ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Horse Race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to taxes on horse-race betting in West Pakistan onto a uniform basis. It defines key terms such as 'backer', 'book-maker', and 'totalizator' and empowers the Government to levy specific taxes on money paid into totalizators and bets made within race enclosures.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTION COMMISSION ACT (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal the West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act, 1958. It was issued pursuant to Presidential Proclamation powers on November 12, 1958.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTION COMMISSION ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission to oversee elections for local authorities in the province. It outlines the Commission's composition, appointment process, and its mandate to study various matters related to election administration, including constituency limits, voter registration, and election conduct.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTION COMMISSION ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission to make recommendations regarding local authority elections in the province. It grants powers to postpone or cancel elections, extend member terms, and codify election laws across different parts of the province.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LOCAL AUTHORITY LAWS AMENDING ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Amending Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Laws
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various laws relating to local authorities in West Pakistan, primarily by substituting the term 'Commissioner' for 'Provincial Government' throughout specific acts. It also introduces new provisions regarding the appointment of presidents for municipal committees and conditions for scheme sanctions.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the employment of women in factories within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes provisions for maternity benefits, including paid leave and specific conditions regarding the employment of pregnant women and those who have recently given birth.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MINERAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation to promote mineral development within the Province of West Pakistan. The Corporation is created as a body corporate with perpetual succession, an authorized capital of five crores rupees subscribed by the Government, and is managed by a Board of Directors appointed by the Government.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to the imposition of tax on motor vehicles in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'motor vehicle', 'licensing officer', and 'tax', and establishes the schedule for quarterly tax payments.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1957. It substitutes a specific clause regarding the commencement dates for various provisions within the amended act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN NATIONAL CALAMITIES (PREVENTION AND RELIEF) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance and restoration of order in areas affected by calamities such as floods, famines, or epidemics. It establishes the powers of a Relief Commissioner to prevent, control, and provide relief against these disasters, including the authority to requisition property and conscript labor.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SPEAKER AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly Speaker and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and other privileges of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan. It received the assent of the Governor on April 8, 1958, and was deemed to have come into force on May 20, 1956.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REGULATION OF MINES AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation of Mines and Mineral Development Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of mines and mineral development in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes provisions for prospecting licenses, mining leases, royalty payments, and the compulsory acquisition of mining properties with compensation.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REGULATION OF MINES AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation of Mines and Mineral Development Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of mines and mineral development in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rules for licensing, royalty payments, and allows the government to acquire mining properties with compensation.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of the West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1957 after its expiration. It empowers the Provincial Government to use requisitioned land, release it from requisition, acquire specific lands for government works, and determine compensation.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1946; Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1947; Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1947; West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of certain powers in relation to requisitioned land in West Pakistan. It allows the Provincial Government to use or deal with such land and establishes procedures for releasing land from requisition or acquiring it by the government.

name: WEST PAKISTAN RESTRICTIONS ON SLAUGHTER OF USEFUL ANIMALS (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Restrictions on Slaughter of Useful Animals (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Conservation (Restriction on Slaughter) of Useful Animals Act, 1950; The Bahawalpur State Conservation (Restriction on Slaughter and Export) of Cattle Act, 1949; The Sind Cattle (Restriction of Slaughter) Act, 1950; The Useful Punjab Livestock Conservation (Restriction of Slaughter) Act, 1953; The Punjab Conservation of Cattle (Meatless Days) Act, 1954; The Khairpur State Cattle (Restriction of Slaughter) Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals various laws relating to the conservation of livestock and restrictions on slaughter in the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Martial Law Regulation No. 54 and the Presidential Proclamation of October 7, 1958.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Supplementary Appropriation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes further payment and appropriation of certain sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1957-58. It specifies the total amount to be paid, which is twenty-six crores sixteen lakhs fifty-six thousand and seventy rupees, to defray supplementary charges for various services and purposes listed in the Schedule.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the regulation of retail sales of manufactured tobacco in urban areas within West Pakistan. It aims to establish a uniform basis for these regulations to protect public health by requiring dealer's licenses and imposing penalties for unauthorized sales.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to vaccination in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'unprotected child' and establishes duties for local authorities, Deputy Commissioners, and parents/guardians regarding the enforcement of vaccination procedures.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a tax on urban immovable property in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'assessing authority' and 'Collector', establishes the structure for rating areas, and specifies the rates at which tax is charged based on annual value.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to vagrancy in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes welfare homes for the custody, detention, and rehabilitation of vagrants while defining specific terms such as 'vagrant', 'public place', and 'welfare home'.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority as a body corporate to manage water and power resources. It outlines the authority's powers for irrigation, flood control, and power generation, while defining its composition and operational duties.

metadata.title: The Cinematograph (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Cinematograph Act, 1918 to apply it specifically to the Province of West Pakistan. It introduces new regulations regarding ticket sales agents, price controls, and establishes an authority for examining and certifying films suitable for public exhibition.

name: WEST PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority to unify and coordinate the development of water and power resources in the province. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its constitution including a Chairman and Members, and grants it powers to prepare comprehensive plans for resource utilization.

name: MOTOR VEHICLES ACT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1957

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles Act (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It validates certain Punjab Road Transport Board Rules from 1952 and 1953, deeming them to have had the force of law despite any conflicting court judgments.

name: MOTOR VEHICLES ACT (WEST PAKISTAN SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1957

metadata.title: THE MOTOR VEHICLES ACT (WEST PAKISTAN SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 as it applies to the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: SIND LOCAL BOARDS (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1957

metadata.title: The Sind Local Boards (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Boards Act, 1923 to modify provisions regarding the term of office for local board members. It allows the Provincial Government to extend a member's term by up to one year and establishes procedures for vacating offices and holding elections if the term expires without extension.

name: SIND DISTRICT MUNICIPAL (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1957

metadata.title: The Sind District Municipal (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957

It establishes procedures for declaring such lands capable of cultivation, serving orders on interested parties, and taking possession of land for reclamation purposes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Registration (Amendment) Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This document is a notification publishing the Punjab Medical Registration (Amendment) Act, 1954. The Act amends the Punjab Medical Registration Act, 1916 by adding a specific clause regarding the election of the Vice-President of the Council.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Act, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924 to adjust tax calculations based on vehicle seating capacity and usage location. It introduces specific provisions for vehicles operating within corporation, municipality, or cantonment limits and establishes additional tax rates for seats beyond a certain number.

name: PUNJAB ORPHANAGES, WIDOWS' HOMES AND MARRIAGE BUREAUS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1954

metadata.title: The Punjab Orphanages, Widows' Homes and Marriage Bureaux (Amendment) Act, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab Orphanages, Widows' Homes and Marriage Bureaux Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Orphanages, Widows' Homes and Marriage Bureaux Act, 1950. It adds a requirement for written appeals to include a copy of the licence granted by the District Magistrate and substitutes Section 8 to allow specific officers to inspect these institutions with proper notice.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pre-emption (Amendment) Act, 1954
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Pre-emption (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pre-emption Act, 1918 to align provisions with Shariat law regarding land succession. It specifically alters Section 15 to adjust the order of succession for sales by a Muslim and repeals the earlier 1951 amendment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Registration of Money-lenders (Amendment) Act, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab Registration of Money-lenders Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Registration of Money-lenders Act, 1938 to provide punishment for non-observance of its provisions. It substitutes specific sections regarding the dismissal of suits by unregistered money-lenders and inserts new sections imposing penalties for carrying on business without registration or charging higher interest rates.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1955

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.amends: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1955. It prohibits courts or authorities from granting injunctions, ejectment orders, possession delivery, or receiver appointments regarding requisitioned buildings and presumes that orders made under the Ordinance were validly issued by the relevant authority.

name: PUNJAB LAWS (ADAPTATION, REVISION AND REPEAL) ACT, 1954

metadata.title: The Punjab Laws (Adaptation, Revision and Repeal) Act, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab Laws (Adaptation, Revision and Repeal) Act, 1854
metadata.summary: This Act adapts and revises existing Punjab laws to account for constitutional and legislative changes following the partition of India in 1947. It also repeals certain obsolete or unnecessary laws from the previous legal framework.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) ORDINANCE, 1955

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides temporary powers to the Provincial Government of Punjab for requisitioning immovable property. It defines key terms such as 'building', 'owner', and types of repairs, outlines procedures for issuing requisition orders and notices, and specifies conditions for releasing buildings back to owners.

metadata.title: The Punjab Secondary Education Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Board of Secondary Education in the Punjab to regulate and supervise secondary education. It also empowers the Board to take charge of conducting examinations related to Matriculation, Intermediate, Pakistan, and Classical Languages.

name: PUNJAB WILD BIRDS AND WILD ANIMALS PROTECTION ACT, 1954

metadata.title: The Punjab Wild Birds and Wild Animals Protection Act, 1955
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Wild Birds and Wild Animals Protection Ordinance, 1954
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of certain wild birds and animals in the Punjab. It regulates the killing, capturing, possession, buying, selling, and exporting of these species through schedules and licensing requirements.

metadata.title: The Punjab University Act, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab University Act, 1882 and the Universities Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law relating to the University of the Punjab. It reorganizes the university's research and administration while providing for new teaching and research centers outside Lahore.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Revenue) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Board of Revenue for the Province of West Pakistan under section 88 of the Government of India Act, 1935. It vests general superintendence and control over all revenue officers and courts in the newly constituted Board, designating it as the final appellate authority for land-related matters.

metadata.title: The Thal Development Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Thal Development Act, 1949 to update provisions regarding the Authority's composition, powers, and financial responsibilities. It introduces specific changes to sections concerning member qualifications, delegation of duties, meeting attendance requirements, and salary limits for posts.

metadata.title: The Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1954 (Punjab Amendment)
metadata.summary: This document is a Punjab Ordinance promulgated by the Governor to amend the Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884. It specifically modifies subsection (1) of section 4 regarding the purchase of land for agricultural purposes.

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation (Amendment) Act, 1953
metadata.amends: The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941 to update provisions regarding councillor terms of office and election procedures. It substitutes specific sections related to the election of Mayor and Deputy Mayor, as well as rules for holding general meetings.

metadata.title: Corrigendum to the Punjab Wild Animals and Birds Protection Ordinance, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wild Animals and Birds Protection Ordinance, 1954
metadata.summary: This document is a corrigendum published in the Punjab Gazette on November 5, 1954. It serves to correct or amend details regarding the Punjab Wild Animals and Birds Protection Ordinance, 1954.

metadata.title: The Kalra Impartible Estate (Repeal) Act, 1954
metadata.repeals: The Kalra Impartible Estate Act, 1931
metadata.summary: This Act was promulgated to repeal the Kalra Impartible Estate Act, 1931, on the grounds that its provisions were repugnant to Islamic Shariat. It applies specifically to the Kalra Estate in Punjab and came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (PROVINCIAL ELECTIONS) (CORRUPT PRACTICES AND ELECTION PETITIONS) ORDER ( PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1954

metadata.title: The Government of India (Corrupt Practices and Election Petitions) Order, 1936 (Amendment) Ordinance, 1954
metadata.amends: The Government of India (Corrupt Practices and Election Petitions) Order, 1936
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Government of India (Corrupt Practices and Election Petitions) Order, 1936 to update terminology and procedures regarding election petitions in Punjab. It substitutes specific words throughout the Order to reflect changes in judicial titles and authority structures.

name: PUNJAB ADAPTATION OF PROVINCIAL LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1953

metadata.title: The Punjab Adaptation of Provincial Laws (Amendment) Act, 1953
metadata.amends: The Punjab Adaptation of Provincial Laws Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Adaptation of Provincial Laws Act, 1950. It substitutes references to 'West Punjab' with 'the Punjab' in various Acts and notifications made before the enforcement of the Indian Independence (Amendment) Act, 1950.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1951 to address tax liabilities when land is transferred to a wife or heirs under eighteen years of age. It stipulates that the owner continues to be liable for tax as if the transfer had not occurred until the heir reaches adulthood.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to apply specifically to the Punjab. It introduces changes regarding court definitions, survey procedures, and provisions for correcting clerical mistakes in awards.

name: PUNJAB ARTICLES OF DAILY USE ACT, 1953

metadata.title: The Punjab Articles of Daily Use Act, 1953
metadata.amends: The Punjab Articles of Daily Use Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act was promulgated to control the prices of articles of daily use in response to a grave economic situation. It grants the Government powers to declare price controls, require stock returns from traders, and fix maximum selling prices.

name: PUNJAB CONSERVATION OF CATTLE (MEATLESS DAYS) ORDINANCE, 1954

metadata.title: The Meatless (Punjab Conservation of Cattle Days) Ordinance, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conservation of cattle in the Punjab by prohibiting the slaughter and sale of meat on Fridays and Saturdays throughout the year. It defines key terms such as 'meatless days' and 'animal', grants powers to officers to seize carcasses or arrest offenders, and prescribes penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton (Control) (Amendment) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949 by substituting a specific clause regarding fees paid by cotton industry occupiers to cover government administration expenses. It also validates any liabilities or actions previously taken under the old clause as if they were incurred under the new substituted clause.

metadata.title: The Punjab Development Fund Cess Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to support the development of the Punjab Province. It establishes a specific cess levied on land and occupier's rates, with provisions for assessment, collection, and recovery similar to existing land revenue laws.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION (CONTROL OF UN-RECOGNIZED PRIVATE INSTITUTIONS) ACT, 1953

metadata.title: The Punjab Education (Control of Unrecognized Private Institutions) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for government control over unrecognized private educational institutions in the Punjab. It mandates the registration of existing institutions and prohibits new ones from functioning without registration, along with penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity Duty (Repeal) Ordinance, 1954
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Electricity Duty Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under section 88 of the Government of India Act, 1935. It repeals the Punjab Electricity Duty Act, 1948, which had been enacted when the Legislature was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Disturbances (Public Inquiry) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Court of Inquiry to investigate the circumstances surrounding the Punjab disturbances that led to the declaration of Martial Law on March 6, 1953. The document outlines the composition of the court, its powers regarding witnesses and evidence, and procedures for publishing its final report.

metadata.title: The Punjab Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1936 to clarify provisions regarding admission fees and exemptions for charitable or educational events. It also introduces new sections concerning security requirements for proprietors and procedures for reviewing orders made by Collectors.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 by modifying specific subsections regarding land revenue and evacuee property. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under section 88 of the Government of India Act, 1935, as the Legislature was not in session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924 to address specific circumstances requiring immediate action. It introduces new tax categories for vehicles used for passenger transport not exclusively within municipal or cantonment limits and adjusts tax rates based on seating capacity.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Safety (Amendment) Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Punjab Public Safety Act, 1949 to provide detained persons with access to relevant material and legal representation. It establishes procedures for the Chief Justice to examine detention cases and release individuals if sufficient cause is not found.

metadata.title: The Punjab Essential Articles Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the prices, possession, and control of essential articles within the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'essential articles', 'trader', and 'retailer' to establish a framework for price fixing and prohibition of unreasonable sales.

metadata.title: The Punjab Trade Employees Act, 1953 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Trade Employees Act, 1940 to regulate the opening and closing hours of shops and commercial establishments. It substitutes Section 6 of the earlier Act with new provisions specifying standard operating hours for summer and winter seasons while allowing exceptions for serving customers who were present before the closing time.

metadata.title: The Punjab University Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1954
metadata.amends: The Punjab University Act, 1882 and the Universities Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab University Act of 1882 and the Universities Act of 1904 to grant the Chancellor specific powers regarding inspections and inquiries into university buildings, laboratories, and conduct. It also transfers the responsibility for conducting Matriculation, Intermediate, and Classical examinations from the University of the Punjab to the Government of Pakistan pending the establishment of a Secondary Education Board.

name: PUNJAB WILD BIRDS AND WILD ANIMALS PROTECTION ORDINANCE, 1954

metadata.title: The Punjab Wild Birds and Wild Animals Protection Ordinance, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes better provision for the protection and preservation of certain wild birds and wild animals in Punjab. It establishes rules regarding when these species may be killed, captured, possessed, or sold, often requiring specific licences or permits.

metadata.title: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation, administration, and accounting of collections of charitable donations. It also aims to prevent frauds associated with such collections.

name: CITY OF LAHORE CORPORATION (EXTENSION OF TERM OF COUNCILLORS) ORDINANCE, 1953

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation (Extension of Term of Councillors) Ordinance, 1953
metadata.amends: The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the term of office for Councillors of the City of Lahore Corporation beyond their original expiration date. It also amends the City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941 to adjust election timelines and procedures for electing the Mayor, Deputy Mayor, and Standing Committee members.

name: Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1953

metadata.title: Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1948 to address specific offences committed by public servants. It inserts new subsections regarding territorial limits for special judges and adds a new section clarifying that military laws do not affect civil court jurisdiction.

name: PUNJAB ARTICLES OF DAILY USE ORDINANCE, 1953

metadata.title: The Punjab Articles of Daily Use Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to regulate the supply and prices of articles of daily use due to soaring prices. It applies to the entire province and comes into force immediately, defining traders' obligations and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1954
metadata.repeals: Indian Stamp (West Punjab Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the application of the Stamp Act, 1899 to the Punjab. It repeals the Indian Stamp (West Punjab Amendment) Act, 1948 and introduces new stamp duty schedules for various instruments.

name: PUNJAB CONSERVATION (RESTRICTIONS ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1953

metadata.title: The Punjab Conservation (Restrictions on Slaughter) of Useful Animals Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conservation of useful animals in the Punjab by restricting their slaughter. It defines terms such as 'animal' and 'carcass', outlines procedures for seizure and disposal, prescribes punishments for contravention, and includes exceptions for sacrificial purposes on Eid-ul-Azha.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1936 to update definitions and procedures regarding land consolidation. It introduces new clauses concerning the Provincial Government's role in moving motions for consolidation and modifies sections related to the Collector and Rehabilitation Authority functions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Goondas (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Punjab Control of Goondas Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This document promulgates an amendment to the Punjab Control of Goondas Act, 1951. It received assent from the Governor-General on March 10, 1953, and came into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton (Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949 to substitute a specific clause regarding fees payable by occupiers and dealers. It validates actions taken under the previous fee clause as if they were incurred under the new substituted clause.

metadata.title: The Punjab District Boards (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab District Boards Act, 1883 to update provisions regarding the examination and audit of district board accounts. It substitutes Section 40 to specify that accounts must be examined and audited in forms prescribed by the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Punjab Disturbances (Public Inquiry) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Disturbances (Public Inquiry) Ordinance, 1953 to address urgent circumstances when the Legislature is not in session. It introduces changes regarding court quorum, evidence inspection rights, police investigation powers, and the format of final reports.

metadata.title: The Punjab Children Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides further provisions for the custody and protection of children within the province of Punjab. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'child', 'fit person', and 'probation officer' to facilitate legal proceedings regarding children in need of care.

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity Duty (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Electricity Duty Act, 1948 to correct specific wording in section 3 regarding the imposition of duty. It received assent on January 28, 1953, and was promulgated for general information on February 2, 1953.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Inquiry Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Court of Inquiry to investigate the circumstances surrounding recent disturbances in Punjab and the responsibility for them. The Court is composed of two High Court judges and has powers similar to those under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, to examine witnesses and compel document production.

name: PUNJAB GROWTH OF FOOD CROPS ORDINANCE, 1953

metadata.title: The Punjab Crops Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the cultivation of food crops in the Punjab to encourage growing more food. It defines key terms such as 'Cultivator' and 'Food Crops' and empowers the Provincial Government to issue orders mandating minimum proportions of land dedicated to food crops.

metadata.title: The Punjab Essential Articles Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the prices, possession, and use of essential articles within the Province of Punjab. It empowers the Government to fix maximum retail prices, prohibit sales above those limits, and control the stock held by traders.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to relieve refugees in the Punjab through a specific cess. The levy is imposed on land revenue and occupier's rates, with provisions for assessment, collection, and recovery similar to existing land revenue laws.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF OPIUM SMOKING ACT, 1952

metadata.title: The Punjab Prohibition of Opium Smoking Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prohibition of opium smoking in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Opium' and 'Place', outlines penalties for manufacturing, possessing, or smoking opium, and grants powers to Excise Officers for investigation and search.

metadata.title: The Punjab Medical Registration (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Medical Registration Act, 1916 to establish a Medical Council for the Punjab with twelve members. It substitutes new provisions regarding the composition of the council, penalties for practitioners with defects of character, and updates the schedule of recognized medical qualifications.

metadata.title: The Punjab Town Improvement (Amendment) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 to provide for the improvement and expansion of towns. It specifically addresses setting up satellite towns to relieve congestion caused by the influx of refugees.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1952

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940. It substitutes a specific clause regarding the interval between successive valuation lists for any rating area.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1952

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1949 to update provisions regarding property maintenance and compensation. It introduces new sections requiring requisitioned persons to maintain structures in good repair and establishes procedures for appeals and rule-making by the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayat (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Village Panchayat Act, 1939 by substituting a proviso to section 4. The amendment clarifies that certain areas shall not include whole or parts of cantonments, municipalities under the Punjab Small Towns Act, 1921, or notified areas under the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911.

metadata.title: The Punjab Youthful Offenders Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides further provisions for the care, custody, trial, and punishment of youthful offenders in the Province of Punjab. It amends the application of the Reformatory Schools Act, 1897, to include these offenders under the Punjab Children Act, 1952.

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the increase of rent for premises located within urban areas in Punjab and regulates the eviction of tenants. It applies to all urban areas except cantonment areas and remains in force for a period of two years.

name: CITY OF LAHORE CORPORATION (EXTENSION OF TERM OF COUNCILLORS) (VALIDATION) ACT, 1951

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation (Extension of Term of Councillors) (Validation) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act validates the extension of the term of office for councillors of the City of Lahore Corporation. It deems a specific notification issued on November 7, 1951, to have been made as if it were issued on October 31, 1951, and recognizes all consequential legal effects.

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to specify circumstances under which no compensation is awarded for damage caused by water stoppage, soil deterioration, or labor displacement. It also deletes specific sections and clauses from the original 1873 Act regarding compensation allowances.

metadata.title: The Court-fees (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Court-fees Act, 1870 to update symbols on court fee stamps from the figure-head to the crescent and star. It specifically addresses documents bearing old British India designs that were still current in Punjab after August 15, 1947, allowing officers to punch out the obsolete figure-head while preserving the designated amount.

metadata.title: The Murree Municipal Committee Constitution Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of the Murree Municipal Committee. It establishes that the committee shall consist of fifteen members, with five appointed by the Provincial Government and ten elected.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to allow land acquisition for companies and for specific purposes like dwelling houses for workmen. It also validates acquisitions made before the amendment came into force that were based on these new purposes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Abolition of Jagirs Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Jagirs Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the immediate abolition of all Jagirs in Punjab, except those granted to military forces or religious/charitable institutions. It prohibits the creation of new Jagirs and terminates all rights accrued by holders or their successors upon the Act's commencement.

name: PUNJAB ADAPTATION OF PROVINCIAL LAWS ACT, 1951

metadata.title: The Punjab Adaptation of Provincial Laws Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act adapts Provincial Laws applicable in the Punjab by replacing references to 'Subordinate Judge' with 'Civil Judge'. It ensures that documents containing the old expression remain valid and are construed as if the replacement had already occurred.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income-Tax (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income-Tax Act, 1951 to update provisions regarding tax rates, assessment procedures, and owner liabilities. It substitutes specific sections of the original act to clarify how taxes are assessed by district collectors and establishes new rules for owners holding land in multiple districts.

metadata.title: The Punjab Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1936, specifically updating the preamble and section 8 regarding duty exemptions. It grants further exemption from entertainments duty for soldiers, sailors, and airmen in uniform belonging to the Armed Forces of Pakistan or any Foreign Country.

metadata.title: The Punjab General Clauses (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab General Clauses Act, 1898 by adding an explanation to section 19. The amendment clarifies that the word 'order' includes all orders made by a competent authority under any enactment, regardless of whether they bear a legislative character.

metadata.title: The Punjab Minor Canals (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905 to update specific sections regarding canal acquisition and compensation procedures. It alters wording in sections concerning inquiries, appeals to the Commissioner, and the timeline for compensation assessment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to relieve refugees in the Punjab through a specific cess. It defines key terms such as 'land', 'cess', and 'occupier's rate' and establishes the basis for levying this tax on land revenue.

name: PUNJAB DEVELOPMENT OF DAMAGED AREAS ACT, 1952

metadata.title: The Development of Damaged Areas Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development of damaged areas in the Punjab. It empowers the Government to frame schemes involving land acquisition, demolition of unfit buildings, and infrastructure improvements like streets and drainage.

name: PUNJAB NATIONAL CALAMITIES (PREVENTION AND RELIEF) ACT, 1951

metadata.title: The Punjab National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance and restoration of order in areas affected by various calamities such as famine, flood, or fire. It establishes the role of a Relief Commissioner who is empowered to take necessary steps to prevent, control, or mitigate these disasters.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION AND RESTORATION OF TENANCY RIGHTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1952

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection and Restoration of Tenancy Rights (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Punjab Protection and Restoration of Tenancy Rights Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Protection and Restoration of Tenancy Rights Act, 1950 to modify provisions regarding personal cultivation areas and tenant protections. It introduces specific rules on land exchange, subletting restrictions, and procedures for landlords wishing to sell land secured for personal cultivation.
