metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Auqaf Act, 1951
metadata.repeals: Punjab Act, XXXVI of 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the proper administration of Muslim Auqaf in the Punjab Province. It establishes a Provincial Auqaf Board, defines key terms related to waqf properties and management, and outlines the financial and procedural framework for managing these endowments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1949 to modify appeal and revision procedures. It adds a new subsection regarding appeals to the High Court and inserts specific wording into existing sections of the parent Act.

name: PUNJAB WILD BIRDS AND WILD ANIMALS PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1952

metadata.title: The Punjab Wild Birds and Wild Animals Protection (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wild Birds and Wild Animals Protection Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Wild Birds and Wild Animals Protection Act, 1933 to enhance arrest procedures for breaches of prohibitions or rules. It empowers police officers or specially authorized persons to arrest individuals without a warrant if their identity is unknown or they refuse to provide accurate details, allowing detention until identification is confirmed.

metadata.title: The Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884 to update provisions regarding loans for agricultural purposes and distress relief. It grants powers to the Financial Commissioner to make rules concerning loans for purchasing seed, cattle, or other agricultural objects not specified in the Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883.

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912 to align its provisions with the Shariat. Specifically, it inserts a requirement that tenants be Muslims and adds a new section regarding succession rights for Muslim heirs upon the death of a tenant or termination of a female's limited interest.

metadata.title: The Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act revises and declares the true form of Central Acts and Ordinances of Pakistan enacted since August 14, 1947. It provides for the printing of these laws in their entirety while specifying which acts are repealed, amended, or declared not applicable to Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of tax on agricultural income in the Punjab province. It establishes that the tax is assessed and levied annually based on total land revenue from the preceding year, payable by the land owner.

metadata.title: The Punjab Soil Reclamation Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Land Acquisition Act, I of 1894
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy reclamation and improvement of areas in Punjab damaged by floods and silt, while also preventing further damage. It establishes a Board as a body corporate with specific powers regarding land acquisition, scheme framing, and financial management.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924. It was enacted by the Governor of the Punjab following the assumption of legislative powers under the Government of India Act, 1935.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to offer relief to refugees in the Punjab. It establishes a specific cess levied on land revenue and occupier's rates, with provisions for its assessment, collection, and recovery.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Auqaf Survey (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.amends: The Punjab Muslim Auqaf Survey Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Muslim Auqaf Survey Act, 1950 by substituting a specific subsection regarding the registration of waqfs. It mandates that Mutawallis must apply for registration within three months of a fixed date or upon the creation of a new waqf, with provisions for reference to the Nazim-i-ala if doubts exist.

name: PUNJAB MUSLIM PERSONAL LAW (SHARIAT) APPLICATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1951

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.amends: The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1948 to provide further provisions for the application of Shariat to Muslims in specific matters. It substitutes existing sections regarding succession and family institutions and inserts a new section addressing the devolution of property when a legatee dies before enjoying their share under a will.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pre-emption (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pre-emption Act, 1913 to align its application to Muslims with the Shariat. Specifically, it adds a proviso to section 15 of the amended 1913 Act regarding sales made by Muslims.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Safety (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Public Safety Act, 1949 to provide for the arrest and detention of persons acting prejudicial to public safety or order. It outlines the procedures for government orders, district magistrate references, police arrest powers without warrants, and judicial review requirements for long-term detentions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Control of Goondas Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better control of riotous persons commonly known as goondas in the Punjab. It establishes District Tribunals composed of the District Magistrate and the Superintendent of Police to conduct enquiries against such persons.

name: PUNJAB STATE AID TO INDUSTRIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1951

metadata.title: The Punjab State Aid to Industries (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.amends: The Punjab State Aid to Industries Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab State Aid to Industries Act, 1935, by altering specific clauses within Section 3 regarding chamber representation. It was enacted by the Governor of the Punjab following a proclamation assuming legislative powers under the Government of India Act, 1935.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pure Food (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pure Food Act, 1929 to update provisions regarding food authorities, inspection powers, and penalties for selling unfit food. It introduces new sections defining local authority roles and substitutes existing clauses with stricter punishments for offenses.

metadata.title: The Punjab Town Improvement (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 by deleting subsection (5) of section 4. It received assent on January 6, 1951, and came into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887 to align its provisions regarding succession and occupancy rights with the Muslim Personal Law (Shariat). It specifically details how rights devolve upon the death of Muslim and non-Muslim tenants, including rules for female limited owners and widows.

metadata.title: The Thal Development (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Thal Development Act, 1949 to update provisions regarding land possession and compensation calculations. It substitutes specific subsections in section 36 and adds new paragraphs to the Schedule concerning net income shares and sale transaction prices for land acquisition.

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act amends the City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941 to further regulate the composition and election of the corporation. It substitutes provisions regarding the number of councillors, election notification procedures, and oaths of allegiance to the Constitution of Pakistan.

name: CITY OF LAHORE CORPORATION (APPOINTMENT AND EXTENSION OF TERM OF COUNCILLORS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation (Appointment and Extension of Term of Councillors) (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The City of Lahore Corporation (Appointment and Extension of Term of Councillors) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the City of Lahore Corporation (Appointment and Extension of Term of Councillors) Act, 1949. It provides for the appointment of new councillors and extends their terms of office by substituting specific dates in the original legislation.

name: PUNJAB (PUBLIC SAFETY) INDEMNIFICATION OF ORDERS, ARRESTS AND DETENTIONS ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab (Public Safety) Indemnification of Orders, Arrests and Detentions Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act indemnifies the Government of Punjab, its officers, and other persons against legal liability for orders, arrests, and detentions made under the Punjab Public Safety Act, 1949. It declares that no suit or criminal prosecution shall lie against those who acted in pursuance of such orders, even if they are later held illegal by a court.

name: Punjab Adaptation of Provincial Laws Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Adaptation of Provincial Laws Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act adapts Provincial Laws for the Punjab by replacing references to 'West Punjab' with 'the Punjab'. It is deemed to have come into force immediately after the enforcement of the Indian Independence (Amendment) Act, 1950.

metadata.title: The Punjab Transport Board Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Punjab Road Transport Board to ensure efficient control and gradual nationalisation of motor road transport in the Punjab. It outlines the composition, appointment, tenure, and duties of the Board's members, as well as its powers regarding undertakings and financial matters.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 to update the definition of agricultural produce. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on April 3, 1950, following assent received on March 29, 1950.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1936 to further regulate the process for consolidating agricultural land holdings. It introduces specific provisions regarding applications by landowners and addresses scenarios involving evacuee property and encroachments on recorded rights.

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition and collection of tax on agricultural income in the Punjab for the year 1950-51. It establishes that the tax shall be assessed based on land revenue payable for the previous year (1949-50) and outlines procedures for assessment, collection, appeals, and penalties for false statements.

name: PUNJAB CROWN LANDS (RESUMPTION OF GRANTS AND EXTINGUISHMENT OF RIGHTS) ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Crown Lands (Resumption of Grants and Extinguishment of Rights) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the resumption of certain government grants of Crown land made between 1945 and 1947, which were issued in disregard of public interest. It also addresses the extinguishment of rights associated with these grants and outlines procedures for compensation or refunds to grantees.

metadata.title: The Punjab District Boards (Second Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab District Boards Act, 1883 by substituting specific words in section 19-A regarding health officials. It was promulgated for general information after receiving the assent of the Governor on August 17, 1950.

metadata.title: The Punjab District Boards (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab District Boards Act, 1883 to update provisions regarding the composition, election, and oath of allegiance for members of District Boards. It also modifies rules concerning term limits, eligibility for re-election, and the handling of casual vacancies.

metadata.title: The Punjab Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1936 to strengthen provisions against duty evasion and impose stricter penalties on proprietors of entertainment venues. It introduces new sections regarding joint liability for offenses committed by employees and clarifies the status of collectors as public servants.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Excise Act of 1914 to update specific clauses regarding intoxicants. It substitutes existing text in section 59 concerning the strength, maximum/minimum prices, and possession limits of intoxicants.

metadata.title: The Punjab Flood Relief Cess (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Punjab Flood Relief Cess Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Flood Relief Cess Act, 1950 by substituting specific figures and hyphens in sections 1 and 3. It is deemed to have come into force simultaneously with the original Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Flood Relief Cess Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds through a specific cess to finance flood relief measures in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Land', 'Cess', and 'Occupier's rate' and specifies the levy rates applicable to land revenue and occupier's rates for the kharif 1950-51 harvest.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 by substituting specific words in its explanation. It received assent on February 16, 1950, and was promulgated for general information on February 21, 1950.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Second Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 by substituting the definition of 'village cess' in section 3 and deleting specific words from section 145. It was promulgated for general information after receiving the assent of the Governor on June 3, 1950.

metadata.title: The Punjab Legislative Assembly Elections (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Punjab Legislative Assembly Elections Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Schedule to the Punjab Legislative Assembly Elections Act, 1950. It substitutes a specific entry regarding Police Station areas in the Mianwali district.

name: PUNJAB HORSE RACE BETTING TAX ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Horse-Race Betting Tax Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a tax on horse-race betting within the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'backer', 'book-maker', and 'totalizator' and establishes the mechanisms for assessing, collecting, and paying these taxes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to offer relief to refugees in the Punjab. It imposes a specific cess on land based on land revenue and occupier's rates, with provisions for its assessment, collection, and recovery.

metadata.title: The Punjab Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maternity Benefit Act, 1943 to change the duration of certain provisions from thirty days to six weeks. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on September 28, 1950, for general information.

metadata.title: The Punjab Maternity Benefit (Second Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maternity Benefit Act, 1943 to update the definition of 'employer'. Specifically, it substitutes a new clause in section 2 to include contractors and sub-contractors engaged in factory-related work within the scope of the employer's responsibilities.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Schedule to the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924. It received assent on February 24, 1950, and was promulgated for general information via a notification on March 2, 1950.

name: PUNJAB MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (FOURTH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation (Fourth Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act serves as the fourth amendment to the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924. It was enacted by the Governor of the Punjab on November 27, 1950, and received general promulgation on November 29, 1950.

name: PUNJAB MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation (Second Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924. It was enacted by the Governor of the Punjab on behalf of the Governor-General following a proclamation under the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: PUNJAB MOTOR VEHICLES TAXATION (THIRD AMENDMENT) ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation (Third Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924 by adding definitions for Excise and Taxation Commissioners. It also substitutes Section 12 to establish a formal appeal process to the Deputy Commissioner and allows for revision of appellate orders.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of a cess on land and occupier's rates to raise funds for the relief of refugees in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'land', 'land revenue', and 'cess', and outlines the rates, liability for payment, and methods for assessment, collection, and recovery.

metadata.title: The Punjab Legislative Assembly Elections Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Government of India (Provincial Elections) (Corrupt Practices and Election Petitions) Order, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions for elections to the Punjab Legislative Assembly, specifically addressing matters related to refugee candidates and reserved seats. It amends the Government of India (Provincial Elections) (Corrupt Practices and Election Petitions) Order, 1936, regarding corrupt practices in the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911 to update provisions regarding municipal committees. It includes changes to committee composition, member retirement by rotation, vacancy filling procedures, and election notification requirements.

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal (Second Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911 to update references regarding health and education officers. Specifically, it substitutes 'District Health Officer' for 'District Medical Officer' and grants certain powers to the Director of Health Services, District Health Officer, or officers of the Department of Public Instruction.

metadata.title: The Punjab Opium Smoking Act, 1950
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Opium Smoking Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of opium smoking practices with the ultimate goal of total prohibition in the Punjab. It establishes a registration system for smokers, regulates the manufacture and possession of prepared opium, and outlines penalties for unauthorized smoking or allowing premises to be used for such activities.

name: PUNJAB ORPHANAGES, WIDOWS, HOMES AND MARRIAGE BUREAUX ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Orphanages, Widows' Homes and Marriage Bureaux Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better control and supervision of orphanages, widows' homes, and marriage bureaus in the Punjab. It establishes definitions for these institutions and outlines the requirements for obtaining a license to operate them, including conditions regarding society registration and local respectability.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION AND RESTORATION OF TENANCY RIGHTS ACT, 1950

metadata.title: The Punjab Protection and Restoration of Tenancy Rights Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act protects and restores the tenancy rights of certain land tenants in Punjab. It establishes specific grounds on which a tenant may be ejected, such as failure to pay rent or failing to cultivate the land, while providing safeguards against arbitrary eviction.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Safety (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Punjab Public Safety Act, 1949 to clarify interpretations regarding section 36 and address differences of opinion on its application. It adds specific explanations about when cases are deemed instituted and modifies procedures concerning trials with or without assessors for cases pending before a certain date.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Safety (Second Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Public Safety (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the West Punjab Public Safety Act, 1949 by inserting a new section regarding trial procedures and omitting specific provisos and explanations from existing sections. It also repeals the previous Punjab Public Safety (Amendment) Act of 1950.

metadata.title: The Punjab Muslim Auqaf Survey Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the survey of Muslim Auqaf in the Province of Punjab. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'Beneficiary', 'Waqf property', and 'Mutawalli', and outlines the appointment of Nazims to manage these affairs.

metadata.title: The Punjab Tenancy (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887 to clarify definitions regarding village cess and contributions. It adds a new section prohibiting landlords from demanding additional cesses or free personal services beyond the agreed rent.

metadata.title: The Punjab Town Improvement (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 by substituting subsection (3) of section 1. It grants the Provincial Government the power to propose applying the rest of the Act to whole or parts of municipalities and adjacent localities via notification.

metadata.title: The Punjab University Malpractices Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the eradication of malpractices connected with university examinations held by the University of the Punjab. It defines specific terms related to examinations and outlines various offenses, such as premature disclosure of questions or falsification of results, along with their punishments.

name: CITY OF LAHORE CORPORATION (APPOINTMENT AND EXTENSION OF TERM OF COUNCILLORS) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation (Appointment and Extension of Term of Councillors) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of councillors and extends their terms of office in the City of Lahore Corporation. It specifically addresses filling vacant non-Muslim councillor seats and extending the term until May 1, 1950.

metadata.title: The Court-Fees (West Punjab Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Court-Fees Act, 1870 by adding a new fee schedule item for permits to obtain iron or steel. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Punjab on December 6, 1949, and deemed to have come into force from November 1, 1949.

name: INDIAN STAMP (WEST PUNJAB SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp (West Punjab Second Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The Indian Stamp (West Punjab Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Stamp (West Punjab Amendment) Act, 1948 by substituting specific words and entries in Schedules I and I-A. It updates monetary values, instrument numbers, exemption categories, and jurisdictional references within the stamp duty schedules.

metadata.title: The Police (West Punjab Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Act, 1881 by adding specific powers regarding dismissal, suspension, reduction in rank or time-scale, and stoppage of increments. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Punjab under the Government of India Act, 1935.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 to update definitions and regulations regarding agricultural products in West Punjab. It introduces new clauses concerning warehousemen, modifies licensing requirements for various market participants, and adjusts provisions related to committee appointments and member qualifications.

name: PUNJAB MUNICIPAL (EXECUTIVE OFFICER) (WEST PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940. It was promulgated for general information after receiving the assent of the Governor on March 21, 1949.

metadata.title: The Sikh Gurdwaras (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925. It adds a proviso to section 84 regarding special circumstances for meetings and substitutes subsection (4) of section 85 concerning the election of local committee members.

name: WEST PAKISTAN AGRICULTURE INCOME TAX ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of a tax on agricultural income in West Punjab. It defines the scope of the tax, the basis for assessment, and procedures for collection and appeals.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1949
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Cotton Control Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the licensing of cotton ginning and pressing factories in West Punjab. It regulates the supply of cotton to these factories, prevents the mixing of different varieties, plans production on a regional basis, and ensures the supply of pure seed to cultivators.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (FIFTH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Fifth Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940 to update definitions and provisions regarding owners, rating areas, and public purpose lands. It also introduces requirements for public notice and returns when new valuation lists are prepared.

name: WEST PUNJAB DISTRICT BOARDS (APPOINTMENT OF MEMBERS) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab District Boards (Appointment of Members) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act was promulgated by the Governor of West Punjab on April 4, 1949, to address vacancies in District Boards caused by the migration of Hindu or Sikh members. It empowers the Provincial Government to appoint settled refugees to fill these seats for the remainder of the original term.

name: WEST PUNJAB ELECTRICITY (EMERGENCY POWERS) (CONTROL OF SUPPLY) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Electricity (Emergency Powers) (Control Supply) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The West Punjab Electricity (Emergency Powers) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuation and exercise of emergency powers to control the supply, consumption, distribution, and use of electrical energy in the Province of West Punjab. It authorizes the Provincial Government to direct suppliers to restrict or discontinue energy supply under specific circumstances, such as contravention of directions or exceeding maximum demand limits.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Excise (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Excise Act, 1914 to update provisions regarding the prohibition and restriction of intoxicant possession and consumption. It specifically alters sections 13, 24, 34, 58, and 61 of the original Act to refine language related to financial commissioners, provincial government powers, and enforcement clauses.

metadata.title: The West Punjab General Clauses (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab General Clauses Act, 1898 to update definitions relevant to the transition from British India to the Dominion of Pakistan. It specifically revises terms such as 'Colony', 'India', 'Pakistan', and 'Provincial Government' to reflect the new political landscape following the establishment of the Federation of Pakistan.

name: WEST PUNJAB MUHAJIR FUND CESS ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of a fund to assist refugees in West Pakistan. It establishes a specific cess levied on land revenue at a rate of two annas per rupee.

name: WEST PUNJAB MUNICIPAL FIRE BRIGADE ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Municipal Fire Brigade Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the organization of fire-brigades in municipal towns within West Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'fire-fighting service' and 'municipal authority', and grants powers to the Provincial Government to establish, inspect, and manage fire services.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Public Safety Act, 1949
metadata.repeals: Punjab Public Safety Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures to ensure public safety and the maintenance of public order in West Punjab. It grants the Government and authorized officials the power to arrest persons without a warrant if necessary to prevent actions prejudicial to public safety or order, and allows for detention exceeding one month under specific conditions.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Qaumi Razakars Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of Qaumi Razakars in West Punjab to assist in maintaining law and order, national reconstruction, and internal defence. It outlines the powers of District Magistrates to constitute these bodies, appoint members, call them out for training or service, and regulate their discipline and uniform.

name: ADAPTATION OF CENTRAL ACTS AND ORDINANCE ORDER, 1949

metadata.title: The Adaptation of Central Acts and Ordinances Order, 1949
metadata.summary: This Order provides necessary adaptations for bringing the provisions of the Indian Independence Act, 1947 into effective operation in Pakistan. It specifies how existing British India laws continue as law in the new Dominion with required modifications and defines terms like 'Central Act' and 'Ordinance' within this context.

name: WEST PUNJAB REFUGEES (REGISTRATION OF LAND CLAIMS) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) Act, 1949
metadata.repeals: The West Punjab Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of claims in respect of lands abandoned by refugees due to civil disturbances or the partition of the country. It defines key terms such as 'claim', 'land', and 'refugee' within the context of West Punjab and establishes the powers of Registering Officers.

name: WEST PUNJAB SMALL TOWNS (APPOINTMENT OF MEMBERS) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Small Towns (Appointment of Members) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The Punjab Hindu Small Towns (Appointment of Members) Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act allows the Provincial Government of West Punjab to appoint a refugee as a member of a town committee if an existing member has migrated and been removed. The term 'refugee' is defined according to Pakistan Ordinance No. XVIII of 1948, and the appointed member serves the unexpired portion of the office held by the previous member.

name: WEST PUNJAB THAL (INCREASE IN VALUE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Thal (Increase in Value) Act, 1940 by substituting the word 'sixty' for 'thirty' in section 3(2), deleting specific subsections of sections 4 and 7, and adding a proviso regarding tax payment for non-inheritance transfers. It was promulgated for general information after receiving the assent of the Governor on June 2, 1949.

name: WEST PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1949
metadata.repeals: The West Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides temporary provisions for the requisitioning and acquisition of immovable property in West Punjab. It outlines the procedures for government orders, release from requisition, and the determination of compensation through agreement or arbitration.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Town Improvement (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This document is an Act received the assent of the Governor on October 28, 1949, and promulgated for general information. It amends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 by replacing the word 'six' with 'four' in section 12(1)(b) of that Act.

name: WEST PUNJAB URBAN RENT RESTRICTION ACT, 1949

metadata.title: The West Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the increase of rent for certain premises situated within urban areas in West Punjab and regulates the eviction of tenants. It applies to all urban areas in West Punjab except Cantonment areas and comes into force immediately after the expiry of the Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1947.

metadata.title: The Arbitral Tribunal (Dissolution) Act, 1948
metadata.repeals: The Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act dissolves the Arbitral Tribunal established under the Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947. It ensures that any awards made by the dissolved tribunal remain valid and binding on all parties concerned.

metadata.title: The Public Subscriptions (Prevention of Abuses) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the collection of public subscriptions to prevent their misuse for political party purposes or election expenses. It mandates that funds collected through government servants must be spent only on authorized objects and requires monthly publication of collected amounts in the Government Gazette.

metadata.title: The Indian Forest (West Punjab Amendment) Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Forest Act of 1927 specifically for its application to West Punjab. It received assent from the Governor on February 18, 1948, and was promulgated for general information on February 20, 1948.

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp (West Punjab Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Stamp Act of 1899 specifically regarding its application to West Punjab. It revises the existing scale of stamp duties for various legal instruments within that region.

name: WEST PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX ACT, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of tax on agricultural income accruing from lands situated in West Punjab. It establishes that the tax shall be assessed by the Collector based on land revenue paid during the financial year 1947-48 and specifies rates for different slabs of revenue.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Border Police Act
metadata.repeals: The Home Guards Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the constitution and functions of a Border Police in West Punjab. It grants members of this new force the same powers, privileges, and protections as regular police officers appointed under existing laws.

name: WEST PUNJAB CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE AND POLICE ACT (AMENDING) ORDINANCE, 1948

metadata.title: West Punjab Code of Criminal Procedure and Police Act (Amending) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.amends: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898; Police Act, 1861
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, and the Police Act, 1861 to reduce the period for disposing of unclaimed or looted property from six months to one month. It applies to the whole of West Punjab and is deemed effective from August 15, 1947.

name: WEST PUNJAB CONTROL OF REFUGEES ORDINANCE, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Control of Refugees Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Punjab to maintain order around refugee camps when the Legislature was not in session. It defines key terms such as 'refugee' and 'Refugee Commissioner' and empowers Magistrates and Police officers to direct refugees to move or refrain from specific actions.

metadata.title: The Thal Development Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy development of the Thal area brought under irrigation by the Thal Project. It also addresses the re-settlement of refugees and other persons in the region, along with the levy of a development fee. The legislation establishes the constitution, powers, and terms of office for the Thal Development Authority responsible for executing these provisions.

name: West Punjab Development of Damaged Areas Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Damaged Areas (Development) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Provincial Government of West Punjab to declare specific areas as damaged and authorize Improvement Trusts to frame development schemes for them. The legislation outlines powers for land acquisition, building demolition, street laying, and infrastructure improvement within these designated zones.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Electricity Duty Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act levies a duty on electrical energy consumed for lights, fans, and certain other appliances in West Punjab. It defines various categories of supply and consumers, including bulk supply, distributing licensees, and industrial consumers.

name: West Punjab Legislative Assembly Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's Salaries (Amendment) Act, 1948

metadata.title: West Punjab Legislative Assembly Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's Salaries (Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.amends: Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's Salaries Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's Salaries Act, 1937 to provide for a free furnished house or an annual allowance of Rs. 3,600 for the Speaker of the West Punjab Legislative Assembly. It also corrects punctuation in section 2 of the amended Act by replacing a full stop with a semi-colon.

name: West Punjab Motor Spirit (Taxation of Sales) (Amendment) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Motor Spirit (Taxation of Sales) (Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.amends: The Punjab Motor Spirit (Taxation of Sales) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Motor Spirit (Taxation of Sales) Act, 1939. It comes into force immediately upon promulgation.

name: West Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess (Amendment) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Muhajar Fund Cess (Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.amends: The West Punjab Muhajar Fund Cess Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act corrects a drafting mistake in the West Punjab Muhajar Fund Cess Act, 1948. It substitutes the year '1947' for '1948' in subsection (3) of section 13 of the original Act.

name: West Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess Act, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Muhajir Fund Cess Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to offer relief to refugees in West Punjab. It was promulgated by the Governor on February 18, 1948, and came into force with effect from the Kharif harvest of 1948.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Highways Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development, construction, and maintenance of highways in West Punjab. It establishes the powers of Highway Authorities to regulate traffic, manage encroachments, and ensure public safety on roads.

name: West Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Applications Act, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the application of the Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) regarding succession to limited interests in West Punjab. It ensures that upon the death of a female owner, her limited interest devolves according to the law as if she had inherited the full property, overriding contrary customs or usages.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Municipal (Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911 by adding a new subsection to section 193. It establishes procedures for building committees regarding the erection or re-erection of buildings that may interfere with proposed schemes.

metadata.title: The West Punjab Public Safety (Amendment) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends section 3(5) of the Punjab Public Safety Act, 1947 to limit the duration of provincial government orders under that Act. It stipulates that such orders shall not remain in force for more than six months unless renewed by the Provincial Government before expiry.

name: WEST PUNJAB REFUGEES (REGISTRATION OF LAND CLAIMS) ORDINANCE, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Punjab to register land claims made by refugees who abandoned their property in East Punjab and surrounding states due to civil disturbances or partition. It defines key terms such as 'refugee', 'land', and 'claim', establishes the powers of Registering Officers, and outlines procedures for submitting claims via affidavit.

metadata.title: The Arbitral Tribunal (Dissolution) Act, 1948
metadata.repeals: The Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act dissolves the Arbitral Tribunal established under the Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947. It ensures that any awards made by the dissolved tribunal remain valid and binding on all parties concerned.

name: West Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Fourth Amendment) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Fourth Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940 by substituting a specific clause regarding annual valuation limits in rating areas. It was promulgated for general information after receiving assent from the Governor on April 7, 1948.

name: West Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Third Amendment) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Third Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940. It specifically addresses procedures for cases where a valuation list is lost or destroyed due to circumstances beyond control, allowing for the preparation of a new list and the recovery of pending taxes.

name: West Punjab Protection of Evacuee Property Act, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Protection of Evacuee Property Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection and care of the property of evacuees from West Punjab. It establishes the powers of a Custodian to take possession of such property, regulate its transfer, and manage it on behalf of the evacuees.

metadata.title: The Police (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Act, 1861 by adding specific clauses regarding dismissal, suspension, or reduction of rank. It also introduces provisions for the stoppage of increments within a time-scale.

metadata.title: The Punjab Cotton (Control) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control and regulation of the production, movement, supply, and distribution of cotton within the Province of Punjab. It empowers the Provincial Government to issue orders regarding licensing, price controls, storage, transport, and the collection of information related to cotton trade.

metadata.title: The Punjab Disturbed Areas (Amendment) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Disturbed Areas Act, 1947 by inserting new sections regarding offenses in disturbed areas. It prescribes the death penalty for causing explosions likely to endanger life or property and for possessing explosives under suspicious circumstances.

metadata.title: The Punjab Disturbed Areas Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the suppression of disorder and maintenance of public order in disturbed areas of Punjab. It empowers the Provincial Government to declare specific areas as disturbed and allows for enhanced punishments, including death, for certain offenses committed within those areas.

metadata.title: The Punjab Damaged Areas Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salvage and disposal of property as well as the clearance of debris in urban areas struck by disaster. It empowers the Provincial Government to declare damaged areas, amend existing municipal laws for specific purposes, and establish Claims Commissioners to handle claims regarding salvaged property.

metadata.title: The Punjab General Clauses (Amendment) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab General Clauses Act, 1898 to clarify how repeals affect existing amendments and to update specific wording within that Act. It was enacted by the Governor of the Punjab following the assumption of legislative powers under the Government of India Act, 1935.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Matured Area) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government of Punjab to prescribe the method for determining the matured area during the rabi 1946-47 harvest. It applies to the whole of Punjab and comes into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Trespass (Emergency Provisions) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the punishment of unlawful cultivation of land and the ejectment of trespassers from such land. It defines key terms like 'land' and 'cultivation' and establishes penalties including imprisonment or fines for those who unlawfully cultivate another's land.

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal (Amendment) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911. It was enacted by the Governor of the Punjab under powers assumed from the Provincial Legislature pursuant to the Government of India Act, 1935.

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity (Emergency Powers) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, consumption, distribution, and use of electrical energy in the Province of Punjab. It empowers the Provincial Government to prohibit or restrict energy supply, fix rates, and manage situations arising from requisitions or contracts during emergency circumstances.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Safety (Amendment) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Public Safety Act, 1947 by re-numbering existing sections and adding new provisions regarding the trial of offences in dangerously disturbed areas. It also substitutes specific wording in Section 37 concerning police reports and the jurisdiction of Courts of Session.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Safety (Second Amendment) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Public Safety Act, 1947 by inserting a new section (13-A). The new provision empowers District Magistrates or authorized first-class Magistrates to order the immediate removal of obstructions that impede police or fire brigade operations in Lahore and other specified areas. It also grants authorities the power to take necessary steps if an ordered person fails to comply within the specified time.

name: PUNJAB REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) ACT, 1947

metadata.title: The Punjab Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides temporary powers for the Provincial Government of Punjab to requisition and acquire immovable property. It outlines procedures for releasing property, determining compensation through agreement or arbitration, and managing disputes related to such acquisitions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Tribunals Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of Special Tribunals to try criminal offences within the Province of Punjab. It outlines the composition of these tribunals, their jurisdiction, procedural rules, and powers regarding sentencing and public access during trials.

metadata.title: The Punjab Special Tribunals (Continuance) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of the Special Tribunals constituted under the Criminal Law Amendment Ordinance, 1943. It ensures that these tribunals can continue to function and dispose of cases not yet concluded before the expiration of the emergency period.

name: ANDAMAN AND NICOBAR ISLANDS POLICE FORCE (TEMPORARY PROVISIONS) ORDINANCE, 1945

metadata.title: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands Police Force (Temporary Provisions) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to temporarily regulate the Andaman and Nicobar Islands Police Force during an emergency. It applies to the whole of British India and grants specific powers to police members within their respective provinces.

metadata.title: Armed Forces (Special Powers) Amendment Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1942 by substituting a new section regarding arrest procedures. It mandates that arrested persons be reported to the appropriate authority or military officer as soon as practicable.

metadata.title: The Badshahi Mosque Fund Cess Act, 1945
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of a cess to raise funds for the repair, maintenance, and endowment of the Badshahi Mosque. The cess is levied on land owned by Muslims or institutions in Punjab at a rate of three pies per rupee of annual value.

metadata.title: The Exchange Control Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides emergency provisions regarding bills of exchange payable outside British India during war conditions. It extends to the whole of British India and allows for legal proceedings related to claims arising from such bills.

metadata.title: The Punjab Public Safety Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures to ensure public safety and the maintenance of public order in the Punjab. It grants the Provincial Government, District Magistrates, and authorized servants of the Crown powers to arrest suspected persons without a warrant and detain them for up to six months.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Amendment) Second Amending Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Criminal Law Amendment Ordinance, 1943. It modifies the long title and preamble of the parent Ordinance, substitutes new sections regarding special tribunals and their composition, and amends the Schedule to include specific offences related to hoarding and profiteering.

metadata.title: Defence of India (Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Defence of India Act, 1939 to address an emergency situation. It inserts specific phrases into sections 2 and 17 of the parent Act regarding orders issued thereunder.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Criminal Law Ordinance, 1943, to facilitate the functioning of Special Tribunals during an emergency. It provides for the substitution of sections, omission of specific words in schedules, and the power to allot cases or transfer them between tribunals via government notification.

metadata.title: The Defence of India (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Defence of India Act, 1939 to address an emergency situation. It specifically adds provisions regarding forfeiture adjudication by courts or other authorities.

metadata.title: The Defence of India (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Defence of India Act, 1939 to address issues regarding property requisitioned by the Government. It specifically alters provisions related to compensation calculations and arbitration proceedings for such properties.

metadata.title: The Excess Profits Tax Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Excess Profits Tax Ordinance, 1943, to address an emergency situation. It inserts new provisions regarding accounting periods ending after December 31, 1944, and substitutes specific figures in the relevant subsections.

metadata.title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 1945
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Factories Act, 1934 to provide for annual holidays and wages for workers in factories. It grants powers to Provincial Governments to make rules regarding holidays and exemptions for factories with similar benefits.

metadata.title: The Indian Explosives (Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Indian Explosives Act, 1884 to strengthen safety measures and inquiry procedures regarding accidents involving explosives. It introduces new penalties for failing to give notice of accidents and substitutes sections related to accident inquiries and exemptions for government forces.

metadata.title: The Indian Army (Amendment) Act, 1945
metadata.amends: The Indian Army Act, 1911; The National Service (European British Subjects) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Indian Army Act, 1911, and the National Service (European British Subjects) Act, 1940. It introduces provisions regarding inquiries into the conduct of prisoners of war and grants authorities power to withhold pay and allowances based on such conduct.

metadata.title: The Indian Companies (Amendment) Act, 1945
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Companies Act, 1913 by adding a new subsection to section 282B. The amendment clarifies that the provisions of the Act do not affect an employee's rights under recognized provident fund rules regarding advances or withdrawals.

name: INDIAN ARMY AND INDIAN AIR FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1945

metadata.title: The Indian Army and Indian Air Force (Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.amends: The Indian Army Act, 1911; The Indian Air Force Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Indian Army Act, 1911, and the Indian Air Force Act, 1932 to address offenses committed by prisoners of war or individuals in enemy territory after December 7, 1941. It defines 'enemy territory' and adjusts time computation periods for legal proceedings involving such individuals.

metadata.title: The Indian Income-tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance enacted by the Governor-General of India to amend the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922. It introduces specific amendments regarding the definition of earned income, treatment of Hindu undivided families, and modifications to sections concerning business profits and super-tax calculations.

metadata.title: The Indian Companies Act (Amendment) Act, 1945
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Companies Act, 1913 to include provisions regarding co-operative societies. It adds a new subsection to section 282B concerning exemptions for members of families employed in cotton premises.

name: MILITARY OPERATIONAL AREA (SPECIAL POWERS) AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1945

metadata.title: The Military Operational Area (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.amends: The Military Operational Area (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Military Operational Area (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1943. It substitutes specific terms regarding the 'General Officer Commanding' and other sections within the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Patents and Designs Act, 1911 (Amendment Act II of 1945)
metadata.summary: This document serves as an amendment to the Patents and Designs Act, 1911. It introduces changes regarding the definitions of provisional and complete specifications, requirements for describing inventions, and timelines for sealing applications.

metadata.title: The Mines (Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Indian Mines Act, 1923 to insert specific clauses regarding the maintenance of rooms reserved for women employed in mines. It establishes rules concerning the number of such rooms and supervision standards applicable during an emergency.

metadata.title: The Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 1945
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Mines Maternity Benefit Act, 1941 to provide further protections for women employed in mines. It introduces requirements for informing owners about pregnancy, mandates medical examinations, and specifies conditions for maternity leave and creche facilities.

name: NATIONAL SERVICE, (EOURPEAN BRITISH SUBJECTS) AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1945

metadata.title: The National Service (European British Subject) Amendment Ordinance, 1945
metadata.amends: The National Service (European British Subject) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the National Service (European British Subject) Act, 1940 to address an emergency situation. It grants powers to the Governor-General or Commander-in-Chief regarding appointments and leave for urgent reasons.

metadata.title: The Present War (Definition) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance defines the meaning of 'war' and related expressions for legal purposes in British India. It specifies that references to war include the period from September 3, 1939, to August 8, 1941, or until hostilities are terminated by the Viceroy and Governor-General.

name: NATIONAL SERVICE, (EOURPEAN BRITISH SUBJECTS) AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1945

metadata.title: The National Service (European British Subjects) Amendment Ordinance, 1945
metadata.amends: The National Service (European British Subjects) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the National Service (European British Subjects) Act, 1940, enacted during an emergency. It substitutes specific clauses regarding competent authority and command areas, while also modifying provisions related to official notices.

metadata.title: Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance temporarily validates certain Provincial debt enactments and amendments enacted before December 12, 1944. It ensures that transactions based on promissory notes are deemed valid and effectual as if they had been made by the Central Legislature.

metadata.title: The Punjab Markets Agricultural Produce (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.amends: The Punjab Markets Agricultural Produce Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Markets Agricultural Produce Act of 1939 by adding specific words to various sections. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Punjab Criminal Law (Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the validity of the Punjab Criminal Law Act, 1935. It substitutes a specific subsection to ensure the Act remains in force until April 30, 1946.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1945 (Amendment) Act
metadata.amends: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1919 to address issues regarding the re-arrangement of holdings for cooperative societies. It includes provisions for arbitration decisions and modifies specific sections and clauses of the original 1919 Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab District Boards (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab District Boards Act, 1883 by substituting a new section regarding local rates on land. It establishes a standard local rate of one anna per rupee of annual value and grants the Provincial Government powers to exempt land or abolish these rates.

name: RESERVE BANK OF INDIA (TEMPORARY AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1945

metadata.title: The Reserve Bank of India Act (Temporary Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.amends: The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to temporarily amend the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 during an emergency. It specifically addresses provisions related to the British Military Administration in Burma and grants powers regarding currency functions and banking operations.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1945
metadata.repeals: The Indian Rubber Control Act, 1934; The Indian Census Act, 1939; The Registration (Emergency Powers) Act, 1940; The Offences on Ships and Aircraft Act, 1940; The Indian Coinage (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Indian Emigration (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Reserve Bank of India (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Arbitration Act, 1940; The Coal Mines Safety (Stowing) Amendment Act, 1940; The Income-tax Law (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Reserve Bank of India (Second Amendment) Act, 1940; The Parsi Marriage and Divorce (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Indian Finance Act, 1940; The Factories (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Defence of India (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Insurance (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Indian Tariff (Second Amendment) Act, 1940; The Indian Mines (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Petroleum (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Indian Works of Defence (Amendment) Act, 1940; The Indian Navy (Discipline) Amendment Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act repeals several enactments specified in the First Schedule and amends certain other enactments listed in the Second Schedule. It also includes provisions to ensure that existing rights, liabilities, and legal procedures are not affected by the repeal or amendment of previous laws.

metadata.title: The Sikh Gurdwaras Act (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This document is an Act to amend the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925. It was passed by the Punjab Legislative Assembly and received assent on January 11, 1945, before being promulgated for general information on January 17, 1945.

metadata.title: The Injuries (Compensation Insurance) Amendment Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Injuries (Compensation Insurance) Act, 1943 to address issues arising from hostilities and prisoner status. It includes specific amendments regarding the computation of time spent by a person in enemy territory or as a prisoner of war.

metadata.title: The War Risks (Factories) Insurance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the War Risks (Factories) Insurance Ordinance, 1942. It specifically revises clauses related to insurance coverage for explosives, munitions, and fire risks in factories.

metadata.title: War Risks (Goods) Insurance (Termination) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.repeals: War Risks (Goods) Insurance Ordinance, 1940
metadata.summary: This ordinance provides for the early termination of the War Risks (Goods) Insurance Scheme. It amends the War Risks (Goods) Insurance Ordinance, 1945, by inserting specific words and repeals provisions from an earlier 1940 ordinance.

metadata.title: The War Risks (Factories) (Termination) Ordinance, 1945
metadata.repeals: War Risks (Factories) Scheme of 1942; War Risks (Inland Vessels) Ordinance, 1943; Insurance Ordinance, 1942
metadata.summary: This ordinance terminates the War Risks (Factories) Scheme of 1942 and repeals specific provisions of the Insurance Ordinance, 1942, and the War Risks (Inland Vessels) Ordinance, 1943. It comes into force at midnight between August 31st and September 18th, 1945.

metadata.title: The Epidemic Diseases (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act amends the application of the Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897 to the Punjab Province. It establishes restrictions on delegated powers and empowers the Deputy Commissioner under specific conditions.

metadata.title: The Women's Auxiliary Corps (Amendment) Ordinance, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Women's Auxiliary Corps Ordinance of 1942 by modifying specific sections regarding officers and military connections. It was promulgated by the Governor-General of India on December 28, 1944, to address matters arising during an emergency.

metadata.title: The Indian Aircraft (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Indian Aircraft Act, 1934. It specifically adds new clauses regarding air transport services and modifies section 5 of the parent Act.

name: Frontier Crimes (Validation of Acts, Orders and Proceedings) Act, 1944

metadata.title: The Frontier Crimes (Validation of Acts, Orders and Proceedings) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain acts, orders, and proceedings done by the Provincial Government or subordinate authorities in relation to Frontier Crimes under the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901. It deems these actions valid as if they were made under a specific notification issued under section 3 of that Regulation.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1944

metadata.title: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1944
metadata.amends: The Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 to address circumstances requiring immediate action regarding market committee members. It specifies provisions for the continuance of office until a successor is appointed and adds text to sections concerning member appointments and delays.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.amends: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903 by inserting specific statements and substitutions into various sections regarding suits and decrees. It introduces requirements for applications to contain details about the plaintiff or decree-holder and modifies provisions related to the continuation or revival of proceedings.

metadata.title: The Punjab General Sales Tax (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.amends: The Punjab General Sales Tax Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab General Sales Tax Act, 1941. It introduces new definitions for certificates, modifies clauses regarding tax payment and turn-over, and grants powers to the Provincial Government and Deputy Commissioner.

name: PUNJAB LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY (ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1944

metadata.title: The Punjab Legislative Assembly (Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.amends: The Punjab Legislative Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Legislative Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1942 by adding a new subsection to Section 3. The amendment specifies allowance rates for members up to March 31, 1944, and thereafter at a rate of three hundred rupees per mensem.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pre-emption Act (Amendment) Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pre-emption Act of 1913 by inserting a new section designated as 21-A. The amendment applies to all suits instituted after the commencement of this Act regarding pre-emption rights in cases involving improvement, inheritance, or succession.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pre-emption (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pre-emption Act, 1913 by inserting a new section designated as 21-A. The amendment applies to all suits and appeals instituted after the commencement of this Act regarding improvements, inheritance, or cession where a vendee-defendant is involved.

metadata.title: The Epidemic Diseases (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Epidemic Diseases Act of 1897 specifically for its application to the Punjab province. It grants the Provincial Government powers to impose restrictions, limitations, and conditions on delegated powers and allows Deputy Commissioners to exercise specific authorities regarding disease control.

name: AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE (GRADING AND MARKING) AMENDMENT ACT, 1943

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Amendment Act, 1948
metadata.amends: The Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This document is an amendment to the Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937. It enacts changes regarding the grading and marking of agricultural produce.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE AMENDMENT ACT, 1943

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Amendment Act, 1943)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to clarify procedures regarding witnesses residing in Tribal Areas or Indian Political States. It grants Magistrates the power to delegate duties and forward commissions for witness examination to appropriate officials or courts.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE SECOND AMENDMENT ACT, 1943

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Second Amendment) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to address situations where a husband serving in His Majesty's armed forces is precluded from obtaining leave of absence. It introduces provisions allowing an authorized person to make a complaint on behalf of such a husband with the leave of the Court.

metadata.title: The Punjab Trade Employees (Amendment) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Trade Employees Act, 1940 by updating its preamble and redefining key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'commercial establishment'. It also inserts new sections to specify which types of shops and establishments are excluded from the Act's provisions.

metadata.title: The Indian Companies (Amendment) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Companies Act, 1913 to alter provisions regarding bad and doubtful debts. It specifically updates Table A in the First Schedule and modifies the Third Schedule forms related to banking companies.

metadata.title: The Indian Tea Control (Second Amendment) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Indian Tea Control Act, 1938. It introduces specific changes to sections 11, 17, 29, and 33 of the said Act regarding tea export regulations, land planting dates, and committee sanctions.

metadata.title: The Victoria Memorial (Amendment) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Victoria Memorial Act of 1903. It was assented to by the Governor-General on November 27, 1943, and published in the Gazette of India on December 4, 1943.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (Drivers) Ordinance Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Motor Vehicles (Drivers) Ordinance, 1942 to address issues regarding the reinstatement of drivers who were employed in service. It inserts a new section 6A detailing an employer's duty to reinstate a person and provisions for compensation if reinstatement is refused or impracticable.

name: Code of Civil Procedure (Second Amendment) Act, 1942

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Second Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 by adding a new rule regarding court fees when a suit abates due to the death of a plaintiff. It also substitutes existing rules to include references to the new provision and establishes a mechanism for recovering unpaid court fees from the deceased plaintiff's estate.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1942

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Second Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to address court fee recovery when a suit abates due to the death of a pauper plaintiff. It inserts new rules regarding the recovery of unpaid court fees from the deceased plaintiff's estate and modifies existing rules in the First Schedule.

name: Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories (Amendment) Act 1942

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.amends: The Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925 to introduce new provisions for weekly returns on cotton ginning quantities. It mandates that factory owners submit these returns to the proper authority and requires provincial governments to publish aggregate statements while protecting individual factory data.

metadata.title: The Indian Boilers (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Boilers Act, 1923 to include specific clauses regarding sterilizers and disinfectors commonly used in hospitals. It adds new text to section 3 of the parent Act to regulate boilers with a capacity not exceeding twenty gallons that are appertaining to such hospital equipment.

metadata.title: The Indian Companies (Second Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Companies Act, 1913 to clarify the definition of banking companies. Specifically, it adds a proviso stating that any company using the word 'bank' in its name shall be deemed a banking company regardless of whether accepting deposits is its principal business.

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Limitation Act, 1908 to alter how the limitation period is computed when payments are made on account of a debt or legacy. Specifically, it substitutes Section 20 to state that a fresh period of limitation begins from the date such payment is made.

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Limitation Act, 1908 to adjust the computation of limitation periods. Specifically, it substitutes a provision stating that if payment is made on account of a debt or interest on a legacy before the prescribed period expires, a fresh period of limitation shall be computed from the date of such payment.

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Indian Limitation Act, 1908. It substitutes a specific provision in section 20 regarding the computation of limitation periods when payment is made on account of a debt or legacy before the expiry of the prescribed period.

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Limitation Act, 1908 by substituting a specific provision in Section 20 regarding legacy payments. It clarifies that when a legacy payment is made before the expiration of the prescribed period by the liable person or their authorized agent, a fresh period of limitation shall be computed from the time of such payment.

metadata.title: The Industrial Statistics Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the collection of statistics relating to various matters concerning industries and labour welfare in British India. It empowers Provincial Governments to direct the collection of specific data, appoints statistics authorities, and grants them access to relevant records and premises.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939 by omitting specific subsections and clauses across various sections. It also inserts new provisions regarding exclusive control of property, fee exemptions for prescribed persons, and powers delegated to transport authorities.

metadata.title: The Music in Muslim Shrines Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act restricts singing and dancing in Muslim shrines within the Punjab province. It defines a shrine to include recognized premises, saint tombs, and attached properties, and prescribes penalties including fines and imprisonment for violations.

metadata.title: The Music in Muslim Shrines Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act restricts singing and dancing in Muslim shrines within the Punjab province. It defines a shrine as a recognized Muslim shrine of a saint and includes attached premises, establishing penalties including fines or imprisonment for violations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903 (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.amends: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903 to alter specific subsections regarding execution suits and proceedings against wards. It also addresses allowances for members of the Legislative Assembly.

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity (Emergency Powers) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of the public during emergencies by allowing the Provincial Government to assume possession and control of public electricity services. It outlines procedures for transferring property, awarding compensation for damages, and imposing penalties for non-compliance with orders issued under the Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Electricity (Emergency Powers) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of the public in cases of emergency regarding electricity service. It empowers the Provincial Government to assume possession and control of public electricity undertakings if there is a likelihood of supply failure or disadvantage to the public.

name: PUNJAB GENERAL SALES TAX (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1942

metadata.title: The Punjab General Sales Tax Act, 1941 (Second Amendment)
metadata.amends: The Punjab General Sales Tax Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a second amendment to the Punjab General Sales Tax Act, 1941. It amends various sections of the original act to adjust tax rates based on turnover thresholds, modify definitions regarding dealers and goods, and update provisions related to tax assessment and enforcement.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Preservation (Chos) (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Land Preservation (Chos) Act, 1900. It includes provisions for omitting specific sections and substituting new text regarding the extension of the Act to areas within the Siwalik mountain range.

name: PUNJAB LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY (ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) ACT, 1942

metadata.title: The Punjab Legislative Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1942
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Legislative Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of allowances to the Speaker and certain members of the Punjab Legislative Assembly. It establishes rates for compensatory, halting, and travelling allowances based on attendance records and specific conditions.
