name: PUNJAB LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY (WAR SERVICE) AMENDMENT) ACT, 1942

metadata.title: The Punjab Legislative Assembly (War Service) Amendment Act, 1942
metadata.amends: The Punjab Legislative Assembly (War Service) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Legislative Assembly (War Service) Act, 1940. It substitutes specific words in Section 2 of the said Act regarding allowances and meetings.

name: PUNJAB LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY (WAR SERVICE, AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1942

metadata.title: The Punjab Legislative Assembly (War Service, Amendment) Ordinance, 1942
metadata.amends: The Punjab Legislative Assembly (War Service) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Legislative Assembly (War Service) Act, 1940 to update references and definitions related to war service. It substitutes specific wording in the long title and section 2 of the original Act to reflect changes in government employment during the prosecution of the war.

metadata.title: The Punjab Relief of Indebtedness (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.amends: The Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act, 1934. It introduces specific changes to sections and clauses regarding debt proceedings, loan liabilities, and the finality of decisions by the Board.

metadata.title: The Punjab Relief of Indebtedness (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.amends: The Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act, 1934 to further regulate procedures regarding debt and debtor status. It introduces specific clauses concerning the finality of Debt Conciliation Board decisions and modifies sections related to board compositions and application processes.

metadata.title: The Workmen's Compensation (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.repeals: The Workmen's Compensation (Second Amendment) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923 to address provisions regarding war allowances and detention schemes. It specifically substitutes clauses in Section 15 concerning compensation for injuries related to war and detention, while also setting conditions for maintaining legal proceedings after applications to other government schemes.

metadata.title: The Berar Laws Extension Act, 1941
metadata.amends: The Indian (Foreign Jurisdiction) Order in Council, 1902
metadata.summary: This Act extends certain Acts in force in British India to the region of Berar. It also amends specific acts listed in the Third Schedule and repeals previous applications made under the Indian (Foreign Jurisdiction) Order in Council, 1902.

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to facilitate the service and execution of summonses and warrants issued in British India at locations outside British India. It establishes procedures for sending these documents to courts established by the Central Government or Crown Representative in other parts of India.

name: Code of Criminal Procedure (Second Amendment) Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Second Amendment) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to facilitate the service of summons and execution of warrants outside British India. It also addresses procedures for handling persons arrested under warrants received from authorities outside British India.

metadata.title: The Essential Services Ordinance, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the maintenance of certain essential services during an emergency. It empowers the Governor-General to declare specific employments as essential and authorizes the Central or Provincial Government to make rules regulating service conditions and imposing penalties for disobedience.

metadata.title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Factories Act, 1934 to extend its provisions to certain places where a manufacturing process is carried on with ten or more workers. It empowers Provincial Governments to declare specific places as factories via notification in the official Gazette.

metadata.title: The Federal Court Act, 1941
metadata.repeals: Section IIIA and Rule 17 of Order XLV of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Federal Court to make rules regulating the presentation and prosecution of appeals lying to that Court. It also repeals specific provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, that previously regulated this matter.

metadata.title: The Insurance (Amendment) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Insurance Act, 1938 to update provisions regarding insurers and provident societies. It introduces new sections for the annual renewal of registration certificates and modifies clauses related to policy descriptions and fee payments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the increase of rents on premises situated within urban areas in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'premises', 'landlord', and 'tenant' for the purposes of the legislation.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Cess Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Imperial Agricultural Produce Cess to improve the financial position of the Imperial Council. It imposes a duty on specific agricultural articles exported from British India and provides for the refund of such cess under certain conditions.

metadata.title: The Arbitration Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to arbitration and amends existing legal provisions in British India. It establishes definitions for key terms like 'arbitration agreement' and 'award', outlines procedures for appointing arbitrators, and details rules regarding court intervention in insolvency cases.

metadata.title: The Factories (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Factories Act, 1934 to apply specifically to the Punjab province. It introduces new sections regarding restrictions on establishing factories without permission and mandates a registration system for factories carrying out specific manufacturing processes.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Motor Vehicles Act, 1939. It specifically revises clauses regarding the limits on stage carriages and permits granted in specified regions or routes.

metadata.title: Payment of Wages (Amendment) Ordinance, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Payment of Wages Act, 1936 to enable employers to deduct sums from wages for approved War Savings schemes. It specifically allows deductions made with written authorization for the purchase of securities of the Government of India or the United Kingdom.

metadata.title: The Punjab Alienation of Land (Amendment) Act, 1940
metadata.amends: The Punjab Alienation of Land Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Alienation of Land Act, 1900 to restrict civil court jurisdiction in matters concerning Deputy Commissioners. It also inserts new sections regarding leases, farms, and mortgages made by Deputy Commissioners.

name: PUNJAB STATE AID TO INDUSTRIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1940

metadata.title: The Punjab State Aid to Industries (Amendment) Act, 1940
metadata.amends: The Punjab State Aid to Industries Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab State Aid to Industries Act, 1935, to further regulate state aid for cottage and village industries. It introduces specific provisions regarding subsidies for machinery purchases and research, as well as adjustments to clauses concerning joint Hindu families and personal law.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1940
metadata.repeals: Various enactments listed in the First Schedule (e.g., The Batwaras Act, 1836; The Bombay Salt Works Act, 1837; The Bengal Ameens Act, 1838; etc.)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain unnecessary or expired enactments and amends others as specified in its schedules. It was promulgated by the Governor General of India on November 30, 1940.

metadata.title: The Badshahi Mosque Fund Cess Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act creates and endows a fund specifically for the repair and maintenance of the Badshahi Mosque in Lahore. It establishes a cess payable by land owners or tenants to finance these expenses, with specific rates defined based on the annual value of the land.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to modify rules regarding the disbursement of salary and allowances under court orders. It substitutes specific wording in Rule 48 of Order XXI to clarify instructions for officers disbursing payments within or beyond local limits.

name: COTTON GINNING AND PRESSING FACTORIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1939

metadata.title: The Workmen's Compensation and Commendments Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923, by redefining monthly wages and restoring certain court proceedings. It also addresses structural alterations in cotton ginning factories and modifies provisions regarding baled cotton contracts.

metadata.title: The Employment of Children Act, 1938 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Employment of Children Act, 1938 to regulate child employment in specific workshops and industrial processes. It introduces new sections regarding notices for adding processes to schedules, age verification procedures, and restrictions on employing children under twelve years old.

metadata.title: The Indian Oaths (Amendment) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Oaths Act, 1873 to address the examination of child witnesses under twelve years of age. It stipulates that if a court believes a child does not understand the nature of an oath or affirmation, the standard provisions regarding oaths shall not apply to them.

metadata.title: The Panth Piploda Courts (Amendment) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Panth Piploda Courts Regulation, 1931 by adding a new sub-section to section 8. The amendment empowers the Central Government to appoint additional judges for courts requiring further assistance in disposing of pending business.

metadata.title: The Punjab Debtors' Protection (Amendment) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act serves as an amendment to the Punjab Debtors' Protection Act of 1936. It was enacted by the Governor of the Punjab with the assent of the Legislative Assembly on November 15, 1939, and published for general information on November 20, 1939.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends specific enactments listed in the First Schedule and repeals other enactments listed in the Second Schedule. It includes provisions to ensure that repeals do not affect existing rights, liabilities, or procedures established under the repealed laws.

metadata.title: The Workmen's Compensation (Amendment) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923 to clarify the definition of monthly wages and remove doubts regarding workmen employed on a non-monthly basis. It also empowers courts to restore proceedings if a person was incorrectly found not to be a workman solely due to their wage structure.

metadata.title: The Child Marriage Restraint (Second Amendment) Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929 to strengthen provisions against child marriages. It introduces new powers for courts to issue injunctions against arranged marriages and modifies sections regarding magistrate titles and complaint procedures.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act amends the criminal law to provide for the punishment of acts intended to adversely affect the recruitment of persons to serve in His Majesty's Forces. It also addresses offenses related to the discipline of these forces, including mutiny and insubordination.

metadata.title: The Cutchi Memons Act
metadata.repeals: The Cutchi Memons Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act provides that all Cutchi Memons shall be governed by the Muhammadan Law in matters of succession and inheritance. It came into force on November 1, 1938, and repealed the previous Cutchi Memons Act of 1920.

metadata.title: The Dangerous Drugs (Amendment) Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Dangerous Drugs Act of 1930. It adds specific wording to Section 2 regarding the bringing of dangerous drugs into any port or place in British India.

metadata.title: The Employment of Children Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the admission of children to certain industrial employments, specifically prohibiting their work in railway transport and port occupations before age fifteen. It establishes penalties for contravention and outlines procedures for prosecution and certification.

metadata.title: The Indian Aircraft (Amendment) Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Aircraft Act, 1934 to provide additional powers to the Central Government during outbreaks of dangerous epidemic diseases. It allows for the insertion of a new section (8B) enabling temporary rules regarding aircraft and travel when ordinary laws are insufficient to prevent public health dangers.

metadata.title: The Indian Coffee Cess (Amendment) Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Coffee Cess Act, 1935. It specifically alters section 4 of the parent act by omitting certain words and substituting new sub-clauses regarding nominations by various planters' associations.

metadata.title: The Indian Companies Act, 1913 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Companies Act, 1913 to update various sections regarding company regulations and reporting requirements. It introduces specific changes to provisions concerning branch office accounts, balance sheet copies, liquidator duties, and the definition of a principal place of business in British India.

metadata.title: Indian Finance Act, 1938
metadata.amends: Indian Post Office Act, 1898; Indian Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act fixes the duty on salt manufactured in or imported into British India and amends the Indian Post Office Act, 1898 to insert new inland postage rates. It also adjusts income-tax and super-tax rates for the year beginning April 1, 1938, based on the previous year's rates.

metadata.title: THE CITY OF LAHORE CORPORATION ACT, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the City of Lahore Corporation and outlines its constitution, government structure, and powers. It details the duties of municipal authorities, management of property, financial provisions including loans and sinking funds, and regulations regarding officers and servants.

name: PREVENTION OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1938

metadata.title: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Amendment) Act, 1938
metadata.amends: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890 by updating definitions and penalties related to animal cruelty. It introduces specific offenses regarding the treatment of milch animals, overloading, and the performance of certain operations on cows.

metadata.title: The Repealing Act, 1938
metadata.repeals: Various Central Acts including The Official Gazettes Act, 1863; The Chief Commissioner's Powers Act, 1867; The Court fees Act (1870); The Indian Penal Code Act, 1870; and many others listed in the Schedule.
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to repeal certain enactments that were otherwise unnecessary or had ceased to be in force. It specifically lists numerous Central Acts from the late 19th and early 20th centuries that are hereby repealed, either wholly or partially.

metadata.title: The Sugar Industry Protection (Temporary Extension) Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act extends the protection conferred on the sugar industry in British Central India for one year. It amends section 3 of the Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932, and substitutes a new item in the First Schedule to the Indian Tariff Act, 1934.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (THIRD AMENDMENT) ACT, 1937

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Third Amendment) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It adds a specific sub-rule to Order XXXII regarding guardians for suits involving minors.

metadata.title: The Insurance Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the business of insurance in British India. It establishes definitions for key terms such as insurer, policy-holder, and approved securities, and mandates that no insurer can carry on insurance business without obtaining a certificate of registration from the Superintendent of Insurance.

name: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (ADAPTATION OF INDIAN LAWS) ORDER, 1937 (1)

metadata.title: The Government of India Order, 1937
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the adaptation of Indian laws to be in force in British India as of April 1, 1937. It directs necessary adaptations and modifications to bring these laws into conformity with the provisions of the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (ADAPTATION OF INDIAN LAWS) ORDER, 1937 (2)

metadata.title: The Government Tenancy (North-West Frontier Province) Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This act amends the Government Tenancy Act of 1893 specifically for the North-West Frontier Province. It removes references to territories administered by the Chief Commissioner and substitutes references to 'Crown' in place of 'Government'.

name: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (ADAPTATION OF INDIAN LAWS) ORDER, 1937 (3)

metadata.title: The Factories Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This document amends the Factories Act, 1934 by removing references to Burma and substituting 'Local Government' with 'Central Government' or 'Provincial Government' as appropriate. It also modifies specific clauses regarding employment in the service of the Crown and omits certain sections related to the Gazette of India.

name: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (ADAPTATION OF INDIAN LAWS) ORDER, 1937 (4)

metadata.title: The Bombay Borstal Schools Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This document outlines amendments to the Bombay Borstal Schools Act, 1929, specifically replacing references to 'Government' with 'Provincial Government' and updating terminology related to legislative chambers.

metadata.title: The Indian Boilers (Amendment) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Boilers Act, 1923 to establish a Central Boilers Board consisting of fourteen members. The legislation outlines the composition of the board, including representatives from various provinces and the railways, and grants the board powers to regulate business and exercise authority despite vacancies.

metadata.title: The Indian Red Cross Society (Amendment) Act, 1937
metadata.amends: The Indian Red Cross Society Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Red Cross Society Act of 1920 to update provisions regarding notifications and schedules. It specifically addresses contributions from various provinces and states to the Central Fund and War Contingent Fund.

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1934 to substitute a specific item in the First Schedule. The amendment updates the tariff entry for broken rice with new protective duties and weight specifications.

metadata.title: The Petroleum (Berar Extension) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Petroleum Act, 1934 to the region of Berar. It also declares that rules and notifications made under the Petroleum Act, 1934 are in force in Berar.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain existing enactments and repeals other specified enactments that are unnecessary or spent. It provides specific details on the amendments to be made in the First Schedule and the enactments to be repealed in the Second Schedule.

metadata.title: The Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the consolidation of holdings in estates or sub-divisions within Punjab to facilitate land distribution and reduce the number of plots. It establishes procedures for landowners to apply for consolidation, requiring a minimum threshold of agreement among them, and outlines the roles of revenue officers in preparing schemes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Copying Fees Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the recovery of fees payable for copies of records kept in Government, Revenue, and Judicial offices in Punjab. It applies to any record or part thereof, including plans and maps, supplied at the request of an applicant.

metadata.title: The Punjab Debtors' Protection Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of debtors in the Punjab. It modifies existing laws regarding money-lenders and companies carrying on business as such, while also addressing provisions related to Co-operative Societies.

name: PUNJAB STATE AID TO INDUSTRIES ACT, 1935

metadata.title: The Punjab State Aid to Industries Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the grant of state aid to encourage industrial development in the Punjab. It establishes a Board consisting of specific members, including a Minister and the Director of Industries, to oversee these activities.

name: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (ADAPTATION OF INDIAN LAWS) ORDER, 1937 (5)

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayat Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This document amends the Punjab Village Panchayat Act of 1921 by substituting references to 'Local Government' with 'His Majesty', 'Governor General in Council' with 'Provincial Government', and updating terms for government servants. It also modifies specific sections regarding excisable articles, debt due to government, and general orders.

metadata.title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Indian General Legislature enacted to amend the Factories Act, 1934. It received assent on September 30, 1935, and was promulgated for general information.

metadata.title: The Government of India Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Railway Authority to exercise executive powers regarding the regulation, construction, maintenance, and operation of railways. It defines the composition of the Authority, its financial responsibilities, and the scope of its functions under the guidance of the Federal Government.

metadata.title: Government of India Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Government of India Act, 1935, establishing the Federation of India and defining its structure. It details the powers of the Federal Executive and Legislature, as well as the provisions for Provincial Governments and Legislatures.

metadata.title: Government of India Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This document outlines the legislative procedures and powers of the Legislature regarding territories in Burma. It details rules for joint sittings, language requirements, restrictions on discussions, and the validity of proceedings despite procedural irregularities.

metadata.title: The Indian Coffee Cess Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a customs duty and land tax known as the coffee cess on coffee produced in India. It establishes a committee to manage the promotion of Indian coffee cultivation, manufacture, and sale.

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1985
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Income-tax Act, 1923, and the First Schedule to the Indian Finance Act, 1984. It includes provisions regarding the imposition of duties on salt manufactured in British India or imported from Burma, Aden, or other places, as well as adjustments to income tax rates for specific years.

metadata.title: The Indian Mines (Amendment) Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Mines Act of 1923 to address specific purposes regarding mining regulations. It introduces new definitions, modifies clauses related to child labor and working hours, and establishes provisions for trade union representation in mines.

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1934 by repealing and inserting new items regarding protective duties on wheat, broken rice, and flour. It was promulgated for general information with specific effective dates mentioned in the text.

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency (Amendment) Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920. It was enacted by the Indian Legislature with assent given in September 1935.

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts (Amendment) Act, 1935
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887. It was received by the Governor-General on September 28, 1935, and promulgated for general information.

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal (Amendment) Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911 to update provisions regarding fines, prosecutions, and building regulations. It also addresses qualifications for election seats and treatment of persons suffering from infectious diseases within municipal limits.

metadata.title: Government of India Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This document contains the Sixth Schedule of the Government of India Act, 1935, specifically Part I regarding general provisions as to franchise. It establishes rules for creating electoral rolls, defines eligibility criteria based on age, nationality, and religion, and outlines restrictions on voting rights for disqualified persons or those serving sentences.

metadata.title: The Punjab Stamp (Amendment) Act, 1935
metadata.amends: The Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (referred to as 'Indian Stamp Act' in text) and The Punjab Stamp Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Stamp Act and the Punjab Stamp Act of 1922. It specifically omits certain words from Schedule I-A of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1935
metadata.repeals: Various enactments listed in the First and Second Schedules including The Repealing and Amending Act, 1920; The North-West Frontier Province Security Regulation, 1925; The British Baluchistan Security Regulation, 1928; The Manpur Laws Regulation, 1926; The Lighters Duty Act, 1934; The Iron and Steel Duties Act, 1934; and others.
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain specified enactments listed in the First Schedule and repeals specific laws listed in the Second Schedule. It includes provisions to ensure that repeals do not affect existing rights, liabilities, or remedies acquired under the repealed acts.

metadata.title: The Amending Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments specified in the Schedule to align them with the Indian Navy (Discipline) Act, 1931. It comes into force on a date appointed by the Governor General in Council via notification in the Gazette of India.

metadata.title: The Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Mines Act, 1923 to extend certain provisions related to salt import duties. It specifically addresses working hours in mines, trade union representation for miners, and regulations regarding relays of work.

metadata.title: The Factories Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act regulates labour in factories within the Punjab jurisdiction, establishing definitions, safety measures, and restrictions on child employment. It also outlines penalties for non-compliance and provisions for factory inspections.

metadata.title: The Factories Act, 1934
metadata.repeals: The Factories Act, 1934 (previous consolidation)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regulating labour in factories across British India. It establishes provisions for adult and child working hours, safety measures, health standards, and penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Indian Dock Labourers (Protection against Accidents) Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in British India to the Geneva Convention concerning the protection against accidents of workers employed in loading or unloading ships. It establishes a framework for appointing inspectors, defining their powers, and making regulations to ensure worker safety during maritime operations.

metadata.title: The Indian Trusts (Amendment) Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Trusts Act, 1882 to address specific provisions regarding securities and guarantees. It adds a proviso to clause (a) of section 20 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Negotiable Instruments (Amendment) Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 to address issues regarding cheques payable to bearer and endorsements. It specifically adds a provision stating that a cheque originally expressed to be payable to bearer is discharged by payment in due course regardless of any endorsement.

metadata.title: The Indian Aircraft Act, 1914
metadata.repeals: Indian Marine Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments and repeals other amendments related to aircraft regulations. It specifically addresses provisions regarding patents, customs notifications, and legal proceedings concerning nuisance from aircraft flights.

metadata.title: The Indian Wireless Telegraphy Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the possession of wireless telegraphy apparatus and empowers the telegraph authority to issue licenses. It defines key terms such as 'wireless communication' and 'wireless telegraphy apparatus', establishes penalties for offenses, and provides powers for search warrants and confiscation.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition Act, 1933 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to facilitate the acquisition of land for industrial concerns. It specifically addresses provisions regarding the erection of dwelling houses and amenities for workmen employed by such concerns.

metadata.title: The Indian Companies (Amendment) Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Indian Legislature that received assent from the Governor-General on March 10, 1932. It serves to amend the existing Indian Companies (Amendment) Act, 1930.

name: INDIAN FINANCE (SUPPLEMENTARY AND EXTENDING) AMENDMENT ACT, 1932

metadata.title: Indian Finance and Extending (Supplementary Amendment) Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a supplementary amendment to the Indian Finance (Supplementary and Extending) Act, 1931. It provides for adaptations of the Income-tax Act, 1922, and establishes procedures for summary assessments and the cancellation or revision of assessments.

metadata.title: The Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act, 1934
metadata.amends: The Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Relief of Indebtedness Act, 1934 to provide for amendments in the law governing relations between debtors and creditors. It includes provisions regarding excessive interest rates, the definition of loans, and the establishment of local boards for the amicable settlement of debts.

metadata.title: The Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1932
metadata.repeals: Section 3 of The Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1931
metadata.summary: This Act extends the operation of The Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1931. It substitutes sub-section (3) of section 2 and repeals section 3 of the 1931 Act.

name: WIRE AND WIRE NAIL INDUSTRY (PROTECTION) ACT, 1932

metadata.title: The Wire and Buttles (Protection) Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act, 1894 to provide discriminating protection for the fostering and development of wire and bamboo industries in British India. It specifies amendments to Schedule II regarding duty rates on items such as wire-netting, barbed wire, and bamboo paper.

metadata.title: The Cantonments (House-Accommodation) Amendment Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Cantonments (House-Accommodation) Act, 1923 to address issues regarding military housing and accommodation within cantonments. It introduces provisions for officers to secure suitable private messes or government accommodation when available options are insufficient.

metadata.title: The Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a supplement to the Law relating to Criminal Procedure in the Punjab. It was promulgated by the Local Legislature of the Punjab following assent from the Governor and the Viceroy.

metadata.title: Indian Railways (Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Railways Act, 1890 to regulate the employment of railway servants. It introduces provisions regarding essentially intermittent work, limits on working hours, mandatory rest periods, and rules for overtime compensation.

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff Act (Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1894 to update and clarify the Second Schedule regarding tariff classifications. It introduces new items, substitutes existing descriptions for various goods like dairy appliances and sugar mills, and renumbers specific schedule entries.

metadata.title: Inland Steam-vessels (Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Inland Steam-vessels Act, 1917 to regulate maximum and minimum rates for passenger fares and freight on inland waterways. It empowers the Governor-General in Council to fix these rates and declare distances between stations for calculation purposes.

metadata.title: The Insolvency Law (Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Insolvency Act of 1909 to alter specific sections regarding official assignees and court procedures. It introduces new clauses concerning the discharge of duties by deputy official assignees and modifications to adjudication processes.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1908 (Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transfer of Property Act, 1908 by inserting specific words into section 4 regarding registered instruments and memorandums. It addresses scenarios where property is not situated in a single sub-district or involves shares acquired under certain conditions.

name: INDIA PATENT AND DESIGNS AMENDMENT ACT 1930

metadata.title: The Indian Patents and Designs (Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.amends: The Indian Patents and Designs Act, 1911
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Patents and Designs Act, 1911 to address certain purposes related to patents and designs. It came into force on July 1, 1930, and includes various amendments to sections regarding definitions, joint applications, specifications, and patent revocations.

metadata.title: The Punjab Regulation of Accounts Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the keeping of accounts for transactions involving loans, inheritances, or assignments. It defines specific terms such as 'loan', 'interest', and 'creditor' to ensure proper record-keeping and recovery procedures.

metadata.title: The Punjab Pure Food Act, 1929
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Food Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act provides better provisions for the control and preparation of food in Punjab. It defines terms such as 'pure food' and 'adulterated food' and establishes the roles of inspectors and public analysts.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act serves to repeal certain enactments and amend others specified in its schedules. It clarifies that the repeal does not affect past acts, obligations, or rights acquired under the repealed laws.

metadata.title: Transfer of Property (Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transfer of Property (Amendment) Act, 1929. It specifically modifies Section 4 regarding registered instruments under the Indian Registration Act, 1908.

metadata.title: Transfer of Property (Amendment) Supplementary Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 by inserting a new section 7A. The amendment specifically modifies clause (o) of rule 1 in Order XLIII of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.

metadata.title: The Burma Salt (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Burma Salt Act, 1917 for specific purposes. It received assent from the Governor General on October 1, 1929, and was promulgated for general information.

metadata.title: The Sikh Gurdwaras (Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sikh Gurdwaras Act of 1925 to further regulate the management and administration of Sikh religious institutions in Punjab. It introduces specific definitions for a 'Sikh', establishes procedures for declaring rights over immovable property, and outlines rules regarding the constitution and membership of Gurdwara Management Committees.

metadata.title: The Restraint of Child Marriage Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to restrain the solemnization of child marriages in British India. It defines a child as a male under eighteen or a female under fourteen and prescribes penalties for contracting or performing such marriages.

metadata.title: The Guardians and Wards (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 to provide for the appointment of auditors when accounts are exhibited by a guardian. It also grants courts the power to direct that remuneration for audit work be paid from the income of the property.

metadata.title: The Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to restrain the solemnization of child marriages across British India. It defines terms such as 'child' and 'child marriage', prescribes penalties for contracting or performing such marriages, and outlines procedures for legal inquiries and court cognizance.

metadata.title: The Indian Boilers (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Boilers Act, 1923 to remove specific wording regarding vessels and to insert a new subsection allowing local governments to exempt certain boilers from the Act's operation. The exemptions apply specifically to boilers used for heating buildings or supplying hot water.

metadata.title: The Indian Cotton Cess (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Indian Cotton Cess Act, 1923 for certain purposes. It substitutes specific titles for agricultural advisers within the Imperial Council of Agricultural Research and modifies section 5 of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Indian Census Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act provides for certain matters in connection with the taking of the census of British India during the year 1931. It defines the appointment of census officers, their status as public servants, and the duties of various individuals and institutions to assist them.

metadata.title: Indian Income-tax (Provident Funds) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922 to provide specific provisions relating to certain classes of provident funds. It defines terms such as 'recognised provident fund' and outlines conditions for recognition by the Commissioner of Income-tax.

metadata.title: The Indian Registration (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.repeals: Act XVI of 1908
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Registration Act, 1908. It specifically repeals Section 56 of the original 1908 Act.

metadata.title: The Indian Succession (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.repeals: The (Amendment) Indian Succession Act, 1920; The (Second Indian Amendment) Succession Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Succession Act, 1925 to include specific clauses regarding District Judges and Civil Courts. It also modifies sections related to wills made by Buddhists, Sikhs, and Hindus after January 1, 1927, and repeals two previous amendment acts from 1920 and 1928.

metadata.title: Public Safety Ordinance, 1929
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to check the dissemination of certain forms and propaganda from other countries in British India during an emergency. It grants powers to remove specific persons and seize monies, securities, or goods associated with unlawful activities threatening public safety.

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Limitation Act, 1908, to alter the order of succession for certain heirs of a Hindu male dying intestate. It also inserts new articles regarding property management and omits specific sections related to religious endowments.

metadata.title: The Specific Relief Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This document amends the Specific Relief Act of 1877 by inserting a new section (27A) regarding specific performance and foreclosure suits. It outlines procedures for accounts, property delivery, and costs when contracts are not fully performed or when mortgagees are joined in suits.

metadata.title: The Indian Mines Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Mines Act of 1923 to regulate working hours, shift systems, and notice requirements for mine operations. It introduces new sections limiting work to twelve hours and mandates specific notices regarding the commencement and end of shifts.

metadata.title: The Indian Succession (Amendment) Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Succession Act, 1925. It was enacted to further amend provisions regarding succession and debt certificates.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1928
metadata.amends: Various enactments specified in the First Schedule (including The Marriage Act, 1872; The General Clauses Act, 1897; The Indian Stamp Act, 1899)
metadata.repeals: Certain enactments specified in the Second Schedule
metadata.summary: This Act amends specific Indian enactments listed in the First Schedule and revives certain repealed laws. It also explicitly repeals other enactments mentioned in the Second Schedule to clarify their legal status.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure Act, 1926 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It specifically addresses a provision regarding the determination of whether a lower appellate court has wrongly determined that a case should not be referred by reason of any illegality, omission, error, or defect.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1926

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: Section 10 and Form C in Schedule II of the Bombay Pleaders Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the appointment of legal practitioners in civil suits. It further amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, specifically regarding rules concerning pleaders and attorneys.

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, to update specific sections regarding complaints and investigations. It includes provisions for substituting text in various sections and repealing a sub-section of section 170.

metadata.title: Transfer of Property (Amendment) Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 to address issues regarding notice, registration, and income accumulation. It introduces specific substitutions and additions to various sections of the original act to clarify legal definitions and procedures.

metadata.title: The Cotton Industry (Statistics) Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: The Cotton Duties Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regular submission of returns regarding the quantities of cotton goods and yarn manufactured in British India. It defines key terms such as 'cotton goods', 'yarn', and 'mill', and mandates that mill owners prepare and deliver monthly returns to authorized officers.

metadata.title: The Government Trading Taxation Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act determines the liability of certain Governments to taxation in British India regarding trading operations carried on by or on their behalf. It stipulates that such governments shall be liable to Indian Income-tax and other taxes in the same manner as a company would be.

metadata.title: The Guardians and Wards Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: Clause (6) of sub-section (2) of section 30 of the Provincial Courts Act, 1917; clause (6) of sub-section (2) of section 31 of the Punjab Courts Act, 1918; and clause (2) of section 4 of the Oudh Courts Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 to clarify definitions regarding District Courts and judicial officers. It also inserts a new section granting High Courts power to transfer proceedings and repeals specific clauses from various Provincial Courts Acts.

metadata.title: The Indian Registration Act, 1908 (Amendment) Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Registration Act, 1908 to address issues regarding the denial of execution. It grants Local Governments the power to declare via notification that it is expedient for certain Sub-Registrars to exercise specific powers and duties related to inquiries when execution is denied.

metadata.title: The Legal Practitioners (Fees) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act defines the rights of legal practitioners regarding their fees and protects them from being sued for negligence in the discharge of professional duties. It amends the Legal Practitioners Act, 1879, to address these specific issues within civil suits.

metadata.title: The Indian Income-tax Act, 1926 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Income-tax Act of 1922 to address issues regarding super-tax on dividends and shareholder income. It introduces new sections for deducting excess tax, updating definitions for 'assessee', and establishing procedures for appeals to the High Court.

metadata.title: The Prisons (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prisons Act, 1894 specifically for the Punjab region. It provides for the appointment of Deputy Jailors and Assistant Jailors to exercise powers previously held by other officers.

metadata.title: The Negotiable Instruments (Interest) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, and the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It specifically alters provisions regarding interest calculations on sums due on instruments and the execution of decrees.

name: PUNJAB LAND PRESERVATION (CHOS) SECOND AMENDMENT ACT, 1926

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Preservation (Chos) Second Amendment Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1900. It modifies specific clauses and sections within the original act regarding land preservation periods and prohibitions.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Preservation (Chos) Amendment Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Preservation (Chos) Act, 1900 to address expedient changes regarding land preservation. It specifically omits certain words from sections and substitutes others to restrict or prohibit specific exercises of rights.

name: SMALL CAUSE COURTS (ATTACHMENT OF IMMOVEABLE PROPERTY) ACT, 1926

metadata.title: The Small Cause Courts (Attachment of Immoveable Property) Act, 1926
metadata.amends: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908; The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, and the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887 to address doubts regarding attachment powers. It specifically authorizes Small Cause Courts to make orders for the attachment of immovable property.

metadata.title: The Cantonments Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Cantonments Act of 1924 to update terminology and definitions regarding military officers and cantonment authorities. It inserts new sections concerning property management powers for authorities and modifies references in the Indian Penal Code.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1925 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It specifically addresses cases where a decree-holder is a registered cooperative society and the judgment-debtor is a member of that society.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This document amends the Criminal Law Act of 1925 to address specific offences and sentencing powers. It extends provisions related to the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, within the context of Bengal.

name: COTTON GINNING AND PRESSING FACTORIES ACT, 1925

metadata.title: The Cotton Factories Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better regulation of cotton ginning and pressing factories. It mandates the maintenance of registers by factory owners to record details such as bale numbers, names of persons involved, and quantities processed.

metadata.title: The Indian Cotton Cess (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Cotton Cess Act of 1923 to address cases where cotton is exported by land and subsequently imported into India. It substitutes specific provisions in section 8 regarding the refund of cess levied on such cotton.

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation Act, 1925 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This document is an amendment to the Indian Limitation Act of 1908. It specifies changes to be made in the First Division of the First Schedule and Article 5 of that Act.

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Stamp Act of 1899. It was assented to by the Governor-General on March 25, 1925, and promulgated for general information.

metadata.title: The Lahore Terminal Tax Validating Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act validates a notification imposing a terminal tax in the Municipality of Lahore dated 6th December 1924. It declares that the tax was legally imposed with effect from the first day of March 1925, thereby removing doubts regarding its legality.

metadata.title: The Obscene Publications Act, 1925
metadata.amends: The Indian Penal Code, 1860; The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to certain articles of the International Convention for the Suppression of, and Traffic in, Obscene Publications. It amends sections 292 and 293 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and related provisions in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise (Amendment) Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: section 78 of the Punjab Excise Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This document amends the Punjab Excise Act of 1914 by substituting specific time periods and omitting certain words in sections 61, 80-A, and 74. It also repeals section 78 of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Prisons (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prisons Act, 1894 to update provisions regarding punishment combinations and cellular confinement. It specifically alters sections 46 and 47 of the original Act to substitute terms like 'cellular' for 'solitary' and adds new clauses concerning prescribed periods.

metadata.title: The Lahore Terminal Tax Validating Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act validates a notification imposing a terminal tax in the Municipality of Lahore dated December 6, 1924. It declares that the tax was legally imposed with effect from March 1, 1925, thereby removing doubts regarding its legality.

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise (Amendment) Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: section 78 of the Punjab Excise Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This document amends the Punjab Excise Act of 1914 by substituting specific time periods and omitting certain words in sections 61, 80-A, and 74. It also repeals section 78 of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor-Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Motor-Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924 to update provisions regarding vehicles plying for hire and seating capacity classifications. It substitutes specific words in the original Act and adds new clauses to the schedule concerning annual tax rates for different vehicle categories.

metadata.title: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a tax on motor vehicles used in the Punjab. It outlines provisions for licensing officers, declarations regarding vehicle use, and penalties for non-compliance or operating without a license.

metadata.title: The Punjab Small Towns (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Small Towns Act of 1921 to address procedural issues regarding local area elections and committee appointments. It introduces new provisions for handling invalid elections, mandates specific oaths for committee members, and updates clauses related to corruption investigations and building regulations.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments and repeals other enactments that are spent or have ceased to be in force. It was received the assent of the Governor General on September 23, 1925, and promulgated for general information.

metadata.title: The Sikh Gurdwaras Act (Supplementary), 1925
metadata.summary: This Act serves to supplement certain provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925. It amends specific sections of that Act by inserting new words and phrases related to tribunals and vacancies.

metadata.title: The Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for managing Sikh Gurdwaras in Punjab, including provisions for petitions regarding property claims and the constitution of a tribunal. It also creates a Board and a Judicial Commission to oversee the control and administration of these religious sites.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 130 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882. It was promulgated by the Governor-General of India for general information on October 3, 1925.

metadata.title: The Workmen's Short title and commencement
metadata.amends: The Workman's Breach of Contract Act, 1859
metadata.repeals: The Workman's Breach of Contract Act, 1859; The Indian Penal Code; The Indian Titles Act, 1897; The Workman's Breach of Contract (Amendment) Act, 1920; The Devolution Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act repeals specific enactments that made breaches of contract by labourers punishable under criminal law. It was received the assent of the Governor General on February 11, 1925, and is promulgated for general information.

metadata.title: The Indian Succession Act
metadata.summary: This Act regulates succession to the property of deceased persons in British India, covering both moveable and immoveable assets. It establishes rules for intestate succession, the execution of privileged and unprivileged wills, and the construction of testamentary documents.

metadata.title: The Indian Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Motor Vehicles Act, 1914 for certain purposes. It was assented to by the Governor General on September 18, 1921, and promulgated for general information.

metadata.title: The Act, 1924
metadata.amends: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898; The Aligarh Muslim University Act, 1920; The Imperial Bank of India Act, 1920; The Indian Income-tax Act, 1922; The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923
metadata.repeals: The Presidency Banks (Amendment) Act, 1920; The Amending and Repealing Act, 1920; The Lower Burma Courts Act, 1900; The Aligarh Muslim University Act, 1920; The Indian Merchant Shipping Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing enactments and repeals others that have become unnecessary or spent. It includes specific provisions to substitute words in various sections of the amended acts and ensures that the repeal does not affect rights, liabilities, or remedies already acquired.

metadata.title: The Sea Customs Act (Amendment) Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Indian Legislature that amends the Sea Customs Act, 1878. It was promulgated by the Governor General on March 29, 1924, and came into force on April 1, 1924.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 by inserting specific phrases regarding conjugal rights, specific performance of contracts, and injunctions into Order XXI. It also modifies rules concerning the execution of decrees against husbands and wives.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1923

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1923
metadata.repeals: Sections 98 and 104 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898; Act V of 1898
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, to provide for the payment of fines in instalments and the suspension of imprisonment sentences. It also repeals specific sections from the previous amendment act of 1898.

metadata.title: The Cotton Transport Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the restriction and control of cotton transport into certain protected areas in British India. It establishes definitions for terms like 'cotton', 'licence', and 'protected area', and outlines procedures for importing cotton, including requirements for licences and certified copies.

metadata.title: The Indian Factories (Amendment) Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Factories Act, 1911 to address safety concerns regarding machinery and electrical fittings. It includes specific provisions for fencing dangerous equipment and modifying rules related to holidays and weekly working hours.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (Amendment) Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act of 1894 to address procedures regarding objections and public purposes. It introduces specific amendments to sections concerning declarations, notifications, and the role of the Collector in handling inquiries and decisions on objections.

metadata.title: The Punjab Industrial Loans Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the improvement of laws relating to loans granted by the Government of the Punjab for industrial purposes. It outlines procedures for loan applications, security requirements, repayment terms, and the legal consequences of default, including declarations and court execution.

metadata.title: The Repealing (Panjab Loans Limitation) Act, 1923
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Loans Limitation Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Loans Limitation Act, 1904. It extends to the Punjab and comes into force on a date appointed by notification.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain existing enactments and repeals others that are specified in the First and Second Schedules. It includes saving provisions to ensure that rights, titles, liabilities, or privileges acquired before the repeal remain unaffected.

metadata.title: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of compensation to workmen injured by accidents while in the service of an employer. It defines key terms such as 'workman', 'employer', 'disablement', and 'wages' within the context of British India.

metadata.title: The Carriers (Amendment) Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Carriers Act of 1865 by modifying provisions regarding liability for loss or damage arising from negligence. It also inserts a new section to amend the Schedule of the said Act.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE AMENDMENT ACT, 1921

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure Act, 1921 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 by substituting specific words in section 55 regarding discharge and release. It changes 'will not be discharged' to 'may be discharged' and 'shall release' to 'may release'.

name: IMPORT AND EXPORT OF GOODS AMENDMENT ACT 1921

metadata.title: The Import and Export of Goods (Amendment) Act, 1921
metadata.amends: The Import and Export of Goods Act, 1916
metadata.repeals: The Import and Export of Goods (Amendment) Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Import and Export of Goods Act, 1916. It specifically updates section (8) of section 1 to change a date reference from March 31, 1921, to March 31, 1922.

metadata.title: The Indian Penal Code (Amendment) Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act amends sections 121, 122, and 121A of the Indian Penal Code. It also repeals sections 61 and 62 of the said Code.

metadata.title: The Indian Post Office (Amendment) Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Post Office Act, 1898 by inserting a new section 24-A. It empowers the Governor General in Council to order the delivery of mail beyond the existing limits of the Post Office.

metadata.title: The Legislative Assembly's Salary Act
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary of the Deputy-President of the Legislative Assembly. It establishes that the salary shall be calculated at a rate of one rupee per mensem and designates the President as the final authority for any disputes regarding this matter.

metadata.title: The Lac Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lac Association and provides for the levy of a cess on lac exported from British India. It outlines provisions for keeping accounts, conducting scientific research, and disposing of proceeds received from the cess.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to address issues regarding the service of summons on defendants. It provides for dismissing suits against defendants who fail to appear after a summons has been issued and returned unserved, or who are avoiding service.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (PUNJAB) AMENDMENT ACT, 1920

metadata.title: The Amendment Act, 1920
metadata.amends: The Colonisation of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Colonisation of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912 to clarify rules regarding succession to tenancy. It specifies how tenancy devolves upon the death or remarriage of a tenant and defines eligible successors in various cases.

metadata.title: The Devolution Act, 1920
metadata.amends: The enactments of certain specified Acts
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain specified enactments received by the Governor General in Council. It transfers specific powers from the Governor General to Local Governments and repeals corresponding provisions in those amended acts.

metadata.title: The Indian Army (Amendment) Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Army Act of 1911 by adding specific provisions to section 116 regarding missing personnel. It addresses the reporting requirements for soldiers who are officially reported as missing while on active service.

metadata.title: The Cantonments Act
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for Cantonment Authorities, defining their composition, powers, and duties. It covers various aspects including elections, taxation, property management, and the administration of burial grounds within cantonments.

metadata.title: The Census Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act provides for certain matters in connection with the taking of the census within British India. It defines the appointment and duties of census officers, outlines who must be included in the census, and establishes the legal obligation for individuals to answer questions asked by authorized officers.

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1894 to update tariff classifications for specific items related to firearms and machinery. It substitutes new descriptions in Schedule II of the parent Act, covering barrels, breech blocks, revolver cylinders, machine guns, and machines for making or capping cartridges.

name: Indian Limitation and Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act 1920

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation (Amendment) Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Limitation Act, 1908 to address procedural issues regarding notices in cases involving deceased parties. It substitutes specific time periods for serving notices and adds provisions allowing courts to dispense with notice if a party has died.

metadata.title: The Inland Steam-vessels Act, 1917 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Inland Steam-vessels Act of 1917 to update requirements for master's and engine-driver's certificates. It also modifies provisions regarding vessel horsepower limits, service duration, and local government powers to grant or vary licences.

metadata.title: The Amending Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments specified in the First Schedule and repeals others listed in the Second Schedule. It was promulgated by the Government of India's Legislative Department in Punjab.

metadata.title: The Amending Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments specified in the First Schedule and repeals others listed in the Second Schedule. It was promulgated by the Government of India's Legislative Department in Punjab.

metadata.title: The United Provinces Town Improvement Act, 1920
metadata.amends: The United Provinces Town Improvement Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act modifies certain provisions of the United Provinces Town Improvement Act, 1919. It establishes rules regarding appeals to the High Court against decisions made by Tribunals constituted under the earlier Act.

metadata.title: The Habitual Offenders Restriction Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides for restricting the movements of habitual offenders in Punjab and requires them to execute bonds for good behavior. It outlines the powers of Magistrates to make restriction orders, including conditions regarding custody, reporting requirements, and the duration of such orders.

metadata.title: The Destruction of Records Act, 1917
metadata.repeals: The Destruction of Records Act, 1879; The Indian Registration Act, 1908; The Official Trustees Act, 1913; The Administrator-General's Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the destruction or other disposal of certain documents in the possession or custody of Courts, Revenue Courts, and public officers. It defines the specific authorities responsible for these actions across different regions and repeals several earlier enactments related to record destruction.

metadata.title: The Indian Registration (Amendment) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Registration Act, 1908 to provide for the re-registration of documents that were not duly registered or became invalid. It allows persons claiming under such documents to present them for re-registration within three months of becoming aware of the invalidity.

metadata.title: The Indian Trusts (Amendment) Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Trusts Act, 1882 by adding specific words to section 20. The amendment addresses interest on debentures of the Bombay Central Co-operative Bank Limited guaranteed by the Secretary of State for India in Council.

name: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Amendment) Act 1917

metadata.title: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1917
metadata.amends: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890 by inserting new sections regarding police powers to search for and seize skins of goats killed in an unnecessarily cruel manner. It establishes legal presumptions that a person possessing such skin had reason to believe the goat was being killed cruelly and prescribes penalties including fines and imprisonment.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain existing enactments listed in the First Schedule and repeals other enactments listed in the Second Schedule. It also ensures that the repeal does not affect rights, liabilities, or proceedings acquired before the Act's commencement.

metadata.title: The Amending Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments specified in the Schedule to correct definitions and update references. It substitutes specific words, figures, and clauses across various laws including the Code of Civil Procedure, Code of Criminal Procedure, and the Indian Stamp Act.

metadata.title: The Salt Duties Ordinance, 1916
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides emergency powers to the Governor General in Council regarding excessive demands for salt duties on goods cleared from ships or warehouses. It authorizes Customs Officers to refuse clearance when duty payments are not made and establishes that no court shall question orders made under this legislation.

metadata.title: The Insolvency Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to insolvency in British India, excluding Scheduled Districts. It defines key terms such as 'debtor', 'creditor', and 'property' for the purposes of proceedings under the Act.

metadata.title: The Indian Trusts (Amendment) Act, 20 A.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Trusts Act, 1882 to regulate trustee investments in securities and annuity funds. It introduces restrictions on investing money after February 15, 1916, and allows trustees to retain capital stock purchased under specific conditions.

metadata.title: An Act to amend certain enactments and to repeal an enactment
metadata.repeals: The Assam Labour and Emigration (Amendment) Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing enactments, including the Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867, the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, and others. It also repeals The Assam Labour and Emigration (Amendment) Act, 1915.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, specifically adding provisions to Section 8 regarding local rules and decrees. It also addresses amendments related to Small Cause Courts under the Presidency Act of 1882.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 by adding provisos to section 8 and renumbering section 67. It empowers High Courts and Local Governments to declare or modify special rules regarding the sale of land in execution of decrees.

metadata.title: The Punjab Military Transport Animals Act, 1916
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Military Transport Animals Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act extends to the Punjab and provides for the impressment of animals, vehicles, and boats for military transport purposes. It establishes provisions for the appointment of officers, inspection procedures, and rules regarding the seizure and compensation for impressed property.

metadata.title: The Indian Companies Act (Amendment), 1913
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Companies Act of 1913 to require directors to disclose their direct or indirect interest in any contract or arrangement entered into by a company. It inserts new sections (83A, 83B, 91A, 91B, 91C, and 91D) to regulate director voting on interested contracts, the appointment of directors, and the consequences of failing to make required disclosures.

metadata.title: The Decentralization Act, 1914
metadata.amends: Various enactments specified in the Schedule (including The Bengal Land Revenue Sales Act, 1859; The Calcutta Pilots Act, 1859; The Madras District Police Act, 1859; The Police Act, 1861; The Waste-lands (Claims) Act, 1863; The Panjab Laws Act, 1872; The Madras Civil Courts Act, 1873; The Northern India Canal and Drainage Act, 1873; The European Vagrancy Act, 1874; The Chota Nagpur Incumbered Estates Act, 1876)
metadata.summary: This Act aims to decentralize and facilitate the administration of specific existing enactments by substituting references to the Board of Revenue or Financial Commissioner for the Local Government. It amends a list of specified laws from 1859 to 1876, replacing terms like 'sanction of the Governor General' with 'control of the Governor General' and transferring certain administrative powers.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain existing enactments and repeals other specific laws listed in its schedules. It ensures that the repeal does not affect rights, liabilities, or remedies already acquired under the repealed laws.

metadata.title: The Indian Copyright Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act modifies and adds to the provisions of the Indian Copyright Act, 1911. It applies to British India, including Baluchistan and the Sontal Parganas.

metadata.title: The Second Repealing and Amending Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments and repeals other specific enactments that are spent or unnecessary. It includes savings provisions to ensure that the repeal does not affect existing rights, liabilities, or past acts.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments listed in the First Schedule and repeals other enactments specified in the Second Schedule. It ensures that these changes do not affect past rights, liabilities, or established legal principles.

metadata.title: The Indian Extradition Act, 1913 (Amendment) Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Extradition Act of 1903 to clarify procedures regarding arrests and statements made by accused persons. It inserts specific wording into Section 7 concerning the roles of District Magistrates and Chief Presidency Magistrates in cases involving local governments.

metadata.title: The Official Trustees Act, 1913
metadata.repeals: Registration Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the office of Official Trustee and defines their powers, duties, and liabilities regarding property vested in them. It also outlines provisions for auditors, fees, and the appointment of Deputy Trustees.

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp Act (Amendment) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This document is an amendment to the Indian Stamp Act, 1899. It was enacted by the Governor General's Council and received assent on March 1st, 1912.

metadata.title: The Panjab Tenaney Amendment Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tenancy Act of 1887 by adding a proviso regarding suits cognizable under civil procedure. It specifies conditions for deciding matters in Civil Courts and outlines procedures for returning plaints to the Collector or proceeding with suits based on value and nature.

metadata.title: The Administrator General's Act, 1913
metadata.repeals: The Scindian Exchections Repealed Act
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the powers, duties, and liabilities of the Administrator General in Punjab regarding the administration of estates. It covers procedures for granting probate or letters of administration, auditing accounts, and handling unclaimed assets, while also repealing previous related legislation.

metadata.title: The Prisons Act (Amendment) Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prisons Act of 1894. It was promulgated by the Government of India in Punjab on April 8, 1910.

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp Act (Amendment) Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 to update stamp duties on bills of exchange and debentures. It introduces a graduated scale for certain transactions while exempting small amounts from duty enhancements.

metadata.title: THE PRESIDENCY-TOWNS INSOLVENCY ACT, 1909
metadata.summary: This Act governs appeals and proceedings related to insolvency in the Presidency-Towns of Punjab. It outlines the powers of courts, duties of insolvents, administration of property, and procedures for discharge.

metadata.title: The Explosive Substances Act, 1908
metadata.amends: The Indian Explosives Act, 1884; The Indian Arms Act, 1878; The Penal Code
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the law relating to explosive substances in British India to address inadequacies in existing legislation regarding accidents and crime prevention. It introduces severe penalties for causing explosions, attempting to cause explosions, or making and possessing explosive substances with unlawful intent.

metadata.title: The Indian Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1908
metadata.amends: The Code of Criminal Procedure, V of 1898
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the more speedy trial of certain offences and prohibits associations dangerous to public peace. It establishes a Special Bench composed of three Judges in High Courts for trying these specific cases.

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the limitation of suits, appeals, and certain applications in British India. It also provides rules for acquiring possession of easements and other property while repealing previous enactments on these subjects.

metadata.title: The Indian Registration Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This document promulgates amendments to the Indian Registration Act of 1903, received assent on December 18, 1908. It outlines procedures for presenting documents, registering wills, and enforcing the appearance of executants and witnesses.

metadata.title: The Indian Trusts Act (Amendment) Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the law relating to Private Trusts and Trustees in British India. It specifically substitutes clause (d) of section 20 of the Indian Trusts Act, 1882, to include securities for money issued by municipal bodies or trustees of presidency towns.

metadata.title: The Excise Act, 1906
metadata.repeals: The United Provinces Excise Law Amendment Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Excise Act of 1896 by adding a new definition for intoxicating drugs and modifying section 18 regarding possession limits. It also repeals specific provisions of the United Provinces Excise Law Amendment Act, 1904.

metadata.title: The Indian Coinage Act, 1906
metadata.repeals: The Indian Coinage Act, 1870; The Indian Coinage Act, 1893; The Indian Coinage Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes the dimensions and designs for gold, silver, nickel, and bronze coins to be issued by the Government of India. It establishes procedures for cutting diminished or defaced coins and defines when such coins remain a legal tender versus when they are considered counterfeit.

metadata.title: The Indian Merchant Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1906
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Merchant Shipping Act of 1859 to further regulate the law relating to merchant seamen. It specifically addresses provisions regarding shipping agreements and stipulations for crew discharge and return payments.

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp Act (Amendment) Act, 1906
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Stamp Act of 1899 to update stamp duties related to fire-insurance policies and receipts. It specifically addresses fees for original policies, renewals, and duplicate receipts based on the sum insured.

metadata.title: Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1906
