metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1894 to increase duties on imported spirits and liqueurs. The new rates are set to come into force one month after the Act is passed.

metadata.title: The Presidency Small Cause Courts Act, 1882
metadata.amends: The Presidency Small Cause Courts Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Presidency Small Cause Courts Act, 1882 to facilitate the insertion of specific words in section 28 and the substitution of provisions in section 69. It addresses procedures for drawing up statements of facts when questions arise regarding the merits of a suit or proceeding.

metadata.title: The Sindh Incumbered Estates (Amendment) Act, 1906
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Incumbered Estates Act, 1896 to alter specific clauses regarding profits and government revenue. It also repeals section 22 of the Bombay Act of 1879 as applied to this legislation.

metadata.title: The Court-fees (Amendment) Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Court-fees Act, 1870 by substituting specific words in section 2 regarding tenancy and immoveable property. It was enacted for general information following assent received on September 9, 1905.

metadata.title: The Punjab Canal Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act provides the Lieutenant-Governor of the Punjab with powers to construct canals, regulate water flow, and remove obstructions. It also establishes procedures for acquiring land, settling disputes, and levying water dues.

name: AN ACT TO REVIVE AND CONTINUE SECTION 8B OF THE INDIAN TARIFF ACT, 1894

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1904
metadata.repeals: The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1902
metadata.summary: This Act revives and continues section 8B of the Indian Tariff Act, 1894. It also repeals section 2 of the Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1902.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Credit Societies Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution, registration, and management of co-operative credit societies in British India. It establishes rules regarding membership qualifications, the powers of the Registrar, and the financial liabilities of members.

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (Amendment) Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 to clarify definitions regarding marketable securities and instruments used as security for loans. It also updates specific sections and Schedule I to adjust stamp duty classifications for leases, mortgages, pawn agreements, and pledges involving title deeds.

metadata.title: The Local Authorities Loan Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides further powers to local authorities in Punjab and its dependencies regarding the borrowing of money. It regulates conditions for loans where the total amount borrowed does not exceed a period fixed by any enactment for repayment.

metadata.title: The Military Police Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the Border Military Police Force in the North-West Frontier Province. It defines the force's constitution, appointment procedures, and outlines the powers and duties of its officers.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property (Amendment) Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 by substituting specific words in its sections regarding leases and registered instruments. It addresses provisions related to oral agreements accompanied by delivery of possession and modifications to section 107 concerning lease terms.

metadata.title: The Indian Electricity Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the supply of electrical energy for lighting and other purposes in British India. It establishes provisions for licensing, defining terms related to electricity supply, and setting rules regarding meters, charges, and the obligations of licensees.

metadata.title: The Indian Extradition Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to the extradition and rendition of fugitive criminals in cases involving foreign states. It also addresses the surrender of persons accused of offences committed at sea and applies provisions from the Fugitive Offenders Act, 1881.

metadata.title: The Indian Post Office Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Post Office Act of 1898. It was promulgated by the Governor General in Council and received assent on March 6, 1903.

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1894 by adding a new section 8C regarding the continuation of duties. It also specifies that Section 3 of the amended act will remain in force until March 31, 1904.

metadata.title: The Indian Works of Defence Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act provides for imposing restrictions on land in the vicinity of defence works to keep them free from buildings and obstructions. It also establishes procedures for determining compensation amounts, defining key terms like 'land' and 'person interested', and outlining the powers of the Court and Collector under the legislation.

metadata.title: The Indian Succession Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Succession Act, 1865 to extend the power to grant probates and letters of administration throughout British India. It inserts new sections and modifies existing provisions regarding the transmission of certificates between High Courts and District Judges.

metadata.title: The Provident Funds (Amendment) Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provident Funds Act of 1897 to provide further protection for deposits made by subscribers or depositors. It specifically addresses rules regarding compulsory deposits and the handling of funds in cases where a subscriber or depositor dies before a certain date.

metadata.title: The Punjab Court of Wards Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the Court of Wards in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'immoveable property' and 'ward', and establishes the powers of the Court of Wards and the Financial Commissioner regarding the superintendence of land-holders who are minors or otherwise incapable of managing their affairs.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act contains the Code of Civil Procedure for India, received assent on March 21, 1908. It outlines the jurisdiction of civil courts, procedures for instituting suits, execution of decrees, and rules regarding appeals.

name: AN ACT TO AMEND AND PROVIDE FOR THE FURTHER CONTINUANCE OF THE CURRENCY CONVERSION (ARMY ANNUAL) ACT, 1899

metadata.title: Act to amend and provide for the Conversion of Indian Currency
metadata.amends: Act to amend and provide for the Conversion of Indian Currency, 1899
metadata.repeals: Act to amend and provide for the Conversion of Indian Currency, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act amends and provides for the conversion of Indian currency. It repeals specific sections of the previous Act from 1899 regarding currency conversion.

name: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE COURT-FEE PAYABLE ON CERTAIN APPLICATIONS TO THE COURT OF THE FINANCIAL COMMISSIONER OF THE PUNJAB

metadata.title: The Punjab Courts Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Courts Act of 1884 by inserting a new section regarding court fees payable on applications. It specifically addresses the revisional jurisdiction of the Financial Commissioner under the Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887.

metadata.title: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Law of Evidence specifically regarding Bankers' Books. It substitutes a definition for 'company' in the relevant section of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.

metadata.title: The Prisoners Act
metadata.summary: This Act received the assent of the Governor-General on February 2, 1900. It contains provisions regarding the delivery of prisoners, execution of sentences, and powers related to licences for persons under penal servitude in the Presidency-towns.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better preservation and protection of certain portions of the Punjab territories, specifically focusing on mountain ranges, forests, streams (chos), and torrents. It empowers the Local Government to make orders regulating or prohibiting activities such as quarrying stone, cutting trees, collecting forest-produce, and admitting cattle into specific areas.

metadata.title: The Ancestral Land Alienation Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the period of limitation for suits concerning ancestral land and customary law regarding alienation in the Punjab. It clarifies specific expressions related to these topics within the context of the Indian Limitation Act, 1877.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the citation of specific enactments and makes formal amendments to others. It also expressly repeals certain other enactments that have become unnecessary or were not repealed by express provision.

metadata.title: The Arbitration Act
metadata.summary: This Act relates to arbitration and the appointment of arbitrators. It outlines the powers of arbitrators regarding awards, clerical mistakes, and vacancies.

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1897
metadata.repeals: Act V of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Reformatory Schools Act, 1870, and provides for the management of reformatory schools in the Punjab. It establishes rules regarding the licensing of youthful offenders, the duties of superintendents, and penalties for introducing prohibited articles.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894
metadata.repeals: The Land Acquisition Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the acquisition of land needed for public purposes or for companies. It defines key terms such as 'land', 'person interested', and 'Collector' within the context of the Punjab.

metadata.title: The Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to guardians and wards in British India, specifically extending to Punjab. It establishes provisions for the appointment, declaration, duties, and removal of guardians for minors, as well as the management of their property.

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1891
metadata.repeals: Various obsolete enactments listed in the First Schedule (e.g., Control of Officers in Assam, Indigo-contracts Act, Bengal Bonded Warehouse, etc.)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain obsolete enactments that have ceased to be in force or are unnecessary. It also provides for formal amendments to specific existing acts and includes savings clauses to protect rights acquired under repealed laws.

name: AN ACT TO AMEND THE INDIAN COMPANIES ACT, 1882

metadata.title: Act No. VI of 1887
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Companies Act of 1882 to establish specific priorities for paying debts during a company's winding-up. It grants priority to revenue, taxes, and salaries of clerks or servants rendered within two months before the commencement of winding-up, provided they do not exceed specified limits.

metadata.title: The General Clauses Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act provides general rules for the interpretation of Acts and regulations made by the Governor-General in Council. It defines specific terms used in legislation, such as 'ship', 'master', and 'local authority', and establishes procedures for making and publishing rules.

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.repeals: Act No. XI of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the constitution, jurisdiction, and procedure of Courts of Small Causes in British India. It repeals previous enactments regarding these courts and establishes rules for judges, decrees, and appeals.

metadata.title: The Indian Ports Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to ports and port charges in India. It establishes powers for local governments, defines roles for port officials, and sets regulations regarding vessel safety, dues, and penalties.

name: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT XXII OF 1881

metadata.title: The Excise Act, 1863
metadata.summary: This document amends the Excise Act by inserting new sections regarding police powers and court cognizance of offences. It also repeals specific words from existing sections related to salary thresholds and complaint procedures.

metadata.title: The Suits Valuation Act, 1887
metadata.repeals: The Court-fees Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes the method for determining the jurisdictional value of suits relating to land in British India. It repeals the relevant sections of the Court-fees Act, 1870, and establishes rules for valuing land interests to determine court fees and appellate jurisdiction.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Mines) Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the acquisition of land containing mines by the Local Government. It amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1870, to specifically address the working of mines and the prevention or restriction thereof when necessary for public purposes.

metadata.title: The Indian Explosives Act, 1884
metadata.repeals: Act XII of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, importation, transport, and use of explosives within Punjab and its dependencies. It empowers the Governor General in Council to make rules regarding licensing, fees, and prohibitions on dangerous activities related to explosives.

metadata.title: The Powers-of-Attorney Act
metadata.repeals: The Powers-of-Attorney Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to powers-of-attorney and repeals previous legislation from 1849 and 1866. It provides for the creation of instruments creating powers-of-attorney, including provisions regarding married women and trustees.

metadata.title: The Indian Trusts Act, 1882
metadata.repeals: Act II of 1871
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to private trusts and trustees in British India. It outlines the creation, duties, liabilities, and powers of trustees, as well as the rights of beneficiaries.

name: AN ACT TO AMEND THE LAND IMPROVEMENT ACT, 1871

metadata.title: The Land Improvement Act (Amendment), 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Improvement Act of 1871 to clarify legal doubts regarding its provisions. It specifically addresses the recovery of advances from borrowers, tenants, and sureties in cases involving land improvement charges.

name: AN ACT TO EXTEND THE CRIMINAL TRIBES ACT, 1871 (ACT VII OF 1876)

metadata.title: The Native Passenger Ships Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Criminal Tribes Act of 1871 to extend its provisions regarding registration and control over native passenger ships. It inserts specific clauses into existing sections to regulate agents, landowners, and occupiers in relation to these vessels.

name: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE MANAGEMENT OF THE PUBLIC MUSEUM OF CALCUTTA

metadata.title: The Land Improvement Act, 1871 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Improvement Act of 1871 to clarify the effects of certain provisions regarding land revenue and advances. It addresses doubts concerning the recovery of advances from borrowers, sureties, or tenants, and defines how such amounts are treated as arrears.

metadata.title: The Bhaunagar Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act regulates dramatic performances and public entertainments in the territory of Kathiawar, specifically addressing villages transferred from the Native State of Bhaunagar to British India. It empowers local governments to issue licenses for such events and authorizes magistrates to seize scenery and articles used in unauthorized performances.

metadata.title: The Bombay Municipal Debentures Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the transfer and consolidation of municipal debentures in Bombay. It provides powers for the Municipal Corporation to consolidate existing mortgages and regulates the appointment of new managers, stamp duties, and legal proceedings related to these instruments.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act governs the transfer of property, whether moveable or immovable, and defines various types of mortgages. It also outlines procedures for foreclosure, sale, and redemption of mortgaged properties.

metadata.title: The Dramatic Performances Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better control of public dramatic performances in British India. It empowers local governments and magistrates to prohibit performances that are obscene, defamatory, or likely to cause disaffection.

metadata.title: The Indian Merchant Seamen's Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to merchant seamen in India. It establishes penalties for distressing seamen, desertion, and disobedience of orders.

metadata.title: The Native Coinage Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the coinage of Native States in British India, declaring that coins struck with the authority of such states shall be legal tender. It establishes conditions regarding metal fineness, weight, and devices for coins issued under this legislation.

metadata.title: The Opium Act, 1876
metadata.repeals: Acts No. XI of 1840, No. XXI of 1856, No. X of 1871, Act VII of 1836, S. 1, and Regulations XXII of 1880
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to opium in British India. It defines key terms such as 'opium' and outlines regulations regarding the cultivation, manufacture, possession, importation, exportation, and sale of opium.

metadata.title: The Native Passenger Ships Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to native passenger ships within British India. It extends to the whole of British India and applies to specific vessels, including those sailing to or from ports in the Red Sea.

metadata.title: The Repealing Act, 1876
metadata.repeals: Various Acts of the Governor-General in Council listed in Schedules I and II (e.g., IX of 1835, XIX of 1838, XXIX of 1838, VI of 1840, etc.)
metadata.summary: This document is an excerpt from the Punjab Gazette dated April 20, 1876, containing a Repealing Act titled 'The Repealing Act, 1876'. The text lists numerous previous Acts of the Governor-General in Council that are being repealed or partially amended, along with the specific sections and words affected by this repeal.

metadata.title: THE SINDH INCUMBERED ESTATES ACT, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to Jagirdars and Zamindars in Sindh who are burdened by debts and liens on their immovable property. It establishes a scheme for the inquiry into debts, the order of management of estates, and the subsequent proceedings including liquidation or restoration of ownership.

metadata.title: The Stage Carriage Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stage Carriage Act of 1861 to extend its provisions to carriages drawn by horses, oxen, or other animals. It ensures that expressions and provisions regarding conveyance apply uniformly across India.

metadata.title: The Indian Oaths Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to oaths and affirmations in British India. It provides for the administration of these by authorized persons and interpreters, while also addressing objections based on religious grounds.

name: NORTHERN INDIA CANAL AND DRAINAGE ACT, 1873

metadata.title: The Northern Drainage Canal Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Acts relating to irrigation, navigation and drainage in Northern India
metadata.summary: This Act regulates irrigation, navigation, and drainage in Northern India. It establishes procedures for water supply, claims for compensation, and penalties for offenses related to canal usage.

metadata.title: The Oudh Land Revenue Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stage Carriages Act of 1861 to exclude carriages drawn by camels or oxen from its provisions. It also serves as a comprehensive statute for land revenue administration in Oudh, covering settlement procedures, assessment rules, record maintenance, and fee structures.

metadata.title: The Repeal Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain obsolete enactments and statutes that are no longer necessary. It ensures that the repeal does not affect existing rights, remedies, or procedures established by prior laws.

metadata.title: The Indian Christian Marriage Act, 1872
metadata.repeals: Enactments repealed
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the solemnization and registration of marriages for Native Christians in Punjab. It establishes procedures for obtaining certificates, publishing notices, and registering marriages performed by ministers or registrars.

metadata.title: The Panjab Laws Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to marriage registration, civil and criminal judicature, land revenue, insolvency, and police matters in Punjab. It also includes provisions regarding local customs, pre-emption rights, and the control of armed men and foreign vagrants.

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the limitation of suits and appeals in British India. It also provides for other purposes such as applications to courts and inquiries into ownership following possession.

metadata.title: The Indian Income-tax Act
metadata.repeals: Act XII of 1871
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition and collection of income tax in British India. It outlines duties on offices, powers regarding trustees, and provisions for deductions and indemnity.

name: AN ACT FOR THE SUPPRESSION OF MURDEROUS OUTRAGES IN CERTAIN DISTRICTS OF THE PUNJAB

metadata.title: The Fanatics Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the trial of offences committed by fanatics in certain districts of Punjab, including murder and attempted murder. It establishes that upon conviction, the offender's property shall be forfeited to the Government and outlines procedures for holding inquests into deaths resulting from these acts.

name: AN ACT RELATING TO MESNE PROFITS AND TO IMPROVEMENTS MADE BY HOLDERS UNDER DEFECTIVE TITLES IN CASES

metadata.title: The Act relating to holders under defective titles
metadata.summary: This Act secures the value of improvements made by bona fide holders under defective titles in cases where English law applies. It entitles such persons to compensation for buildings or improvements if they are evicted, or allows them to purchase the land interest at its value.

name: AN ACT TO ENABLE EXECUTORS, ADMINISTRATORS OR REPRESENTATIVES TO SUE AND BE SUED FOR CERTAIN WRONGS

metadata.title: The Act No. XII of 1855
metadata.summary: This Act enables executors, administrators, or representatives of a deceased person to sue and be sued for certain wrongs committed during the deceased's lifetime. It allows actions to be maintained against these representatives if the wrong caused pecuniary loss to the estate and was committed within one year before death.

name: AN ACT TO PROVIDE COMPENSATION TO FAMILIES FOR LOSS OCCASIONED BY THE DEATH OF A PERSON CASUED BY ACTIONABLE WRONG

metadata.title: The Fatal Accidents Act, 1855
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the recovery of damages caused by the wrongful act, neglect, or default of a person resulting in death. It ensures that an action for compensation can be maintained against the wrongdoer despite the death of the injured party, with proceeds benefiting the deceased's family.

name: PUNJAB UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY RASUL (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab University of Technology Rasul (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab University of Technology Rasul Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab University of Technology Rasul Act, 2018 to update the institution's name and scope. It specifically changes references from 'Technology Rasul' to 'Rasul, Mandi Baha Uddin' and expands the fields of study in Section 4 to include engineering, sciences, management, and related areas.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to introduce provisions for rewarding whistleblowers and officials who report tax evasion, fraud, or corruption. It establishes procedures for sanctioning rewards from penalties imposed on offenders and defines specific conditions under which claims for such rewards may be rejected.

metadata.title: The Punjab Vagrancy (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958 to include definitions for 'organizer' and 'person' (including transgender persons). It substitutes sections regarding punishment for organizing or employing individuals to solicit alms, jurisdiction over offences, and provisions on cognizance and bail.

metadata.title: The Court Fees Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the levy of court fees in High Courts, Small Cause Courts, and other original courts within British India. It outlines procedures for fee assessment, exemptions, stamping requirements, and the recovery of unpaid fees.

name: PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974 to update definitions regarding protected areas, captive animals, and animal cruelty. It also introduces new roles such as the Chief Wildlife Ranger and Prosecutor, while omitting specific sections of the original 1974 Act.

metadata.title: The Punjab Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Punjab Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2019 to update definitions and procedures regarding the Employees' Social Security Institution. It substitutes specific terms throughout the original Act, inserts new clauses concerning collection charges and essential commodity purchases, and transfers pending appeals to the new institution.

metadata.title: The Sitara International University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sitara International University in the private sector with its main campus in Faisalabad. It defines the university's structure, including a Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various faculties such as Medicine, Engineering, and Law.

metadata.title: The South Hill University Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the South Hill University as a private sector institution with its main campus located in Multan. It defines the university's structure, including the Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various academic bodies, while outlining its functions such as providing instruction across multiple faculties and conducting research.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to update provisions regarding valuation appeals and refund procedures. It also substitutes specific wording in existing sections and inserts a new section concerning refunds for persons unable to claim them due to detention or hospitalization.

name: SUGARCANE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Sugarcane Research and Development Board Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the Sugarcane Research and Development Board, establishing it as a body corporate with headquarters in Lahore. It outlines the composition of the Board, including members from government departments, universities, research institutes, and the farming sector, along with their nomination processes.

metadata.title: The Times Institute, Multan (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Times Institute, Multan Act, 2020 to rename the institution as Times University, Multan and change its status from an institute to a university. It further updates governance structures by substituting 'Rector' with 'Vice Chancellor', modifying Board composition requirements, and establishing specific provisions for the Vice Chancellor's appointment and functions.

metadata.title: The Times University, Multan (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Times University, Multan Act, 2020 to update various sections regarding campus openings, appointments, and governance structures. It also introduces a new University Endowment Fund for sustainable revenue and adds indemnity provisions for university authorities acting in good faith.

metadata.title: The Suthra Punjab Authority Ordinance 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Suthra Punjab Authority to manage an integrated system for solid waste collection, recycling, and safe disposal. It aims to improve sanitation services, promote waste-to-energy initiatives, and protect public health across the Province of Punjab.

metadata.title: The Universities and Institutes Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to universities and institutes in both the public and private sectors within the Punjab. Specifically, it updates provisions regarding the nomination of members from the Provincial Assembly to these institutions.

metadata.title: The University of White Rock, Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of White Rock as a private sector university with its main campus in Lahore. It provides for the university's corporate status, organizational structure, functions, and powers to conduct courses, hold examinations, and award degrees.

name: UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY, CULTURE AND HEALTH SCIENCES, GUJRANWALA ACT 2025

metadata.title: The University of Technology, Culture and Health Sciences, Gujranwala Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Technology, Culture and Health Sciences, Gujranwala as a body with perpetual succession in the private sector. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and various faculties such as Pharmacy and Computer Science.

metadata.title: Punjab Bait-ul-Mal Act, 1991
metadata.summary: The document establishes the Punjab Bait-ul-Mal as an autonomous body created in 1989 via Ordinance and later formalized by this Act in 1991. It outlines the ideological basis of social welfare, the structure of the Bait-ul-Mal Council headed by an Ameen, and the creation of District Bait-ul-Mal Committees for equitable fund distribution.

name: PUNJAB INFORMATION OF TEMPORARY RESIDENTS ORDINANCE 2015 [URDU VERSION]

metadata.title: Ordinance for Information of Temporary Residents Punjab 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework for collecting and maintaining a database of information regarding migrants and temporary residents in the Punjab province. It mandates that owners, landlords, and hoteliers provide specific details about tenants and guests to the police within strict timeframes to aid in terrorism prevention and criminal investigations.

metadata.title: Ordinance (Amendment) Punjab Ordinance 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends Section 13 of the Pakistan Ordinance 1965 to define specific offences related to weapons, ammunition, and explosives. It establishes penalties including imprisonment terms ranging from two to fifteen years and forfeiture of seized property depending on the type and quantity of weapons possessed or transported.

name: THE PUNJAB LOUD SPEAKER REGULATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015 [URDU VERSION]

metadata.title: Sound System (Regulation) Ordinance, Punjab 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Province of Punjab to prevent public mischief and unrest. It prohibits the use of sound systems that cause nuisance, distress, or interfere with the peace and safety of persons in the vicinity, particularly near places of worship and residential areas.

name: THE PUNJAB LOUD SPEAKER REGULATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015 [URDU VERSION]

metadata.title: Ordinance (Regulation) Sound Systems Punjab 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Punjab province to prevent subversive activities, maintain public peace, and ensure public order. It prohibits unnecessary noise, defines specific restrictions on usage near places of worship and other sensitive locations, and outlines penalties for violations including imprisonment and fines.

name: THE PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF EXPRESSING MATTERS ON WALLS(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2015 [URDU VERSION]

metadata.title: Prohibition of Expression of Opinion on Walls Ordinance (Amendment) Punjab 2015
metadata.amends: Prohibition of Advertisements on Walls Act, Punjab 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Prohibition of Advertisements on Walls Act, Punjab 1995 to increase fines and introduce police arrestability for offenses. It was promulgated by the Governor of Punjab under Article 128(1) of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly had not met.

name: THE PUNJAB SECURITY OF VULNERABLE ESTABLISHMENT ORDINANCE 2015 [URDU VERSION]

metadata.title: Non-Secure Institutions Security Ordinance, Punjab 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes measures to ensure security for non-secure and vulnerable institutions within the Punjab province. It creates a Security Advisory Committee responsible for identifying vulnerable sites, issuing security advisories, and conducting annual inspections. The document defines specific security arrangements required, such as CCTV monitoring and biometric systems, and outlines the powers of the District Coordination Officer to declare institutions as vulnerable.

name: PENAL CODE QALAT (WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960

metadata.title: Criminal Procedure Code of the State of Qalat (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: Criminal Procedure Code of the State of Qalat, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Criminal Procedure Code of the State of Qalat, 1951, to further regulate the delegation of judicial powers. It authorizes the Government of West Pakistan to delegate the powers of a Magistrate and the authority for investigation and prosecution to Special Magistrates.

metadata.title: Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1951, to update terminology and definitions regarding magistrates and district courts in West Pakistan. It replaces references to 'District Magistrate' with specific grades, substitutes 'Prime Minister' with 'Government of West Pakistan', and alters sentencing powers and jurisdictional boundaries.

metadata.title: The Punjab Lands Improvement Tax Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Lands Improvement Tax Ordinance, 1975 (Punjab Ordinance No. I of 1975)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a specific tax on certain lands situated in local areas within the Punjab. It establishes a tax rate of Rs. 3-75 per acre per annum for a period of 12 years and outlines the manner of collection and recovery of arrears.

name: PUNJAB WATER AND SANITATION AUTHORITY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority to develop, operate, and maintain water supply and sanitation systems in the province. It also aims to conserve groundwater and manage water resources across specified districts in Punjab.

name: ASSET MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY OF PUNJAB ORDINANCE 2026

metadata.title: The Asset Management Authority of Punjab Ordinance 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Asset Management Authority of Punjab to effectively manage and utilize government assets. It aims to attract investment, undertake economic projects with private partners, generate revenue, and improve service delivery.

name: ALI BIN USMAN INSTITUTE, MULTAN ACT 2025

metadata.title: Ali Bin Usman Institute, Multan Act 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ali Bin Usman Institute, Multan as a private sector body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the institute's structure, including its Patron, Board, and various faculties, while defining its functions to provide education, training, and research across multiple disciplines.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION, CURRICULUM, TRAINING AND ASSESSMENT AUTHORITY ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Punjab Education, Curriculum, Training and Assessment Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Education, Curriculum, Training and Assessment Authority to coordinate educational standards in the province. It aims to transform and innovate education by managing curriculum development, textbook creation, student assessments, teacher training, and monitoring regimes.

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to incorporate digital land record systems and update definitions for officials like Kanungo and Patwari. It also modifies provisions regarding the service of summons and the appointment duties of revenue officers.

metadata.title: The Punjab Locum Hiring Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to ensure quality healthcare services by facilitating the availability of specialized human resources on a temporary or contract basis. It creates a Locum Policy Committee to oversee hiring processes, define terms and conditions for locum staff, and manage deficiencies in specific medical specialties.
